The apartment is right near columbus circle so in a perfect position, near the metro and Times Square so i really advice it for then position. We were welcome by a girl but after that we have never seen the owner so you have practically the house all for you (your room and the bathroom; we never used the kitchen). The room is just what you need as you probably will be always outside and use it just to sleep.

Die Lage der Wohnung ist phantstisch! Central Park, 5th ave, Times Square, Empire States Building etc. sind innerhalb von 5 - 15min zu Fuß zu erreichen. Das Essensangebot in der Umgebung ist reichhaltig. Direkt gegenüber ist eine Parkgarage - interessant für Mietwagennehmer.
Die Wohnung selbst riecht sauber, die Böden, die Toiette und das Waschbecken waren stets picobello.
Die Wohnung befindet sich allerdings in einem stark renovierungsbedürftigen Zustand. Dies betrifft vor allem das Bad mit starkem Schimmelbefall rund um die schlecht funktionierende Dusche, sowie das desolate Gästezimmer. Die Wände sind rissig und fleckig. Die Sauberkeit rund um Mikrowelle und Kühlschrank laden nicht zur Essenszubereitung ein. Die Möbel haben ihre besten Zeiten längst hinter sich. Die Kopfkissen riechen wie das Basecap eines Teenagers. Bettenbezüge waren wahrscheinlich gewaschen, trotzdem voller Flecken. Wir haben uns eigene Kopfkissen und neue Bettwäsche gekauft. Fazit: wem der Zustand der Wohnung egal ist, und kein Problem mit Schimmel im Bad hat, sollte sich sein eigenes Bettzeug mitbringen und die tolle Lage der Wohnung genießen! Shunichi scheint ein ordentlicher Typ zu sein, obwohl wir Ihn nicht persönlich angetroffen hatten. Er war zwar ab und zu anwesend, scheint aber nicht am Kontakt mit seinen Gästen interessiert zu sein. Abolut O.K. für uns! Seine Katze ist jedenfalls supersüß und sehr viel kontaktfreudiger ;-)

We loved the host's helpfulness and location, but not so much the lack of cleanliness in our room and the bathroom. The picture on Airbnb is quite misleading in this aspect. Though there were many amenities (fridge, TV, heater etc) in the room, they were all overed with thick layers of dust. The whole place smelled musty. The shelves were grimy, we had to wipe them down ourselves. There was also lots of hair strands on the duvet, but thankfully no bugs. There is also no lift, so if you have large luggage, it's quite a hassle up the stairs.

If the actual room had matched the clean looking Airbnb photo, we would not have taken issue. I hope that the host will either maintain a better upkeep of the room and bathroom for future guests.

Shunichi war ein sehr freundlicher Host, aber die Wohnung war nicht wirklich einladend. Im Bad war sehr starker Schimmelbefall und unter sauber versteht man auch etwas anderes. Auch die Dusche war nicht wirklich zufriedenstellend , da die Temperatureinstellung nicht richtig funktionierte.Das Zimmer war auch nicht wirklich besser. Es befindet sich in einem stark renovierungsbedürftigen Zustand. Flecken an der Decke, dreckige Wände und auch auch der Bereich, wo der Kühlschrank und die Mikrowelle stehen, ist sehr keimig. Leider hatten wir im frisch bezogenem Bett ( wir hoffen es zumindest ) sowie auf den Überdecken lange dunkle Haare. Shunichi war aber so freundlich und hat die Decken dann ausgetauscht. Auch unter dem Bett waren Ansammlungen von Haaren :-/
Die Lage der Wohnung ist aber perfekt.
Wem Schimmel und Unsauberkeit nichts ausmacht, kann hier günstig unterkommen.

Shunichi is a very thoughtful person. Too bad we didn't spend so much time with him (we stayed one night). But he planned everything for our stay in the bedroom he prepared for us.
It was near everything in Manhattan (especially time square and hell's kitchen).
It was perfect for our short trip.

I stayed here with 2 of my friends for 2 days. The booking was for 2 people, but we had a last min change of plan and Shunichi was nice enough to accommodate 3 of us.

The place, however, was not at all like the description/photos. It was an ok neighborhood, the stairs to the place were extremely dusty and smelly. The room was also very dusty and old. They also have a cat which was not mentioned. I am prone to allergies, and ended up having a running nose during the trip. Both me and my friend had sore throats by the end of it.

We didn't use the kitchen at all, but it didn't seem very inviting either. The bathroom was just ok. I would probably not book that place again.

Clean and large room. The location of the apt was superb! Really convenient if you want to catch Broadway shows. There are also lots of good food in the area. Shunichi was a very accommodating and polite host.

Shunichi was kind from the little interaction I had with him.
The only issue I had with the listing was that the room was dusty and smelly.
Also the room has a separate blower heater(not central heating), that needs to be kept on at all times in current weather conditions.
Laurie was extremely responsive and hospitable.  It's a great place to stay in Brooklyn!
Laurie's house is lovely. I enjoyed time reading, eating and just sitting in the garden. Great walking and close to subway and restaurants, coffee shops, etc. A great slice of Brooklyn!

Laurie’s Haus ist sehr ruhig gelegen und laurie gibt sich die größte Mühe alles angenehm und hilfreich zu gestalten. Vorab gibt es ein tolles booklet dass schon fast ein Reiseführer ist. Die Zimmer sind ausreichend groß und es ist alles sauber. Und sogar Frühstück wird angeboten-die cream cheese bagel waren großartig. Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit und würden immer wieder kommen.
憧れのタウンハウス。古いお家というのは事実だけど、そこがまた良かった。過剰な干渉もなく、朝ごはんも自分で自由に食べれて、色んなアドバイスも貰える。駅にも近いし、街並みも最高。是非また泊まりたい。
Laurie is a super host, we had a wonderful time in her house!

We had a great time. The neighbourhood is great, a lot of different restaurants and very close to all the things to do in Manhattan and surroundings. The place is very cosy and warm styled. Laurie had a booklet with a lot of tips to eat and go to.

It was a great stay. Its perfect located in a great neighborhood with a lot of shops, bras, and restaurants around you. The house and the room is also very clean. The communication with the host is simply and fast. She also can help you with tips and a driver if you need.

The house is at a perfect location in park slope, one of the best neighbourhoods of brooklyn. Lots of restaurants and bars nearby. Also the subway station is one block away. In 25 minutes in mid-town manhattan. The house has a nice atmosphere and  is very clean. Lots of suggestions by our host for activities to do in NY.

Laurie's package of info is a wealth of info. And, of course, so is she! Whatever you need or are seeking, she has suggestions to help make this happen. Convenient location with lots of space. Ideal place to explore Park Slope.
Très facile d’accès

Laurie was so kind and offered my friend and me because of the Covid 19 situation the apartment (flat)  instead of the room we booked. The apartment is very cosy and furnished with love. The area Park Slope is full of nice shops and restaurants. The booklet Laurie send us was very useful. Thank you :)

My situation was unique in that I stayed in Laurie's beautiful old home during a quarantine in preparation for my son's wedding. I had the place mostly to myself, but the location and the space was perfect. It was quiet and close to plenty of food and wine needs. Her cats - Batman and Robin - kept me company and kept me from missing my own furry babies back home. I especially enjoyed the back garden on a cool afternoon. As quarantines go, it was pretty nice!
Great place to stay and great hospitality!
Beautiful home and great location. Laurie is super welcoming and helpful. Would absolutely stay again in a heartbeat!

The space was beautiful and communication with the host is easy. There are particular rules around usage in the common areas, bathroom, and kitchen so just be in contact with the host to get clarity on that before arriving.
What an amazing and thoughtful spot and host! This is one of those special places where you truly feel a part of Brooklyn. Laurie was an amazing host!

Laurie was gracious and accommodating.  She made things easy and provides a detailed listing of restaurants and points of interest in NYC.  Location is great.  She has a beautiful garden in the premises I didn't get to enjoy as I spent most of the time with my family who lives in North Park Slope

Laurie’s place is very charming/whimsical, and the location can’t be beat. Lots of fun cafes and things to explore within walking distance. The back patio is also very cute and a great place to unwind after a busy day in the city. Laurie is a friendly and helpful host, and her two cats were very friendly co-hosts too!

Laurie's place is a gem in Brooklyn, and is a genuinely warm and homey place. I enjoyed having breakfast with the cats and sharing in small talk with the other guests when I wanted, though I had full privacy when I needed that too.

Laurie's house is as pictured. She goes to great lengths to meet and know her guests. She is extremely knowledgeable about the neighborhood and is happy to share. Very safe neighborhood with great shops and food. If you want to be in Brooklyn, this is  where you want to stay.
Gracious hostess who is enthusiastic and very knowledgeable about Park Slope.
Laurie is a fantastic host, she makes you feel right at home. I do hope to visit again soon.

The location is definitely fantastic and is the reason we choose to stay here. They are very quiet so you feel almost like they're not there.
Unfortunately, everything else (whilst as described) is pretty ordinary.
There was no one to meet us despite advising previously of our arrival time to JFK. We had to wait in the freezing cold for around 45mins and then when his friend got there to let us in, we had to wait while they prepared the room. They didn't change the top two blankets which was a bit gross. There was also a general unclean smell throughout.
The internet is slow (when it's working) and the shower is truly awful - you either get third degree burns or pneumonia.
It's a shame because the setup is pretty good, and the place could be brilliant with a bit of TLC - but then it would definitely cost a lot more.
In general, location is unbeatable but the accommodation itself isn't great.

Shunichi war ein höflicher und zurücknehmender Gastgeber. Der Raum ist einfach und funktional eingerichtet. Das Bett ist bequem und ich habe - trotz der Straßengeräusche - gut geschlafen. Die zentrale Lage in fußläufiger Entfernung von Central Park und Time Square ist ein toller Startpunkt für die Erkundung von Manhattan. Ich würde wieder kommen.
I had little interactions with my host but he was nice and helpful when I did speak with him. Great and convenient neighbourhood.

Although we checked in during the middle if the day, Shunichi graciously arranged for his housekeeper to let us in while he was working. The room and bathroom were very clean.  Although our schedules never coincided for us to meet, everything was just as expected and even more considerations, like extra bathroom necessities in our room if we had forgotten anything, tea and a hot water kettle, etc.  I will definitely consider staying again and will recommend to others.

The host couldn't make me feel like in home because we were almost all the time outside knowing New York. But the neighborhood was very comfortable and the location of the room is convenient. I think that this is a good room for summer (because heating is not working very much) and if you want a room in Manhattan near some of the best attractions and at good price

Veldig hyggelig husvert som lar deg komme å gå som du vil.
Sentralt beliggende i midtown, og nær Central Park og Subway.
Jeg trivdes veldig bra!
Internettet kan være raskere, især om man vil sitte på skrivebordet å jobbe er nettet veldig treigt!

Ellers enn det, var dette et perfekt sted å bo for meg da jeg skulle hit for å jobbe og søke inspirasjon.
5 stjerner!

Sunichi was very hospitable, kind and friendly. The room was like the photo: comfortable bed to sleep and some basic utensils in case you want to eat some take away food. Both the room and the bathroom were clean. The apartament and host were very quiet. If we come back to nyc we'd consider staying there again

El cuarto bien, practicamente no estas en la casa. Shunichi no se siente, es como estar solo en el departamento. Lo mejor es la ubicacion y la calefaccion, lo peor la limpieza, hay bastante polvo.
El baño un poco deteriorado pero se puede usar a la perfeccion, la cocina no la usamos.
La zona es buenisima, con varios lugares para ir a comer y varias lineas de subte. Nosotros eramos dos y estabamos bien, si sos uno te sobra. El placard es enorme y la cama comoda.
El WIFI no anda a la perfección pero te podes comunicar.
Las cerraduras de la entrada del edificio son un desastre, muy difícil abrir la puerta, mas que nada la segunda.
Recomiendo esta habitacion dependiendo lo que busques, si es lujo aqui no lo vas a encontrar.
Pero si vas a conocer NY y no estas nunca en la habitacion, solo para dormir, mas que recomendado.

The fourth well, almost not at home. Shunichi not feel, it's like being alone in the apartment. The best is the location and heating, cleaning worst, there is enough dust.
Bathroom a bit run down but can be used perfectly, the kitchen did not use it.
The area is lovely, with several places to go to eat and several subway lines. We were two and we were well, if you're one spare. The closet is huge and comfortable bed.
The WIFI does not go perfectly, but you can you communicate.
The locks on the building entrance are a mess, very difficult to open the door, but nothing the second.
I recommend this room depending how you look, if you fancy here you will not find.
But if you go to NY and never know you are in the room, only to sleep, more than recommende

My mom and I stayed on the top floor of Laurie's house for 3 days. Its in a great location, really can't beat it! It was a great place to have as a home base while apartment hunting all over brooklyn. There were 3 other people staying at the house, so depending on you level of covid concerns you may want to find a less communal airbnb.

Fantastic experience with a tremendous host!  Laurie gave us great suggestions for things to see, do, and places to eat.  Close to subway and Prospect Park.  Beautiful backyard garden along with a couple of feline super heroes named Batman and Robin!  This was our first Airbnb experience and it didn't disappoint!!
Laurie is a gracious host, happy to help, very generous with her time, always offering food.  The house is lovely and the neighborhood fantastic.  This is a great deal for the price.

The location of this listing is superb. The host, Laurie, was responsive and easy to communicate with. She provided a helpful online brochure and made great dining suggestions and transportation advice. However, the photos were not truly reflective of the condition of the housing -- there was much deferred maintenance that included loose interior/exterior stair threads and railings, peeling paint on bedroom ceilings, leaks from roof hatch, etc. This became very apparent as it rained frequently during our stay.  No less, we appreciated Laurie's candor and assistance.

This is a beautiful old house. It is in Park Slope which is a really nice part of Brooklyn. We put our car in a paid garage for $100 for 3 days. It was easy to get to Manhattan by subway and it was about 20 to SoHo. Laurie has a depth of knowledge about the restaurants and bars in Park Slope and is happy to make recommendations. We had to go a little further for a restaurant that serves organic and it's generally very pricey here. We enjoyed walking around Brooklyn and even caught some music in the nearby park.
The place was very comfortable and lovely. The location is great and Laurie was a great host.
Great location with walking access to the park slope area of Brooklyn.  Everything was as advertised and I am likely to be back.

Grab it! Comfortable bed. Spacious, well designed room in an historic house. Laurie is a an experienced host and a terrific resource for everything Brooklyn/NYC.   Perfect location with access to multiple subway lines plus every type of restaurant and store you might need.
great location, excellent host, good advice.

This wonderful house is full of unique and very New York spirit - warm, stylish, with strong character and fantastic Hostess! If you want to have an authentic Brooklyn experience and have a taste of that disappearing New York, Laurie's House is what you need.

Good guest house if you plan to stay in the Park Slope area
it’s a good location close to many restaurants and different attraction in the neighbourhood.

Prospect Park in my humble opinion is the best!

Thanks Laurie

Excellent location and a great, knowledgeable host for the area. Whether focusing on the Brooklyn area or looking for a good base point for the city, this location is prime. Understand there are some rules to the house that may cause small inconvenience, but understand this is a single room and you should always respect those around you. Definitely a good place to stay, we would do it again if available the next time around.

Laurie’s place is a funky/whimsical place and in a great location loaded with interesting artwork and appointments. Laurie was a great help and attentive to our unique needs, being newcomers to the area, especially in advice about local transportation. She provides a booklet with a veritable travel guide to restaurants, pubs, art museums, happenings, etc. While there are communal spaces and cute kittys, we never felt crowded.

We were visiting family a few blocks away, so we were not able to enjoy the kitchen or sitting areas, but they looked inviting, especially that back yard! Advice would be to edit the booklet regarding entry, but Laurie is responsive to your requests. As seniors, we were prepared for the stairways, and if you are a senior, it is a climb! The bed was a bit hard on the back, but all the linens and toweling were perfect. If you prefer funk over sterile hotel rooms, this is your place, and at a very fair price for Park Slope!

Great location for walking to restaurants and the park. Beautiful neighborhood and home. Nice clean bathroom with everything you could need. Laurie gave great recommendations and had lots of information to look through if needed. Wish I could live there!
Laurie is a very welcoming host and provides good suggestions for things to do and places to eat/shop.  Her home is conveniently located within the Park Slope neighborhood.

My stay with Laurie can only be described as stellar.  Her home is beautiful and very comfortable. The online booklet she provided was very thorough and helpful. Along with other information, the booklet provided directions to her home, information about the property, things to do nearby and spot-on dining recommendations. Laurie is a delightful host. You can't do better than this.

Unsere Reise war überragend.
Wir wurden zur abgesprochenen Zeit im Appartement empfangen.
Der Vermieter war sehr nett und zuvorkommend während der ganzen Zeit.
Das Zimmer und Bad entsprachen den Fotos und waren sauber und gut ausgestattet.
Die Lage ist Perfekt für eine NYC Reise. Wir konnten vom JFK Airport direkt mit der Subway bis ca 400m vom Appartement fahren.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder dieses Zimmer mieten.

Partiamo dall'aspetto principale che rende la valutazione di questo appartamento positiva: la zona era semplicemente perfetta! In meno di 5 minuti a piedi si arriva a Central Park o a due differenti fermate della metro.
Per il resto l'appartamento è piccolo, spesso odora di chiuso e, non si può definire sporco, ma quanto meno poco curato e anche poco accogliente. Tutto sommato però se si usa solo ed esclusivamente come base per andare a dormire vale affidarsi al prezzo e alla convenienza della zona.
Per quanto riguarda Shunichi, è molto disponibile anche se molto riservato, per avere una conversazione con lui è necessario andare a bussare alla sua porta (ognuno valuti se sia un elemento positivo o meno!), ma per ogni problema è disponibile.
Le regole della casa, in conclusione, permetterebbero l'utilizzo della cucina in qualsiasi motivo lui non sia in casa. Noi siamo stati una settimana intera e lo abbiamo sempre trovato in casa, per cui se la vostra idea è quella di avere la possibilità di cucinare non vi consiglio questo appartamento. In caso contrario un po' alla buona, ma la posizione è ottima!
For my first bnb experience, I thought this was wonderful! Cozy little room in New York right next to central park. Our host was nice and helpful and made sure everything was set up for our arrival.

Shunichi actually was away while we stayed so we didn't get to meet him really. He had a friend there to let us in and there was no issues with communication or the check in process.
The location is amazing, unbeatable for the price. The room has everything you need.
The room was neat and tidy although I think a new set of bed sheets are needed.
We would definitely stay again.
Listing accurate-shared bathroom with host. Walking distance to many tourist sights. Good neighborhood. Host was available for questions and helpful with meeting us and working around our schedule.

Gracias Shunichi por hospedarnos!
El barrio es seguro, perfecta ubicacion con lugares accesibles para desayunar, almorzar o cenar. Hay farmacias y despensas muy cerca.
El cuarto es justo para dos personas, hay una heladera, microondas, pava electrica, tv y vajilla. La cama es doble, y se nos entregaron sabanas y toallas.
Shunichi es tranquilo y servicial.
Si buscas lujo, no es el lugar, si solo vas para tener un lugar donde dejar las cosas, salir todo el día y volver a dormir, la relacion costo beneficio, es positiva.
Muchas gracias!
Thank you S! to be our host. Everything was ok. Your house is a place to be in vacation! See you soon!

El anfitrión estuvo presente en el departamento todas las noches, pero en ningún momento tuvo contacto con nosotros, no se presentó y no nos dió la bienvenida, lo que fue bastante raro e incómodo. Fue una convivencia tranquila.
A partir del cuarto día de nuestra estadía, el wifi dejó de funcionar y estuvimos sin internet hasta el último día.
Las fotos publicadas no coinciden con el estado real de la habitación y departamento. El departamento se encuentra muy sucio, con acumulación de cosas en los espacios comunes, está desordenado y muy deteriorado, con mobiliarios rotos en la habitación, enchufes con los cables saliendo para afuera, el piso sucio y todo rayado, las ventanas sucias, la cajonera también rota. No es un lugar habitable, no volvería bajo ninguna circunstancia. De hecho las fotos publicadas al momento de mi reserva eran otras, las de ahora se ven mucho peor y la realidad es aún peor. El baño sucio, el agua de la ducha fue imposible de graduar, o fría o hirviendo, y mala presión de agua. La cocina nada que ver con la foto, muy sucia, con cantidad de cosas acumuladas, tierra y olor. Muy desagradable en general. El departamento está abandonado, sucio, desordenado, deteriorado. A pesar de pasar todo el día afuera y de la buena ubicación, no se justifica reservar este departamento para dormir, es imposible bañarse, usar el baño cómodo y dormir tranquilo debido al desorden y la suciedad, es muy incómodo dormir ahí, con un acolchado muy sucio y que no dan ganas de usar ni de tocar.
Aclaro que yo reservé el hospedaje porque leí muchos comentarios buenos, pero leyendo los comentarios de los últimos tiempos empezaron a aparecer comentarios negativos y ahora el mio. Lamento haber reservado, esos comentarios positivos no tuvieron nada que ver con mi experiencia.
La ubicación fue lo UNICO bueno del hospedaje, y no justifica su reserva. Aclaro que me he hospedado en hostels y lugares muy básicos y sencillos, pero cómodos, acogedores y limpios, no se necesita mucho pero si lo básico, y acá no lo encontré.
Lamento ser dura, pero prefiero contar mi experiencia sinceramente y que otros puedan evitarse malas experiencias.
Y si me preguntan por qué me quede, es obvio, porque salir a buscar hospedaje era imposible por los costos elevados que se manejan en Manhattan.
Simple room in a great location - close to many theaters and tourist attractions. Also many restaurants and cafes around.

The location and hosts were great and super easy. Would definitely recommend staying here. The only downer for us was the shower only being freezing or boiling hot which was a little bit unpleasant. But apart from that it was perfect for us! Thanks
Die Lage ist perfekt, das Zimmer und die Ausstattung sind ok. Allerdings wirkt das Zimmer auf dem Foto freundlicher als es wirklich ist. Und es war alles andere als sauber.

Shunichi was very welcomming and flexible with checkin times, and he had arranged for a friend to let us into his apartment when we arrived during the day.
We had an amazing time in NYC and the room fit our needs perfectly. The bed was comfortable, and it was easy to feel at home and relaxed in the room. Both the room and the bathroom had plenty of space, and was nice and clean.

The location in Manhattan was very central and close to many things, while still being relatively calm at night. We also found that there was an abundance of good restaurants literally right around the corner, which was a great luxury. The most difficult thing was to chose just one place to eat at after a long day of sightseeing!

I would reccommend booking this room to anyone who wants to go to NYC, it definitely contributed to making our NYC experience amazing!
The large room, air conditioning, and location were all great. No problems.

GREAT LOCATION! Near subway, bus station, lots of restaurants. You can walk to Time Square within 20 minutes.
The host is very easy to communicate and respond quickly.
The room is nice and tidy.
Great place to stay in New York!

There was a bit of a mishap with arrival but other than that the stay was perfect. It was close to everything and if you wanted to catch the subway it was only a few blocks away. The area and room were very secure and the air conditioning was amazing in the summer heat. Shunichi was very friendly and ready to help should I need it. Enjoyed my stay a lot and would definitely stay again :)

We had a great time in New York and Chris and his girlfriend were wonderful hosts!! The room as the whole flat were very friendly and clean. The bed is super comfi!! The C and G train are right around the corner, it's a 20min subway ride to Manhatten.
We were allowed to come and go whenever we wanted and to use the perfectly equipped kitchen. Chris even invited us to drink his home brewed beer, which was delicious! We would totally recommend to stay there!

Chris's apartment is beautifully decorated and very clean and you couldn't find a better host. I booked his apartment for my dad while he was in town. He and Chris seemed to really hit it off. Chris was so outgoing and helpful and he truly enjoys hosting others and getting to know them.

My boyfriend and I enjoyed our stay at Christopher's. It really is a pleasant room and a very clean and tidy apartment. We didn't see Chris much, but he was flexible about when to let us check in and very friendly. He gave us great recommendations for Clinton Hill - the Mexican restaurant on Vandebuilt was one of our culinary New York highlights. Clinton Hill is a good neighborhood if you want to wind down a bit after a day in Manhattan. And I can recommend Chris apartment without hesistation. Thanks Chris!
Had a great time with Chris and Jan. They took me out to the Brooklyn Brewery and were all round great hosts. Would recommend staying there to anyone!

Chris's place was cozy, clean and spacious. Close to subway C line, which is very convenient to go to Manhattan.
As for Chris, I really appreciate his hospitality. Though I arrived at late night, Chris welcomed me. He always cared me, even when he was working, gave me a lot of advice, recommended me good places. Unforgettable is his self-brewed beer. It was great.
These are why Chris's place is definitely recommendable. I'd like to go there again and say cheers with his great beer.

Chris is a wonderful host. The location is ideal for access to Manhattan and elsewhere in Brooklyn, and the local neighbourhood is safe and friendly. Chris is an attentive and generous host, always ready to share his time, beer, and roof (complete with grill!). The room is spacious, comfortable, with ample storage, a very comfortable bed, and good a/c. I was in NYC conducting academic research, so had a longer term stay to do work rather than the tourist experience. I was lucky enough to share 4 July with Chris and Jen, and several outings to local pubs and restaurants besides. In short, I had a wonderful time, as you will if you stay.

I highly, HIGHLY recommend Chris's space! Being somewhat of a germaphobe I was not disappointed. Chris was super friendly and welcoming without being overbearing - the perfect balance of a great host. The apartment was super clean, spacious and perfectly located on the edge of Fort Greene (an amazing BK neighbourhood). Thanks so much for your hospitality Chris!!
Yael & Melissa

We were very pleased with the room, and with Chris. The apartment is clean and bright, and close to the C subway to Manhattan. We had access to the kitchen, which we used for breakfast before heading out to a conference and sightseeing.

Christopher is a wonderful host and his place is super clean, spacious and has an excellent location (just a minute to the C station and 10 min to the Manhattan).  The neighborhood is quite and safe, there is an awesome Dominican restaurant 'Puerto Viejo' just 10 min walk from the building. We had a great time and definitely recommend everyone to stay in Brooklyn at Christopher's.

My wife and I stayed with Chris during the first week of January 2014 and had a great time. Brooklyn is great and this apartment is well located near restaurants and there is a subway at the end of the street to take you direct to Manhattan. The flat is clean and warm, the bed is comfy and the room big enough for two with a place for clothes/baggage. Chris and Jen were good hosts, friendly and very helpful, I would stay here again (if lucky enough to get back to NY some day). Unfortunately i didn't get to taste Chris' beer, poor timing on my part! correspondence was quick and hassle free.
Rory & Fiona

I would definitely recommend this place and I will stay here if I ever go back to NY. The apartment is beautiful and the room is cozy and clean. Chris and Jenn are great, friendly and always available if you need anything. The neighbourhood is very safe and has great restaurants nearby. Having the C train right on the corner is a plus!

Great experience . the place is clean and spacious, the bed is super!
Cris and Janny were wonderful hosts they alweys cared us. He is great self-brewed beer!
I recommend Chris Apartment.
Luca
We had a lovely stay in this beautiful old house. The bed was comfortable, the books and art were lovely, and Laurie was warm and easy to communicate with. Everything was spotless.
Great location close to everything! Clean and easy to access, enjoyed my stay!!
Nice clean place as well as location. We would certainly like to come back!

Laurie place it's so cozy!! I felt at home as soon as I contact her by message.
She is so affectionate and caring! She is the perfect host and really take care of every detail! My room was so magical with beautiful paintings, drawings and lot of books! The book that she has created for her guest it's fantastic!
I highly recommend her place! The perfect place to be in Brooklyn!

The house did not live up to our expectations having viewed the photos on the website. The flights of  steep winding stairs to the upstairs rooms are an ordeal if you have much luggage.  There are no locks for your room and you will share a bathroom (clean) which can't be locked.  While we were there the living area was unusable due to papers on every surface and there are two cats living permanently inside.  Laurie is friendly and helpful and the back garden is lovely.
Laurie is a great host and her home is awesome!

Laurie place is a hidden gem. She is very kind and welcoming, definitely would recommend to anyone visiting NYC. Batman and Robin (cats) were precious and the garden was lovely to sit in during the day.  Looking forward to visiting again soon.
Manhattan and Brooklyn, Park Slope is a great combination. Laurie’s stay is just all you need!
Laurie was very helpful in coordinating with our booking. Her place was also very nice and just as advertised! It's in a great location very close to the subway station. Would highly recommend!

Excellent choice to stay in Brooklyn. Very close to a key subway stop. Vibrant neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants. The place itself is very clean and comfortable. You can't go wrong staying here.

We highly recommend Lori‘s Airbnb. She’s gracious and accommodating and easy to approach with questions. The house and patio are so comfortable. Our room was great and the location is quiet yet close to the metro and all that Park Slope has to offer. Although we’ve visited Park Slope many times, Laurie was able to introduce us to some wonderful new places. We both highly recommend her Airbnb.
We had a great time at Laurie’s place. The location, proximity to various train stops and Laurie’s knowledge of the city made for a memorable trip. Would definitely stay again.
It was clean but the propert was to old and out dated. It did not mention the property would have multiple guests at a time.
Great stay at Laurie’s place - room and bathroom were clean, she was flexible and friendly, and the location was very convenient. Would definitely come back!
Lovely place with a lovely and knowledgeable host - Laurie will make sure that you have everything you need during your stay, and has great recommendations  for the area and the city.

Great location in Brooklyn, near the subway with easy access to Manhattan. The house is near of a number of local restaurants, coffee shops, and various shops. The bedroom I stayed was spacious, clean, plenty of space and warm. Great powerful hot shower! Laurie provides a booklet with lots of useful information (transport, restaurants, shops, bars etc) which was a life saver as I didn't need to do a lot of research, everything I needed was in the leaflet. I recommend anyone staying with Laurie to utilise it. Laurie was flexible and accommodating with my check out time. It was my first time in NYC and Brooklyn was definitely a great idea.

Thank you Laurie for hosting me in your cozy space!
Comfortable and quiet.  Perfect for my trip to visit my daughter and her family blocks away.

Stayed with Allen and Irina about a year ago. The apartment was more spacious than we thought it would be. They were helpful and nice when we needed that, and left us alone when we needed that too. The location is pretty good, not that far a walk into Williamsburg/hipsterville, and not that far into Manhattan either. We enjoyed our stay!

We had great days and Chris helps us with many informations. Everything was perfect and we can recommend this room everyone!

Thx Chris and Jenn, from Tirol
Christian & Lily

P.S. Tom's Diner was a fantastic tipp!

I just spent five days in Brooklyn and the surrounds and stayed in Chris' wonderful room. It is very comfortable and has all the amenities one could want from an iron and hair dryer to a comfy bed and wifi. The location is terrific - close to the train and bus routes, safe to walk day or night, good restaurants and groceries right around the corner. We spent time on the roof deck sipping some of Chris' home brew. A great experience. I'll definitely be back for more.

We found the accomodations were perfect for us! The room is bright and clean, the building well-maintained, and the location convenient to the subway and many of the places in Brooklyn we wanted to visit. Chris is a charming host who, graciously, went above and beyond to make us feel right at home. We certainly want to stay with him on our next visit.

Good neighborhood, ~10/15 minutes to Downtown with the C train. Awesome room (huge, clean, beautiful!). I would stress over all, the hosts: Chris and Jen and are great couple and make you feel like you are at home. Zero complaints.

I couldn't recommend it more.

Accoglienza splendida, Chris & Jenn due persone squisite che ti fanno sentire a casa tua. La stanza è accogliente ed il bagno pulito. Il quartiere è perfetto, con la metro C ad un passo (davvero!), per andare a Manhattan in 15 minuti. E' un posto dove riandrei domani! Consigliata caldamente a tutti!
Great host, kind and nice. Neighbor hood is convenient in every aspects. The best part of our New York trip.

This was my first airbnb experience, and it could not have been any better. The hosts,  Chris and Jenn, were warm and gracious and made me feel right at home. The home was extremely clean and well-organized. The room was quite large for NY (larger than most hotel rooms I've stayed in there). They had a huge closet in the room just for the airbnb guest. The building was really nice, well-lit, well-maintained, and it felt safe. The neighborhood was nice. There were 2 organic juice bars and a great bagel place just around the corner, and best of all, it's only 1/2 block to the subway that takes you right into Manhattan. Overall, it was a 10 out of 10 experience.

I had an awesome stay at Chris and Jenn's. They are both so friendly and we had a lot in common regarding our interests in sustainable food and traveling. Chris was even able to attend an event that my nonprofit, Slow Food USA, put on to celebrate the 25th anniversary of our movement. Their place is new, clean, and conveniently located near the subway (A,C lines).

We had a great time staying with Jenn and Chris. They were very accommodating with check in/ check out times, the flat was great and the room very spacious and comfortable. They were also very friendly and gave is suggestions of local places to check out, including a great local diner. I can really recommend their place if you want to  discover Brooklyn (which is a lot of fun!)

Chris and Jenn are fantastic hosts! Made us feel very comfortable and at home. Chris gave us a lot of great tips on local restaurants and things to do. Neighborhood is safe and very convenient to the subway line into Manhattan. Room was nice, clean, and bed was comfortable. If you're craving Mexican food check out Xochtil Taqueria. For a local low-key bar check out Hudson dry. Great Atmosphere and friendly people. Overall a 10 out of 10 and a great location to check out Manhattan and Brooklyn! Don't be afraid to explore! New Yorkers are very friendly and helpful!

My wife and I had a fantastic time at chris and jenn ' s place . Their place was just as described . They had fantastic eating suggestions. Chris when the brewing time was right a real beer brewer and full of knowledge . Thanks again guys you really made staying with you so comfortable

We had another amazing visit to the city! Chris and Jen are incredibly gracious hosts and have an extremely relaxed style of hosting. This is my second time staying with them and they will continue to be my 1st choice anytime I return to the city. They are both so kind and generous with their space, and we found it very easy to come and go as needed no matter our schedule. Thank you again for helping to make our trip so much fun!

Our first airbnb experience was excellent.  The hosts were friendly but not intrusive.  They were flexible regarding our arrival time.  The room was as described and was clean and comfortable.  The home brew was a special treat.  The location was great.  It was close to restaurants, the subway, and coffee shops.  The neighborhood was nice and quiet.

Chris & Jenn are awesome! We had such a great stay at their beautiful home. They welcomed us very warm and gave us tips about everything we needed. They also provided much information material in our room. Especially regarding our delayed luggage, they were so helpful. Thanks again for that!
The location is just perfect! The whole apartment is very clean and the guestroom is spacious, cozy and bright. The house is literally just 20 steps from the metro, which brings you to downtown Manhattan in 15 Minutes. The neighbourhood in Brooklyn is great as well and worth a visit away from Manhattan. You should follow Chris and Jenn’s food recommends nearby!! We love Emily’s and Tom’s.  And last but not least, Chris’ homemade beer is so delicious ;) –
What a fantastic airbnb experience! We highly recommend to stay with Chris and Jenn, you won’t get it better in NYC.

My stay at this apartment was not the best experience, but if what you care about the most is a great location, then this is the place for you. The picture is a good reference of what to expect, although simply add an unpleasant layer of grime to everything and you have a more accurate idea. My main issue was that the room, while tidy, felt unclean and the bathroom was unpleasantly dirty, to say the least. The apartment looks really worn and it is right next to the trash room, so opening the door you smell the trash and it can be pretty disgusting. However, the inside of the apartment smelled fine. I appreciated that the room is independent of the owner's space, as a door separates the room and the bathroom from the living room and the owner's room. It was also very convenient that the room came with a fridge, microwave, toaster, and even plates and cutlery. It is pleasantly large and the bed was more of a full-sized futon. The a/c worked, but not very well, which is not an inconvenience unless one comes in the summertime like I did. Our host provided us with a room key, so it was nice to be able to lock the room and feel my stuff would not be disturbed. I didn't really see much of the owner, as a friend of his welcomed me when I arrived, and I believe that if I hadn't proceeded to ask him a few questions the one day I saw him at the apartment, we might never have talked, as he always left before I did and arrived apparently after. However, the main thing about this apartment is the location. Incredible location! It is walking distance from  Columbus Circle and all the theater area and Times Square, which made it very convenient when I got out of a play late at night. There are also a number of grocery stores nearby, including an organic whole foods style one. There are nearby subway stations and tons of restaurants, so it is easy to find anything one might need within a few blocks.
Perfect location for the show I was seeing- thanks to the host for offering this.

The person (host's friend) that was supposed to let us in the apartment at the schedule time wasn't there, so we had to wait almost an hour, until the previous guest open the door for us. That person was still in the room, sheets all messy, dirty towels on the bed...nasty view. The host was already on his way to receive us due to the fact that his friend never showed up. He apologized and was quick to "prepare the room". Honestly, the fact that we had to wait wasn't that big of a deal, hiccups happen. But the fact that after he prepare the room, it continued to look messy and dirty was kind of disappointing. To all of you looking to stay in NYC, be aware of Pros and Cons of this listing! Pros: location is excellent! Good neighborhood, very close to Central Park by Columbus Circle, lots of nice restaurants and shops nearby. This is what this listing is about. Also, he provided with maps, hairdryer, sun screen, scissors and that kind of essentials. There was a small working fridge, instant coffee, microwave and TV, which I don't know if they worked, never used them. Cons: On the other hand, the room and bathroom were really dirty, mostly the bathroom. Guys, I had to grab a cleaning brush and a bottle of cleaning product that was next to the toilet to clean the bathtub floor, because I didn't dare to put my feet there, considering on how the rest of the bathroom looked. The sheets looked clean, but we didn't dare to use the towels, we just used small ones that we packed just in case. The cover on the small sofa was also pretty nasty. Honestly, this is not a place to stay more than one night, and that's why we decided to stay after seeing all this. If it would had been more that one night, we would have gone to our friend's house in New Jersey, which it'd had ruined all our plans. Bottom line: If you don't mind staying relatively cheap in the middle of the city, in a dirty place, this the listing to do so. At least neighborhood is safe. Otherwise, go to a different place, you got to be a care-free person to stay in a place like this, and have seen many dirty places to assimilate this. I come from a dirty 3rd world country, so there's that. But never expected this in an Air bnb listing, mind you, is my first experience :( Good luck to you all!
P.S: The $15 cleaning fee are not being used towards that, I guarantee it!
Everything was great! Perfect location! So close to Central Park & Broadway. Also super flexible with leaving our luggage for the day! Good value accommodation. Thanks!
Flat very well situated, easy access by subway. The street is quite noisy. The room is nice, well furnished and we were very well received. Thank you!

My whole experience at Shunichi's place was perfect! Check in was easy. I just let him know about what time I was expected to arrive and he arranged a friend to let me in and provide me the keys. You can't beat the location. It's only a few blocks away from the Columbus Circle subway station, which is right next to Central Park. One block south is an NYPD station, so the neighborhood is fairly safe. Around the corner is Mariella's Pizza, which I highly recommend. There are several 24 hour stores in the area for your convenience. The room is very spacious and is perfect for one person, but it can accommodate two people comfortably. The mini fridge was very useful and the air conditioner worked adequately, especially during summer.  The bathroom was clean and functional and towels were provided. I stayed here for a whole week and actually saw Shunichi only one time and waved hello, so I had my privacy the entire time of my stay. I really enjoyed my stay here. In fact, if I ever do return to NYC, this is the first place I'll check to find a place to stay.

Localização! o local é espetacular e de fácil acesso ao metrô e mesmo à pé para os principais pontos turísticos de Manhattan. O quarto é bom, o host te deixa bem à vontade, como se de fato estivesse só. Não tive nada a reclamar, me senti em casa. Chegamos e o local estava limpo e no quarto tinha alguns eletrodomésticos que com certeza auxiliaram na estadia. O único ponto negativo vai para o ar-condicionado, pois acho que estava sem manutenção, gelava bem, porém estava muito empoeirado, o que me deixou com uma alergia

La habitación es como se indica en la descripción, con lo básico para pasar unos días en NY. La ubicación es perfecta para poder ir a todos los sitios céntricos a pie y bien comunicado con el metro.
El anfitrión se amoldó a nuestra hora de llegada sin problemas.

Nous avons été bien reçu mais notre hôte était peu présent et on a un peu galéré avec la douche et la télé qui ne captait pas. L'appartement est très bien situé mais un peu vétuste. Y a moyen de trouver mieux pour ce prix je pense.

I will divide the evaluation, so you have a better point of view. And I would also like to explain that I traveled with my boyfriend, and were all day out walking, so we didn't need to stay in the room during the day.

Pros: location is great, in the middle of the city. Shunichi is almost always out or inside his space, so you won't feel controlled. The bed was as announced and host offers a few more things as scissors, shampoos, some cuttlery, things that may come in handy.

Cons: room is tidy, but is quite dark (curtains could be washed too). Air conditioner works, but makes a lot of noise during the night (and you'll need it in hot summer). Bathroom is clean as far as you can see, but if you glance a little further, you'll notice some dirty spots. My towel was a bit dirty also, I had to use my bf's. Apt is on first floor (consider that if you carry heavy luggage). What seems to be living room is stacked with boxes and things -I understand is his place after all, but it may shock you when you enter. And kitchen is definitely a no to use it.

However, Shunichi is very respectful and shy, so he won't mess around you but will help you get the best out your stay. Would return, if I make a similar trip.

Details on my experience: This was my first time using AirBnB, and I thought that it was a great experience. I've already recommended the site to many friends, and will use it again. My sister's family used it simultaneously, and my brother and I stayed at Allen and Irina's place while she stayed at one of the Hotel Toshi properties. We were both very happy with our stays, but I think that I got the better deal.

Allen and Irina were *extremely* proactive communicators, confirming dates and arrival times and printing out neighborhood maps with recommended restaurants. Allen had a parking space right outside the front door, which he gave to me for unloading (my initial spot was 1.5 blocks away - safe, free parking is easily found nearby). Both were very concerned about making sure we had everything we wanted, and freely offered info, but they never felt intrusive. Helpful, friendly and truly concerned with ensuring we enjoyed ourselves - some of the best customer service ever!

The place itself was really nice. Brooklyn on somewhat of a budget nice, not W hotel nice, but I liked it better than my stay at the Waldorf Astoria several years back. Bigger rooms, fridge and pantry spare but stocked with breakfast essentials, bathroom built for tall people (I'm 6'2" and my brother is 6'4" and neither of us had to do the usual ducking for showerheads or sink mirror). Also, they provided way more clean towels, blankets, etc than we might ever need, and everything looked and felt very clean. Seriously, getting this space at this price was great!

The negatives:
Our last night there, wireless internet went out. Out of their control, as they lost their residential phone, internet & cable upstairs (as usual, TWC sucks) and they obviously wanted it fixed more than we did. The TV in the room (as I saw in the photos) was a very small oldschool TV/VCR combo - not a problem for me but perhaps for others. The apartment is obviously furnished by people rather than by IKEA, which I prefer but some may not like.

Overall, I'm glad we stayed here rather than one of the Hotel Toshi properties, which have nicer stuff (big flatscreen TV's, ultramodern furnishings) but require dealing with a more corporate machine type of customer service (separate building for check-in, sub-par customer service, maids rushing you to leave so they can clean, etc). Anyone wishing to contact me for more details is welcome to do so. Thanks Allen and Irina!

Mon amie et moi-même avons profité de l'appartement de Suchini durant 15 jours (du 26/12/16 au 08/01/17). J'ai beaucoup hésité pour la note entre 3 et 4 mais finalement j'ai tranché sur un 3 et je m'explique tout de suite. Tout d'abord parlons des points positifs : - l'appartement a une situation idéale, à 5 min de Central Park, à 10 minutes de Time Square. Le top ! On était à proximité de tout : de boutiques souvenirs, de restaurants, de fast-foods, de Columbus Circle où on peut faire ses courses facilement, bref parfait ! - la chambre est vraiment spacieuse (avec mon amie on s'est vraiment étalé, et oui on est des filles :p, mais on était vraiment à l’aise) et des équipements à dispo un frigo, un micro-onde, de la vaisselle, une TV (un peu sensible avec l'antenne), un Wi-Fi un peu capricieux parfois avec notre ordinateur, quelques nécessaires de toilette, des plans de NY à dispo... - la cuisine est à dispo et à tout ce qu'il faut pour se cuisiner des repas rapides (cela change des fast-foods à gogo :)) - la salle de bain est spacieuse également. Pas de petite salle de bain toute riquiqui, non il y a de la place dans la douche, pour se préparer, pour utiliser le lavabo… Mais malheureusement il y a quand même quelques points négatifs à retenir et pas des moindres comme : - la propreté en général. Nous ne sommes pas regardantes avec mon amie sur 2-3 poils qui pourraient se trouver dans une douche ou un grain de poussière dans l'appartement. Mais là c'était vraiment très limite, sans parler de la vétusté de l'appart, la salle de bain était vraiment borderline avec des poils, des cheveux, de la poussière par terre, le lavabo n'était pas nettoyé, je doute que le tapis soit lavé par exemple aussi. Et dans la cuisine, la plaque de gaz était grasse, noire de saleté... Dans la chambre, on aurait apprécié des draps propres entre ces deux semaines, le sol n’était pas vraiment propre, et le frigo n’était pas nettoyé. Bref nous étions vraiment déçues par rapport à cela. Et je reprécise que pourtant nous ne sommes pas difficiles en règle générale. - la salle de bain. En plus d'être très vieille (des barres de douche rouillées, des murs moisis, une vieille plomberie), prendre une douche était vraiment un calvaire. Une fois brûlante et une fois glacée, on arrivait à régler l'eau une fois sur 10. Et autant dire que c'est frustrant de pas pouvoir prendre une douche correcte quand on a marché toute la journée et qu'on est crevé. Enfin dernier point, plutôt mitigé - la communication avec l’hôte. Alors certes l’hôte est très discret et pour des gens comme moi qui préfère cela aux personnes envahissantes, c’était parfait. Néanmoins mon amie a regretté le fait de ne pas avoir parfois des infos, des recommandations (nous nous ne sommes même pas souhaités la bonne année, c’est quand même dommage quand deux...

Location is fantastic, and Bread & Honey store around corner amongst others provides ample amenities nearby. Bathroom is the only other room you have access to, but kettle and small fridge in bedroom makes it workable.  As noted, this is basic -- think dorm-room style -- then remind yourself again about the location; neighborhood felt safe even at night.  2nd floor with lots of stairs but also high ceiling in room of this old building. Host was prompt on communication and exceptionally quiet.

Shunichi was an accomodating, respectful and friendly host. The apartment is nice, in walking distance of Central Park, and public transport in all parts of town easily accessible. There's at least four Starbucks, a Whole Foods and several 24-h pharmacies/stores in close vicinity. If you want to see New York, this is an awesome homebase. Would definitely recommend and stay there again.

As the description says, don't expect luxuries. The room is okay and the bathroom is not the best but it works if you don't expect much and are there just to sleep at night and take a shower. The host was barely visible so you don't have to worry about him being in the way. We didn't get to use the kitchen but we never asked either so we don't know if it wasn't allowed at all. Overall, the location is great. There are a couple of subways, restaurants and markets to buy breakfast nearby. Not far from Times Square and Broadway. Shunichi was great at answering all questions we had so I really recommend to stay at his place while in New York.

Lo mejor la ubicación, excelente. La casa no es acogedora ni limpia, pero la habitación es amplia, esta ordenada y tiene un sofa sucio q cubrimos con una manta del avion para usarlo. Además de la ubicación, tienes absoluta privacidad, a veces no sabes si Shunichi está en casa, entras y sales sin problema. La cama esta muy bien y las sabanas estaban limpias. La ducha no estaba limpísima pero las he visto mucho peores, es aceptable ducharse ahí si piensas en lo barato del alojamiento y el sitio en el q está. Si vas a New York para estar todo el dia en la calle, y pasar el tiempo justo en el alojamiento para dormir descansar y ducharte es una opcion barata que te gustará. Yo repetiría! No es apto para príncipes y princesas pero estás en pleno Manhattan por muy poco dinero. Shunichi es agradable y muy escueto, tuvimos un problema con una llave y lo solucionó rapidamente. Todo fue correcto.

Shunichi offers a place to stay in Manhattan without the huge cost. He was very accommodating for early checking and checkouts. Granted, it could use an interior makover, but it was comfortable, quiet and close to shops, restaurants, and the Subway.  I see it already booked for the rest of the year, so I recommend you book early for next summer.
Wonderful location right in hells kitchen. Would definitely book with Shunichi again!
Shunichi was very nice and kind.

Das Apartment zeichnet sich für Urlauber durch seine top Lage aus.
Jedoch sind viele andere Dinge sehr dürftig ausgefallen.
Das ‚Schlafzimmer‘ war weitestgehend in Ordnung, von einem Wohlfühlfaktor konnten wir jedoch nicht sprechen.
Im Bad schimmelte es überall, an der Badewanne, den Duschvorhängen und der Einrichtung befanden sich Schichten von Dreck, Rost und anderen undefinierbaren Dingen, was eine Dusche zu einem eher unangenehmen Erlebnis machte. Zudem fehlte an 2 von 7 Tagen warmes Wasser und im Bad befanden sich einige gebrauchte Überreste an Rasierern, Duschgels etc. von vorherigen Gästen - auch nicht sehr lecker.
Die ausgeschriebene Küche war extrem verdreckt, was aber eigentlich keine Rolle spielte, da der Raum, in dem sie sich befand, nicht zugänglich und somit für uns nicht nutzbar war. Wir wurden in jenem Raum kurz ‚geparkt‘, als eine ‚Freundin‘, von ihm, die uns auch in Empfang nahm, bei unserer Ankunft erst einmal unser Zimmer sauber machte.. das aber auch eher sporadisch.
Die Klimaanlage im ‚Schlafzimmer‘ funktionierte zwar, das jedoch eher halblebig; ein kühles Zimmer hatten wir jedenfalls nicht, und das sehr zu unserem Leidwesen, da es im New Yorker Hochsommer dringend nötig gewesen wäre.
Wir mussten ihm am Anreisetag nach mehrfachem Anschreiben hinterher telefonieren, wann wir das Zimmer denn jetzt beziehen dürfen. Obwohl er jeden Abend zu Hause war kam kein einziger persönlicher Kontakt zu Stande, was wir sehr schade und auch befremdlich fanden, da wir ja Tür an Tür wohnten. Check-Out Belange klärte er dann auch lieber über die App, sprich die Gastgeberrolle wurde hier nicht wirklich wahrgenommen.
Der Preis war für diese tolle Lage unglaublich gut, alles andere jedoch hat einen nicht zum Verweilen verleiten können. Mehr als ‚geschlafen‘, unser Gepäck geparkt und geduscht haben wir dort nicht.
It was in an amazing location for a really good price!

Looking for a good place to crash for a few days at Shunichi's place is a good idea. Though it was very hot and hard to sleep, Shunichi provided us with another air con and it worked well. The bathroom had some stains, grime and mold. There were old curtains but it got the job done. The bedroom was dusty and dark but the bed was a good size and the host/host's friend provided us more blankets and pillows if needed. Overall, for the price and location, it's definitely a steal. But the cleanliness can be worked on.
This is my first Airbnb stay and I am very satisfied. I felt safe in this location and my room was clean and spacious. I would request this Airbnb in my future trips to NYC.
Excellent location to experience Manhattan

La habitación estaba algo sucia aunque las sábanas estaban limpias. El baño estaba sucio, sobre todo la ducha (moho en techo y cortinas de baño). El pasillo estaba lleno de trastos y olía un poco a humedad (es un bloque de edificios antiguo). Por otro lado, Shunichi fue muy educado aunque distante, como si no estuviese en casa. Nos dio facilidades para dejar la maleta en el pasillo el último día hasta que cogimos el avión. Lo más importante del apartamento es que está muy bien situado (entre Central Park y Times Square). Si no eres muy escrupuloso por lo del baño (y te llevas unas chanclas), en general está bien para lo que pagas. Si eres muy fino, busca otro.

Just saw sunichi once when he leave the Keys so we really didnt get the chance to Know him

The room is big and very well located, with microwave and fridge.

A great bud get option for manhattan, near central park and times square
The condo is very nice, with a lot of comfort, exactly as is described at the site. Our room was big and nice. Chris was a great host in every way. I would certainly stay again in his place.

Chris est un hôte très dévoué qui a fait tout son possible pour rendre mon séjour tes agréable et faire en sorte que je me sente chez moi. Son logement est impeccable, la chambre est grande, les rangements importants. Il met à disposition très volontiers sa cuisine et sa belle télévision ! Il aime discuter et s'intéresse à beaucoup de choses. Son chien est absolument adorable. Le logement est très proche de la ligne de métro pour JFK d'un côté et pour Manhattan de l'autre, ce qui n'empêche pas de profiter de Brooklyn qui est très agréable ! J'ai passé un excellent séjour.
Great place close by public transport and a wonderful host!
Awesome experience, very helpful and knowledgeable of NYC
Absolut eine Wohlfühlunterkunft! Sehr zu empfehlen!
Chris was great; very welcoming. Room was very clean and comfortable. Location was good: close to restaurants and public transportation.
Chris was very good host. He answered for all our questions. We can recomend Him for all.
Great host with an amazing place. Thank you for your hospitality Chris.

Who ever liked clean places should go here. Right next to the blue line bringing quickly to manahanthan . Much better the the red line further away that is much longer. Chris was extremely helpfull. Very appreciated .

We stayed at Chris's place during our trip to NY. The host is very friendly and has wonderful dog - Jitsu. The place is very clean, spacious and conveniently located near the subway station. It is very easy to go to Manhattan or JFK airport. The whole area is safe and has lots of shops and restaurants. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Chris is definitely way beyond a "superhost"! My friend and I have been staying in his flat for a month and everything is just perfect. The neighbourhood has all what you need - 100 steps away from the metro, welcoming and safe neighbourhood, and of course loads of cafes to satisfy our crave for good food!! Chris is a bonus for our trip, he's a really friendly and accommodating host - I arrived to NYC a day earlier and made a really late notice to him, yet he was still able to cater for my sudden change :) also, he's an interesting person with diverse interests, we definitely enjoyed our talks with him and he respected our privacy when we needed too! His flat is one of the tidiest and cleanest that i have stayed in so we really feel "at home" every time we are back, will definitely recommend this awesome bnb to everyone who wish to explore NYC <3

Chris is an amazing example of what a real human is like! He is down to earth, always eager to help and please his guests.

He gave me all different sorts of tops about great food, amazing bars. He also gave me his museum membership card to use for free, that's not to mention his awesome home brewed beer!

I must add the man is a very friendly intelligent conversationalist, and I really enjoyed our chats!

If you are lucky enough to find him available, book without hesitation, trust me you will have an awesome stay
He was so friendly and kind. I got free beers from him! I loved drinking it. I hope I'll visit his house again.
Chris was a phenomenal host! It was my first Airbnb stay, and he made it simple and effortless. I will definitely look him up when I'm back in NY!
非常干净整洁的房间里各种生活用品齐全，主人随和热情，附近的地铁超市十分方便，社区整齐，有安全感，还有一家超赞的早午餐厅，令人难忘。

Excellent location, very close to subway into Manhattan, and easy walks to shopping mall, museums and parks. This is a super, immaculate room in a flat that has everything a guest could want. Chris is the perfect host: friendly, knowledgeable, and responsive to guests' requirements, whether it be tourist or transport information, guides and maps, or where to eat out. His beautifully behaved Jitsu is a bonus and would make anyone a dog lover.

I appreciated the added bonus of a beautiful, friendly dog (Jitsu) to play with. It was also nice to have access to a full kitchen, cold water, and the museum passes, which we used. The bedroom was comfortable and spacious - great A/C and fan for the hot weather. Large, comfortable bed - but very flat pillows, which were difficult to sleep on. Overall, a nice place in a good location and friendly hosts.

숙소도 깨끗하고 체크인도 시간조정이라 편리했습니다! 무엇보다 역이 바로 옆에 있어서 맨해튼으로 가기도 편리했구요~ 강아지Jitsu(?)도 너무 귀여웠어요:) 아 그리구 이 집만의 장점은 게스트들을 위해 우산, 로션과 같은 편의도구들을 방안에 비치해놓은 거에요~ 하지만 방 천장에 등이 없고 스탠드 두개만 있어 방이 조금 어두웠던게 아쉽습니당ㅠㅠ 그래두 Chris도 친절하시구 만족했던 숙소였어요!
We had such a good time at chris place communication was 10/10 we definitely recommending!
Chris was really friendly and his house was super clean and well-furnished. We felt really at home and I would definitely stay again!
Chris was a great host! His place was comfy and his dog, Jitsu, was very cute and chill. Chris was friendly and had lots of helpful tips for us. Thanks again!

Chris is the nicest host I've ever met! His place is close to the subway station which makes us easy to explore NY.  He has a buddy named Jitsu, and he is so chill and just adorable dog!  I highly recommend to stay at his place If you're looking for a place in Brooklyn!
Appartement tres propre et hôte très sympa. Il est situé à 2 min du métro pour Manhattan qui met 25 min pour arriver à Times Square ! Tres central

Allen and Irina were great hosts, both of them met us when we arrived and gave us the house rules, Irina showed us how to work the TV and used her "nose like a bloodhound" to help fix the oven. The apartment itself was really nice, it had a lovely homely feel and was surprisingly large, way more than enough room for 2. The bed was amazingly comfortable and the bathroom was great too. Another upside was that the apartment was always lovely and warm whenever we returned from our travels. Unfortunately we didn't get to try out the kitchen beyond using a glass or two (one of the downsides of eating out every night haha) but everything looked in working order.

The location of the apartment was brilliant. In a safe area that's just a walk away from Bedford Avenue and all manner of Restaurants, Cafés, Bars and Delis. There is definitely a lot to do near the apartment. It is also incredibly easy to travel into Manhattan via the L train only a few minutes walk away.

We would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking to visit New York. It is a great place to stay with amazing transport links and brilliant hosts.
Perfetto!

L'appartement de Chris est idéalement placé, commerces, métro, tout est à proximité. Il est également très propre. Chris est arrangeant et toujours prêt à aider et donner des conseils. Si vous aimez échanger avec votre hôte, n'hésitez pas une seconde. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Brooklyn. En bonus son chien est adorable. Nous recommandons cet hôte.

Chris was a terrific host. He was helpful in so many ways. His place is very nice. It is very close to the subway, restaurants, and grocery stores. The bed is firm, which was fine with me; but if you are used to squishy bed, it might take some getting used to. His dog is adorable and very well-behaved. We really enjoyed staying there!

Eu e minha filha adolescente estivemos no espaço do Chris por uma semana e adoramos! O check-in foi muito fácil (embora ele não estivesse em casa, nos deu todas as orientações de como entrar no apto), não havia restrições de horários (ficamos com nossa chave durante nossa estadia), nos sentimos muito seguras e confortáveis, com tudo que precisamos.
Há armário com espelho, banheiro próximo ao quarto, ambiente limpo e acolhedor. Cama e travesseiros deliciosos para repousar de um dia cansativo de passeio. Chris foi muito amigável e nos ajudou em tudo que precisamos. O condomínio tem bom ambiente e não tivemos nenhum problema com segurança, mesmo voltando as vezes tarde da noite. O metrô fica a meia quadra de distância, então o usamos como meio de transporte todos os dias. Apenas um quarto do apto é alugado pelo Airbnb, o que traz a sensação de estar passando dias com um parente ou amigo.
Foi nossa primeira experiência no Airbnb, e não poderia ser melhor. Estar com um morador do local, ver de perto a vida real das pessoas é maravilhoso, enriquece muito a experiência da viagem. Recomendo fortemente o espaço do Chris. Espero voltar assim que possível! Obrigada mesmo por tudo, Chris! Você foi parte importante de nossa maravilhosa viagem! Abraços para você e Jitsu!

Chris’s place was awesome! Very clean and everything I would need in my own home was available. The bedroom is quite large so easy to spread out your suitcase. Subway stop is a 30 second walk from the front door. Chris gave us lots of good suggestions of local restaurants to try out, wish we were there for longer to give them all a try! His dog Jitsu is very well behaved and fun to hang out with. Definitely recommend staying here! We will be back.
It’s a very nice neighborhood, the room is comfortable and Chris is always there to help incase you need it.

We appreciate Chris’s hospitality, his very cosy flat and the very close subway station ( 2 minutes walk) . It is so easy to go to Manhattan.
You can also for find nice restaurants close from the flat.
We really had a great time at Chris.

Truly a 5-star experience staying with Chris and his awesome dog Jitsu. Chris is an accommodating and generous host and we had a wonderful stay at his stylish Brooklyn 2BR apartment about 200ft (65m) from the Subway station. My boyfriend and I had the had the pleasure of staying with Chris (and Jitsu!) for a couple of weeks as we searched for apartments and settled into our new life in New York. Chris was an incredible host who always made us feel right at home. The entire apartment was incredibly clean, and when you’re living out of your suitcase that makes a huge difference. He was friendly, responsive and flexible - everything you could want in a host.

Thanks for everything, Chris!

Chris was the most hospitable person we've ever stayed with. His place is very clean, the room is sunbathed and very comfortable and the location puts you at the heart of a family friendly neighborhood with plenty of subway stops. Also, his doggy Jitsu might as well be a celebrity he's adorable and sweet. You should definitely stay here.

Me and my husband visited NYC in April'18 and stayed at Chris' place. Not only is the apartment spacious and clean but it also has all the amenities to make you feel at home. He's such a calm and lovable little pet! We really appreciate how Chris helped us with understanding the subway, tips on what places to visit, good restaurants et al. Happy to have found a wonderful host. Thank you Chris for everything. Make sure you visit us whenever you come to India. Best wishes.... Smruti & Bharat:)

Wir würden diese Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen. Chris ist ein toller Gastgeber. Die Kommunikation mit ihm war ausgezeichnet. Great experience!! Best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at!!

Chris was very welcoming and very thorough about giving the maximum of detail about how to work around the apartment. He accommodated my parents very well, even though they didn't speak perfect English! Not to mention Chris brews an amazing beer that he was kind enough to give us a taste of. Well done! The location is great in Brooklyn, cannot be closer to the subway (C Train). The only slight drawback I would point is the noise from the street as you can hear the firetrucks and police. But it's New York right? ;)

Will book again with Chris for my parents, and would recommend the experience to anyone.

Très bonne situation géographique dans un quartier plutôt calme avec toutes les commodités à proximité. L'appartement est à 2 pas du métro pour se rendre très facilement dans Manhattan où Brooklyn. Nous avons pu dîner quelques fois chez Chris et la cuisine est parfaitement équipée. Tous le rest est OK. Douche, lit, etc... Je conseille cet endroit !

I’m really happy to have found Chris’s place in Brooklyn. I stayed at his place for 3 night and it couldn’t have been better. Thanks Chris!

I had a pleasant stay with Sunichi.  The check-in process was vey smooth.  The room was large, clean, and perfectly adequate for my needs.  The bed was very comfortable, and the desk was convenient for working.  The bathroom was not sparkling clean, but you can't expect that in an older apartment.  Overall, I was satisfied, and I felt like I got a good deal since I paid a lot less than I would at a hotel.  I would recommend Sunichi's place to anyone looking for a simple and affordable place to stay in midtown Manhattan.
A convenient place to stay when you're going to be mostly out and about. Great location.

As per description, it is a basic room but location makes up for everything else. I booked the room for my stay in NYC as I wanted to be as close to Carnegie Hall as possible for a concert that I took part in on 25 Nov. It was a 5min walk to Carnegie Hall.

Some of the reviews commented on the appearance of the room. We found the room clean and neat with everything that we needed. I think some people found the furniture "old and used" but everything is clean.

Sharing the bathroom was not an issue as the owner was not home most of the time. We didn't even need to use the kitchen as dishwashing liquid was provided in the bathroom and we could rinse out our coffee mugs there.

The owner was also very accommodating in arranging at the last minute for early access to the apartment as we arrived an hour earlier than I had anticipated. He was also very thoughtful and provided us with an additional heater for the room when NYC experienced the coldest Thanksgiving Day in the last 100 years!

I would definitely stay there again if I ever get a chance to visit NYC again.
Excellent location!!

Shunichi’s place was awesome!!! Great value, he was super flexible and was reliable in checking in! Apartment is in a brilliant spot with excellent neighbours and big room! Una muy buena opción calidad precio. Ubicación inmejorable . No es un lugar lujoso, pero totalmente aceptable para pasar tu estancia allí.

Very good location, with subway station nearby, walking distance from time square and all you need within blocks of the place. Host let me check in sooner and have a late checkout and that was very kind. Major aspect to be improved is Wi-Fi connection, frequently too slow or unstable. All good other than that, good value for money.
Place was great, good location and very homely. Allen & Irina were helpfully and welcoming.

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment is very clean and had everything we needed. The host was friendly and easy to deal with. Das Apartment ist sehr gemütlich, sauber und gut angebunden. In unmittelbarer Nähe befinden sich diverse Delis, Diner und Restaurants. Man kann bequem zur Subwaystation laufen und ist sehr schnell in Manhattan. Irena und Allen sind sehr nett, hilfsbereit und locker.

great location, near to metro station and lots of attractions.

Very good location and reasonable price!!

honestly a little disappointed, and I think I would have been better off getting a hotel for just a little more...

Extremely convenient place to walk around Times Square, 7th avenue, or other attranctions. Room is well enough to stay for single Men's traveler.
Neat bedroom with amenities as described. A most convenient location right near the theater district.
A great value place in a stellar location, any questions or queries were quickly answered by the host who was extremely accommodating.
100% recomendable, super céntrico y muy buena persona
