Chris' place was perfect for us for a four night stay to check out the city. I personally prefer Brooklyn over Manhattan, but if you want to go there it's only a subway ride of about half an hour. The apartment is conveniently located on the C line.
The apartment is perfectly clean with a friendly dog and beer in the fridge (which I have to try next time!) and Chris is a great host.
Thank you for everything!

Chris was an excellent host during our 5-night stay in NYC! We arrived quite late but it was no problem signing in. The room was tidy and everything was well considered so that it was easy to be a guest. Chris gave some good tips and we had nice conversations about living in USA. We highly recommend this place!!

Chris is the really great host!
His place is clean, well organized, everything you need are there including cooking tools.
He is super friendly, kind and responsible person. He always listened my terrible English with patient and his responses were always quick.
The dog Jitsu is also very friendly and cute. I could enjoy a lot with him when I was at home.
No negative concerns during my stay.

I'm sure I will come back to his place when I visit NYC in future.
Thanks Chris and Jitsu!

Chris's space is impeccable.
Clean to a very high standard.
We had everything we needed and more.
Chris made our stay incredibly enjoyable and made us feel right at home.
You will definitely enjoy your stay here.

In our experience, Chris's place was pretty much the gold standard of what Airbnb can be. We had high expectations from the listing, but they were met and exceeded.

While his schedule kept him slightly out of sync with us when we were staying there, we always felt extremely welcome and had a good time anytime we would get to talk. The local tips and museum memberships were a great bonus, especially being able to go the members-only movie night in Brooklyn Botanical gardens (which turned out to be the highlight of the trip). Getting to Manhattan every day was trivial as the Subway was close by (just far enough to not be bothered by any noise).

Finally, Jitsu was fantastic and pretty much adopted us from the first day. Nothing quite makes you feel like home somewhere like a friendly dog rushing to meet you when you get up in the morning.

All in all, this is how Airbnb always should be, and it's great to know we now have a home away from home whenever we're in New York.
Chris is very nice and the houe is really clean.

Really strategic place, close to the subway(50 meters), very clean, comfortable, quiet area. Although close to subway and main street very silent and you can sleep very well.

The Host Chris is just amazing, best air bnb we have ever
found. Excellent communication and availability. In the and as a cherry on the pie, the lovely dog Jitsu so sweet and polite him too🐶❤️.

I suggest this air bnb to everyone do not want to spend a lot of money in Manhattan being very close to it and explore the awesome Brooklyn at the same time.

Thanks again Chris.

Came in town for an interview, Chris was easy to reach, gave me many helpful pointers about the area and kept the room impeccably clean because of my mild dog-hair allergy. Very considerate. I would definitly recommend his place to others. Cheers!

Would recommend staying here to anyone. Although my boyfriend and I didn't spend much time in the room, when we did we felt 100% comfortable.
Chris gave us some tips of places to eat and even had some tickets available for us to use for some Brooklyn attractions.
The place is about a 2 minuet walk from the C train which was our main source of transportation. Easy to get to and from the city and we didn't get lost once!
Thank you Chris and Jitsu for your hospitality and we will definitely stay again the next time we come to NY.

Very friendly and quick responding host. Very tidy and clean appartment. bedroom is very spacious. a few steps away from the subway, so you are around NYC in no time. shops and retaurants nearby.
I think this place is what airbnb is all about, will go back for sure.

Our stay at Chris was really great. Chris is an amazing host. We are only sorry we had too much to do and see in three days, so we did not really ger a chance to sit down and chat or even enjoy a beer or lunch together. And also his little Jitsu is sooo cute :)
Deffinitely worth booking.
Kind regards to Chris and Jitsu :)
Great host  , good location , would recommend this place any time

O espaço é muito bom e aconchegante, você se sentirá em casa. O cão Jitsu é muito amigo e obediente, inacreditável.
Muito próximo do trem, menos de 100 metros do metro linha “C” e algumas quadras da linha “G”.
Você terá tudo que precisa, cozinha, lavanderia, armários e ótima cama.
Recomendo a todos.

Chris's place is great! Super close to the subway and a decent amount of quick food options. Safe neighborhood. Chris has a super sweet and friendly dog. He's super hospitable and kind. Returns messages quickly, is great about making sure that you are comfortable. We didn't need or want for anything while we were there. Would definitely return to Chris' pad!

Excelente anfitrión, respuesta rápida en cualquier momento, ubicación excelente la estación del metro que te lleva a Manhattan esta a 200mts y es la misma estación que te lleva al JFK. Sin duda regresaría al mismo lugar. Chris es una excelente persona, el departamento super limpio, habitación muy agradable y cómoda. 100% recomendado.
Chris and his place were awesome.  He couldn't have been nicer.  He even shared his home brewed beer, which was great!  I would highly recommend.

La ubicación es inmejorable! Y la habitación es espaciosa. Sin embargo esta sucio y descuidado. Lo recomendamos solamente para dormir y una corta estadia. Nunca vez a Shunichi que vive en la cocina. Es un primer piso, y el ruido del exterior se siente. Remarcamos que estaba sucio.

The location is perfect. It is near
broadway district and time square. Although I didn't meet Mr. Sunichi much, but he communicated with me via Airbnb. He is very flexible about checking in and checking out.
Excellent place to stay in middle Manhattan, clean, confortable and near the best attractions in NYC

Fue todo según lo pactado. Se respeto lo publicado. La ubicación es excelente,  cerca de 5ta avenida, central park, time square, subtes, lugares de comida, supermercados. Volveria a hospedarme sin dudarlo.
Great location and comfortable place

the bathroom is dirty, the kitchen could not be used because it was full and dirty, the photos correspond but really very messy everything I would not recommend this place is not the complete apt just a room and bathroom shared
Good location to stay close everything
Location and price is great, but hygiene is not acceptable.

Fantastic location, authentic New York apartment. This place was only a few minutes walk from Times Square in one direction, and Central Park in the other! The place is a little rough and ready, but Shunichi is very obliging and we had everything we needed. A great base to explore.
Wonderful place to stay right in the heart of the city!! Shunichi is a good communicator and provides a safe and clean place in the middle of the city.
Shunichi’s place was extremely well located. The host is nice and communicates well. As for the apartment, you get what you paid for. All in all, excellent stay for young people.
Not as clean as the picture shows, but it was a great location with great AC on a very hot day.
Very big space & great location!  Decently clean , just a bit cluttered! Shunichi was a fast communicator. Overall, great value!

Si vous cherchez un lieu de rencontre en passant par Air BnB, ce n’est pas le logement qu’il vous faut ! Notre hôte a été très discret (nous l’avons seulement vu à l’arrivée, nous échangions ensuite par mail). De plus, si vous êtes un accro du ménage et de la propreté, ce logement n’est pas adéquat ! Il est très vétuste et n’est pas ordonné du tout ! La salle de bain est peu inspirante... et le petit coin cuisine dans la chambre également ! (Micro-ondes et frigo pas propres).

Cependant, c’est un logement très bien situé et l’hôte est arrangeant à l’arrivée et au départ ! Sa localisation implique beaucoup de bruit la nuit (rue + clim).

La clim est un plus malgré le bruit !
Very spacious and clean by NYC standards. Perfect for my needs (conference at the Hilton and Sheraton). Never saw or heard host. Had problems with the wifi tho, hopefully they'll get fixed soon.
If you need a place to stay in NYC this is great. There are lots of places super close for food or a quick item you may have forgotten.

The apartment was completely clean. It was a typical nyc apt. A lot of stuff in the hallways but who cares. If you are looking for a place to hang out in than this is not the place. If you need a basic place to rest your head than this is the place. Perfect location.  The hallway leading up to the apartment is dingy but again who cares. Perfect location,  great price.
This place is super well-located! With this wonderful location, other stuff becomes meaningless!
No lo recomiendo a nadie solo una rata puede vivir así un asco de sucio no lo alquilen se van a llevar una sorpresa
뉴욕의 살인적인 물가에 비해 저렴한집이었으나 그에 부합한 가격만큼의 집이었습니다. 청결이나 시설이 좋지않았으나 호스트님의 설명대로의 집이었습니다. 만약 청결이나 시설을 중시하시는 분이라면 적합하지는 않을 것 같습니다. 위치는 정말좋아요. 센트럴파크와 타임스퀘어, 지하철역도 도보 몇분거리입니다. 호스트분도 정말 친절하시고 지내는 내내 보지 못했습니다.

Clean, tidy, warm and easy to get to. A very good option if you want to be in Brooklyn and near a subway for quick access to Manhattan. It would be a bit dark if you wanted to spend any time indoors during the day, but near perfect as a place to sleep and shower at.

Our stay was great! The location could not be better, you are walking distance from Times Square, Central Park, Broadway Theaters, etc. The host was very kind and even allowed us to check in much earlier before the usual check in time because our flight landed really early in the morning. This was very useful to us.
This space has excellent location and I would recommend it to all travelers. Don't expect too much about the space but it has complete basic necessities to refrigerator, microwave, hair dryer, etc.
Хозяина не видели,жили сами,он был на работе.Жилье расположено в центре Манхеттена.В комнате было все необходимое.
Excellent place! Perfect location walking distance to great spots

I booked this last minute to be close to my new job in Midtown — Shunichi accepted the reservation within minutes. So grateful that he accepted since his booking page prefers a greater lead time.

You get what you pay for! Great price compared to other similarly-priced listings, which only offer shared rooms. I quickly passed on the shared rooms! This private room is spacious, has really tall ceilings, and has many dated amenities. Very thankful the room has a mini fridge. Not many channels available on the TV, but with access to Shunichi's Wi-Fi service, your viewing options will only be limited by the number of your own streaming subscriptions.

Super location. In walking distance to so many Broadway shows, Times Square, subway stations, restaurants, Hell's Kitchen, Central Park ... (and my new job!).

I left the bedroom window open, and was still able to sleep like a rock. I live in another populated U.S. city, and am accustomed to the expected vibrant sounds of a metropolis. If you come from a rural place, you might consider closing the window.

All in all, a wonderful experience. Would highly recommend!

Shunichi’s place was just as advertised. A large room with lots of amenities and had everything you needed. The location and price could not be beat!   We got to town way before check in time and he had a friend meet us there so we could sight see without our luggage.

Literally don’t know where to start. This is the most DISGUSTING place I’ve ever stepped foot in. Everything was dirty. This is a place that you wipe your feet before going outside, not the other way around. I can’t believe this is even an allowable listing.
I couldn’t tell if bedding had been washed, stains on the bath towels, hair matted into a hairbrush that was sitting in what I assume was an attempt at an “amenity” basket. Cracks in walls and ceilings, dirt on the walls. Unidentifiable stains on the couch.
THE BATHROOM OMG. Black mold literally everywhere.
Needless to say I didn’t end up sleeping here. I was in the unit for about 30-45 minutes total while troubleshooting with Airbnb on how to get my money back. I was so anxious after my initial report and after submitting initial photos that I called back and the person that looked at my case and saw the photos said “omg that’s so disgusting”
I honestly can’t believe the listing is still in existence. It derailed my entire weekend on NYC Marathon weekend trying to find last minute accommodations. Thank god I had a friend in the city that could find space for my friend and I.

This place is in a great location a short walk to times square or the subway to head downtown. Didn’t see Shunichi at all so felt like I had the place to myself. It is as described, room only and shared bathroom, which is perfect if using it for a base only.

Staying at Shunichi’s place went way better than I expected. You’re definitely only getting what you paid for but he was super nice and let us check in HOURS earlier. We landed at 7:30 am and he let us check in at 10am. It was easy getting to his place and the check in and out was a breeze.

Great location at a reasonable price. Nothing misleading about the pictures or description of his place, it’s as posted nothing luxurious. Just a place to stay while we explored Manhattan majority of the day and really only used the place to shower and sleep. We had no issues and we will definitely be getting the place again when we come back to visit again in the future.

The location of this flat is great, especially for first time visitors like us, that wanted to be in the middle of everything. But the room is basic plus clattered with furniture or stuff, that makes it feel too messy. Also, both bathroom and bedroom were not extremely clean. And when I first booked this, the host didn't even respond to me to welcome us. Then I asked a question in order to pay the remaining amount, and had to bring Air BnB in for him to reply. Better but still slow communication about check in. The woman was checked us in was lovely though.

All in all, we loved the location, but we wouldn't go back to the room for a drink. As long as you're out all day, it works.

Pros and cons. Location is amazing. The room was as described and had some nice touches many of the other “shared rooms” or just bedrooms had. Fridge, kettle, toaster, heater, couch, microwave. Room was clean and spacious. Apartment was easily accessed and we even were given the chance to drop our bags and get keys early before we checked in. Was like we had the entire place to ourselves. Never even saw the host.
Would give this a much higher review if not for the bathroom. I am by no means high upkeep or expect much. Very low maintenance. But when there is black mould all over the bathroom it’s not only a cleanliness issue, it’s a health issue. It wouldn’t take much to remove the caulking, recaulk and scrub the bathtub clean. We were cold and damp with tired feet from being out all day and would’ve loved a soak or shower but there’s no way I was stepping foot in that tub.
Other than the bathroom it was all what I expected.

There are so many great features to Chris's condo. The location couldn't be beat - about a block from a Citibike rental and even closer to a convenient subway stop (super easy to get into Manhattan) and some really great bars and restaurants. We really enjoyed Chris's recommendations too, especially Sister and Locanda Vini e Olii. It also might have been the cleanest Airbnb I've ever stayed in, and the bed/sheets were very comfortable. The space even seems a bit bigger than the photos look, which isn't common either! On top of that (plus the perk of Chris's memberships to the Brooklyn Museum, Botanic Garden & more) Chris and Jitsu were welcoming, hospitable, helpful and super friendly. Such a fun Brooklyn vacation!
A great place for my mom to stay while she visited us!

Great experience! Beautiful and clean apartment, very comfortable bed, quiet area at night, very clean bathroom. Chris is an amazing host, very available, friendly and knowledgeable. The beer he makes is awesome! Jitsu (the dog) is adorable and very quiet (no barking!). Would absolutely recommend this place and Chris and Jitsu’s company.

One of the best Airbnbs ever! We had an excellent time. The room is spacious and tidy and it's better in real life than it is in the pictures. Subway station is 03 minutes away from the apartment and there are restaurants and 24hr delis nearby. It is definitely a great spot!  Chris was very friendly and respectful. Every time I texted him, he would answer within minutes. Best host ever! (for real) We couldn't be happier! I recommend it 100% and, without question, would stay here again. I can't forget to talk about Jitsu, a lovely dog that made our stay even happier.

Would 100% recommend Chris' place. Amazing location and was quick to respond to messages. Too bad we didn't meet him as he's out of town town so we didn't get to try his home-brewed beer. Perhaps next time we're back in NYC?

J’ai passé deux semaines chez Chris et je ne regrette vraiment pas. Il est super comme hôte.
L’appartement est magnifique et très propre, grand, très bien équipé, bien chauffé, et Il se situe dans une rue très calme, donc pas de bruit et à proximité des commerces et restaurants. Chris répond très très vite aux messages et il est très gentil, il n’hésite pas à vous donnez les bon plans sur Brooklyn ou New-York. Il fait vraiment tout son maximum pour vous mettre à l’aise et pour que vous puissiez passer des bonnes vacances dans des bonnes conditions.
Jitsu "le chien" est adorable il adore les câlins. Prenez bien soin de lui.

Chris was an awesome Host. He is quick to respond, courteous, respectful, good conversations, access to museum memberships. Most importantly he is very helpful!

Such a great place to stay! Chris is a wonderful host, so nice and helpful. The place is a great location in Brooklyn, just right above the C train straight to Manhattan. Also, Jitsu is the sweetest little guy!! I would definitely stay again and highly recommend.

We had a great stay in Chris's apartment for one week. Such a friendly host with a gorgeous dog jitsu. Apartment right beside subway & convenience stores. Chris also very kindly gave us passes to musuems & lots of tips. Thanks Chris

Staying at Chris’ was pure delight!! He was such an amazing host. Very hospitable, friendly, and just wholesome all around. He even had amazing recommendations of where to eat, what to see, and how to get around the city. PLUS, he brews amazing beers! Next time we visit New York and stay in Brooklyn, we will definitely stay here again. Thank you so much for a very memorable stay, Chris!! Please give Jitsu a big hug for us!

Had a wonderful experience staying at Chris'. The location is amazing (the subway station nearby makes it super easy to get by) and his place was extremely clean. Chris was so hospitable and accommodating and staying at his place made our entire trip so much more memorable and worth it. His homebrewed beer was hands down the best beer that I've tried, and his Shiba, Jitsu, is absolutely adorable! Cannot recommend highly enough!

I highly recommend Chris as he’s been such a wonderful and caring host during our stay. The bedroom is large and super comfortable, and so is the apartment. Also perfectly located in a lovely Brooklyn neighborhood right by a subway station. Great host and location!
Chris es un excelente anfitrión. Pasamos unos días muy agradables en su apartamento, el lugar es limpio, ordenado , la cama cómoda y su perro adorable!

Chris & Jyustu was such a great hosts!!! Actually, I was not a dog person so, I was a bit worried.  But Jyustu was sooo cute and friendly.  The room is super clean and bed is so comfy.  I will definitely want to stay his place again!!!

My husband and I were sooo pleased with our stay in Chris's place! It couldn't have been a better experience. Everything was clean, the apartment is super spacious and the location was everything we needed and more! Chris was an outstanding host and we will be sure to check his place out next time we come back to Brooklyn!

Fue un gran placer conocer a Chris. Tiene un departamento muy lindo en Brooklyn, a pocos metros de la parada del metro, a pocos minutos a Manhattan.
El es muy amable, nos explico absolutamente todo sobre su departamento y tenia disponible para nosotros pases para algunos museos.
Es un gran cocinero de cerveza artesanal.
Su perro Shi Tzu es un gran compañero, cariñoso y amigable.

Volveremos!

Chez Chris, pas de mauvaise surprise. La chambre correspond à la photo, l’appartement, très propre, est idéalement placé, à 3 mn à pied d’un métro qui dessert tout Manhattan, le quartier est assez calme, la literie est super.
Ajoutez à cela un hôte qui,après avoir soigné l’accueil, fait tout son possible pour aider, tout en restant discret, et qui en plus est doté d’un chien adorable !
Bref, nous conseillons fortement cette adresse !

What an awesome host!   We got in late and he was so accommodating. He also gave great advice on how to get around and where to eat etc.  most importantly was he made us feel at home.  And his dog is definitely a plus!!   We had a great time and a wonderful experience staying at Chris’s pad!

Nous ne regrettons pas d'avoir choisi l'appartement de Chris pour notre séjour à New York. Celui-ci est très bien situé, à quelques pas d'une station de métro qui vous emmène directement à Manhattan. Nous nous sommes sentis comme chez nous : nous avons pu cuisiner, faire notre lessive... Chris a toujours été là pour répondre à nos questions et discuter de choses et d'autres. Son chien, Jitsu, est très calme, vraiment adorable. Nous n'hésiterons pas à retourner chez Chris si nous programmons un nouveau séjour à NYC.

Easily the best Airbnb experience ever. The place is so incredibly comfortable with the perfect amount of privacy. My friend and I had an amazing experience with Chris & Jitsu and will most definitely be seeking out their place on future trips to the city. The apartment is clean and in a safe neighborhood. We were close to the train as well as local shops and cafes which was very convenient!! Chris also offered many local tips and shared passes for some of the city attractions.

Allen and Irina's place was a nice little getaway from Manhattan, and, as other reviews have said, it's a quick train ride into the city. The place was a great size and set up for two people and included a great internet connection (a minimum requirement for me) with access to Netflix and basic TV for the times not exploring the area.
The windows were right on the street, which could get a bit noisy especially on the warmer evenings when people were out socializing in the neighborhood, but if you've worn yourself out sightseeing, you can easily block this out. Communication was great, the place was clean and stores to stock up on food were close by. An enjoyable stay.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Allen and Irina's convenient Williamsburg home. The bottom story studio was welcoming and very warm (handy as it was bitter cold outside!) Irina was friendly and provided us with some local knowledge.
Thanks to Allen and Irina :) It was a pleasure to stay in their warm, cosy place! Easy to get to Manhattan (just few stops). Besides, Davidson family was very helpful!

L'appartement correspondait exactement à la description. Tout était parfait.
Nous avons passé un super séjour.
Merci à Irina et Allen.

Wir wurden von Irina sehr freundlich empfangen und haben uns in ihrem Studio sofort wohl gefühlt. Es ist alles sehr sauber und Bett und Schlafcouch waren sehr gemütlich. Für 3 Leute ist das Studio auf jeden Fall groß genug. Uns hat Williamsburg super gut gefallen und man erreicht Manhatten schnell und problemlos mit der Metro. Irina konnte uns gute Tips geben und war super hilfsbereit. Das Gebäude ist etwas hellhörig.
Irina & Allen were amazing hosts - very attentive and easy going.  The apartment was as listed and very convenient for all of our needs.

We loved our stay here. The room was clean, more spacious than the photos indicated, very warm and the bed was amazingly comfortable. We had all the creature comforts of home with a well stocked kitchen and extra blankets and towels stowed conveniently in the cupboard. The location is also great with it being close to many of the train stations and positioned in what felt like the outskirts of Williamsburg. It's not right in the thick of Williamsburg, but we liked that as it meant we were more likely to explore some of the other cool areas nearby, like Green Point and Brooklyn Heights. But in terms of walking distance, it is most closely located to the main part of Williamsburg than anywhere else and was a very easy walk to the main streets.

In terms of the hosts, Allen and Irina, we found them to be hands-off but ready and there to help us when we needed them - so this suited us perfectly as we liked having our autonomy during our stay. Irina welcomed us when we first arrived and was very flexible with accommodating our arrival time that had shifted slightly. She also helped with printing some tickets for us while we were there and let us store our luggage in an adjoining shed after check-out - which was super appreciated as we weren't flying out until the evening! The only small point of feedback we have is that on one occasion we could not get the key to work in the door so we had to ring the bell to get back into the room. Allen came down to let us in but wasn't very friendly with us. It was after 10am in the morning and we hadn't lost the key, we just couldn't get it to work in the door, so we felt a bit put off by the manner we were met with.

With everything said, this place is clean, cozy, homely and well located for those wanting to explore the many areas of Brooklyn. We would definitely recommend for others to stay here.

Chris & Jitsu were gracious hosts. Everything was 5 stars. Loved the conversation and how friendly Chris was. And Jitsu is the greatest dog ever. Will def book with him again wen I come to visit my daughter. It was my first time booking a room in someone’s home & it was an excellent choice.

Chris was a hospitable host. His apartment was spotless, quiet, and near the subway station, as advertised. He was lightning fast to get back to my endless inquiries and his sweet pup "Jitsu" was an added bonus to the stay.  I would stay at Chris's again without hesitation.
Expect what is offered
Location was good, place was clean and most of all host was very kind and good. The point is JITSU IS THE CUTEEST DOG IN THE WORLD...!!!!

Chris' cosy home is a tranquil oasis to which it is pleasant to return to if you have spent all day in the hussle and bussle of that city that never sleeps... Ideally located because not far from a subway station, but you can easily enjoy the neighborhood itself, plenty of restaurants in the vicinity and not far from the beautiful Botanic Garden and Museum of Brooklyn... Chris is the ideal NY host with plenty of advice ready...

Chris was a great host for the 6 nights we spent there - he was very flexible on check in/check out times and had loads of great tips on places to check out across both Brooklyn and Manhattan. We tried out a fair few of his recommendations and were not disappointed!
The room was exactly as described and pictured, and is in a perfect location to explore Brooklyn/Manhattan - we would definitely recommend Chris as a host to anyone heading to the Brooklyn/New York area.
Also, Jitsu is a super chilled out dog who's great to have around!

Chris was a great host!His place is close to the subway station which makes us easy to explore NY. And his dog,Jitsu ,was very cute and friendly.
We had a terrific time at his place and we definitely are looking forward to coming back again.

Chris was such an excellent host! He welcomed us upon our late arrival as if we were arriving at a friend’s house. Everything was clean and comfortable and he was incredibly thoughtful and considerate. It was such a great value and good location. Will definitely stay again next time I’m in Brooklyn.
C’est la deuxième fois que je séjourne chez Chris et comme la première fois cela fut vraiment top. Je conseille vraiment cet hôte il est vraiment au top. Merci encore Chris et à bientôt je pense 😊
Chris and Jitsu were very welcoming hosts.  The apartment was clean and spacious. It is very close to transport and we used on of his passes to see the Brooklyn Botanical Garden.

Everything was perfect with Chris as a host, from the little things to his Dog Jitsu. Everything is as advertised and the host goes above and beyond to make you feel at home.

Would recommend and stay here again in a heartbeat

Alles ist perfekt bis auf den Lärmpegel, die Wohnung hat die Fenster zur Straße, die Wohnung ist geschmackvoll eingerichtet, das Zimmer ist groß, das Bett ebenfalls, die Matratze sehr gut, die U-Bahn um die Ecke, Manhattan leicht erreichbar, Chris ist ein sehr rücksichtsvoller Gastgeber, sein Hund nicht spürbar und sehr brav. Wer nicht sensibel auf Lärm reagiert, den wird dies nicht stören.

Chris was a fantastic host. Our room was clean and Chris provided helpful tips about the neighborhood and provided passes to museums. The apartment is right by the subway as well which made it easy to get around. Also his dog Jitsu is awesome.

Chris is the best host you could wish for your stay in NYC.

Beautiful apartment, great location, perfectly clean, good talks with Chris and a beautiful and friendly dog ​​named Jitsu.

I would definitely stay again

The apartment is very well located next to the subway. Chris's instructions, tips and help to improve our vacation were fantastic. Jitsu is an adorable dog. It's the first time I use Airbnb and my experience in Chris's apartment has been excellent.
A great place to spend the night, very close to lots of attractions.

Great location, great amenities, great flexibility for checkin and luggage storage. The room got more than everything you need. Sometimes the toilet was not flushing properly, but everything else were alright during our short stay.
Great location.  Close to so much.  Great value.
Building was old, flat looked old too. I would say that this is the only bad thing about this, but... HE Y! almost whole Manhattan is old so it wasn't a flaw. Everything was perfect. :)

A true gem!!! I was on a solo trip to explore the city and mostly watch musicals! This location was the most perfect. Easy access to tkts Lincoln center AND times square locations, so I got amzing tickets every day, wed and sat twice a day! Food is all around u! 24/7. The room is very simple, but very comfortable, hard bed (I hate soft beds) nice pillows everything changed clean and fresh! He was also super nice when giving me the keys, and so flexible with check in/out time. I HIGHLY recommend this place, for solo travelers that needs a ny style place to stay for very affordable and in the middle of the action! Im booking again for may and August.

Shunichi was an excellent host. He stayed up late to meet me on the
night that I arrived and he responded promptly by text to the few
questions I had during my stay. The room had not only a bed and desk,
but also its own refrigerator and microwave. The location was very
convenient and the price reasonable. I would definitely stay with
Shunichi again if I visit Midtown Manhattan.
A simple and peaceful retreat after a long day in the city. Much appreciated the unintrusive hospitality.

Great location, great price, and has all you need for a place to come back to at the end of the night after a day of exploring. The room & bathroom could use some cleaning, but the bed itself was clean and for my stay that’s all I really needed.

Good relation value/price. Shunichi is very good host and the place is very well located i NYC.

Shunichi responded to messages quickly and was very flexible for us to checkin and checkout. The place is exactly as described. Great location, steps away from Central Park, coffee shops and train stations. Will stay again when I visit NYC
Amazing location! You cannot find better.

Exactly as advertised.
Flexible with check-in, nice spot in midtown so trains are walking distance.

Está en un lugar súper céntrico, el espacio es sencillo pero cómodo. Hay múltiples opciones de transporte y se puede caminar a muchos lugares turísticos. De noche la calles es un poco ruidosa lo cual es natural por la ubicación.

The room is really clean and comfortable and it helped to have mini fridge in the room!
Super central, and gives a feeling for simple living in NYC

Great location

2, the apartment is old, and definitely not spot clean. While I'm okay with the overall situation, I did wish it was cleaner, especially around the shower.
Excellent lications. Friendly host. A place I would return gladly.
Great location, perfect for exploring what NYC has to offer.

Exactly as advertised. Good location and great for the price.

Great room. Easy check in as well as check out.

amazing!!

Allen and Irina were very friendly and everything was fine.

Great location , very clean unit and amazing communication between the owner and us. Would stay again.

Chris is honestly an awesome host! Couldn’t have asked for anything better. Will definitely think of this place for the future.

Chris is the perfect host. He is communicative and accommodating. He was flexible on check in/out and the place was super clean. Chris is easy to talk to and knows the area very well. I would highly recommend his place and would stay here again.
excellent stay, everything was excellent, the location is very good and close to the subway
Amazing stay ! Highly recommended!

Location - literally next to a subway for getting in/out of Manhattan. Beautiful part of Brooklyn.

Chris & Jitsu - wonderful company. Jitsu is a very cute dog who will show you his toy and politely say hello.

Chris is an excellent host, keeps a clean, plentifully-stocked house and communicates well. This was a great base of operations for our visit to the city.
Cozy room, welcoming host, wonderful neighborhood.

great BK location and a cute pup roommate.

Great value and allowed us to experience more things on a budget.  Did make us feel more like a New Yorker having an apt and not a hotel room :)

Host helped us with a really late check in and was efficient when communicating and throughout our stay we barely noticed he was there.

La ubicación está muy bien, el lugar es muy bueno, al baño le falta mucha limpieza pero en general está bien

Good value when staying in New York Manhattan.
Great location and easy to find. Didn't spend much time in the room. It is perfect for just sleeping and showering. Very comfy bed!
Great place- very clean, polite host,full privacy,easy to communicate with, and super location . I recommend this place !
Shunichi’s place was amazing! The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, it was centrally located, and the host was respectful of our privacy.

Very good location in Brooklyn, a quiet place to sleep after days of walking in Manhattan !
Chris is very kind and available for any advices.

Chris was an amazing host, especially for our first time visiting NYC! Nice stay in Brooklyn!
Nice place in Brooklyn. Hosts extremely available and helpful with everything.

Irina and Allen were wonderful. The space is great and the location was close to the L. The space is slightly darker than in the photos, but we did not care about that. Chris is a great host with a lovely, clean apartment which is perfectly located for exploring Brooklyn as well as Manhattan. We had an amazing time and would definitely recommend staying with Chris and Jitsu. Thanks for having us!

Chris and Jitsu are the best! We stayed for a week and had a great time. The room is close to the train station, and it was overall pretty quiet at night. We were comfortable and felt at home. There are also plenty of things to do in the surrounding Brooklyn area, which was nice!

Chris and Jitsu (cutest shiba you’ll meet !) have been wonderful hosts, and our experience is one of the best we had through Airbnbs.

Finding parking was a little challenging a Thursday afternoon but definitely not impossible. It is free and depending on which street you park, there is a chance you can leave your car for about 7 days straight, so once you find your spot, you’re all set for the whole duration of your stay !
Since we were not familiar with parking in Brooklyn, Chris even offered to have a look to make sure our spot was fine.

The appartement was the very easy to find and the elevator in the building made it convenient to reach the 3rd floor with heavy luggages.

Chris greeted us warmly, offered us refreshments and showed us our room. It was very spacious, sparkling clean (like every inches of the apartment 🙌) and well furnished with drawers and closet for clothes, many books and games, a large desk as well as a very comfortable bed.

We enjoyed a detailed tour of the apartment so we know where is everything we might need for the next couple days.
The kitchen was very well organized and you can use it to cook. As a side note, Chris has the most amazing collection of spices I have ever seen ! In the morning, you can make coffee and tea.
The living room is spacious, where you can watch TV, read or listen to music.
The bathroom is sparking clean and close to the bedroom so it is easy to access it and you don’t need to travel across the apartment in case you need it in the middle of the night.

We stayed for 3 nights and ended up sleeping very well the window open (and that’s to say, I am usually a light sleeper). The neighborhood tends to get pretty quiet from 11pm to 8am so you’ll get good night’s sleep alright.

The apartment is located about 1 minute walk away from the Manhattan bound subway entrance, which makes you reach the City in less than 20 minutes.

Chris offer to use passes for 2 to museums (listed in the description) which will definitely make you save about $250 !
We haven’t enjoyed those this time, but that’s definitely something to point out as a “great value bonus” of the place.

To sum it up (if you’re not convinced yet), you must book Chris place without thinking twice ! 🔥

Great Host, great place, great location! Chris is just the perfect host, has plenty of tips on food, drinks and things to do. His place is awesome and perfectly located. We couldn't have had a better experience and can't wait to go back to NYC and Chris' place. Thanks so much for everything, Chris!!!!
My sister and her husband had lovely time staying at Chris’s place.
Really nice room, good location, clean, Chris is a very friendly helpful host with good tips for things to do and see and finally his dog is very cute.

Primo choice for a stay! Chris was a fantastic, fun host with great tips and stories…and like everyone else, we immediately fell in love with sweet Jitsu!   Super reasonable rate for clean, comfortable accommodations, a breeze to both the subway and bagel shop, in a delightful neighborhood with lovely evening walks.  We can’t wait to come back!

Lovely welcome and great room in a very good location.

Thank you Chris and Jitsu for a wonderful stay! The area is pretty calm and the subway station to the city/ airport are super close. Chris was a super host! Very welcoming and kind. This Brooklyn Airbnb is not to be missed! The room is spacious and inviting, plus it's close to the subway which makes it really convenient for getting into Manhattan for sightseeing. Jitsu is an amazing canine co-host and is sure to bring a smile to your face every time you open the apartment door. I really recommend staying with Chris if you're looking for a great visit to the NYC!

I had a great experience, Irina was there to greet me and welcome me to the Airbnb, and was very helpful in showing me all the amenities of the place. She was very easy to communicate with and very kind. I would definitely recommend staying there.

This place has everything you need. The room was spacious and the bed was large and confortable. In the kitchen you can see the variety of tools and plates. Every morning we had great breakfast here. Irine was helful while we were staying. She also kindly lent us an umbrella when it rained. I liked the place.

This was everything we needed! It was right around the corner from where our friend lives, and was beautifully large, clean, and so super comfortable. We were so happy to rest our heads here after a long day of walking all over NYC. Thank you guys so much for your hospitality. We will definitely be back again next year!

Irina was responsive to all our communications. She met us upon arrival, showed us around the apartment, and offered to be available if we needed anything. The apartment is spacious, well equipped, spotlessly clean and very comfortable, especially the wonderful king bed. Surprisingly quiet too!

We loved our time at Allen & Irina's place! It was really clean, bright and in a fantastic location. We met Irina on arrival, and she was very welcoming and happy to host us. The full kitchen is really nice, and is was great to see the dishwasher and clothes washer, even though we didn't use them. We recommend this place to anyone who needs a place to stay in Williamsburg. We will certainly look to Allen & Irina the next time we plan a trip to the area.

Stayed here for five days with my girlfriend. We arrived late at night from the airport as our luggage was lost, but the kind host patiently waited for us! Pros: The apartment is centrally located in Williamsburg and is big and comfortable for two people. Cons: very noisy.

Chris’s room is spacious and perfectly located for exploring Brooklyn and Manhattan. Chris’s dog Jitsu is incredibly friendly and a great roommate to have. The museum passes were such a plus. He’s a super friendly and helpful host and his sustainable lifestyle is great.
Good experience staying with Chris and Jitsu!
Location was right next to train, and the bedroom very comfortable. Chris was a fantastic host. Thank you!

Quedarnos con Chris ha sido seguramente lo mejor que podíamos hacer para disfrutar nuestro viaje a NY! La tranquilidad del barrio en Brooklyn es ideal para descansar de Manhattan y volver a cargar las pilas para el día siguiente.

Chris y Jitsu han sido unos anfitriones excepcionales, amables y atentos en todo momento, con una comunicación por chat muy rápida, poniendo las cosas muy fáciles. Sin duda si volvemos a NY repetiremos en este alojamiento!

Chris and Jitsu are really friendly. Chris will give you great tips about some good places to grab something to eat. I would like to emphasize on his good disposition to check us in at 4am, we are really grateful for that!

Chris is a lovely and kind person, always available and nice. The house is very clean with everything you wish!
Hope to come back soon. Thanks again for everything!!!

Chris' place was really good. It was amazingly clean and organized. Loved it was a quiet neighborhood vs staying in Manhattan, and it was easy to take the train from his place. His puppy Jitsu was always greeting at us!
Chris was really helpful, answered messages quickly, and had recommendations for places to go around the city. The Museum tickets were really helpful. Definitely a 10/10!

Our stay at Chris's Airbnb was special and pleasant. The company of Chris and Jitsu (his pet) was enjoyable, Jitsu is a very well-behaved animal. Chris's attention from the beginning to the end is greatly appreciated. Everything was in order, from how to access the place, the security of the space, the opportunities to use the membership passes for museums, and recommendations for places to eat. It was all an extra for our stay. We recommend it for other travelers to have the same experience or even better than the one we had. Thank you Chris! Many blessings and we hope to see you again!

Incredible place to stay. Chris is a perfect host- so kind and attentive but also just let us do our own thing. Thanks, Chris!

We loved him and looked forward to him greeting us at the door in the evenings. Overall, highly recommend Chris’ place.

I attend school in NY once a month, so I've visited a few Airbnbs in Brooklyn. This one is by far the cleanest place with a very hospitable host. The bedroom was spacious, and the kitchen was available to use. The bathroom was clean and came with all the amenities.

The C train in on the corner, and grocery stores are down the block. The wifi is fast, and there's a nice working space if you need to do any work while visiting.

I'd book with Chris again for sure.

We loved staying at Per's apartment! It was clean, well furnished and it is near 2 subway stations, near central park and museums. Per always responded quickly when we had questions. I would definitely recomend it!

Pers Place is awesome since its located in one of Manhattans most Authentic Neighbourhoods! II lived in NYC for 5 Years and Pers Apartment put me back to my times in NYC.  You live like a local in Pers Apartment I really appreciated living there amongst the local folks again. Cant wait to come back again. Was a very nice month in East Harlem Manhattan, Pers Apartment felt like coming home.

Per's apartment was perfect for an extended stay in New York City. The apartment is incredibly well-equipped, spotlessly clean and very comfortable. One block from Central Park, good grocery stores a block or two blocks away depending on your preference and a short walk to the subway (either to go down the west or east side - very convenient!) I would definitely stay here again, and Per was very quick and attentive to messages too.

Both my husband and I are New Yorkers of 14 years. We needed an apartment for two months while we were in between two moves, while all our stuff was in storage. Per's apartment came to our rescue. Located on the border of Upper East and East Harlem, it is certainly a neighborhood on the verge of transition, however convenience wise, we couldn't asked for anything better. You are a 5 min walk away from both West Side (2/3) and East Side (6) trains, the buses on 5th Ave are a HUGE plus, and also - since we have a medium sized dog, we absolutely loved being just one block away from the Northern end of Central Park. Our pooch got sufficiently spoiled with her daily walks and extended play times there.

As far as the apartment goes, it's a well-laid out, well-stocked, clean and convenient one bedroom. All you need to buy is the groceries (there is a pretty big store on Madison, just one block away from Per's apartment). There is also laundry and gym on the top floor of the building for added convenience.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. Per was communicative and helpful; and was always available for questions. If you are looking for a long term stay, I would recommend his apartment strongly.

Beautiful, clean, modern, comfortable apartment in a elevator building in a safe neighborhood. Perfect location, you can easily go anywhere with easy access to subway. Lovely in the winter with heat and hot water. More than enough space for your clothes and toiletries, which isn't always the case with Airbnb units. The place feels warm and homey yet modern with no clutter. You can't do better on Airbnb. Sofa is perfect for that extra guest! The host was very friendly, easy to communicate with, and reliable.

Allen and Irina's place was clean and comfortable. The apartment was secure behind the cutest orange door on the block!  Neighborhood felt safe and was within walking distance to restaurants, grocery, and pharmacy. We definitely enjoyed our stay here, felt like a home away from home!

Das Studio hat eine tolle Lage und ist für New Yorker Verhältnisse wirklich sehr großzügig. Die große Küche ist sehr modern und vollständig ausgerüstet, wir haben sie allerdings gar nicht genutzt. Auch das Bad ist sehr geräumig.
Was aus dem Inserat und den Bildern nicht hervorgeht, ist dass es sich quasi um ein Souterrain-Apartment handelt, daher also trotz voller Beleuchtung deutlich dunkler ist. Dadurch wirkt auch die größtenteils "klassische" Ausstattung weniger modern als auf den Bildern, was uns zu Beginn etwas enttäuscht hat. Aber wenn man wie wir sowieso nur zum Schlafen im Studio ist, ist das auch schnell wieder egal. Das riesige Bett ist dafür nämlich unglaublich bequem. Trotzdem in jedem Fall Ohrstöpsel mitnehmen, da es recht hellhörig ist.
Alles in allem hatten wir einen tollen Aufenthalt im Apartment.

Irina was very friendly and cordial and provided a tour of the apartment on arrival.  I arrived many hours before check in and she allowed me to drop off my bags at the apartment which made it easier for me to go out into the city.  She offered a great suggestion for a nearby cafe for me to visit as well.  The apartment was very clean and cozy.  The neighborhood felt safe, and I saw lots of young adults as well as families walking around the area.  There was a little construction happening on the street at the time of my stay, but obviously out of the hosts control.  I would absolutely stay here again and look forward to returning.

We loved staying here. Irina was really welcoming and helpful (we were particularly grateful that she let us leave our bags in the apartment after checkout on the final day, as our flight home was late afternoon).  The apartment was very comfortable - clean, spacious and homely. It was great to have Netflix for when we returned after a long day of sightseeing! The apartment was ideally situated for us - close to the subway and with lots of great places to eat and drink within walking distance. We would definitely stay there again. Thank you very much!

Irina war immer sehr gut zu erreichen – die Anreise/Abreise und „Check In/Out“ haben reibungslos funktioniert.
Das Appartement war sehr sauber und geräumig. In der Küche war alles vorhanden, um gut zu frühstücken.
Die Anbindung an Manhattan ist wirklich sehr gut – es sind nur ein paar Minuten bis zur nächsten Metro (Hewes St), die direkt über die Williamsburg Bridge nach Manhattan führt. Williamsburg selbst kann man gut zu Fuß erkunden.

This is a great base for enjoying both Manhattan and Brooklyn. It's easy to get in to Manhattan on a couple of metro lines and it's nice to return at the end of the day to a comfy apartment in a neighbourhood rather than a tiny hotel room in Manhattan. The bed was extremely comfortable and we had great sleep each night despite a bit of noise from outside and above. The apartment was nice and clean and well equipped and the shower was good. Overall a very good choice.

My stay was nice, the apartment had all of the amenities necessary for a stay -- and the bed was really comfortable. My only slight complaint is that the photos make the place look a lot brighter than it actually is -- it's a basement property so it was often quite dark, even with the lights on. Besides that, Irina was lovely and the apartment is in a great location for exploring Brooklyn and quickly getting into Manhattan. I would highly recommend staying here.

Great place to stay in brooklyn. The appartement is very close from subway, it s spacious and bed is amazing ..Irina answers to your questions if you need it. Only one thing it s a little bit dark and noisy sometimes..

Great location, great small apartment with large well equipped kitchen.  Noise levels a little high; could hear their parrot and outside as on ground level and poorly lit, but it was perfect for trip, comfortable and very clean.

Fantastic apartment with loads of space and convenience. The bed is heaven. Occasionally noisy and the wifi can be patchy but it's the perfect location to explore the city from, or to take a stroll in Williamsburg.

We really enjoyed our stay at Allen and Irina's apartment. Brooklyn is a wonderful area to explore on it own with lots of restaurants within walking distance. Very close to Metropolitan avenue station G and L lines as well as the J and M lines at Hewes St station (the latter particularly useful for connecting with the JFK airtrain) and the Q54 bus so the apartment is very easy to get to without having to use a taxi. There is everything in the apartment that you could possibly need including a dishwasher and all the kitchen accoutrements and the bed is super comfy. We loved our stay and found Irina and Allen to be great hosts.

Oh and for any fellow Australian visitors who love their espresso, excellent Australian style coffee can be found within walking distance (1km) at Sweatshop cafe in metropolitan avenue.

The apartment was very comfortable and it felt like our own home for 10 days! It is very well equipped with everything you need in the kitchen and plenty of linens and towels with extra pillows and blankets. The location is ideal for browsing Brooklyn or going to Manhattan. The subway is a short walk for the L train to Manhattan. The area has grocery stores, laundry, coffee shops, restaraunts, bars all within walking distance. Walk to Greenpoint and Williamsburg central or get the train to Fort Greene for further taste of Brooklyn - have a drink, a bite to eat, get your nails done, visit a book shop, work out in the park or sit and watch the world go by! The apartment has a real Brooklyn feel - the parrot upstairs chirping and the occasional street noise just added to the authentic  experience. We would love to return so One!
Nicole was GREAT!!  The location was WONDERFUL, and her hospitality was 5-star.  Great apt. in a great location and very easy to get around the city.  I would definitely recommend!

Great place, well located near a subway station and Central Park!!
I love staying at Lara's house, she is very caring, sweet and receptive. I felt very good and safe there. The location is great and for sure I would suggest staying with her.

It was a very nice and kind stay at the appartment. Everything worked fine. The situation of the appartment is great.

As advertised. Great location in Hell’s Kitchen. Very clean and shampoo, etc provided. Had a great stay.

Lara is very flexible when plans change and takes away travelstress. She's a nice and welcoming host. She is clear and fast in her reactions. Her place is smallish, but the room itself is not too small. And hey, the centre of Manhattan, so the centre of the Universe, for that price? A bargain!
Enjoyed my stay. Very accommodating. Close to the metro that will get you anywhere in the city.

Lara is a great hostess, responsive, easy to communicate and very quick to answer my messages.  The place is very nice and comfortable.  The location is excellent very near the subway and the main attractions of Manhatan.  If I go back to NY I will definitely stay there again.  I recommend!
Lara was super !!!! Very great experince !!!!

Fabulous stay! Totally clean, quiet, and peaceful place.  Slept better than I do at home. I really enjoyed this place. Great for a business trip. Close to all the action.

A fine room in a great location. Clean place, quick replies. Would recommend.

It was very pleasant experience to stay with Nicole in her cozy and quiet place in the middle of Manhattan. Super convenient location to any corner of New York City. Comfy bed, good size room.
Place very clean. She is very friendly and helpful host.

Larissa is a very welcoming host. Her apartment is spotlessly clean and uncluttered. FYI, it’s a 4th floor walk-up. The quiet bedroom has nice closet and drawer space. Location is fabulous - close to subways, shops, and Central Park.

Charming accomadatıons,  Friendlly hosts  with delıghtful children,

Convenient and nice place

Adrienne´s room is a perfect location for a stay in Williamsburg! We had a late arrival from the airport and she made everything as easy as possible for us to check in at night.

Suited us perfectly. Comfy bed, great powerful shower and the air-con worked well. It was in the high 80's in June. Fridge was great too and finding a hairdryer.  Compact, clean and tidy. Thank you Adrienne.
Great Family, great location, quaint room. Will stay again next time.

We were very happy with our stay at Adrienne's place.  The space was wonderful and the location was perfect.  We rode out hurricane Irene in comfort and ease.  We will definitely stay again!
Thank you for a short but great stay in your nice and cozy apartment. It's in a great location also. We really loved it and we'll certainly be back another time! Monica and Janina

A nice little basement studio with private entrance and bathroom and windows to the backyard. Adrienne and her husband were extremely friendly and basically there were just no problems of any kind. Definitely recommended.

I would stay here again.

A really nice place in a beautiful area of Brooklyn. It's a little walk to the subway and back but after a long day in crowded and noisy Manhattan, it's a relief to come back to Williamsburg. There are a lot of good shops, bars, and restaurants in the area and the view of Manhattan from the new pier is overwhelming!

The room is exactly the way it is described. We really appreciated that we could make our own coffee in the morning and that ground coffee was waiting there for us. The bathroom is a bit damp, though.

We talked to Adrienne only twice but she was always warmhearted, extremely friendly and helpful (asked us in, called a taxi for us, gave us advice on restaurants). We felt very much welcome and would recommend Adrienne's place to other people.

Très bon emplacement, à proximité de plusieurs métro et dans un quartier agréable. L'appartement et spacieux et très propre, avec tous les équipements nécessaires. Les hôtes étaient très réactifs. Comfortable basement apartment. Convenient location - close to hewes st station.
Good base for New York trip.

Very nice!
Had my parents stay here while they visited me. Great place, the hosts are very friendly and kind.
We had a pleasant time in this cozy apartment. When we come back again, first thing would be to check with Addriane if the place is available. Thanks you so much!
My parents stayed here for a quick weekend in NY. They absolutely loved the convenience of a first floor apartment, and the space was just perfect for two people.

We would definitely consider staying at Adrienne's place again!

Great Apartment, very well located(only one stop from Manhattan). Adrienne and her family were very kind and helpful and they let us stay until late our last day there. Thank u very much!!! Muchas Gracias por todo.

Great experience! Adrienne and her family were very kind and helpful during all my stay, much more than I could expect. We had the best thinkable stay that we could ever imagine with Adrienne and the family. They were all so nice and helpful with everything we needed. My stay at Adrienne's place in Williamsburg could not have been better!  Everything was just perfect. Adrienne was very accommodating and made sure I had everything I needed to have a great stay. I will definitely stay at this place again in the future. Thanks for everything, Adrienne!

I stayed at Adrienne's apartment for 3 weeks and it was perfect!!! The entire family was very welcoming and accommodating (and so sweet)! They were very helpful and really easy to get in touch with. I was there during the winter and when it snowed, I woke up to a shoveled patio.
The apartment itself is really cute and feels like an actual home. Everything was clean and exactly as depicted. The internet works and the bed is sooo comfortable!!!!

If I need a place to stay in NYC, I would love to stay here again!

Staying at Adrienne's was truly like home from home, clean, comfortable and cosy warm which was really appreciated as I had arrived to a New York Winter from an Australian Summer. The children are delightful( didn't get to meet Jeff)  I will definitely recommend and expect to be back.  .

Adrienne and her family were lovely hosts. We saw them on a few occasions and they were very friendly, welcoming and helpful. If I am ever in New York again I won't hesitate to come back and stay here !

Small cosy apartment, flooded with light, in a perfect location. Des problèmes de santé nous ont empêchés de partir à la date prévue, Tom s'est montré excessivement gentil, compréhensif, et nous a permis de rester quelques jours de plus chez lui. C'était vraiment un soulagement pour nous.

Do not miss this place. Incredible value, nice and clean and less than 15 minutes to Manhattan
Great location. Easy communications. Would stay here again.

Irina welcomed us personally at her apartment. The apartment itself was Cozy and well equipped (it was luxury to have a washing machine and a dish washer).

We greatly enjoyed our stay and definitely recommend vacations here to visit New York City. Great host. I highly recommend staying at Allen & Irina`s place.

Great location. It’s close to lots of great restaurants and shops and easy access to the subway or buses. Irina was very nice and made sure we were happy. Definitely recommend their place.

Very nice place! Probably the best we’ve found for price range. Spacious. In-unit washing machine is awesome and dishwasher. The pictures are professional but the space didn’t disappoint. Will definitely stay again.

Very confortable. Amazing studio. We LOVE IT! Tom is  so cool.

Tom's place is great. Awesome location and a great apartment. I stayed for 3 weeks on business

I would recommend the studio to anyone and wouldn't hesitate to stat again.

Tom is an awesome host and his place is the quintessential New York West Village apartment. Really comfortable bed, great light and all the necessities make staying at his apartment very enjoyable. Located in one of the most desirable parts of the West Village surrounded by excellent restaurants and jazz clubs. Highly recommend!
I had a wonderful stay in one of the best neighborhoods in the city. Tom was communicative and helpful. Thanks again.

Highly recommend—and the apartment is just as it is in the pictures, lots of morning sunlight and a cozy, lived-in feel. 5 stars!

I highly recommend staying at Tom's apartment. Tom was incredibly helpful, and made sure I was comfortable and had everything I needed. I will 100% stay here again in the future if possible.
Great location with easy access to West Village, Greenwich Village, Hudson River Park and so much more. An abundance of restaurants and bars nearby, and groceries are just a few blocks away.

Staying at Tom's place was really wonderful. He has a beautiful home and the apartment is a great size. I was so comfortable being there and the location is absolutely beautiful. My 17 year old daughter stayed in Adrienne's apt for one month this summer while working in NYC. Adrienne was incredibly welcoming, supportive, responsive and communicative. We had a lovely stay in Williamsburg. Adrienne took care of everything and it couldn't have been smoother.
Apartment is as appears and the location is great.
If we ever make it back this way we will definitely be staying here again.

We stayed at the Adrienne’s place for 9 days…and what we could say…everything was absolutely PERFECT. The home is little but very comfortable and there is everything you need.
The kitchen is fully-equipped , the bathroom is very big and with a wonderful shower and everything is really very clean.
Adrienne and Jeff are very nice and really friendly… she gave us extra-toilet paper and extra towels. We really felt home.
The house is located in Williamsburg in Brooklyn and the location is strategic. You are at only 1 metro stop from Manhattan so you can easily get in to the city…but not only!!! At only five minute walking there is the East River Ferry stop where the ferry can take you directly to Midtown or Downtown stopping at Dumbo…but the thing that really worth is the wondeful view of Manhattan skyline… we passed at this place at least once a day before going home!!!Especially in the evening with all the lights on.. it’s really a breath-taking view.
The area is very safe and full of cafès, restaurants, deli, pharmacies and grocery stores…you can easily find everything you need just few steps from home.
We want to underline this…we are Italian (from Rome) and before taking off for New York we said “ We won’t eat Italian food, we will taste food from all over the world”…well because of “La Nonna” on Bedford Ave we broke this statement twice!!! During the first days we passed by this pizzeria going back home from the metro station and gave a look to its pizzas… what we could say is that we ate better at “La Nonna” than in the 90% of pizzerias in Rome!!!
The last thing is that on Bedford Ave just on the way for the metro station there is Northside luxury car service office where we reserved a car that for 38$ take us to the airport on the last day! (The taxi on arrival costed us 45$ plus tips).
If it wasn’t for Airbnb where we found this perfect accomodation we probably couldn’t afford to visit to NYC, we just can’t wait to come back to New York at Adrienne’s obviously! ;-)
Siamo stati da Adrienne 9 notti e tutto è stato assolutamente perfetto! La casa è piccolina ma molto confortevole. La cucina è equipaggiata ed il bagno è grande e molto pulito. Adrienne e Jeff sono persone molto cordiali e simpatiche. La posizione in Williamsburg è strategica: 1 fermata di metro da Manhattan e con l'east river ferry si può facilmente raggiungere anche Dumbo. Inoltre dalla fermata del ferry si può godere di una stupenda vista su Manhattan! Se non fosse per Airbnb e per l'accomodation di Adrienne probabilmente non avremmo fatto questo bellissimo viaggio!

This is an excellent place to experience williamsburg and nyc in general.
