Adrienne and her family are very welcoming and have a great knowledge of the area.

I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for any kind of stay in New York

My wife and I spent a whole month in this apartment and Adrienne and her family made us feel at home in this place that has everything you'll need! The apartment is very clean and the area feels secure. The closeness to Williamsburg Bridge makes it super easy to take a walk to Manhattan if you want to and the area in Williamsburg is great for eating out or getting a drink.
We couldn't have had a better trip and we definitely want to stay here again when we go to New York next time!

Adrienne and her family are amazing people. Very helpful and polite. The place is very clean and they provide everything you need. They live upstairs in case you need them. L and J trains are just a couple of blocks away and the neighberhood is very calm and full of places to visit.
Thank you Adrienne and Jeff for having me.

Great location amidst all the hip cafes, boutique shops and restaurants in the heart of Williamsburg, but close to Manhattan. It's a vibrant, yet a very safe neighborhood – and traveling with a toddler, we especially appreciated the great playground just around the corner. Adrienne and her family were extremely nice and helpful throughout our 2-month stay. We felt very welcome, and immediately at home. The kitchen is somewhat small, but does the trick. The A/C, the shower and the internet all worked really well. We will definitely return!

We stayed at Adrienne's suite for two weeks or so. It was the perfect space for us. The location cannot be beat with the best of Williamsburg out your door, a quick walk to the train into the city, and the river park down the street! The bed is comfy and fresh sheets and towels were provided during our stay. The place is clean, sweetly decorated and the kitchen was well stocked with anything a modest dinner might need. We had a great time and look forward to booking again in the future!!

Had a pretty nice 30-day stay here from mid January to mid February. Adrianne and her family were actually away on holiday for most of my time there, so I only got to meet them upon checkout, but they did seem like nice people, as most other comments mention.

-The place is spotless and has lots and lots of closet/drawer space (vital for long stays).
-Heating worked perfectly, even during the coldest days of January (Snowpocalypse included).
-Kitchen was well equipped, with a Keurig (and capsules), a fast-heating oven, and lots of utensils and stuff. No microwave, though.
-Bathroom was huge, but with a clear humidity problem. The issue here is that, to counter the humidity, you need to run a huge exhaust fan which, in cold winter days, can get the bathroom to a freezing temperature pretty quickly. It's probably not a big issue in the summer, but in wintertime, this was a problem (especially since it took us a while to figure out how to close the vent properly).
-As mentioned, I was only living under Adrienne's family for the last few days of my stay but I honestly wouldn't recommend this place for light sleepers or longer stays (unless the family is on holiday). My girlfriend's a light sleeper and the noise from upstairs drove her a bit crazy those last few days. Keep in mind she woke up and left everyday before 7:30am, so this noise thing starts really early.
-Neighborhood is very cool, full of hip cafes, restaurants, food trucks, bars, etc. all within an 8 block radius. Subway is a bit far, at least 7 or 8 blocks away, but they're all cool, very safe blocks, and it's great that this is the last stop before Manhattan.
-Adrienne, through e-mail while she was on holiday and in person upon checkout, was very warm, responsive and helpful.

I was like home.
Adrienne and her family are amazing people the one bed flat is very clean and they provide everything you need in every single details. They live upstairs in case you need them but you’ll be very independent with your own Kitchenette, bathroom and bedroom. Very close to shops, grocery and subway. The view from two block away is stunning just near east river. I recommend this place for sure.

Estuvimos 33 noches en el departamento de Adrienne y nos sentimos muy cómodos. El lugar es ideal para dos personas, chiquito, con mucho espacio de guardado, todos los elementos necesarios para cocinar...tiene todo lo que se necesita para vivir. El barrio es hermoso, en otra ocasión me alojé en Time Square, East Village, Soho y Bushwick pero sin duda alguna volvería a elegir Williamsburg! Si bien las líneas de subway L y J están a unas cuadras, son trayectos seguros y lindos para caminar. El barrio siempre está en movimiento. Adrienne y su familia son muy adorables, en todo momento se preocuparon porque estemos cómodos y nos sintamos bien en su espacio. Nos gustó que vivan arriba ya que cualquier eventualidad es fácil comunicarse y resolver. Parte de nuestra estadía ellos estuvieron de viaje y seguimos comunicándonos por teléfono sin ningún problema, de hecho se tapó el desagüe de la cocina y nos ofrecieron subir a cocinar a su casa, optamos por seguir cocinando en el apartamento y a los dos días nos mandaron un plomero que rápidamente resolvió el problema. A raíz de esto quisieron reembolsarnos y no nos pareció necesario. A nosotros los ruidos de los cuales hablan algunos comentarios no nos molestaron ya que nuestro estilo de estadía fue levantarnos temprano y aprovechar el día en la ciudad. Lo único que queremos destacar es que el colchón de la cama es muy soft y como tenemos la espalda sensible a veces nos hizo doler. Ante el todo fue un detalle menor. El apartamento de Adrienne es súper recomendable!

出張の際に1ヶ月強滞在しました。ブルックリンのウィリアムズバーグのベッドフォード駅から徒歩8〜10分程度でとてもとても快適な滞在でした。一軒家の半地下の部屋にはベッドルーム、ミニキッチン、トイレ・バスが備え付けられていて、申し分ない環境です。近くには素敵なカフェ、バー、日本食レストラン含めなんでもあり、次回ニューヨークを訪れる際にはぜひまた利用したいと思ってます。
ホストファミリーはとても親しみを持って迎えてくれて、週末には一度朝ごはんをご馳走になりました。ちいさなお子さん二人とご主人もいつも笑顔で話かけてくれて、まさに住むように滞在するを地でいくような体験です。
So, I stayed a bit over one month, and it was my perfect Airbnb experience, well-furnished room, and warm welcome from w wonderful family with friendly care and interaction. Having dad-made taco breakfast with family over for weekend was wonderful memory for me. Love to come back in the future!

Adrienne, Jeff, Lola and Blake are a lovely family who make you feel very welcome. Anything you need, they are happy to help or guide you in the right direction. The place is very homely, clean and everything you need. It is located close to everything without having the hustle and bustle at your doorstep. Definitely recommend this spot to anyone, although maybe not or it will be booked out and I'll never get back in!
Nos brindo su confianza en todo momento.  Por su buena acogida y disponibilidad cuando fuera necesaria.  Brindándonos todo lo necesario para que estuviéramos cómodos.

My wife and I loved staying at Adrienne's place.
Location is really close to public transport, shops, restaurants and is in the heart of Williamsburg.
The place felt like home, clean and comfortable. As most others mentioned Adrienne and her family are wonderful people. We would recommend this place for sure to anyone. Do not miss it.

My boyfriend and I spent two months and a half in Adrienne's house and everything was good! The apartment is comfortable and it is good for a couple. The bed is large, the bathroom is huge and the whole house is clean. Because of the humidity in the bathroom Adrienne and Jeff added two heaters more so the room was warm during our stay (from January to March). In the house there is wifi and it works very well. The neighborhood is convenient, there are restaurants, shops and a big supermarket close to the house and the street where the apt is located is quiet. The L train (Bedford Avenue stop) is not more than 10 minute walk from the house. Adrienne and Jeff are wonderful people and the whole family is very hospitable! Their kids are so sweet! Adrienne and Jeff were very helpful and kind. They often made sure everything was going well. The communication was very good and easy from the beginning. We absolutely recommend staying in this apartment and we hope to come back soon there! A real “home away from home” experience and in this case you will have a second family too!

I really loved that place,
It is a nice quiet place, having a whole apartment in Williamsburg for that price is really good!
The area is full of coffees, restaurant, shops the metro is really close to go to Manhattan via L at Bedford station.
The hosts are the nicest people I have ever stayed with!
If you are a couple this place is the perfect place you wanna be at, it is really cute!
I will definitely come back here sometimes , i stayed 1 month and it went very fast.
I would recommend it for any kind of stay ,short or long.
Can t wai t to be back!

Adrienne is a Top Class host. I had to book her place for my friend who was arriving from India for work in New York with his wife and 2 year kid. Although i could not meet adrienne in person because of my schedule. All i heard from my friend was how good and wonderful the host(including her family) are.
I liked the bathroom more than anything in this place, it was super huge. Some quick facts below

Commute
Bedford Ave station is walkable and takes you directly to downtown manhattan, where you can do free transfer to midtown or uptown etc. Direct midtown trains (M Trains) are at Marcy's Ave station 17 min walk from the place.

Communication
Host will be available to handover the keys , explain what is your boundary and moving around the neighborhood. She also has this neat handout, which has all stores listed you might need for your stay.

Neighborhood
The place is so lively with people from various nations, culture and pub's , bars in walkable distance.

I would definitely recommend this place if you plan to stay as couple, Two roomates or Couple with small kid. Stay at adrienne's place you will love it !!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Adrienne and Jeffs place for approximately 2.5 months. The location is great - right in the center of Williamsburg and only about a 10 minute walk from the L train which takes you to manhattan. Williamsburg was such a cool place to live - so much creativity, lots of cool restaurants and bars. Adrienne was always quick to respond to us with any questions or concerns. Jeff was super nice and welcoming as well! They have two kids who are very sweet and well mannered. The space is a studio apartment with a lot of storage space for clothes. The bathroom is huge with a walk in shower. It was honestly such a spectacular deal for the location and the fact that Adrienne provides all the toiletries and even washes your sheets and towels when needed! You will have to walk to a laundromat but there's a big one we used on south 4th street between wythe and Berry. I can't say enough good things about living here! We just loved it so much! Our summer definitely would not have been as good if we lived anywhere else. The noise from footsteps upstairs really was not an issue for us at all. The only thing I will say though is that my phone reception was not the best if I wanted to make a call from the apartment because it is down in the basement. I usually made calls outside in front of the house because calls from the apartment were too staticky for people to hear me.  We had the best time here though and would definitely return in a heartbeat!

Adrienne and her family were extremely friendly and welcoming with plenty of suggestions of where to go and eat, drink and explore. The studio has everything you would ever need, stocked kitchenette, small fridge, and a massive bathroom which is really nice to have. The bed is super comfortable also which is a big plus!
The location is perfect. You're right near all the best restaurants and bars in Brooklyn and only a short walk to the L or JMZ trains. We stayed for a month and would definitely recommend to anyone.

Amazing place to stay in Brooklyn.
The place is spotless and well thought out.
Adrienne provided a white noise machine and also an electric blanket.
Close to all the necessities (train station, grocery store, UPS, etc...). You can be in manhattan in minutes.
Adrienne was very friendly and accommodating.
I would definitely stay again and recommend to my friends.

Everyone was in touch, kind, and accommodating, it was very easy for us to pick up and drop off keys with a friend. The apartment was very clean and well appointed. We had a very lovely time and would absolutely stay here again.

Hands down a great experience! Better than what I expected. Ashni and Jessica had great communication skills and was there for anything we needed. We had our own space, it was clean, peaceful, safe and they were kind to allow us use their laundry machines. Didn't expect to need it, but after being in Times Square for over 12 hours in the rain; our clothes definitely needed washing and drying. Ashni was so kind to welcome us into her home; we arrived and seen a welcome ballon with a basket full of a goodies and a kind hand written message to us. The hospitality was great! I have no complaints. Might I mention the gratitude of not being over priced  or highly price for this location being that it was during a major holiday. Lastly, the house is local to the subway and less than a minute to the bus stop. Overall a great experience and we are glad we found this place!
Sunder’s place is private and really cute. clean and there’s no bugs. location is right near a bus stop. they leave snacks. theres ambiance. very accommodating. righteous experience.
I was not given the place that was described in the advertisement and that was very disappointing.

Our stay with Waldemar was great.  We were in town looking for an apartment during a heat wave, it was a stressful time to say the least.  To be able to come back to a lovely brownstone with air conditioning AND a ceiling fan was indispensable!  Waldemar was very helpful with any information we needed about the city, especially regarding fixing our flat tire!  It is a great neighborhood with lots of cute restaurants and alot of soul and character.  I would recommend Waldemar's to any travelers looking for a genuine Brooklynite experience.

Had a very comfortable and pleasant week at Waldemars place.
I stay in NYC often for business and really enjoyed the space and neighborhood. The common spaces are beautifully appointed and the master bed and private bath give you privacy and comfort. The room is clean, in the back and very quiet. Waldemar is gracious, helpful, available, and he and his roomates are very respectful of your privacy.
The neighborhood is classic Brooklyn. A great mix of people, families, art students etc...
Close to some great restaurants and a wonderful French deli that also has delicious prepared foods on the corner. I enjoyed the convenience of getting into manhattan with the subway less then two blocks away. A great base for exploring manhattan and Brooklyn. I look forward to staying here again.

Waldmar was a wonderful host and his home is a lovely old brownstone in the Clinton Hill area of Brooklyn. We enjoyed our morning coffee together and then went about our busy days. Our family loved the fact we were close enough to them to walk over for brunch or meander home at night.

Waldmar's brownstone is authentic--it has not been defaced to look like a standard american home-it has been preserved to celebrate the 100 plus years it has been a brownstone in Brooklyn. You are in for a treat!
I've stayed with Waldemar a few times now and really enjoy being there.  He's courteous, the place clean and location ideal. Couldn't be happier.

He was just one of the best host, Very helpful to me and his home was very warm and inviting not only did I have my own bathroom which is very important to me but I felt at home in his place and it open the door for me to want to live in that area. I was new in town and he really help me out. He is the top on my list of host....I 100% give him a ten out of ten......

Waldemar is a wonderful host. The room in the appartment is big, clean and cozy and situated in the very heart of Brooklyn. The neighbourhood has very cool and friendly cafés and restaurants at Dekalb Avenue. There you can also find a yogaplace. Our absolute favourite breakfast was at the extraordinary Choice café just half a block down from the appartment or at Choice nr 2, a market on a parallel street. A big supermarket and the subway is just a minute away. We are very lucky that this became our choice and would love to come back again.

anna & johan
Enjoyable visit.  Just right for us.  Easy to come and go.  Great for access to Manhatten. Nice cafes in area.

We (my daughter and I) stayed in NYC for business in the City. We found the room beautiful, quiet, even at night, relaxing and convenient to the subway.
Our host(s) were gracious and engaging. We enjoyed our stay immensely and would stay there again.

Todo correcto. Es importante o imprescindible dominar la lengua inglesa
De lo contrario. Se te complicará la comunicación. Por lo demás las fotos son del lugar. El barrio algo ruidoso por las noches. Igualmente seguro
Great location and really friendly hosts

Good location, very clean. Allen was there when we arrived and helped us find our way to the subway. We have Verizon phone service and had difficulties with connecting inside the apartment, but the WiFi works great and we were able to get Uber rides. Good to know if subway is on holiday schedule or not in service, but that is nothing our hosts could control. We did have trouble getting used to city noises and close living, the windows have street lights shining in so it never gets really dark in the apartment. We did appreciate the lovely space and complete kitchen with lots of little extras that made our stay special. There is a lot to do in Brooklyn and we look forward to coming back!
Super clean, super nice, close to everything !
Beautiful place, great neighbourhood.
Good value. 15 minute walk to wburg central

We had a good stay in the apartment but did have some issues. The apartment was very nice, clean and comfortable. The kitchen was fully stocked, bed was huge and soft and there were lots of books and travel guides to reference. It was super convenient to several train lines as well, less than a 10 minute walk to the L, M, J and G trains. The TV only had a Roku which was fine with us but there is no cable for those unfamiliar with Netflix/Hulu etc. Wi-Fi was available but spotty. The host was nice and responsive while messaging but quiet and a bit awkward in person. The biggest issue we had was with the front door. We were not warned that it was tricky, and only shown how to lock/unlock from the inside at first. When we left for the first time we tried practicing unlocking it from the outside and couldn’t do it. The host heard us struggling and came down to show us but it was still difficult for us to open when we got back later that night. I messaged for them to come help us and they did but they just seemed very inconvenienced by us. We apologized several times for needing more help and they didn’t say anything back or reassure us that it was ok. We looked at past reviews and it seemed like we were not the only ones to have this issue. Another issue we had was the noise, some of it was from the street and construction outside which we expected and didn’t care about but one morning we were awoken by someone screaming upstairs and loud bangs (the hosts live above the apartment). We probably will not stay here again due to our experiences but overall the apartment was very nice and conveniently located!
Excellent space.
Thank you for having us .... This place was exactly what my wife and I were looking for .... Close to everything .... Good restaurants, caffee shops, train stations .... Highly recommended ....

The apartment was bigger then expected with lots of space.  It was very clean and the kitchen was fully equipped. The king bed was also very comfortable.  We enjoyed our stay and the christmas tree was a lovely holiday touch!

A great space for a couple looking to explore Williamsburg with easy access to the surrounding NYC area. The apartment was large for a studio and the king size bed was wonderful. The Christmas tree was a nice touch as well. The kitchen was well set up to do any sort of cooking you’d want. The location was great too - a short walk away from great restaurant options, the subway, and north Williamsburg. Would definitely stay again!

Somewhat mixed feelings about this one. Many good things! Irina was nice and friendly when she met us for a check-in. The place is conveniently located in Williamsburg (though a bit further away from the liveliest part, but it can be a good thing). Lots of nice restaurants within walking distance. The bed was super comfortable. The apartment had everything we needed. Allen and Irina even had a Christmas tree up, which was super nice of them! (We visited right after the New Year).

But also we found that photos misrepresented the place quite a bit. The photos are photoshopped to make everything look new and shiny, sort of a fancy loft place. In fact, this is a ground floor space in the hosts’ house with older furniture. Nothing bad about it - but it wasn’t what we expected from the pictures. We also didn’t hear from the hosts about the check-in time and whether it worked for them until we already landed and were in a taxi to get there. Finally, I have to mention the floors above us creaked every time someone took a step or too. And the heating system was incredibly loud (although it was nice to have working heating at all in the winter).

In the end everything worked out fine and we are grateful to Irina and Allen for opening their house to guests. I just wish the communication about the apartment, including the photos, was a bit more transparent.
Everything was perfect!

Overall my stay was good. I didn't like having to walk by the living/dining area to get to the stairs to the room which were rather narrow and steep but not uncommon in older homes. The room was clean. It is small and would be tight but acceptable for two people. It lacked a few amenities that more expensive places offer such as bureau drawers to put you clothes in and a desk for my computer. The bathroom was very nice with lots of hot water but was up three steep steps which was of concern when I have to get up in the middle of the night. The location is very good and only a block and a half from the "G" train. Waldemar was a gracious host and makes good coffee. I would not hesitate to stay there on my next trip to NYC as it is clean and fairly priced.

I enjoyed my stay at Waldemar's home.  Very nice bathroom and comfortable bed.  Excellent location:  two minute walk to G train which connects with the A train two stops away.  A market, deli, and gourmet bakery/coffee shop less than a block away.  Waldemar is a charming, helpful host who has a lovely home.

A delightful host! Brooklyn's Fort Greene is a fantastic way to enjoy the best of the burroughs. Waldemar (aka: Xavier) is soft-spoken, urbane, hip and considerate. I loved the room & bath (yes!), the brownstone is like a wonderful antique. Thanks a million for an excellent experience :-)

I really liked Waldemar's place. It is cosy, quiet and charming. The location is great as well: safe area with a nice mix of people living there and it is close to Manhattan. Waldemar was very hospitable and helpful, and I would definitely stay there again!

I enjoyed my stay at Waldemars place. He is a great helpful host, doing everything for me to feel at home. I liked the spacios, warm, quiet room, the perfect bathroom and
the comfortable bed. On my next NY-stay I will defenitely book it again!
I had a very pleasant stay at Waldemars´. The room is spacious, warm & cosy and the bathroom is super clean and stylish. Much appreciated.

Waldemar's home was the answer to my needs: clean, comfortable, convenient and secure at an affordable rate.  And Waldemar is a terrific host, ready to listen, ready to advise. I'll stay at his house again any time.

Great place, wonderful Host. The neighborhood is very cozy and calm, which is good after having spent the whole day in crazy and loud Manhattan. It takes 35 minutes at the most to get to Times Square from that apartment. There are also places to visit in Brooklyn so I'll definitely recommend it.
Thanks again.  This was a repeat visit.  We were happy to stay somewhere familiar and comfortable.  Many thanks for sharing your space and making us feel so welcome.

Another great stay at Waldemar's place.  Most convenient location--could take the G to Carrol Gardens where my family lives; upon leaving, I took the G train to Hoyt, transferred to the A and went right into the Port Authority--thus I avoided the rainy weather and did not have to go outside until I returned to New Hampshire.   There's a new bus service from NYC to Portsmouth NH which is super.

I stayed here for about seven weeks, and the room was all I could ask for: spacious, clean, comfortable, and conveniently located. The neighborhood was pleasant, and Wald was nothing but considerate, helpful, and friendly. Sound tends to carry readily throughout the house, particularly from the room next door, but that is only a minor fault in an otherwise wonderful stay.

This shared apartment was very convenient to Pratt Institute where I was visiting. Close to  shops and a vibrant Brooklyn neighborhood. Subway was literally right next door. The bedroom was spacious with a nice little deck. Bathroom was immaculate and private. Waldemar is a pleasant and charming host.

This spacious bedroom and private bath near the Pratt Institute were perfect for my Brooklyn visit. Wald was a responsive, flexible, and helpful host. The apartment and neighborhood are relatively quiet, subway-accessible, and walking distance to Ft. Greene and lots of good restaurants.

Waldmar was a friendly, helpful and thoughtful host.  The room was comfortable, spaceous and clean.  The neighborhood was pleasant, and everything that I needed this trip was within a comfortable walking distance.  The only thing to be aware of is that sound can carry easily through the house especially from the room next door, so if you are sensitive to noise, you may wish to bring earplugs.  I would definitely stay here again.

The room was nice and clean when I got there. What you see is what you get; spacy room, great private bathroom and access to a small terrace. The rooms looks to the back yard and it is mostly quiet and feels safe. Access to the G line of the subway is two minutes by foot. Waldemar, the host, was great in the process of reserving the room and the check-in in and out. There are a couple of nice restaurants close by, but the neighborhood is quiet. I commuted every day to Manhattan, Grand Central, and it took me between 30 to 40 minutes.

It was such a pleasure meeting Adrienne - she is such a warm person and went out of her way to give local recommendations based on my vegetarian diet and travel with my infant.  I definitely recommend staying at her place!
Great value for the location, wonderful to have a private place with all the amenities of a great hotel!
This was an amazing place to stay! The whole family was super pleasant and easy to communicate with. We were even invited for brunch with them and some of their friends. Would highly recommend :).

This apartment is a perfect cozy spot in Williamsburg. A wonderful garden apartment, with wood floors, spacious bathroom, and a big living room. The apartment is 10-minute walk from the L train, so you can quickly get to Manhattan, etc. Adrienne was incredibly accommodating, allowing for flexibility in check-in and check-out due our red-eye flights. I would definitely stay here again.

Stedet ligger i et rolig område av Williamsburg, samtidig som det føles sentralt. Det er en enkelt møblert leilighet, men har de viktigste tingene. Verten Adrienne er veldig hyggelig, og hjelpsom med det som trengs.

First thing anyone thinking about NYC should know: Williamsburg is by far the best neighborhood to base yourself in. It's the best in NY-- safest, friendliest, best restaurants, shops, artisanal coffee, bakeries-- it's just got everything. And Adrienne's apartment is in the exact center of everything. If the best location is 5 stars, this is 7. The best location in the best city on Earth.
The apartment is nothing luxurious, the kitchen very small if you were thinking of doing a lot of cooking (which would be crazy in this neighborhood anyway)... but for the money, this is an insane bargain in NY, and very comfortable for 4 (the pull out couch is the most comfortable I have ever seen. It's like some strange alien technology-- I didn't know it was even possible for a pull out couch to be so comfortable for sleeping.
...But the best part of all is Adrienne and her incredibly kind and charming family, who live in the 2 floors above the apartment. You will feel completely at home from the moment you arrive.

Adrienne and Jeff are amazing hosts who completely made our stay. Friendly, very communicative, and supplied us with a whole range of child's toys/books/sleeping materials when we had some family visit us. We spent a month in the apartment and really enjoyed being there - location is perfect (minutes from Bedford Avenue metro and surrounded by great restaurants/bars), and the flat is very large for being in NY! AC is great for when it gets hot, and there are good kitchen facilities for those staying any longer. Really great stay and would recommend to anyone!

Adrienne’s place is spacious and warm. There’s a bedroom and living room and also a small kitchen, so it really is an entire private apartment. The bathroom is also big . The place was clean and Adrienne was easy to reach and accommodated any need within minutes!
The location is great, minutes walk from Bedford Ave and the L train station.
I highly recommend this place and my parents would definitely book that place again on their next visit.

Loved staying at Adrienne and Jeffs place. So kind and lovely people. Had breakfast with them a couple of times and took care of their sweet dog George for a weekend. Apartment was great, cozy and cute, it was clean and everything we needed was there! Best place in Williamsburg!

Adrienne was a very friendly host. Check-in/check out was super easy and I was provided with every item that I needed for a longer stay! Adrienne was easily available via airbnb text and responded quickly. The apartment looks like the pictures, the bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is big enough to cook on a daily basis. Sometimes her dogs were playing in the upper floor that might wake you up. The good thing is that you don't want to sleep much in such an amazing city! The apartment is not far from the metro station Bedford Ave, so it's a good location if you want to take public transport to Manhattan. There is also a city-bike stop nearby. Williamsburg is a nice place to live: grocery stores, cafes and a lot of fashion brands all nearby, however one of the more expensive areas. The view on the skyline of Manhattan from Domino park (3 minutes) is amazing. The Gran Torino (10 minutes) is the place to go for a Friday night. I'd definitely recommend this apartment if you need a stay in New York. Thanks Adrienne!

Good location, about 5-10 minutes to the subway.
If you have problem, they will solve the problem very quickly.

This is a wonderful apartment.  We just stayed one month at Adrienne’s place as we were welcoming our first grandchild in Williamsburg.  All the excellent reviews of this place are fully deserved.  Adrienne is a wonderful, kind, and thoughtful host.  The apartment is spacious and impeccable.  The bed very comfortable.  The kitchen although small is fully stocked and if you decide to cook (I did) you will find all you need.  Thank you Adrienne and family for being such nice hosts.

Adrienne’s place is perfect for a longer term stay. The place is big and bright and has everything you need. The location is excellent for exploring Williamsburg, walking distance to everything as well as great access for the subways. Would definitely stay here again and recommend Adrienne’s place.

We could hear Adrienne and her family above, however nothing that impacted our stay.
Very comfortable bed and warm place in winter.

This apartment is a little gem a short three-minute walk from multiple train stops, which made it very easy to get to Manhattan. Irina was a great host, very communicative, and the place itself was incredibly comfy, very well appointed and so, so clean! You could cook a meal for ten people in that kitchen. Would definitely stay again.

We were three people staying at Adrienne's and we absolutely loved it! The location in Williamsburg is amazing, close to lots and lots of cosy cafes, awesome restaurants and quirky shops! The stay was perfect, we had everything we needed in the apartment and if we needed anything Adrienne was always quick and happy to help! In the mornings we could hear the foot steps from above, but we had already been warned, and we didn't find it annoying. We had planned to stay four weeks but had to leave after two weeks because of the outbreak of the corona virus... But our two weeks were fantastic and if we're ever back in NYC again we would stay here again and I would recommend it to anybody!

I stayed here for 2.5 months between leases in the city. Adrienne's place is wonderful, the location is great for exploring Williamsburg, and is a short trip to Manhattan as well. The unit itself is beautiful, and there are a lot of thoughtful touches throughout.

The kitchenette is well stocked, but pretty small, and it would be difficult to cook large meals there. However there are many grocery stores, and restaurants nearby.

Due to Covid, I was unable to interact too much in person with Adrienne or her family, but all communication was prompt and helpful! Overall, highly recommend for anyone coming to NYC!

I stayed here for a full month. The location is the main selling point, it's a trendy fun part of the city. Apartment has kind of a strange set up with the bedroom next to the street (so expect street noise). The host was friendly and very responsive, and the photos are accurate.

My only issue staying here was a mosquito/bug problem, which may be worse in the summer months. You walk through a swarm of flies when you enter the apartment. A few mosquitoes would get in every day (through the window screens or front entrance), so I was constantly swatting mosquitoes inside the apartment and got a few bites in my sleep.

Adrienne's place was a wonderful sanctuary for me over the course of 2 months. It's an ample space, totally adequate for cooking meals and working and living in. The space is stylishly and comfortably decorated, as well as being super toasty in the winters.

I stayed at Adrienne's place for a full month and it was a great place to stay long-term in Brooklyn. The location was great and Adrienne was very nice and accommodating. Adrienne had thoughtful touches throughout which made it as cozy as pictured. Highly recommend.
We had a great stay! The apartment was cozy and it was in a great location, just a block away from Domino Park. Adrienne was super accommodating and really helpful in answering any questions we had.

This is a gem. Perfect location, one train stop from Manhattan, so many grocery stores and great coffee shops and friendly neighborhood in general . The place is clean, has plenty of natural light. The kitchen might appear small, but don’t worry, it has everything you might need and it’s just enough of space. The bathroom is big, the water pressure is fantastic! The interior of the place reminded me of the vintage style summer house in the Hamptons. Adrienne is very helpful and accommodating, we definitely felt like home. Highly recommend!

I stayed at Adrienne's for nearly 3 months, and I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay for my transition to living in NYC! Adrienne and her family were kind and responsive. The location is incredible and walking distance to shops & restaurants, and only a couple blocks from Domino Park. I would 100% stay here again.

Adrienne's place was fantastic. I stayed for a whole month, and she was very attentive to my needs. The apartment is very spacious for one person, and located in an excellent neighborhood! The bed was very comfortable :)

Perfect location and communication. Adrienne was very helpful and nice during my 1 month stay. The place looks exactly as it does on the pictures, it is very cozy and comfortable. I recommend staying here :)
Adrienne and Jeff are the best!!
Adrienne and her family make the guest feel like they are at home. Prompt communication and any problems encountered are taken care of. Great stay overall!

I loved my stay! Adrienne is an awesome host, so helpful and responsive to any needs or questions. Especially appreciated her taking care of my sheets and towels throughout my month long stay. The apartment is so cute and has everything you need and the location and value could not be beat. Yes, you can hear them upstairs, but it didn’t bother me. The white noise they provided made it easy for me to sleep in to my heart’s content.

We had the best time at Adrienne's place! She was an awesome host- helpful, responsive, and even offered to washed our towels/sheets a few times too (we were there for about 6 wks)

The apartment is cozy, clean, and well equipped for a long stay. The kitchen had everything you could need, and the bed was comfy. The blackout curtains were great and she has a sound machine so you really can't hear anything from the street or upstairs while sleeping.

Location can't be beat- super close to lots of fun restaurants, shopping, and Domino Park.

Would definitely return!

My host was very friendly and helpful. We had good consersations and he pointed out places of interest and provided lots of practical information (restaurants, supermarket, etc) about the neighborhood, etc. His home is a lovely browstone typical of Brooklyn and was nicely decorated. The room was very spacious, clean and quiet. Having my own private (design) bathroom was great (I'm a girl) and I truly enjoyed having access to my private deck opening onto the garden--absolutely relaxing! I'm allergic to cats but his does not go upstairs, so I had no problems. I  also had access to a common fridge and kitchen which is useful if one does not want to eat outside all the time. The location is also very practical: a couple of blocks from subway, park, restaurants, bars, movie theater, etc.  I'd go back any time! Lots of thanks to my host!

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this room.  I found the bed to be perfectly comfortable.  The room was spacious and the private bathroom was awesome! Everything was very clean.  There is a terrific coffee shop on the corner and the location is very convenient to the subway and easy walking to lots of very good restaurants.  Waldemar is very welcoming and  helpful and made me feel right at home immediately.   A totally positive experience all around.  If you're looking for a pleasant stay in Brooklyn do yourself a favor and stay here.  I plan to return.

My mom stayed here while she was visiting me from out of state. The brownstone is charming -- lots of space, a recently renovated bathroom, and original architectural details. The neighborhood (Clinton Hill/Fort Greene) is also adorable. Very quiet with lots of families. Overall a great choice for your next visit to NYC!

Waldemar's home is exquisite!  The master bedroom opens onto a outdoor sitting area that overlookis a serene & beautiful garden.  Coming home to this was, by far, the favorite part of my stay!!!  The ensuite bathroom is nicely appointed with plush linens and the room itself is spacious and comfortable.  Waldemar is a wonderful host who gave me very helpful advice about  parking, finding housing in Brooklyn, etc..  I would highly recommend this host and this Bed and Breakfast to anyone!

A great old house in exactly the neighborhood I wanted to be in. So happy to find him! The room was big and had a great bathroom and lovely balcony. I got a little work done there, too–wi-fi was great.

It was quiet and I got great sleep and was able to come and go easily. And he was a great host—super-friendly and great to chat with.

I will definitely stay there again if I get the chance!

Our stay was perfect- the room was excellent- comfortable bed, well-appointed en-suite, plenty of space, tv, air conditioning and a little balcony with chairs, what more could you want?
The brownstone townhouse is beautiful, as Xavier is an attentive and reliable host, who was happy to answer all our queries, offer tips, and go out of his way to accomodate our wishes.
The location of the house is 1 block from a subway station which has direct access to Williamsburg (15 min) and downtown Brooklyn (5 min or a 15min walk) - for excellent cafes, restaurants and nightlife, and a 25 min subway to manhattan. The area feels safe, lots of parks etc- also 1 block from supermarket, and an excellent cafe!

My sister and I had a very nice stay with Waldemar. The beds were excellent and in general the accomodations were very good. I specially appreciated the privacy of having our own bathroom and a space that was separate from the rest of the household and very quiet.
I did not use public transportation however, neither did we explore the immediate neighborhood, because we were visiting my children in Brooklyn, so I cannot comment about that. Mr. Lobban was a very pleasant host and very helpful to us.
Was perfect for my needs!  Bedroom suite is old world with modern amenities.  Waldemar is very accessible, personable and helpful. Ample, free, on street parking and close by subway.
Xavier was a wonderful host. The place is well located with the subway a couple of minutes away, and the room was clean and had loads of character. I'll be back.

This was about as close to perfect as I think you can reasonably expect. Clinton Hill is a venerable old residential neighborhood, quiet, leafy, and diverse, and a welcome relief from Manhattan's frenzy. And it's a quick subway ride to the frenzy, in any event. If you want to see how people actually live in New York--rather than just look at other visitors from Indiana or North Carolina--head to Brooklyn. It will give you a very different perspective on the city.

The accommodations themselves can't be beat for the price. A spacious bedroom with a very comfortable bed, wi-fi, and (by New York standards) a huge bathroom, all to yourself. The room has an AC unit, but I found the ceiling fan provided all the climate control I needed. There's also a small deck, but I never had a chance to use it. And there's a television, which I also ignored. The only possible quibble people might have is that the room is a bit dark, but there's ample lighting throughout, and as a native New Yorker I can tell you that apartments awash in natural light in that city are almost unheard of.

Finally, there's your host, Xavier. Relaxed and personable, he takes a sincere interest in his guests and seemed always to be available without ever being intrusive. I very much enjoyed our chats over a cup of strong coffee in the morning. Added bonus: if you're there during Wimbledon fortnight, you can watch a couple of sets with him and listen to his commentary!

In all honesty, I had a wonderful time and hope to stay with him again on my regular visits to the city.
Polite hosts and a cozy appartment with all amneties.

Our host Waldemar, was welcoming, friendly and helpful during our five night stay. The AC was heavenly and having an ensuite bathroom was deluxe. The location and neighborhood was convenient and safe with many fine and reasonably priced restaurants within walking distance. Subway access was a breeze and we actually could park our car near the home when not in use.
The place was a hit! I certainly hope to stay there again, soon.

Xavier's place is lovely - and worth every penny. The room is huge, with a private bathroom, and a little porch outside for those of us who prefer fresh air to being cooped up inside. There's TV, A/C (which I never turned on because the room stayed nice and cool with the ceiling fan), and a big comfy bed. It really is like having your own hotel room.

Xavier is a lovely host. I changed my arrival time a million times when my work schedule got flipped around, but he was still flexible and available.

The location is great. It's literally above the G train, and a few blocks from the E train. Clinton Hill is a darling neighborhood, and Myrtle Street has pretty much everything you need -- a supermarket, a greasy spoon diner, fantastic Chinese take-out, and yummy bagels - as well as lots of cute little shops and older, classic-style bodegas.

I never ran into the roommates, though I did hear them a couple of times. I'm sure they're perfectly nice, as I doubt Xavier would live with anybody who wasn't.
Xavier was great host. Friendly and flexible. Didn't have chance to take advantage of deck in back. Would definitely stay again.

great place, lovely host, and air conditioning! I was there during the July heat wave. I was out and about in the day time and coming home to sleep in a cool room was delightful. I have a son and his family a 13 min. walk from Xavier's place. I loved the area and felt part of the community rather than the hotel scene which can be more separated from the real feel of the community. I would definitely stay there again.

Madhavii Shirman

Its hard to say enough about how pleasant my stay was. Waldemar was a wonderful host, and the accommodations were everything listed and more.  I had a perfect sojourn, and would recommend Waldemar heartily.  Enjoy!

This place is great! Xavier was welcoming and friendly. I love the neighborhood and its super close to the subway. Plenty of great restaurants within walking distance. Also the Clinton Hill/Ft. Greene area feels safe, quiet and relaxed.

The room was excellent and very clean. I really enjoyed the balcony and it let in a nice breeze even in July! The A/C was great to have for sleeping. The bed is VERY comfy!! I highly recommend this place and would definitely stay here again.

Xavier was lovely, really helpful, easy going and unimposing. The house is in a nice vibrant area with a great coffee shop/ cafe called Chioces at the end of the block. Minutes walk into Fort Greene where there are loads of cafe's restaurants and bars. The G train at the end of the block and the C train is 8 minutes walk, so very convenient transport into Manhattan and also from JFK on the C train. Also the long Island railroad is about 15 minutes walk to Atlantic, so we got that to Long Island beach. The room was big  and the bathroom was fab, clean, spacious and lovely design. I enjoyed my stay and my friend wanted to stay longer. I felt safe and secure. Thank you Xavier. xXx

290 Lafayette Ave, great address for a start with easy access to the subway. It was a joy staying at Waldemar's place, very welcoming and helpful with a flexible demeanor that made you feel instantly comfortable. I totally recommend booking here, the room is comfortable with all the mod cons one needs.

The main thing a hotel sells is sleep - and I slept extremely well (and long) in the comfortable double bed at a fraction of a hotel price.
The bathroom was a delight for the weary traveller - an old fashioned claw foot bath/shower to wallow in, complemented by ultra modern washbasins and toilet.
Getting to and from Manhattan is no problem using the G and C lines. 50th Street being reached in around 40 minutes.
JFK is just over one hour away.
The neighbourhood is perfectly safe and I had no qualms about travelling late at night.
Although Xavier does not offer breakfast, if you give him half a chance he will regale you with endless cups of tea or coffee accompanied by entertaining and informative conversation.
So, if you are looking for quiet, comfortable, clean accommodation at a reasonable price, then take a look at this.

Violetta is a wonderful host and her place is amazing: immaculate, charming, quiet, convenient to transportation, close to restaurants and bars, in a safe neighborhood. I would recommend this place to anybody.

I rented the apartment for my parents coming to visit us from Italy.
It was very nice, clean and organized. The building had doorman and is an excellent location: close to subway and on route of frequent buses. Far enough from midtown to be out of the big noise but reachable in just a few minutes.
Violetta was very kind and accomodating.
I truly recommend it if you are looking for a visit to NY !!!!

I had a fabulous stay,the apartment was tidy and clean and violetta was a very lovely lady,she made me feel like i was staying at a friends house,its a cute and cozy apartment in a great area and my girlfriend and i loved our stay...
We loved the balcony:)

highly recommend that place to a couple ,or even unto 3 people.
Alex

Our stay at Violetta's apartment was wonderful.  The apartment was spotless, light, and comfortable.  The location was absolutely perfect since we needed to be on the Upper West Side.  There were plenty of markets, coffee shops, drugs stores and restaurants nearby, and the subway stop is right out the door.   Violetta was easy to get a hold of, and very flexible.  We would certainly ask to rent Violetta's apartment for another stay.

The apartment was attractive and very well equipped for our month-long stay and an ideal size for a couple - it was actually bigger than we expected from the photos. The bed was extremely comfortable. Great location, close to subway and buses so easy to get around. Close to shops and restaurants.  Area is very safe and the building is secure. Added advantage of terrace where we had breakfast most mornings.  Violetta was a charming and helpful host who did much to make our stay enjoyable.

Great location - pretty close to the 1 line and a short walk away from the express 3 train. The bed here is extremely comfy - holy cow - I can't remember the last time I've had to drag myself out of bed because of how comfortable it was.

The terrace is really enjoyable as well. Many nights after work - I'd sit outside and stare south off of the terrace and take in the skyline of mid-town, it was a great way to unwind after a tough day.

The place has enough space to feel relaxed, it isn't cramped at all. The main living area is spacious enough to kick back and watch a movie on the flat screen tv.

Great place - I'd stay again no problems!

First I would like to thanks Violetta : she's a perfect host and she's been a absolutly wonderful during sandy's hurricane days.
The apartment is just perfect : very well located and convenient : subways and buses "just at the door" and everything you need all around (good and fresh food, deli's, restaurants, ...)
very sunny with a large terrace with amazing skyline views, and so warm, cosy and clean; it make you feel like at your own home and for a long stay (3 weeks for me) it means !
so without any hesitation I would recommend this place for a wonderful stay in NYC. and I hope to have the chance to stay again on my next trip to NYC

My girlfriend and I had an amazing stay in New York at Violetta's apartment! I have no idea where to start...the location of the apartment is very great and everything you need is located super near like the Metro, Bus, Starbucks, Supermarket and even the Metro-ride to Time Square, 5th Ave and other stuff is not longer than 10-15min! The apartment is clean and had a bath tub which was super dope :)

Living Room is nice too! We enjoyed sitting on the couch and watching some movies at the evening after a long day in town and the skyline is pretty dope too! You can see the Empire State Building :)) yaaay! :)

The kitchen has everything you need to cook a great dinner, even for NYE and after dinner u can take a walk to the Central Park (10min away). And the bed is super large and is very comfortable! You'll def. enjoy your stay! :) PROMISE!!!

We had a great time and def. would come back to that place!
So go and enjoy people!

Violetta's place is the nicest I've stayed in over the past years. The apartment is perfect, Violetta is a super host, and the location is gorgeous. The icing on the cake: the spacious terrace with sun all day and a spectacular view.
I couldn't have found a better place for my two weeks' stay this summer, and I can definitely recommend this apartment for singles, couples or even three people.

Violetta is a great host. Her appartment is just a pearl: best situation in UWS ,great terrace so nice for dinner or breakfast, very comfortable, clean and with all you need to feel at home !
We were just so happy there! Thank you very much Violetta!!!!!

Had a great trip to New York exploring Manhattan and going to US Open Tennis Championship . Violetta's apartment was perfect as regards location and facilities. Violetta herself is a wonderful host and was really great to communicate with .
Hope to be back in New York in the future and hope to stay with her again. This is my first time using airbnb and it has been fantastic in every way. Tim

We had such a great time in Violetta's apartment. It is on the 15th and last floor so it was a real pleasure to have a space outside with the terrace. The flat  is excatly as shown on the pictures and there is a bathtub in the bathroom which was highly appreciated after a long day of walk! The local subway is just one block away. The building and the street are very quiet, perfect to relax. The bed is Amazing (be careful you may want to stay sleeping all day...). We definitly recommand Violetta's apartment.

I stayed in Violetta's flat for three weeks and it has been fantastic. The flat is even better than on the pictures, very well located, very clean, comfortable, everything that you could wish for - plenty of shops and supermarkets in the area to fit all tastes, easy access to the subway... Violetta is a great host, very friendly and always ready to help. I definitely recommend staying there - and would hope to stay there again in a future trip to NY!

Violetta's place was wonderful!!!  My parents stayed there while visiting me in NYC, and all I could think was - I wish I could live here all the time!  The location was perfect - very close the the subway and Central Park, and tons of delicious restaurants.  It was such a great experience to be able to walk to some museums, eat delicious food, and come back to a beautiful, clean, and quiet apartment.  It's rare to have a place in NYC without a lot of street noise, but somehow her apartment was able to keep the noise out.  I would hands down recommend this place to anybody who wants to stay in a more residential neighborhood in NYC - enjoy the hustle and bustle of the touristy areas during the day, and return back to a nice, relaxing abode :)
The reservation was canceled 21 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Violetta was a lovely host, and we loved this apartment.  Although it was too cold to spend much time on the  terrace during our stay, we did get to see some gorgeous sunsets and great city views.  The bed was unbelievably comfortable, there was plenty of free space for our things, and Violetta was close by and available.  We can't wait to go back - this is our favorite place in the city by far!

The Penthouse was so gorgeous with all the equipment required and an exceptional view from the terrace (15th floor) ! The location is just perfect and, last but not least, Violetta is the perfect host (very kind, always available, with a lot of good advice regarding the neighbourhood but also more broadly NYC). Highly recommendable and recommended !

I very much liked my stay in Violetta's apartment! The appartment is clean, comfortable, quiet and very well equipped with everything you might need. Violleta is a great host, friendly and interesting to talk with!

It was my second time in Violetta'a beautiful apartment, and I felt at home again immediately. I can only repeat my words from last year - the place is superb in every sense (furnishing, style, equipment, decoration, location…), even more than the pictures could tell you. And Violetta is simply the perfect host. She couldn't have been more helpful with whatever request or question I had. She's also a great friend :-) and I hope to be staying there again soon. Highly recommend!!!

We stayed 8 days at Violetta's apartment and had a great, great experience. Super well located, one block from the subway, the apartment is a great size for two people. Despite being near Broadway, the apartment is in a peaceful and quiet street, close to all you might need (food stores, cafeterias, restaurants, etc.).
Though we haven't met Violetta in person (she was travelling around Europe at the time), we could easily get what we needed. Violetta found an optimal way to get the keys to us, which turned out to be incredibly efficient. She texted us as we checked in to make sure everything was okay, and kept contact all the time by messages.
Everything was clean, working properly, and exactly as described. The terrace and the view from the 15th floor are awesome: having breakfast watching the Manhattan skyline is an experience that we will miss for a long time!
We definitely recommend this wonderful apartment!
Thank you for everything Violetta!

It was our first Airbnb experience, so we didn't know what to expect, but thankfully, Violetta was an excellent host! Her responses were immediate and she was always willing to answer our questions thoroughly.

Entering and getting the keys was easy thanks to a 24/7 doorman (we were arriving in NYC quite late, so this was an important perk for us). The building itself is very quiet and has a nice feeling to it.

Violetta's penthouse apartment is huge for New York standards - it's a true one bedroom with a spacious living room. The terrace offering views of the city skyline is a nice bonus, but we didn't use it as much as we thought we would. Everything is very clean and the king-size bed is really comfortable. The kitchen (with a window) and the bathroom are well-equipped.

The location is excellent, just two blocks from the 1 subway that takes you pretty much everywhere on Manhattan. There is a Starbucks across the street, a bakery, a pizza place and many stores nearby. UWS is full of people even late in the evening and we felt very safe during our stay.

All in all, I highly recommend Violetta's place - it's comfortable, clean and at a great location. The hostess is very accommodating, quick to respond and seems like a really nice person.

Irina and Allen's place was wonderful and highly recommended. So cozy and relaxing with everything you need, fully stocked kitchen and washing machine too! Irina met us for check in and was very thorough with her tour and information of the place. The place is clean and a comfortable place to retreat after a day in the bustling city. Thank you for having us!

- Bring earplugs!! - The place was nice, but much darker then the photo’s suggest. Very little daylight. The bed was amazing! But... we couldn’t sleep -or relax- without using earplugs. We heard every step the hosts took (they live upstairs). Starting from very early in the morning (7 am) and with their shoes on. Also there is a squicking loud noise right above the bed in the ceiling. (....)
All and all, the place was okay, but the noises made an impact on our stay. We would stay again (and bring even better earplugs), because the subway is close and the neigbourhood is nice, but keep the cons in mind when you book. It’s not a place where you can live and relax a week if that’s your plan.

Irina and Allen's apartment was nice and has everything that you need for relax and resting after exploring the city.

The neighborhood is very cool, close to Manhattan and full of cool cafes and shops.

The apartment can be a little bit noisy since you are in a ground floor with the windows to the street and you can hear every step that the landlords take upstairs. This didn't bother us and we slept amazing ( the bed is sooo comfortable) but it's true that the landlords could pay a little bit more attention to the noise that they do walking at home with shoes or when going down the stairs and closing the main door.
Great apartment in a very fun part of town. Highly recommend
Great location with super comfy bed.

Allen and Irina’s place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location - easy to walk pretty much everywhere and/or get to the subway in just a few minutes. Irina was very communicative and flexible. The only thing I would mention is that there is some street noise periodically, but I wore earplugs and it wasn’t a problem for me. Thanks for a lovely stay!
Cute and cozy studio. Bigger than expected, and easy access to Manhattan/other boroughs.

Die Wohung liegt in einer relativ ruhigen Seitenstrasse zwischen zwei U-Bahnstation (weniger als 5.min Laufweg) und ist mit allem ausgestattet was man braucht! Irina ist sehr freudlich und wir konnten auch am Abreisetag problemlos unser Gepäck stehen lassen. Als Ausgangspunkt ideal für Manhattan und Brooklyn. In Laufweite sind außerdem zahlreiche Kneipen, Cafes, Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Eine CityBike Station (empfehlenswert) ist gleich um Ecke.

Nous avons séjourné dans ce studio fonctionnel durant 6 jours cependant quelques détails ont un peu gâché notre séjour.
En effet , l'appartement est situé en rez-de-chaussée nous avons donc entendu tous les bruits de la rue. De plus, les radiateurs sont très bruyants et se déclenchent en pleine nuit. Il manquait également un carreau sur l'une des fenêtres et la manivelle de la chasse d'eau était cassée. Bref nous avons trouvé que le rapport qualité prix n'était pas respecté malgré un super emplacement.

Only stayed for a few hours as our expectations of the apartment was not as expected. It is a bit more darker than pictured and the apartment is under ground level and therefore not possible to open the windows. The bed I agree with others, is very comfortable. But if you are sensitive to sounds please be aware that you will hear the owners walking around upstairs, so earplugs are advised.
Irina accepted that we decided to leave and was helpful with cancelling the booking.

The place is like the photos, actually in my personal experience it ended up been bigger than what I was expecting from the pictures. The metro station is 5 blocks away, and from there you can go anywhere in Manhattan.
We really enjoy the place, the bed is amazing!

Irina’s flat was nice but looks soo much different from the pictures. It was a bit dark and looks smaller from the pictures. It creaks everytime we walk too. Also you can hear everything from the top floor and the streets since you’re on ground floor. The good thing about it is the suuuper comfy and fluffy bed. And the location is great to explore Brooklyn plus it’s really near the subway too
A great deal in a great location. Highly recommended.

The location is great, very close to several metro stations which can bring you anywhere in the city. The apartment is super clean and spacious. As others have already described it is a bit darker than in the photos and it is quite noisy from upstairs. We were prepared for this and would still recommend the place. Especially since Willemsburg is also a fun neighborhood!
Sehr sauber.
We loved this spot and the are! Very sweet and kind hosts. The bed was amazing!! Slept so well. No sound from street outside, just light. loved it!
Excellent place to stay. I would recommend to anyone looking for a great place in Brooklyn.

One of the nicest 1 bedroom apartments on the UWS I have seen. Extremely quiet and private.
Fantastic south facing terrace. Cozy charming and a nice old school pre-war bathroom. Definitely would stay again and the host, Violetta, is super nice and attentive and keeps her place nice. Best of all, without seeming impersonal, the apartment doesn't make you feel like your stepping on someones else's personal space, its entirely welcoming and comfortable. The best of what airbnb can offer.

Violetta was a great host, very accommodating to my needs, arrival and departure times and general experience. I'm in New York a lot, but this is simply a fantastic apartment, very welcoming neighborhood and if you enjoy Central Park it is definitely a place to be.

I had an absolutely perfect stay at Violetta's apartment. She couldn't have been more welcoming when I arrived. The apartment itself is stunning and the terrace is gorgeous to have. There was also plenty of wardrobe space, which was great as I was staying for a few weeks so had plenty of clothes to hang up! Location-wise it is a block away from the subway and on the doorstep of lots of supermarkets so the perfect Upper West Side location!

I wouldn't hesitate in recommending the apartment and staying there again. Thanks Violetta :)

Our stay at Violetta's apt. was perfect! She is a charming host and extremely helpful and accomodating. The neighbourhood was calm (for New York) and one feels very safe here. The terrace was an absolute peaceful haven to unwind and watch the beautiful sunsets at the end of the day. The apt. was very clean, comfortable and had absolutely everything we could possibly need. The bed was a dream...makes me want to change my bed at home ;) Thank you Violetta! Hope we will be back.

Violetta's place is very welcoming, charming, stylish and surprisingly homey and warm. For anyone who would like to stay in the area I would highly recommend this place. It's truly a rare find for an NYC apartment. The bonus of an amazing outdoor space with Manhattan skyline views is absolutely unusual and more than a bonus. Lovely apartment with a lovely hostess.
A great place to stay and a great host.

Very good apartment in a great location.  Spacious living area, delightful terrace and very clean.  Close to the subway and only a few blocks from Central Park.  I would recommend this apartment to other travellers.
Perfect place to stay on the upper west side of Manhattan. Close to the subway and restaurants but a quiet place for New York.Very clean and has everything you need.

This really was the best AirBnb experience I’ve had by far. Violetta’s home was warm, spacious, and comfortable. The balcony was a great touch! Perfect for sitting out with a glass of wine. The location was ideal for me. Close enough to areas I was interested in (Central Park, Zabar’s, etc) but nice and quiet.
Violetta was the perfect host. Gracious, thoughtful, and very quick to respond.
I’m looking forward to the next time I can stay here! I stay in Airbnb’s generally for 6 weeks at a time and this was the most I’ve felt “at home”.
The host canceled this reservation 76 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

I’ve stayed at Violetta’s apartment before and hope to stay there again. The location is perfect and it feels like a warm, comfortable, home. Violetta is always quick to respond and the doormen are always welcoming and gracious. Very close to the subway and a variety of restaurants.

WiFi was pretty patchy at times

However would definitely consider staying again if we return to NYC.
This studio apartment is a little dated but was super clean and had everything we needed to make a great weekend. Irina was a great host and very accommodating.

Great location in Williamsburg. Easy access to the subway to get across to Manhattan, and close to plenty of great shops, restaurants, and bars. Apartment is clean and kitchen is well stocked with supplies if you decide to prepare a meal and stay in for a day. Washing machine and iron come in handy as well. Great, hot shower and bath for a good soak. The neighborhood can be a bit noisy at times, but that’s to be expected almost anywhere in NYC. This is the second time I have stayed here, so I definitely recommend it if you’re looking for a great spot in Williamsburg.
The place is wonderfull. Location is nice, peace neighborhood and very easy to reach any location in Manhattan. I strongly recomend this place, we had a great time in NYC.

Such a clean, confortable & very well equipped flat. It’s location is ideal thanks to the 3 subway’s lines at 4 minutes.
The neighborhood is very nice and quiet at night.
Thank you again for your very Kind hospitality

My daughter and I arrived after a long flight. The apartment was available for us just before 9 am. The apartment was equipped to stay just like home including the small details such as fitted kitchen towels soaps and even electrical outlets to suit Europeans

Nous sommes allés chez Alicia fin février, expérience formidable. Nous étions 4 adultes et 3 enfants, l'Appartement était très agréable, grand avec beaucoup de lumière, la décoration trés soignée, Idéalement placé, près du métro, une grande épicericerie bio a 2 minutes.
Alicia était charmante.
Quartier trés vivant, nous pouvions aller à SOho en 5 minutes.
Un carnet d'adresses vous attend chez Alicia avec toutes les bonnes adresses.
Vous pouvez y aller en toute confiance. FORMIDABLE
We had a pleasant stay with Waldemar, He was very polite and the location was excellent.

We had a great stay in NY. Waldemar is very nice and helpful. The place is very quiet and very close to the metro station (5-minute walk). The bedroom is very spacious and you can use the kitchen whenever you want. We felt like home... We recomment this place!
We had a great stay! Irina is a friendly and welcoming host and the apartment was nice. Place is a bit of darker than in the pictures but great value still!

A great space and location! Clean, comfortable bed, a lot more space than I'd expected. Irina was welcoming, easy to get in touch with, and quick to respond. Close to the subway and restaurants, etc. Would definitely stay here again and recommend.

Allen & Irina’s place is in a convenient location in Williamsburg for quick transit to Manhattan and other parts of Brooklyn. It is a spacious studio that is a little dated but still very comfortable. Speaking of comfort, the bed was extremely comfortable! Note that this Airbnb is in the bottom floor of their residence so you can hear the sounds of footsteps and their bird(s) during waking hours.

Allen and Irina’s place was great! It is perfectly located with easy access to various parts of Brooklyn and Manhattan. The apartment is clean and the bed is really comfortable. I would definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay at Irina’s place, conveniently located and a great base to explore NYC. Clean, huge bed and nice to have some kitchen space. Would recommend.

Fantastic spot to stay while visiting NYC. Everything about our stay with Allen and Irina was awesome. Great little apartment, great location, and great communication. Comfortable bed, safe neighborhood, short walk to subway that was only two stops away from Manhattan, plenty of food, bodegas to grab supplies. Would definitely stay there again next time we are heading to NYC.

I enjoyed my stay at Allen and Irina's place in Williamsburg. The location is great. Also easy access to Manhattan by subway. The apartment is spacious, clean and very comfortable. Irina was very helpful. I'd love to stay here again. Thank you so much!
Very nice and comfortable
Amazing location! Our stay was incredibly comfortable, and we had everything we needed for our weekend getaway in NYC. I would definitely recommend this place.

We stayed this place very well. This space is enough big for 2-3 peoples and well equipped at kitchen and wash room. Boiler is operating very well and can maintain warm inside of rooms. One problem is main entrance key. We need very techincal and skillful handling of key to open the door
Very clean, spacious, easy to access, wonderful neighborhood, fantastic bed. Only good things to say about this place!
The place was amazing, worth every penny, close to subway, everything as same as I expected, will stay there again if I go back to NYC, thanks Allen & Irina

Decent, not great. The bed was comfortable, but the mattress protector had a huge coffee-like stain on it and the bed skirt was dusty. The photos are enhanced to make this below-grade apartment seem brighter than it actually is. Minimal amenities; not even any coffee unless someone before you was generous enough to leave some behind. We were left with someone’s decaf and some old tea. You can hear outside noise, but that’s to be expected. What’s not expected was being able to hear everything from the hosts upstairs. VERY thin walls. We could hear them walking around, opening doors, coughing, etc. Also their bird. I don’t know what kind of bird it was, but it’s a loud screeching type, not a small chirping bird. It wasn’t very active until the morning we were checking out when it was squawking very loudly all morning long. The hosts were also stomping around upstairs, repeatedly going up and down the stairs outside the apt door, and opening/closing heavy doors all morning. I don’t know whether all of this activity was intentional, but since no other morning was that excessively noisy other than the one on check out day, it sure felt intentional and very rude. Maybe they have had other guests overstay past check out time, but that’s really no reason to punish future guests.

There are better deals with the new pod hotels that are cleaner and closer to where you want to be. We’ll be going that route next time.
Good apartment!!
Nice place to stay.  Waldemar is a good host. Close to the subway.  The only thing to remark on is that it would have been good if it was possible to lock the door from the outside.

We stayed a week in this very clean and spacious room in Brooklyn. The insuite bathroom and the cosy balcony are super nice and provide for a very private and almost hotel-like atmosphere.

The cafe around the corner serves some decent coffee. A subway station is just a 2 minute walk from the apartment, but note that this is a G-line station and that you need to change for trains to Manhattan. It usually took us 30-45 minutes to get there.

The only downside is that this is a rather old building with very thin walls.

All in all, we can recommend this place that seems perfect for 2 persons to share.

what an amazing apartment. We felt like true manhattenites waking up in the loft, watching the Bowery come alive and enjoying the sunshine streaming in the kitchen as we made our coffee.
Wonderful to have run of such a large place with 7 of us. no one getting under anyone's feet. Alicia generously left us towels and linen, use of all her kitchen appliances and Huge desk top Mac which was very useful. The only tiny criticism is the bathroom. quirky and fits the building but a bit of a pain getting a shower, especially with 7 of us.
But overall we adored staying there and feel very lucky to have come across it
Irina was a gracious host. The apartment is large for NYC. Great location!

We had a wonderful experience in Alicia's New York loft. It's got charm and style - the lighting is brilliant and Alicia was incredibly accomodating, giving us her best tips for restaurants in the area. The stair make up for all the good meals :-) Great inspiration for us writers. I'd go back any time, highly recommend.

Fabulous stay in Chinatown.

This loft will not disappoint, the location is ideal for exploring the LES, & Nolita (5mins either direction), not to mention Soho & East Village (10mins). From the website, we thought this apartment was a bit too good to be true, but you can be assured that the photos are an accurate representation of its style, size and facilities. It is a lovely place to stay.
We were a group of 4 (1 couple and 2 singles) and we really made the most of the shared space areas - lovely big lounge, formal dining and informal eat-in kitchen areas. It worked perfectly. The bedrooms are all generous sizes with heaps of storage etc.

The only downside; the 4-flight stair hike to the loft - not great if you struggle with stairs… as the loft is located at the top of the building. But on the positive side, the stairs are very useful in burning off the calories consumed whilst enjoying the best NYC has to offer!
Highly recommend.

Nous voilà rentrés en Belgique... après ce super séjour à NY!
Nous avons vraiment beaucoup apprécié le loft d'Alicia, son espace si agréable, sa localisation idéale pour démarrer différents circuits, et le quartier que nous avons découvert et où nous nous sommes sentis très à l'aise pour faire nos petites courses!
Nous avons d'ailleurs largement profité de la cuisine super bien équipée et très agréable pour prendre le brunch au soleil du matin...
Nous étions 3 couples et avons tous trouvé notre place dans le loft d'Alicia que nous recommandons vivement pour vivre un séjour typiquement New-Yorkais!

The loft was awesome, the location is amazing, and Alicia couldn't be nicer.  The binder she leaves with suggestions is extremely helpful, and having a washer in the loft is fantastic.  Overall a great experience.  Would definitely stay here again.

This apartment is the ultimate NYC experience. Beautiful, clean, sunny & well styled. Very comfy beds. Perfect location for everything L.E.S and Soho.
Large living rooms with generous sized bed rooms and storage space.
Having a washer and dryer also was great.
Overall an amazing apartment and pleasant stay.
Would definitely love to visit again soon!
Stayed at Alicia's fabulous Loft sept 2011 with my family. Truly an amazing place. Thankyou so much for the experience.

Our stay at Alicia's loft was brilliant. It is a beautiful space and well worth the exhausting climb up 4 very steep flights of stairs. Spacious, light with beautiful windows and groovy furniture- it was perfect for 5 of us holidaying in New York for a week.

Great location- very close to Nolita, Soho etc and a Whole Foods only a few blocks away!

Only minor drawback was the shower which was an interesting experience! if you are ok with sitting or squatting in the shower while people can potentially see you through the window then you'll be fine! We got used to it and it was a source of constant amusement. I think the shower was built for midgets!

We had a wedding in New York and stayed  at Alicia' s gorgeous loft apartment.  It was perfect for the 5 of us and was both spacious and light. The location was fantastic and it only took a few minutes to walk to my favourite areas such as nolita and soho. Alicia was also a fanastic host.  I would definitely recommend this place to stay.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjours de 10 jours dans le loft d’Alicia (à 6 personnes : 2 couples et 2 enfants).

Le loft est très bien situé dans LES.

L’agencement des espaces et l’aménagement d’Alicia sont parfaits pour cet ancien entrepôt ou atelier new yorkais en ce qui nous concerne (les photos présentées sur le site sont conformes à la réalité).

Seules la salle de bain et les toilettes non indépendants sont un peu justes pour 6 personnes.

Le loft est également plutôt bien équipé (cuisine, ordinateur, wifi, vidéo et musique).

Enfin nous avons été très bien accueillis par Alicia.

Nous conseillons donc vivement son loft.

Loved our stay in Alicia's very cool apartment. After we recovered from the journey up the 85 or so steep stairs (pack light) and the uninviting communal areas, we discovered a lovely bright sunny welcoming home amazingly spacious by any standards but especially for NYC. Location was amazing too so many great things on the doorstep.
