Only negatives were: the bathroom which is v small given the size of the loft, the fact that you can't stand up in the shower and the toilet plumbing....the apartment instructions include how to unblock the toilet, so you get the idea; the front room mattress was very hard; and the ladder up to the upstairs bedroom was a bit precarious after a few cocktails BUT don't be put off. If you can do stairs and want to stay in a really cool apartment in a really cool area, stay here. I would definitely go back.  Alicia was lovely, amenable and good to deal with. A great NYC experience.

This loft is a gem in a convenient location in SoHo.  It is large comfortable and close to everything in Manhattan.  It has all the comforts of home and lots more.  A good kitchen, a good sound system, a good heater and a very spaceous and comfortable living area.  Can't fault it and we would go back in a heartbeat.  Only negative, if that could be called as such, is the climb up to the apartment is not for the unfit and the shower is strange.  It is so odd you feel someone is having a lend of you when you are using it.  Apart from that it is a great place to stay.  100% recommendation!!

Alicia's loft is my dream NY home.  This was my sixth visit to NY and staying  in Alicias home gave me the chance to experience NY in a way I imagine a 'local' might.  Light filled, elegant and quintessentially New York this superb  loft is the perfect base.
Alicia was a great host and her apartment was amazing. The stairs are worth it! So centrally located and stylishly appointed. Would definitely rent the space again!
Amazing apartment, great location, can fully recommend!

The perfect host and the perfect place!
Stay there if you want to get a real taste of the life in NYC...
We'll definitely come back.
C.
Alicia is a fabulous host. I needed a place for two guests last minute and she was very responsive and friendly. She stayed at the apartment as well and my guests had a great time with her. Enjoy!

Waldemar was a fantastic host! The room was really great; clean, spacious, ice cold aircon and a fan. The bed was very comfortable, I felt safe, and slept well. The bathroom was really awesome as well! Clean, plenty of towels and bathroom stuff.. Also two sinks makes the room PERFECT for couples. The fire places are very cozy and cute and the kitchen is amazing.. His cat is super cute! I'd definitely stay again!! Thank you Waldemar;))

I returned to Waldemar's, this time staying with a friend in the bigger room. It's a very charming place with a beautiful and spotless bathroom and a lovely porch. We had a wonderful stay again. Thank you!

Waldemar was thoroughly charming and generous. The room was spacious and comfortable. The bathroom was beautiful and had everything we needed from towels to soap! The private terrace was a most welcome way to start the day....and provided the perfect ending to each evening. While we did not require a guide to the city or suggestions on activities, we know that - if needed - Waldemar would have provided a comprehensive list of possible sites and attractions. We plan on staying with him again, and recommending his apartment to friends who may visit the city.

It was a wonderful opportunity for us to stay in a brownstone building in a lovely part of NYC..and the room Waldemar provided was lovely, with its porch, and the large comfy bed. The bathroom
was also such luxury after so much travelling, definitely the top bathroom of our extended travels! We enjoyed conversing with Waldemar and we just wish we had had more time to explore that part of NYC. There is a wonderful cafe around the corner that unfortunately we only discovered on the last day, don't miss it.
Also there was a large supermarket a minute away for added convenience.

my wife and i had a nice stay at waldemar's. the location is fantastic, close to the subway in a quiet neighborhood. the room is spacious and so is the private bathroom. waldemar is a nice and kind person. i definitely recommend this place.

I've had a great stay at Waldemar's. He's very helpful and respectful. His place is nice too, and the room I stayed at had a nice porch and a private bathroom. I strongly recommend Waldemar and his place!
The place to be! Thank you Wald! Next time I'll prepare you something els than pasta!
Waldemar is the best.  His place is really nice and very clean and spacious.  I em enjoying my stay enormously.

Waldemar's space is exceptional. The room is very clean and it is a massive space by New York standards.  The bathroom is clean and beautiful.  You have a little balcony adjacent to your bedroom overlooking a lovely garden.   This room is a creative space made for sleeping, dreaming and writing. This space has a poetic quality to it as well as being very functional.  I recommend it highly.  The flat screen television has many channels.  And the ceiling fan works very very well.
My stay in Brooklyn was very relaxed and friendly. The ensuite bathroom was clean and well-appointed, the bed was comfortable, and the balcony made fresh air and light into a lovely part of my stay.

It's a nice room, exactly as the pictures and introduction described.  The bathroom is clean and spacious.  The location is convenient, very close to subway G station and a few minutes' walk to subway C station.  I really like the deli recommended by Waldemar.  It's just around the corner and the food/ coffee is fantastic!  Overall I had a great time.  Many thanks Waldemar!

Host = perfect! (available but unobtrusive)

Location = perfect! (Wonderful, beautiful area in Brooklyn (great! bars and restaurants all around) and extremely conveniently located to Manhattan: 1 transfer if you don't want to walk to G subway, 0 transfers if you walk to A/C subway about 10 minutes)

Room =

a) room itself is exactly as depicted = spacious and perfect!

b) room is badly soundproofed; if next-door-room ("Parlor Room In Victorian Townhouse") is rented out as well, bring earplugs, a sleep mask and expect little sleep; of course this depends also on the decency of your fellow visitors.

All in all I'd recommend this place for the dream of room, location and host. But I'd consider renting the neighboring room as well just to get rest. This issue doesn't seem to have disturbed visitors before me (which is a mistery to me) but as I'd really liked to have considered it beforehand, I mention it.

Located in a pleasant and safe area of Brooklyn, this is ideal for those looking for good value, quiet and well-situated accommodation. The bedroom and bathroom were clean and spacious and the bed large and very comfortable. Waldemar was an ideal host: pleasant, helpful and unobtrusive,
Excellent links to other areas of New York (G train station 3 mins away): taking, for example, between 15-30 minutes to Manhattan depending on where you go.
Wonderful coffee shop (Choice) around the corner. Supermarket and restaurants very close by.

Allen & Irina are great hosts. My partner and I stayed at this studio apartment for a week during a networking trip and it was perfect. Large private studio a few blocks from the subway, perfect for a weekend or long term stay! Would recommend to anyone going to NYC looking for a private place.

Allen and Irina's studio is quite lovely! Very well decorated and spacious enough to spread your things out and relax. Perfect for two guests. We loved the location -- very close to coffee shops, restaurants, bars and just a quick metro ride into the city! We did not stay long enough to utilize the kitchen, but it seems perfect for guests who want to cook during their stay!

Our accommodations were in a perfect location (great neighborhood, steps from the train), private, spacious, lovely, and at an amazing price. Our host was gracious and kind. Couldn't have been a better stay!

We had a fantastic time, and would certainly want to stay here again, if we had the opportunity.

The apartment is not only very large, it is beautifully furnished with interesting contemporary furniture. The kitchen is also exceptionally well equipped, and despite the many good restaurants in the area, we couldn't resist taking the opportunity to do some home cooking as well.

The bathroom has been recently renovated, and was very attractive, clean, and functional.

There is also a very good stereo system which takes a while to get the hang of, but manages to fill the space with sound very well.

Some guests might want to be aware that, being on a busy street, near a busy intersection, this apartment can be a little noisy. The noise is primarily traffic, though during our stay there were some loud roadworks (jackhammering, etc.) being conducted at night which were somewhat intrusive. We did not find this a major problem, but it is something to take into account. (But if you want a very quiet apartment, you probably should not be staying in the Chinatown area at all!)

Ali was a very helpful and accommodating host, and we can recommend her apartment very strongly indeed.

It was the perfect place: what a beautifull app.! We loved it and thought that is was even more impressive than what we had expected! Everything went very smoothly: Thanks Alicia & Lauren! We would love to come back!!!

Ali was a wonderful host and, and the apartment was an absolute pleasure - just like in the photos! The mattress in the main bedroom is very hard, but that shouldn't deter you from enjoying a comfortable stay in an excellent location.

We had a great time at Alicia's loft in the LES, that location was perfect - close to all the best shopping and great eating places all around. The apartment was fabulous and very comfortable after a long day out in NYC!

We had a great stay at Ali's flat on Bowery.

The flat is quintessential Manhattan loft living with a fashionable bohemian feel, lots of light and space, we instantly felt a home for our weeks stay. Ali was a great host giving us some pointers for local hang outs and restaurants the location being perfect for excursions into the east village, Noho and Greenwich. Trendy Brooklyn and Williamsburg are a 5 - 10 minute cab ride away just over the bridge too.

Top marks.
Ali is a gracious and thoughtful host, thanks for lending the pad. worked out great.
Ali's house is great! She is very welcoming and informative.  Fun neighborhood! Definitely worth staying there!
The apartment is amazing, spacious and clean. Great location and host!

Place very pleasant, located in a great area, perfect to enjoy the city by walking. Nothing is far and even if you want to take a taxi, it will not cost you an arm!
You just feel like home and Ali makes sure that you will feel like that.
Highly recommended!

There are a lot of noise, not only from the neighbourhood, but you can hear everything from the hosts who live upstairs. They have a bird or another animal that makes noises all day long and night. Additionally, every morning it sounded like someone was trying to break down the window in the kitchen - rather disturbing.

We had a great stay at Ali's place. The loft truly is spacious and made the perfect setting for our group to catch up before heading out into the city. Ali was a great host - she was very responsive and the place was immaculate with fresh linens laid out in each room. We did not do any cooking so I can't say much about the kitchen but the newly renovated bathroom is quite refreshing for an NYC apartment. Keep in mind that this apartment is on the Bowery in the heart of Chinatown so the exterior leaves a bit to be desired and there are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment, but once you are inside it is an extremely inviting space. The more time we spent, the more we came to appreciate Ali's design aesthetic. I would definitely recommend this apartment.

Sehr geschmack- und stilvolle eingerichtete Loft-Wohnung im Zentrum Manhattans. Die Wohnung ist geräumig, hell und praktisch eingerichtet. In der Küche findet man nicht nur alle nötigen Küchenutensilien sondern wird vom Gastgeber sogar noch mit ein paar Ess- und Trinkwaren begrüsst - sehr gastfreundlich, super!
Man kann den Mac- und die Stereoanlage benutzen. Wir (eine 5 köpfige Familie mit 3 Teenagern) fühlten uns sehr wohl in der Wohnung.
Einzige zwei Minuspunkte vielleicht:
-steile lange Treppe ohne Lift ist mit Koffern in den 4. Stock recht anstrengend...
-Einkaufsmöglichkeiten (Supermarkt) für anderes als chinesefood ist am Rand von Chinatown etwas schwieriger als sonst in N.Y.

This was our second time at Ali's loft and the beauty of this place remains the same! The light, the view, the space: THE perfect combination to enjoy the NYC way of life! Thanks again Ali and see you next year! Catherine and Co.

There were 4 of us on a work trip staying at the loft.  Ali's apartment is beautiful and clean and the location couldn't be better.  She was super accommodating about our check-in & out times.  Everything went really smoothly, highly recommend staying here

We had a great stay and Ali is a good host. Her housekeeper left us the keys and picked them up when we left. Location is perfect and the apartment looks ever better than on the pictures. Its very spacious as well.

Thank you!
The apartment is spacious with great decor. We really enjoyed our stay there. It is located perfectly. We look forward to revisiting the place. Maria

We had a wonderful stay at Ali's apartment. The location is fantastic, the place looked exactly like it did in the pictures. Get ready for a stair climb, typical NYC fashion we counted 86 steps to the top! But the apartment is worth it :) We would definitely recommend this apartment for a small group. Thank you Ali.

Ali's apartment on Bowery was absolutely perfect for our family trip. Amazing location amongst some incredible places to eat in LES and Soho, beautifully furnished and convenient facilities such as, huge kitchen with washing machine, two separate dining areas and air-con in several rooms, which was heaven away from the sweltering NY summer.

Aside from what was a wonderful 2 week stay, we did have severely noisy road works going on until 2 or 3am. On some nights there were also what seemed to be groups of people jumping or gathering on the roof above our bedrooms. These two things were not thrilling to our older travel companions who were lights out early, things that may need to be mentioned prior to booking for future patrons.

Overall our stay was not tainted by this and I would recommend anyone getting a taste for NY to stay here, in what ended up being our favourite area of Manhattan. Thanks!
We loved our stay in this loft apartment! Spacious and beautiful and in a fabulous location!!

Wonderful Apartment, Ali is a great host! You can easily walk around  the area and access all important spots in the city from there. The only "negative" thing is that you have to climb a lot of stairs to get to the apartment - especially during heatwave. But everything else (including the great bathroom) is amazing.

Our stay in the Bowery could not have been more perfect! Ali was a gracious and accommodating host with our requests for early arrival and to leave our bags at the end of our stay.

The place feels like a perfect oasis to recharge in between your New York adventures. It is immaculately furnished, stocked with every amenity Including cable TV and Apple TV a desktop computer and reliable wireless. The air-conditioning kept the place very cool and comfortable through a very very hot week in New York. Even the lighting is thoughtful and super-cool with interesting little details throughout. The bathroom has been beautifully remodeled. The kitchen is a large and social space stocked with everything you might need whether you're a cook or just turning the space into a makeshift bar for an evening haha.

Location-wise, you're literally at the nexus of the LES, East Village SoHo. Chinatown and Little Italy. You are easy walking distance to the Williamsburgh bridge. We couldn't believe our luck.

Our group of 6 was completely comfortable in this large fabulous home. I obviously can't recommend it enough. The four flights of stairs are noteworthy for those who might have health issues, or are elderly, but weren't an issue for us.

Thanks, Ali so much. I can say without hesitation that ill be back!!

-John Alexander

Séjour de 5 nuits fin juillet 2013 dans l'appartement d' Ali pour 6 personnes adultes. L'appartement est conforme à la description donnée sur le site et son emplacement permet de se déplacer facilement en métro. La remise des clefs en début et fin de séjour a été simple et facile. Ali comme prévu nous avait rajouté  un lit supplémentaire. Une remarque: les escaliers pour rejoindre l'appartement sont relativement raides et ne conviendraient peut être pas pour une personne ayant du mal à se déplacer.En résumé, un très bon séjour dans cet appartement et Ali, parlant très bien Français nous a facilité notre séjour.

Allen and Irina were great hosts! Very communicative and friendly. The apartment was very well stocked with plenty of linens, towels, and kitchenware.

As other reviews have mentioned, you can hear a pet bird upstairs every now and then, but only ever in the middle of the day. We personally weren't bothered at all by this.

We found the location very convenient, being just a few minutes walking to the L, G, J and M trains.

We spent a fantastic week at Waldemar's place, the room was spacious, spotlessly clean and lived up to all our expectations and Waldemar's description. The entire place has a really special and charming character which makes it absolutely easy to feel at home straight away. Waldemar is a very kind and attentive host who was always there when needed to provide information or a little chat. Arriving late at his place was no problem whatsoever and the area is perfect for people who want to experience some authentic Brooklyn feeling. Getting into Manhattan was absolutely easy, the subway is close at hand, same as a couple of nice cafes to have breakfast. This is a truly recommendable place at all times, providing the fantastic extra treat of being directly located at the track of the New York Marathon event in November! We absolutely enjoyed being part of the cheering crowd right in front of Waldemar's home, it was the perfect place to be!

Wir haben eine Woche bei Waldemar verbracht und von der Ankunft bis zur Abreise hat alles sehr gut geklappt. Das Zimmer war genauso hübsch wie beschrieben, alles war sehr sauber und Waldemar ist ein herzlicher und sehr angenehmer host, der sich sehr gut um uns gekümmert hat. Die location ist ruhig und man fühlt sich sofort sehr wohl, auch die Verkehrsanbindung mit der U-Bahn ist prima. Waldemar hat auf jede mail vor unserer Reise sofort und prompt reagiert und der Kontakt war vollkommen problemlos und freundlich. Alle Angaben aus seiner Beschreibung waren absolut korrekt und zuverlässig, wir waren sehr zufrieden und empfehlen Waldemar und seine Unterkunft uneingeschränkt an jeden weiter, der Lust hat auf eine lebendige neighborhood und authentisches Brooklyn-Gefühl und der die halbstündige U-Bahn-Fahrt nach Manhattan nicht scheut. Für uns hat Waldemars Wohnung sehr dazu beigetragen, uns von Anfang an als mehr als nur Touristen zu fühlen, sondern ein wenig in New Yorker Alltagsleben einzutauchen. Und wir würden jederzeit wieder bei ihm buchen!

Great place, quintessential Brooklyn townhouse with charming period details.   Cute cat named Kitty and host is attentive and helpful.  My only complaint is I just checked the airbnb calendar and the room is not available for my next trip :-( .
Waldemar was an accomodating and gracious host, and our room was charming and spacious.
Waldemar is a gracious host; very friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable about the neighborhood. We had lovely conversations and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend him.

We visited the weekend of 11/23-23/2013. Waldemar is a great guy--welcoming and helpful. Our room was large and comfortable--excellent bed and private bathroom. Nice deck outside although it was too chilly to use it. Everything was clean. Cotton sheets. Great Internet connection. We did not use the kitchen but it looked up-to-date and well-equipped.

Our one concern is that the living room was sort of disheveled--lots of his things around--clothes, etc. It didn't really seem a place that we'd want to spend time. Didn't matter to us too much since we weren't in the apartment that much. But it might make a difference to someone else. Also, while there was a clothes rack in our room, all the closets were full of his things--there really wasn't anywhere to put away our clothes so we were living out of our suitcases which would have been a problem had we been staying more than a couple of nights. Somewhat the same thing in the bathroom.

This is a terrific neighborhood where we have spent a lot of time. A block from the subway. Choice, the coffee shop and bakery, at the corner. Lots of good restaurants on Dekalb Ave. Walk to the Barclay Center if you're going to something there. And you can park on the street which saves a ton of $$ compared to Manhatten (just be alert to the street cleaning signs). Very comfortable place to use as a gateway to the city.
Nice stay.. very quiet area..easy subway access.. cool place..Waldemar was a great host.. cordial and helpful. Having our own bathroom was a plus. Thanks!

My husband and I stayed at Waldemar's in December when we were in town for a slew of holiday parties.
His home was absolutely cozy and smelled of vanilla and spice. (not joking) The room was large, warm and beautiful with a large bathroom perfect for getting ready for a night out on the town.
Waldemar was kind and helpful, and made sure we were comfortable.
Near by, a sweet little cafe, great for a morning coffee or quick bite, and a block away from the G train.
It was a great location and with only a 30 min commute to the city.
I would highly recommend staying at Waldemar's and I believe we will do so again in the future!
Waldemar is such a great boy, lo recomiendo por su seriedad a la hora  de cumplir con lo pactado y lo  recomiendo ampliamente ya que volvería a parar en su dpto.

So we were visiting during the end of December, early Jan. The apartment was great, very clean and large with a private bathroom, lovely. However, due to the cold the pipes froze so we had to use the bathroom downstairs.

The early check out complicated things a bit since we had a later flight, but otherwise perfect!

Waldemar was so nice and so accommodating and his home is stunning and clean. With a price that surpasses local hotel chains, an in room patio and bathroom nestled within a spectacular brownstone you couldn't ask for anything more.

Waldemar was incredibly friendly and helpful with me. His location was as described. There were issues with the weather (snow), that caused some issues with the water, but he was more than accommodating.

Highly recommended.
Convenient location. Easy street parking.  Great coffee shop on corner.  If mobility issues, consider a different location-narrow stairway to bedroom; 3 stairs to private bathroom-no railing.

Wonderful experience staying in this Brooklyn airbnb while visiting our daughter who recently moved to Clinton Hill. . Clean, welcoming and convenient to all neighborhoods.  Waldemar couldn't have been more gracious and helpful. I recommend this air bnb.

I stayed in the orange room which strangely only had a rack for clothing for my use and no drawers although there were four huge wardrobes but all filled with host clothing I presumed.   The bathroom was modern and had continuous hot water and plenty of towels just three steps up into the bathroom.   The double bed was comfortable although having to put my arm between the headboard and the mattress was not the best idea in the world to switch on a lamp via an extension lying on the floor, it also meant that my pillows were slipping through the hole onto the floor during the night.   However the pillows were nice and soft and the sheets were clean and soft on my face.   Host was helpful in giving me directions around the train systems, privacy and offering to order me a taxi for the airport.   He is a very nice respectful  host.

This was a perfect location for us to visit our daughter in Brooklyn. Waldemar was pleasant. We had different schedules so we did not see each other a lot. There are great restaurants in the area. We recommend Hoja Santas for dinner and Urban Vintage for brunch.
This was a great place!  It was a beautiful room and bed, and it is very close to the subway.  I would recommend this for anyone!

We had a lovely stay with Waldemar in Brooklyn. His historic brownstone is located in a neighborhood of colleges, St. Joseph's College and Pratt Institute. Public transportation is very handy.  We never had difficulty finding a parking spot within one block and we felt very safe. Our room was charming and clean and Waldemar is a gracious host.

Being the first time in Brooklyn, Waldemars flat was a very good place to stay. He is a pleasant host and ready to support us anytime. The room is more than enough for two persons. Having our own bathroom made it very comfortable. Recommending his place to everybody.

Our stay with Waldemar was great! The room was comfortable, quite and private as well as being close to public transport, food and entertainment venues. Waldemar was very accommodating, friendly and generally made our stay very easy and comfortable.
I highly recommend the room for anyone visiting NYC.

Waldemar is a lovely and considerate host.  Very pleasant and charming, with just the right mixture of qualities for an air bnb host.  His brownstone is beautiful, wonderful interior moldings and details.  My room was a self contained room from another era with its own bathroom and private terrace.  Amazing value!  Just a note (I am an older guest), the upstairs suite involves a little stairclimbing, so if mobility is a bit of an issue, there is, I understand, an amazing room available on the ground floor.  The subway is a block away, an easy commute into Manhattan.  Very convenient location, with a great market one block away also.  An outstanding value in New York City!
Nice room.  I had a very pleasant stay.  Sanctuary in the city!  Waldemar was a gracious host.

we enjoyed our stay at Waldemar's place. the room is incredible like on photos and the private bathroom very convenient. we've found in the neighborhood nice places for breakfast or dinner and it's a good starting point to discover NY.
as we came to the place as a couple the only small remark we have to do is that we found our selfs a reduced privacy because your bed is alongside a wooden door to the next room with another guest.
this place is definitely a good value and Waldemar is a very courteous host.
we would recommend his place.

I really enjoyed my stay at Waldemar's place. He is very friendly and would love to help if you need any. The neighborhood is great, the room is very nice. Loved the bathroom and the garden. Very easy to go to Manhattan and JFK. Would love to come back.

We stayed with Wald for 4 days It was our first time in the city so we stayed little at the home. He was a great host providing all the flexibility required.

We arrived very late for the check in, and we did a last minute checkout. We usually get to the home very late at night, but we never got a complain.

If you want to stay in Brooklyn in a conformable place and a nice neighborhood, He's the way to go!

I stayed at Waldemar's place by myself (traveling alone) when I was checking in late at night, Waldemar wasn't home. The area was dark and I had trouble unlocking the door (Waldemar was very quick to respond on how to do this, so don't freak out!) once I got in, I went upstairs to the room and Waldemar left the light on for me. The room is very spacious and with a lovely bathroom all to yourself. For the price you're paying and the location (very close to subway and easy to find) I would highly recommend this place. I was out from morning until around 9pm every night I was here so I didn't use any other facilities so I can't judge that but this was exactly what I needed. Waldemar was friendly and kept to himself - I think for me. I definitely appreciated it because after working all day I just wanted to have some alone time and sleep! Had no problem with the bed. It is a little dark at night with only one light but otherwise perfect. Towels were provided, toilet was cleaned before I arrived. Thanks a lot!!

Wir hatten sehr schöne Tage in NY. Die Umgebung um die Lafayette Ave. ist ein aufstrebendes Alternativviertel, dabei ist es angenehm ruhig. Es lassen sich ausser der G Linie auch die A und C Linie in kurzer Entfernung erreichen, um nach Manhattan in ca. 30 min zu kommen. Waldemar war uns ein guter Gastgeber, der sich um unser Wohlbefinden kümmerte. Bettwäsche wechseln, Bad reinigen usw. war wie verabredet pünktlich. Wir haben jeden morgen in dem phantastischen Cafe an der Ecke gefrühstückt. Alles in Allem eine gute Erfahrung.

Me and my girlfriend stayed in Waldemar's En Suite for 9 nights. We had a great time with all we could wish for. The room is spacious, the private bathroom was clean, big bed and a nice deck of your own. The area is really cool with lots of great restaurants and bars. It's also close to a bunch of different subway-stations to get you were you want. Waldemar is a great host, kind and helpful. Highly recommended!
Waldemar is very harmfull but his house is too  noisy an dusty. I would not recommended this adress

We rented the room en suite bedroom. Location and accommendation exactly as photos show, and valued low rate.  Waldemar was a wonderful, responsive, respectful host, and I would love to stay at his place again! Our suite had great ventilation: Luxurious fresh air from deck door coming in and an inviting and super clean bathroom has 3 windows. Bed was very comfortable. Those items and location were most important for us, since we had an assignment 2 and 4 blocks away on this past weekend! Chef's kitchen was there for us, conversation with guests and host, very enjoyable, french lunch place -almost next door- and parking in FRONT of house, made our stay perfect for us.

Spacious, stylish 4th floor loft apartment in a great location. It met and surpassed expectations. You couldn't wish to be in a better area. Lots of restaurants, bars and shops within minutes of leaving the apartment.

Ali, the owner, was a great host. She answered all of my questions almost instantly and she was very flexible with certain requests I had.

This was my first experience booking through airbnb and I couldn't have asked for a better one. Would highly recommend this apartment.

Ali's apartment was perfect for five people for a long weekend in NYC. It's a perfect location, minutes away from Little Italy and Soho.

The apartment itself is spacious, light and airy, a haven from the noise and bright lights of Manhattan. Everything you need is provided and the apartment is tastefully decorated with great lighting and shelves filled with interesting books. We were impressed with how clean everything was including the linen and towels and felt totally at home and comfortable.

We look forward to a return trip one day. Thank you Ali.

This is a great place to stay with a group of people for the space. I came with my adult children and we really enjoyed the space, the privacy for each bedroom, and the opportunity to sit around the lounge and chat and enjoy our own company. The house is fairly well equipped- missing a kettle and a place to hang your clothes to dry but we managed with a pot and hanging our clothes under the fans on the back of chairs. The dryer doesn't work and we had to put new batteries in the computer keypad but happy to have the use of wifi. The instructions for the stereo are a bit challenging and we couldn't get that to work either.
The apartment is in a great position near the metro and in the middle of many neighbourhoods so this was a real bonus.
There are 4 flights of stairs so not for the faint hearted. The apartment faces east /west so does warm up fairly quickly and air con is a bit dated.
The noise from the road works outside the house was VERY LOUD- and started from 10pm to at least 2am 5 nights a week. Fortunately they did have the weekends off so we could recover. One night we could hardly hear ourselves talk. We were staying for 10 nights so that was a while to cope with the noise- a shorter stay wouldn't bother anyone.

Overall this was a great place to stay although the road works look like they are ongoing as the road opposite is permanently blocked off full of machinery so bring your ear plugs. Otherwise I reccommend the Bowery for the space and ambience after days and nights of exploring the city.

We spent a weekend in New York as a group of 6 friends and really loved this loft apartment. The location was perfect for the area's we wanted to spend time in and really close to Broadway for shopping! The apartment itself was so unique with really beautiful style. Ali allowed us to drop our bags off early and to check out a little later making our visit completely hassle free. As others have mentioned the 4 flights of stairs can be a challenge but personally it made me feel less guilty about all of the great food I was eating in NY! Highly recommend and would definitely stay there again.

Very nice loft conveniently situated. Ali was very helpful concerning our delayed luggage ...  We really appreciated the space and the furniture . Well equiped. It was great being so close to Soho and chinatown, but quite difficult to climb the stairs after hours of walking in NYC at night. We would recommend it, but be aware of the noisy environment at nights.

C'est un très beau loft, avec une ambiance très new yorkaise, déco très sympa et propre, mais il se trouve sur l'avenue la plus bruyante de NYC! Le salon est donc très bruyant, et il est très difficile de dormir dans l'une des chambres (avec futon en plus) à cause du bruit de la circulation (nuit et jour!). Les murs tremblent dès qu'un camion passe!! Il y avait en plus un chantier juste à côté, donc pas terrible le réveil marteau piqueur lundi 7h...
Je n'ai pas vu l'hôte, nous avons été "accueillis" par la femme de ménage en 10 sec chrono, et personne non plus pour le check out. Un peu déçue donc...

The loft at 131 Bowery is a true New York expreience. It is spacious, has all the equipment you need and the bathroom is fresh and inviting. Everything was clean and functioning. The location is perfect if you want to explore Manhattan.
The one thing that might be a concern is the sound of the traffic and now in November the sound of the construction work during the night time. On the other hand; where can you stay on Manhattan where there is no traffic?
All contacts with Ali have been swift and she has been very service oriented. Everything worked out really well and I can strongly recomend Ali as host.
This is a safe choice and a nice experience.

Spent 4 days in Ali's loft as a family trip ( 6 adults). We were all delighted with the loft !
Great location , a stone's throw from Chinatown, SoHo - great bars & restaurants, closest subway (Grand St) a 2 minute walk. Whole Foods ( yum! ) a short walk away.
The loft was well equipped, with clear instructions on wifi, tv etc. There was plenty of space for us all to hang out, the bedrooms were roomy with fresh, clean bedding & towels.
Access to the loft & leaving was very straightforward with Julia the housekeeper meeting us at the loft.
Only two notes; a long flight of stairs to get to the loft.....ok for 6 adults, but might be a problem for buggies etc. Secondly, the front bedroom was quite noisy ( traffic, roadworks at the moment) for 2 people who usually live in a quiet area in the UK) However, the rest of my family had no issues with the noise and with earplugs it was no problem. I think it's a reflection of how central the apartment is and probably to be expected in NYC.
Overall, a big thumbs up and we would happily stay here again if we visit NY again. Thanks !

We stayed at Alis Loft for 20 days in December with 3 kids and can recommend it. The loft is very very well equipped. We enjoyed the unique design and lighting. Beds very comfortable, clean and soft linen, enough towels, good heating, lots of storage space, sound surround system, apple tv with lots of movies, computer and printer to use, wifi, shelves full of nice books, new and clean bathroom providing shower gels...
Ali left a folder with all important information about the loft and area including food delivery menus...she was very fast anwering all our questions. We felt taken care of - great host!!
B and D subways are just around the corner, J and Z a few walking minutes away. Within no time you can reach all the "hotspots". Very good seafood at reasonable prices just around the corner at chinese markets.
The stairs were only a problem at the beginning and the end of our stay as we had many heavy suitcases. All the rest of the time we found it absolutely fine to walk up and train our butts (even with three little kids)
Unfortunately there was a lot of noise at night due to construction work in front of the house and next to the house - not on weekends.
Thanks Ali!

We stayed at this apt over New Year and were delighted with the interior and space made available to us. It truly is a unique apt and as all three of us are interior designers we love to stay in unusual homes and this really hit the mark.
The location was great making it easy to access New York and all it has to offer.
Many of the reviews mention the stairs and they are quite demanding, I wouldn't recommend for anyone with pushchairs etc but they wouldn't put me off staying again.
All in all we had a wonderful time and staying at the apt rather than a hotel made it even more enjoyable.

We stayed for a week with 4 very tall adult children in the middle of the snow.
A great location and very comfortable - spacious and full of everything you need.
Great location near to good food, interesting area and very easy for travel/sightseeing
Would highly recommend it
The reservation was canceled 4 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Amazing apartment! I would definitely recommend, especially if you like to be close to all the best places i.e. Soho, West Village and the East village!
Ali made everything easy and communication was great. You dont need to worry about anything. Go!

L appartement d Ali est idéalement situé, il est très propre, pratique , et typiquement new yorkais. Nous étions 5 filles et avons passé 5 jours magiques.
Ali est très bien organisée pour les clés et tout le reste dans l'appartement .
Elle a été très accommodante pour l'heure d'arrivée et surtout notre départ.
Encore merci Ali!

We loved this space. It was perfect for our group of friends, were we all got separate bed rooms bit still had lots of space to socialize in.
Bathroom was very clean and fresh and in the kitchen you'll find everything you need.
Ali was a great host, available for questions and very friendly.
You should be aware it's six stairs up, and located on a very busy street, so you can be disturb by noise if you're a light sleeper.
But in the other hand you have five mins walk to a number of great restaurants and shops.

A group of 8 of us had a fantastic time at Ali's place. Super close to Little Italy and Chinatown, and we comfortably walked to downtown, and the subway to Midtown and Brooklyn is easily accessible. It is a bit of a hike up the steps, and there was some noise from the street, but hey this is not the suburbs. Ali was very helpful and it's a great place to experience NYC.
Cool design throughout the whole loft. It was great with good location close to Nolita, Soho and Chinatown. The Bowery was a bit noisy. Ali was a perfect and generous host.

Ali is a great host! Everything was as stated in the description of her place. A couple of times I texted her about occasions/clubs/restaurants in NY and she answered fast with good help to us tourists in NY. From her flat you see the entrance to Chinatown and a few blocks away is Little Italy. One block to the subway. Perfect location!

Everything was brilliant. Apartment absolutely as described and Ali was a star in assisting us on several occasions. I can strongly recommend the flat and Ali (as a host) to anyone using Airbnb. Peter

Stayed for a second time in a month. As good experience as the first time, and Ali was extremely helpful to sort out our stay with short notice. We had a great time and                                                                                                                                           yet again Ali was very flexible and accommodating. Thanks Peter

Ali's loft is spacious, true ny style, with a large living room, decorated with fun and tasteful furniture, an eclectic DVD collection as well as a selection of art and photography books. The bathroom is clean and recently renovated and the kitchen is well stocked. There are two bedrooms on the main floor, one of which has a futon with a really hard mattress and a mezzanine with a low ceiling (less than 1 meter!) and no window which can feel a little claustrophobic. While the location is right in Chinatown and at walking distance from Little Italy,Soho or the New Museum, please be aware of the excessive noise coming from day and night traffic, with the entire living room feeling the tremors of the passing trucks as well as road works till 5AM right across the street. We did enjoy our time in New York but couldn't really rest after long days in the city.

My stay at Allen and Irina's satisfied my wanting an urban space to live in for 3 months. I felt safe
. . The bed was great and the kitchen is well equipped. I was able to park my car on the block and the neighborhood was enjoyable from my perspective. Living in the same house with the owners meant I always felt safe but it was noisy above at times like walking in heavy boots.
We all got along well and I found some good neighborhood shops.
The place is very cute and cozy, and it is also in a fantastic location. I had everything I needed here, and they were great hosts and very quick to respond to messages! I would stay here again!

Good location/neighborhood, 5 mins walk to subway station
The place is pretty spacious (for a studio in NYC). Kitchen fully equipped, comfy bed, nice bathroom. Not much natural lights but it is expected for a half basement unit. The heat is strong enough for the coldest days in the year but the hiss from the pipe can be loud (you can shut it down manually but not the best idea in the middle of the night).
Communication is super with instant response if anything.
Overall great experience and could be even better if staying in warmer seasons.

About my 3 month stay..

What I liked very much: The apartment is super easy to reach by metro, there are various supermarkets in the area, the area is very safe even in the evening and as a woman alone, you have a lot of space in the apartment, Irina answers super fast, the apartment has good facilities, the internet works great (except in the kitchen) what is really perfect when you work from there

Suggestions for improvement: The vent in the bathroom was very dusty, a shelf with drawers or similar would be great for more storage space, especially for long term stays

Also, like almost all apartments in New York, the apartment is very noisy -but that gives you Manhattan vibes ;) And be aware that the apartment is much darker than in the pictures and has a little bit outdated furnishings.

All in all, it is a good apartment for Brooklyn and for all those who want to be quickly in Manhattan and for whom a good and safe location is important (the location was absolutely perfect). I would recommend the apartment, especially for short time stays (up to one month).
Great little spot in Williamsburg. I really enjoyed my stay. Allen and Irena were very accommodating.
Yes Ali was a great host and made us feel welcome. The place was in an excellent location, well kept and had everything we needed to have a pleasant stay in the city. I would definitely go back.

Would not have done NYC any other way! The loft is as beautiful as the photos show. Great character, clean, and lots of space in an awesome central location. While we didn't have the opportunity to meet Ali, she was attentive and friendly in all communication. Would definitely stay again, highly recommend!

The Chinatown loft was perfect for our stay! Wonderful location, lots of space, great quality sheets and towels, everything we needed in the kitchen, and wicked stylish. Ali was totally accessible when we had questions.

The apartment was fantastic. Great location right near Chinatown, SoHo and a good choice of subways. We were a group of girlfriends in town to celebrate birthdays and this apartment was perfect for that purpose it had everything we needed. There was a lot of noise the week we were there with road works until early hours of the morning however it is NYC and this is to be expected. The white noise machines helped a lot.  Ali was very responsive and helpful host. I would recommend staying at The Bowery Loft.
Although we were many people in the apartment, Ali managed to fullfil all the expectations and helped a lot with logistics, very good host!

Ali´s place is just great! Her cool apartment was clean, true to the pictures and is situated in a very nice and eclectic area. Unfortunately we didn´t meet Ali in person but she was very helpful when we needed help with transportation and flexible with our departure time. We truly recommend a stay at Ali´s place at Bowery!

Ali was a great host, with continual communication in the lead up to and during our stay.
The loft is exactly as per pictures, eclectic, warm and inviting. We felt right at home.
Positioning is basically opposite the Welcome sign for Chinatown with a subway station behind and a few blocks away. Bars, clubs and restaurants are within walking distance.
My thoughts for future travellers:
- if a very little sleeper bring earplugs. This city never sleeps!!
- the apt is at the top of 4 flights of stairs. Easier for some.
The loft has everything you need, amazing vibe, lots of space, great sound system and on the doorstep of some amazing nightlife.
Highly recommend.

Ali was very communicative and helpful prior to and during our stay. The loft is gorgeous, exactly as we had expected! Some of the reviews mentioned noise, but we didn't have a problem at all with that. It's very spacious and social for groups of friends staying there.

A few more mirrors would have been helpful (we were 6 girls staying there!), and the stairs are a good work out for the thighs :)

Cannot beat the location. My friends were really pleased with our spot, and we had the best time.

Thanks

Ali's loft was the perfect spot for a girlie weekend.  Gabbing in her cozy, clean, spacious flat and everything you could want for food, shopping and entertainment right on your doorstep.  The linens and towels were lovely.  Ali was flexible about check out and our questions were answered in her informative binder.  The best part of the stay was the location, it can't be beat!
Ali's loft is incredible!!! Beautiful furniture; terrific layout; perfect location. Three very separate rooms with nicely-sized beds. If I lived in NYC, I wish I could live in a place this gorgeous!

This was our first trip with Airbnb and could not have been better. Charming and spacious loft (just see and read for yourself) with excellent location. Full setup of everything you could imagine in a home. We did only use a fraction (not making any cooking byouselves). But wifi, computer and printer made it very handy to plan the days (including printing tickets!). Ali very supportive (although hardly needed). Everyone agreed this gave a much greater flavour to the trip than hotel.

Our stay at Ali's loft was great!  The space was perfect for a group of friends...we were three couples...the 3 bedrooms are separate and well sized!  The living space is superb and allows for a large group to share without feeling on top of one another.  The bonus...Ali's furnishings are excellent and she provides kitchen and bathroom essentials! Communication was seamless and Ali was more than flexible on a late check out!  Thanks Ali...it was a great stay!
Very nice appartment, spacious, very luminous, confortable, ideally located for Soho addicts.

Ali's apartment is authentic, stylish, well located, comfortable and spacious.

She and her team of helpers are also professional, courteous and responsive.

I have lived in New York for 1.5 years, in 6 different apartments, and stayed in 4 different airbnb's in the city. You won't find a better deal than this.

Ali's loft is spacious and comfortable. Situated in Chinatown, very close to Little Italy & Nolita, with a subway really close-by, it is very well situated for a visit to NYC.

Downsides : noisy due to a lot of street traffic, 1 of the beds is very hard, 4th floor (stairs are tough at the end of a long day), no microwave when we were there.

Upsides : location (for visiting, for shopping & for restaurants), proximity of subway, spaciousness of the loft, comfort.

I will certainly recommend this apartment to friends who are visiting NYC !

Thanks Ali - the loft contributed to a very nice week in NYC - despite the freezing cold ! ;)

We had a fantastic time in New York whilst staying at this loft. On arrival the loft was exactly as expected with the photos a true reflection. The location wasperfect; a short walk to restaurants, shopping and also close by to a number of subway stations making it easy to also get to the sights synonymous with NY.

Arriving in the evening wasn't a problem for access and whilst we didn't meet Ali herself she was easily contactable if we had any questions during our stay and lovely to deal with.

The loft is a gorgeous warm space with quality furnishings. It's on the top floor so the stairs certainly aren't for the faint-hearted but worth the climb to the stylish oasis.

We'd definitely stay again.

The loft was nice and very spacious, the location very good in the middle of Chinatown and Little Italy. Close to transport and busy streets. Nice bedrooms and really big living room and kitchen. Alis loft was everything it promised. Thanks Ali, it was a great stay!

The Loft is exactly as described and shown on the pictures and it is very spacious and thus easily accommodates six people. We were a group of six and enjoyed the available space. The Loft's location is also perfect if you want to visit NYC - just a couple of minutes walk to SoHo, Broadway, LES and other great neighborhoods. It was very clean and we also had everything we need from towels to sheets etc. We also appreciated the little details such as the white noise machines in the bedrooms. Communication with Ali was straightforward, fast and forthcoming. All in all I would definitely recommend you staying at this Loft when you are visiting New York.

Ali's apartment was exactly as described and the layout was even better than it appeared in the photos. The apartment is huge for NYC and 7 girls were very comfortable here for a long weekend. The common living areas (living room, dining area and kitchen with table) and spacious bedrooms were nicely decorated and had everything we could imagine. Although there is only 1 bathroom (which was beautiful - recently renovated) it was not a problem at all for a short stay.
Although we didn't cook, the kitchen is set up for it with every seasoning you can imagine and most are organic (a nice surprise). I brought coffee, milk and sugar and there were many options to make coffee. There was also filtered tap water! The 4 flight walk up is rough but was worth it for such a great space! Other's commented that it was noisy, which is was, but it is in a busy neighborhood in NYC, so that kind of goes with the territory. Ali is kind enough to provide white noise machines to her guests.
The apartment is located on the edge of Chinatown and is a quick walk to the LES, Broadway, Little Italy and subway. It was an awesome location! Ali was great to deal with. She always responded in a timely manner and was accommodating when we were later than expected checking in.
We could not have been happier and none of us wanted to leave! Thanks again for this great space Ali. I would highly recommend staying here!

Neighborhood was interesting with lots of great small shops around the corner to eat and/or have a coffee. It's certainly diverse, but still hasn't reached that hipster quality that places like Park Slope or Williamsburg have. The picture is exactly the room; the house, though old, is architecturally beautiful, with high ceilings. LOVED the terrace. Waldemar was always around and he engaged in conversation if you wanted to converse, or left you alone if you didn't want to. I had a car and had no problems finding a spot. Bed was also comfortable. And hot evenings, you had the option of using a ceiling fan or air conditioner. (I opted for the fan.)

Waldemar was extremely considerate and responsive to all my questions.  He even introduced me to other people staying at the residence and made me feel like I was at home.  I would definitely stay with Waldemar again.

This was a really great base for my NYC holiday. The location couldn't have been better. Within 1 block is a coffee shop, a good grocery store, a Citi bike station and the surprisingly useful G train. The G train is good for Wburg, Park Slope MOMA PS1, and even for midtown.

Waldemar was a very nice host and was available at all times. He also had World cup and Wimbledon on which was good for getting updates.

The room was spacious and comfortable. Even on 95+ days the room was bearable with the fan on. The bathroom is very nice, and the small outdoor deck was perfect for breakfasts each morning.

The only thing I think everyone should be aware of is that there is very little acoustic privacy between this room and the neighboring room and also with the rest of the house. My girlfriend and I wanted to make *ahem* noise. We didn't really feel comfortable doing that and had to keep a lid on it. If you too are traveling as a couple you'll want to know this before you book...

Waldemar is a genial host who provided good advice about the neighbourhood and which subway lines to take to get to specific destinations.

The room was better than I expected it to be. Very large with a high ceiling. Very quiet. Big ceiling fan to keep the room cool. Clean.

The Airbnb is located in a great Brooklyn neighbourhood and is close to two subway lines that take visitors to Manhattan. Very good bakery/cafe with excellent coffee half a block from Waldemar's Airbnb.

I would stay here again!
Clean, easy room in great area; good host, extremely fast responses to all messages: recommended!

Waldemar was a helpful and friendly host for the most part.  He advised me about subway routes, local attractions/businesses, and responded to my room needs.  He was almost always in the living room hanging out during my comings and goings from the residence. Two things should be noted about the accommodations: (1) There is no exterior lock to the room doors so they are accessible to the host (or anyone in the residence) and (2) the room air-conditioning is monitored and rationed according to the host's discretion. (On at 9 PM- off at 7 AM)  I was willing to follow these prescriptions, but was somewhat baffled and dismayed when i discovered the air conditioner was on a timer and i couldn't modify the schedule based on realistic need for comfort. This disallows the notion that a given guest will use their own judgement and common courtesy to turn the air on and off at a reasonable hour to honor the request of the host.

I had a wonderful time. Waldemar was friendly and helpful, and the room was beautiful! I slept well and appreciated Waldemar's advice about the city. Everything in the room was furnished as seen in the picture.

My Room with EnSuite Bathroom and Deck was excellent. This listing was perfect - everything was delivered and came as promised. Huge, comfortable and clean space.

Waldemar the host was great - he was very approacable, friendly and informative.

The neighborhood is quiet and safe, and picturesque. Only minutes to SoHo via the Manhattan bridge, or a couple of blocks walk to the Metro where you can easily get to anywhere Downtown, Uptown, or Mid-Town via any one of the subway lines.

I would definitely stay there again.

Waldemar is a very personable, laid back host, which I appreciated. The space itself is exactly as shown in the photo, though perhaps a little more casual than it appears. It was roomy, with an en suite bath and tiny private deck, which was nice. Cable TV, ceiling fan, and AC also provided.

The location is a bit of a schlep to Manhattan, although there are subway stops nearby. I couldn't figure out how to get to the upper east side without having to get off one train, walk a block or two, and get on another, but I'm sure there must be a way.

Very convenient to BAM and all things Brooklyn. I found on-street parking where I could leave my car unmolested for two or more days.

All in all a pleasant stay. It's nice not to have to worry about having a safe, friendly place to return to at the end of the day.

Waldemar was a very nice and polite host who was always helpful. The apartment is located  not even 20min away from lower Manhatten so you can get to main sights fairly quickly. The room itself was spacious and homely which just made our overall experience in New York just so much better. Highly recommended.

Waldemar was a good host. The room was clean and large. The bathroom is private with tub/shower and 2 separate sinks. Clean towels and linens were provided. A small outdoor terrace is avaiable. Nice amenities like WiFi and HD TV are also provided along with A/C.
This is a nice room in a good safe location.









The room is located in a nice location with easy access to restaurants, shopping and the subway.

Staying with Waldemar at his beautiful brownstone was a fantastic experience. The room was huge, immaculate, and it was so nice having the balcony and ensuite. Waldemar was very friendly, helpful and accommodating. I would absolutely recommend him as a host, and would definitely stay at his place again the next time I'm in Brooklyn. Even his cat was friendly, and I'm a dog person ;)
Yes! Great place in a great area!

My experience staying here was great! Waldemar was always there to answer any questions I had. He was a thoughtful but unobtrusive host and made checking in and out fast and easy. I loved the neighborhood and the room, and the little cafe on the corner! The bathroom had tons of products I could use. The G train was a block away and provided easy access to Manhattan and other parts of Brooklyn. I would definitely recommend anyone visiting NYC to stay here!

Waldemar is a friendly host. He's not intrusive which is a big plus considering that you're staying in somebody's home. The place could do with a good clean, especially that there were odd sock and glove among other weird objects laying around in the guest room. Also, the place was very dusty and floor wasn't clean. However, if you can overlook that and you are on the budget, you can consider staying there, as the price is very competitive.

The least hospitable host yet in our experience with Airbnb. A room with lots of potential, spoiled by an environment of being made feel like an intruder, in an apartment suffering quite a bit of neglect. From simple things like the front security door jambing, and requiring two hands to both open and close, to a fridge overflowing with old stock that made it near impossible to place one's own items, to a washing machine that was broken......get the picture? Not the worst experience in my travels, but enough to tarnish my memory of this wonderful and exciting city. Knowing what we know now, we would not have stayed there with Waldemar

Waldemar was a welcoming and friendly host. The accommodation was as described, with a comfortable bed, large bathroom and nice modern amenities like HDTV and WiFi.

This room in one of New York's ubiquitous brownstones is a good alternative to the usual tourist spots in Manhattan, with a great cafe and bar just around the corner from the property, providing a good insight to what life is like for most New Yorkers. There are two subway lines within 15 mins which allowed easy access to Manhattan and the rest of Brooklyn.

Our stay at Waldemar's place was great. He was a lovely host, friendly, accommodating and always available. The cat was also very friendly, which is always nice for those leaving their pets at home :)

There were no surprises - the room was the same as in the photos, the bathroom was fully stocked (even with a hair dryer) and the bed was spacious with very soft sheets.

The neighborhood was great as well - a coffeeshop/deli 2 min down the street had wonderful coffee and pastries.

Overall it was a very nice, chill place to stay.
Great Stay, awesome location, Room was clean and everything well provided.  Waldemar was gracious and helpful.

Une belle pièce à coucher, donnant sur un jardin, avec une petite terrasse, une salle de bains impeccable, un hôte très aimable et fort peu gênant. L'appartement est bien situé, dans un quartier agréable et vivant. Je m'y suis senti à l'aise, d'autant plus que j'ai été très bien reçu par Waldemar. Le chat lui-même mérite une caresse. J'espère y retourner. Great place! Great host!

The room was very good, we loved being there the whole time. My friend & I were excited by the location, the house & the room. It was exactly what we needed, a comfortable bed, a bonus ensuite bathroom & the balcony was good for early morning fresh air.  As new Airbnb users we were very happy & if Waldermer would have us again we would definitely want to stay with him again :)
For my first experience with Airbnb my visit was a delight
The room was decent and the host was accommodating. The bathroom was well stocked and the price was good.

Waldemar's place is in a great location. The balcony is a special touch. Waldemar was very patient with our questions giving us great advice on how to get places and eating establishments. The room was comfy and to find a room with an en suite was great. Kitty is a handsome friendly fellow who will wine your heart. Brooklyn was a lovely place to stay and the neighbourhood has many quaint restaurants with all kinds of cuisine. The address is within walking distance of so much. We would not hesitate to stay with Waldemar and Kitty again!

Our trip to New York ended at Waldemar's place.
The welcome was very good as he gave us a tour of the house + our room explaining how everything worked and where everything was.
He is not invasive and as we were out early in the morning and back in around 8pm we didn't see him much. We still had the chance to have a quick chat and he seemed a very nice person.

The room itself was huge, there is a big space in the middle which was great for us to arrange our suitcases etc. A scale was also available to weight our suitcases.
The bed was big and we slept really well.
The En Suite bathroom was also very appreciated as it was big and clean.
The + was the small 'balcony' with the table and chairs, although we didn't have the chance to really spend time on it.

His house is located VERY close to the subway. Within 20 minutes and 1 change you could hit times Square or Penn Station.
Brooklyn itself is nice visiting and the street is very quiet and welcoming.

The other good thing was the small supermarket accross the street where they had good salads and fresh sandwiches.

We enjoyed our stay.
Hemos estado muy a gusto en la casa de Irina, la ubicación es mejor imposible, sin duda repetiremos
Great studio!! The area was very safe and had everything around. The place was very spacious. The host were great and very accommodating. I would rent here again for a month
Great location and well equipped for an extended  stay.

Waldemar was an excellent host, he is very friendly and respectful, and he has a lot of information about the area which is very helpful. The room was exactly as described, the balcony was spectacular and very tranquil. The neighborhood is great, within only a short walk to the subway, and only a block away from the supermarket and restaurants and coffeeshops. I highly recommend staying with Waldemar would definitely stay here again!
Nice comfortable room. It made our stay very convenient and enjoyable. Host is very amicable and room is as described. Good location and price

This place is fantastic. Very clean and stylish place with everything you need. In a great location, close to subway stations, food places, grocery stores, and delis! Kae was very accommodating and helpful making sure I had everything I needed.  Communication was great too. I would highly recommend this wonderful apartment.

Waldemar was a great host! Helpful and very quick to respond and accommodate when we had a transit delay.  The room is nice with a well stocked bathroom and lovely outdoor area to have a coffee in the morning.

We stayed here for two nights. the neighbarhood is very nice and safe. The metro to manhatten is only 3 minutes from the apartment. VERY comfortable bed!! Very nice and friendly host. We could definitly recommend this place.
If you stay there try "choice" (bakery/take away on the corner) for breakfast!!

Waldemar, the host, will help you with everything and he will make you feel like you're at your own home.
The room with TV is quite big and with lots of space for your stuff and the bed is very very comfortable. The bathroom, which is very clean, is very spacious with natural light from the windows and all the amenities you may need.
You also can have breakfasts outside on the terrace/garden.
Two subway stations will get you to Manhattan in a very short time (30 min) and a big groceries store just around the corner.
I totally recommend Waldemar's apartment and I definitely will repeat next time. Thanks Waldemar for everything

My stay at Waldemar's was a good experience. He was great about showing me how all the locks work, as well as the lights in the room before giving me total privacy. The house was really clean and my room itself was charming, quiet, the bed was really comfy. It was made clear that Waldemar is willing to go above and beyond to make sure his guests feel accommodated.
The listing description was accurate.  The bedroom and en suite were spacious and the area was very convenient to restaurant, grocery and coffee shops.

Everything was perfect! The room is exactly as on the photo! It is very spacious. The private bathroom was very nice too.
The room is very quiet et the bed is very confortable.
Waldemard is very friendly and the cat too!
The house is close to G train and C train which is very convenient to go to Manhatan.

This house (brownstone) is located in a terrific neighborhood in Brooklyn.  The room is in the back of the house and is very quiet.  I could not hear any street noise.  The bathroom is clean and modern and is stocked with plenty of cleaning products for use at the two sinks and in the shower/tub.  There are lots of towels.  There is a small deck in the back allowing me to sit outside and the door to the deck provides good ventilation.  The wireless reception is perfect allowing for streaming movies, checking email, watching live football games and etc.  The queen size bed is comfortable.  My overall expeience was very positive.
Waldemar is a really nice host, the room is (as you can see on the pics) lovely and the area is relaxed. So the perfect homebase for discovering NYC!
Waldemar is a great host. The room description and pictures are 100% accurate. Our stay was very comfortable. I would repeate and recommend this place to others.

This was a repeat stay with Waldemar (first was in March this year).  However, my first to stay in the Room with En Suite Bathroom!  What a beautiful room ... the private bath (although understandably more costly) was a worthy investment in my 2-night stay.  Waldemar is an excellent host!  He is warm, friendly and invites conversation ... but allows total privacy, if desired.  Staying with Waldemar twice now has provided me a sense of 'coming home' when I walk in the door.

The host was very cordial. He is very nice. The neighborhood seems safe.
Some kind of alarm kept going off at 6am, which was great for me because I am an early riser.
A heavy comforter is provided to compensate for the fact that the heat is limited.
There is plenty of room on the floor for your suitcase.
There is a wooden door with some drapes over it between you and the host's bedroom.
The host greets you cordially as you enter and leave through the living area.
Most of the towels and sheets smelled fresh.
Its a great place for a man to stay.

Waldemar was very attentive even before the trip. He made sure to know what time I was arriving and we kept in constant contact when my flight was delayed. He was not there when I arrived late but left a key available for me and I got in after figuring out the trick to the lock. A few minutes later, he arrived and gave me the layout of the house and showed me how everything worked.

The room was exactly as described. The bed was comfortable, the room was huge, and although the deck went unvisited, the light from the door was spectacular. I love the size of the bathroom. There were plenty of towels and plenty of hot water. It was also very private, which is exactly what I was looking for.

The room itself was shielded well from outside noise. The house is creaky but not overly loud, so it never bothered me as I slept.

The neighborhood is great and quiet. I was able to walk a few blocks in any direction and find great pizza, coffee, pub fare. There is a supermarket across the street. A few easily accessible subway stations and it was very easy to hail a cab.

I loved my stay. Particularly on the last day when I was exhausted. I stayed in bed all day and watched cable on the high quality tv and ordered delivery. It was quiet and relaxing and I ended my trip on the perfect note.

Any time I needed anything (which wasn't often), Waldemar was very quick to respond to a message. This is a great place to stay and I will be back!

Endroit plaisant, typique, spacieux, situé à proximité du métro, d'un supermarché, d'une super boulangerie où vous pouvez prendre un délicieux petit déjeuner.
Hôte sympathique et serviable, son chat est adorable.
Points négatifs:
-on pouvait entendre tout ce qu'il se passait dans la chambre d'à côté
- la propreté... le linge de lit et les serviettes de toilette sont propres, mais le sol dans la chambre et dans la salle de bains n'avait pas été nettoyé... (cheveux, poussières).
Je recommande l'endroit, mais ce point est à améliorer.

The loft was great and very spacious. Ali made us feel very welcome and there were lots of add little touches that made our stay very comfortable. I had my own laptop with me but Ali had a IMac which we could have used when booking cars, searching stuff etc. There was plenty of hot water for our group of 4. We thought the location was great right next to Chinatown and easy walk to closest metro station. Two things I would mention is the street is very busy and a bit noisy but we all had ear plugs so that fixed the problem and there are lots of stairs but we got a good workout while staying. Thank you again Ali!
The loft is amazing. We had a very nice stay in that place. Very well situated between east vullage, soho and little italy. Ali was very kind. Stongly recomended for a nice trip in NYC.
Spacious place near Italy town.  Great location!!

Ali was an excellent host! We would recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to visit NYC and stay in a great apartment in a fantastic location! Ali was so helpful and organised for us to pick up the key one day before our arrival so we could check in smoothly the night after!

Hope we can get the opportunity to stay at this amazing place again.

// Tictail

My family stayed in Ali's loft for our weekend in New York and had a wonderful experience. It's a gorgeous space and very convenient to SoHo, Nolita, Chinatown and (via the subway just around the corner), most of Manhattan.

Ali was a wonderful host. She went out of her way to accommodate our various arrival and departure schedules and saw that all of our needs were met. The kitchen is well stocked, there were all the facilities we needed for coffee and tea in the morning (important to us) and a built in water filter which we greatly appreciated.

The loft is nicely decorated, the shower is new with great water pressure (but realize there is only one bathroom so plan accordingly). As others have noted, the loft is on the fourth floor but well worth the effort of dragging our luggage up all those flights of stairs. We slept in the middle bedroom and it was quiet except for occasional sirens. We were not troubled by general street noise.

We would definitely stay there again and thank Ali for graciously opening her home for our use.
Cynthia is very warm and welcoming, she does all the best to make you feel at home and comfortable. Her flat is exactly like her and really close to NY main attractions. I had a very good time.

Good interface and made sure someone met us when we arrived.

Perfect for our trip close to the financial district.
Beautiful space, great energy, extremely well maintained, exactly as advertised. I had a fantastic stay at this property; very posh and relaxing. Looking forward to coming back soon! Thanks Ali!
Huge space with a lot of character. It's in the heart of Chinatown with so many restaurants and a short walk to Soho & Nolita. We had a wonderful stay! Ali is a great host!
Great loft - awesome location and cool vibe throughout. Ali was very helpful and accommodating. Could not have asked for a better experience. Thanks Ali!

Ali was a wonderful host and accommodated my family on very short notice.  She checked in during our stay to ensure that we had everything we needed for the stay.  The apartment is bright and spacious and in an ideal location if you are looking to stay in Soho, Nolita, Little Italy ...  Thanks, Ali.

The loft was beautiful and was perfect for a girls weekend getaway.  Prime location (you can go towards the west side (Soho/Nolita) or the east side (LES), amazing light and very spacious for the group!  Ali was quick to respond and made it a very easy and comfortable stay.  I would 100% recommend/stay there again!

The loft is amazing!
It is very clean, decorated with great taste, and contains everything you'll need. The computer, the printer and the wi-if were really helpful.
Everything is as you can see in the photos.
The location is perfect to visit NYC and the neighborhood is full of great restaurants and bars.
Ali was very nice and very comprehensive about our time at arrival and departure.
We were 7: 3 couples and a friend, and our stay was absolutely perfect!
I surely recommend this loft and will come again with great pleasure!

Place was clean and very well situated. Comfortably stayed there with a group of six.

Sound system was great, shower too. The mattresses a little too firm and there are lots of stairs to climb to get up to the apartment, was tough for the older guests - something to keep in mind if your staying here.

All in all we enjoyed our stay, thank you Ali!

Authentic Bowery Flat.  Had commercial feel with great design touches.  Kitchen and bath were great.  Plenty of room for us to lounge.  Ali was very responsive and accommodating.  Having lived in NYC before, we were not surprised by the traffic noise below, but it was an adjustment for the kids. Ali had white noise machines in the bedrooms for us.  If you want to expand your NYC visit into exploring Little Italy / China this could be a good fix.

We stay there for 10 days with 3 adults and 4 teenagers end of october 2015. If you plan a trip to visit NY this is the perfect place. Idealy located in a vibrant historic area, you can almost walk Manathan from there. A few minute from the flat you can cross walk the east river to join Brooklyn and Williamburg.
The apartment is very spacious and bright although the noise of the street are presents (but remember you are in NY and noise is every where). I would recommend earplug for a safer night.
Ali, the host, has been perfect to welcome us and came to solve a heating problem in a snap.
All in one, a 5 stars experience.

We had a great time. The location is perfect for exploring Manhattan on foot, very close to cool bars/restaurants and lots of sights, or the subway if you need to get up town.

The apartment itself is large and funkily appointed. The beds are comfy. Good kitchen and very nice bathroom.

There's even a view of the empire state out of the window up Bowery.

The four flights of stairs are not a problem (it's a loft), but might not be to everyone's taste, especially anyone with mobility issues.

We were allowed to leave luggage at the apartment until our flight in the evening which was v handy.

My family of 6 stayed at Ali's place for Thanksgiving and we had an amazing time. Ali's place is beautiful and comfortable, and the location doesn't get much better. My family has already talked about wanting to stay there again one day. Overall, a great experience—easy check in/out and Ali was extremely responsive and helpful with everything we needed.

We had a great stay at the apartment, very spacious and Ali was a very attentive host. The apartment is in a great location on the edges of Chinatown/little Italy/LES with easy walking location to many places. Would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone for a stay in a great neighbourhood of Manhattan.

We stayed for 5 nights and had an absolute blast. The apartment is very very cool and made the whole NYC experience that much better. A classic NYC loft in a great location. Clean, well appointed and large. Ali - thanks for making your home available to us. Jim

When we arrove in his home, he was still waiting vor us. It was already 1.30 am. He showed us the room which was almost as i was described. The bath and the little space outside were so nice.
The other morning he was waiting for us to give us the key and explained everything. During our stay Waldemar was always at home, helping us with everything and being very friendly. Not to forget that his cat is very cute.
The neighborhood was really nice. A supermarket and the metro were right around the corner.
The only thing we have mention negatively is that Waldemar has other rooms for guest. We went there on New Years Eve and there were peolpe in everey room. We could hear every single word the guests in the room right next to us said.
All in all we had a very nice stay :)

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Waldemar's. He is a cheerful, helpful host. The upstairs room where I stayed is spacious yet cozy. The location of Waldemar's home is extremely convenient: 1/2 block from a grocery store and a coffee cafe/bakery; one block from Pratt Institute and the G subway line; 0.8 miles from BAM (Brooklyn Academy of Music). I walked to all of these localities, enjoying the lively vibe of the neighborhoods. During my winter stay, the water pipes to my private bathroom froze due to prolonged sub-freezing temperatures. However, I was able to use a bathroom shared by other Airbnb guests on the ground level.

I've been in Waldemars room for only two days but it looks nice enough.
The room is exactly like the pictures.
