If you are looking for a good place to sleep and know the city by day, this is perfect. Subway G line at 1 block.

Waldemar was very accommodating! This room is great if you're going to be running around all day and need a nice, quiet and spacious room to stay in. In all honesty, the bathroom was a little chilly and the shower is made for someone just a touch shorter than 5'8" but overall I had a good experience and Waldemar is a wonderful host!

Waldemar was a fine host.  He was quick returning texts, and left behind a key when I informed him I was running late.  And when I had issues manipulating the gate he made a special trip back home to help/let me in.  Nice guy, up for a chat, or not if you're not.  The place was great, as pictured.  Comfortable bed, cool bathroom.  Neighborhood was convenient to Manhattan, with all things useful -metro,grocery, bakery- a block away.  Will consider another stay next time I'm in town.
Waldemar was cozy, kind, and spacious, loved my stay.
Accueil Ok sans plus. Hôte peu locace. logement spacieux et confortable. En même temps c'était poussiéreux et semblait entretenu un minimum. Notre expérience est mitigée.

Nothing more I could ask for. Large room with own bathroom, nice comfy bed, close to all the trains and awesome coffee shops and restaurants around the corner. Waldemar's been a great host and would always choose to stay here again. Thanks again for staying up late for my late night arrival!

Great place, quiet and convenient location. Waldemar is a nice, laid back host and has everything set up very comfortably. He is a seasoned resident ho can offer any advice to the area you need.

Would recommend to anyone who needs to stay in the area.

Very fast replies to my emails before arrival.
Room exactly as shown.
Easy to move around, but far from Manhattan, unless you want to spend the whole day out and use your room just to sleep.

Another very satisfactory stay at Waldemar's place.  Waldemar is most accommodating... great conversationalist with wealth of life experiences.  The room is one of my all-time favorites from Airbnb stays... impeccably clean, thoughtfully furnished ... it's like going/coming home.

The room is huge and beautiful. Waldemar was so sweet and welcoming; helpful to point out directions, flexible and available upon our unplanned late arrival, and a great in conversation. Highly recommended!

I stayed here for a work trip, so was just looking for a quiet and comfortable place to crash after long days. The neighborhood was nice and accessible to Manhattan and other parts of Brooklyn, and the room was clean and looked as pictured. However, I would not stay here again. On two weeknights, Waldemar had loud friends over — one night they were really loud until 5AM. As a result, I found it very difficult to actually sleep or feel any sense of relaxation. It may have just been the host's unfortunate timing or a carelessness, but staying here made me feel uncomfortable, frustrated, and very, very tired!

For my visit to NYC I wanted to find a place in Brooklyn, I have previously stayed in Manhattan in the past. Waldemar's flat apartment was perfect and also offers quaint furniture and fitting and a very quiet location (I could not hear the normal night hum of a city with police sirens etc.) within easy reach of the main MTA system, being only a short walk couple of blocks away at Clinton & Washington Aveson the G train. Waldemar was fully responsive to my needs and was the perfect host for my short stay with him.
Everything was perfect! Very good location!
Very welcoming host.  Room exactly as described and delightful.  Really interesting neighbourhood with excellent public transport links across the city.  Highly recommended!
My experience had good and not-so-good elements.
Stayed for the third time at Waldemar's place and enjoyed it as much as the other times. I'll def come back!
Great Owner, very welcoming. Great location, walking distance from the metro, restaurants and the Pratt Institute.  Decent value for money so close to Manhattan.
The listing was as described and the neighborhood was great!!

Very positive experience. Our host was friendly and hospitable. The room was clean and spacious. I especially liked the small deck off of the room, a plus in NYC. Ample bathroom with two sinks. Easy access to subway and a wonderful cafe a block away - Choice Market. I had a nice experience.

The room is beautiful, there are two others in the house, this room has a balcony and ensuite which I really enjoyed.  The host was friendly and even though I was hardly there, he was available at all hours.  Travelling on my own it was nice to come back to a house with other people in it.

Waldemar was most relaxed and welcoming; he seemed very unfazed and understanding when travel problems meant later than anticipated arrivals.  Carried my luggage upstairs to this charming room which was cool and comfortable.  As it was so hot, I did not avail myself of the little outdoor space, but it was pleasant to have the door open to the balcony allowing sunlight in. Having an en suite bathroom was definitely a plus; a relaxing place to shower and tidy up at the end of each day.  Neighborhood is great - a terrific 24hr. supermarket and an excellent coffee shop right on the doorstep; I chatted with people in both - very friendly.

Waldemar was a wonderful host who is concerned about giving visitors their privacy. We actually became friendly and had some nice conversations.  The room is spacious and comfortable, complete with a small terrace and all conveniences such as wireless Internet and cable TV.  I slept very well. The apartment is welcoming and in a typical Brooklyn neighborhood with good restaurants within a couple of blocks. I particularly liked Madiba - a famous South African restaurant only 2 blocks away. Brooklyn Flea (market), a new New York institution and a must-do activity on Saturdays with lots of local vendors and food options, is also only 2 blocks away in a different direction.  You can easily spend a lot of time around the apartment getting a New York experience without going to Manhattan. And yet, Manhattan was a short subway ride away from a station just a few feet away from the apt. I will definitely return.
Great experience. Great location and host was very nice. Will stay here again next time.
very nice, very relaxed host (although I didnt read his instructions how to get there, which you should do :)) nice food right next door complemented the stay

First time not staying in a hotel in NYC and only 3rd time in the city. The listing was accurate. The neighborhood was nice. The on the street parking was challenging! The room was clean close to a subway stop so once we got parked, we did not drive again until we left. The host was helpful and unobtrusive. My son's first trip to the city! Great base and great value!
Great place to stay in Brooklyn.  Waldemar was welcoming and flexible.  Excellent location and great value!

Waldemar was very welcoming and friendly. I arrived much later than scheduled, but he didn't mind at all and was extremely helpful.

The room is great, and the listing is 100% accurate. Shower bathroom works really well too. It's in a nice neighbourhood, with good access into the city.
This room is very nice

This was the first Air BNB I've stayed in. I am from Nebraska so I traveled pretty far to be in NYC in a completely different atmosphere. It was a great stay at Waldemor's place. I felt like I was at home with the atmosphere he provided. My favorite part was the nice bathroom! It is very close to the subway and he is more than happy to help you find your way around. I will definitely stay here again if I am ever in the city!

We had a great experience staying here. Waldemar was extremely prompt in responding to our questions and was gracious about allowing us to store our luggage at his place several hours before our check in. The room was exactly as described and we enjoyed drinking our morning coffee on the balcony off the room. Close to public transportation and many great restaurants.
Waldemar provided plenty of helpful information and had the room and key ready. All went well!
nice

Cynthia was a fantastic host.  Her place was cozy and meticulously clean.  It was also beautifully and artistically decorated in Cynthia's own personal style.  In many ways i thought the place was a work of art in itself.  The bed was also very comfortable.  Cynthia went out of her way to be both a helpful and welcoming host and she cooked some fantastic and healthy meals. The area is also great for shopping and food.  My stay at Cynthia's was a very pleasant, comfortable and enjoyable experience.

Cynthia's apartment was absolutely beautiful. It is definitely a work of art and reminiscient of a life-size doll's house. It is in a lovely, quiet location, and just one block from the 6 train an buses, which take you pretty much anywhere you want to go. I stayed here with 5 other girls and although there was a good amount of space, it got messy very quickly, so I would definitely recommend a smaller group. Especially because Cynthia likes to keep the place meticulous at all times - and rightly so! She was a very good host and kind enough to show us around the neighbourhood on our arrival. Staying here definitely enhanced our fabulous NYC experience!

Cynthia was an amazing host- You will love her place, it is beautiful! She made us a delicious, healthy breakfast. She was helpful and went out of her way to help us find great things to do while we were there. Good neighborhood, we felt safe walking back at 2am. We would love to stay with Cynthia again...fantastic experience.
Cynthia was very friendly and helpful. Her place is beautiful and very clean. Easy to get to and a good neighborhood. I would absolutely stay there again.

Waldemar is a really great host. He was there when I got there and was very professional. I liked his place, and its location. It had a cosy charm to it and was just two blocks from the subway station and four blocks from a street with a number of restaurants/grocery etc. Waldemar was extremely courteous and friendly and gave me all the tips about where to eat etc. He arranged for a car to take me to JFK on my last day and everything went really smoothly. I will stay there again.
Great experience. Waldemar was a good host, and knowledgeable about the area. Room was beautiful, along with the bathroom and backyard.
A large room with your own private bathroom and deck overlooking the backyard in a pleasant and quiet Brooklyn neighborhood. The subway is only a short walk away and Waldemar was a friendly host.
Parfait, et beaucoup de plaisir de revoir Waldemar.

Waldemar and the room were both great! I arrived a bit late due to a late train and he left me a key and gave me some advice through AirBnb messaging very promptly. He made me feel welcome and always chatted with me when I came back in from a long day of exploring. He gave good tips on how to navigate the city and helped calm my nerves about heading out by myself at night!

He has a few other people staying with him through AirBnb and they were all friendly as well, though we only saw each other in passing. They were all quiet and I barely noticed they were there at all unless I saw them.

The room was a gem, the bed was comfortable and it has a TV with cable. The bathroom was well maintained and the little patio out back was nice.

The neighborhood was great, down the street is Dough, which is a great donut spot that anyone visiting should check out. There's also a few coffee shops and food places. Luigi's pizza is great NY style pizza that I had multiple times here!

I loved this space and when I come back to NYC I would love to stay here again. Unless I decide to just move there!

Oh yeah! If you decide to stay here say hi to Kitty for me! Waldemar's awesome cat who just chills out downstairs and is very much a people cat :)

The room came as advertised.  Very spacious, plenty of hot water, access to a beautiful backyard.  WiFi was very fast and easy to connect to.  Waldemar is very knowledgeable about the neighborhood and was able to advise me on trains, coffee shops, pubs, etc.  He's also very friendly and accommodating.
Amazing, comfortable and private room. Looks exactly like the pictures. Very welcoming and helpful host. Would highly recommend this room

Waldemar is a great host. Really helpful and responded to my messages super fast. The room is old world gorgeous with an incredibly comfortable bed and luxurious en suite. The area has a lot to offer - the house is 2 mins walk from a really gorgeous café , 5 mins walk either way to 2 subway stations (about 20 mins to get downtown) and numerous bus lines. I highly recommend staying here.

Great place. Walden are was a gracious host, helpful and knowledgable about the city.
Beautiful room - very Parisian - comfortable bed and very modern bath. The neighbourhood is very interesting and "Choice", a super bistro, is half a block away. Close to the subway with access to all of New York City. Book now!
Lovely flat and room with super fast Wi-Fi! Close to subway and good cafe nearby. Thank you Valdamar.

I arrived a bit earlier than anticipated, but Waldemar was still very friendly when I arrived. He carried my luggage upstairs to my room, and showed me in detail how the lights all worked, how the porch door locked, etc. The room is IDENTICAL to how it was advertised. The porch off the back is very cozy, and has a table and chairs, and a wall light for night use. The private bath was just lovely; had plenty of hot water for a wonderful rain shower. Actually, the host was very exact when he said he is right around the corner from PRATT Architecture building, which is what I wanted to be close to.
Also, as I am on a budget, I cooked dinner one night in the great gourmet kitchen for my daughter and friend.
Sorry Waldemar was feeling a little sick and could not enjoy my wine and dinner.
It is located very central in Brooklyn, close to subway lines, coffee shops, and not too far from downtown Brooklyn. I will try to book with Waldemar on my next Brooklyn visit!
Was again a very nice experience staying at Waldemar! Felt like I came home. Will be back shortly....
I arrive before he was ready, so he took my baggage.

I had the most wonderful experience staying with Waldemar. He was a kind and comforting host and was so patient with my questions.  He carried my bags for me and showed me all the little details - lighting, wifi, locks, etc. The room was exactly as pictures/described. I had everything I needed. Clean, welcoming and relaxing. The neighborhood was charming and the two nearby coffee shops were delightful. This was also a perfect location for cheering on and viewing the marathon!!
Yes, the spot was perfect, private and rookie. Get access to MTA and the corner coffee shop, bakery, food options spot was great for meals. I would stay again.

Ali was great, with no problems
Area is really chinatown but very close to little italy and soho
appartment was really cool, much better than even the photos
There are a lot of stairs though so it may not suit an old/infirm person.
Overall a great apartment and a great host
merci beaucoup!!

Dealing with Ali was fantastic from start to finish. She was really helpful and quick to reply to our questions. The apartment itself is absolutely wonderful and had everything we needed even down to shampoo and conditioner! Ali also kindly accommodated a late checkout which was very useful. We're very sad to be home again!!

10/10
Flat and location perfect. We were three colleagues staying for 2 weeks, everything was so tidy, and personally i fell for the interior designs of the flat as well. Ali was available for any questions and was always so super friendly when we contacted him. Yup, 10/10. :)

The loft was unique, spacious, clean and very well equipped for our stay, with easy access to public transportation. In addition to this, Ali was really pleasant and easy to approach person. Recommended!
We absolutely loved our stay at Ali's!  Great location, exactly as pictured, clean and perfect.  Ali was very responsive and helpful throughout our trip! I would stay again, and highly recommend.

Fantastic weekend in NY with my husband, two daughters and significant others.   A perfect NY weekend, wonderfully central location, interesting neighborhood and attentive host.  It is a walk up, so a little hard on aging knees, but would recommend it highly!

Ali's flat is beautiful, spacious and immaculately furnished. I had an excellent stay for a few nights with two colleagues for a work trip. Ali was helpful and responsive to any queries.

After leaving, we had a minor misunderstanding as she thought we'd broken the house rules by smoking inside (which we hadn't), which was alarming. But we had a phone call which I hope cleared things up.

Ali kindly accommodated us at short notice due to the late cancellation of our booking by another host. Ali couldn't have been more helpful and was a delight to communicate with.

Ali's place is absolutely beautiful, the loft is spacious, artfully decorated and a perfect home away from home.

The location is perfect for exploring New York and close to great restaurants and bars. I highly recommend staying at Ali's!!

We enjoyed our time in Ali's loft!
Unfortunately Ali was out of town so we did not get a chance to meet her but she was very accommodating and let us check in early and check out late to work with our flight arrival and departures, which was very helpful!
Julia her cleaning lady was finishing up when we got there and kindly showed us around before she left. The loft was clean, sunny and comfortable — but also a fourth floor walk up! Because going up and down the 90 (!!) steep stairs was really tiring for us, we did not spend much time at the loft. Instead of using the space is a place to chill between activities we instead stayed out all day and really only used the loft for sleeping.
We never got a chance to cook or use the kitchen, which did seem well equipped and stocked.The loft was relatively quiet except for a guy that shows up early in the morning and sits on the corner of Grand and the Bowery, playing some sort of the screeching, loud violin. We got ear plugs after the first night and the rest of the time we slept perfectly.
We’d recommend Ali’s place to anyone willing to overlook it’s quirks (violin guy and lots and lots of steps) in favor of its many good qualities.

AMAZING!

Served all our needs and Ali was wonderfully helpful, answering all of our questions with immediacy and zero annoyance.

Would suggest everyone to stay at her dope pad!
The apartment is stunning and in the best location in the city!

Fantastic week at Ali's flat.
Excellent host in communicating with me, replying quickly to all my questions. During the week, it started to get very cold and I couldn't put the heater on. We managed to Facetime so she could explain how to get it to work.
We all loved the flat. Great location, typical New York vibe.
Flat had everything you needed and more. We really felt at home!
It was really a perfect stay.

Awesome all round - location, finish, furnishings.

Ali was super responsive and so easy to communicate with - and has an amazing selection of books!

Our host was excellent at communicating - reaching out to ask about our arrival time and checking-in after we arrived to make sure we'd settled.  The loft is truly extraordinary.  Lots of stairs but the payoff is high ceilings and beautiful light throughout the day.  There's space the eat in the kitchen, gather with family around the dining room table, sit together around a huge semi-circular couch...there's no place in the ample apartment that feels cramped.  Like no other NYC apartment I've known! The shower is even luxurious.  Innovative design details everywhere and the ideal location made this place perfect for me and my family of picky architects.

What can I say about Cynthia?
We stayed at her apartment for 3 nights & it was fantastic. I booked it at very short notice and was slightly worried as I was travelling with my 11 year old daughter and hadn't been to NY for 20 years but I had nothing to worry about, Cynthia went out of her way to make sure we were comfortable and happy. She is the perfect hostess & we felt we were staying with family than renting a place.
The apartment is amazing & oozes style. The location is great with Central Park a few blocks away & the Subway round the corner. Thank you Cynthia it was a real pleasure to meet you & you made our NY experience a lot more pleasurable.
I wouldn't hesitate in recommending this apartment hope to return again soon! :)

This worked out just perfectly for our quick weekend in NYC. With free parking on the street and the train just a block away, we were able to get around quickly and easily, and Cynthia's place is gorgeous, clean, and comfortable. She's an artist whose stunning work is everywhere in the apartment, and we loved hearing about her work, too.

absolutely the best experience I've ever had at Airbnb. Cynthia's place is AMAZING... it's spacious, impeccably clean, peaceful and a one of a kind artistic space. She has remodeled the space and added her artistic touches to just about every square inch-- and it's done very well. Additionally, Cynthia is a great host and goes out of her way to make sure your stay is the best it can be. The physical location of the place is also superb; half a block away there are restaurants and a CVS, one block away is the subway, grocery store, and specialty produce store. The neighborhood is safe, beautiful and residential with a mix of really good shopping and restaurants a walk away; no need to take cabs. Do yourself a favor and book here, you will certainly enjoy your stay.

WE HAD A PERFFECT WEEK AT CYNTHIA'S PLACE. THE APARTAMENT IS REALLY CONFORTABLE, CLEAN, WITH EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO MADE A LIVING, AND IN A GREAT LOCATION: TWO MINUTES TO SUBWAY, GROCERIES, PHARMACY... AND ALSO A GOOD PRICE. EVERYTHING WAS PERFECTLY CLEAR WITH CYNTHIA, SHE'S REALLY NICE AND HELPFUL. I CAN'T UNDERSTAND THE COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE DEPOSIT, SHE INFORMED US ABOUT IT, AND HAD NO PROBLEM GETTIN IT BACK. THANKS CYNTHIA.

Let’s be honest. As a spoiled child who is partial to 1982 Château Margauxs and Nat Shermans, I enjoy the finer things in life. This usually means I stay at the Ritz Carlton and have grown accustomed to be waited on and cleaned up after.

With that said, this was my first time using AirBnB and to be honest I was absolutely hesitant about “sharing” a room. Fortunately, I stumbled upon Cynthia’s listing and I was instantly intrigued. First of all, Cynthia offers the fairest rate out of all the Upper East Manhatten listings. Other people wanted to charge me twice or triple the amount for run down studios that I could have by myself or maybe share the place with a few cockroaches. Secondly, Cynthia’s apartment is akin to spending a few nights in a Lautner home. She has meticulously designed the bathrooms and the bedrooms so that you are constantly reminded that you are living in a piece of artwork. Finally, Cynthia was a fantastic and attentive host. She knows the city well and was constantly making sure that I was comfortable. (LA people beware: she thinks that walking fifty blocks is normal) I know for certain that if I ever find myself in the city of blinding lights again, I will stay with Cynthia or at the very least invite her out to dinner so that I can dispel her opinions with mine.

When experiencing a city as special as NY, its important to experience the people that make the city so special.  Cynthia's home is, in my opinion, the epitome of the spirit of New York.  She puts the same thought and consideration that goes into every piece of her artwork, into every space in her home, combining art and comfort, something that takes a lot of insight to create.  She is also so full of energy and life, so positive, which adds to the excitement of being in New York!  The location is perfect, a block from the 6 train, close to great shopping and restaurants.  She's very accommodating and easy going, a perfect host!  Thank you for everything, Cynthia!  I will be seeing you soon ;-)

Fantastic apartment! We traveled as a group of 5 women on a special getaway and we were so pleased when we arrived at Ali's homely apartment. It's in a great location for exploring Downtown with so many bars, cafes, restaurants and boutiques in walking distance and is also close to a number of subways to take you to all the sights. It was very warm on our stay and the air conditioners were all needed, the loft bedroom did get stuffy at times as it only had a fan. Ali was out of town during our stay but regularly touched base to see that all was going smoothly. Julia the housekeeper was also great who greeted us and also came to our rescue when a minor incident occurred. I would definitely recommend this apartment but do remember it is a walk up so there are many stairs. Don't hesitate you'll love this NYC loft.

The apartment is stunning, clean and in the best location in the city!
Ali is excellent at communicating - reaching out to ask about our arrival time and checking-in after we arrived to make sure we'd settled.
We absolutely loved our stay at Ali's!
房子的装修风格非常独特时尚，很宽敞，非常适合几个朋友一起居住。Ali对房子的装饰很用心，每个小细节都让人惊叹。浴室很棒，漂亮又明亮，热水也很稳定。房子的位置非常便利，离地铁站很近，周围临近小意大利，中国城和soho，逛街吃饭的地方很多。但是房子因为是loft，所以在顶楼，楼梯很长坡度很高，可能比较不适合年纪大的人攀爬，除此之外一切都很棒。

Ali has a wonderful loft apartment and it was an absolute pleasure to stay in this AirBNB. It made our stay in NYC so authentic and all our New York friends were jealous of our massive loft apartment right on the Bowery. The location is perfect, next to Lolita, Soho and the Lower East Side. This area of New York is becoming the hot place to stay and spending time in the area proved correct. The loft is huge and we loved every moment in the place. The little touches like mirror balls and large party sound system were a nice touch and reminded me of a rock stars house. You will love staying here. Its amazing.

We had a great stay in Ali's loft apartment. We were there for 2 weeks and found the apartment to be spacious, comfortable for our family of 5 and clean, a perfect retreat form the busy city streets. We really enjoyed the location as was so close to great cafes, restaurants and shopping in Soho, Nolita and Lower East side. There was only a small problem with the fridge breaking down during our stay, but Ali did her best to resolve this as quickly as she could.

Ali was an excellent host. She was very easy to get a hold of throughout our stay. The apartment was beautiful, spacious and very clean. The location was very convenient and close to restaurants and shops. We had a lovely stay and highly recommend this loft!
Ali was very accommodating to our needs.  Great space and great host.

Great, great spot overall - location, amenities, space, etc.  The place was very clean upon our arrival.   And, Ali was easy to communicate with and flexible with our travel schedule that was disrupted on the front and back end by some flight cancellations/reschedules.
All was great! Everything worked perfectly

The place was fantastic, a really great space, plenty of room for our group of 6, and close to a lot of tasty spots to eat and drink.  Ali was super responsive, incredibly helpful and welcoming.  We would definitely go back if we had the chance.

Very cool apmnt in a cool, centrally located neighborhood.  Alicia was out of the country while we were there but very accommodating.  The apartment has great light and was perfect for a large group of friends traveling together. So nice to be in a home vs a hotel.

Alicia has created a wonderful, artistically pleasing and comfortable living space in lower Manhattan. Our family enjoyed the convenience of the location and the warmth of the loft. Alicia is a great person to work with and is very helpful in making the stay painless! 5 Stars all the way!

This apartment is amazing - it's the NY loft made of dreams - extremely spacious, bright, spectacularly decorated, comfortable, and well laid out. But that's not all - it is fully stocked with everything you might need - and I mean everything. Alicia has not forgotten a single item or detail. Oh and the neighborhood is perfect - close to everything. We had a wonderful weekend, would go back again, am recommending to anyone who will listen!

Overall our stay here was really lovely! Alicia was great at communicating and made sure our check in was smooth (we met with her housekeeper). The apartment is beautiful and large - tons of space for a group of 8. TV area was comfortable and everything worked (TV, Netflix, stereo system, etc.). The kitchen had almost everything we needed, however the stove was old and we could not get it working and there was also no microwave we could find.
The neighborhood is right on the edge of china town (which isn't my favorite area). But it is walking distance to almost everything in the LES and super close to subway. The only big complaint we had is there was garbage left in the stairway of the apartment building which smelt horrible. But once in the apartment it was great. Love the décor! Rooms were large (3 total with space for additional blow up mattress). Renters should note that one of the beds is up in a little loft area - cute and comfortable but small space.
Overall I would definitely recommend this place! Thanks Alicia :)

Great neighborhood, great space, great host, perfect for a long weekend in NYC!  Waldemar is personable, engaging, available.  I visited my daughters and wanted a clean, comfy space with lots of room, private bath and a little outdoor space.  I got the perfect weekend, in a very enjoyable environment.  Close to subway and bike paths.

Waldemar was welcoming.  He communicates very effectively.  The room is spacious.  The room and the house generally has pleasing architectural detail.  The neighborhood is conveniently located.  The advertisement is accurate.  Thank you Waldemar for being a good host.
Large room with a nice bathroom and balcony. Charming. Good location.

Waldemar was very nice but could have communicated a little better with regards to renovation work , providing keys . The living room, dining space and kitchen were all unusable, not as described. The bedroom was untidy and the carpet was dirty.

This is a great place to stay.  What you see in the picture is exactly as it is.  The room is on the first floor, not the basement, and toward the back of the apartment with a private bath, so no street noise.  It is very clean, quiet and comfortable.  Less than a block from the subway, this is excellent, and Waldemar is a friendly and welcoming host. Highly recommended.  Thanks.

Waldemar was a very courteous host, and his home was an excellent place to stay. The room was exactly as described, spacious and clean. The location was perfect for us being only a block from the subway and 1/2 a block from a great little coffee shop/bistro. This was our first Airbnb experience, and it set the bar high for other places we will ever stay. Waldemar's home is really nice, and he was available to us at all times without being intrusive. A very friendly fellow to visit with. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting NYC.

Waldemar's place is really nice. This room feels very private and has a nice little outdoor space.And Waldemar was very accommodating and nice.I didn't quite know when I was going to arrive and he was very easy going about this. I love the neighbourhood. I feel very relaxed there and I love the diversity.

I loved staying at Waldemar's house! Not only was it a lovely room, and very convenient to everything, but also Waldemar was so welcoming and accommodating--and happens to be a terrific guy to have a cup of coffee with. Thanks for the great conversations, Waldemar! I'll be back!!

Waldemar welcomed us warmly and showed us to the room. The suite seemed as expected, providing us with the necessities we needed for our extended weekend in NYC. The neighborhood was in a great location, within walking distance to the subway and accessible to some of the great Brooklyn neighborhoods.

The actual space was doable, but we found the room to be poorly insulated from surrounding rooms and neighbors. The adjoining room in particular was quite loud and noises seemed to amplify which didn't lend to a great sense of privacy. The bathroom was okay, clean enough but could have used a bit more cleaning (there was a dead bug on the windowsill and quite a bit of dust and dirt). Windows on the door to the hallway didn't do a great job of keeping light out so when other guests were up and about the hallway light made it difficult to relax completely.

As a last note we weren't supplied with keys to our actual bedroom and only had a sliding lock available to shut the door while we were in the bedroom. I personally prefer the ability to lock the door even when we are out of the room.

All in all, a solid place to stay if you plan on using the space as a place to crash and are a heavy sleeper and aren't expecting hotel-level quality.

Waldemar was so pleasant, and a great host.
Nice, clean place to lay your head. Great neighborhood. Would recommend to all my friends when visiting NYC!

I reserved this room very last minute, like a few hours prior, and the host was very responsive and accommodating. I was also able to reach him very easily via phone and within the unit itself once I got there . We didn't really communicate much via email. The place was as described as far as set up and amenities, clean and adequate. Lots of natural light. There are a few other guest units in the same dwelling as well and sound does transfer between rooms. Off course this is not a hotel,  but a residential unit, so I guess that is to be expected, except if you are a bit more sensitive than most other people in this regard. I found however that I was able to get satisfactory rest while in the space. The place is also very close to the subway, and I felt comfortable in the neighborhood. Although I did not find that there were too many eateries and amenities nearby, mainly residential, and generally quiet. It is however, a very good starting point to explore Manhattan and Brooklyn itself.
I had a completely wonderful stay. The sunny room with the deck was beautiful. Thank you for accommodating me and my coming and going throughout the days!
The room was lovely, just as it is in the picture, and Waldemar was very nice. I would definitely stay here again if I'm ever back in Brooklyn!
Staying at Waldemars was great! nice room, good location and very nice host.

A very pleasant stay with a gracious host. Waldemar was very accomodative and helpful and made my stay very pleasant. The room was clean and the house is close to the subway with easy access to the city.

If you are looking for an awesome room with a great location in Brooklyn, then I recommend you stay here! About two blocks from the G train which can pretty much take you anywhere in Brooklyn and 10 minute walk to the A C trains which take you right into the heart of Manhattan (and get you home when you're drunk with no phone at 5 am ha). Waldemar is nice and very responsive. I had an early flight and had to leave at 330 am and he had no problem with it. Glad I stayed here.

Very friendly, clean. Provided wifi. The room was great, a extremely small deck/platform to walk out if you wanted to have a smoke or get out of the room. Had Verizon Fios with HBO. Wifi was great. Heat only goes up to 67 if that bothers you. Great host, would stay again.

I had a great experience. Waldemar was an exceptional host. He was engaged, friendly, and offered suggestions on local dining. The room was spacious and the private bathroom was very convenient. It was a great way to experience the Clinton Hill area of Brooklyn.
place looked same as pictures, host was warm and welcoming.

Waldemar was a great host, easily approachable and available when required. Room was great and the house situated in an ideal location for me to meet up with my daughter. Subway 2 minutes away. As with most apartments, can be noisy if you are not used to it.

Waldemar was friendly and welcoming. The location could not have been better, just a short walk to the subway. The neighborhood is charming and has many options for eating out or picking up whatever you need (and forgot to pack).

The location was fantastic, only a few minutes from the subway and it was not a long ride to Manhattan....the room and bathroom were clean and in great condition...I had my privacy and enjoyed the cable in the room. The host was also very quick to respond to any questions I had which was great

I had an enjoyable stay at Waldemar's apartment in Brooklyn. The room is large with a small balcony overlooking the backyards, a modern private bathroom, and a TV with lots of channels. I was greeted by Kitty, the friendly house cat on arrival. It's only 2 blocks from the subway and a good, affordable choice for exploring Brooklyn or Manhattan.

Great place. Calm, quiet neighborhood with good transit connections. Nice places to eat right around the corner.

The room was exactly as advertised, and the friendly cat was a nice perk.

It's been my fifth or sixth time at Waldemar and it was as great as ever. He makes me always feel like I'm home!
Will be back in october

i will make it short
the place is not what is seems
poor maintenance
thin walls,we could hear the neighbor snowring all night long
if you want privacy this is not the place for you.we chose this apartment because of its price...well nothing come cheap
Waldemar is really friendly and welcoming. I booked his room for my dad and grandma, they all love this place. The room has its own bathroom and little outdoor balcony that is really lovely.
Waldemar was great! Everything was ready and as promised.
Wonderful place and host! Just like I expected! Hope to stay here again sometime!
Waldemar is really nice and helpful! I enjoyed my stay in his place and the location is great. Kitty is also quite lovely.
Lovely, clean, comfortable, fast WiFi, great location. Would stay again.
The room as just as depicted in the pictures. Lovely home, very clean, and close to transportation and cute cafe's. Waldamar was very responsive and friendly. I enjoyed my stay.
Lovely place! Fabulous value and adorable cat. Everything is as described. Wish I could have stayed longer!
I enjoyed my stay. Great location, close to transportation, clean, room as described and fast wifi.

Staying with Cynthia MADE our trip to New York City. Her house is AMAZING. She is AMAZING. And we had the most memorable time thanks to her. First of all, Cynthia's house is a work of art. All the rooms have the 'Cynthia' stamp. Waking up each morning in the beautiful rooms with the exposed brick walls, layers of velvet and contempory artwork masterpieces made us, my mother and I, feel like we were in a dream. The beds are oh so comfortable and Cynthia goes out of her way to make you feel right at home. Everything is meticulously clean and the bathroom is devine! Studying the carefully handcrafted mosaic mirror bathroom you will appreciate all the attention and love she has put into the apartment. I will miss her yummy healthy breakfasts and her warm smile. She is the best tour guide and shared with us the best places to eat, drink and shop like a local. I hope to only stay at Cynthia's when I am in New York City-my time with her was that enjoyable!!! Three days after leaving Cynthia's and I already am missing it!!

Great Room! Cozy and quite private. Right by the subway and convenient to walk to different coffee shops in the neighborhood. Didn't utilize the common space downstairs too much, but room with bathroom attached was great!

Although host's communication style is terse, it was still effective. It was fortunate that I ran into Waldemar when I arrived, because the key wasn't where we agreed upon, and I had difficulty opening the front gate. Otherwise, the room was as expected. I didn't utilize the common area, so can't comment there.

Waldemar was easy to communicate with and welcoming. The room was exactly as described. The location couldn't have been better for my purposes. Kitty was so sweet and greeted me each time I came and went.

I only stayed for two nights, but this is a lovely room in a brownstone building in a nice neighborhood. Waldemar was very accommodating with my check-in time, which I greatly appreciated. It is also really nice to have a room with a private bathroom. If I had stayed longer, I would probably have sat outside on the cute little deck.

Our stay was very weird. No communication and never saw the host until we were leaving. Every question I asked after he told us where the key was was completely ignored until I got a text the day of check out reminding me the time we needed to leave. Check out was at 12 and I asked for 15-20 extra minutes at 11:30 and he said I already had that amount to leave. For the price, not worth it at all. The room was nice and it did have a back porch to hang out. The extra $40 per person a night fee was sneaky and ridiculous. If you come home late, the host may be passed out on the couch, or one of the two other bedrooms so you need to tip toe around to be a nice guest in his home. I will say location was close to a metro and some good restaurants but we will never stay here again and will recommend our friends who frequently visit Brooklyn to avoid as well.

Nicely situated place. Quiet neighbourhood close to transport. Waldemar was very helpful, seems to pass through occasionally... very relaxed guy. Rooms are lived in but genuine Brooklyn. The room wasn't as bright as in the picture but I was mostly there in the evening! Would definitely stay again.
So smooth. No waiting upon arrival; privacy in a shared space; and great conversations. Stay here.
This place was great.  The bathroom was like something out of a dream.  And Waldemar was the perfect host - courteous and responsive but ultimately nonintrusive.  Five stars across the board.
Had a great stay! The room is large and very comfortable. It has everything you need plus a terrace! Waldemar was very kind and helpful!
It was great! Thanks again!

I found Waldemar to friendly and accommodating. He always seemed to be on hand and responded quickly to communications. At the same time he was low key enough to allow me to do my thing without fuss. I would certainly use him again.

Great location in a nice neighbourhood. Was a great base to have. Waldemar was really helpful. I'd definitely stay here again.

Kitty is a top cat!
Everything worked out well. The place was beautiful and clean, the bed was comfy and I slept like a rock. The host was professional. I felt safe there. Definitely recommend this room!

The space was great, near subway and Nice Ride bike stand.  Nice coffee shop on the corner, a short mile from the Brooklyn Museum and Botanical Garden.  Loved having my own bath and the deck was sweet.
Waldemar is friendly and welcoming. Our paths didn't cross too much given my schedule, and I wish we'd had more opportunity to talk. Next time!
Waldemar was very accessable and made sure to check in with me before my arrival. Everything about the stay was simple and easy...great room in a great area.

Waldemar was super helpful, friendly, and responsive. The room was as advertised, and the neighborhood has some great little gems for eating/drinking. The room is in the back of the house so there's not really even any street noise, which is an extra bonus.
Enjoyable stay. Lovely room. I definitely recommend.
Had a wonderful time in the neighborhood, very close to good delis and restaurants and was a very short ride away from Barclays. Would highly recommend!

The arrival process was incredibly smooth. We were able to meet with the friendly housekeeper to get a rundown of the property, neighborhood, house rules and checkout procedure. We were a group of 5 people total, and all of us were incredibly comfortable in the large space. The windows provide a fresh breeze and people watching during the day. At night you have a straight line of sight to the Empire State Building and all the lights of midtown.
The beds were all very comfortable, including the loft (where I stayed). I LOVE the shower in the bathroom! It gave me very serious bathroom envy.
I would absolutely recommend this for your stay, if you don't mind the part about no elevator to the top floor. Look at it this way - it'll help you work off the delicious food and drinks in the neighborhood bars and restaurants!

Great apartment, loads of space for four of us. Our style conscious teenagers loved it. The only drawbacks are the 130 stairs which are a bore at the end of the day (young kids or old people should probably not stay here), the street noise in the front bedroom (take earplugs) and very firm bed in the same room.
The immediate area is a bit scruffy but you're two minutes from Little Italy, LES, etc and the subway is super close, so it's not a problem.
The only other issue we had was the $50 charge for arriving in the evening which we felt was very steep. But overall would definitely recommend, for a larger party than ours.
Amazing location and apartment and Alicia was very helpful and accommodating, we had a fantastic stay.
A great unique place to stay. An incredible amount of space. Brand new bathroom and kitchen which is fully equipped. The owner is very helpful and always at hand if you have any questions.
Nice place for a group!

We had a wonderful experience in Alicia's loft. I spent a few days with my family (6adults) in her flat over Christmas and the apartment is a perfect place to go around the city. it's very well located, very comfy and trendy ! Communication was easy with Alicia before and during our stay.
We'll definitely rebook if we happen to be another time in NYC.
Thanks Alicia!

Idéalement placé, au carrefour de Soho, Little Italie, Chinatown. Boutiques pour les filles, resto pour le soir et à 100 mètres du métro!
Logement très agréable, bien équipé ( cuisine, ordinateur a dispo etc....) et bien chauffé dans lequel on se sent bien. Pas particulièrement bruyant car au 4eme étage (et je suis de la campagne donc je suis sensible au bruit).
Alicia très arrangeante quant aux horaires d'arrivée (22h) et de départ(19h), très réactive par sms ou mails si on a des questions.
Nous étions 7 (2 couples avec enfants) et avons été, grands et petits, super contents de retrouver notre loft le soir après une journée de visites.
Très agréable, pas seulement un endroit pour dormir. On y a passé de bonnes soirées et les enfants ont pu dormir tard le matin sans être réveillé par le bruit.
Ce qu'il faut savoir:
1) 4 étages d'escalier à monter. Personnellement, je ne suis pas sportive mais ça ne m'a pas posé de problème.
2) 1 seul salle de bain donc il faut s'organiser quand on est 7
Merci Alicia. J'y reviendrais!

Staying at Alicia's loft on Bowery was incredible. As an experience is great because you get to know soho, china town and little Italy like you were a local.

The loft is super comfy and for a party of four or for 3 couples it's great.

Impecable taste in decoration and all that you might need is in there.

If you go to NYC and want a bohemian chic experience, Alicia's loft on Bowery is the perfect place.
Alicia's loft is perfect. Would absolutely stay here again!

Alicia's loft was perfect! It is located in Chinatown with a short 2 minute walk up to Nolita where you can find trendy shops and restaurants like de maria and the butchers daughter. The space itself is so well decorated with an amazing living room (the photos say it all)! There are three separate rooms which was perfect for our group of 3. The kitchen itself was stocked with everything we needed. As in reviews before, there is no elevator which may cause you to be a bit winded once you reach the top, but trust me, its completely worth it! If you're looking for a beautifully decorated loft, centrally located, with a ton of space this is it!

Thank you Alicia for being a lovely host, extremely communicative and very accommodating!

Alicia's place was the quintessential cool loft for a recent trip I made to NYC with my two brothers. The space is laid out very well with big spacious rooms, high ceilings, and tons of character. Her style of decor using many antiques mixed with funky lighting went really well and set the vibe of hip New York. Lastly the location was really ideal for us. We walked everywhere from East Village, Noho, Soho, downtown, and the Bowery is the border of Chinatown and Little Italy.  Was perfect. Thanks Alicia!

I was in NYC for business with two colleagues and we stayed at Alicia's place. It was perfectly located, clean, spacious and a wonderful home away from home.
We even got extra excercise everyday climbing the stairs! We will be back!
The apartment is fantastic and very well located. I would recommend it to anywone. We had a great time at Alicia's.

I highly, highly recommend Alicia's place on the Bowery, right next to both Chinatown and Little Italy.

We (two of us) stayed there with two young children and were pleasantly surprised to find everything we ever could have needed (super comfortable beds, wonderful noise machines in each bedroom, coffee maker, well-equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, reliable internet, apple tv, a luxurious shower--even kids' cups and water bottles to go); nevertheless, it is a stylish, well-done space, perfect for the downtime one inevitably needs after pounding the NYC pavement.

You should know that there are 4 flights of stairs to contend with, but they are doable. Our kids took the challenge beautifully and it offset all of the eating we did at the ridiculous number of wonderful restaurants within a 30 min walking radius (Oiji, Momofuku's Noodle and Milk Bars, Superiority Burger, Pasquale Jones).

And, Alicia was a great host- with recommendations as needed and just the right amount of communication. Check in and out was remarkably easy.

In short, it's a really great find. Would stay there again without reservation.

Cynthia is just amazing. So helpfull, knows everything about NYC. A wonderful person. Staying with her is the best one can do. I love that girl.
Dennis

It was just like living in the city! Close to everything, nice, clean, comfy and safe.
The blue room isn't really that private because you share a window area with the red velvet room and a sheer curtain with the living room. The bathroom is amazing and a work of art but the door doesn't close all the way or lock. I had a restful experience there. Cynthia is the hostess with the mostest!
I had a fabulous stay with Cynthia. The house is a work of art in itself, and Cynthia was great company. The house is very near the subway so it's easy to get around. Don't hesitate to book!

Great area to stay in and very unique and artistic apartment.  Cynthia couldn't have been more kind to us.  We had the whole place to ourselves, but Cynthia was really helpful in recommending places to go, etc. When two of us found ourselves stranded in New York, Cynthia kindly offered to put us up, despite having another guest due. We didn't have to take her up on the offer, but we appreciated it very much.

My stay with Cynthia was fantastic and made the NYC experience all the richer. A warm and comfortable retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city. Cynthia is a generous host who provides a wealth of information and was great company. I could not recommend her and her apartment more highly.

Cynthia`s apartment is a work of art. The place it`s cool, cosy, and extremely clean, a 5 star bed and breakfast located in a good&safe neighborhood surrounded by subway and bus lines, restaurants, antiques, groceries, bank offices, post office, and all sort of shops you can imagine.


Besides all that (plus the fact that the Blue Room is fantastic), Cynthia herself should be considered a NYC must: her amazing company, joy of life and sense of humor will make your stay in NYC be anything less than remarkable (just like it was mine).

in other words: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

I have had the privilege of staying with Cynthia at 97th street for two weeks during my first visit to NYC.

It is no exaggeration to say that her home is by itself, a work of art. Every space is tastefully designed and furnished to combine aesthetic appeal with functionality. The blue room which I rented may appear rather small, but it has everything from a full length mirror, a closet, shelves, vanity top to a working space for the laptop! Cynthia also uses top quality sheets and linen which are extremely comfortable and clean.

Cynthia herself is a delight as a housemate and host. During my stay, I felt more like a longtime friend rather than a short term guest, not once did it feel like a commercial rental arrangement. Cynthia is warm, accomodating and generous, willing to involve you in her
day-to-day activities and events if you so wish. Everything is left as an open invitation, so you will not feel obliged if you already have other plans.

Would recommend to any of my friends without hesitation.

Good luck getting a reservation!
Cynthia  is a very gracious host, and the location is very convenient.

Cynthia is delightful, and her home is incredibly creative and filled with art and architectural innovations. We unfortunately came at an extremely hot August time, and there wasn't adequate air conditioning. We would highly recommend a visit at any other time of year. Note that Cynthia tried hard to accommodate us with a fan, but we ended up having to move the final night when there would be 4 of us.

Staying with Cynthia was a pleasure.

Her home is a work of art, spotless, beautiful and artistic.
Not only was the setting perfect but Cynthia's friendliness and helpfulness went above and beyond.
Nothing at all was too much trouble for her and she went beyond her role as host many times, I was apartment hunting during my stay and Cynthia asked her friends, looked online and did everything within her power to help me find somewhere.

A wonderful woman, you would be lucky to stay in her home.

Friendly and generous host. Convenient location for getting around NYC.  The apartment on E 97th is an artistic upgrade of a traditional NY apartment.  I think most people looking at this site would enjoy staying with Cynthia, and I certainly did.

Alicia's place is absolutely gorgeous and made for some pretty cool Instagram pictures. It's in a great location, and there were almost too many good nearby restaurants to choose from! Alicia herself was very sweet, easy to communicate with, and flexible. We hope to come back here someday!
Coole Gegend, sehr schöne Wohnung, hilfsbereite Gastgeberin, sehr zu empfehlen

Alicia's place is absolutely amazing, perfectly equiped and beautiful in every way./ The four floors stairway is tough for senior people or small kids.
Amazing experience though.
Close to the subway, fast wifi, great spot if you just plan on sleeping there.
Been at Waldemar for the 6th time I think. Cant wait for the 7th. He and his app are great! Thanks and see you soon
Our host made us feel very welcome and offered great advice on the neighbourhood. This is a great location and very good value. It is exactly as advertised. We will return!

This is my second time staying at Waldemar's, and as with the first time it was a lovely visit. This time we stayed in the 'Room with en suite Bathroom', and it was very comfortable, clean, etc. Waldemar is always responsive and warm and very welcoming. The neighborhood is very convenient for Brooklyn and Manhattan, pleasant to stroll around, & with a couple of excellent cafes nearby for working/chatting.

Great location and a large room! Waldemar was a great host and responded very quickly to any questions I had prior to our stay. We arrived early, and Waldemar let us store our bags so that we could walk around Clinton Hills while the room was being cleaned. Thanks for the great place to stay!
Cynthia is a delightful and helpful hostess.  Staying there is like inhabiting a work or art.  One block to subway makes location convenient.

There is no place like home and Cynthia is the best hostes I've ever know.
She is a friend, a companion and reminds you of the good things in life ;)
The apartament is beautiful and cozy and her greates masterpiece :)
Great sport, will recomend her anywhere in the world!!!

Obrigada!! :D

Cynthia's apartment is artistic and clean and she was a warm and welcoming host.  The room I stayed in was large and the bed comfortable.  The place was conveniently located near my family so that was a big plus for me. Sharing a bathroom turned out to be OK, but the design of the bathroom sink made it hard to use so I used the kitchen sink instead. All in all, it was a nice place to stay for a few nights.

Cynthia is an amazing host and her home a beautiful piece of art. I was really impressed with how spotlessly clean the place is. This is without a doubt the best place for the price in all of Manhattan...and nicer I'm sure than most places twice the price.

I spent 7 fantastic days here and felt at home from beginning to end. The apartment *is* a work of art - there is nothing like it which contributed to make it a unique vacation for me.
Cynthia is a great host and person.

I don't know if i can praise the experience enough. It is my first time using AIRBNB as well as staying at a bed and breakfast, but I would not stay at a hotel room for my vacation anymore. The apartment is a work of art, Cynthia is a wonderful host, and location awesome. Walking distance to central park and museums there and even shorter walk to the metro.

I had a wonderful time staying with Cynthia. Her home is truly a work of art and credit to her for the hard work and creativity she has been able to adopt to her amazing home. I enjoyed being a part of her developments for a short time and look forward to a return visit. Her warmth, kindness and positive enthusiasm to life was energising during my stay.

We had such a great stay at Alicia's loft! I didn't want to leave. The space itself is so beautiful, and in such a great location! Alicia was friendly, accommodating and easy to get in touch with. Her housekeeper Julia let us in and was lovely as well. There were so many details that made our stay even better- like good shampoo/conditioner/body wash in the bathroom and a hair dryer and straightener so I didn't have to pack them. A dressing room with an iron and ironing board, a great speaker system, good wifi, and things like olive oil, salt and pepper, and spices in the kitchen. I highly recommend this space and would definitely stay again!

This is a gorgeous apartment in a lively and convenient part of the city. The space is beautiful and it was fantastic for our family with two kids (6 and 11). The kids loved the loft space; we all loved the gorgeous living area with its great light. The renovated bathroom was also fantastic. The location was really convenient for us and is near tons of great restaurants and things to do. The kids loved having all the gelato in Little Italy so close! We had a fabulous brunch at the Clinton Street Baking Co, which was recommended by Alicia (and if you have kids, it isn't too hard to get there right when it opens at 9 and get a spot right away!). Definitely a great place to stay!
Very beautiful loft. We couldn't have wished for anything better. Great location as well.

Grosszügige Loft, voll ausgerüstet. Es ist wirklich alles vorhanden. Man fühlt sich sofort zu Hause. Sehr gute Lage.
Auch die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin problemlos. Sehr empfehlenswert. Die Treppe in den 4. Stock bringt etwas Fitness ins Programm. Würde jederzeit wieder kommen!
This is the best place for location and food! You have easy access to all of NYC and in the heart of China town. The place is very large and great facilities
Alicia's place is wonderful. All good, happy to stay at her place again in the future!

Loved this place for my family of 6! So spacious and comfortable. Everything was as described. Only thing to be aware of is the apartment is a 4th floor walk up. Other than that I couldn't think of any downsides here. Alicia was a wonderful host. Highly recommend!
Great place, great location, great host!

The aparment was in a great location and perfect for our group. We lucked out with the little italy festival going on very close by. The apartment has a very nice view, is well kept and has some nice extras too (all seasons of sex and the city!). Thanks very much alicia tot your hospitality.

Alicia was an exceptionally gracious and helpful host. I was coming to town for a food event and prepared most of it in her kitchen, which was well-equipped and organized. She was very helpful with directions and more. Her place looked just like the photos—so cool! I would love to stay there again.

Alicia's loft is amazing.
This place is spacious, super clean, and fully equiped.
I highly recommend

We had a great stay at Alicia’s flat with our 4 kids . It’s a real NY loft conversion very nicely decorated . You feel at home, it’s very well equipped, lots of storage, the bathroom is really nice. The flat was clean and tidy and the matressess quality was also very good.
The location in Chinatown is also perfect to explore the city, very close to the trendiest places and restaurants.The only drawback for us was the noise at night because of the location on Browery.
Apart from that we really loved it and Alicia was also very kind and flexible with check-in/out time

We selected Alicia’s loft for a special girls weekend and were very happy we did. It is a great space with plenty of room for everyone to have a little privacy combined with fun spaces to hang out and catch up. It was a perfect weekend!
Incredible space and extremely clean. Alicia was a wonderful host! We hope to stay here again.
Super appartement dans un quartier animé et central. La décoration est  sympa. La cuisine très bien équipée. Salon  cosy.  Bien chauffé en hiver. Très recommandable.

Alicia's space was as described and pictured. Loved the funky decor! Very comfortable beds! The space was just right for a holiday family get together for 6 - with everyone feeling comfortable.
The kitchen was well equipped and cozy - enjoyed having that morning cup of coffee with the family early birds! And the separate dining area was perfect for a big family sit-down dinner!
Alicia's location in Chinatown was fabulous! An easy walk to the subway. Great bagels close by! No problems getting out and about.
Alicia communicated well with us and responded promptly to questions we had about the space. I would not hesitate to stay with her on a future visit to NYC.
Thanks, Alicia, for a great Airbnb experience!

Absolutely stunning place, and a perfect host :)

Definitely recommend to anyone
Alicia’s place had such character and was so stylish! The living room was especially fun and we LOVED the floral sofa. For NYC, I️t was so spacious and easily accommodated our group for a weekend.
We had the best time at Alicia's place! The loft is beautiful and great for a girls weekend! The location is great, and Alicia was super easy to get in touch with and quick to respond.

Alicia's place is amazing! 6 of us girls stayed here for a weekend in NYC and it was exactly what we were looking for. Obviously this place is super stylish, but it also has everything you could need! We cooked breakfast on Saturday morning and it was so nice to be able to actually sit at a kitchen table in New York together :) Alicia was easy to get ahold of and although we didn't actually meet her, she was very nice. Her housekeeper was there to let us in and to show us around and she was very helpful. The location is perfect. Walking distance to all of the best neighborhoods (SoHo, Nolita, Chinatown, LES). Love this place and can't recommend it enough!

We just loved our time in Alicia's loft! The space is so well designed, and thoughtfully decorated. There is just a really great energy in the loft. It's spacious, with three full bedrooms, and a huge living area. The neighborhood is fun and there is so much nearby. Alicia was completely lovely to work with, and flexible and generous. We hope to stay again and highly recommend the apartment!

From beginning to end staying in this apartment was a delight. First, Alicia was incredibly accommodating with our arrival time. Second, when we got to the apartment it was exactly as described (possibly better!). Thoughtfully decorated, super spacious, and immaculate. Third, it was quieter than we anticipated and it was exciting for the kids we were with to stay in a real NYC apartment instead of a hotel. They LOVED the loft bed. Finally, the location is fantastic. For those hoping to spend time exploring downtown Manhattan by foot, you couldn’t find a better place. And when it’s time to head uptown to Broadway or elsewhere, it is well-serves by subway.

We would absolutely recommend Alicia’s place to anyone.
Alicia’s apartment is beautiful and in a brilliant location. Extremely well equipped apartment and with some handbook of helpful tips. We couldn’t have asked for more.
Great place for a girls weekend! Adorable and comfy space!!

Nice spacious apartment with full kitchen and gorgeous decorating throughout the loft. Host was very prompt with communication. We arrived a little early and were able to drop our bags (after walking up 4 flights) and go for a walk. If you enjoy exploring SOHO and the Village, the location is very good. The Manhattan Bridge entrance is very close and cool for a walk or run. The apartment building is on an extremely noisy thoroughfare in NYC + there was was loud street construction going on until 1:00am a couple of nights. The good news is that you are on the 4th floor vs street level and earplugs helped!
Top location, space (rare in NYC), comfy bed, new kitchen and super well equipped. And a free workout (with being located on the 4th floor!)

Alicia’s place was really great! Very spacious and great for our group of 4. Large eat in kitchen, dining area and very large living room. It was very clean and had tons of beautiful natural light. Beds were comfy and linens were nice. Great bath as well.
I would suggest packing lightly and doing your clothes shopping there. Stairs were a killer with a suitcase! Overall wonderful stay!
If you want to live in a SUPER classy and modern appartment with well thought out pieces and a great location - this is it!

Nous avons adoré ce loft! Nous étions une famille de 5 et c’était idéal pour notre séjour de 6 jours, bien situé pour explorer à pied le sud de Manhattan (puis en métro depuis Grand Street a 2 pas du loft, pour le centre et nord). L’appart est tres propre, bien aménagé et organisé, très bien climatisé, confortable et très spacieux! Exercices cardio gratuits en prime pour monter 4 ( dernier) étages tous les jours ( pour nous ce n’était pas un problème mais il faut le savoir). De très beaux livres et une deco design avec certains meubles vintage, exactement comme sur les photo. Vue sur l’avenue et la one world tower en arrière plan. Machine à laver et sèche linge neufs, parfait avec une famille. Le bâtiment en brique rouge, typique NYC, est relativement calme, le salon donne sur l’avenue mais étant au quatrième étage, c’est tout à fait acceptable. Nous avons été accueilli par l’housekeeper d’Alicia mais Alicia réagit très rapidement par messages, elle communique aussi par téléphone si nécessaire. Elle nous a donné de bonnes adresses ‘take away’ pour dîner à l’appart, et s’est montré très flexible pour l’horaire de départ.
Je recommande vivement ce loft!

Alicia's artist loft is true to all the pics. It is very spacious and has all the amenities that you would need for a visit with your family or a group. It's a great representative of what if would feel like if you lived in New York, especially with the four flights of stairs. It was a intense for our family of four (we have 2 young daughters) climbing those stairs with all our daily equipment & luggage but we managed to figure it. The street noise is loud there but she has provided sound machines. This location is on the ChinaTown side of Bowery but literally has Little Italy across the street, Lower East Side 10 minute walk and Soho 15 min walk. This is my favorite spot of the city, so you can't beat that. Thanks Alicia for letting us stay at your artsy, cool loft. We enjoyed ourselves very much!

We absolutely loved this apartment! Spacious and with cool design, with a wonderful NY vibe. It was perfect for our group of friends, were we all got separate bed rooms bit still had lots of space to socialize in. We would recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to visit NYC and stay in a great apartment in a good location in Chinatown and close to SoHo, Nolita and Lower East Side!

And Alicia was a very helpful host, and organised for us for a very late check in as well a smooth late check out, which really made our stay an amazing time.

Alicia is a great host,  Was available to all our questions, and flexible at checkout. The apartment is amazing, equipped with everything you need and designed to a high standard. The location was great and it is very easy to travel anywhere.   Thank you for your hospitality we definitely come again.
The perfect stylish base for a trip to the city. Easy walking distance to the LES, Nolita, Chinatown and Soho.

I really enjoyed staying with Cynthia in her beautiful, thought-provoking home.  Cynthia is an artist, and everything in her home is crafted to be comfortable and beautiful.  Cynthia was a laid-back host -- when I was around, if she happened to be eating or cooking, she shared delicious chicken soups and avacado salads with me.  More enjoyably, we shared numerous conversations and I even got to weigh on decorating choices for the next guests!  Anything I needed for my comfort, Cynthia made sure that I had it, and she was also very laid back around my intensive, early and late scheduling needs.  Cynthia made me feel like an old friend, not a new guest, and when I can next come to Manhattan, I plan to stay at Cynthias.

Our stay at Cynthia house was excellent. Cynthia was really helpful and helped us when I lost my bag in the shuttle. The room was very nice and the flat is just as the pictures shows, awesome ! The place is just next to the metro station which is very convenient to discover the city. If I had to come back to New York I would definitely choose her place again. Thanks a lot.

Cynthia’s apartment is a work of art. It was a gorgeous place to stay, very clean, warm and convenient for sight seeing. Cynthia is a wonderful host, supplying plenty of New York info and hospitality. I very much look forward to returning.

We looked for a true NYC experience when booking Cynthia's apartment and we got it. Cynthia is a marvelous host and presented a truly unique apartment; something of herself that she seeks to share with others.  Cynthia had a genuine interest in us as her guests and treated us like family. We would thoroughly recommend Cynthia's apartment as a base for exploring NYC.  Thank you so much Cynthia.  See you in Oz some time down the track.

Me and my other half stayed at Cynthias from 28th Dec until 4th Jan 2011. The apartment is in a great location about a ten second walk from the subway, and then a quick route straight down to times square. The area is lovely with a great smoothie shop with cheap prices just round the corner which Cynthia kindly took us to. The apartment itself is AMAZING!! Me and my other half absolutely loved everything about her place it was very homely, clean and just stunning!! After a stressful 18 hour journey thanks to many delays, we arrived in the middle of the night and what a relief to arrive to such a nice welcoming apartment was fantastic. Cynthia is a lovely kind hearted, warm person and we are very grateful to have met her and stayed at her beautiful home. We look forward to visiting again hopefully in the summer :)

ps... We stayed in the Grand Room, the bed is extremely comfortable and you will get a great nights sleep!!

Cynthia was a wonderful and accommodating host. I stood the first night with my daughter, and we had a blast playing in the loft rooms she created. Nights two and three I was there with my girlfriend and Cynthia was so helpful with recommending places for us to have breafkast and dinner. She even invited us along to an event and dinner on the last evening we were there. We had a lot of great conversation, and I really enjoyed our little walk and talk while we were looking for a cab. I really appreciated her welcoming demeanor, and I'm sure anyone interested in this location will appreciate this quality of hers as well.

This is a superb space. Plenty of beds when you are tired, but for the "awake time," one can REALLY enjoy this loft. The kitchen is very well-equipped if you want to cook (but with all the nearby restaurants, why bother?), and certainly makes an in-house breakfast easy. If you need to wash clothes, the washer and dryer await. The real treasure is the living room and adjoining dining room, flooded by light from the huge windows that face west with views of the city.

The apartment is in Chinatown (fantastic), and within a 5-minute walk you can be in a choice of totally different, charming, vibrant neighborhoods. If you wish to go farther afield, the subway is, literally, around the corner, with other lines accessed by walking a few minutes farther in the opposite direction.

Yes, there are four flights of stairs to the loft, but we hardly noticed (ages ranged from 16 - 62). The stairs are actually a bonus -- it made us feel better about all that we were eating.

We arrived a couple hours earlier than 3pm, and Alicia graciously offered to have us leave our bags in the apartment while the cleaner (very nice person) was finishing. Easy and informative check-in.

Alicia was responsive and informative throughout the process. We would love to take advantage of her hospitality on a return trip. Really sorry we never met her!

This is a stylish apartment in a central location. You are in china town and little Italy so lots of local shops, restaurants and bars close by and the subway is only a 2 minute walk away so getting around New York is no problem.  We had a fantastic stay and the host is very helpful and easy to contact. Great place !
Habitación correcta y casa bien comunicada

Waldemar is a wonderful host.  The room is lovely, huge, with a private bathroom, also huge.  I was visiting my child who is a student at Pratt.  It was a short walk to Pratt campus, also very close to the subway station.  It is located in a quiet residential block with a few coffee shops around the corner.  Myrtle Ave is a short walk and there are lots of restaurants.  I had a flat on the drive in and Waldemar showed me to a garage.  He goes above and beyond as a host.   Off street parking was not difficult to find but you should know New York traffic/parking rules if you plan to drive here.  I would love to stay here again in future visits.
Nice place in a nice neighborhood. The host was responsive and welcoming upon arrival.
Waldemar's place was perfect for relaxing. The cat is adorable!
Lugar calido y acogedor muy cerca del metro. Buen anfitrión, muy atento
Nice place to stay at for few nights.

Beautiful brownstone, secure location. Very cold during the night. In fact, I now have a cold from showering and stepping into a freezing room afterward. I asked if the heat could be adjusted and the host told me the heat is set at a temperature for comfortable sleeping. My boyfriend and I were freezing! Waldemar suggested we "cuddle up under the covers". I looked at the digital thermostat and the temperature read 64 degrees for the entire weekend. The room was spacious and looked just like the pictures. The bathroom is beautiful. I had to move the bathroom mats before showering because there were some yellow stains on them. Having worked in customer service for many many years, I hate to give negative reviews because I understand people have off days. However, upon first walking in the door my friend and I should have turned away. We arrived at 5:15. Was a couple minutes behind but nothing crazy. Upon entering, our host told us to sit on the couch and to have the WiFi keep us busy because the linens were not dry. The linens were dry about 5 minutes after we walked in as he took them up to the room. The rest of the time we could hear him frantically cleaning the room. I understand running behind so i didn’t say anything although your check in was 2 hours before and he wasn’t prepared at all and did make a little comment about us being late. As we sat there, we did notice cat poop on the ground. I didn’t say anything about that either as I figured he would see it as he was tidying up in the sitting area. As soon as we went into the room we left set our things down and headed for the city. We noticed the door to our room didn’t lock from the outside. but figured everything would be okay. Nothing was ever stolen but we did enter our room multiple times after leaving the lights on (purposely as we knew we would be returning after dark) and we would come home to find them all turned off. That left and uneasy feeling knowing that someone was in our room. I don’t know if it was the host or another person staying there but their should be a way to lock the door from the outside. There was a point where my friend had ordered food in and I told her to make sure to lock the gate and not the front door. We didn’t realize it until later when another person staying couldn’t get in and I was woken up at midnight being told to call my host. I called him immediately and he began yelling at me about how it was ridiculous that I locked the door and their was no reason for it. I explained that it was a simple misunderstanding (language barrier with my friend)and apologized and he proceeded to yell over me. Not listening to what I had to say. He did not apologize for his behavior over any part of our stay and I don’t not take any sort of joy in writing a negative review but I honestly wish I would have just spent the extra money on a clean hotel.
