The location is great - walkable to many places and very close to a subway station.  Thank you so much Alicia.
Great stay!

Alicia's loft is exactly what I would love to own in NYC! Bright, spacious, great amenities and close to everything we wanted to get to...LES/Little Italy/Chinatown/Soho!  It is a hike to the 4th floor, but don't let that deter you from renting this! We got our exercise in but no complaints from my family! Alicia is a very warm host and was a pleasure to talk to and work with.

Tive uma excelente experiência durante minha estadia. Fiquei 6 noites em NY com minha família. A localização do loft é ótima: intersecção entre Chinatown, Soho e Nolita. Chegávamos em qualquer lugar de Manhatan muito rápido, ainda mais com a estação de metrô a alguns metros do Loft.
A decoração é maravilhosa e super aconchegante. Nos sentimos em casa. Com certeza voltaria.

It was a wonderful place to stay for two weeks to explore lower Manhattan. There are so many different and interesting neighborhoods just a very short walk away: Little Italy, Chinatown, Nolita, Lower East Side, East Village and a fun/ not long walk to the West/Greenwich Village and NYU/New School/Cooper Union campuses.  My favorite thing about the location was running a loop in the morning across Manhattan Bridge, along Dumbo waterfront, and back on Brooklyn Bridge, then picking up breakfast in LES or Chinatown. I have traveled a lot throughout the world, but that might be my favorite run ANYWHERE.  The apartment is incredibly spacious for Manhattan with gorgeous light. Can't wait to stay there again.

We stayed in Alicia’s beautiful loft for 3 weeks. It was spacious, very clean, filled with light, beautifully decorated, comfortable, and really, ideal. I would definitely stay here again. Situated on the edge of Chinatown and Little Italy, food options were abundant. Whole Foods was a short walk, and we had access to everything downtown by foot. The 4-floor walk up is a bit daunting, but it beats the gym! Overall, I highly recommend Alicia’s loft. Thank you so much for a wonderful stay!

Alicia’s loft is beautiful, airy, stylish, warm and wonderful. My family and I loved coming home here at the end of long days out exploring. As a NYC resident years ago - in a tiny apartment- I so appreciated the space, the light and that we all had our own rooms!  Even the stairs, while daunting with luggage, became an integral part of my kids having an authentic NYC experience.

Great loft apartment that's ideally located in the Bowery. I stayed here for 5 days and everything from check-in to getting around the city was a breeze. Also, very cool décor throughout the apartment.

Fun and spacious apartment in an interesting area of the city. Felt like ‘real’ New York living - complete with lots of stairs (which were daunting at first but totally manageable). Unexpected bonus is that the kitchen is shockingly well organized and has everything you need.

An incredible space in a perfect location. We were very comfortable staying in Alicia’s apartment and absolutely would stay here again. The kitchen in fully stocked and the beds are comfortable, AC works great. We were in awe of how beautifully designed the loft and has everything we needed for our 10 day stay in Manhattan.

Hello Alicia

Thank you very much for this time!
It was a very nice and beautiful inn!

If you have another chance, thank you.
Very nice and very spacious place to stay! Very well stocked with essentials  and Alicia was very helpful! Will definitely recommend!
Gorgeous space in a perfect location. We absolutely loved our stay. The kitchen is well equipped for cooking and dining. Highly recommended!

Great location in NY - close to Soho, LES, East Village, West Village…we walked everywhere!  The loft is huge and incredibly well appointed.  It’s at the top of 4 very steep flights of stairs so just be aware when packing your suitcases.  Alicia was incredibly responsive and flexible during our stay, and check-in/check-out was super easy. Would definitely stay here again.
This is the perfect place for your Manhattan visit.  Alicia is a great communicator, clear expectations, and the place was so clean and stylish.

I have been at Cynthia's during 5 nights last week (April 2011) and everything has been excellent. She is a great host and the best guide to enjoy the city (as well as her apartment, which is a very nice place to be, a work of art). My name is Diego and I am 34, from Buenos Aires Argentina.

Cynthia is a star....my first Airbnb experience and what a way to start. Extremely accomodating, sociable and caring. The apartment is fantastic and so brilliantly located; I was mainly In Manhatten and walked everywhere. The apartment was very clean, tidy, warm and cosy. I felt at home and safe (as a female travelling on her own I think this is important) Would most definitely book with Cynthia again if in NY. An extremely talented artist too.

Cynthia's home is very UNIQUE NEW YORK! My friend and I had an amazing time staying with Cynthia. She was an amazing host and a great person to be around. Very helpful and only a phone call away. My friend and I loved her place, it is colorful and creative, and has a story of its own. I can say her home is my favorite place I've stayed in so far. Her location is great, the subway is right around the corner, and Central Park is only 3 blocks away. I truely would recommend others to stay at Cynthia's home. Cythnia thanks for letting us stay at your home we had a lovely time!!

Un séjour parfait !!! Cynthia est une hôte fabuleuse qui s'aura s'adapter à vos envies : si vous avez des questions elle n'hésitera pas à vous aider et à vous proposer des sorties. Si vous préférez vivre votre aventure seul, elle vous laissera faire ce que vous voulez ! L'appartement est vraiment somptueux, en plein upper east side à quelques pas d'une station de métro ! Vraiment idyllique ! Une première à NYC pour ma part, et ça risque de ne pas être la dernière ! Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés !

Alicia’s home was amazing! My family and I loved the space. Perfect location within a block of the train (subway). The space is tastefully decorated and has all of the essentials for a comfy stay. Alicia was a wonderful host and was very communicative. I hope we get back to NYC to stay here again.
Typical New York loft and a perfect place to stay ! Alicia was very nice to communicate with. Would definitely come back and recommend that place !
My friends and I had a wonderful time staying here for Memorial Day weekend! Only downside is walking up the four flights of stairs, but everything else was perfect. Thanks Alicia!
We enjoyed our stay
Stunning apartment, super clean and conveniently located. So nice, we stayed here twice!!
Place is beautiful and amazing but beware the walk up is definitely a lot !

We thoroughly enjoyed the time in this lovely apartment! A beautiful, perfectly located space that felt like home each day coming back from our adventures. Alicia took wonderfully care of us and was very attentive to all our questions. We highly recommend staying with her and in this great place!
Very nice loft with lots of space. It's styled with taste, it felt like home. It's location close to Little Italy, Soho and Nolita makes it a great place to stay.

The Appartement is super nice, cozy and for a family of 5 very convenient with lots of space. The area is definitively a place to be as it offers a perfect contrast to the midtown area. We enjoyed coming back to this place after a long day tour exploring the entire city. The communication with
Alicia was extremely easy and straightforward. She is a great host. We would definitely come back again.

Book this space! We just returned from the most wonderful visit to NYC. We spent Halloween weekend at Alicia’s apartment to attend a friend’s wedding nearby. The neighborhood was nice and we enjoyed the short walks to great restaurants, shopping, museums, galleries, and church’s — all within a few blocks. Our young daughter loved the kids room and the big couch in the apartment. I liked knowing I was close to her in the lofted bed. The space felt luxurious and eclectic and was more than we could have asked for. We felt extra fancy with a washer/dryer, full sized fridge and stove, and multiple bedrooms in NYC… there aren’t many spaces like this! There is a reasonably priced parking garage right around the corner. The building felt safe. Alicia was great at responding when I had questions. Julia was accommodating at check in and check out, too. Thank you for sharing your lovely space with us!
Had a wonderful time staying here. Room was beautiful and the access to the balcony was very cool! Would definitely stay here again!
Beautiful home. Close to transit. Great host. Easy, simple. Peaceful and clean. Great stay, thanks waldemar
expect not to go
Great location and very comfortable space. I would come again.

Waldemar ist ein superfreundlicher Gastgeber, das Haus bzw. das Zimmer ist super toll. Ich hatte eigenes Bad und Terrasse dazu. Ganz ruhiger, grüner Hinterhof mit Vogelgezwitscher. Alle Ubahnen sind in Laufweite gut zu erreichen. Bus fährt fast direkt vor der Haustüre ... kleines Cafe am Eck und ein super nettes Deli ebenfalls am Eck. Es war ein wunderbarer Aufenthalt. Und nicht zu vergessen, die Katze von Waldemar. Kittycat is the Best!
Gracious host. Perfect location. Great value.

Really lovely space. I felt like I was in a beautiful Victorian ballroom. Very comfortable bed with memory foam pillows and a great bathroom with a *claw-foot tub*. Well worth the price. My only complaint is that the floors are a bit squeaky and you can hear what's going on in the rest of the house, which is to be expected in an old house. I was definitely a bit self-conscious waking up early and going down the stairs.
Great location. Comfortable room with balcony and cable. Walking distance to trains and downtown Brooklyn. Great bodega and pastry/coffee shop on the corner. No complaints.
Great place and location! Would stay again!
Outstanding experience! Great location, nice and clean room with an amazing bed, nice and pragmatic host that let me keep my bags at his place after checkout time, because my flight was delayed.

Very cool room with high ceilings, comfortable bed, and a great little terrace to have your morning coffee. Shares a wall/ covered parlor door with another guest’s room, sound travels a little bit but otherwise quite private.
Nice place, conveniently located.

Best holiday ever, facilitated by Cynthia´s supreme hospitality, warmth and not least her breathtaking apartment. My girlfriend and I enjoyed our stay from start to finish and Cynthia treated us like old friends from the moment we walked in the door.

The location was excellent - just a minute´s walk from the nearest subway. The bed was comfortable and the apartment was spotless throughout. But the greatest plus was Cynthia herself - always smiling and helpful with plenty of great stories to tell and full of interesting ideas for sightseeing and restaurants.

I can´t recommend this apartment highly enough.

We started our wonderful trip to the big apple with a town car at the airport that was arranged by Cynthia. Then a warm greeting by our host. She showed us around her neighborhood and gave us very sound advice about the subways and how to get around. She prepared us a hearty breakfast every morning and sent cheerly on our way.
Her apartment is cool, very comfortable, very clean and easy to get to. We had a wonderful time in NYC and she was definitely a contributing factor.
I will stay there again.

I enjoyed my stay with Cynthia tremendously!! Her home is more beautiful than I ever imagined. It was a wonderful experience spending time with her and she is brillant at making her guests feel comfortable. She offers a warm haven to live that feels like home and her beautiful artwork is a festival for the eyes in every room. I did not want to leave. I felt like I was not just a guest, but part of her family. She goes the extra mile to welcoming her guests into her home. She spent a lot of time helping me get settled and giving me valuable information about places to eat and and have fun.
This was my first real visit to New York City and Cynthia was a most wise philosopher and guide to the city and to life. I couldn't believe how fortunate I was to have her as my host. She has so much positive passion and energy about her work and about people and she had a life changing effect on me. I am thrilled I got to meet her, and honored to call her a friend. People like Cynthia do not come around all the time, and when you get a rare opportunity to know them, PLEASE GRAB IT!!!!!!!

We had a great time staying here!

We had a fairly packed schedule, so we didn't spend much time talking to Cynthia, but she was super friendly, made us feel very at home, and was full of good recommendations.

The apartment is amazing. The photos really don't do it justice, and we loved the kitchen in particular.

Cynthia is nothing short of awesome!!! Her home is gorgeous, I liken it to a museum yet it's cozy and comfortable too. Cynthia wants only the best for her guests and it shows - super plush towels, soft soft sheets, lots of laughter and if you're lucky, an escapade or two. A few blocks to one of the most gorgeous areas of Central Park and 1 block from a central subway line. Live it up in style and comfort in this fantastic one of a kind experience!
Gracious, informative host. The bed was comfy.. The bathroom Big and private.  I will be coming back!
Great spot would stay again in heartbeat
Awesome place with high ceilings, convenient location by the G train.  Superb and accommodating host. Definitely a place to stay to enjoy the weekend!
A great value and really convenient to the subway!
The house has a very nice style and also the position is good. Could be cleaner (f.e. under the bed and in the bathroom).
Amazing neighborhood. Cozy cafes, great restaurants and bars a couple of blocks away. Safe neighborhood. Great room. Amazing hosts
Great location and awesome little suite.
Excellent historical home with great hosts!

This is our second stay and it is just as advertised. Quiet room, comfortable bed, plenty of space including closet space. Waldemar seems very available and informative. It’s a great location for us. We would definitely stay here again!

I wish I lived here all the time. A space of true peace and tranquility in an amazing location in the heart of Brooklyn! I. Love. This. Room. The colors, the light, the vaulted ceilings, the deck right outside is like a mini-jungle... the bathroom is so sparkling clean & has two sinks! And a luxurious shower. The bed was so so comfortable (and the BEST kind of pillows on the bed - same as at my bf's house!) - and there's a comforter in the closet if you need the extra weight/warmth.

There is a house rule of not running the AC for more than 12 hours a day; I didn't need it! There is a remote-controlled fan and the room is very spacious, so I was very comfortable the whole time.

Waldemar & his sister Beverly were outstanding hosts; very friendly and accommodating with enough distance that you feel like you truly have your own space. And there's ol' Kitty! A chatty old tuxedo cat who loves to be pet. If you want loving pet energy, it's here!

If you care about cosmetic things, the walls of the bedroom are in need of a paint job. This minor detail did not affect my stay in the slightest because I'm not the kind of person that cares about that BS.

I would absolutely book again.
Great people and a novel spot in Clinton Hill. I enjoyed my stay.
Nice space, all good!
Great location. Reasonably priced. Entry to apartment was all very easy. Waldemar and Beverly are friendly hosts. They were very accommodating by letting me leave my luggage there prior to check in.
Great space in cool neighborhood. Exactly what I picture Brooklyn looking like in my mind when I think of the city. The room was great and Waldemar was a fantastic host.

Waldemar was a great host. The place was amazing, especially given it has its own en-suite. No problems at all. Loved my stay, I would highly recommend it and I will certainly have this place on top of my list of places to stay next time.
Kamer in souterrain in Brooklyn vlakbij 2 metrohaltes. Communicatie vooraf was prima. We vonden de kamer een beetje verouderd en rommelig. Niet echt een aanrader.
nice space, great location.

Waldemars space is a perfect place to land if you're looking for a purely authentic Brooklyn private oasis! It was truly wonderful having a private bathroom connected directly to the room and also the beautiful privilege of a private balcony to enjoy morning coffee and treats as you get accommodated with the days weather before journeying off.  I was able to get a lot of work done with the access to wifi and a private, mostly quiet space, which was a relief as a traveling student/teacher.  The room doesnt receive a lot of natural light so expect to sleep a little longer than usual if you don't set an alarm and/or are use to being awakened by the sun rising. You also have to be able to navigate a narrow stairway to and from the room. 10/10 would stay again!

Waldemar and Dorothy were do kind as they allowed us to drop our bags after our red-eye flight so we could do other things prior to check in. This is a wonderful beautiful neighborhood. The bathroom is clean and spacious as us the room. The terrace outside was great for morning. The old woodwork lovely. Plus, Waldemar is just a cool guy.
Great space in a great location

Wonderful location for those who want to be near Pratt and stay at an authentic brownstone. G train is a block away and it's close to buses. Bed was extremely comfortable. Quiet at night. The WiFi was fast. A sweet little terrace provides a nice greenspace when weather permits.

Host was available and open to answer questions, but I know the area and city well. Always felt welcome by the hosts and Kitty the resident cat.

The bedroom door can only be locked when you are inside - therefore it is unlocked when you are out. I felt very secure in this home.

The bathroom is charming with its clawfoot tub, but not appropriate for those more comfortable with a grab bar.

Lovely respite after a busy day in the city for those who value quiet and a place to recharge.

Waldemar's place was perfect for spending the weekend for an event at Pratt, only a couple blocks away. The bedroom was a nice and private space. I wish it was a little bit cleaner, but nothing that bothered me too much. The neighborhood was pleasant and had some great restaurants nearby (I recommend TasteKorea232).

Waldermar's place was located near the metro and super convenient. He kindly met me upon arrival and helped me check-in. The bed was SO comfortable and the en-suite bathroom was clean and spacious. I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend!

Very cool house. The stairs are a bit narrow and could be tricky for an older person. Home owner is super nice!! I had nice conversations with he, his Aunt and his sister. The tub/shower was the only downfall of the house. I would book my 70+ yr old parents here just because stepping in and out of tub could be dangerous for them. I on the hand would definitely book here again.
This is a very cute spot! Funky and close to transit, the private bathroom and veranda is lovely.
So cosy and nice deck..

we spent three wonderful months in silvia's apartment, it was small but really quiet and comfortable! we loved the neighborhood and the proximity of the central park, jogging the morning and picnicking and reading the afternoon! a great supermarket, the trader joe's, is at the corner, as well the subway express red line, that brings you in one stop in times square and in some others in west village! the laundry is at the end of the street, we found some good restaurants, and the lincoln center is some blocks away!
thanks Silvia for the great experience, it was really as a second home in NYC! we totally recommend it!
The apartment is very small , but cosy. The location is stunning. Silvia was a great host. We felt we lived in NY  and would love to repeat the experience. Peter

I rented the apartment for 2 of my friends who came for a month in NY.
Silvia was always very easy to work with and even when she was away and we had questions she answered them promptly.
The apartment was as described, small but perfectly organized and very conveniently situated.
I would strongly recommend her place for your next stay in the city.

Silvia & Clara were great hosts - communication was frequent, clear, and timely; Clara was there upon my (very late!) arrival to the apartment with keys and instructions; Silvia accommodated our request for 3 guests instead of 2.

The apartment itself is lovely and also very utilitarian - the loft provides for maximum use of space. The place is clean and tidy, as were the sheets and towels. There are pots and pans in the kitchen with which to cook (if you should choose to do so). The location is exactly what I was looking for, in the Upper West Side and close to the 1,2,3,B and C lines. Everything you might need is only steps away, but somehow the apartment manages to stay nice and quiet!

The one (very minor) drawback is that when it rains, the window in the bathroom occasionally drips. I remedied this by putting a towel on the window ledge and wringing it out from time to time.

I would definitely recommend this place to friends (and already have!), and I'll be hoping to stay here again in the future!

My husband and I stayed at Silvia's for a week of NYC vacation and LOVED it! It truly gave us the New York experience and made us look forward to returning next year. I definitely recommend her apartment!

Being at Silvia's has been a pleasure: easy, clean, sunny and perfectly located (72subway station beside de apartment, and Riverside Park or Central Park to choose for a first hour running session). When we arrived she was waiting for us to explain the apartment's rules and give us the keys. We've been in touch from the first time… really convenient!

Me and my husband stayed in Silvia's place for 10 days and we love it! It was our first time using Airbnb and it couldn't be better. The apartment is exactly as the pictures, very clean and cosy and has the pecfect location, right next to the subway and Central Park. Silvia was very nice and waited for us despite our late time of arrival and explain everything about the place.New York is a great city and Silvia's apartment just contributed with a dream vacation!

Great apartment for one or two people.  Clean, good space, nicely furnished.  Very efficient.  Silvia is responsive and helpful and a great host.  The upper west side location is close to the subway and Central Park. Really convenient.  Would be happy to go back.

We stayed 10 days in Silvia`s apartment and it was a great experience. The place is great, exactly as described, and the location is the best.
Silvia helped us very much, and was very nice and professional.
Highly recommended!

We loved our stay. Great to have our own place for our 5 weeks in NYC. The area's good but we preferred spending our days in the village and lower Manhattan. Having the express subway so close meant we didn't have to spend too long travelling though.

Trader Joe's is right across the road too which is great. The cafes are good, fruit from the vendor on the corner was fresh and tasty.

We didn't realise that there'd be no TV service at all but that's our own faulty and you don't need a TV when you're in such an amazing city.
We loved staying in this apt, perfect location (right next to the subway and Central Park) really cool neighborhood and apt. Silvia was a great host! Highly recommended!

I stayed in Silvia's apartment for the month of july.I had a great time and it was my first experience with Airbnb and it could not have been better. The apartment is very well located on Upper West Side which is a lovely area to live in. Lots of shops and restaurants, close to the subway and of course to Central Park.
The apartment is as described on the photos, i felt home right away. Silvia was a great host and communication was easy. I would totally stay at Silvia's place again :)
Silvia's apartment is a sweet and quiet hideaway in the busy and convenient Upper West Side.  Clean and comfortable, my colleague and I had a lovely stay.

Our experience with Silvia and her apt was fantastic! She's very responsive and easy to communicate with. The apt is exactly as advertised...and after walking pretty much everywhere in Manhattan, I don't think there's a better location. We would definitely stay here again.

I'm so glad I found this apartment! I've spend 10 days in Silvia's apt and it was really great. Silvia was a great host, she and her boyfriend were expecting for me very early in the morning to give me the keys and all kind of recommendation for my stay. She was always available for questions and helped in every way possible to make my stay a real delight.

The apt is exactly as described and very quiet, so you can rest at night, and it is in a unbeatable location! Safe, just next to the subway and with a lot of things to do in the neighbourhood.

Silvia, you are the best! I hope I can stay next year again!

It's a really lovely loft-ish studio with a nice kitchen. Super clean & quite. The location is perfect for taking subway and going to the Central Park. Silvia is a very kind host. I'd highly recommended this place for visiting in NYC, and I might stay here again!

Silvia is an excellent hostess and made us feel very welcome during our stay. The size of the apartment is great: compact but well-equipped. Location is excellent with metro station around the corner and one of the city's best grocery stores right next to it. Highly recommended.

The apartment is ideally located near the 1/2/3 subway station and extraordinarly close to Central Park. Silvia was an excellent hostess who made sure that you instantly fell at home at the apartment. I would recommend this apartment to everyone for both long and short trips, especially when  you are planning to stay in the UWS.

Большое спасибо Сильвии за все, как она помогала и решала наши проблемы в Нью-Йорке. Для одного человека или семейной пары ее квартира оптимальное место для желающих провести время в Нью-Йорке, с точки зрения и доступности достопримечательностей и ресторанов- максимум полчаса, или пешком или на метро - по Московским меркам это не время; мы не готовили, завтрак - напротив через улицу.
С точки зрения цены и качества квартира - оптимальное место для турпоездки в Нью-Йорк.

The apartment was exactly as described in the profile. A cozy and clean apartment that has got pretty much everything you may need for a nice and relaxing stay in New York. It is a light apartment, with several windows in the kitchen, bathroom and in the living room/sleeping area. Fully stocked kitchen with pots and cans, spices etc. The only things I missed was a coffee machine (I'm a Swede, we drink a lot of strong coffee ;-) ) and a toaster. Otherwise I had everything I needed.

The apartment is situated on the ground floor which is good in most perspective but you can easily hear everyone coming into the building, checking their mail boxes, hear what they are talking about (and some neighbors tend to come home and talk loudly even after midnight - and this can be a bit annoying at first - but once you get used to it it doesn't bother you that much. You get used to it.

It is situated in a perfect area of UWS, really close to the park and to several subway lines. Shops, grocery stores and plenty of nice restaurants basically just around the corner.

Silvia is a really good and informative tenant. She contacted me after a few days just to check how things where and to let me know that I could reach her whenever I wanted. Didn't need to contact her though as everything worked smoothly.

I would definitely like to stay here when I come to visit NYC next time!

I had a fantastic 4 days staying with Cynthia in her beautifully decorated apartment. Her warm hospitality and caring nature made my stay in New York all the more memorable. She even invited me to join her for lunch and dinner with her friends, and we had a great time doing some shopping, especially in antique stores!

I highly recommend Cynthia's place when staying in New York.
An amazing oasis in the city. Both quiet and close to everything. The lay-out of the loft is fun and functional. We have nothing bad to say about this clean, well designed loft.
Silvia and her apartment is AMAZING! Simply the best I could hope for during my parents' visit to NYC. It is clean, lovely, comfortable, and in a wonderful neighborhood.

Silvia's place was great and exactly as described. The location is fantastic. Literally 1 minute to the subway and only two blocks to Central Park. Lots of grocery and restaurant options as well. Silvia was also a great host. Her place provided everything you need and she was easy to contact. I highly recommend staying here.

Silvia's apartment was exactly as described in the listing and is extremely well located close to the subway, near Lincoln Center, and lots of great restaurants. From my first contact to the last, Silvia responded very quickly to my questions and concerns.
I was staying for over a month while my home was undergoing a renovation, so the kitchen was important. I was able to cook an entire Christmas dinner in the well appointed kitchen. Midway through my stay, I heard my renovation would be delayed, and Silvia allowed me to extend my stay.
The whole experience was delightful and stress free!

Lindo en una muy buena ubicación. Si bien el apartamento es pequeño, está muy bien arreglado y tiene todo lo que se necesita. Se encuentra en planta baja así que no hay problemas de escaleras. El edificio es muy tranquilo. El barrio es por demás recomendable, tiene todo tipo de servicios a unos pocos pasos (restaurantes, supermercados, bancos, tiendas, etc) pero a la vez bastante tranquilo. Y lo más importante, dos estaciones de metro realmente muy cerca. Silvia fue muy cordial en todo momento y la comunicación fue siempre muy rápida. Tanto la llegada como la salida fue perfectamente acordada. Recomiendo tanto al apartamento como a Silvia.

We had a good stay at Silvias appartment. Of course it was small but it was in Manhattan. The apt has its own small kitchen which was good for breakfast, a very nice bathroom and a combined living room/bedroom. The stairs to bed and the thin mattress is probably nothing for older people, we had some sleeping problems because of the firm matress after 10 nights, less nights would have been better but NYC is it worth. After all, we really enjoyed to live in this tidy little beautiful appartment. Silvia did her best to fulfil our wishes. Thanks for that. Thumb up! :-)

Silvia is a great host. I stayed here for a month while working down in Tribeca. She was remote the entire time, but very accommodating for my late night arrival and quick to respond to any questions. The place is in a fantastic location with a lot of great things within 1-2 blocks walking distance—Central Park, the 1/2/3 subway line, Magnolia Bakery, Trader Joe's, Fairway Market. It's a very cozy apartment, but it has everything you need for a short or long stay.

We really enjoyed our 6 week stay at Silvia's appartment! The neighborhood is great, and Trader Joe's, subway and Central Park are all REALLY close to the appartment. The appartment is small but well equipped with a great kitchen and everything else you might need. We did however have to buy soap, dish soap, toilet paper, salt and pepper ourselves right away even though the page says that should be available. Found a few bugs in the kitchen and bathroom, but that wasn't really a big problem for us. Silvia was very quick on responding to our questions via email and we would for sure recommend you staying here! :)

I have never lived in a place so small yet so big. It is done with great imagination for comfort. It is an ideal place for great thinking and writing. And you can buy fresh groceries from Trader Joe next door as they are put on the shelves. If you a looking for daily exercise, the Central Park is close by. Good food? The restaurants are over the place. Theater and Cinema? You are near Lincoln Center and several cinemas. Shopping? You will spoiled for choice. You want to join demonstrations? Trump International Hotel and Tower is within a walking distance.

My partner and I stayed at Silvia's apartment for almost 3 months over the Summer and we loved it!

The apartment is very small but pretty much what we expected. Space wasn't an issue for us because we spent most of our days exploring anyway. The proximity to Central Park is ideal (only 2 blocks away) and it gave us a reason to exercise in the morning. The 72nd St Subway Station is just around the corner and being on the express line (2,3) was great because it made getting Downtown much faster and easier. The kitchen was very well equipped and had everything we needed for a night in. There are also some great supermarkets within walking distance (Trader Joe's is across the road and Fairway Supermarket is only a few blocks away). The apartment does not face the street so it was surprisingly quiet at night - we couldn't hear any outside noise at all. Although as others have mentioned, the mattress in the loft is very thin and may be in an issue if you have shoulder or back problems.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay here and would book again in a heartbeat!

The guest in the room next to me was incredibly loud and noisy, and given the fact that there are wood floors with no carpeting in an old Brownstone, it is incredibly noisy. Also they were singing or humming all night, banging on walls, and their phone was going off all night.

To summarize, it's a nice house in a great neighborhood, but lack of communicating all the particulars led to a miserable stay.

I came from France Aix en Provence to stay 8 days in NYC. My trip was a success with Cynthia who gives so much advises when we need. Always she is very helpful and facilitate to come from the JFK Airport or other places you want to visit. Cynthia's apartment in the Upper East and close from subway stations and buses. The home is very clean and quiet, my room was comfortable. After the day in NYC, it is relaxant to come back easily with subway or bus to the home. Cynthia knows to be considerate . I will recommend this place for friends who wants discover NYC and living in one friendly apartment and need help when it is necessary. xavier
A fantastic and generous host. Very much looking forward to staying with Cynthia again soon.

Kurt and his wife are very gracious hosts.   The accommodations are wonderful and just as described. Kurt walked us to the subway station (one small block away) and helped get us on our way the first day.  The place is spacious and part of a magnificent building.  You will want to just sit and read. It is also nice to get to see this part of Manhattan more intimately.

Kurt and Camilla were fantastic hosts full of enthusiasm and detailed knowledge about the city and in particular his locale. He recommended some great walks and we enjoyed his stories, his house and the private library.
We will be back !

What a great experience!  Kurt was an extraordinary host; allowing us to feel most welcome  prior to arrival, inquiring about our needs and in scheduling  a time to meet.  We found on street parking in sight of the front door immediately.  The neighborhood was tranquil; a mix of multi-ethnics & young hipsters-making people watching and inexpensive,exotic dining a treat.  Access to the subway was great being less than a two block walk.  The accommodations were perfect-clean, roomy, with great beds and linens.  It was very quiet in the evening, allowing us to rest up from our busy days.  There is a very functional kitchen and dining area.  The back yard was a super treat-a green space to decompress when you needed a quiet moment.  The unexpected bonus is the amazing book store on site, which Kurt generously gave us a tour of and the library in our part of the house which could provide a lifetime of fascinating reading.  We will return to this gem of a property!  Thanks so much, Kurt.

What a wonderful stay we had! Kurt and his lovely wife are deeply embedded in the culture & arts of New York and obviously love to share with their guests. The property is exactly as described, and for anyone who may look at a map and have questions about the location, do not be concerned! We'll definitely be returning!
The host canceled this reservation 28 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Cynthia is a great person to stay with; expect smoothies, art and noodles. Her apartment is appropriately luxurious and you're well situated on the 4-5-6 Metro lines which give you connections to the rest of the city, not to mention being a stone's throw from the bigger galleries and museums of Manhattan. A fantastic few days. Strongly recommended.

To meet Cynthia and to stay in her tasteful outfitted appartement was a great pleasure for me. Cynthia is a very sympatic and warm person and she has an amazing positive attitude towards life. She is a wonderful and provident host, helpful in every situation. I had a phantastic and secure time in New York and after tiring tours in 'downtown' I felt like coming home. Her smoothies in the morning are the cherry on top.

Amazing place and location, i would recommend this place to anyone who is traveling to NYC! the place to stay!  Cynthia was so helpful and she is the most amazing person that you will meet in your travels! THANK YOU CYNTHIA FOR EVERYTHING :)

stay was wonderful, the place makes you feel home and cosy. cynthia made her famous smoothies every morning. she is a great host. i would recommend her place to everyone. not only because cynthia is so taking care of her guests and beeing helpful in any kind of matters, she just got something, that not everyone has it.

This is, indeed, one of New York's most-unique destinations.


Cynthia is an internationally-known visual artist with formal architectural training, and her home is the product of 22 years of sustained artistic focus. The photos are accurate but cannot capture a myriad small details such as the elegant solutions for concealing piping and wiring runs, or for ensuring adequate airflow between the lofts and open areas. At one point, I got a glimpse of a concealed wiring closet as she relocated her wifi base station -- I was impressed by the carefully-designed infrastructure that lies beneath the sumptuous exterior.


As an extra treat, Cynthia's artwork graces the walls. The overall effect is stunning, like living in a bohemian fin-de-siècle palace -- admittedly a compact one, but a palace, nonetheless.


Cynthia herself is the epitome of the perfect hostess. Her warmth and generosity is beyond compare. Her morning smoothies are the perfect metaphor -- healthy, fresh, and sustaining.


Living successfully in a small shared place requires the willingness to balance intimacy with privacy, and she handles that balancing act with effortless grace. In the last week of my two-week stay, I fell ill. Cynthia went overboard to ensure that I was comfortable, even to the point of getting chicken soup for me!


There is a large community of people around Cynthia, some drawn initially by her miniature palace. I feel lucky to have joined that community.

I enjoyed staying with Cynthia so much!  She works very hard to  take excellent care of her guests. She offers shelter that not only gives the body rest and renewal,  but also feeds the mind.   If you are lucky enough to get a chance to stay with her, you will never forget this trans formative experience.

A truly lovely experience! Cynthia's gorgeous home was an excellent base for me to really explore the Upper East Side and her suggestions for the very best places to dine and visit were perfect. Cynthia organised everything seamlessly and she was so helpful that it was very easy to move in and have an excellent week. Thank you Cynthia - I shall return!

I stayed 2 weeks in Cynthia's home, which really is a place of artwork. I spent all days outside and made my daily reports after that in the blue room. I often finished at midnight. The days were fully planned. So I was happy to be in a place next to the subway. Cynthia gave me some advices, called a taxi for me, and I loved her smoothies in the morning. Thank you for that very much, Cynthia!

But I would like to point out a few things which should be mentioned. The pictures do not show the true dimensions of the blue room. The blue room is only about 6 square meters bed included. There is only a bench to sit on with no backrest. Stairs lead you to your bed. The bed goes over the floor. The room is open to the ceiling. Underneath is place for your clothes as well as on the opposite side. Real space to live in is therefore very very narrow. The room is not separated enough. Everybody in the flat can hear everything you say. There is no privacy in that room.
There was not a single table with a chair in normal size in the kitchen nor in the living room nor in the blue room. I found a few bar stools in the kitchen, one of them I could use in my room to reach my laptop. If you prepare your meal in the kitchen you have to eat from the working place sitting on a bar stool or standing. The fridge is too small for more than 1 person if rooms are booked. There is no microwave. The flat is shoe free, but Cynthia did not say that she does not like sandals or slippers. She walks barefoot and wanted me to do so or in my socks. I do not like that. The place is beautiful, but to pay 95 $ for a room of 6 square meters? Cynthia is nice at one hand. But she gave me the feeling that she cared at first about every piece in her flat, then about her guest. I would wish to see more respect for the dignity of guests from different countries with different aspects of life. Do I recommend? For people who like such very small places, yes.

Cynthia  makes you feel at home immediately , and her home is  a fabulous and special  place to stay when visiting NYC . Her home is  wonderful with thought given to every detail from the mosaic on the kitchen wall, the Aladdin treasure cave rooms ,the gorgeous bathroom and the stunning living room. But even more lovely is Cynthia herself , who takes care of her guests from the morning smoothies to the evening welcome when you return after a day in the city. I feel really  lucky that I stayed with her and will come back next year.

Le logement est tout à fait conforme à la description, c'est un lieu très paisible au milieu des livres de Kurt. Le jardin est une bénédiction, surtout en été ! Kurt et Camilla ont été des hôtes fantastiques, toujours prêts à rendre service en cas de besoin et pleins de bons conseils sur le quartier et New York en général. L'appartement est tout équipé... Le quartier est sûr et agréable.. Il y a un supermarché à un bloc et le métro vous mène dans le centre de Manhattan en 30 minutes.
Nous recommandons vraiment cet endroit, nous y retournerons volontiers !!!!
非常完美的房子，地理位置很好，非常有品位。房东是一位作家，很高的文化素养。房东各方面都想的很周到。

Nous avons passé un merveilleux moment dans cet appartement. Le jardin est magique,  surtout pendant notre séjour où il a fait très chaud. Nous pouvions le soir y prendre l'apéritif. le quartier est très calme et reposant après une journée bruyante en centre ville.
Everything was

La casa di Kurt è un'"esperienza".
Si varca la soglia e si è letteralmente immersi, circondati, assediati dalla cultura. Anzi, dalla Cultura.
Cultura in ogni sua manifestazione: Storia (seppur "giovane" agli occhi di un visitatore europeo), Letteratura, Musica, Arte, Fotografia.
E libri. Centinaia e centinaia di libri, che foderano tutti gli ambienti dell'appartamento che vi sarà messo a disposizione, che staranno lì per la vostra gioia, da scoprire e centellinare - magari comodamente seduti nel giardino sul retro - alla tenue luce di lampade sornione.
Sornione come Kurt, il Padrone di casa che, se lo vorrà, vi aprirà le altre "stanze del tesoro", quelle dove lui passa le proprie giornate, circondato dalle note di dischi in vinile di musica jazz per palati fini.
E lui, Kurt, vi condurrà alla scoperta di esperienze personali incredibili, di conoscenza diretta con Mostri Sacri (qualcuno ha sentito parlare di un certo Andy Warhol?, ma ce ne sono tanti altri) della letteratura, della musica, dell'arte, della fotografia, illustrandovi le incredibili opere della sua Camilla che, attraverso quelli che a una prima occhiata potrebbero sembrare semplici manichini, in realtà sono delle vere e proprie rappresentazioni storiche.
Ci fermiamo qui, per non levarvi il gusto di scoprire le mille meraviglie di questa casa, per costruire la vostra "esperienza", che trasformerà la visita a NYC in un evento memorabile.
Gabriella, Guido, Alessandro e Annalisa

Kurt nous attendait à notre arrivée, il nous avait préparé de quoi prendre notre petit déjeuner et a veillé nous faciliter le séjour, conseils sur les transports, les musées, Halloween,... il a tout fait pour contribuer à rendre notre séjour agréable.
This apartment was awesome! And Kurt was such an accommodating host. Very highly recommended!

One amazingly inspiring woman.
A warm and wonderful place with a soul of its own.
An unforgettable experience...

Kurt was a most responsive and congenial host.  The apartment was very comfortable and well equipped.  The  garden terrace was beautiful, particularly at night when its twinkly lights competed with the stars above.  Perfect location and an easy walk for train ride to points of interest.  Highly recommend!

Not in your usual location but Kurt runs a hidden gem. Washington heights is save, lively and only 30 mins from downtown by uberx. The neighbourhood itself is residential with enough restaurants.
The place has a lot of charm, two bedrooms and good kitchen and living area. Very clean, good beds and record player with fanastic jazz collection. If you dont mind paying less for more and dont mind hopping in an uber, this is very good. The host Kurt is friendly, gave a warm welcome and answered all questions regarding bookings etc.

Its a charming place to stay and perfect if you are in town for a Yankees game. The stadium is a 20 minute stroll across the bridge. The neighborhood is safe and lively. Subway stops are nearby. Kurt is personable and had several good recommendations for nearby restaurants that were quite good. Its a great place to stay to avoid the tourist trap areas.

Kurt has been an excellent host, very helpful and giving very good advices to have a great stay at New York. The apartment was great,with all the things you need. Beds were comfortable and the kitchen had all the things you need. It has a spectacular garden that you can use. Supermarket and subway is at 100m from the apartment. Great place to spend wonderful days in New York.
Very nice and cosy apartment refurbished with garden, books and jazz. Kurt is a gentle and friendly host.

Kurt is a fabulous host and his apartment is an unexpected gem in Harlem - meticulously furnished and designed and it has a wonderful garden. If you are not only looking for a great host, but also someone that is deeply immersed in the life and the culture of the city - Kurt is your man - luckily he is ready share his knowledge with his guests. We are very glad to have stayed with him.

Staying at Kurt's place will immerge you in the spirit of Harlem's rennaissance and will provide to you and your family a safe home sweet home location to recover from full days spent in great Manhattan. Kurt brings great attention to his tenants and drives his place with great personal and professional care.
If you dream of visiting one the most amazing city in the world by waking up first thing in the morning at the melody of one of hundreeds Kurt's local Harlem Jazz vynil disc available with thousands other books in the appartment, this is the place to stay at.

Kurt is a wonderful host. Very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. It's an inspiration to stay in his bookshop surrounded by history. The neighbourhood is quite and nice, easy transport, sightseeing, music etc. It's also suitable for traveling with kids. We have two girls at 3 + 5 and they loved the 3 weeks we stayed with Kurt.

Thank you Kurt. You didn't just open your doors late on Christmas Eve to a family of unseasoned travellers ...you shared with us a most special view of New York heritage and culture,  past and present.  Your beautiful building was very stately yet comfortable. The streetscape is charming and the neighbourhood very safe with convenient access to shops and transport. Thank you for your kindness and hospitality. We will be recommending your accomodation to all our friends, and will return again ourselves for sure.

科特的房子充满艺术气息，是一个私人图书馆改造，如图片所示，空间很大，设施齐全。我们住在一层，他与妻子住在上层，给了我们无微不至的帮助。
找车位稍微出现了一些麻烦，但是科特真的很好，耐心帮我一起寻找，最后很幸运在屋子门外等到一个完美车位。
这里位于纽约曼哈顿的上城，位于地铁15分钟步程，建议还是坐地铁会方便些。
周围有野生的小浣熊非常生态，整个房子布置的很文艺，但是十分干净。
他给了我们所有能给我们的帮助，我们交流很通畅愉快，语言不是问题，我们甚至谈了政治。
下次有机会希望能多住几天，在这里居住，是非常适合了解纽约文化的地方。

This is just the best place!  My family was in NY to celebrate a wedding.  Four of us stayed quite comfortably here.  The beds were fabulous—great mattresses and linen sheets. Kurt checked to see what we might like in the fridge for breakfast, and it was ready with coffee, fruit, and bagels when we arrived.  There is a lovely back garden lit with tiny lights, comfortable seating; it is a place to relax.  Inside Kurt’s brownstone, every room is filled with books and photos of literary people and music.  There is so much to look at.  Kurt was very helpful to us as we also hosted a brunch and were able to rent two other floors if his house. Our guests were most impressed too and they had a fabulous time.  Communication was flawless.  I can’t recommend Kurt’s house highly enough.
Kurt went above and beyond.  An amazing and fascinating human.  Gracious, open, friendly, kind hearted.   I felt right at home.  5 STARS and more!

We really enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere of this eclectic space, very comfortable apartment with all the amenities. Lots to look at and peruse. Beautiful backyard garden space. Kurt is easily available and a wealth of information.

Wow! It’s simply beautiful and should be a historical landmark of Harlem.

It’s inspiring, stylish, clean, romantic, functional, spacious and ideal for visitors of all types.

The space was comfortable, eclectic and unique all rolled into one!

Kurt is the perfect host...
Courteous, responsive, resourceful and meant to host. He makes me proud to be a New Yorker after hosting my guests and making everything great for them and me!

Kurt, I’m happy to know you, never change! As a super bonus, if you like books, you are in for a treat.

Kurt, you superstar host!

One of the best things about my trip to New York was meeting Cynthia. Waking up to her blending her famous 'happy juice' or arriving home to hear about her latest home project after a long day exploring New York was refreshing. Simply, we clicked like sisters...and were never at a loss to find things to talk about. As numerous other guests have said, her place is an inspiration to anyone artistic. It's a continual work in progress with creative ideas flowing. The two weeks I spent with her flew by. As it was, we ran out of time for Raman noodles! If you're looking for a place to stay where you immediately feel like you're with family or a close friend, this is the place. She's spotlessly clean and graciously attends to any needs you may have. If I have the opportunity to use Airbnb again, I can only hope I find a host as amazing as Cynthia. Thank-you 'Mama' for a great introduction to New York. Until I see you again... :)

October, 2012
hard to better. great location, easy to get around, safe and historically fascinating neighborhood. Spacious property with all amenities, fascinating and helpful host.

A warm and very comfortable place to stay. The location is rich in history and is an easy place to travel downtown from.
Kurt is a wonderful host and we would definitely recommend this accommodation without hesitation. We’ll be back!

El apartamento de Kurt es tal cual como se ve en las fotos. Esta en la zona alta de Harlem y tiene un encanto especial, es historia americana pura el recorrer esas calles y el estar dentro de ese apartamento.
El depa tiene todo lo necesario para pasar una agradable estancia y Kurt es un anfitrión excelente.
Sin duda es recomendable 100%
Such an amazing place! Kurt was more than helpful during my stay. Highly recommend!!

My family of five just stayed at Kurt’s place for a week over the holidays.  We weren’t there much, but it was warm with plenty of hot water, and convenient to subway and dining.  Great book collection and fantastic ambience!

This is not just any Airbnb. Kurt’s place is special: from the cozy, history-steeped and book-rich interior to the peaceful and truly beautiful outdoor garden area. We celebrated our daughter’s Columbia commencement here with family and close friends: staying in the apartment for a total of 5 days/4 nights. We couldn’t have picked a better place. The ease of the walk to the 157th street stop on the 1, to the great Mexican food on the corner that totally came through with food for our party, to the quiet, we’ll-stocked kitchen and comfortable beds that easily slept five of us: we just loved it. Kurt went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable, and adds much to the stay via his true love for the neighborhood’s rich culture and history. Absolutely stay here!

Such a charming New York experience! If you want to know what it’s like to live as a “New Yorker,” Kurt’s place is for you. We are a family of five, teens included, and everyone had enough space to feel comfortable. The character and charm of the apartment, as well as the amenities, are far better than you’ll find in a hotel. Kurt is the nicest to work with, and communicated with us quickly, so we never felt alone while in NY. Since he is from the area, and is onsite, he expertise is such a bonus. He gave us advice on some “must see” sites and this really gave us a full experience. I would definitely recommend Kurt’s apartment and would love to return in the future.
Fabulous neighborhood, love the detailed black history library which is all over the space in an eclectic way and the garden is a dream.

You just can't imagine how wonderful Kurt and Camilla's place was.  I just can't say enough wonderful things about it.  The record selection was beyond amazing as were the acoustics.  The books covering everything from Slavery to Human Rights to Cooking to Theater to you name it...just wow.  It was peaceful and the amenities were beyond terrific.  The garden was a treat and the dining tips were super.  The neighborhood was great.  Like I said, I just can't say enough.  You have to pick Kurt's place the next time you go to New York.
Kurt was a great host with excellent communication. The apartment is exactly as the pictures suggest and is really convenient for the subway!

This is a very special place. We have been staying in certain Airbnb locations before but we never found a house like this. Kurt is an amazing host. He is an extraordinary personality with a higly interesting past. You will love to listening to him. And he loves books and you can feel it in every corner of the house. It is not an usual holiday apartment - this is a home in the most exciting city of the world. It was a great pleasure for us to meet Kurts wife Camilla, too. They are both very inspiring people.
The apartment itself is beautiful and charming. We were four and have been staying there for 10 days. A supermarket and the Subway are just around the corner. If you take an Express Line it takes less than 25 minutes from Kurts place to 42nd Street. If you have got the chance to book this apartment - do it. It will be an unique experience. We highly recommend it.

There are simply no words for how magical our stay was. I have been to NY more times than I can count but Kurt’s hospitality and the history of the home were so inspiring.

As an avid lover of books and old records, Kurt’s home was instantly the things written about in movies and described in poems.

I will no doubt stay again and spend more time reading the books, listening to the records and learning more about the magic that made NYC the incredible city that it is.

The place is a real gem. It’s a ground floor apartment in a red brick, right across the street from a historical mansion, a short walk from the subway, with groceries and restaurants nearby. The apartment used to be a bookstore specialising in black history - lots to read in your spare time! The owner lives upstairs and you couldn’t wish for a more knowledgeable and welcoming host. There’s also a very friendly kitty who likes to visit if you let him in. A very New York experience.
Kurt's place was absolutely wonderful and we had a lovely 4 day stay. Kurt was super friendly, knowledgable and the perfect host for such a unique home. I highly recommend you book this place!
My stay was great.  Waldemar was very welcoming, great communication.  Perfect location.
This location is just as depicted. The hosts were welcoming and kind. We felt comfortable in their home, we had close access to the subway and was only a short car ride to LaGuardia.

Waldemar’s place is just wonderful. I usually stay in places where I’ve got the whole place to myself—this is as close as it gets to that in a private room listing. The en suite bathroom and private deck makes it really feel like your own space. I would not hesitate to stay here again will definitely  recommend it to anyone else. Waldemar and his sister are gracious hosts and really cool humans. The location is the perfect home base for city explorations, especially if you plan to go around Brooklyn and Manhattan. Super close train and bus stations.

We loved our stay at Waldemar's Airbnb. It was easy to communicate with him and he gave us some good tips about the neighbourhood. We really enjoyed the balcony in the backyard where we sat every night. There were so many beautiful plants there and we felt like we were in a park setting.
The neighbourhood is amazing. We always felt safe, even at night and loved the diversity it offered. There was a grocery store, an amazing cafe, a convenience store and a street with many other restaurants nearby. Several subway stations were within easy walking distance.
We would definitely stay here again.
Lovely and spacious room in a great location. Would stay here again!
Excellent spot, great host, I am a repeat visitor

Very accessible neighbourhood near metro + restaurants, very walk-able. Beautiful home with tall ceilings and plenty of room to stretch out. I wouldn't call it luxurious but an authentic NYC brownstone in a lively neighbourhood with lotsa character and charm. Waldamer and Beverly were very courteous and polite :)
