Perfect spot in a perfect location!
Our stay was comfortable. The house is well located and close to NYC subway lines. Good options to eat in the vicinity.
Very friendly hosts!

Great stay at Waldemar’s place. Room and bathroom were spacious and we enjoyed the deck outside as well. Communication was quick and easy and the location is fantastic. Kind and friendly host, would definitely recommend and stay again.
Lovely home, beautiful room, clean and secure place, fabulous location and attentive host. I recommend Waldemar and his Airbnb highly!

Waldemars place is perfect for a visit with a kid who is at Pratt, it is literally across the street. Room is big and appreciated the door to the back patio. Subway right out side the front door, great restaurants and coffee shops steps away.

Thanks for lovely visit.

Pippa
Charming!

Checkin instructions were very clear, it was easy to find the building and know not to go up the stairs that lead to the neighboring apt. Upon our arrival, Waldemar showed us to the room and walked us through how to use the front door. The room was very similar to the photos. Plenty of room, high ceilings, double sinks in the bathroom was a huge plus. It should be noted that this home is older, so along with its charm and character, there were definitely lots of creaks when walking around the room. On a Saturday night, we could hear the neighboring apartment until about 11pm (not bothersome for us). After that the room was very quiet. Room felt very private. The stairway up to the room is very narrow and there are also stairs up to the bathroom in the room. The room can be locked from the inside, but not from the outside. Not an issue for us, but might be for some. Plenty of hot water and fresh towels, soap and shampoo, but no drain plug for tub. G and C trains were very accessible.
All good. 2nd time staying there. I recommend it.
My stay at Waldemar's was very enjoyable. He was very friendly and helpful.  The room was clean and quiet and  the bed was very comfortable.  I would definitely stay there again!

Cynthia, oh Cynthia. How can I start about her and her lovely home?
Well it all really is perfect. She is a very thoughtful hostess: she makes ‘happy juice’ every day, she is talkative, inviting, patient, interesting and warm.
Her home is just gorgeous, being an Interior Designer myself, I totally fell in love with the whole European flair and uniqueness of this lovely and well located apartment in a safe and nice area in the Upper East.
You just can’t ask for more. An experience I am so thankful for having!

As everyone has said, Cynthia's place is beautiful and she is great fun. I regret that I was out and about so much that I didn't have much time to chat.  But that said, the place is perfect for social folks who want to get out and around. It's convenient to the subway, there are restaurants in the area, and the apartment is clean. Cynthia is a wonderful host. It's not the place for someone who wants to spend a great deal of time in their room alone. The room is small (but has plenty of room for all your stuff and a comfortable bed), and even with all the lights on, it's quite dark. But who goes to New York to stay in their room! The living room is wonderful and bright and comfortable, so if you have work to do you can sit in there. I'd definitely stay here again.

Staying at Cynthia's apartment was an amazing experience, as not only is it perfectly located, but it's a beautiful, restful space to reside in. Cynthia made amazing smoothies every morning, and was a perfect host to hang out with. Everything in her apartment was geared towards making my stay as comfortable as possible. I would definetely recommend her apartment and I would also stay there again.
You do require some athleticism to climb into the bed space, but this didn't cause an issue for me.

My stay at Cynthia was simply fantastic. The location could not be better. Only a block away from the subway station. Three blocks away from central park... How about a walk in the park? Yes, please!! Plenty of restaurants, coffee shops (Yes, including Starbucks for those of you who are not willing to support small but great businesses). Cleaners, delis, clothing stores, barber shops... You get my point!.
The actual place is UNIQUE. I doubt that many places in NYC are as nice as this little apartment. The building, like many in NYC is old but very well kept. Cynthia's apartment is beautiful. Small but so well organized and decorated that every little corner has personality. Cynthia is an artist and she is constantly working on her apartment and expressing her art throughout the entire place. The room is small but I was amazed with how much she was able to accomplish in that little space. She certainly has been able to create the feeling of an entire bedroom in the two cozy niches she has put together. She is a smart and charismatic lady. Always concerned about one's comfort. I enjoyed every conversation I had with her as she did not hesitate to share her thoughts on any given subject. Her fruit smoothies are just great and energetic. The perfect start for every morning.
I can go on and on about this place but let just put it simply. Go ahead and book. You will not be disappointed. It will add to your whole experience next time you are in NYC.

Cynthia was the perfect host for me. She took me out and about, showed me around the area and filled me in on pretty much everything that I needed to know for my first time here in New York. Her home is absolutely stunning!

Cynthia was a great host! I really enjoyed my stay. Her home is situated in a great location right by the subway. She was very helpful and gave lots of suggestions for good restaurants. Highly recommend for any traveler.

Beautiful and comfy oasis in perfect location!
Cynthia is a lovely, accommodating hostess. Loved waking to smoothies in the morning! Best Cuban coffee is around the corner at Judy's. CVS literally at the corner for any last minute items you might have forgotten. Easy subway access.
All expectations fulfilled-- beautiful apartment, gracious host, delicious morning smoothie, wonderful conversation, practical help with whatever was needed.

Cynthia is a very friendly,warm and a very easy person to get on with.She was very welcoming and made my stay in New York city very pleasant.I got a really bad cold when I was in NY,Cynthia really looked after me and made sure I was back on my feet sight seeing again!
Her apartment is a work of art clean and comfortable even her bins are vintage!!!
Love love that apartment ( I still cant decide which is my fav room between the bathroom,the kitchen or the living room...)
If you are looking for a comfortable,great location apartment with a great friendly host I would def. recommend Cynthia's apartment.
Thanks again Cynthia for making my stay in NY city very memeorable!!!!

Jennifer's place is the perfect spot to stay in New York City. Its location is super convenient for all the fun things that are happening in Manhattan and Brooklyn.

The apartment itself is really clean & private, has all of the kitchen and bathroom essentials, and the bedroom is very cozy. It felt like our own home in NYC.

Smeagol is the coolest cat to hang out with; he made the trip a lot more fun. He was a great host.

Thanks a lot, Jennifer! We'll definitely be coming back.

I had a wonderful time staying with Cynthia! Beautiful apartment perfectly located in a great neighbourhood. As a host, Cynthia is helpful, warm and extremely welcoming and relaxed. I will definitely stay again!

Cynthia was an incredible host. She was warm, and kind, inviting me to gallery openings, taking me for runs on Central Park, and helping me plan my subway rides each day. The house is gorgeous, quiet, and unique. I slept wonderfully in the Blue Room, and Cynthia sweetly accommodated my early to bed, early to rise schedule. I'll be reaching out to her any time I'm in NYC. .

My second time to NYC & first time solo; also my first time using Airbnb. I am very glad I stayed at Cynthia's. I would highly recommend staying here if you want to get away from the "touristy" part of the city & explore the neighbourhoods. She is right in the heart of the Upper East Side. It was a wonderful stay. Here is my review: long & hopefully detailed enough. Cynthia as a host was fantastic. She had booked a car service for me to & from the airport (cheaper than a cab), & greeted me with open arms when I arrived. She immediately struck up conversation; this girl can talk, & her conversations are intriguing & wonderful. She respected that I wasn't a morning person, & kept quiet in the mornings. She let me borrow her umbrella during the one day that it poured. She gave me a subway map & explained the lines to me. She provided me with a list of nearby cafe's, restaurants, & grocery stores. She also gave me the low down on what's up with the museum admissions... I suggest staying with her if you want to know about that as well. Overall, she was very kind & helpful & I appreciated it all. The apartment itself looks exactly like the photos & is so thoughtfully & artistically designed & detailed. It was also extremely clean! Staying here was an experience in itself. Keep in mind the "no shoes in the apartment" rule is a strict one; all shoes are kept outside. Cynthia walks around barefoot, & I was comfortable doing the same, but if you aren't, make sure to bring socks or slippers. I found the loft very comfortable after my days of wandering around. There is an air conditioner up there that you have control over, which was very nice. The room was small but cozy, & the only thing worth mentioning is that the walls of the room & loft do not go all the way up to the ceiling so you will hear everything in the apartment. Also, the door to the room is see-through, so you do not have 100% privacy. Changing in the little dressing room was a bit tough for me at 5'4" tall; consider changing in the bathroom if you are taller. The rest of the apartment is perfect. The area is wonderful. A pharmacy & Starbucks & a subway station within a block walk; Central Park steps away with the Reservoir greeting you when you enter. Museum Mile is close as well. Getting down to Brooklyn Bridge took about 20 minutes on the express lines & another 5 down to Bowling Green & Battery Park. Not too difficult to get to Times Square either. Overall, fantastic location. Lots of cute shops & places to eat. Very non-touristy feeling. I will be contacting Cynthia again if I ever need a place to stay in NYC. 5 star rating from me; fantastic stay. Would highly recommend....

Great location - close to some awesome foodie spots and the numerous LES bars without too much disturbance at night. The space is nice and fairly open, especially with the windows. Residents themselves are very quiet and mostly families. Heat is building-maintained so it's always warm; just pop a window open if it gets too stuffy.

However, make sure you like cats (in the sense that you will be interacting with one, not just looking at it)! Smeagol is very affectionate and will want to be played with/picked up. If the thought of a cat brushing up against you freaks you out, then this is not an ideal apartment for you. Just remember to hang your wool coats out of reach and tuck your suitcases in the bedroom if you don't want cat hair on them.
The host canceled my reservation 14 days before arrival.

We've been staying 3 nights in Jennifer's apt in may 2011 and everything was perfect.
It is well located in Lower east side in Chinatown, the subway is just 3 blocks away, 5min walking. It will bring you to Time Square in 20min. You have many shops and nice restaurants around. You have internet (bring your laptop) and everything you need to make your own food if you don't want to spend too much money eating outside.
The room is quite big and the bed is comfortable.

We came by car and left it in a 24h parking on Allen street for 27$ per day, which is not so bad for NY.

Jenn is a terrific host! Her friendly and welcoming energy made our stay an absolute delight! Her place is clean and secure with a lovely balcony. It's close to great restaurants, the subway and shops. The building's super is a splendid fellow and Jenn's cat is a totally cool dude, a pleasure to have around and look after.

Jennifer's place was amazing! Convenient location to shopping, eating, subways, etc. I felt safe the entire time and had no problems getting there, finding a place to eat, or anything else during the week I stayed. Smeagol the cat who I shared the place with was no problem at all as I didn't have to work around my schedule to feed him. As long as your interact with him a few time everyday you'll be fine. The price is perfect and I'll definitely be staying here again as I highly recommend staying here.
We spent 2 weeks in this cozy apartment, for us a perfect starting point to enjoy NYC. We practice Yoga, and it's a walkable distance from some of best yoga school in NY.

Jennifer's place is amazing! It's located in a perfect position in Manhattan, close to Subway (there is also the Line J, directly linked to Airtrain to JFK airport)...with a nice walk you can arrive everywhere in Downtown.
Jennifer gave us very good suggestions on markets, restaurants, and cafes.
The home is clean and comfortable and everything was as expected. Smeagol is a lovely cat.
We would stay in Jennifer place any time we come back to NYC !

Very nice experience!!!
The place is cozy and clean, the position is good (only a few blocks from subways) and the company of the cats has been very funny... but most of all Jennifer kindness, before our arrive (and her assistant during our stay).
Really nothing was wrong or under our expectation.
I will recomend Jennifer's place for sure, and i hope to be her guest in future.
Thank you Jennifer

Lovely apartment in a secure building. Friendly superintendent was very helpful. It was a pleasure to look after Jennifer's 2 cats :)
convenient location for Chinatown. Lots of places to eat even late at night.
A bit far from central locations like Times Square but easy to get to by subway. but walk able to places like Greenwich Village and
Little Italy is also very close.
We stayed for 5 nights and it was good to feel like a local and away from an ordinary hotel.

We stayed at Jennifer's place for 2 weeks and had a great time. The apartment has a lot of natural light coming in and is very open.
Everything was clean when we got there and the place is not crowded at all.

Train access is very convenient, 2 short blocks away from the F line.
The neighborhood itself is very nice with plenty of good restaurants (Joe's Shanghai is a 10 minute walk away, so is Inoteca) and anything you could need (Whole Foods within walking distance as well).
Her two kittens are beautiful and very playful, getting more and more friendly as time goes by and we were really sad to leave them.

Communication with Jen and her assistant Marianna was perfect, they were available throughout our entire stay and King, the building's super was really nice and helpful.

We'd definitely come again. Thanks!

First, the appartment : exactly as shown on the pictures, exactly that you need for 2 people, with a separate bedroom and a dining-room.
The neighborhood is safe nights and days, the nearest subway station is about 100 meters, the bus station also, and you are near Chinatown with many restaurants and groceries. You can also walk to the restaurants of East Village and you have a good market at Essex street.
The 2 cats are very friendly and it's really a plus to play with Stinker (the black) and Smeagol (the red), if you love animals.
I did'nt met Jennifer but we had discussions with mails before the rental, and she is a very pleasant person.
In the building, there is a superintendant named M. King very helpfull.

In conclusion : if you need a perfect appartment for 2 in Manhattan, close from transportations, and also if you love cats, do'nt hesitate to rent Jennifer's appartment (if available).

Great place, great hostess. We will definitely be coming back over and over.
thanks!
Alli was a friendly and considerate host. We enjoyed our stay at her place. It was nice and quiet too.

Our host was a very welcoming host and provided everything we needed, as well as offering help on how to get around the city etc.

The studio space was lovely and clean, with plenty of space, and the subway is just a short walk away.

We had an excellent stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay again.

Myself, my partner and our two little ones from Australia stayed with Alli in Fort Greene/Clinton Hill for 9 nights in April. Everything about the stay was awesome.

Our host was a brilliant host who went out of her way with all the little touches (eg. home made cookies to greet us) and was a lovely, lovely person to stay with. Very helpful, very kind.

The room was fantastic. Very clean, very cosy, beautifully decorated and lots of room to spread out for our small family.

The area was awesome. The apartment is in a lovely, quiet street. Very convenient to everything (several subway options within a 5 minute walk), the best flea market I've ever experienced (literally around the corner on a Saturday) and loads of restaurant options just around the corner.

Highly recommended. If we get to New York again, we'll definitely be looking to stay here again!

Great place, quiet, close to the subwayif you wanna go to manhattan and in the center of one of the most beautiful architectural places in Brooklyn. Safe and close to one of the most beautiful nightviews from Manhattan (Peer 1 at the brooklyn peer park) Dumbo, etc...

Alli was also a great hostess! she and her Family made me feel like at home in NY.

great place I'll recommend to everyone who wanna stay in NY.
lovely

The Waverly was the perfect place for my adult son and I to stay while visiting Pratt Institute and exploring Brooklyn and Mahattan over five days. The studio was cool place to return to after a hot day of exploration of the city. We had all the comforts of a more expensive hotel room, with the added bonus of feeling like we were part of a very nice community. Alli and her son were great host,  very hospitable, informative and  very respectable of our privacy. I would stay at the Waverly again.

Our host was very warm and welcoming.  It is a very neat and comfortable room.  One of the main benefits was that it was a downstairs room that remained cool and you did not have to climb numerous stairs to access the room.  The subway into Manhattan was only two blocks away and was a direct line into the city.

Ali is a charming host and made our first NYC experience very pleasant from the drinks in our room when we arrived to the provisions for our first breakfast.  We especially enjoyed having the garden area where we could sit at a table with a glass of wine after a busy day.  Thanks for your restuarant tips too Ali
The room is comfortable and spacious. Sahr is a delightful lady. She provided us with delicious, home-made cookies and made us  very welcome. We would stay there again without hesitation.

Ali’s Place
We could not have been more pleased with our stay at Ali’s place. Although we looked quickly at the reviews, which were all great, our goal was to be at a place close to our son who had been injured in an accident and was released from the Hospital to further recuperate at his apartment. Proximity was the primary goal.
Ali’s physical place was everything all have said before, spotless, well cared for and just right; nevertheless, it was Ali, herself who made a significant difference for us. Known for her greeting goodies, she changed that upon learning my dietary limitations. She expressed care and understanding for our circumstances and helped us as a friend though a difficult period. She made suggestions for local assistance from drive services, to food services, to dealing with the police to get the accident report. To us (way older) she was a mother, a helper and guide. Careful not to be intrusive, she made sure that we were ok and offered helpful suggestions about how to deal with our son’s recuperation.
Ali’s Place was for us a home away from home and she was generous and giving. Great place, great host. It doesn’t get any better than this!

I stayed here for a week and the place was great. Clean and i got mini cupcakes and juice on arrival! Location was awesome also as it was minutes from the metro and a short walk to Fort Greene and Atlantic Ave.

I had a great stay with Sahr. The space is a very good size and she has a number of amenities, including silverware, cookware, a private half bath, extra futon for sleeping and a stocked refridgerator all to yourself. The neighborhood is lovely, with some cute restaurants and cafes, and it's just a short walk to Atlantic station where you can catch most trains you need to get around the city (some trains don't run in Brooklyn on the weekends--the C and G are very, very close but have spotty weekend service).

I had a great two-week stay at Ali’s place, conveniently located in the beautiful Clinton Hill; one of the nicest neighbourhoods you’ll find in Brooklyn, filled with historic townhouse architecture.
The location was very close to both the C and G train that made traversing around Manhattan and Brooklyn a fast and easy experience.

I find when traveling to New York City, the best place is to stay is Brooklyn. When the sights and scenes of Manhattan are done for the day it’s nice to retreat back to a less intense place to stay. Filled with better bars, food and people.

Ali was a fantastic host, she provided me with plenty of information on things to see and do around the local areas and Manhattan as well as travel information and directions. My flights were delayed and she was still very welcoming at the 2am arrival time with tea and cakes and a stocked fridge waiting for me in my room.

The room itself was huge, exactly as you see from the photos. It’s clean and tidy, you get your own half bathroom with your private full bathroom upstairs. You have basic cooking utensils, cutlery, glasses and plates, a fridge and tv with cable. It’s private and just what I wanted.

I would defiantly recommend it to others and I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

This accommodation is brilliant and the warm welcome into a family home that is full of fun, laughter and love makes you sad to leave! Sahr is hilarious and her son delightful. They are warm and welcoming. If there is one place to stay in NYC, make it this one and you will be well looked after.

Staying at 430 Waverly was a wonderful experience. I stayed for a full week and felt very comfortable and grateful for a calm and quiet place to be while visiting family in the city. Sahr made check in very easy and welcoming. The apartment fridge is filled with juice, water, lemonade, snacks and light breakfast supplies. The apartment is photographed and described very accurately. She is very respectful towards her guests and made it clear that she was open to hearing any concerns or issues though I had none. There are wonderful parks, playgrounds, restaurants, coffee spots, and easy subway access very nearby. I would absolutely recommend staying here to anyone and hope to stay here again on my next visit to the city.

From the moment i walked into the apartment i knew this was a different kind of airbnb experience. The interior decoration is beautiful and each room looks great in its own unique way, with chandeliers, mosaics and chic modern art all around.

Cynthia is a generous and kind person who went out of her way to make my five days in New York as fun and easy as it could possibly be. There are lots of grocery stores, restaurants, and things to do in the area, and walking around was pretty safe at night. Central Park is a five minute walk, the subway is 90 seconds away, and there's also the metro museum of art about a 15 minute walk away. All really convenient, but if you'll be spending most of your time downtown then lower Manhattan is very easy to get to in about 20-25 minutes on the subway, and Times Square is about the same with one train transfer on the way.

Cynthia was extremely considerate and always thinking ahead - she really is a wonderful host in what many might see as an intimidating city. New York is a great city full of predominantly great people, and Cynthia really made it feel that way as soon as i got there - after the first night i was more than comfortable and really enjoyed myself, when maybe i would have been a bit tentative going out at night by myself, it was great. I absolutely loved my stay and will be trying to make sure that all my friends stay with Cynthia when visiting this great city in the future.

The best place to stay in NYC! Cynthia is a wonderful person, and her house is very clean and beautiful. It was my first experience using Airbnb and  I absolutely loved it!  I slept wonderfully in the Frette sheets and her towels are great too, as everything else in the apt. Great neighbourhood, I will definitely stay again!

Five stars! I'm a first time Airbnb user and wasn't certain what to expect; I'm so glad I picked Cynthia's location. The room was exactly as pictured and promised. This apartment is a dream, very well-loved and cared for, and the location is fantastic. Cynthia provided me with fantastic restaurant suggestions, directions, shopping destinations- I felt immediately at home. This will be my new UES location of choice.

Cynthia is a wonderful host! Friendly, helpful, did everything she could to make my stay comfortable, easy, and memorable. Her home is beautiful, albeit eccentric, and tip-top clean. The shower is great, I felt at home in the kitchen making tea and helping myself to cereal, the bed was very comfortable and linens exquisite and it's quiet quiet quiet at night. Location is great too -- an easy subway ride downtown, walkable to Guggenheim and Met, good restaurants in the hood, I felt fine walking home late at night too. I recommend it and would stay again.

I had an amazing time at Cynthia's place in Manhattan.

Cynthia is an honest person and full of energy, willing to have interesting conversations about any subject you or she pops up. She helped me getting to her place from the AirPort and responds to email on à Really short notice.

When I arrived she showed me around in the neighbourhood, gave me a metrocard and explained me how to get on the train. The place is very close to all of the major things to see in NY.

Her place is totally clean and is flourishing with her own art., if thats your thing you would be amazed. Otherwise, it's stil very Nice and interesting to see.

In other words, Cynthia is an amazing person to spend your time in NY with, the place has à very good location is totally clean, and the city ofcourse is wonderful. This is an outstanding place to stay, I would recommend it to anyone.
What an amazing host. Caring and looking after your every need. I cannot recommend Cynthia or this listing highly enough.

We felt really welcome at Waverly. There were cupcakes,  refreshments and breakfast rready waiting for us. The place was really clean and yes, very spacious. Sahr and her son made us feel comfortable and  at home still totally respecting our privacy. And the boutique and the clothes! Looking forward to meeting you again

A great apartment in a fantastic location! The perfect way to see NYC - clean, spacious and the two loving cats made it feel very homely. Close to transport, excellent restaurants and thriving nightlife.
Jennifer was a fantastic host and made us feel very welcome. We will definitely be staying here again!

Nice and lovely apartment. Spacious and clean. Bed is a futon, but very comfortable.
The 2 cats are great and very well behaved.
Location is perfect. subway stop is 2 minutes walk away. there are shops and restaurants very close by (we loved the Fat Radish!) and the main "going out" area in lower east side is about 4-5 blocks away, which is brilliant!
The street and surrenders are safe; a bit noisy on the early morning when local shops vans bring their products, but nothing major.It's Manhattan!!
Jennifer and Marianna where very helpful with everything and made our stay very easy. not a problem getting the keys and leaving the apartment.
Overall a great experience and very happy with everything.

Jennifer is a fantastic host! Her Assistant Marianna has been available for everithing during our staying. The apartment is situated very close to subway station. The two cats Made our journey really funny, we played and cuddeled them, Also slept with them! We definitively recommend Jennifer place to everybody Who is in love with cats! We were Sad to leave them as they have been an important part of our holiday.
Once again, thank you so much Jennifer

We needed somewhere reasonably priced and homely for a three-week stay in New York, and found it here in Jen's beautiful clean and light apartment, with her two adorable cats.

We loved staying here - very close and convenient to a subway station, just around the corner from very vibrant and trendy parts of town, and nice and quiet to get a good night's rest in.

Couldn't recommend this more highly. Jen is great to deal with, and so professional. Her doorman is also very welcoming and accommodating.

We'd definitely stay here again if we got the chance.

Jennifer was a great host. Unfortunately, we couldn't meet, but she took care of everything and replied to all our emails as soon as she could. King, the super, helped a lot, too! The apartment is clear, well furnished and the cats are so nice! We really had a great stay. Can't wait to come back!

Jennifer has a nice home she's very professional with her tenants. Everything was clean and tidy as we moved in.
The cats are cute and fun to play with just be sure you want to deal with cats in small space, it takes some extra time to take care of cleaning. That's why it's a more reasonable rent.
The area is nice with lots of Galleries and great Restaurants and shops nearby. The building is very quiet and well kept from a really nice Super.

We really enjoyed our stay at Jennifer's place. She was a lovely host and the cats very also nice, well behaving companionship. The apartment is very well located, nice restaurants at a walking distance, and subway at a convenient distance to reach the center uptown. I would happily suggest anyone to stay at her place for a great stay at NY.

A great apartment so comfortable and bright in the best neighborhood in the city. The cats are so lovely and will make you feel so at home. I wish Jennifer didn't come home I could have stayed there forever.

Our days at Jennifers House were wonderful and just perfect. Her place is very nice and the cats are lovely. Its clean und you have fresh towels and everything else what you need. We also really enjoyed the balcony, its perfect for sit outside a while and enjoy whats going on in the street. Its very quiet  and save area. also king, the manager from the house is very nice. Jennifer answer always very fast and she was more then nice to us. i can recommend highly this place and i really hope i can go back. the metro station its just 2 minutes walk, you can also walk to chinatown, brooklin bridge, little italy, soho, financial district. Thank you so much for everything.

We stayed at Jennifer´s place for a couple of days and were very happy with the apartment. The location was perfect, ideal for going around Downtown, with very nice cafes and bars nearby. The bed was very comfortable and we had everything we needed to survive in the flat.
We didn´t meet Jennifer, because she was traveling but we were welcomed and taken care of by King , the super of the building. He made sure that we were comfortable and Jennifer was always reachable by phone whenever we had questions.
The kitties were adorable, it was very easy to communicate with them, and they were very playful once the initial shyness was over.
Overall it was a very nice experience and we would recommend staying here without a doubt!
Thank you so much Jennifer, Smeagol and Stinker!
Splendid apartment in a great location. The cats are awesome and quite playful. A+ would stay again.

We stayed in Jennifer's apartment for 3 weeks and it was fabulous. It was in a great location. Close to Subway stations, restaurants and a grocery store. It's also walking distance of Chinatown and SOHO.

Even though our arrival was delayed, Jennifer met us upon arrival and gave us a run down of the place. Her apartment is neat and clean air conditioning and a nice balcony to relax on.

The apartment super King, is great. He was very happy to help and have a chat when we had questions to ask.

Jennifer was a great host, and was in contact to see if we needed anything. Would definitely stay at Jennifer's again!

I had a great time staying at Cynthia's place! She was such a great host! She was helpful, friendly, and made my trip in New York so memorable :) And the house is beautiful, clean, and extremely cozy. I'll definitely go back! :D
That's what I call home in NY. Did I already say it? =)
A great location to stay and lovely host.  Particularly liked the Mexican restaurant (Cynthia's local). I went back the following night on my way back for a busy day out!
Cynthia is a wonderful person and a great host. The location is ideal. Her place is clean, comfortable, and an artistic experience. I definitely plan to return!

I had a great stay with Cynthia. She is smart, helpful and very quick to respond to queries. She makes a delicious breakfast that kept me energised during a pretty exhausting week. The apartment is beautiful and scrupulously clean. The room is small but perfect and the bed is up some steps and really comfortable (but not advisable if you have mobility problems).
Good location, close to restaurants and subway. I felt fine coming back to the apartment at night by myself. All in all, a brilliant experience.

Cynthia was the nicest host I could expect, and she made me to feel at home. The house is really stylish and was a warm place to rest inside that very cold city. If I go back to NYC, I will know where to stay.
Thanks a lot Cynthia!
Cynthia is a generous and engaging hostess and her home is itself a work of art. She like having people around.

Clean affordable place, very comfortable bed for me, convenient 1-block to Lex train to mid-town, good neighborhood, 24-hour produce store on corner, quiet space to work in living room with wi-fi, good capable host with good quiet work can be done in apartment, but the fun conversation is there if you want it.  Thumbs up.

Jennifer was a great host! She made sure everything was prepared for our stay and was very easy to reach. The apartment was clean, accurate to the description, and in one of the best neighborhoods that you could be living in Manhattan. The almighty F train is literally 2 blocks away and is a great subway line to cross into Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhattan.

If your intention is to travel across the boroughs, see the city, but want to reside in a convenient, cool, and quiet part of town, I'd highly suggest Jennifer's apartment.

The neighborhood itself is hip, but at the same time quaint. Within literally one block, there's a one-of-a-kind pharmacy/cafe (Stanley's), a classic Americana coffee shop that has been open since the 1970's, and a lively Brazilian bar where my girlfriend and I had a number of truly memorable nights (Barzinho). Just Foursquare what's around you and you'll soon find out that there are many gems to be found in terms of food, culture, and nightlife.

My girlfriend and I can't express how memorable this trip was. Many thanks to Jennifer for sharing her space and her neighborhood with us.

I had a great experience staying at Jennifer's apartment.

Jennifer was very responsive ahead of my arrival and was very accommodating with my late check-in. When early cold weather and malfunctioning building heating arrived, Jennifer promptly arranged for a space heater to delivered-

The apartment was clean and as pictured (minus the shelf in the bedroom), with ample storage space (completely empty drawer chest and closet).

The area, on the border between the Lower East Side and Chinatown, is full of restaurants and bars and walking distance from Little Italy, SoHo, East Village, and the Financial District. Several subways where 5min walking distance.

Overall, would certainly recommend!

It was a real pleasure dealing with Jennifer. She was very friendly and always answered back quickly. Same goes for the superintendent of the building, King, who let me in when I arrived. He was nice to have a little chat with in the lobby when I got home at night.
The area is great! I love LES. It's calmer than many other neighborhoods in the city, yet there is always something exciting going on. Lots of good restaurants, take away places (mostly chinese and vietnamese, but little Italy is within walking distance) and shopping such as Fine Fare and Essex Street Market.
The apartment is nice and bright and have a lot closet/drawer space for your clothes. When I was there, Jennifer had moved a lot of the furniture you see in the pictures to her studio. There were also very few kitchen appliances and utensils (fx only 1 pot and no spatula or kettle for boiling water even though it shows in the photo). That made it feel not quite as homely as it looks in the pictures. Jennifer acknowledge the issue and said she was going to move some stuff back for future guests.
I somehow missed that the futon bed was a japanese style futon and not a "regular" futon. It's a cushion/pad like bed which lies directly on the floor and it was too hard for my taste. I ended up buying a raised, queen size air bed - which Jennifer offered to buy from me for future guest. That was really nice of her.
I would definately recommend Jennifer as a hostess.

We really enjoyed our three week stay. The apartment is just as described and very well located. The F and D trains are just a short walk, and bus access is also very close.
Although the futon beds are a little hard, the inflatable double bed is comfortable.
Jennifer was a charming host and King, the building super, was friendly and helpful. We enjoyed the company of Smeagol and Stinker (Jennifer's lovely cats) for a few days - making our stay feel very homely.

I had a great time at Jenifer's place. The apartment has a great location and it is exactly as Jenifer says in the announce.
Jenifer managed everything for our arrival. And she was very helpful during our stay!! I strongly recommand this apartment and this is a pleasure to deal with Jenifer.

We didn't know what to expect as this was our first time staying in NYC for more than a few days. But we are SO stoked that we found Jennifer's place. It's in an awesome neighborhood with a ton of great restaurants, bars, grocery stores, gyms, and coffee shops near by. The other great thing is that there are two major subway stations (Grand & East Broadway) 2-3 blocks from her place which makes getting anywhere in the city super easy. It's also a fairly large 1-bedroom with room to work or hang and has great Wifi. Would definitely stay here again if we're ever in NYC. Thanks, Jennifer!

Jennifer's place is lovely. As a host, she was always easy to reach and happy to help (she even watered our plants for us when we were away on vacation). Only gripe is the apt was somewhat dirty upon our arrival. Killer location, dope balcony, and natural light galore. I highly recommend.

The apartment has a great location. It is only a three min walk to the East-Broadway subway station (F line) and a 5 min walk to the Essex subway station (J, M, Z line). There are lots of nice restaurants and bars within walking distance. However, the next supermarket, which offers organic fruits, vegetables and meat, is Whole Foods at Houston St (which is a 15 min walk or 2 subway stops).
The apartment is very clean and offers a well-equipped kitchen. The mattress is comfortable and the apartment offers lots of storage room.
The neighbors are very quiet and since there are not any bars close by, you will have a good night sleep.
The only thing which is a bit annoying is the heating system. You can hardly regulate the heat and it is a bit noisy.
Jennifer was an excellent host. She made sure that my stay was great. I can highly recommend the place!
I feel so lucky having this opportunity to stay in Cynthia's home, which makes my NY trip a perfect experience! Thank you Cynthia!
Staying at Cynthia's place was just great and would recommend it anyone who's interested! She's very sweet and the place is just awesome :)

Being a first time Airbnb user, I had a hard time trying to sort out where to stay in such a big city...however, this apartment was a true adventure and haven at the same time. A great find!

Opulently decorated with art work by the owner/host, it is well presented, clean and comfortable. Even though the rooms are snug, it is more than enough for the single intrepid traveller.

Breakfast is a healthy mix of granola, hemp and chia seeds, raw chocolate a dash of agave oil and a generous dollop of natural yoghurt. A great starter for the busy day of sightseeing or shopping aead.

Close to the subway direct to downtown and a short stroll to Central Park, it also has many facilities in the area including a 24hour convenience store/pharmacy, some great eateries and drinking holes.

Best of all, the host, Cynthia, is a warm and most approachable person. She is helpful, has great tips for exploring the city and loves a chat.

I would recommend this apartment to any one who wants to explore and experience New York like a local.

Le séjour chez Cynthia a été vraiment très agréable, la situation de l'appartement est idéale, près de Central Park et du métro, et le décor de l'appartement est magnifique, digne d'un palais vénitien !!! Cynthia et une hôte très accueillante, prête à donner des informations, nous aider dans nos recherches, nous donner des conseils. On se sent vraiment chez soi.

Just returned from a stimulating few days chez Cynthia. The apartment is warm, comfortable and beautifully furnished and decorated (check out the chandeliers...).  She is great company, interesting but also interested in you. And helpful, whether recommending great bookstores, alerting you to art exhibitions or printing out your boarding pass for you. I enjoyed my stay immensely and hope to be back soon.

L'appartement de Cynthia est idéalement situé, à deux pas de Central Park dans un chouette quartier. De là, il est facile de joindre tous les sites remarquables de Manhattan. Cynthia, artiste engagée au grand coeur, donne beaucoup de son temps et de ses connaissances à ses hôtes. Qu'elle bichonne lors de leur séjour.
Une vraie rencontre et des découvertes.
lovely as usual

Cynthia was a great host. Very flexible, courteous and available. Her place is a beautiful experience and the location can't be beat: diverse area, a block away from the subway and a short jog to central park. Would recommend.

Staying with Cynthia was a great experience! She's a caring host.who wants nothing but total comfort for her guests. She makes great beverages for breakfast, has amazing feather-soft bath towels, amazingly comfortable bed, air conditioning (you'll need it in NYC in the summertime) and fast wifi. The location is very good and the neighbourhood is safe. Besides physical comfort you also get a great interesting person to chat with, she will tell you anything you need to know about the city and more. It was my first time with Airbnb and I am so happy: I found this intelligent and smart woman and I'll definitely stay at this place again.

I loved staying with Cynthia. She is very nice and accommodating. The place is beautiful and a great location in the middle of Manhattan. Breakfast was delicious and made a great start to a fabulous day in New York City. A great safe neighborhood to stay in if you are a lone traveler wanting to explore this amazing city. The room is quite small but very dark and quiet so it is great for sleeping and getting over jet lag.

Jennifer’s place is very central to a lot of tourist places. There are two subway stations very close to her home that will take you anywhere in the city. I would recommend this home to anyone who’s looking to visit Manhattan and have a great time. Her home is very comfortable and clean. The kitchen is awesome to cook!

Jennifer is an adorable person. She  went the extra mile to make sure our check-in was smooth & we could settle in very easily with our cat. The apt is very clean and convenient, and it is easy to park free on the streets. And she has good recos whether in terms of restaurants around or cat-care.

I loved my stay at Jennifer's place! I lived in her apartment for the whole spring semester while I was studying at NYU. The neighborhood is lovely, with incredible restaraunts within walking distance. The subway is also very accessible- the BDFM and J lines are all about a 5 minute walk away, which can easily take you anywhere in the city. The apartment is very large for NYC, with a nice kitchen, large fridge, etc. It was surprisingly quiet as well, something very hard to find in Manhattan!! Jennifer was a fantastic host, very communicative and attentive to my needs. She provided all the basic necessities I needed, and whenever I needed something she helped me; when I asked to buy a few extra kitchen appliances she even refunded me the price! The building's super is also very friendly and helpful.

Jennifer was such an amazing host! And the place was perfect the neighborhood was so nice and we had all our essentials nearby! The apartment it was lovely and clean. And we couldn’t be happier with all the information Jennifer shared gave us and how easy it was to contact her. Rally recommend anyone visiting New York to try and book her apartment

The apartment is small, but it is New York, after all. Great location. Walking distance to Chinatown,  and Little Italy etc. and to lots of small restaurants. Nearby corner bodegas for groceries are pricey, though. Bit difficult to find a cab nearby. Recommend Quick Ride car service just down Hester Street for ride to airports. Jennifer was very responsive host. Check in/out were painless.  Would stay again.

Bel appartement, clair, bien placé, conforme aux photos même si la propreté laissait un peu à désirer (ménage fait de manière superficielle et rideau de douche très sale)...
Bien pour 2 adultes et un enfant (matelas futon dans la pièce commune).
La climatisation un peu bruyante, mais très utile!
De bonnes adresses et de bons conseils.
Everything was okay, actual place may not be exactly matching what's seen in pictures, but understandable.
Jennifer’s place is fantastic. I had a great time here. It’s a little darker than I expected but other than that everything was accurate!

This is the place to stay if you are new, familiar and old to NYC. It's PERFECT!

The space is super cute with everything you need to feel comfortable and at home.
It's super cozy and clean.

Jennifer is an amazing host - very kind and thoughtful and responds really quickly and her art is cool!

Okay, my favorite thing about this place is the location! Everything you need and more is around you. Want to go out in Brooklyn? No problem, hop on the F which is 3 minutes away or walk 5-6 minutes and get on other trains.
Hungry? This will never happen because everything you want is so close by.
Want to cook? Head to trader joes or if I were you stroll down the road into China Town and get really fresh amazing food!
Want to get a drink but you're on your own, step outside turn right and clockwork is right there - super cozy, fun, characterful and cheap drinks!

Midtown and most of the sites are about 20 minutes away on the subway or just walk :)

Anyway, I'll be back and you should stay if you're considering!

Jennifer is a great host. Her place has a perfect location in Manhattan, if you want to be close to Soho, Little Italy or Financial District. We loved the apartment, simple, minimalistic, but you can feel it's an artsy place. We spent one month - a family of four. Good local bars in a close vicinity.

It was a wonderful experience. The pictures are quite accurate though somehow it feels more spacious than I'd expected. The bed was very comfortable. The location is terrific -- a short walk to four different subway lines that get you into mid-town Manhattan in under half an hour, and a 15-minute bus ride to the TKTS booth in South Street Seaport where the wait is usually less that five minutes. Comfortable walk to a brand new food market with local vendors, and a short walk to Target and Trader Joe's. You can get just about anything you need at those three places. I can't comment on the trendiness of the neighborhood (I'm far from young), but there seemed to be plenty of young people enjoying themselves. Lots of restaurants and lots of choices.
I'd stay there again in a heartbeat.

I spent four weeks in this wonderful place. Thanks Jennifer!
Jennifer is a very nice and caring landlady. She was always available by phone or SMS.
The apartment is nice and cozy, as shown in the pictures. The building and residents are very quiet and are maintained by a really nice Super, named King. It was always nice to chat with him, arriving in the lobby.
I loved staying here - very close to many subway stations and busses, around the corner from very lively and trendy neighborhoods, and very quiet at night for a good sleep and recovering for the next day's trip!
I would like to stay here again as soon as possible! Take care!

When looking for accommodation I insist that three conditions are always met, cleanliness, easy access to public transport and lots of positive reviews, and this property delivered on all three and more besides. Cynthia replies promptly with booking requests and general queries about her place and when I arrived she showed me round her immediate neighbourhood and helped me with purchasing my MetroCard. She takes her responsibility as a host seriously and that can only be a good thing for any future guests.

This was my first Airbnb booking.

Cynthia est une personne chaleureuse qui sait recevoir les voyageurs. Sa sensibilité artistique donne à sa demeure un coté atypique et très personnel. Ça restera une belle rencontre.
a bientôt Cynthia.

Cynthia was very friendly and nice. The room I stayed was small and cozy.The apartment was beautiful and comfortable. I think the location was perfect and close to central park and subways. She made sure to make me comfortable and apartment was  clean and maintained really well. I could use the kitchen and had choices of breakfast which makes you feel like being at your home :). I look forward to staying her  again too.
What a charming, sun-drenched apartment! Just a few blocks from Chinatown and a subway that will take you straight into the Village/Midtown.  Jennifer makes sure you have everything you need.
Great place and location!
My parents had a great 2 months stay at Jennifer’s place. It’s very convenient to get to subway, Little Italy and Chinatown. The photos are pretty accurate too. Definitely recommend it!

The place is smaller than expected, but it has everything for an extended stay.
The host is an absolute pleasure to deal with
Highly recommended!

Jennifer's apartment was an amazingly comfortable, well located and well appointed sanctuary for me for five weeks. The neighborhood is brimming with creative energy and authenticity. I loved getting to know its amenities and its people. The super in the building is also very sweet and incredibly helpful.
Great location and perfectly equipped spot in LES. Jennifer and the building sup, King, are very accommodating. Made you feel like you were home.

Jennifer’s place was the perfect place to stay in NYC. Tons of natural light, a lovely balcony, and a spacious apartment with a fully functional kitchen. This was perfect for our 2 month stay, as it had absolutely everything we needed and the building supervisor is very kind and helpful. The location is also great, in a lovely residential street but close to shops, bars and restaurants. We recommend this to anyone looking for a nice place to unwind while staying in NYC!
Convenient location and easy to communicate super. Lots of diverse restaurants near by, and quiet enough for the lower east side! Highly recommend, Jennifer is a great host.

Jennifer has a great 1 bedroom right on the border of Chinatown and LES. Everything you need is a short walk away. Very close to bars and restaurants down orchard and Ludlow street. The balcony was great when some fresh air was needed. Overall very doable place for my girlfriend and I who both were working remote from the apartment for the month while we were there. Jennifer is very helpful and nice, along with great communication throughout our stay. The super of the building, King is also SUPER nice and was there when we needed assistance during our stay.

The apartment is pretty large for a 1 bedroom in NYC! The bed was comfortable and the photos were accurate. There was a new couch delivered during my stay as well. There could be some updates on the apartment though, like the cabinets in the kitchen as well as the chairs in the dining room. However, the location is amazing, within minutes of several different lines. It is a short walk to Trader joe's and Target. This is very close to several trendy bars, rooftops and restaurants. Jennifer and King are both extremely welcoming. They are available to assist with everything! I would recommend staying here.

Very clean and lots of natural sunlight. Quite spacious for Manhattan. Jennifer had good communication and quickly handled my concerns such as ordering a new lamp when the old one broke. Would recommend!

Jennifer’s place is a haven in a great central location with everything you need and the added benefits of a lovely living room and balcony! We were very happy with our stay and would recommend to other guests!

Jennifer's apt is great, perfectly located 1 block from Dimes Square and F, JMZ, BD trains. It's bright and spacious and has everything you need for a long stay. Jennifer is friendly, fast on communications and made sure I had the best experience in her home. Thank you Jennifer and King!
Great location and very easy check-in and out. The balcony was a nice perk to enjoy some fresh air in the summer.
Great stay right in the heart of Chinatown. Jennifer was super responsive and made my stay extremely enjoyable. She even upgraded the internet while I was there! Would definitely recommend.

the stay was good - washer dryer is not in building it’s a public laundromat on the corner. The bedroom gets super overheated in winter and if you open a window it’s really noisy. The chairs and table are super wobly and old - could use an upgrade there. The elevator broke as well so no elevator during the stay. No dishwasher for a month became bothersome and overall the price was high for the apartment and the minor inconveniences grew into relatively big deals. The super was very friendly and helpful. The neighborhood is good location to groceries and access to downtown is great. Jennifer was responsive and natural light was nice. Overall the stay was good quiet building respectful neighbors but wouldn’t pay that rate again

Sahr Ali is heel attent en duidelijk. Vooraf met duidelijke voorschriften en communicatie. Zo was de koelkast heerlijk gevuld voor het eerste ontbijt! Ook stonden er zelfgemaakte cupcakes en drinken voor ons klaar. Dat is prettig na zo'. n lange reis. De etage is precies zoals afgebeeld op de foto. Het bed slaapt heerlijk. Handdoeken liggen klaar. Het is donker en stil 's nachts. De kelder, toilet en badkamer zijn uitstekend schoon en met zorg en stijl in gericht. De badkamer voor eigen gebruik is op de begane grond maar tegenover de eigen deur naar beneden. Daarom is de privacy genoeg voor huurder en verhuurder. Sahr Ali is een hele aardige, attente, gezellige, vrolijke host. Zij doet je snel thuis voelen. Gaf ons het vertrouwen de eigen gang te kunnen gaan. Gaf goede instructies voor bijvoorbeeld de sloten van deuren.
Probeer ook vooral de restaurants in Brooklyn die Ali adviseert. Keuze voor Brooklyn en deze straat zijn ons goed bevallen. Dicht bij de lokale subway Cpt op een express trein A wanneer je van en naar JFK reist. Bij het dichtstbijzijnde station ( 5 minuten lopen) stopt alleen de lokale trein. Daarom wel opletten dat je oversta Een rustige buurt met hoofdstraat en winkels en restaurantjes allemaal op loopafstand. Brooklyn is duidelijk een buurt die nu heel "hip" is voor New Yorkers. Minder druk dan Manhattan. Veilige en prettige sfeer. Zelf vonden we het ook leuk om vanaf Brooklyn lopend naar Manhattan te gaan via de bruggen. Als je van wandelen houdt, is dit een leuke manier en kost je tot de bruggen gemiddeld drie kwartier lopen. Kortom om de soms wat al te toeristische en dure Manhattan te ontvluchten is het erg leuk om vanuit het adres van Sahr een ander stukje New York te ontdekken. WIFI werkt erg goed!

The Waverly was a great place to stay and Sahr was a great host! Plenty of space downstairs for our new family to spread out and have all of the amenities you need. Pack and play was even setup when we arrived. Sahr greeted us with tea and had snacks and started the trip off great with a warm welcome. The neighborhood was a great location right off the C line to Manhattan and in the center of some of the great neighborhoods of Brooklyn. Sahr was also great at pointing out some cool places to check out and how to get around town the best. We'll stay again next time we're in NY.

Sauberes und ruhiges Zimmer in Brooklyn. U-Bahn ganz in der Nähe.
Netter Empfang. Alles perfekt:)))
We had a lovely time...apartment was so comfortable ( amazing bed!).. And we were made to feel very at home, perfect little touches like cup cakes and tea on arrival! Thankyou so much .Theresa x

The room is as it appears in the pictures, Ali is a nice hostess, the communications were fine.
The room is in a part of Brooklyn with on the street parking
really great! : ) definitely recommended if you need a place to stay in brooklyn.

It was a great experience! Sahr was a great host and goes above and beyond to make sure you stay is comfortable. The location is great, short walkable distance to the subway and with subway lines that take you straight into Manhattan. The room is spacious and would say comfortable for 2 for sure and can even fit 3 for a short stay. I would definetely recommend this place!

The Brooklyn Waverly was a nice stay. Great location next to A and C train yet on a quiet and pretty street. Lots of great cafes and restaurants within walking distance and the Brooklyn Flea on Saturday was amazing.
Ali was very welcoming and the place is large and comfortable as shown in the pictures. They were very considerate towards me, I was often coming in late and they'd always leave the light on!

Liebe Sahr,
vielen lieben Dank für den wunderbaren Aufenthalt in Deinem Haus. Du hast uns nach der langen Reise von Berlin so herzlich empfangen, dass wir uns bei Dir gleich wohl gefühlt haben.
Das Zimmer haben wir so vorgefunden, wie Du es beschrieben hast und es ist mit allem Nützlichen ausgestattet und war sehr sauber. Den Garten konnten wir leider nicht nutzen, da wir ständig unterwegs waren.
Die zentrale Lage Deines Hauses ist super. In 3 Minuten erreicht man zu Fuß die U-Bahn nach Manhattan oder nach Williamsburg. Wir wünschen Dir und Deinem Sohn alles Liebe und Gute für die Zukunft.
Beste Grüße
Wiebke

My friends and I had a lovely moment with Ali and her son.
They are really nice and helpfull.
If we'll come back to NYC, we'll go for sure by Ali.
Ali's place is very close from the subway (line C or A for the night), we was in manhattan in 10 minutes.
The neighborhood is very quiet and pleasant with a lot of pubs and restaurants.

We recommend this room for short stays, but it is really not equipped for stays over 1 week in length.

Why?
My friend and I leased this room for one month during a collegiate summer internship. Upon arrival, Ali was very welcoming, the room (smaller than anticipated) was clean, and she offered neighborhood advice which was very helpful. Within the hour, Ali left town and failed to mention the additional guest, a fully grown man, who was sharing the upstairs bathroom that had been advertised as for our sole use. Upstairs kitchen use is limited at best; Ali prefers that you wash any dishes in the downstairs pedestal sink. Given our longer stay she offered to wash our dishes, but soon retracted the offer and allowed us to use the upstairs sink instead. After the unexpected additional tenant (who stayed for over 1 week) had left, we encountered a few more issues including a leak in the basement wall and various large bugs (centipedes, spiders, and cockroaches). Ali also got a dog and started a vintage shop in the living room during our stay which we didn't mind, but was not mentioned in the ad. The addition of the dog also means there will be poop on the pavement in the advertised back garden. Another item of note is that the door separating the rented basement from the main floor is an accordion door with no acoustic insulation. Do not expect to have a private conversation or cell reception. Ali did provide first day gifts so that we did not have to immediately go to the grocery store which was very kind! And she allowed us to use the washer/dryer for our extended stay. The location is great and Ali and her son are both very nice hosts!

We greatly enjoyed our stay at Sahr’s place. On arrival, we quickly found a parking spot on the other side of the block and later moved to a spot directly in front of the door. Sahr was a gracious host and provided welcoming refreshments. Everything in the unit was as described; it was very convenient having one and a half baths. Neither of us was around much during our stay, but communication via email and text was excellent with quick turnaround. Travel to Manhattan was easy via two nearby subway stops. Sahr provided us a with a long list with a wide range of nearby restaurants that she recommended, and we enjoyed eating at several of them.

Cynthia's apartment is beautifully unique, you need only take the detail of her images & description as a guide of a thoughtful host. The furnishings and decoration are such a pleasure, comfortable and full of creative energy. A perfect location for art lovers, little more than 10 blocks from the Guggenheim, and with the Whitney & MET just beyond, along with Central Park's Conservatory Water. All central sights are walking distance, and key subway lines are just 1 block away if you prefer. Such good conversation from a like creative mind, someone who made me feel considered, thoughtfully accommodated and made me feel safe as a lone traveller, even inviting me to dinner. No small detail was not thought of. An excellent apartment, great recommendations and someone who added even more flair to a wonderful trip.

This was my first airbnb and it was a great experience at Cynthia's. The atmosphere of the apartment and her charming personality added greatly to my NY experience. In short: prompt and great communication, a clean, relaxing and comfortable apartment with the facilities in perfect working condition. A helpful and friendly hostess who takes care of her airbnb in a professional way. Access to main subway line is just around the corner. I would definitely book it again if i am staying in NY.

My partner and I stayed with Sahr because we needed a private, comfortable, and ideally located place to stay for a few days, a place to call home base during a transition. What we received far outpaced our expectations. The accommodations were extremely comfortable, clean, and well taken care of with plenty of space for work and relaxing. Having an entire floor to ourselves provided a much more homelike and private feel than a lot of other AirBnBs.

Furthermore, Sahr's hospitality was above and beyond, and she regularly went out of her way to ensure our comfort. We felt wonderfully at home and well taken care of. It was a pleasure to share her space.

Thank you very much for the wonderful few days!

Sahr was a very friendly host, always prompt to respond to questions and very helpful. The room was very nice and comfortable, and we really appreciated that the fridge was stocked with breakfast for the morning after our arrival. We definitely would have been happy to stay longer, or come visit again!

Sahr, Idryis and Chester are great hosts! Staying with Sahr and her familiy feels like staying with friends. Sahr welcomed us very warmly, helped us with useful recommendations for NY and the area and reacted promptly when we needed her help.  We were happy to find a small breakfirst for us stored in the fridge. Everything was easy and smooth with her. Her hospitality was far beyond our expectations! Idryis was fun talking to and very easy going. We can fully reccommend staying with Sahr. Sahr, Idryis and Chester you get five stars from us :-)

Rolman and Ruperto were the perfect hosts.
Good communication from the outset. The flat is in a fantastic location in the very heart if the West Village. Great shops and restaurants are moments from the door and yet the flat is quiet in the evening. Perfect!
Excellent location, perfectly maintained and clean apartment, well designed interiors and lots of light.
Very nice and clean apartment, just like on the photos, convenient location, friendly and helpful host, no doubt recommend it to everybody. Thank you Rolman and Ruperto

I loved this apartment. Exactly as shown. Neat and tidy. Comfortable bed. Good counter space in the kitchen. Strong shower - good pressure and plenty of hot water.  You do not have the sense of staying in someone's house (ie, junky stuff in drawers and cabinets) but you also don't feel like it is a barren hotel. They have clearly put thought into making sure you have what you need. One floor up so you get good light but not so many flights that it is a hassle to deal with stairs. I will definitely be back.  R&R were super friendly too.

Perfect Stay! Couldn't ask for a better location.. Apartment was a good size, clean and had all the necessary amenities. Would highly recommend and stay again! Thank you Rolman & Ruperto for making our stay so easy.

Gorgeous apartment in a great location, exactly as described. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay and will be recommending to friends. Good communications, and hassle free check-in etc. ...and an amazing sun drenched roof deck with views over the city! Couldn't have asked for more. Thanks Ruperto and Rolman.
Very nice area, the apartment is cozy, and the hosts are helpful.

Can't find a better word then great ! Maybe best ...:)

The apparrmant , the location , all the details , Ruperto Norman

We had the best time there

I strongly recomand it if u have Manhathn on it schaduale ..

Cynthia was a great host who really helped me to feel comfortable at home and finding my way into the New York jungle. The room was tiny but had everything I needed. Most important, it was completely quiet - something to appreciate when staying in a big city! The apartment is just beautiful with all decorations and details, and it is close to Central Park, the subway and museums.

We had a fabulous time at this apartment. The location was great, just a couple of minutes away from the subway and the area felt very safe which is important as someone who doesn't know the city at all. There are loads of great bars and restaurants nearby.

The apartment was warm (v. important in December!) and comfortable. It was so much better than staying in a hotel! The shower was great and the bathroom was v. clean.

We would definitely recommend this apartment, and would happily stay here if we were visiting the city again.

Located in the midst of New York's West Village this apartment is perfection. Clean contemporary design and appointments provided for comfort... this apartment was ideal for our 3 week NY stay.
Restaurants, cafes and shops abound.
Ruperto and Rolman welcomed us with gracious enthusiasm.
Thank you for making Christmas in NYC a true holiday.

Liz Q
Ruperto was very kind and accommodating. Sigrid had a wonderful stay at this lovely apartment. I would recommend this apartment to anyone who is looking to stay in the West Village area.

A truly lovely apartment. It made 10 days of very hard work much easier. Coming home at night after a long days work, it was just great to pop along the road to a selection of delicious restaurants and drinks at fun little bars. The apartment was spotless and the shower was difficult to get out of at times. A 5 star performance. I hope to use it as my base again when I return to NY. Thank you!

Great place to stay while in New York, at an amazing location. The appt. is spacious, clean and welcoming and has a classic new york appt. charm to it. It's filled with beautiful art works and has a fully supplied kitchen. There's an inviting living room and a spacious bedroom with comfy bed. the bathroom is small but very clean and there are fresh soft white towels.
About the neighborhood- filled with restaurants, cafes, bars and the best boutiques in New York, it has everything your looking for. There is also a subway nearby ( 3 minutes walk) which makes commuting very easy. It felt like home away from home for us, we were so sad to leave! Highly recommended and much better then staying at any hotel.
About the hosts :although we never met them, they were very accommodating, responsive and reliable.

Fantastic location, restaurants and bars on every corner an opportunity yo experience New York away from the bigger tourist areas. The apartment was clean and exactly as described and the bed was very comfy. Hosts were friendly and helpful.
The reservation was canceled 3 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

The apartment was an absolute delight. It was tastefully decorated, clean and homely without being sterile or cluttered. There's a lot of room, particularly helpful if you plan on doing some shopping. The location could not be any better. Despite exploring so much of New York, we could not find a better area. There's fantastic restaurants, bars, parks, cafes and retail shops all within walking distance as well as having the subway a less than 5 minute walk away to get you everywhere else. The neighbourhood was quiet and we felt completely safe walking around no matter the time of day. Rolman and Ruperto were great hosts! The restaurants they recommended were some of our favourites and they were helpful whenever we needed anything. We would never stay elsewhere when visiting NYC again.

Lovely appartment, located in a nice area closed to cafés, bars and good restaurants. Handy for shopping and other several amenities including meatpacking district at only 4 blocks. Really close to metro (number 1 sheridan square). Quiet neighborhood with police station nearby. Nice furnishing, very clean and tidy with a comfortable bedroom. Kitchen fully equipped. Very welcoming, feeling like home after just one week. Will definetely come back here next time in NY

Amazingly great location in the heart of the Village.  Tremendous amounts of places within walking distance and multiple subways close by for everything else.  Apartment had everything we needed.  Interior could use a little refreshing but it was perfect for us.  Due to late heat wave air conditioning came  was appreciated.
Great space!  Clean, well decorated on a nice central street.  Ruperto made it very easy too.

The apartment was the best I have stayed in while in NYC, clean, comfortable and in a great location. Ruperto was also a great host, I would recommend this apartment to anyone and will be back for sure.

We had a great stay at the apartment, it is exactly how it is described and clean! The location was very close to many subway stations and yummy restaurants and jazz bars.

It was very easy to get in touch with Ruperto, fantastic host!

This apartment is ideally located and a perfect place to visit New York from. We stayed over Christmas and the New Year period and enjoyed retreating to this cosy and warm apartment after being out and about in the winter weather especially the snow! The apartment was just as described and well fit out for cooking, but why bother when there is such great dining options on your doorstep! We would definitely recommend this apartment and would stay here again next time we visit New York. R & R were easy to deal with and answered any questions we had promptly.

The adventure began looking for a nice place for us to stay in the city of New York, we found this option and from the moment we saw gave us confidence.

Sahr from the moment we arrived behaved like a very nice person and was greeted at home. The place is very clean, comfortable and a very nice way to welcome guests to stay a few days in the city, it is advisable to 100%, is located in a very nice and peaceful neighborhood, gives some confidence and above all has very good access to metro line C and G.

Definitely recommended and I think that is a very good choice, in our next trip to the city rest assured that we would look the same hosting.

I stayed at Sahr's place during a six day vacation with my girlfriend and our 4 year-old daughter. Sahr is a wonderful host, and she made us feel really welcome. She was very helpful and everything was prepared for us, including a nice breakfast for the first morning, which was perfect, since we arrived somewhat late in the evening.

The room is pretty much exactly as advertised, it has everything you need if you are spending the days in the streets of NYC, and need a quiet place to relax in the evenings, and prepare ind the mornings.

The neighbourhood of Clinton Hill is endearing, beautiful, and located perfectly, close to everything you need in Brooklyn, and just around the corner from the subway, which will take you to Manhattan in about 15 minutes. The best of both worlds, in my opinion.

I highly recommend this place!

Ausführliche Infos kurz vor der Reise. Herzlicher Empfang und geräumiges Zimmer. Free wifi, Willkommensdrink und süße Cupcakes. Zentrale Lage in Brooklyn und gute Anbindung nach JFK und Manhattan. Preisbildung bei Airbnb/ Nebenkosten allerdings sehr intransparent.

Great location, one block from metro stop and 3 blocks from Central Park which. Was important for me as I needed to continue some training. Cynthia's created a unique and warm home and she has fantastic energy, I don't know how she does it. Great suggestions on local places to shop and available for advice at any time. Hope to visit again and would recommend to anyone.

Sahr was such a wonderful host for us! Great hospitality, cupcakes and lemonade!
Apartment was so cozy, with big personality and originality.
Location was great for us, 1 block from the Clinton Washington subway station. Several quaint little restaurants in the neighborhood.

Great place to stay! Amazing location. Beautiful apartment. And Ruperto was a dream to work with -- very responsive, accommodating, and professional. Really enjoyed my time here and would recommend it to anyone visiting NYC.

The apartment was just what we had hoped for and perfect for our honeymoon in New York. Stylish and very comfortable with the separate living area providing ample room to move around. The quieter village environment was just what we needed after a day of hustle and noise in upper NYC and we spent many evenings dining in the surrounding streets. So many restaurants, bars, jazz clubs and the Meat Packing district and shopping districts of Soho were all within walking distance. It had the great pleasure of meeting both Ruperto and Rolman who were very kind and accommodating at all times. We hope one day that we will return to this beautiful New York apartment.

Absolutely loved our stay at Ruperto's.
The apartment was exactly as pictured and perfect for a couple. The location was in the heart of the West Village ( which in my opinion is the best neighborhood in NYC) there is 2 train stations within walking distance so getting around the entire city was very easy. Spoilt for choice of bars and restaurants in just the surrounding streets alone! Lots of lovely shops, cafes, delis as well.
The apartment itself was very clean and tidy with a good sized shower and bed, cupboard space, wifi and plenty of light. A special touch was fresh flowers and chocolates on our arrival. Would definitely recommend to others and most certainly stay again.

Rolman was really nice, not only he was kind enough to give us a hand with our luggage (and with a 8 month old baby there was a lot of luggage), but he also took the time to show us around the appartment.

This appartement was clean and cosy. Kitchen was sufficient for basic cooking, but guests without children should probably take more advantage of the amazing location, with its multitude of great restaurants.

You can't beat the location, close to the river, with access to the cycling/running track. West village is great.

Only minor negative, but that has more to do with the "City that never sleeps" is the street noise, louder than London, but manageable. We can't wait to come back.

All the other reviews have said it all. We spent 28 days in New York, and this was home. It was central, convenient and was exactly what we wanted. Ruperto was easy to get hold of and responded to our queries promptly. I highly recommend this apartment.

A perfect apartment and a perfect location for a perfect month in New York. Everything was as described, and our host was courteous and helpful. Manhattan is not the cheapest alternative for a stay in New York, but we felt that with this placed we certainly got our money's worth. Recommended without reservations to any couple wanting to be close to everyhing in New York and still in a cozy, atmospheric neighbourhood.

Rolman & Ruperto were great from the moment i checked in to departure. I was met and shown around the property in detail and even given a bottle of wine! There was a fruit bowl for me and bare essentials such as soap, toilet paper etc. Clean linens and towels were also in abundance. The place was clean and well ordered.

The apartment is in an amazing location... probably one of the best addresses in Manhattan. Opposite a fantastic Italian restaurant called L'Artusi. Between Hudson and Bleecker which are fantastic roads to stroll down with a whole host of shops, restaurants and bars. Easy 20 mins walk on Bleecker to the East side of the city.

Definitely worth staying at this comfortable little prime location apartment.

We loved our stay at Ruperto and Rolman's apartment. Everything about the transaction was easy and straightforward, allowing us to really enjoy our time in New York. The location is absolutely unbeatable--right in the heart of the West Village. Steps away from great restaurants, jazz shows, the subway, and more. The apartment is exactly as shown in the pictures, and everything worked exactly as expected. The internet is fast, also. Quick communication with Ruperto and Rolman. I would highly recommend this apartment!

Everything was absolutely perfect at Ruperto's. He was there to meet me upon arrival with fruit and a bottle of wine and insured I had everything I needed for my stay. The place is very clean and the location really can't be beat.

Amazing place! Perfect location, nicely furnished. Ruperto was very accommodating.
