The day I checked in, he let me know that the stove and oven have not been working due to a building issue, but he was quick to ameliorate this situation by bringing in a portable cooktop and offering a toaster oven. If you're looking to stay in the West Village, this is the spot.

El departamento tiene una ubicación muy buena, esta rodeado de muchos restaurantes, bares de jazz, y además está a unas cuadras del Río Hudson que es muy bonito.

El departamento es muy cómodo y Ruperto es una persona muy agradable además de que es muy atento.

Definitivamente regresaría a hospedarme con el otra vez.

The other high-rated reviews here are accurate. For the month of July 2017 this place felt like home at the heart of the West Village. Ruperto was very welcoming and remained communicative throughout my whole stay.
A beautiful apartment in the heart of the West Village. Ruperto was very accommodating and a great host. A wonderful home for our four week stay - highly recommended!

I had a wonderful NY experience with Cynthia K. For a start, she was very responsive, and communication was easy and efficient. Before I arrived she provided many suggestions and tips of how to get there and things I could do and see.
When I arrived her welcome was warm and made me feel at home immediately. Cynthia was a great host - she was there when I needed her but I had privacy otherwise. In addition, she helped with all those little things one may need - an umbrella on a rainy day, a laminated subway map, etc.

The house is a real gem - everywhere you look there is another thing to explore. And everything is spotless and well maintained.
It is under 1 minute walk to the nearest subway, very close to central park, and within an easy walk from some of the most famous museums.

I had a great time and certainly hope to stay there again.

Cynthia is a fantastic host. She made me feel welcome from the very first moment I entered her apartment. She cares for the well-being of her guests, is very helpful with practical information (transportation in NYC, good places to eat etc.) and she is always open for a chat.
The room is small but clean and very quiet and you are free to use the living room and kitchen. The apartment itself is worth a visit! Every room is furnished and decorated with an artistic touch that is a feast for the eye. The atmosphere is nice and comfortable.
Situated on a quiet street on the upper east side, the apartment is in walking distance from Central Park and very close to a subway station with a direct line to downtown Manhattan (approx. 15 min.). It is thus easy to get to and from the place and the area feels secure, also at night.
I can warmly recommend a stay at Cynthia's!

Cynthia provides so much more than a bed to sleep in (which was extremely comfortable by the way). The apartment is also her studio so expect to see art in the making and witness her passion and excitement about her work. It is also her home, so there are a few rules (alas I managed to forget most of them at least once - *sorry* Cynthia). Highly recommended.
The location was great

A Home Away from Home. The property is incredibly well located on the Upper East Side. 40min from JFK. 10min from Hyde Park. 15min from the Guggenheim. Great pizzas & burger joint nearby.

The flat is incredible. Totally art deco. The rooms are small but very well furnished. The bedding is soft & the shower warm.

Most importantly, Cynthia was a terrific host, welcoming, caring & attentive.

I will be back.

Cynthia was really friendly and helpful. The place was really cool. My bedroom was very small but wasn't claustrophobic at all! The rest of the house looked really awesome too. And it was all very clean and well taken care of. The area was very calm. It was very convenient that there was a subway station very nearby.
So all in all, it was a very good experience

Lovely apartment, impeccably kept. Close to Central Park. Safe neighborhood. Cynthia is a very warm, friendly and inclusive host - I had a much more enjoyable trip as a result of staying with her than I would have in a hotel.

Nearly six weeks in Ruperto’s apartment made clear that Ruperto is a very good host who has put a lot of thought into making this rental experience mutually functional and well-facilitated. The apartment is clean, has ample space to unpack and get comfortable for the long-term and has a very good “feng shui” feel to it.

overall the place looks like the pictures and the location is hard to beat. it was clean and cozy, but needs some tlc.

the closets in the apartment are all locked so if you’re staying for a long period of time, be prepared to have very little storage space.

the windows aren’t functional and the blinds have a rough time going up and down. the curtains when i arrived were mismatched and practically transparent, doing little to block light or noise on a very noisy street. luckily he approved me switching them out for my stay.

ruperto made requests - like checking batteries for smoke and carbon detectors - that were disruptive to my schedule while i was there and frankly not appropriate for a guest to deal with. he also dropped by multiple times. when the fridge broke he asked me to take measurements for him, wait around for someone to check repairs on it, and it took a week to get replaced. more annoyances and disruptions to the stay.

although he is communicative and has nice bedside manner, he asks more from his guests than any host i’ve stayed with in the past.

his cleaning lady is kind and efficient, i recommend using her if you’re staying for a while. if you ever want to vacuum yourself or sweep anything up, request for those items to be left out, otherwise they’ll be locked away.

the stove in the kitchen is barely functional and requires a grill light to get going, so be prepared for that.

i think, price wise, it’s high. i spoke with the neighbor who was also renting on air bnb and she was paying $1,200 less a month than i was for basically the same apartment. food for thought!
Would highly recommend this place. Ruperto was great and the location is absolutely perfect!

Ruperto has a very nice place.
If you know anything about NYC and the West Village this is a very good location. The apartment was clean functional and only one flight of stairs up.
There are excellent laundry facilities if you are on an extended stay. I can clearly recommend and I would stay there again. Thank You Ruperto!!

This is an excellent apartment in a pleasant neighbourhood and is well-suited to extended stays. I found the apartment to be exactly as described and comfortable. There is plenty of storage space and there are lots of practical and decorative touches that make it a perfect home away from home. The air con is much appreciated for summer stays.

Well connected via two local subway stations (allowing easy access to the entire west side of Manhattan, direct trains as far as Coney Island and simple connections to anywhere else in the city) there is also much on offer in the local neighbourhood in terms of places to eat, drink and hang out.

This is New York City so there will be some noise on the street at night but there are no loud venues on this block so it's about as quiet as it gets for the West Village! Blackout curtains really help you to get a good night's sleep. The bed is comfortable, albeit a little softer than I am used to.

Ruperto is an excellent host and clear in his communications. I would recommend this apartment to friends visiting NYC and would strongly consider staying here again should I make a similar trip in the future.

This studio was ideal for my first month in NYC. Charming, quiet condo building in a perfect location in West Village. Quick walk to various subways (particularly 1 & BDFM lines), close to cool restaurants / cafes / bars and relatively close to Hudson River Park. Place is very homely and comfortable. Ruperto is a super responsive and helpful host. Highly recommend both place and host.

I cannot imagine a better located apartment in Manhattan. Close to most all the subways, an interesting yet peaceful neighborhood, minutes to Times Square. The one-floor-up (that's important) apartment is small but adequate for 2 people. There is street noise (the police station is next door, but they are considerate), but hey, this is New York City. The host is exceptionally responsive and helpful. We hope to be back.

Great rental! Ruperto goes above and beyond as a host—super friendly and easy to get ahold of.

The apartment itself is exactly as advertised, if not better. Perfect location, cute decor and relatively quiet for NYC. Very spacious too! Clean and absolutely no issues. I would wholeheartedly recommend this rental to others and would stay here again.

Extremely convenient and pleasant location near to many clothing stores and convenience stores and NYU. While there are some noises like police sirens and people talking that erupt from time to time it is mostly a quiet location. The place is super clean. The fan above the bed is quite useful when it gets hot. Everything else works as you would expect. There is a rooftop which is very nice.


The apartment is very nicely decorated but sacrifices practicality for aesthetics. I suggest to move decorations like glass bottles and painting and such to safer locations. The window does not automatically stay open so need to prop it up with a wooden block. Be careful of bumping your head on the wooden shelves that are slanted downwards above the sofa.

I highly recommend Ruperto’s apartment. My wife and I stayed for a month and really enjoyed our stay. It’s in an incredible location, so close to restaurants/bars/shops. The apartment was clean, nicely decorated and had everything we needed for our stay. Ruperto was an excellent host and was extremely responsive and attentive to any questions we had.
Cynthia's place is just a beautiful as she describes. Really cool kitchen and the bed is so comfortable for a perfect nights sleep.

I had a great time at Cynthia's "mansion". My room was cosy and the whole place is very tidy and perfectly organised.
She's a very lovely host who really cares for her guests and always helps out if you are new to the city or need any other kind o advice ;) Thanks darling for a wonderful stay! I'll be back!

Cynthia is very nice , caring and warm; a lovely host. Her apartment is beautifully decorated, very cosy and very clean. And her house is ideally located, very close to the subway and near Central Park... great for going for a run! I much enjoyed my stay, and I will not forget the very good times shared with Cynthia and other guest during breakfast. It was a dream to go to New York, and it was wonderful to meet Cynthia. Thank you for all yours attentions. I will be back.

I stayed with Cynthia for two weeks during Christmas and New Years and definitely my trip couldn't be better. She is a really nice and interesting person who is up to help you to have a great experience around NYC. We spent a nice time together, her place is LOVELY!!! The Oak Room is a nice space, with a comfortable bed, space to your things and be sure you gonna have a good rest there. Like the description, the apartment is really close from the line 6 of the Metro Station, something that makes easy go and come from wherever you want. The neighborhood is really safe (walked around late at night few times and totally safe)
I'm glad to had choose Cynthia's place for my trip and already decided if I go back, do it at her place. Recommendation: Spent time with her, you won't be disappointed. Thanks for everything Cynthia!!!

Cynthia's place was amazing. I highly recommend. She was so wonderful and one unique human being. I'm glad I got to meet her and stay at her place. She definitely made my visit to NYC a unforgettable experience. Everything from the room, bathroom,kitchen and living room was beautifuly decorated and super clean. Most likely on my next trip I'll be booking again with her. Thanks Cynthia!

I enjoyed a great stay in NYC here! Cynthia is a very nice and caring host. The apartment is really beautiful with great attention to detail and decoration. Also, it is exemplary clean and tidy.

The subway is only one block away so you can easily reach downtown.

I would choose this apartment again for my next visit to New York!

It was a good few days in New York, The flat was great very clean and organised. As well as being only one street away from the underground station, which was very nice after walking around manhattan all day. Cynthia was a very nice host and helpful.

Sahr and her son are very kind, hospitable people who were gracious and open when my mother stayed with them. She enjoyed her stay (and the already-mentioned cupcakes!) as the room was clean and wonderfully located. My mother will definitely stay here again! Thanks so much for everything!
Sahr and her son were great, gracious hosts. Location A+ and the room was quiet and comfortable.

We really enjoyed our stay with Sahr although a short one - we were made to feel very welcome and at home.  Sahr is a wonderful host and very approachable.  She was always available if we had any questions or needed anything.  Our living space was very cozy, spacious and well appointed.  Its the first time we've stayed in this area and we really enjoyed it.  The location is perfect - walking distance to some great little restaurants and the metro.  Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the city.

We loved staying at this beautiful Airbnb. Sahr is amazing. Great vibes. Great atmosphere. Lots of beautiful art. Awesome backyard is a real plus! Wonderful location and accommodations. Very homey. We plan to stay here again.

This is our second stay at The Waverly. We chose this place because of its close proximity to Pratt Campus where our daughter is currently attending school. We have enjoyed staying at the Waverly and found this place to be spacious, clean and private. Sahr is friendly and helpful . We felt at home during our stay. and plan to return when we visit Brooklyn in the future. Susan and James

My mother's recent four-night stay at the Brooklyn Waverly was entirely satisfactory. The apartment was immaculate, spacious, comfortable and very attractive. It was such a pleasant environment to return to each night and felt like a haven from the bustle of Brooklyn.

Sahr couldn't have been more thoughtful and welcoming. She stocked the spotless refrigerator with fresh organic eggs, good coffee, yogurt, and other ingredients for a simple and satisfying breakfast. The bed was perfectly comfortable and the room perfectly quiet at night.

I very happily recommend the Brooklyn Waverly without reservation.

Our stay with Sahr at The Waverley was simply fantastic. She made us feel so welcome even before arriving, and was so helpful & communicative when we messed up our original dates. When we arrived we felt like we were meeting an old friend. She is the most gracious host, and our room was full of delicious treats. The private floor is spacious, warm and inviting, and very very comfortable - even a private garden outside! The location was fabulous for us as we were visiting our daughter in Brooklyn. It is in a great neighbourhood, and close by the subway and nice eateries. We arrived straight from a long haul flight and it was so inviting and restful. It was our first Airbnb stay, and we were simply delighted. Sahr was so helpful and inspiring. This is great value, and we wholeheartedly recommend it and Sahr to you. Thats for having us in your home!!

Hi all.
Sahr's place is a beautiful occasion to see New York. The neighbour is really pleasant & calm, vs Manhattan.
The room was great too, with a great space and a backward.
Sahr was really helpful and we love the welcome cocktail!
Rate: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Comfy stay in brooklyn!
Terrific stay- everything was seamless and perfect- wonderful host and lovely, comfortable place to stay- thank you!

First off, Sahr's tree-lined block of Waverly Avenue is lovely, with restored brick buildings, flowers blooming in pots, nice parks full of happy kids nearby, and a great market (Waverly Urban Gourmet) and a terrific coffee shop (Primrose) just a block away.

Sahr met me at the door, carried my bag down into the flat, and showed me how everything works. She was most hospitable and warm, and as I got to know her, I appreciated her breadth of knowledge, talent and experience; she's an interesting person. Be sure to ask her about her vintage clothing! I bought a beautiful hand-sewn caftan from her.

Sahr's son Idriys was polite and helpful, and Chester the dog is just as well-behaved as he can be (I'm not a dog person, but I liked Chester. He doesn't bark!)

Of all the Airbnb spaces I've rented, and I've rented a few, Sahr's was the best equipped. She truly has thought of every single thing you might need, from guidebooks and Broadway playbills to umbrellas and fresh-ground gourmet coffee. Be sure to explore every little nook of this beautiful flat; you'll be amazed at what Sahr has included for your comfort.

This clean, cheerful space was a perfect home base for me. I loved the bright eclectic decor, the comfy easy chair for reading, and I slept well in the large futon bed. The little fridge and hot plate were all I needed; Sahr has provided everything you'd want to prepare and enjoy simple meals.

Sahr's home is situated in a really lively, vibrant, fun area where I felt perfectly safe at all times, even walking home late at night. Twice I walked to BAM (Brooklyn Academy of Music) to watch great indie films, and I enjoyed Indian, Greek, and Nigerian meals at nearby restaurants. It's a wonderful neighborhood. I highly recommend Sahr's space for your next visit to Brooklyn.

I booked Sahr's place for my mother, and she really enjoyed staying there. Sahr is a truly gracious host and made my mother feel very comfortable and welcome. My mom felt that having the lower floor gave her the perfect amount of privacy/alone time when she needed it. She also enjoyed chatting with Sahr and playing with her adorable dog Chester!

Sahr was warm welcoming and friendly.  This was our first Airbnb experience and it was exactly as listed and instantly felt like home from home. Sahr even stocked a few basics in the fridge to get us started.  I would definitely recommend this as a place to stay with great subway links into Manhattan.
Sahr is very, friendly, eloquent, warm, always finding ways to further please your stay. We really enjoyed chatting with her and meeting her children.

Sahr was a perfect host and our family loved staying at her place.  She was really sweet to our two daughters, who are still talking about Chester (the cutest little dog).  She brought us an unexpected treat upon our arrival, that let us know that the stay would be a smooth ride.  A great place in a beautiful neighborhood in Brooklyn with the subway two blocks away (C or G train).  We can't wait to stay at Sahr's place again!
This was the perfect place for me. It was comfortable, quiet and close to great restaurants.
Sahr was so lovely the whole time I was in town. When I got sick she insisted on helping me. The neighbourhood is really charming too!
Second time at Sahr's. she and her son are lovely people and the space is very comfortable.

Sahr was an A+ communicator with me as the person making the reservation and with my parents and grandmother. No surprises, very professional. She welcomed them into her beautiful home very warmly and made sure they had not just what they needed on arrival but also throughout their stay. The space was spacious, private, and clean. Her neighborhood is the envy of most in NYC. I'd recommend a stay with her anytime you're​ in NYC and especially Brooklyn.

Had a great stay at Sahr's for 5 days. It was a comfortable stay for 3 people, and Chester the dog is very friendly and well behaved. We really appreciate the treats that Sahr shared with us. The place is in a very convenient location, close to the subway and in a charming neighborhood, but is also hidden from the noisy street. Communication with Sahr was easy before the stay. Thanks for everything!

I felt welcome at Sahr's home to minute I arrived. She was friendly and helpful , and at the same time respectful of my privacy. My room was spacious and well equipped, and I was comfortable. I chose Sahr's place because is was close to my son's home, and I stayed 6 nights. The neighborhood is wonderful with excellent restaurants, yoga studios, parks, and subway closeby. I walked to the Brooklyn Museum, and it was a quick subway trip to Manhattan.I only wish I had had more time to enjoy her brick patio.  I look forward to staying there on my next trip!

We live in the neighborhood and stayed at Sahr's place while getting some work done on our apartment.  Our stay was very comfortable.  The location is great, very close to wonderful restaurants and only a block to the the train.  The room was private, spacious, and clean with a comfortable bed and central air conditioning.  Sahr was very friendly and accommodating.  We would stay again, and recommend Sahr's place to friends visiting Brooklyn.

My son and my dog I felt very comfortable at Sahr's place. It has a comfy bed, a couch, a TV, and may amenities. I indulged in the coffee (with a french press) and treats they left for us. We didn't consume much of the food they offered, but it felt nice that it was available for us.

I love the neighborhood. There's Fort Greene Park nearby, and it's walkable and busable to good eats and other fun parts of Brooklyn. This is an ideal place for people who want to stay in Brooklyn and experience Brooklyn. If you're a tourist and you're in New York to do the Times Square/Broadway, save some time to walk around and be part of this area.

Thanks again.

The Brooklyn Waverly is a charming place to stay in a very convenient location in Brooklyn. The subway is just a short walk away and the neighborhood is safe and comfortable with some nice options for food nearby (Sisters, Emily, bagels). Closeby is an elementary school and Pratt a further walk away.

Sahr was a great host - responsive and warm. We stayed in the basement apartment room - there was a small kitchenette set up for us with some refreshments and towels for the bathroom. There is a 1/2 bathroom connected to the basement apartment and a full bathroom upstairs. Though we shared the home with Sahr, her son, and four-legged pal Chester, we never felt disturbed nor felt like we were encroaching on their space.

Overall a convenient place to stay in to explore Brooklyn and not too far from the city.
The host canceled this reservation 5 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Excellent stay with Sahr, Idriys & Chester. The space was clean and provided everything we could need for our extended stay. Hospitality was exceptional. We truly felt like part of the family. We even extended our stay with no issues.
The best part was that our Boston Terrier was welcomed, made herself at home and now has a best friend, Chester. Not only are you comfortable on Waverly, but the location is perfect for transportation, excellent dinners and great cafes. You will truly have the “BROOKLYN” experience. I would definitely recommend to any friends and family coming to visit NYC.

Wonderful stay on Waverly! The location is on a leafy street close to the train and restaurants. Sahr offered a warm welcome when I arrived and stocked the fridge with yogurt, juice, bread, and coffee. The room was comfortable and had everything I needed. I really enjoyed chatting with Sahr each day. Highly recommended!

Our 5 night stay as guests in Sahr's home was wonderful.   We truly felt like part of the family, yet they always respected our privacy.   We got to know the whole family - Sahr, Idriys, and Chester.    Sarh's tips and knowledge of Brooklyn and NYC were all extremely beneficial to the success our trip.   430 Waverly Ave is conveniently located to some great restaurants and the subway, thus a great  launching off point to whatever we wanted to do and wherever.  Our favorite neighborhood dining spots were Olea, Aita & Bergen Bagels.   Although it was a very cold week in NYC, we left knowing that we are warmly blessed to have new friends in Brooklyn.    We truly recommend Sahr's place.

I work in NYC and needed a temporary stay in between apts. The building is older, but what makes it special is Sahr's personal hospitality and effort to make the place comfortable with little details. (And Chester the dog is just adorable and friendly). Like everyone says, it feels like you're staying with actual family because Sahr is so warm and welcoming, which is wonderful, but maybe not the right fit if you're looking for a more independent hotel like stay. I would mention to travelers to be aware that this listing charges 1. A late check in fee, 2. Occupancy taxes (which most other NYC hosts don't charge for) 3. And you have to sign an external rental contract, which was all a little bit more work than the average airbnb. The space has changed since the photos were taken. The apt is very conveniently located near the multiple subway lines. The bathroom with a shower/bath is not attached to the private room, it's in the main part of Sahr's apartment and up a flight of stairs, so make sure you're ok with stairs before booking (I had a knee injury during my stay). I would recommend this listing for short-term budget travelers, or for people who want a lot of host interaction and guidance with NYC.

Sahr, a cheerful and warm host, welcomed us with thoughtful touches like stocking the fridge for breakfast. The apartment was a short walk to the trains but be prepared to travel at least half hour into the city. All in we had a pleasant and comfortable stay. Thanks Sahr.

I booked this stay for a visiting friend and cannot speak with specificity to the day to day experience but I found the host to be extremely responsive and helpful in making all arrangements and I understand the refrigerator was stocked for my guest upon his arrival, which seemed to be to be a very generous extra touch.

Great place to stay, near the metro and some very goog restaurants.
Cute room with a lot os interestings books with informacion and photos of NY.
Very clean and full os details to make you feel in home.
We really enjoyed our stay at Waverly, Sahr was really attentive and a great host

Sahr's place was really great and comfortable - it worked perfectly for our stay. The location was really great - close to a lot of lovely restaurants and bars. Sahr is attentive and professional. We had a 3 month old baby, and she and her son were really sweet and patient about the unpredictability of a baby! When we arrived, Sahr and her son even helped us carry our massive amounts of luggage. Their little dog, Chester, is adorable and SO SMART!

Because of the baby and flight times, we had a couple of additional requests to make of Sahr, and she went above and beyond to help us out and accommodate our needs. It was incredibly appreciated, and really helped to make our stay much easier and way less stressful than it otherwise could have been - especially traveling with a baby.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay - the space is clean, cool, and comfortable!

Nous avons été très bien accueillis et notre hôte s'est inquiétée de savoir si nous avions besoin de quelque chose, bien dormi etc. très gentille et sympathique et très discrète aussi, son fils est très sympa et même Chester le toutou est formidable, très calme et très obéissant. Le logement est très propre et tout à fait conforme à ce qui est promis. Le quartier est calme, propre et métro à deux pas. Nous recommandons cet endroit sans hésiter, nous avons passé un séjour formidable. Merci à notre hôte et sa petite famille que nous embrassons chaleureusement.
Loved the cats, very convenient location, cool roommates- had a lovely stay!

Ben is an awesome guy. Actually, I didn't meet him because he was out of town (this was why the room was free ;) ) but he gave me a lot of informations about the apartment, about the neighborhood, the roomates, the cats... I was feeling like at home!
The 3 roomates were amazing people and I hope I'll see them next time I'll be in NYC.
The apartment is really really nice, huge and the rooftop is just perfect.
Everything is clean and the two cats are adorable.
Thank you guys!

I had a great time staying in Williamsburg thanks to Ben and his awesome housemates. The room was clean/neat/tidy, housemates were friendly and considerate and eveything was as it had been described in the ad - not to mention located in a great 'hood.

Sono stato 5 notti in questo meraviglioso appartamento. Cynthia si è rivelata un'ottima host, sempre gentile e premurosa. Mi ha aiutato per ogni dubbio o richiesta sulla città La metro è vicinissima e comoda per raggiungere ogni parte di NY. Sicuramente la contatterò per un prossimo soggiorno.
Grazie Cynthia, alla prossima!!!

Thank you Cynthia so much for your hospitality, kindness and for caring so much.  I had an wonderful stay with you and enjoyed spending time out with you. I'm generally, don't mind a run-down place categorizing it under authentic but next time I come for a romantic get-away this would not be the place for me.

As I said it's a matter of exceptions.
His place is spacious and has everything that you need. Location is great. He accomates your needs. I would recommend this place
The apartment was very nice and clean.  Loved the location - able to walk almost everywhere.

This was my first Airbnb experience and it couldn't have gone any better! My boyfriend and I went to NYC for his birthday. Hudson was very accommodating and laid back. He was there at the apt when we arrived, answered all questions I had and was very responsive to my text messages. The apartment itself was clean and cozy. He provided clean sheets, blankets and towels for us. It was also really nice to have some outside space on the porch. The apartment was only 1 block from Central Park, this location is ideal for anyone who wants to experience real NYC living. I would definitely stay here again.

Two words...awesome location! Which for us, is by far the most important factor when choosing a place to stay - after all, how much time do you really spend in your lodging - especially in NYC? Hudson's apt is a block from Central Park and the subway. The Drake is one street over. Great restaurants (try the sheep's milk dumplings at Kefi on Columbus Ave.) and coffee shops. Zabars is a short stroll away. Much more authentic experience than staying in some generic hotel room. Our first time using airbnb.com and we will use it again. Thanks for everything, Hudson!

My stay at Sahr’s place was perfect. Clinton Hill is beautiful. Stones throw away from the subway. The room is perfect. Feels like you have your own little apartment. Sahr was incredibly hospitable. Going above and beyond to make sure I was happy and comfortable. She even had little cupcakes waiting for me in my room when I arrived. Great stay.
Good location - Sahr is a great hostess.

We had a wonderful time during our stay here. Beautiful place, easy check-in, nice touches (we loved the welcome cupcakes). We traveled with our four year old and infant and greatly appreciated the toys that Sahr set out and the pack n play. Great location, convenient to trains and walkable to Prospect Park!

Sahr es una mujer muy amable, muy agradable.  Me gusto mucho el lugar. Muy limpio.  Tener en cuenta que  el viaje en subterraneo  hasta el central park es media hora aproximadamente. Y al puente de brooklyn hay 5 kilometros.
Sahr has been a fantastic host to our daughter and friend.
A wonderful place to sleep in the city that never sleeps! + Amazing host.

I had a lovely month staying at Sahr's. The space was great - spacious, cozy, clean, peaceful, and perfectly located on a beautiful street. The neighborhood is also incredible, extremely close (2 blocks) to the subway, and contains the best of everything Brooklyn has to offer - great restaurants, beautiful architecture, interesting people - an all-around cool vibe! And apart from all that I had a great time getting to know Sahr. She's super smart, funny, sweet, responsive - the perfect hostess the entire time - and in the end a great new friend!

1. very smartly located in williamsburg, walking distance to anything in williams b.
2. clean, and crisp, just as it looks in photos
3. friendly accomodating hosts, provided local info

good stuff

Ming and Mat apartment is absolutely perfect! Located on a quiet and charming street, in a three floor house, it's perfect for a single person or a couple. The place itself is lovely, very bright and Ming and Mat were very accomodating and they did everything for us to feel "at home".
Also, it's in the heart of Williamsburg, a nice, young and arty neighbourhood, with tones of cool bars, shops, restaurant and just one subway sation from manhattan.
Next time I travel to New York I hope the place will be available!

A pitch perfect stay with Ming and Matt !! We arrived late on Sunday night after an arduous long distance drive (through pouring rain) only to have our gracious hosts wait up for us and save a street side parking spot. The Apartment itself is wonderful and very thoughtfully decorated and designed with everything you might need being at hand. It is not only clean and bright but has tonnes of character and many great details. The location can't be better , smack in the middle of all the action but on one of the only shorter and quieter streets in the area. We loved it ! We dined on many of Ming and Matt's insider tips and enjoyed them all . All in all a great stay ! we just hope there's going to be space for us on the calendar in the future !

Very close to Williamsburg's hippest spots, yet on an extremely quiet street. Ming and Matt have a very charming place, full of small details that will make you feel instantly at home in your make-believe chic Brooklyn flat.

Very lovely place and gorgeous hosts! Although the house is only a stone throw's away from Williamsburg's hot-spots (restaurants, bars, shops etc.), it is located in an extremely quiet and charming little street. The L-train to Manhattan is in walking distance. The place itself is lovely furnished, very bright and tidy. We felt immediately "at home" and enjoyed our stay very much. It couldn't have been any better!

We loved our stay at Ming and Matt's place. The apartment is the perfect size for a couple and comes equipped with everything you might need for your stay (including pastries on arrival! ). The location is great too, surrounded by a wide variety of cafes, restaurants and shops and only a short walk to the L train which takes you very speedily under the river to Manhattan. Ming and Matt are lovely and made our stay a real pleasure without ever intruding on our privacy.

I was very pleased that our professor loved his stay at Ming's guesthouse. The simplicity and charm of the apartment added to Ming's attention to detail and hospitality, makes this place a keeper in my rolodex. SV, Administrator CHE-NY

5日間泊まらせていただいて、素晴らしい経験ができました！
ベッドルームやキッチン、リビング、バスルームは隅々まで手入れが行き届いてていて、空調や収納など、使う人の目線に立った設備が整っていました。
Cynthiaさんの統一感のある部屋の環境づくりには、ただただ脱帽です。ぜひ一度泊まることをお勧めします。

ニューヨークを旅する際には、さまざまなアドバイスを下さるので、それもすごく助けとなりました。
最初から最後までお世話になり、本当に感謝しています。

Cynthia is a very nice host , hospitable and sweet.She is also a cool artist.The house is decorated very well, a lot of interesting stuffs to discover.  And the room is clean the bed is soft and cozy. I have a wonderful time there,we hung out together，eat and talk...make me feel like I real live in New York.Highly recommended.
Cynthia is a warm, available and correct host. She has a well kept place furnished with taste and creativity. A very pleasant stay and a pleasure to make her acquaintance.

We had such a wonderful stay with Ming and Matt, they made us feel at home immediately and the apartment was a delight, with everything you could need, modern finishings and a warm, historic feel. In a very quiet street literally the blocks from great coffee, restaurants, shopping and the L train, it was a great base for us to explore both the area and Manhattan over the week or so we stayed. We had so many great local tips and advice and even got to enjoy a local thanksgiving dinner! thanks again to you both and hope to stay again one day.

We spent 2 weeks here and it was just great.
The apartment is really nice and comfortable. Perfect for a couple.
It's perfect located. Close to the subway, 15min to Manhattan.
The neighborhood is awesome. Shops, restaurants, bars...
And Matt and Ming are really great hosts.
Totally recommended!
We had a wonderful time staying here. The apartment was charming, great location, and Ming was lovely. We would absolutely stay here again!

So wonderful. It was a lil sanctuary and the perfect place to set down temporary roots in the city. I absolutely love this apartment and its proprietors. It is so well appointed and relaxing and given my higher than normal aesthetic requirements (I'm an artist) I will return here in the future for sure!

We stayed in NYC for one week (our first time) and loved this perfect, beautiful and incredible clean apartment. It was so sweet!! Ming and Matt are the best hosts we can imagine: young, uncomplicated and really nice.
Actually we wanted to explore Manhatten (only 1 stop from there), but because of this wonderful apartment in Williamsburg we also got unbelievable impressions of this part of Brooklyn. Be sure to check out Bedford Ave, too!
We are looking forward to come back very soon!

Williamsburg is a great area, and Ming's place is close to subway, and awesome places to shop, eat and go out. Don't get put off that it is not in Manhattan. It is literally three stops on the subway!

Ming is an excellent host - very helpful and chilled out.

Defintely recommend it to anyone visiting New York. And will recommend to my friends and family too.

We spent a wonderful week at Ming and Matt's place and we really loved it ! The apartment is charming and you'll find everything you need to feel at home. Matt and Ming are really nice and helpful if you need anything but never intrusive.
Williamsburg is a great neighborhood (a lot of coffes, restaurants, shops...) and very close to Manhattan with the L train.
We just think about when we could come back to Brooklyn...

The best stay we ever had at a private apartment. Everything fits perfectly, it's charming and in a great location. We felt directly at home when Ming opened the door. I think Ming and Matt are both great and so nice to talk to. Ming was very helpful and so attend to us. We would love to come back one day.

Such a lovely flat! The flat was clean and beautifully decorated, Ideal for 2 people to share. perfect location and a relaxing area to stay in. A treat to escape to after a day out, Ming was very sweet and thoughtful, perfect host!
And.. not to forget,,, the almond pastry from the nearby patisserie was something from heaven..
Would love to come back and stay in Williamsburg again soon!
Wonderful! Ming and Matt are delightful. The pad is perfect and it's smack bang in the middle of cool. Yes. We liked it a lot. Thanks Ming!

We loved, staying at Ming and Matt. We definetly high-recommend staying there and would love to come back one day.
The apartment is so sweet and made with love. we really felt like home, once we arrived. tired after the long flight from germany, matt already waited for us at the entry and we had a nice welcome by ming, matt and their nice dog charlie. the bed is comfortable, the shower has a rain-shower in it and the kitchen is great - has a big fridge and an oven. you´ll find supermarkets all around and ming and matts ideas made our trip perfect. whenever we had some questions or problems, they helped out perfectly. it was like a family. time was running in williamsburg - for us the best place to stay while visiting NYC. and definetly the nicest hosts we ever met!! discover big, loud and awesome nyc - and come and feel home at night at ming and matt in williamsburg.we´ll be back and tell all our friends about their great hospitality. THANKS M&M :-)

Verena and Kris (Krefeld, Germany)

This apartment was wonderful!  The location was quiet, the view out to the backyard very pleasant.  Lists of restaurants, breakfast place, etc., were helpful.  Very private.  I couldn't believe the amenities!  The shower was great, the bed comfortable.  I didn't want to leave!  Thanks, Ming!

We had a great 10-day stay in this wonderful apartment. The photos shown on this website represent it well: it is clean, calm, cozy and fitted with everything you might need. Subway, supermarket and Bedford Avenue are just a short walk as are the many nice restaurants, cafe's and shops in the neighbourhood. Ming and Matt are most welcoming hosts who will surely assist and advise wherever they can. But by far the best part of our stay was the birthday cake waiting for me upon arrival!

We've just spent three weeks at Ming and Matt's apartment. The place was spotlessly clean when we arrived and there were some very lovely cupcakes in the fridge! Our hosts were very helpful, thoughtful and friendly throughout our stay and Ming's communication was before our arrival was thorough and reassuring. You really couldn't ask for more.
It must be one of the best locations not just in New York, but in Williamsburg. Walk out the front door and go north, east, south or west and you will pass a bar you want to drink in, a restaurant to try out tomorrow and a shop selling something you'll want to take home. To be that close to all those fantastic bars, restaurants and shops, but to feel like you are in a residential neighbourhood is really special. The bars mean there is sometimes some loud music at night, but hey, it's NYC, you're going to get some noise. We hope it won't be too long before we go back.

Ming and Matt were perfect hosts - always around to help out and organise things like a taxi to the airport. The apartment is located right in the middle of Williamsburg, putting it in the centre of all that Williamsburg has to offer. Clean linens, towels and home comforts are provided in abundance. Ming has thought of everything to make your stay comfortable and convenient. The shower is fabulous and the space is spotless and fresh. You will never want to leave!

Ming and Mat are fantastic hosts and they have the best place to stay in Williamsburg. The important things are all there: great location, close to subway, private and quiet. And then there were subtle, yet very pleasant details which meant a lot to us: great decoration, clean, functional and with all the personality you would expect from Williamsburg.... Lots of natural light and a garden view...Amenities such as organic shampoo, good quality towels, water filter, green cleaning supplies, beach towels, good books on the shelves, umbrellas, maps...Also, Ming and Mat were super friendly and more than willing to go out of their way to make our stay memorable. We definitely recommend their place!

Ming and Matt?!? What a surprise!

this lovely apartment is so cool to make you feel like a real williamsbourg people.
perfectly located, is in the real center of what is going on in the neighborhood, were you can find many cool bar, resturant, shop and young beautiful people.
it is also perfectly clean, with everything you can need during your permanence.
Ming and Matt are so sweet friends and they were really helpfully with all infos and helps.

i'll reccomend this place to every one who whats to live an nyc real experience, out of turist trap!
Great quiet apartment in a central location. Strong AC, powerful wifi.Matt and Ming are gracious and relaxed. Really makes you feel like part of the neighborhood.

We have had a fabulous stay. Ming and Matt are very kind, generous and thoughtful hosts and the apartment is even more charming than you would expect from the pictures. Williamsburg is a lively neighourbood with many nice bars and restaurants and loads of original vintage clothing shops and record stores to check out. Manhattan is only one subway stop away. Next time we visit NYC we will definitely stay at this lovely 'Retreat in Williamsburg' again!

Only one word to describe this place: perfect! Ming and Matt were so welcoming and helpful, it really felt like a home from home.

Every detail in the apartment has been thought through - all the products are eco-friendly, the furniture and fittings are great, and the bathroom (particularly the shower) is fantastic!

Williamsburg is a great area to stay in NYC, close to Manhattan but loads going on in its own right. Ming and Matt provided some great recommendations of local places to eat and drink so you're never at a loss for somewhere to go.

I would definitely recommend this place to any vistor to New York, and will definitely be coming back myself!

The apartment was a very charming and quiet getaway. We had everything we needed in the apartment, thanks to Ming. There's also no shortage of restaurants and bars nearby. I would definitely consider staying again. Ming was so thoughtful have delicious pastries waiting for us from around the corner and shared her coffee with us as well. Good coffee!

I just left Ming & Matt's lovely apartment in Williamsburg yesterday and I miss it already! I have rented numerous other flats around Brooklyn over the years and this one by far was my favorite. When making the initial arrangements, it was very easy to contact and communicate back and forth with Ming regarding details. When I checked in, I felt like I was arriving for a visit with friends.

The apartment is the perfect size for a single traveler or a couple. The bedroom is comfortable and has a beautiful, but gentle light in the morning. The kitchen feels big and functions as both kitchen and sitting area as there is no living room. As someone who likes to cook on vacation, I found the kitchen stocked with basics like oil, salt, pepper, coffee, teas and more. The bathroom is wonderful! It has beautiful tile work and the dual shower was a great touch. The pictures don't do justice to this space - it is gorgeous!

Thank you again for a wonderful stay - I will most certainly be back again and plan to stay here!

We had a fantastic stay at Ming and Matt's apartment. If you are interested in spending time in Williamsburg, this is a great place to stay! So close to Bedford Ave and only one subway stop from Manhattan's Lower East Side. The apartment is absolutely perfect for a single or couple - it was very clean when we arrived and was perfectly equipped with everything we needed to make our stay extremely enjoyable. We will always recommend this to others and we will definitely be back!

Ben and Claire

Staying at Hudson's was perfect. If you're someone who loves amazing city parks, then I would recommend staying here. On one side you've got Central Park (3 min walk) and the other Riverside Park (10 mins). Rent a bike (also close by) and go nuts in these parks or on NYC new bike lanes.  In addition to the parks the apartment is extremely close to the subway, great restaurants, bakeries and the rest of Manhattan. Inside the apartment is everything you need, not to mention a balcony for optimal people watching. Hudson was really easy to get a hold of, really nice, always answered questions quickly and arranged to a convenient key drop off even though we arrived at 1am. Would go back again, and would recommend to others.

Hudson’s apartment was great! I’ve received the keys of the department by Hudson’s friendly neighbor Christoph who offered me help for everything even though I’ve arrived around 11:00pm. Hudson kept continuous communication during the time I spent at his place and also gave me advice about places to visit and transportation.

About the apartment, the location was just perfect!!! You have a Starbucks and a food store in front of the apartment. Central Park is just two blocks away!!!!!! also you’ll find banks, restaurants, and a metro station near this place. Columbus Circle is close and I enjoyed walking until Time’s Square. Since the apartment is located in a corner you have lots of natural light and a great view. The wifi worked perfectly and no problems with any appliance.

It was my first experience using AIRBNB and it was pretty awesome.

Awesome location! A block from Central Park and a block from the 72nd express. Loved the two terraces. Hudson was very kind and provided everything we needed. This was my first time using AirBnB and I don't think I'll ever stay in a hotel again! I used to live on the Upper West Side and it was so great to return and have such an amazing experience. I would definitely stay here again.

In NYC is all about the location, and this apt's location is perfect! one block to Central Park and 72nd st Subway, lots of restaurants/delis/markets nearby (theres 24 hour market downstairs). my girlfriend did say the bathroom needs a little love, but been a guy's place its not bad.  The bed is very confortable, the apt was clean and cozy. Cool host, he arranged with us early check in and a late check out without any issues, great airbnb experience!

We chose this property for it's air conditioning, location, internet, and the host's flexibility.
None disappointed.
Although the AC in the bedroom had a crackle noise to it, the overall experience was excellent, and I would visit again.

We really enjoyed our stay in NYC and Hudson's place was great. The location was perfect: so close to Central Park and two subway lines that can get you anywhere. The apartment was actually bigger than we expected and Hudson was flexible with the check-in/out times. The kitchen was small but with so many nice places to eat near-by this was a non-issue. It was our first time using this site and we would definitely use it again!

Had an amazing time! Perfect location, one block away from Central Park and I think I'm in love with this city!! Hudson is an amazing host how kept in contact with us the whole time and suggested fun free things to do, lived like real New Yorkers and loved it

Host was helpful, friendly, and responsive.
Location! Location! Location!
Price was right!

Stay here! Hudson was a sweet, gracious host, responsive and helpful. As an example of his graciousness, even when we called him with a situation that turned out to be 100% our fault, (we were embarrassingly at the door of the wrong unit and could not open the door), he was still nice.  As for the apartment, we could not have been more satisfied with our stay.  It is perfectly located, steps from Central Park, subways, excellent dining, shopping  and entertainment.  The unit extremely  comfortable with all amenities you could want and then some.  The private balcony is large and very much adds to the overall experience of spaciousness. We made as much use of it as possible during our Spring visit. Try a glass of wine at sunset or wake up in the fresh air with bagels and coffee in the am. If available we will definitely keep on our list for a return visit. Thanks Hudson!

Hudson was a helpful host, providing lots of great restaurant suggestions.  The location of the apartment was excellent for us, a block from Central Park and 2 blocks from the Beacon Theatre.  Sheets and towels were fresh, but overall, the apartment was way below my standard of cleanliness.
The apartment is so cute, and Hudson is great. He even drove out of his way to get my the keys. It is a great location, and the bed is super comfy. Great balconies. Thanks for an awesome stay!

We enjoyed our stay very much especially thanks to the location of the apartment. Minutes away from Central Park, 25 minutes away from 5th Avenue it was ideal! Nevertheless,  there are great restaurants in the neighborhood. Hudson was very quick in responding to our inquiries and made sure someone came to greet us upon our arrival. The apartment is charming but could have been a bit cleaner but honestly it wasn't a big deal for us as we weren't much in it anyway.

Hudson was accommodating and able to meet me at his place once i arrived in the city.  The location is a nice, quite spot on the upper east side.  It has great access to the subway and it has a great bodega downstairs for getting all the essentials, such as milk and water.

We had a great weekend staying at Hudson’s apt.  Pictures are accurate.  The place is charming and located in a perfect location.  Hudson is a gracious and accommodating host.  I would definitely recommend.

Perfect quite place in Manhattan: very close to Central Park and the subway station.
We stayed in this nice, cosy apartment, for 2 nights (one of us on the bed and one on the sofa) and had a great time.

We enjoyed staying in Hudson's home over the thanksgiving period. The best things about the flat are its windows and its brilliant situation, a block from central park (where we watched the thanksgiving parade) and a couple of blocks from the Beacon Theatre. A useful and friendly 24 hour shop downstairs, and Starbucks across the street. We felt like New Yorkers.
The central heating system for the block kept us toasty warm, but is oddly noisy at times.
The flat might not be suitable for those who want a minimalist or highly polished hotel room type experience, but we enjoyed staying here.

My stay at Hudson's place was incredible! The space was exactly as pictured and more! Not only was there plenty of space, but it was clean and in a great location. With a balcony AND a terrace (something almost no other apartment on our block had) we had amazing views with great people watching. There is a Starbucks steps out the front door and Central Park is only one block away! There are also subway stations 1.5 blocks away. On top of everything else, Hudson's hospitality was above and beyond! He texted us throughout our trip to make sure we were having a good time and even sent us info on events going on near the place. Upon our arrival he even graced us with a bottle of wine! I couldn't speak more highly and I hope I get the chance to stay here again!
Hudson's place was the perfect way to spend a weekend in NYC and actually "live" like a New Yorker. The apartment was fair-sized by NYC standards. The location was Absolutely Fabulous!

Hudson fue muy atento aunque no tuvimos la posibilidad de conocerlo personalmente. Su apartamento queda en una ubicación espectacular y nos resulto muy cómodo para todo lo que quisimos hacer. Tiene todo lo necesario para cocinar y relajarse. La única diferencia que encontramos con el anuncio fue que no disponía de una notebook aunque no la necesitábamos.

Hudson's place is loaded with character and very clean. The kitchen is small, but who's cooking while visiting New York?  The balcony was awesome and a sitting out there at night after a long day of exploring the city was a perfect way to end the day. The building is quiet and in a great location one block from Central Park. We were also only a block from two different subway stations, which took us everywhere we wanted to go, including Yankee Stadium and downtown. There are lots of great bakeries, restaurants, and cafes in the neighborhood, so finding delicious food was easy. Hudson even gave us some suggestions based on our tastes. He was very easy to communicate with and answered all of our questions promptly. We were able to take his parking spot on his way out, so parking our car for the weekend was simple, too. It's hard to imagine a better place and host. My husband and I are looking forward to our next trip and would gladly stay at Hudson's place again.

Great location and great communication from Hudson during the whole stay.  He recommended a few bars and restaurants in the area.  Was very helpful arranging the collection of keys for us.  Would def stay here again , thanks Hudson!
Excellent neighbourhood, the apartment is clean and welcoming. If you're looking to stay somewhere that really feels like Manhatten, this is it. Skip the hotel!

This place was perfect for me and my son on a 3 night trip to New York. Close to Central Park and several art museums. We loved its homeliness and felt like it was our home! It was lovely to sit on the balcony in the cool mornings and evenings watching local street life.

Hudson's place was great!  Conveniently located to several subway lines giving you easy access to the whole city, steps away from Central Park and amazing UWS restaurants.  Building / fixtures is on the older side but not unusual for NY - had all the charm/character you'd want from an NY apartment.  The balcony was a bonus!  Hudson was a great host - very friendly, responsive and flexible.  Would recommend the place for solo/couple travelers to NY.

Hudson is a very welcoming and friendly host.
His place is cosy, charming and very well located to move in the City.
The neighbourhood is very pleasant with nice shops and places to eat.
I definitely recommend!
Hudson is great
Très bon séjour chez Hudson, qui est très arrangeant et réactif. Excellent emplacement. Appartement de caractère, caractéristique de New York.
Hudson is a excellent host. Always available to help, reliable and kind. The apartment reflected the description and was very well equipped. I really felt home. Thank you Hudson.

She is an excellent hostess, friendly and warm. Her apartment fascinate me. It has an exquisite taste in decor and admired both for her achievements at home and by the great person she is. Greetings and i hope we are in touch for the next.

Best. Isis

Staying at Cynthia's was a special event. First, her place is exquisitely decoarated with an eclectic touch that only an artist like her could provide. Coming home each night to her warm abode was like returning to a familiar surrounding you knew all of your life. But most importantly, was Cynthia herself. She not only made me feel very much at home but offered such an engaging conversation I look very forward to staying with her over and over again. I definitely found a wonderful new friend to talk and laugh with on my often otherwise weary travels about.

Five stars! Highly recommend!

Good location，amazing decoration，warm care！All about Sweetie Cynthiais is a pretty good host. 5 days stay with a artist is a good experience.The room which I stayed is clean and warm，every morning she made apple&banana smoothie for me and we sit together and talk about our life.If u come to NYC，you cannot miss her place which felt like stay at home.

A very warm fine little room in the heart of Greenpoint with a single bed suitable for one person. it worked out well for me.
Close to many great eating and drinking establishments with a subway stop a block and a half away.

I stayed at Vanessa's for 4 nights, and had a very comfortable stay. The house is cozy and clean, and quiet during the day and the night. The room, although a bit small, has everything you need in it, and Vanessa was a perfect host. It is very close to the near subway, and walking distance from Bedford. Plus - a lot of nice Polish restaurants in the vicinity...
Vanessa was a nice host, the flat is comfortable and clean and the location quite convenient to reach Manhattan and the rest of the city! Try it out!

I had a great stay at Vanessa's. It's a nice room in the heart of Greenpoint, just fine for 1 person and accessible to everything.  I hardly spent any time there except to sleep.  Vanessa was a great hostess and gave me all the privacy I needed (a pass-through to the kitchen would make the room less private but Vanessa gives you all the privacy you want).  I would stay there again any time.

I loved the location! So close to everything! This space is like most places I've seen in NYC- little :)  but the desk and high speed wireless internet in the room was super helpful for me as as I needed that for work.  I also was thankful for access to the  back yard for doing my morning yoga practice. It was quite overgrown at this time though, but I didn't mind. Vanessa was friendly and helpful. I guess being from California I'm used to big spaces, so I couldn't do the little bed for more than a day or 2, but again I was very happy with proximity to everything!
The reservation was canceled 6 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Unfortunately I didn't have the chance to get to know Vanessa since she was not there when I arrived. But everything was perfectly arranged. She provided blankets and towels for me. Everything was clean and tidy. I loved staying at her place and I only can recommend it for other people who need a place in NYC.

The location of the apartment is great for those who would like to explore Brooklyn and beyond (the G stop is on the same block as the flat).  The area felt very safe, even in the later hours, as people frequent restaurants and bars in Greenpoint throughout the day.  The apartment itself felt surprisingly quiet; it is so much more peaceful than most of Manhattan!  Vanessa is nice and gives you a lot of privacy.  One thing I would note is that there is a wall opening between the kitchen area and the bedroom.  It's not a big deal, as Vanessa rarely spends any time in that section of the apartment, but just something that might not be very apparent from the pictures/listing.  Overall, this is a very good option at the price.
The reservation was canceled 18 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

The apartment is very well located and the room is quiet. Vanessa was away during most of my stay but she kept in touch to make sure everything was alright. She also woke up very early on a Sunday morning to open the door as I took a red-eye to come to NY...
I'll definitely reach out to her again when I come back to NY.

Vanessa's place is very clean and tidy. It's right above the vibrant street but absolutely quiet. It's not spacious but has just everything you need. Vanessa is helpful in providing travel guides and she even drew me a map :D The room is connected to the artistic kitchen and Vanessa gives you enough privacy. I like the comfortable pillow. Overall, it's a happy experience.
Communication was easy and Vanessa made me very welcome. The apartment is extremely conveniently located, close to the subway.

Vanessa is very welcoming and pleasant. She gave me a brief tour of the apartment when I moved in. The room looks like in the picture. The apartment (the room, bathroom, kitchen etc.) is very clean. I had a pleasant time staying here.
Vanessa was very pleasant and communication was very good.
Great location! Close to G train.

Highly recommend. Cannot beat this value.

Great location - 4 minute walk to subway and 20 sec to bus which connects you easily and quickly to various parts of Manhattan and Brooklyn. Organic (as well as regular) grocery stores and lots of awesome restaurants and stores near by. Very safe neighborhoods

THE PLACE:

THE HOST:

CONCLUSION:
Rent it with your eyes closed. In my opinion (plain guest), satisfaction guaranteed!

Daniel and Nazleen were very welcoming and although we really didn't get to meet, I could tell how warm, honest, and welcoming they are.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. It had everything we needed (eg. fridge, microwave, toiletries, towels, air conditioning - a bit noisy but very useful on a hot day). The view from balcony is a bit obstructed by one building but still beautiful. The journey to the centre of Manhattan by public transport took us from around 35 to 50 minutes. There are maps and other useful information in the apartment that can help you plan your stay. Nazleen and Daniel are perfect hosts: very friendly and accommodating, and thanks to them our experience was all the more enjoyable.

Nazleen & Daniel's mini studio was great! It had everything we needed and they really make excellent use of the space. Getting around using the bus and subway was relatively easy, and Nazleen & Daniel were very accommodating when we couldn't find a place to park our car upon arrival. Nazleen even turned on the A/C before we arrived to cool it off for us! The bed was comfy, towels fresh, and they even manage to fit a small table and chairs for meals, an impressive feat given the space of the typical NY apartment space. The shower also had pumps for shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, and lotion, which is not a feature I've experienced in other AirBnBs (I also appreciated the hairdryer in the apartment, which I had forgotten to pack). The private roof/deck area was an added bonus. I would recommend this place to any and all NYC travelers looking for an affordable spot in a reasonable location!

Great place, great location, very helpful hosts. Nazleen was very considerate and helpful throughout the entire process. The apartment is as nice as pictured. It is a perfect place to stay close to the city and the private roof deck is a really nice touch! I stayed here for almost 3 weeks and enjoyed my entire time there. It is a great place, great location, great hosts.

Fully and completely recommend!

Our stay at Daniel and Nazleen's Astoria studio was great! The studio was clean, very comfortable and roomy. We especially loved coming home each evening after a busy day in the city to a hot shower and comfy bed to sleep in. Nazleen left specific directions on how to access everything from the Wifi to public transport into the city. Our first day we were a bit confused on how to navigate the buses to get to the train, and we ended up on Roosevelt island instead of Manhattan! By day 2 we had it figured out and were in the city within 20 minutes (Bus ride + Q train into Times Square). We used Uber both days to get back to the apartment (first from Times Square and then from Yankee Stadium). Both rides were under $20. We spent most of our time in Manhattan, so we didn't get to see much in Astoria, however the neighborhood was VERY quiet at night and we felt safe walking to the bus stop each morning (which is almost directly across the street from the apartment). Nazleen was available to answer any questions and Daniel came up to check on us before we checked out. Other than those interactions, the studio was very private. There is no elevator, so be prepared to climb 5 flights of stairs to the studio's rooftop entrance. We had a rental car and parking was not an issue. We cannot wait to return to NYC and see more of the sites! :) Thanks again for awesome accommodations.

L'appartement (encore plus beau en vrai!) est très bien situé métro tout proche et central parc à 5 minutes à pied. Et l'hôte, Cynthia est ADORABLE : très réactive aux messages, attentive aux détails et à l'écoute de son hôte, de superbes discussions, bonne conseillère sur les bonnes adresses et endroits à visiter, un smoothie wouaouh tous les matins. Avoir une hôte comme Cynthia rend le séjour encore plus parfait!

Tolles Apartment mit schicker, liebevoller, wenn auch leicht toskanisch-viktorianischer Einrichtung. Bett himmlisch. Lage hervorragend. Gastgeberin ungeheuer nett und hilfsbereit. Wer allerdings viel sitzen möchte, hat schlechte Karten, da es keine Stühle gibt.

I stayed at Cyn's place for 5 days, but thanks to her great hospitality, I felt as if I've already lived many years there. Everything in her place is aesthetic until the tiniest details, I felt like living in the museum. The location is perfect, too, it is very well connected with public transportations, you can go everywhere easily. She also gave me a great introduction to the NY city. Cyn is an energetic, super cool and open-hearted person - one of the most amazing persons I've ever met! Sincere thanks again for all lovely time during my NY stay, and hope to see you soon again!

I had a fantastic trip in New-York and Cyn's place was great !
The location is very good (next to the metro '6', some good restaurants in the neighborhood...) and Cyn is friendly, everything good ^^

The bed was very comfortable
The room was an adequate size for one person
The bathroom was clean
Privacy was good
Public transport was close by

So much to love about this place! It's arty and interesting and comfortable and clean. It's also in a great neighbourhood. Right away from all the touristy hoo-har of mid-town and downtown, but easily accessible on two subway lines - the 6 and the Q. If you're staying for over a week like I did, Cyn will provide you with a metro card. All you have to do is load it up for $32 and you go anywhere and everywhere you want. But the best thing about this place is Cyn herself. I started most of my mornings with a healthy smoothie and oodles of interesting chit-chat. NYC is an awesome place anyway, but staying here made it even more awesome!

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment is beautifully furnished and decorated and the neighborhood has great shops and restaurants and so close to Central Park! And course the subway. Cynthia is a fantastic host and her smoothies are amazing! Would thoroughly recommend staying here
Un séjour douillet, dans un décor féérique et une hôte souriante, joyeuse et pleine de bons plans. Une artiste au coeur grand  ❣

Cyn Is a photographer and artist.   Her home has been an ongoing art project for about 20 years.  It is beautiful, comfortable, and every detail has been thought through. Committed to her guests’ comfort, she happily oriented me to the neighborhood and gave me ideas for what to see in Manhattan.  I had a great time —and a much better time than had I stayed In a hotel. Thank you so much, Cyn!
Un bon spot au calme proche du métro.
Cyn's place is amazing.  She is friendly, courteous, helpful and a great hostess with the mostess!

Absolutely terrific. Excellent communication leading up to my arrival, including quick and helpful responses. Flat itself is spotlessly clean and beautifully furnished, with real care evident throughout. Cyn was a perfect host - incredibly generous and willing to share local's tips for New York. Great location, too - just a minute's walk from the subway, so east to get anywhere. Plus lots of the main museums and galleries are within walking distance from the flat anyway! Would highly recommend.

I love Cyn’s magic house ,which makes me feel warm and cozy. She always tell me the best tips and gives me the nice caring. The location is also good that can let u go anywhere u want to go within the least time.
If u want to experience the local American life,I really recommend that. Thanks Cyn!

O apartamento é muito estiloso e bem localizado, a 1 quadra e meia do metrô, 1 quadra de Starbucks, farmácia... então facilmente você pode ir onde quiser. Na chegada há escadas, mas ela te ajuda com a mala. Fui no extremo inverno e o chuveiro é bem quentinho. A cama, o edredom e o travesseiro são maravilhosamente confortáveis, e o quarto é 100% silencioso então você pode dormir até a hora que quiser. O  quarto é bem pequeno, então se você tiver com muitas malas pode ser complicado. Cyn é uma excelente pessoa e te deixa muito a vontade, como se fosse sua própria casa. Ela deixa você tomar 2 banhos no dia (e até gosta que você tome), é muito limpa e organizada. Te trata calorosamente e amigavel, e mesmo se você não dominar o inglês, ela tem toda a paciência do mundo e te ensina quantas vezes for necessario como funciona as coisas da casa te mostrando na prática, não com bilhetinhos, o que torna mais agradável. E sempre dará um jeito de ajudar você quando você estiver em apuros. Ela me ajudou muito, não sei o que seria de mim sem ela. Pediu até para uma amiga dela intermediar a conversa em português comigo e me deu muitas dicas e atenção quando teve uma tempestade de neve. Eu só tenho a agradecer. Eu realmente recomendo que você se hospede em lugar onde você possa se sentir seguro.

Cyn is the most amazing host, super welcoming, friendly, warm, attentive, communicative and caring. Her house is a spectacular artistic project, spotlessly clean, super comfortable, perfectly located. I truly enjoyed staying with Cyn and believe this is the absolutely perfect place to stay in NYC. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful time staying at Nazleen and Daniel's.  They had some trouble with the air conditioner right before we arrived to 90+ degree weather, but they were very communicative about what happened and that they had plans to get it fixed ASAP.  It all worked out perfectly and everything ended up being taken care of before we arrived.  Daniel was so accommodating, and even let us leave our bags with them until they finished upstairs. Thank you again for taking such good care of us!

Nazleen's apartment was the perfect place for me and one of my friends to stay. It was clean, cozy, very affordable, and a quick cab ride to many attractions. The view of the skyline is awesome as well. Thanks for hosting us!

Daniel and Nazleen were the perfect hosts! Daniel met us downstairs and brought us to our studio-- it was beautiful. There was a binder full of information as well as a guest book. The guest book provided us with information on the area as well as other guests' thoughts. They checked in on us on the last day. We had a good amount of communication.

The space is very clean and modern. The bed was so comfortable and the lounge chair outside was also comfortable. There was closet space and drawers for storage. The studio is very clean. The location is also prime and transportation was simple. We were in Time Square in about a half hour and the buses run early and late (except on some days, like Sunday).

My girlfriend and I recommend this place for for anyone and everyone looking to visit New York. The view is beautiful, too.

for ourfirst time to NY, apartment was up to our expectations :comfort, air conditionning, accessibility downtown, free parking and the best surprise is the large terrace and stunning views.... wonderful...amazing. We were with two children and we felt like home. Nasleen and Daniel were available and caring.
We recommend it 100%.

L'emplacement idéal pour visiter NY, très bon rapport qualité prix, parking gratuit, terrasse et vue splendide comme dans les séries américaines ;-)
et les hôtes au top!

Just returned home from staying in this studio.  The room was quite clean and cozy.  All the amenities were as described in the listing.  Had some questions for Nazleen, and she was very prompt in replying.  The location of the studio was great as it was VERY close to public transportation.  I would highly recommend this studio to any couple wishing to visit NYC.

Cyn es una gran anfitriona. Pasé ocho noches en su apartamento y aun habiendo otras dos personas hospedadas, siempre tuve privacidad. La habitación es muy silenciosa. Cyn está atenta a lo que necesites y a responder a las preguntas. La ubicación es ideal porque hay dos estaciones de metro, una a 70 metros y otra a 300 metros, desde donde se puede acceder en 15 minutos al centro de Manhattan. Por Lexington hay muchos lugares para tomar café, almorzar, cenar y se percibe tranquilidad y seguridad a toda hora.

Great apartment to stay in, nice size room with enough space for all clothes and essentials. Location is excellent for public transport, local food and shopping. Will definitely be staying here again if I go back to New York
Perfect location for Williamsburg, very simple, clean and comfi flat, amazing hosts. Coffee, tea and flowers definitively a plus! I definitively recommend and will come back. Thank you Ming & Matt
Immaculately clean. Exceptionally accommodating.

We had the very best time in this retreat in Williamsburg. Ming and her family were absolutely amazing. Their kindness was exceptional! We arrived f.e. a little bit late because it took us a while to get out of JFK - they were already waiting and when we asked them where we could change our money because the airport exchange had some problems - they borrowed us more than enough and we could give it back to them a day after. So, so very nice and lovely the three of them!

The apartment itself is very well located, has everything you could wish for and is very very clean. We can highly recommend this lovely airbnb apartment and will definitely come back! Love to Ming and their family and thank you once again for having us*

Ming & Matt are fantastic hosts, they let me felt like at home from the very first moment. They are easy to communicate, incredibly polite and very helpful.
The apartment itself is absolutely beautiful, very clean, comfy, spacious and located in a lovely renovated old house and nice neighborhood.
