I enjoyed my stay very much and would highly recommend to anyone traveling to NYC.
Thank you again for wonderful and perfect three weeks !!!

A great place! Perfectly located for exploring the NYC and very tastefully furnished for those who want to stay in. Ming & Matt really care about this being a special experience - the apartment has everything you need from towels, books, through umbrella to coffee.  In addition they are always available to help and give advice, e.g. on hairdressers (thanks again!), help with arranging the transport. Also before the arrival - very responsive and flexible with the arrival/departure time. I could go on and on. Just perfect and I'm definitely going to be back.

Our stay was completely perfect!
Beautiful place and really great hosts. (Ming and Matthew are a lovely couple).
Ming was very kind from our very first communication and was very flexible about our arrival and departure.
The location could not be better, in a vibrant neighbourhood and just 1 subway station to Manhattan. The apartment is cozy, spacious and clean. Would definitely recommend this place to everyone travelling to NYC

Ming is a dream- unfathomably accommodating and organized. The place is exactly as pictured; minimalistic with character and cleanliness. I couldn't have been happier; the fact that it's only a couple of blocks from great restaurants, Whole Foods, and good coffee didn't hurt either.
Ming's apartment was very nice, and located in a great neighborhood. I had a wonderful stay, and would highly recommend it to anyone who is traveling to New York.

Gibt es etwas Schöneres, bei einer Unterkunft im Regen anzukommen und der Gastgeber öffnet die Tür und heisst einen aufs freundlichste willkommen, bevor man überhaupt die Klingel drücken kann? Ich glaube nicht. Matt, der host, führte uns in der Wohnung im ersten Stock seines Hauses herum (er und Ming leben mit Katze, Hund und Baby im Erdgeschoss) und erzählte Geschichten über die Entwicklung von Williamsburg. Beide waren sehr offen und hilfsbereit.
Das Apartment ist genau das, was die Bilder versprechen: eine entspannte location mit einem gewissen "Berlin"-Charme. Also: keine rechten Winkel und steriles Hotel-Ambiente. Alles sauber und viele kleine liebevolle Details: eine edle Tafel Schokolade der Mast-Manufaktur, Mineralwasser, hochwertige Duschseife. Die Wohnung liegt 5 min. entfernt von 2 U-Bahnstationen - die L-Linie führt einen in 10 min. direkt nach Manhattan. Mit den Citibike-Leihrädern lässt sich sogar ganz gemütlich rüberradeln!
Williamsburg ist ein lebendiges Viertel, hat viele schöne Cafes (Five Leaves!), Kneipen (die Terasse des Juliette) und locations (Rough Trade). Ein phantastischer Wholefoods-Supermarkt ist um die Ecke.
Fazit: Williamsburg und Mings/Matts-Wohnung: eine gute Kombination.

Ming et sa famille nous ont accueillis très chaleureusement dans leur appartement qui était bien plus spacieux que ce nous avions imaginé. Propre, lumineux, calme, très bien équipé et décoré avec goût, nous nous sommes immédiatement senties à la maison. Havre de paix que nous nous réjouissions de retrouver après de longues journées à sillonner Manhattan et Brooklyn.
Nous recommandons vivement ce logement et espérons pouvoir y retourner prochainement.

This was our second stay at Ming's place and it was just as perfect as the first time.  This place is ideal in terms of location, proximity to great restaurants, bars and transport.  Remarkably quiet at night despite being in such a busy area as it's on a lovely quiet street.  The bed is super comfortable, and the house is tastefully appointed with all that one needs.  We will definitely be back again!

We have stayed at Ming's apartment the last few times we have visited NYC and couldn't ask for a better place to call home whilst visiting.

The apartment is perfect, it's in a great location and Ming & Matt are the best hosts.

There is nowhere else we would stay when visiting New York.

This is such a wonderful apartment. Located in a quiet street, but so close to everything - great location. It is bright, clean and very Williamburgish; old wooden floors, white walls, high ceiling and a lot of charm.
Wifi is great - if you have to work, no problem. Bathroom has a lovely big shower. Big soft towels are provided as well as a hairdryer, and there are several shelves for all your creams and other remedies.
In the morning, the sun brightens up the bedroom, but no worries if you don´t like early morning wake up, there are blinds and curtains.
Meyers Bageri is right around the corner - tasty fresh sourdough bread in the morning, and a cup of coffee. Wholefood is just 3min away, and the store is a haven for foodists - they have everything you need, and then some. The subway is 5min by foot, and it is easy to travel to Manhattan with the L line. Change train on 14th UnionSquare (only 3 stops) if you want to go Uptown or Downtown - or you can walk the other way, passing under Williamsburg bridge, and take the J or Z line from Myrtle Avenue. Why not walk over Williamsburg bridge. Keep on the left side, right side is for bikers.
If you walk down Driggs avenue, and take a left on 6th street all the way down, you will find the NY Waterway ferry that will take you down to Wall Street on East River, passing under Brooklyn Bridge (stopping at South Williamsburg and Dumbo). Perfect way of transportation, $4 one way. You need to buy a ticket before you go onbard - the have an App, easy to use.
Try Maison Premiere for their Oyster Happy Hour - 4-7pm. Sit in the bar, and enjoy watching the bartenders while working - it's like watching a well choreographed dance in bar mixing. Do try the Absinth drip, lovely and fresh.
If you like meat, then El Almacen is a great choice. Remember to book a table. SweetGreen and their warm Harvest Bowl is supertasty, and their other salads are also delicious - only 20m from Wholefood.
There is a long list of good restaurant, cafe´s and bakeries on the fridge. .
Would definitely recommend Ming and Matthews apartment - ideal for everyone who likes to explore and enjoy life. We truly enjoyed our stay.

Book this place! Best location for ease of access to all the great happenings in Williamsburg plus you're only 6-7 blocks from 2 different subway lines that connect you virtually anywhere in Manhattan in a snap. Very clean, strangely quiet for how much hustle and bustle you expect in NYC as it is a few blocks off the main dining/shopping block and that makes a big difference with street noise. This felt like we were staying in our own apartment and the little kitchen is pretty much equipped with everything you need. Just add groceries and you're set if you want to stay in a few meals. One of the best AirBnB rentals I've come across and I stay somewhere different almost every 2 weeks. Thanks, Ming!

We had a such a wonderful stay! The apartment is in the perfect location, right in the heart of Williamsburg. We were walking distance to the subway and everywhere we wanted to go in Brooklyn. You can get into Manhattan in just a few minutes via uber or subway. Very little noise makes its way in and it was even larger than we had anticipated! That never happens in NYC :) Much of the apartment is updated and decorated very tastefully. Ming was extremely responsive leading up to and during our stay. She was there to meet us on our arrival. We would definitely stay here again and cannot recommend it enough!

Cynthia is an amazing host. During my month long stay, she made sure that I had clean sheets, fresh pillows and towels, and even made smoothies and dinners for me and the other guests during our stay! Her place is beautiful, eclectic and cozy. Great location as well as it is one block away from the 6 subway line, a few blocks away from Central Park, and close to many grocery stores, places to eat and a 24 hour pharmacy.  Would not highly recommend more for a great and convenient place to stay in New York!!
Great Host! However the room was tiny and the bed was uncomfortable. I ended my 1 month stay early due to a sore back from the bed. Thanks you otherwise Cyn!

Cynthia was absolutely wonderful. Thank you so much for making my stay so pleasurable, I would highly recommend this apartment & my host. I felt both safe and welcome . The room was very clean and is in a great location which made exploring NYC easy. The location is right next to the subway and there was plenty to do in the local neighbourhood.  A big thank you to Cynthia for her hospitality .

We loved the staying on Nazleen. The place was just like she said, we are very comfortable and what we need, Nazleen helped us. We saw then in very few times, but this wasn`t a problem for us... We loved very much. It's a little bit far from Manhattan, but very easy to get it Nazleen, and to go to Manhattan. Just take a little while to get there on rush hours... but again, wasn't a problem for us, we already expected to be like that... In the end, they helped us booking a taxi to take us to the airport... Thank you so much Nazleen and Daniel

Once we booked the listing we soon received a message from Nazleen on location, key pick-up, and many more important details about our stay.  We did not get a chance to meet our host in person.  The private rooftop was a real nice touch.  The bed is super comfortable especially after exploring NYC.  The apartment space is perfect for two people.  I only skimmed through them but definitely read the materials in front of the TV.  You may find some helpful hints or nuggets. The only killer would be the 4-5 flights of stairs we had to carry our luggage up but we fortunate enough to meet Nazleens partner who was a gem and helped us. Nothing but love for this place and we would definitely stay again :)

Nazleen and his wife were good hosts. We were very pleased of our stay at their house, the location is accessible for buses and the neighborhood is quiet.
The suite is welcoming and the wine was a lovely surprise.
We would go back and recommend it for all who want to know New York and the Astoria neighborhood.
Thanks for receive us!

Nazleen's place is simply beautiful, and beautifully simple. Is small but is great for a single person or a couple (possibly more people if you make efficient use of the bathroom). I didn't see Nazleen at all during my stay, but I did contact her by phone when I first arrived as I was a bit confused about getting into the building. It was a misunderstanding on my part about where to actually enter the building (in front), nothing at all that was wrong with the listing or instructions, but Nazleen was readily available for me my phone and explained where to go to me and followed up by text very quickly after the call to make sure I got in with no problem.

The space was beautiful and clean and the inclusion of the bus schedules for the bus lines that are right outside the door were incredibly helpful. My only disappointment was that the weather did not allow me to enjoy the rooftop deck more. I'd happily stay here again in the future.

I booked this place for my parents to stay while they were visiting me. I must say Daniel and Naz are the most helpful airbnb'ers I have met so far. I was not able to arrive new york when my parents arrived. Daniel helped them to settle down. I thank Daniel a lot for that.
Now let's talk about the a apartment. It is an apartment located in a very nice location. I wish we booked this place in summer. It is accessible to Manhattan by N/Q trains.
Daniel has all the information in the room regarding MTA. It was a nice and cozy room, with a whole veranda only for you. The only flaw is the stairs to 4rth floor which fades away with the hospitality of Daniel and Naz. Also the place was neat & clean and the neighborhood is diverse and decent.
I would recommend this place to any airbnb'er visiting new york. And I wish I would find such hosts in future again.

THANKS DANIEL AND NAZLEEN FOR YOUR HOSPITALITY!!!!

So if you can’t tell I enjoyed my stay and loved Cynthia as a host, then I don’t know what else to tell you but to book this place and find out for yourself if this place is worth the hype. Cynthia is the BEST host!! I adored staying in her home and have made a lifelong friend in her.

Cynthia is a wonderful host and provides an apartment that is quaint and charming. Great location!
Cynthia is an amazing host. Location is great.
As good as it gets

The location was perfect and this is an excellent deal for how expensive everything is in NYC. The apartment was clean and the sheets were regularly washed. Cynthia is very welcoming, sweet and generous. I truly felt at home for the entire month I spent there.

Das Apartment war den Bildern entsprechend. Alles war sauber und aufgeräumt, die Verkehrsanbindung war ideal um nach Manhattan zu gelangen. Der Aufenthalt in Nazleens und Daniels Apartment und in New York war sehr gut.

The apartment was great - nice and tidy and at a great location. Ming is also really nice and very helpful. Recommend this place!

Karin
여행하면서 에어비앤비를 꽤 많이 이용해봤는데, 그 중 단연 가장 마음에 들었던 숙소였어요. 개인실인줄 알았는데, 위 아래층이 독립적이여서 거의 집 전체를 사용하는 기분이었구요. 호스트였던 밍과 그의 남편, 아기까지 모두 사랑스럽고 친절한 가족이었습니다. 다음에 뉴욕에 가도 꼭 밍의 집에서 다시 머무르고 싶네요. 위치도 윌리엄스버그 중심이어서 완벽했어요.
Ming's apartment was right in the middle of Williamsburg, a buoyant and trendy neighborhood yet peaceful and perfect for relaxing after a very busy day. Clean, authentic, very recommended.
Wenn ihr nach einem Tag Manhattan eure Ruhe wollt, dann ist diese Wohnung genau das Richtige.

Schön! Ming's and Matthew's Townhouse ist gut, zentral gelegen, mitten in Williamsburg. Die Bedford Avenue mit all den Restaurants, Bars and Shops ist gleich um die Ecke. Die Lage ist auch perfekt wenn man Kleinigkeiten zum essen oder trinken einkaufen möchte, Whole Foods und Foodtown befinden sich ebenfalls direkt in der Nähe. Trotzt der lebhaften Nachbarschaft befindet sich das Haus auf einer ruhigen Seitenstrasse, man kann also problemlos schlafen. Es ist überhaupt nicht laut. Das Apartment ist gut eingerichtet und es ist alles da was man braucht. Eine kleine Küche mit Esstisch, Schlafzimmer mit einem bequemen Bett und ein Badezimmer mit einem bequemen Bett. Ming hat Bio-Seife, Shampoo und Hairspühlung für uns bereitgestellt, was wir süß fanden. Auf dem Kühlschrank hat sie auch alle nötige Informationen gelassen die uns während unseres Aufenthaltes geholfen haben uns zu recht zu finden. Wir haben uns hier sehr wohl gefühlt. Thank you guys!

Ming & Matt were excelent and really helpful hosts. The house was very pleasant, had very good wi-fi connection and the street is very quiet. You can get from there to Manhattan in about 10 min by using the L subway. Williamsburg is a very nice and safe neighbourhood and full of hip restaurants and bars. There are two supermarkets within 5 min walk and open until midnight. We would definitely recomend you to stay with them!

Ming's apartment is great - very cozy and perfect for a couple. The location is the best part - even though it's very quiet, it's in the heart of Williamsburg: half a block away from Williamsburg Cinemas, Samurai Mama (amazing udon and sashimi!), and all the great shopping on Grand Street. Ming was great at communicating and always responded promptly to everything we needed. Recommended!

Wir waren bereits zum zweiten Mal bei Ming und Matt und hatten wieder eine wunderbare Zeit. Die Wohnung und die Gastgeber sind in allen Belangen grossartig! Ich würde diese Unterkunft jederzeit meinen Freunden und Familie weiterempfehlen.

My husband and I stayed in September and found the apartment ideal for the two of us. Ming and Matt are great hosts and made us very welcome. Ming communicated in detail before and during our visit. They helped us out with taxis and finding shops. The apartment is in a traditional building in a quiet street, but very close to shops and restaurants. The nearest subway is on a direct line to the centre of Manhattan. Very clean, good shower room with toiletries and plenty of towels. Comfortable bed and good hanging space with lots of hangers.
It's worth splashing out on a drink in the Ides bar in the Wyeth Hotel for a superb view of Manhattan!
We would visit again if returning to Brooklyn.

This place felt like a real oasis after spending hours in the huge Manhattan. Williamsburg is a lovely, safe and very lively neighborhood. The flat is perfect for two, very bright!! and also it is really easy to get to everywhere in nyc. We had a wonderful time there, ,Ming was very attentive. Thank you&best wishes!

Met mijn dochter 5 dagen in Williamsburg in het appartement van Ming verbleven. Appartement ligt paar minuten lopen van de metro op Bedford ave, Eerste halte vanaf Manhattan. Appartement was schoon, verzorgd, compleet en rustig gelegen. Een tweepersoonsbed en een slaapbank voor 1 persoon in een ander kametje. En wat een verademing om terug van Manhattan in Williamsburg te komen elke dag! Ook lekker om eens een dag in de buurt te blijven. Genoeg te doen. Leuke winkels, restaurants, juicebars. etc. Veel organic en vegan. Erg relaxte, sfeervolle, hippe wijk.
Perfect apartment. Slept like a dream. Neighborhood is fantastic, super cool, arty, great cafes and restaurants, low key vibe.  Ming is awesome. Book this place now.  We will be back for sure.

We stayed in Ming & Matty's beautiful apartment for a week in October and loved every single second. It was just as lovely as the photos look- if not better! Clean, bright and homely with good air conditioning and heating, both of which we had to use (typical NYC weather).

The location is ideal- just a couple of subway stops into central Manhattan and a comfortable stroll to amazing restaurants, bars and everything else you might need in Williamsburg.

Ming and Matty were incredibly welcoming and very chilled. They left us to our own devices but were always on the end of the phone if needed.

We hope you enjoy staying here as much as we did! We will most definitely be returning on our next trip to NYC.

Lotte & Jude x

Apartment is perfect, has everything you need - nice and clean. Beautifully thought out and well designed, has lots of charm. Located so close to everything in Williamsburg. Ming was so nice and accommodating, would definitely go back! Thanks Ming.

It was an absolute pleasure staying at Ming’s place. It is a beautiful, clean and spacious apartment close to public transport and shops and restaurants.
Ming was an excellent host and went out of her way to make sure we had a great stay. Definitely recommend.

I absolutely adored staying at Ming's. Her little bungalow was perfectly tucked down a quiet street in Williamsburg yet was surrounded by everything you'd need: Wholefoods, great coffee, cute shops etc. The space was minimal, spacious and airy - I loved coming back 'home' each night to make dinner in the glow of the warm kitchen. Ming and her family were equally warm and I cannot thank them enough for the stay. Make sure to check out the little collection of books in the bedroom!
Ming is vriendelijk, attent en haar appartement bevindt zich in een mooi oud pand in een rustige straat op een prachtige locatie in Williamsburg (Brooklyn). Aanrader!

Working with Ming went super smoothly and the place was great! My whole trip was in Brooklyn so this location was perfect. On a quiet street (well, for NYC that is) and very convenient. Very clean and kitchen had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay.  Would definitely stay here again!

Ming was a great host - super quick to respond, warm welcome, a little gift, lots of great tips and very accommodating for our requests. The apartment is spotless and has a really lovely vibe - very calm and relaxed. The location is perfect - lots of great places to eat and drink... Maison Premiere for oysters and cocktails, The Llama Inn for incredible beef tenderloin, Egg for breakfast... endless. Will def stay again!
The ideal Brooklyn stay! Easy back-and-forth to Manhattan and other Brooklyn neighbourhoods, and lots of amenities nearby. We've stayed here multiple times and couldn't recommend Ming's place more!

We stayed five amazing weeks in January/February in the apartment and loved the atmosphere at first sight. Ming answered all our questions immediately and gave some suggestions on nearby excellent cafes and restaurants. The appartement is in the middle of Williamsburg in a calm street.

The connection to Mannhattan was easy/ quick. But every time we returned to Brooklyn we thought: It was the best decision to choose our stay in Brooklyn and in this lovely apartment!

Ming es una mujer encantadora. Ella vive en el piso de abajo así que si necesitas algo ella siempre puede ayudarte. Además, las respuestas al correo son muy rápidas. El apartamento se encuentra en una calle muy tranquila en el centro de williambsburgh rodeado de muchas tiendas de diseño, cafes y restaurantes encantadores. En metro estas a una parada de Manhatan. El apartamento tiene mucho encanto, es espacioso y decorado con mucho gusto. Todo muy limpio. El  único pero seria la calefacción que se activaba a las 6 de la mañana y las cañerías hacen mucho ruido. A nosotros no nos molesto, nos volvíamos a dormir y también nos servia para madrugar y aprovechar el día en Nueva york. Nosotros recomendamos sin duda el apartamento de Ming y regresaremos a el cuando volvamos a Nueva york. Muchas gracias por todo Ming.
Lovely, stylish apartment in a great location close to the subway. We loved our stay.

This may be our favourite Airbnb stay yet! Everything about this place is perfect. The location is so close to such good restaurants, bars & cafes but remains such a peaceful retreat. It’s spotless with lots of natural light. The bed was so comfortable, we had the best nights sleep. The bathroom and kitchen were modern and immaculate. But the best part was the hospitality shown by our hosts! Ming and Matt were the greatest. They both went beyond, helping us settle in after a stressful flight. If you are reading these reviews wondering if you should book, you should stop looking and immediately reserve this apartment and you’ll have the best time in New York City

Another perfect stay at this lovely oasis in Williamsburg. Our third time now and we will be back next time we are in NYC.  Ming’s place is perfect, quiet, comfortable and ideally situated.  We slept so well there and really love it as a launchpad for exploring NYC. Thanks again!

It was an absolute pleasure staying at Ming’s place. It is a beautiful, clean and spacious apartment filled with natural light located on a quite street close to public transport, shops and restaurants. Ming was an excellent host and very communicative and responsive in any of our questions. Would DEFINITELY recommend this place to all!
Ming’s apartment was lovely, in a great place, all amenities in the area and a quick subway ride into Manhattan. Overall a great little apartment.

Ming is a very warm and friendly host who was flexible and let us check in early. She was always prompt in her communication and helpful in arranging our ride to airport. The apartment was extremely comfortable with plenty of space for a couple, the bedroom , bathroom and kitchen were large and tastefully decorated, walk in wardrobe and separate lounge were added bonus. Location was superb, safe, quiet and easy access to L train and Main streets of Williamsburg. Close to all shops and restaurants. We truly had amazing and relaxed stay , felt like home away from home . Highly recommend Ming’s place. Elizabeth
Best place to stay when visiting New York

The perfect apartment for a stay in a vibrant City. Still it‘s in a silent street to get a proper rest After exploring the City.
Cafés, shops and Public transport - everything around The corner.

Thanks to Ming for being an amazing host.

My girlfriend and I had a fantastic stay in Ming's apartment. Ming and her husband were great hosts; super friendly and helpful, and they always had kind words when we met them! Ming left us a list of tips for great places to visit nearby, and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

The apartment is super cozy with great facilities, and really makes you feel at home like a native Brooklynite. It is centrally located in the great neighbourhood of Williamsburg, just a block away from the main street, but is still quiet and relaxing. A great base for exploring both Brooklyn and Manhattan (just one subway stop away), and great place to rest when you return at night.

We loved every bit of our stay, and would gladly recommend staying here to anyone who wants to visit NYC. We hope to come back as soon as possible, both for the city, the neighbourhood, and this great place to stay!
Clean, simple, with just what we needed to enjoy a stay in Brooklyn. I appreciated the teas and water in the refrigerator, a nice touch.

L'appartement de Ming et Matt est juste idéalement placé dans le quartier de Williamsburg.
À côté de la rue principale mais au calme.
À côté des commerces de proximité et des nombreux restaurants, bars de Williamsburg.
Ming et Matt sont des hôtes attentifs, très disponible et surtout très sympathique.
Les bons conseils en restaurants si tu aussi très précieux
Je vous recommande chaleureusement ce lieux.

Ming was a wonderful Host! Great with check in and check out. The location is perfect, right in the hub of Williamsburg.
It was safe, clean, well presented and spacious for NY!
Would stay again.

Note: Anyone with mobility issues, there is a steep flight of stairs on entry to the apartment.

Don't think about it, just book this place! Calm oasis to come home to after the madness of Manhattan. A wonderful apartment with a brilliant location. Great quirky shops and fabulous eating to be had. Do try Rosarito Fish Shack in Wythe Ave. The. Best. Tacos. Ever. And taking the ferry to Manhattan with glorious downtown views is so much nicer than the stinky subway.

Ming and Matt are simply the most wonderful, chilled hosts. Thank you both for welcoming me to your home.
A new best friend basically <3 !
Such a lovely flat in a great location! Ming is a great host, very thoughtful and the place is spotless, comfortable and nicely decorated. Can recommend 100%!
Great location, great host would certainly go back
Perfect base for a NY trip. Clean and comfortable, with plenty of space. Check in and communication couldn’t have been any easier.

Wonderful experience and just a beautiful apartment in central Williamsburg .
The apartment was well equipped the only thing missing was a laundry and there was one only a couple of blocks away .
Fantastic host . Ming gave us privacy but was available for any questions and needs . Always a quick response. Our stay here exceeded our expectations and we will definitely be back , providing this hidden gem is available !!
Thank you so much Ming

Ming’s place is gorgeous and clean, perfectly located for shops and restaurants. I felt like a true local living the Brooklyn experience and loved it. The space itself is contemporary and beautiful, and calming to spend time in. It has everything you might need. Ming is very kind and helpful.

I was a little disappointed to learn that the L train is sometimes closed due to upgrade works... and potentially moreso in future. There is a shuttle running and Marcy Ace Station is not too far to walk.

Please also note that the heating for the apartment in the cooler months can be very noisy (the pipes clang twice a day for approximately 15-25 mins) and may bother a light sleeper. Apart from this, the street is very safe, peaceful and quiet and only a short walk (2mins) to the best part of Williamsburg. Brilliant!

I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Ming’s apartment. I had a wonderful time!

A perfect stay for my first time in New York! Williamsburg is by far the best location, and only 15 minutes to Manhattan on the subway. Everything was so close, so charming, and everyone was so nice. Cute shops and some of the best restaurants in New York just blocks away. I am so happy we chose to stay here! Ming's place was so dreamy--clean, stylish, cozy, historic, and spacious. I felt at home right away. It will certainly be our go to place when we come back!

Ming’s apartment is in a fantastic location and is comfortable and clean. She was flexible about arrival and gave us some good tips. We also really appreciated being able to leave our bags there on the final day so we could do some more exploring. Thank you!

An absolute must if you're visiting NYC !!!! Ming's place is perfectly located in the great neighbourhood of Williamsburg, with bars, restaurants and subway around the corner. The flat is spotless, bed is comfortable, nice little sunny kitchen,  it's all you need to come home to after a tiring and noisy day in Manhattan! I recommend it 200%. Thanks again Ming, it was a real pleasure.

Ming’s apartment was a perfect apartment for both short and longer stays. We found the space incredibly clean, with excellent amenities and space to unpack and feel at home. It is close to all Williamsburg facilities - Food stores, coffee shops, bars and transport all close. The street is very quiet. Ming was always available, responded promptly to any query we had and was a perfect host. We loved the apartment and will certainly stay there again in future.
John and Jacqui (Australia)

A stylish, comfortable apartment with all the amenities you desire. The space is spotless with a fully equipped and modern kitchen and fast WiFi. Convenient for public transport, local shops, bars, and restaurants. Ming was a friendly, informative, and helpful host. We had a fabulous time.

There is really nothing to add to all the excellent reviews of the previous guests. This is the best airbnb I've stayed so far in New York. The place is extremely cosy and clean, thoughtfully decorated, and just perfect to relax after a long day out. The location is unbeatable, right in the middle of Williamsburg and close to the L train, but very quiet in a small street. Ming was a great host and we could even leave our luggage until the evening on our departure day. We loved the place and hope to come back as soon as possible.

We loved staying at Ming’s Retreat in Williamsburg. The classic Brooklyn brownstone is on quiet street that reminds you of old New York, but is still right in the heart of Williamsburg. It was the perfect place for us to relax and rewind at the end of the day.

Ming was very welcoming and made us feel right at home, and her recommendations for restaurants and things to do around town included some of our favorite spots in Brooklyn.

We would definitely stay there anytime we’re in Williamsburg!
Nice place. Handy to the subway
Clean & aesthically pleasing apartment in a great location. Very responsive and friendly host. Highly recommend.

Cyn's place is located on the 97th East street and is easily accessible by metro/bus and has eateries/CVS etc around. It is just 2 blocks from the Central Park. The room is of a smaller dimension but can't complain of that in NY. The bed was super comfortable and so was the size (i am 6ft +). I had access to the living room, kitchen etc and had a comfortable stay. Cyn was very helpful and ready to help.
Beautiful apartment, perfect location, and great host!

Highly recommend this gem. Very clean, stylish, cosy, had everything we needed and located in a great neighbourhood. Thank you Ming for being a great host! We had an amazing stay and hope to be back soon!

Lovely apartment on a quiet street in Williamsburg. Very close to the subway. The hosts were helpful and answered all questions promptly. I would definitivly stay again on my next visit to the states.
This place is so good we keep coming back every year and staying here. The perfect home away from home in a perfect Williamsburg location

Nous avons passé 4 jours très agréables dans l'appartement de Ming. Il est très bien décoré, très propre et très bien placé. La communication avec Ming était très facile ! Nous recommandons chaudement !
Beautiful Williamsburg apartment. Loved the layout and the location. Will for sure be coming back.

I can only reiterate what all the other reviewers have said - this is an absolutely wonderful place to stay. I have no complaints at all! The location is fantastic - a really peaceful haven after busy days exploring Manhattan, with a lovely neighbourhood feel. The apartment is beautifully furnished, so homely and very well equipped. Ming and Matt are a lovely couple and we really enjoyed chatting to them. Definitely the best Airbnb I've stayed in!
Great place with personal touch in a fairly quiet side road but within short walking distance to all conveniences - very nice place and fantastic host
Appartement idealement situé et très agréable ! Beaucoup plus grand que sur les photos. Si je reviens à New York je louerai très certainement l'appartement de Ming qui nous a très bien accueillis !

Ming’s space was great! It was cute, comfortable, and had everything I needed. It is close to shops, restaurants, bars, and the train station, but is located on a quiet, cute little street. I highly recommend the space and would love to stay there again!
Perfect Williamsburg location! Ming and her husband were excellent hosts. We will definitely be back!

Everything you want in an Airbnb -- a home away from home, location location location, well-lit, nicely decorated space with charm, a nice shower/bathroom, advice and fast responses from a knowledgable host. We didn't leave the neighborhood because there was so much to do! The bed was super comfortable and small touches like flowers in the kitchen, a hot water kettle, tea, sparking water in the fridge, a chocolate bar from Mast -- all made the stay better than any hotel could ever manage. Situated on a super, super quiet street. Very close to the Williamsburg bridge, Domino Park, LaGuardia airport, wine bars (Have & Meyer), coffee shops (Devocion and Ppl), awesome restaurants (Four Horseman, St. Anselm, Birds of a Feather, Maison Premiere), cute shops. Will definitely stay here again when in Brooklyn. Thanks Ming and Matt!
There isn't much I can say beyond the other glowing reviews. Ming's place is the perfect NYC base!
Great place, great location , great town

Ming has been an amazing host. Her apartment is absolutely beautiful and located right in the heart of trendy Williamsburg. It’s a quite place, perfect for a good rest after a long day of strolling through the city. Ming knows a lot of great places in the neighbourhood and made sure we had the best stay possible: from installing the A/C to fixing the hallway lightbulb!

Our go to! This was my second time staying here, and we loved it just as much! Clean, comfortable, accommodating and close to everything I love in Brooklyn. Manhattan is just a quick subway away, only 20 minutes to get to any of the places we needed to go. My favorite vintage shop is only half a block away, and favorite coffee a 6 minute stroll. We will certainly continue to stay here, it always feels like home!

The apartment is clean, conveniently located close to the subway L train stop as well as the J/M/Z lines. It's in the heart of Williamsburg. The place was clean and fully equipped, even for cooking.
Ming was very kind.
I recommend.
Second time at Ming‘s place, this is still our first choice when being in the city. I would love to give more than 5 stars, this is an exceptional place and Ming is a wonderful host.

Ming, her family, the apartment and the neighborhood are all wonderful--we really loved staying here.  The apartment is stylish, has character and is very comfortable.  Ming is very kind and thoughtful as a host and her whole family that lives downstairs is super lovely and welcoming.  The annual block party happened during our stay and it was nice to see how friendly everyone is with each other on the block (and with us as well.)   We learned that the author Henry Miller also lived on this block and called it "the most enchanting street I have ever seen in all my life."  The location is close to Bedford Ave. and has many attractive restaurants, bars, and shops, including Whole Foods, but is in an alley, so is quiet.  We love staying in Williamsburg and would happily stay in Ming's place again and highly recommend it.

Naz's place was great, perfect for our weekend stay, and the parking was a big plus for us, as we drove down from Boston. Even though it's January, the rooftop deck was a great feature. Overall a really comfortable place to stay, and great if you're looking to do a short trip in New York.
Nazleen's place is great. The parking is very convenient for us since we have to drive to NYC. The house is also close to bus station. You can easily transfer to subway station. Highly recommend!

This apartment was great for a weekend stay and the view of Manhattan from the private deck was beautiful. Great plus for parking since we were traveling from 6-7 hours away. Nazleen was very accommodating and quick to respond with any questions or concerns. Great price for staying so close to the city and the commute into Manhattan was very easy! Overal, I'd recommend staying here for anyone who simply needs a basic place to sleep at night and bathroom to shower in. Spent the majority of the time in the city anyways!

Nazleen and Daniel were great hosts! Nazleen met us upon arrival and was prompt to respond to questions we had during our stay. The neighborhood is visibly on the up and up, but not one I felt very comfortable walking through at night with my teenaged daughter. The space fit the pictures and description well and since we had great weather during our stay, we got to enjoy the patio a bit!

With no doubt I would repeat at Cyn's place if I went back to NYC. She is completely amazing, welcoming and kind! For those who want to improve their English, she is the one as she has a very interesting conversation! ;) Also, it was so cold she offered me some of her warm clothes, cooked breakfast one day, invited me to her gallery art exhibition and thanks giving dinner.. Definitely, a super host! The room is small, but it's cozy and clean, besides it's located in a very good area in NYC. I felt safe at any time, even at night. I've spent there two months and I wish I could have stayed longer.
Thank you for so much! One of the most wonderful experiences in my life

What a great spot. The apartment is spacious and relaxing. The neighborhood has tons of great food and is great for getting to Manhattan or other neighborhoods in Brooklyn. To top it all off Joelle is very communicative and went out of her way to accommodate my travel plans. I would certainly go back the next time I'm in NY.

Nazleen and Daniel are amazing  hosts, Nazleen was so cute and obliging, all requests are immediately fullfilled and we had a beautiful stay there!!! The flat is tiny and have no kitchen, but a microwave and a coffeemaker are inside! The way from the flat to the most attractions in Manhattan are reachable in 40 to 45 minutes by bus and subway. A Little supermarket it's close to the appartment!

Thank you very much Daniel and Nazleen for this nice week in your apartment, which was perfect "headquarters" for us to take the best of this amazing city !! The studio is very clean and functional, with many little attentions (tea/coffee, peanut butter, books, travel guides, practical tips, and even a Wii !!). It's well located near a bus stop, not so far from the 30 Av subway station (20 minutes walk), very close to La Guardia airport. The borough is vibrant, with many 24 hr supermarkets, restaurants, pubs near 30 Av subway. It's easy to find with the directions provided by our hosts. Finally, even if we unfortunately didn't meet Nazleen, thanks a lot to Daniel for booking us a cab the last day. We wish you all the best for the future. Kind regards - David, Frank & Antoine.
I had a great time, Nazleen was a great host. I absolutely loved the terrace outside that has an amazing view.

Thanks a lot to Daniel & Nazleen!! We have wonderful first day un New York!
The appartement is so nice and very well located near bus and train.
Nazleen and Daniel are very kind and helped me with anything I needed. Thank you! The place is  a perfect size for two and I would return for a short getaway for sure! The views are awesome :)

Nous avons passé un excellent moment à New York ! Nous n'avons pas rencontré Nazleen mais Daniel nous a proposé de nous ramener de l'aéroport et nous y a reconduis le dernier jour. Ce sont des hôtes très serviables et disponibles. En ce qui concerne l'emplacement : l'appartement est quand même assez distant du centre ville et accessible via un bus. Il est tout à fait possible de faire à pied le trajet du métro à l'appartement mais après les journées de marche c'est un peu difficile pour les pieds ... Nous avons signalé à Daniel que le lit mériterai d'être réparé car il est complètement affaissé mais sinon le reste et conforme à l'annonce situé dans un quartier au calme qui mérite d'être visité. Nazleen et Daniel mettent à disposition café et chocolat pour le matin ce qui peut être très agréable.

Tolle Wohnung, eignet sich auch für einen schönen Moment beim Sonnenuntergang und einer Flasche Bier.
In unmittelbarer Nähe befinden sich eine Bushaltestellen und ein Supermarkt. Mit dem Bus erreicht man eine Bahnstation, mit welcher man weiter nach Manhattan fahren kann - Fahrzeit gut 30 Minuten.
Der Gastgeber ist sehr engagiert und freundlich. Unsere Anreise verschob sich aufgrund von Verspätungen beim Flug auf Mitternacht. Daniel wartete auf uns und stellte uns für die erste Nacht Getränke bereit, da die Geschäfte geschlossen hatten. Weiterhin ist Daniel sehr umgänglich und freundlich, weshalb wir diese Wohnung weiterempfehlen möchte!
Vielen Dank für den netten Aufenthalt!
I loved this place. I felt very welcomed. This is the perfect little cozy place. Easy to get to. Quick transportation. Lots of privacy. Amazing.

Nazleen y Daniel son los mejores anfitriones. Muy atentos y cordiales. Del uno al diez los califico con 11. Excelentes personas. El apartamento es lo que se ve, pequeño pero cómodo. Tal vez una cocina podría dar un plus al apartamento. Todo nos pareció excelente, sobretodo lo que tiene que ver con el transporte. En 20 minutos podés estar en Manhattan. Si tuviera que poner "un pero" lo haría con el barrio. En la zona existen personas muy territoriales que nos hicieron pasar malos momentos en más de una oportunidad. Pero la gentileza y la amabilidad  de los anfitriones hace que estas experiencias pasen a un segundo plano. Pasamos muy bien en el apartamento de Nazleen y Daniel.

Nice and cosy studio wis a perfect view on the roof ! Extra shower and perfect air conditioning in this period . The bed was really comfortable . Daniel and Nazleen were really helpful and really great people. Around 20 min to go to Manhattan with bus and train , bus stop just 10 sec from the studio . Train and bus 24/24 and 7/7 . Calm neighborhood. And close to the train station maybe the best breakfast food truck you can find in NYC . That was perfect . Thanx a lot Daniel and Nazleen !

Our first visit to NY was very nice, and part of that good experience was thanks to Nazleem's place. It is great! And after the long days of sightseeing and city exploration, we found very comfortable to have our own mini studio to rest and recharge batteries for the next day. The neighbourhood is OK, very residential but it has some nice restaurants and cafes nearby when you rather stay in Long Island city ;-) The closest metro station is a 20 min walk, from there the metro line connects you directly to the city center of NYC. So, very convenient!
Naz and Daniel are very nice and helpful with any inquiry that you might have. And the view from the rooftop is great! Will definitely recommend to stay there

Great view,  hosts were very helpful, and apartment was better than anticipated. We were very happy with our stay. Close to the bus stop, 20 minute walk to the subway, and terrific view of the skyline.

This little respite was PERFECT for our family of four. Naz and Daniel's photos represented exactly what we got: clean, nice and cool (hot city days!) and an awesome roof deck with sweeping views of Manhattan. Easy access to MTA and a Metro Card in the apartment for use! (Refill it on your way out)
Clean linens and shower equipped with pump shampoo/conditioner etc on the wall. Cable and Wii kept our little ones content while we watched the sunset on the deck.
We recommend and will stay again!
Super easy getting to LGA (10min drive).
Also, hosts are downstairs (you won't see them unless you need something) and very helpful and available for restaurant recommendations etc.
EXCELLENT SPOT.

Daniel a fait le necessaire pour nous permettre d'arriver dans les meilleures conditions et tout son possible pour nous faciliter les choses avec beaucoup de gentilesse.
La terrasse est très agréable et l'appartement est vraiment agréable.
Il est situé dans un endroit pratique pour rejoindre Manhattan et très bien desservi par les transports. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié les cartes de Métro / Bus qui nous ont permis de gagner du temps le premier jour.
David and Nazleen were great to deal with in terms of getting access and any requests.  Our flights arrived late after midnight and David was up waiting for us to help get inside.

Conveniently located. The bus and metro worked perfectly. The view from the rooftop was wonderful.
We did not need much but Nazleen made herself available from the start. Thank you for hosting us!

We enjoyed our stay here for our first time to New York City.  The first night we was graciously greeted by our host.  The rooftop had a great partial skyline view of Manhattan.   The location was convenient enough for us first timers to get around easily.  The hosts were readily available to answer any questions.  Thank you for letting us stay at your place.
Host was very helpful and the place totally suited our needs. Thanks so much for the stay!!

Unfortunately, I didn't get to meet Joelle, but her place is super cool and with lots of character. It is located centrally in the Williamsburg area. There are a lot of interesting shops, cafes and bars just a step away from the apartment. I had a chance to meet and chat a bit with Joelle's roommate below as well as one of the neighbours and they were both extremely friendly and helpful. I had a great time here and would love to return again when in Brooklyn/NY.
un lugar ideal para relajarse y vivir el ambiente de Williamsburg en un espacio muy acojedor y con buenisima energia. Excelente anfitriona.
The apartment was great, the location was perfect and Joelle was a great host - very helpful ( especially considering I booked very last minute ). I'd definitely stay again.
We had a very great time at Joelle's place ! the neighborood is a very charming one and the room we lived in was very spaceful and nice.

My daughter and I stayed at Joelle's place for about a month and it was an overall wonderful experience. To start with Joelle was great throughout about providing consistently clear and concise communication, just enough to be helpful but not at all intrusive.
She was there to meet us even as our arrival time was somewhat "iffy" and late night. She provided us with several pamphlets about local attractions, events, etc., suggested several late night eateries, and drew maps to subway stations close by.
Though Joelle was out of town for the remainder of our trip, she left us well supported with information, contact info. for herself and neighbors, and checked in with us a couple of times throughout our stay.
Joelle's roommate, Annie, who was there for part of our stay, was a wonderful balance of friendly, helpful, yet respectful of using the common areas and of our privacy.
The apartment is just as fantastic as it looks in the photos. The bedroom area is a large open area containing within it a cozy living area and a long desk/work area backed with wall-to-wall book shelves. The kitchen and bathroom(on the same floor) were a nice size for our needs. Both spaces have ample skylights which of course provided great natural lighting and completed that amazing airy loft feel. Joelle had thoughtfully cleared storage space in the closet, kitchen, and bathroom areas, so we had more than enough space for our belongings. We ended up eating quite a few meals at home and the kitchen efficiently met our needs. The space in general provided a very comfortable and peaceful refuge at the end of our busy days.
The apartment is located in a great neighborhood, very convenient to a wide variety of restaurants, shops, etc.while not being in the midst of too much noise and commotion. There are two subway stations within comfortable walking distance, a bus stop close by, and there's even a movie theater at the end of the block. (My daughter, a cinephile, was in heaven!) In terms of security, the neighborhood felt very safe and the apartment itself has two locked doors to gain entrance, so security was never an issue.
In a one-sentence wrap-up, we loved the whole experience and would do it again in a heartbeat! Thanks Joelle and Annie!

You'll find Joelle's Boho-chic apartment deep in the heart of boisterous Williamsburg. If you wanna get to know the area there's no better place from which to do it. Joelle is responsive, kind, open and full of only good intentions. With the L train a short walk away you're minutes from Manhattan. I recommend the waterfront and the Polish bakery on North 8th.
Such a wonderful place, super calm and relaxing, and very welcoming host at the last minute!

Joelle is fantastic. Intelligent, classy, and welcoming. She made sure everything was taken care of, and followed up to make sure I am enjoying my stay. The place is beautiful and spacious. I would gladly stay here in the future (though thankfully my housing situation is resolved!)
The communication was excellent, and Joelle was very prompt in responding to any questions, etc. The location couldn't be beat!

We had a fabulous time staying in Joelle's beautiful place during a very hot two weeks in August 2022! The apartment is in an ideal location to explore the beautiful area of Williamsburg (Domino Park is c.5 minutes out of the front door with the best views of Manhattan around!) and close to a number of subway stations to travel elsewhere in the city. Joelle was so helpful both before and during our stay and we really could not have asked for a better welcome to the city - would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great, safe location from which to explore all NYC has to offer
Great space in a great location with easy access to the city. Joelle is a very thoughtful and communicative host and made sure I was comfortable throughout my stay.

I had the best stay for a few nights. location is fantastic and close to the subway and plenty of stores, and joelle is a wonderful host: communicative, and also very respectful of your personal space. comfy bedroom and great energy!

A great space for a fair price in one of Brooklyns best neighborhoods. Bed was comfortable and had access to a washer dryer which was extremely helpful as well as nicely appointed sitting room There were many wonderful eateries within a 4 or 5 block area
I highly recommend this one

Thank you Nazleen and Daniel for having us. It is a great place with an amazing view. This place is easily accessible by bus. Thank you again for answering our questions. I would definitely recommend this place.

We had a great stay at Nazleen's & Daniel's place! The view is nice, and the terrace is a wonderful escape from bustling NYC. We loved watching the sunset while sipping on a glass of wine after an eventful day in the city.

The apartment is in an developing area, but buses make it very easy to go around. Also, we had no trouble catching a Lyft or Uber, regular yellow cabs were a bit difficult to find.

Nazleen even went out of her way and purchased some dog food for us, so my dog wouldn't have to go to bed hungry when we arrived late. Thank you!!

The apartment is on the 5th Floor, so it is a bit of a hike, but the terrace totally made up for it. At our arrival Daniel was so friendly to help us get into the apartment at later hours, and even helped us with our bags.

Nazleen has great communication and answered all the questions that I had.  The location is very close to the bus stop,  which can take you to the subway station and then into the city.  The view on top of the building is very nice, as long as you don't mind carrying your bags up a few flights of stairs!

Beautiful views of Manhattan from the rooftop. A handy location with a choice of 4 different buses taking you to different lines. In all it will take about 30-45 minutes with a bus and subway into Manhattan. There's some food shops and a laundromat nearby. Perfect for 1-2 people.

Los anfitriones fueron geniales. Nos dieron las llaves en mano, nos ofrecieron ayuda para subir las maletas, nos dejaron un billete de metro para poder movernos, un teléfono móvil para facilitarnos pedir comida a domicilio, y nos permitieron salir más tarde el día que nos íbamos para dejar las maletas hasta la hora de viajar de vuelta. Siempre contestan a los mensajes y están dispuestos a ayudar.

Además, el piso es perfecto, buena localización, limpio, acogedor, vistas espectaculares.

Recomendable 100%

The place was great for the price. Daniel came up to check on us to make sure we got in okay. We loved the big deck with the city view. The bed was comfy however the pillows could stand to be replaced, they were extremely flat. Also be aware that the shower is a tight squeeze. It was convenient to the bus.
Great hosts! Even offered to help watch over our yorkie and have a play date with their pup!

This place was awesome and the host as well. They made sure everything was alright very detailed on where everything is at. They even left a book telling you where all the good restaurants are at and they're nice enough to offer to take you to the city for a good amount.
It has a killing view of Manhattan. The neighbor is quiet and there're amazing restaurants on 30th ave. Great stay and great experience!

Appartement très sympa et très propre, largement suffisant pour 2-3 personnes, situé à environ 40 minutes de Times Square. Accès très facile par bus et métro, même tard le soir.
Nazleen et Daniel sont de supers hôtes qui ont tout fait pour faciliter notre arrivée. Le prêt d'un téléphone avec numéro américain est un plus, notamment pour l'utilisation du GPS, et l'achat en avance de Metrocards était très pratique. Des gens vraiment top, merci beaucoup!!!

Great place for the value. Nice view from the patio. Small but if you just need a place to crash after a long day of exploring the city then it's perfect. Unfortunately, nearest subway station is 20 min walk away but you can take an uber to it. Has parking so it's great if you're driving in. Nice quiet area.

Nous sommes restés 12 jours chez Daniel et Nazleen en mars. Le séjour était parfait, ils mettent à disposition une machine à café, du thé, un micro-onde, un petit frigo et il y a un peu de vaisselle pour ceux qui souhaitent manger sur place. Le plus du séjour c’était quand même le portable qui vous prête avec la 4G et les appels en illimité pour les USA. Tellement pratique pour s'orienter à New York !!! Sans le téléphone on aurait perdu énormément de temps dans nos itinéraires. Quand on est habitué au métro parisien c’est vraiment pas facile.
Le logement se trouve à Astoria très calme et reposant par rapport à New York. Il faut compter 40min pour rejoindre Time Square et une heure pour le quartier de Wall Street. Le bus se trouve en face de l’immeuble et il y en a un toutes les 20 minutes. Avec google maps on a tout en temps réel pour les horaires de bus.
Ils ont toujours été là pour le moindre soucis ou petit détail et on a pu passer une petite soirée avec Daniel et Nazleen avant de partir. C'etait vraiment super et on a pu échanger sur nos expériences. Merci encore à eux.
Great host and a great room! Looking forward to renting the room again with better weather.
Great place. The hosts' were very accommodating. Overall i enjoyed my stay!

I loved staying at this apartment.  We wanted to live like New Yorkers for our stay and this place gave us that.  The bus stop is right outside the door, and in 5 to 10 minutes you're on the train to any borough.  Naz and Daniel were very welcoming and helpful.  I would definitely stay here again.

We loved staying here for a few days! The hosts were very accommodating and helpful. Quiet, residential area that was right by a bus stop that took you to the subway station. Would definitely stay here again!
Im Studio von Naz und Daniel ist man komplett für sich. Die schöne Dachterrasse kann an lauen Sommerabenden sehr schön genutzt werden.
The place is a great location to stay right outside of NYC. Not hectic and loud. Nice get away to relax and enjoy the view. Great location for easy transportation access as well.

It was my boyfriend and I's first time in NY. We had an amazing time exploring and getting to see all NY had to offer. We spent a lot of time in the city so coming back to Nazleen's and Daniel's place was so relaxing. The area we were in was very quiet even, during the middle of the night.

We were super close to pubic transit so it was very easy to get around. The space itself was lovely. The outdoor area gave us an amazing view. Plus it was nice to just have somewhere to sit and relax after a long day. The room was in the small side but the space was utilized so well it was perfect for us. Anything we could think of was provided and they even left a phone with videos on how to use everything in the space.

Communication was excellent as well. Although we never got to meet. I was in contact with Nazleen the whole time. We had an issue with our tv when we arrived. I contacted Nazleen about it and within a few hours it was replaced!

Wonderful experience. Will definitely look into their place again! :)
Nice place but keep your guard up. Allot of  ghetto people around.

Naz and Daniel are amazing hosts!! They make you feel as comfortable as they can. The place is nice and perfect for anyone that wants to get away and be in New York. Perfect view and setting. I would definitely stay again! Thanks guys!
Very nice location and view. Had no issues with the host. Will definitely book this place next time I visit NY!
Great place, cozy, and close to the bus & metro, would certainly recommend this place to anyone exploring the city.

Le studio est conforme à l explication et se situe dans un quartier calme. Proche de bus  que vous emmènent au métro pour Manhattan. Prévoyez 45 min' pour vous rendre dans Manhattan. Nous avons apprécié le séjour mais je le recommande si vous y passé au moins une semaine du à la durée du trajet.

It was a bit of a walk to the subway, but the room was very clean and had all the typical hotel-like amenities. I would definitely recommend staying here if you know how to navigate public transportation.

Nazleen's place is awesome. It is not huge, but it was plenty of space for us. It is not in the middle of noisy streets, and there is very little traffic around so that helped cut down on some of the noise. Getting to other parts of the city was easy, just a short bus ride and then into the subway. There are several good places to eat right around the subway stop so you don't have to travel too far for dinner. When we return to New York City we definitely plan on staying there again.

Nazleen's 5th story apartment was perfect for my husband, teen daughter, & me. It was far enough away from the heart of the city that we had free parking behind the building. Unloading our car into the apartment was pretty easy, even with the stair climb. On the flip side, the apartment was a relatively short and affordable Uber/Lyft ride away from everywhere we want to be in the heart of the city. (I say relative because transportation in NYC can be rather pricey in general, so it's good to weigh your options. If we'd been staying longer, we would have invested in a 7-day unlimited ride pass.) A perfect location for the combination of an activity filled day in the city and quiet, relaxing evening inside or outside on the rooftop patio. The patio was lovely, with a nice view of the city.

The apartment was small but arranged for maximum use and comfort. We were on a road trip and still had plenty of room to store and access all our stuff. Several extras (games, snacks, instructions for navigating the city, etc) made the stay most accommodating.

Nazleen was just a call or text away if we needed anything and Danny was very helpfully present to greet us upon arrival and show us the apartment.
Excellent people! Loved the place and Nazleen and Daniel are the best.

We had a great 10 day stay at Nazleen and Daniels place. Even after arriving at 2am they were so accommodating and showed us to our room. The place was just perfect, with a TV that had access to Netflix and a Wii to play. All the facilities were great, especially the AC. The availability of shower gel and shampoo in the bathroom lasted us our whole stay. Nazleen even provided clean towels half way through our trip. The location was good, easy transport routes on buses and subway. The east river ferry to Wall St is a must. The bed was unbelievably comfortable, especially after a long day in the city. The only thing we could have done with was some bowls for cereal. Communication with Nazleen and Daniel was great, they were always on hand to provide us with information and answer any questions we had. Overall a really perfect place to stay! Thank you!
We had a great stay at Nazleen's place. It was very cozy, clean and in a convenient location. We would stay again. I highly recommend going to il Fornaio Bakery for breakfast, it is not too far away.
房东很不错 给我们提供了很多的便利 很好的旅行体验
The stay was so awesome. We would stay here again👍🏼

The place was private and had a great view. Public transportation was so easy within a day I knew how to get to the closest main hub which allowed me to get anywhere in the city quickly and easily! Nazleen was super helpful with directions and any request we had.  I would definitely stay here again, and would recommend to all my friends.
Nice and bright appartment at great location with everything we needed. We loved Williamsburg with great views of Manhattan at Domino Park!

If you want a genuine taste of Williamsburg Ming’s Place is for you .
The apartment occupies a floor in a heritage home and has lots of charm and character . It is also very convenient to all that Williamsburg has to offer . Ming is very professional and friendly and we would have no hesitation in recommending her property .

The apartment was perfectly located (5min away from the subway and near everything you need: restaurants, shops etc.), clean and very pretty. The bed was comfortable and the street was quiet. Ming had let us beverages in the fridge and a list of good spots in town. It was our first time in Williamsburg and we definitely had the best time! Thank you Ming!! Can’t wait to be back.

After spending the day in busy Manhattan with lots of new impressions and eyperiences Ming‘s apartment is a perfect retreat and feels like coming home. The apartment was super clean, furniture very stylish and the bed is super comfortable. Also Williamsburg offers so many nice places for coffee, lunch, dinner or going out for a drink just around the corner. I definitely recommend Ming‘s apartment!!

A clean, comfortable and stylish place to stay in a great location in hip Williamsburg.  The apartment was bigger than expected with everything you could possibly need. It’s in a lovely street that is relatively calm and quiet compared to the hustle and bustle of the surroundings.  It’s a short and pleasant walk to the subway to take you into Manhattan but we loved staying around Williamsburg and nearby areas in Brooklyn - there are so many cool shops, bars and restaurants. We were really pleased we decided to stay here rather than in Manhattan itself. Would definitely come back. Thank you Ming and Matt!
We had a wonderful time! Really, really recommend this apartment, the neighbourhood and the hosts!

We stayed two months in the apartement and it really became a home away from home. Ming and Matt are absolutely lovely and do everything to make your stay perfect.
The apartement is in an old brick building in a nice street super centrally located in the heart of Williamsburg. Everything you need (and will love) is within walking distance and there are three subway lines that bring you into Manhattan within 20-30 minutes (depending where you want to go and if trains are running properly).
The apartement itself is perfectly clean and as shown in the pictures. You have everything you need (including cooking basics, soap etc) even for a long term stay.
I felt safe and comfortable at any time (in the apartement and also in the neigborhood) even while I lived there only by myself.
Thank you so much Ming & Matt - we will certainly be back!

Another perfect stay at one of our favorite Airbnb accommodations in the world.

We keep coming back nearly every year for more!

Thanks as always Ming - the apartment is looking nicer every time we come :)

We stayed at Ming's for 5 nights and it really was a good experience. The appartement is very well located, 1 bloc away from the lively Bedford street's bars, shops and restaurants but in a calmer area, which was important for us after the daily exhausting marathons all around the city. Acces to Manhattan is easy and convenient with either L or M line. The appartement itself is very clean, pretty large and tastefully  decorated. It had all amenities required, although we actually didn't used it much. Ming quickly and accurately answered to all questions we had. The only bad point was the klanking pipes and radiators in the bedroom every morning at around 6am when the heat starts. It was hard for us jetlacked visitors to fall asleep again but eventually forced us to wake up and go out. Thank you again Ming
Highly recommend this apartment!
Great location, thoughtfully decorated, fast wifi.

Ming’s Airbnb is a lovely place, perfectly situated on a quiet street and close to so many great restaurants, bakeries, and public transportation. I was impressed by the tasteful details, modern amenities, and cleanliness throughout the space. The bedroom is quiet and cozy, and the kitchen is packed with great equipment to make cooking very enjoyable. Beyond all this, Ming is an expert host, very responsive and accommodating. I really enjoyed my stay. Thank you!

We loved staying at Ming’s place! My husband and I worked from there for two weeks, and the home was great for that.
The apartment is cozy, comfortable, clean, charming and practical. It has high ceilings and plenty of light. It’s also located in a prime spot in Williamsburg.
Ming herself is warm, welcoming and quick to reply.
She left special touches in the apartment for us like fruit, flowers and tea.
She even ordered a desk for the bedroom as I mentioned I would like one to work on! So thoughtful.
Ming's home was lovely, clean, and in a convenient location. There were thoughtful touches in the apartment and she was very responsive to our needs. We had a great time and felt very at home!

Gorgeous brownstone renovation in a nice neighborhood.  It definitely WAS "perfect for parents".  We had the top floor with big, comfy bed.  Attention to detail, immaculately clean, welcoming host.  Highly recommend this.

Highly recommend. My parents recently stayed with J., they loved her house. J was friendly and hospitable, offering a tour of her entire home which blew them away - J. has put tremendous love and effort into restoring her brownstone.

The garden unit was clean, large, and beautifully furnished. And the attached garden was extremely attractive.

The bed is a foldout but reportedly quite comfortable (and my father is a big guy, he presents a real test for a bed!). The "kitchen" has a sink, coffee maker, fridge, but no stove/oven.

I give J.'s place four stars only because the last guest had not adequately cleaned the dishes and there was no sponge with which to do the job, we had to go out and buy one. Minor quibble. Apart from that, it was a five star experience for a fair price.

We felt so lucky to have found this garden apartment and were well taken care of by J! Fort Greene is an amazing area close to the city but quiet, lush (at least in May) and full of great places to eat. The apartment is on one of the nicest streets in the area, close to everything but still peaceful. It was very clean, beautifully renovated, the bed was comfy and the kitchen perfect for our needs - which was breakfast, because honestly, if you are in NYC to visit you should eat out as much as possible. The garden is lovely and was perfect for breakfast or for drinks in the evening. Highly recomended!
J made us feel at home instantly.  The townhouse is airy, bright, and VERY clean. The top floor was a comfortable and roomy getaway.  We hope to return.

Appartement en bon état, espace suffisant pour une semaine. Propriétaires sympathiques.
Bien desservi par les transports mais un peu excentré. Uber : 15$ depuis Brooklyn, 20$ depuis Grand central
Je recommande
Wicked awesome place to stay. Very private, clean, and comfortable. Definitely gonna plan to stay again!

Nazleen and Daniel's flat is really awesome.  The view is great, the flat itself is clean and can easily host 2 person. Nazleen and Daniel are really kind. They will be here anyway to provide any kind of help you may need. The smartphone and metro card provided avoid you loads of  headaches.  Thanks so much again. It was amazing.
Beautiful place, excellent location and great accommodations. J was very considerate and gracious. Would stay there again on our next trip to New York.
Clean, private and lovely accommodation. Treated well. Would stay there again.

My husband & I had a Wonderful stay in Brooklyn, we loved the neighborhood~& were bowled over by the beauty of J's home & furnishings.

An absolutely perfect little getaway, Highly Recommended!!
Great place and great location.  Everything you need is less than a block or two away.

i stayed on the top floor, which had beautiful light. Everything was clean and new, the place felt like a fancy hotel. J is an excellent host.  I would certainly stay here again.  The neighborhood is safe and full of great places to eat and useful stores, and a nice park. I wish I lived there. 5 stars without hesitation.

My wife and I stayed in the garden apartment for three days and we could not have been more pleased.  J made it very easy to get in and get ourselves comfortable.  The WiFi worked great, the bed was comfortable, and the shower is fantastic.  This is a spacious place with your own entrance, the rooms are clean, and the sleeping is at the back where the overhead fan makes it even more likely that you will sleep peacefully.  We needed to set the alarm to get up in the morning — it's that quiet.  We would be glad to stay here again, in fact, we will make this our first choice the next time we're in Brooklyn.

Even though I would not recognize her from her photo, the person we met was lovely, as was her apartment, conveniently located in a beautiful part of Brooklyn, and so quiet that we overslept! We hope to stay there again on future trips.

Beautiful, quality rooms and garden, in a lovely neighborhood; so much nicer than a top notch hotel room. Convenient to subway. Owner is practical and helpful but not intrusive.   A great way to experience Brooklyn brownstone living at it's best. We will be back.

We rented the top-floor space and found it beautiful, spacious, and very clean- and just around the corner from many excellent bars, restaurants and cafes. Conveniently located to several subway stops.

J was also an excellent host and made the entire transaction easy and worry-free.

We'll definitely be back.

We spent two nights in the beautiful Garden Apartment, and we didn't want to leave.  The apartment was spacious, clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully decorated.  We really enjoyed the large garden in the back--quiet and peaceful.  The host J. was great, very friendly and accomodating, giving us helpful info on everything.  We would most definitely stay here again.

The top floor is gorgeous and very clean. The photos don't adequately show the charm and spaciousness of the place. There is a beautiful stained glass skylight in the landing area and a small room that is connected to the bedroom by French doors that has the closet and dresser as well as an additional window. The "laundry room" is also on the top floor and looks more like a dining room with a big table and chairs and was only used by me.

The place was very quiet with a view through the trees outside of the other brownstones on the block. The neighborhood is very attractive with restaurants and stores.

J was very responsible.

My stay at J's place could not have been better (stayed on the third floor).  It's gorgeous and much bigger than the pictures make it seem.  There's a kitchen-like room with a table and chairs (though just a sink, no fridge or stove/microwave), a beautiful bathroom, a bedroom and a dressing room off to the side.  Plenty of natural light through windows and skylights and very tastefully decorated.  It was an absolute pleasure to be there.  Feels very private even though people are living downstairs.  We neither heard nor saw anyone until we were literally walking out the door to leave.  However, J made it known that we could reach if we needed anything.  Would return in a heartbeat.  Thanks, J!
J's place is beautiful, and my parents really enjoyed their stay.

Wonderful stay in J's garden apartment - charming, spacious, clean, conveniently located, and safe.
J was great - very friendly, helpful, and thougtful. We appreciated everything from the coffe beans and coffee grinder to the wine glasses. We hope J's place is available if we go to NYC again!

J's place worked out perfectly for our stay.  We walked to wine shops, restaurants, my daughter's apartment... It was a perfect location for us.  The apartment was quite nice.  J even had a coffee grinder and whole bean coffee in the room for us.  On our 1st stay in Brooklyn we stayed at the Nu Hotel.  It was nice, however, the price, room, comfort and location of J's place was a MUCH better option!  Thanks J!
Excellent stay. Beautiful building with five-star furnishings. Great interactions with the host. Fun neighborhood. We're true believers!

Loved the apartment, excellent view of the city! Really convenient location right across the street from a bus stop, so easy access to Manhattan if you need it. It's cozy and a great value - Nazleen was super helpful when we needed assistance and was just a great host.
Eine sehr gemütliche kleine Wohnung mit toller Dachterasse und sehr viel Austattung :)

Können wir nur empfehlen. Schnelle Kommunikation und hilfreich. Host ist leicht zu finden, mit der beigefügten Wegbeschreibung. Man kann den Host super leicht mit U-Bahn und Bus erreichen, man spart dadurch viel Geld mit dem Taxi. Komme gerne wieder.

Wir hatten eine super Zeit bei Naz & Daniel und haben uns in dem kleinen Studio sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Größe ist perfekt für 2 Personen.
Naz & Daniel waren vor und während des Aufenthaltes immer erreichbar, haben total lieb auf unsere Fragen geantwortet und haben auf ihrem YouTube Canal prima Tipps (wie kommt man vom Flughafen zur Whg, wie in die Stadt, wie kaufe ich ein Metro Ticket usw.)
Die Wohnung ist liebevoll ausgestattet und man merkt das sich die beiden Gedanken machen den Aufenthalt für ihre Gäste so angenehm und unkompliziert wie möglich zu machen. TOP!
Die Lage in Queens ist ganz ok, man bekommt auf jeden Fall einen Einblick fernab der bekannten Touri Pfade. :)
Enjoyed this place - a bit of a walk to the subway, but the ferry service (which was new to me) was very close and an amazing way to see the City!

Great place. Great location. Wonderful hospitality. During our stay we didn't encounter any issues with the neighbors. If you want to travel downtown this is a good place because you get to see the other side of New York. The scenery is great as well. If you are tired from walking or touring around downtown, just come back to their place and just stare at the city lights. Private rooftop and playing in the snow :) would highly recommend this place.
Cozy, quiet place in a very convenient location to LaGuardia airport. Nazleen is quick to respond and very accommodating. Would stay here again!

Wij kozen dit appartement omdat we toch gedurende de dag in de stad zouden zijn. Zolang we maar een bed hadden en een plek waar we even snel een ontbijtje konden eten. Helaas hebben we dit onderschat. Ondanks de schoonmaak kosten die we betaalden, lagen er plukken stof op de vloer, was al het servies nog vies, lag de badkamervloer bezaaid met haren en stof en roken de handdoeken sterk naar urine. Het leek alsof alle afzuigkappen van het appartementengebouw in deze kamer uitkwamen, wij werden beiden (zonder overdrijven) enorm misselijk van alle verschillende eet-geuren die in de kamer hingen. Helaas, omdat het winter is, was het te koud om de ramen op te doen. De verwarming maakte zo'n intens hard lawaai dat we ook deze liever uit hadden.
Het bed is enorm doorgeleefd en heeft een kuil in het midden, waardoor je telkens naar elkaar toe rolt. Ook het donkere beddengoed verhult vieze plekken, waardoor we niet prettig sliepen.
De douchekop is vastgemaakt met ducktape en lekt bovendien.
De verhuurders hebben een toprating, maar toen we aankwamen kregen we amper 5 minuten om verwelkomd te worden.

Ook goed om te weten: de dichtstbijzijnde metro is 20 minuten lopen.

Wel een pluspunt: hoewel wij er geen gebruik van hebben gemaakt, ligt er wel een metrokaart en een mobiele telefoon met internet in de kamer die je kunt gebruiken.
Super appartment on a rooftop in astoria! Great hosts and perfect trip! Thx again
Best hospitality in NYC. This is the place where you want to stay. It is central to every area and extremely safe.
As described
The apartment was lovely and so were the hosts. :)

What an amazing find! This cute little space was perfect for our weekend getaway. It has easy access to public transportation and is located in a very walkable neighborhood. We loved the personal touches and helpful notes provided by the host.

I always travel with my small dogs. They had plenty of room to safely explore on the rooftop patio and there are parks and dog friendly businesses nearby.

This place is perfect for a short trip to NYC! We just needed a good place to crash every night where we felt safe and Nazleen’s place is exactly that!! There’s also parking which was amazing because we drove there. We definitely would come back again!!
The host canceled this reservation 7 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

My fiancé and i stayed in Nazleen’s place while in town for an engagement party. The studio was just what we needed, right amount of space and perfect little touches. Nazleen included a lot of tips for using public transit and getting around the city. She gave us our space and privacy which was appreciated. The roof deck patio is definitely my favorite part of the place!

Nazleen's place is so nice and cozy. I love the style of their place. The balcony is especially nice since it is so large and has a very nice view of part of the city. They are great hosts with very quick responses and great communication. Would definitely go back!
