This place is amazing! Wonderful view and the private roof deck was superb! Nazleen was great - very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!

This place was fantastic.   Private,  lots of room, tremendous view from the deck.  Hosts were wonderful,  helpful and very accommodating.   Slightly off the beaten path but Uber and the nearby bus made traveling easy.   I could not recommend this place any more highly.
I loved the apartment and the great hospitality! The amazing decoration made my stay so cozy that I felt at home. I would love to come back!
We tried Chick-n- soup it's a must have

Great stay! Quiet and away from the city noise. The room was just perfect size for my boyfriend and I. Must be able to climb up and down 5 stories. Also the Shower is tight, but other than that, it was a great stay. I will stay here again when I visit.

Le quartier est pas très agréable au premier coup d’œil mais les gens sont cools, gentils et c’est le Queen’s! Nazleen est dispo pour vous aider avec les commandes de taxi ou pour garder les valises, elle vous confie un téléphone avec internet ce qui est précieux pour le gps car nous avons fait beaucoup de vélos, il y a des pistes cyclables dans tout Brooklyn, Manhattan c’est plus compliqué.
L’appartement est idéal pour un couple et si la météo est clémente, profitez de la grande terrasse avec vue sur le haut de Manhattan.
Host is really kindly people! i love this place:)

Great place to stay if you are in New York. There is no Elevator so if that is an issue, you will need to walk up stairs. As long as you can get your bags up it's not a big deal. I would stay here again, hosts were very helpful and great to work with.

Such a convenient place espically for taking the ferry. Highly recommend this place if you making travaling plans to Wall Street, time square, and empire state building or near there. The host responsed very fast and answer questions patiently. We did enjoyed staying here!

We chose this suite based on the overwhelmingly positive reviews. We were disappointed with the cleanliness of the suite. The space just seemed like it needed a good scrub. Other than that one disappointment, we liked that the location is within walking distance of the ferry and relatively close to some good bars. The hosts also provided a metro card, which was convenient. The neighborhood was quiet. The roof had good views.
Awesome location , and awesome host !
Private, cozy, and a nice place to crash after a long day out in the city.
Affordable , private , and quiet !   You can not go wrong . The great rooftop view of the water was beautiful ... perfect for late night chats with me and my wife

Nazleen’s place is just as pictured ! My favorite part was not 1 but TWO patios both of which had pretty decent views. The bed was sooooo comfortable especially after walking in nyc all day it was just what we needed . Would definitely recommend this spot !

This place is where “real New Yorkers” live. It’s a several block walk to restaurants, but they are worth it! The bus stop is literally out the door and is the first and last stop on the route which makes it easy to know when to get off. The ferry is also close by, and it’s a nice ride to Wall St. You also get a decent view of Roosevelt Island from the roof of the building. It’s worth staying here, but you will need to take the bus to get to any subway station.
Everything was wonderful! Amazing view, fantastic city recommendations, extremely nice place to stay. If you are traveling to New York..STAY HERE. You will be EXTREMELY satisfied.
Nazleen's place was absolutely incredible, and throughout the entire process, she was very communicative. The airbnb was also in an amazing location close to Manhatten.
This was a beautiful place. The rooftop was so magical. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

This is an excellent option for a trip to NYC! Amazing hosts who are excellent communicators and a great location for getting into the city easily. The rooftop balcony is one of the best parts, it’s a great view in the evenings!! There is a bus stop nearby, but my husband and I used the ferry to get into the city. It’s about a 5-10 minute walk from the apartment, costs $2.75 and goes to E 34th St (near Empire State Building) and Wall St. super fun experience and some great views of the city! Thanks again for a great stay and we hope to be back soon!

Great secluded studio with rooftop AND balcony views! Hosts are lovely and provide some extra amenities that were super helpful. Perfect amount of space for 2 people. A/C was strong which was great for the super humid weather. Walking distance to the Noguchi Museum, Sculpture Park and MoMa PS1. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely stay again.

I definitely recommend Nazleen’s place, great host, communication and hospitality all the way, I recommend to use the ferry to move around! And there’s a bar near called Astoria Craft, great service and good quality beer, and Tuesday’s are trivia nights and is SO fun!

Very convenient location and nice sized space if you are traveling to the city. The ferry is easy to get to and takes you right to Manhattan.  Naz was so great at responding to all of our questions right away and also offered a metro card and phone to use during our stay was super helpful! :)

Awesome hosts,  immediate responses and walked me through checkin when i couldnt find my way.  My fault as i didnt read instructions!  Bus, subway and ferry all a few minutes walk from their place.  I would stay again!  Thank you!
Great rooftop with an awesome view to the city, a grill and a fireplace. Free parking on the street. Value per night could be a bit cheaper.

The view is amazing from the balcony.
The room has aircon which is a life saver in summer.
Perfect place for a busy tourist to come to after a long day to unwind and soak up the last light of the day on the balcony.
The hosts were amazingly helpful and available so quickly.

Nazs place was awesome. Very handy to where I needed to get too. The only downside was the stairs LOL but overall the place was nice. The balcony was very nice in the evenings and aircon was aaaammmaazziiinngg.

This is the perfect apartment for a one or two person stay in Williamsburg. The apartment is spotless, equipped with everything you need, and 5-10 minutes walk from anything you might want. I couldn’t have been more comfortable and would stay again in a heartbeat.

Ming's place was perfect. It is the second level apartment in a three story brownstone. The apartment itself is very minimalist, clean and cozy - every item in there felt intentionally chosen. It is an older building with some original elements like the built-in cupboards, gorgeous floorboards, and rustic doors, but paired so well with modern designed furniture and kitchenware. The kitchen window overlooks a some greenery and is so serene in the morning. The street itself is tucked away from the larger traffic areas and is usually very quiet. There was one rowdy night where some sound carried over, but that was the first warm weekend and when things were opening back up. There was also an issue where I thought I misplaced the keys, but Ming responded promptly even though it was 9pm when she was out of town, and quickly arranged for the neighbor to get me in the apartment. Overall her communication really made me feel taken care of. I stayed 5 days but wish it could have lasted so much longer! Would definitely come back if I was back in Brooklyn, and I don't often feel that way! Really one of the best BnB stays I've had.
Great location, central to everything in Williamsburg on a quiet street. Excellent communication with Ming and check in was super easy. Very, very clean and comfortable! Highly recommended!

Ming’s home was perfect: great/safe location in the ‘burg (there’s an amazing bakery a block away), clean and charming space, and easy check-in/communication. There was complimentary still and sparkling bottled water in the fridge. Would def stay again. Thanks, Ming!

Amazing location - close to restaurants, shops, groceries, park, subway, laundry. The apartment is super clean, great space for 2 people, Ming and her husband are very kind and helpful. Highly recommend if you're looking to stay in Williamsburg!
A gem in a wonderful location. Highly recommend!

Ming's apartment is one of the best AirBnB experiences I've ever had. Stayed for 5 nights. Great location on a quite street within the heart of Williamsburg. Immaculately decorated. Stocked with everything you need (there were bottles of still and sparkling water in the refrigerator!). Highly recommend.

Great place located just around the corner from a variety of bars, restaurants and shops in Williamsburg. Ming was very easy to deal with and always very responsive. Pictures reflect exactly what the apartment is like. Highly recommend if you are looking for a clean, spacious and light filled apartment located in the heart of Williamsburg. Ideal for couples.

The space is impeccably clean and tastefully decorated. Situated on a quiet block in Brooklyn, the apartment is full of historic charm and is a wonderful respite from the hustle and bustle of city streets.

Ming is a fantastic host and provides all the amenities guests could possibly need - cool water waiting in the fridge, umbrellas for the rain. And a gorgeous space to relax and unwind. Would absolutely stay again and highly recommend it for any travelers looking for a classic Brooklyn brownstone to call home for a few days!

This is a gorgeous apartment, very centrally located to great dining, parks, shopping, and subway lines. It's a very cozy and clean space to come home to after a day trekking around Brooklyn. I would definitely recommend!
Great place, very clean and cute and in a perfect Williamsburg location
We had a very good stay in Ming's Arbnb.  Great location and perfect for 2 people.  Would recommend highly for a visit to Williamsburg and Brooklyn.
Our stay was perfect and Ming was a fantastic host. Highly recommended!
My cozy BK home away from home. Thank you, Ming!
Great apt, host and location - would definitely stay there again!

Ming’s place is just what you need to rest/recoup after a long day of tromping around NYC. Every detail is attended to in this light, quiet apartment. We enjoyed the historic building equipped with modern conveniences. The location is just right for enjoying Brooklyn and conveniently located to the subway. The bed is unusually comfortable, and I already ordered my own set of the pillows because they’re just right! We especially appreciated the chilled water (both still and sparkling) waiting for us upon arrival. And we loved morning coffee from PPL nearby! The only sad thing is that we had to leave…too bad vacations can’t last forever.
A beautiful space in a gorgeous neighborhood.  J made us feel comfortable and at home.  I will recommend her place to my friends.

This was a great find - and really perfect for parents. Plenty of space and well looked after, the garden is beautiful for relaxing days reading the papers. It's right around the corner from Fort Greene and the C, G and N, Q trains.  Perfect.

What an amazing place to stay (we were in the garden apartment)... the rooms are of a generous size and the quality of the furnishings and design work is of an extremely high standard.  The garden is such a treat to have, especially in a big city like NYC.  The kitchenette was perfect for making tea and had plenty of useful dishes, glasses, utensils, et cetera.  The bed was large and comfortable, the television is huge, the shower is powerful and gorgeous and J was so helpful and responsive to any questions - we had total privacy while we were staying in the apartment, but she left us her number so we could ring her if we needed anything.  It is such a wonderful place to stay, so much nicer than a hotel - we would definitely go back and will recommend to all our friends.

Nice/safe location. We had the whole top floor and it was lovely. Very clean and nicely decorated. Had a kitchen area, own bathroom with a deep tub, and a separate room area for the closet. It felt very roomy and made you forget you were in the busy crowed area of Brooklyn.
Stunning home in great location.  Perfect for "parents".  We stayed on the third floor; beautiful furnishings and very private.  Host was entirely accommodating with facilities.

I booked the garden apartment for my parents and it was indeed perfect. They loved the place and thought it was wonderful to have a "home" to stay in while visiting their new grandson in Brooklyn. They found the bed very comfy and the apartment was charming. We will definitely look to use this location again for future visits!

We were in the garden flat. Great and adorable place in a quiet neibourhood in Brooklyn. The subway is quite close. Safe. Jay is a good person. I recommend it 100%.

Thanks Jay for all!!
My visit to NYC was wonderful. I love Fort Greene! Jay's apt  is lovely and cozy. The apt is a couple of blocks from the subway and an easy ride to the city. I will stay again!

The  apartment is beautiful and comfortable and located in a great neighborhood--good restaurants and cafes, and a block from the park.  J couldn't have been more friendly or accommodating.  We hope to stay there again.

we stayed for 6 nights in November / December while visiting our daughter and were delighted to have found this accommodation. Every bit as nice as it looks in the "advertising" and in a picturesque, accessible Brooklyn location.
the host is welcoming and accommodating and it was indeed "perfect for parents"
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
Great place in a perfect location.

This garden apartment was lovely, with interesting appointments throughout and careful attention to decor. I stayed 4 nights, and enjoyed being able to work in the apartment. The weather two of the days in March was nice enough to sit and work outside. J was very accommodating, prompt in responding to any questions or needs, and flexible on check in and out.

Pros: Good location within walking distance of many good restaurants along Dekalb. Seven blocks to G or C subway. The bathroom is large and well lighted. The apartment is large.

Cons: Bed is uncomfortable. Second mattress atop sleeper sofa is foam, it's mushy, soft, worn-out, has a tendency to roll you to the middle, not good with two adults. Sheets, bedding are showing signs of wear, pulled off around corners every night. Would give this place more stars if the bed was better and for the price per night it should be better.
The back yard chairs and tables were very dirty and could not be used.

Very private fairly spacious flat. Lovely garden was a major plus over a beautiful weekend. Wonderful location, close to everything!

The only reason I'm not giving it 4 stars and not 5 is because the bed is on a pull out frame, so it may not be comfy sleeping for everyone, but we slept fine and truly enjoyed 2 nights at the apt.

We plan on being repeat visitors!

We had a delightful stay at Perfect for Parents visiting family in Clinton Hill. The apartment is spacious and the weather was great for enjoying the garden patio. Jay is an accommodating host as well. Great location with everything we needed within walking distance. Highly recommend!
Great quiet apartment with great light and a lovely backyard.  Beautiful new bathroom with a fabulous shower.   It really did feel like a home away from home.

Great location and cute place. Short distance to the metro, and lots of restaurants are within walking. Ming communicate directions ahead time. Unit has all the amenities as described. Would recommend.
Lovely, clean, lots of space, quiet street, and perfect location to explore Williamsburg.   Great food nearby.   Don’t miss the La Bicyclette Bakery.   Ming was super helpful in answer any questions.
The space was excellent.  The location was perfectly convenient. And Ming was an incredible, gracious host. I highly recommend this space!!
Amazing space and hospitality. Unit is super clean and has all you may need. Will come back again. Walking distance to everything.

Ming & Matt are lovely people and their place really is a 10 / 10! The interior is beautiful, the neighborhood is perfect (close to the subway, in a quiet street around the corner from a bakery and plenty of restaurants and shops). The appartment has everything you need including a great bed & shower. Kitchen also has all appliances you could wish for during your stay. Would 100% recommend! Thanks guys!
The pictures are exactly what the room looks like! There’s also a wii to play games before bed super nice!
Places was great, nice and cozy with a beautiful view.

It was one of the best if not the best place me and my partner have ever stayed at in New York using Airbnb. The location is convenient as it’s close to the subway station, it’s easy to ride the bus, and you can ride the ferry to reach Manhattan so there are a lot of options for traveling from place to place. There is also a supermarket near the station at 30th ave that’s open even at midnight. The view is breathtaking, the room is very stylish and clean and cozy, especially the bed! There was a table complete with utensils and there was a microwave and a mini fridge.  Check in was smooth because Nazleen gave us very helpful and clear instructions, response is also very fast. I definitely recommend this place and would love to come back!

Nazleens place was wonderful!
the room was all we needed throughout our stay + some!
the private terrace was our favorite feature but the location itself topped it all off! tons of transportation options in the area & nazleen was excellent in responding to our needs.
Highly recommend to any couple wanting to explore the city!
If you need small cozy apartment in a quiet place near Manhattan, I recommend Naz place!

We were in town for a music festival and this Airbnb was great for our stay. It was very close to where we needed to go, very clean and just enough space for 3 people. The host responds very quickly to any messages.

We came on holiday a week in New York, we were lucky enough to fall in Nazleen and Daniel's accommodations which was just perfect for a couple, the terrace is just awesome! The accommodation seems far away at first, but in fact there is the ferry which is right next door which leads directly to Manhattan! The housing area is very quiet and nice! Nazleen and Daniel are lovely, great hosts who are attentive and present even though we did not have the chance to spend an evening with them! They leave a phone with international calls, restaurant recommendations and more.
They also left us a subway map and coffee, they are even busy with our taxi back! they are really fabulous hosts !! :)
This accommodation is as described, it is recommended without problem ! :)

Well from where to start!!!
The guys put so much effort and love to their apartment that is the coziest place we ever stayed!!! Feels home!
Super clean, with the greatest transportation ever only 10 minutes walk from the station and even less with the bus ( we were enjoying walking as the neighborhood is so pretty).
They even provided hair shampoo, conditioner,coffee , milk , water and a scale !!!!!!!!that was like the cherry on the tart!
The view just stunning that makes our nights with wine and chat in the terrace amazing!
Even if they were abroad they were always responded to our msg to cover any questions we had ( like taxi number !!!!)
THANK YOU SO MUCH
Will definitely come back!!!

Great place to stay in Queens! Walking distance to both the bus and ferry made the location convenient for getting around. Small private space with all necessary amenities. Nazleen makes it very easy to check-in/out

Naz place is a great place to stay in the city with great access to public transportation. In the apartment there are great tips to the city with a loner bus/train card. The view of the Manhattan is amazing. And the rooftop is great to just relax and enjoy the magnificent views. Naz also responded quick and was very acclimating to needs. I recommend to stay there.
GREAT PLACE super close to the ferry! Great views from the balcony

We had a fabulous time staying at Naz's NYC apartment! Checkin was exactly as described and we had an easy time getting in and out of the city with Uber and taxi (about $30 each way). The bed was super comfy and we enjoyed all the little touches in the apartment which was very clean and exactly what we needed after a long day and night in the city. Plan on some type of transportation in and around the area because even though you could walk to the ferry and other ways of getting around, it's not an easy walk with lots of different streets and crossings, etc. and there was quite a bit of construction while we were there. Also plan on climbing the stairs since the apartment is at the top of about 4 flights with an amazing view right from the rooftop! That was our favorite feature by far!! Thank you both for all your suggestions and travel tips and thank you for being so available to help us with our trip! We'll be back to see you soon!
place is great for the price, highly recommended

Esperienza positiva. L'appartamento e' molto carino e accogliente, dotato di tutto il necessario per trascorrere alcuni giorni a New York (wifi, forno a microonde, set di stoviglie, phon, ferro da stiro). Ideale per 2 persone. Abbiamo effettuato come previsto il self check in, prendendo le chiavi da una cassetta a codice, e' stato semplice. La zona e' tranquilla, certo non la migliore di New York e un po' lontana dal centro della città. C'è la fermata di bus (Q18 e Q102) a 20 metri abbastanza comoda e la metropolitana a 10 minuti. Host molto molto disponibili e reattivi. In generale consigliabile, soprattutto per giovani coppie.

I’ll start off by saying this location is perfect and the view is beautiful especially at night! The bed is very comfortable. I parked in front of the building for the whole time I was there. Nazleen has gone out of her way for me on more then one occasion and I appreciate it very much. I would highly recommend this place and I will definitely be back!
the place was very good They were very gentle. the space was very well decorated very clean very tidy I definitely recommend it.

Easy check in and check out. Very comfortable bed and good hot shower. Ferry next to the place is super easy and cheap and cool way to go into the city; nice views. Only downside is a lack of shopping/dining within .5 of place but for a place to sleep fairly close to Manhattan and Brooklyn it did the job. Bus was a little confusing and we used a lot of uber/lyft which can sometime get pretty pricy. Very close to LGA which was nice to not have to rush the day we left town.
Studio très humide
Wonderful place to stay! Convenient to all of NYC, super quiet & cozy! Hosts are super helpful and easily accessible. Well worth the price!

Naz and Daniel were very friendly, helpful, and were willing to be as present as we wanted. It was very nice to have our own space including a private entrance. Bus transportation is right across the street. Food is not as convenient, I would bring a snack along if you are arriving at meal time.. We would consider staying there again.
Nice place clean and tidy...the host really nice fast to answer of any question
Great communication, easy self check-in/out, homemade cookies on arrival, warm, cosy and clean place, with all the facilities one might need. Quite a lot of steps but exercise is good ;)
Great host! Made us feel very welcomed & cozy. Will definitely come back!

Nazleen fue muy atento dejándonos quedar en la habitación hasta las8pm debido a que habíamos llegado a la 11pm y adicionalmente teníamos vuelo a muy altas horas de la noche. Vi en los comentarios que les permitieron utilizar un teléfono y una tarjeta para el metro, en nuestro caso no sucedió, pero de igual manera no fue necesario.

My stay was great, the place was clean and check in was easy! The area was great and had a wonderful view to the city. Nazleen was wonderful and provided me with local tips and things to do. I loved it definitely would recommend.

My husband, dog, and a I had a blast and we felt so comfortable here! We will absolutely stay again if we ever visit NYC again! Daniel and Naz are so friendly and will respond fast to your messages. We enjoyed our private space but felt comforted by the fact that Dan and Naz were easily reachable in case of an emergency or request. We loved the fact that there was a Keurig and coffee, fresh linens, towels, other thoughtful touches, and plenty of space to store our belongings! The view was beautiful from the balcony and our pup really enjoyed the baseball field down the street! We highly recommend this apartment to anyone! Just be prepared for stairs and the friendliest neighbors! :)

it was amazing.
the Apartment its really clean and has everything.
nazleen is a friendly and good host.
Nazleen and Daniel’s place was great. Certainly a good value to stay in NYC and very close to the rich offerings of Astoria. Take advantage of the NYC ferry nearby and check out their tips!
Great place to stay has a very incredible view. They are very welcoming and helpful, would total stay there in the future. 5 stars

This is a nice quiet place to stay while visiting NYC! It is a walk up (5 flights of stairs and no elevator available) which was fine for us, but might not be for people who have difficulties with stairs. The studio has lots of amenities which we appreciated. This studio also is in a more suburban area (restaurants/shops not just down from the studio), but the bus system, Citi bikes, Water taxi, or free delivery at most restaurants was sufficient. Overall, a nice Airbnb!
Very accommodating. I would recommend this room and will definitely use it again.

If your in a car especially a rental car it is very difficult to find parking near this place also there are stairs so if you have lots of luggage beware for a trek up several flights of stairs. Neighborhood seemed sketchy, we drove around looking for parking and seen two individuals looking into cars for valuables, didn’t take a chance on parking and got a hotel instead! Best decision for us since we had a rental car.

A very nice and clean place to stay,   with a nice bed and Nazleen was very helpfull and everything workout as was planned. The aparment is close to the river and we recommend using the ferry at least once or twice, what a view:)
Great set up! Especially enjoyed relaxing on rooftop terrace while taking in views of Manhattan! It is a climb (5 floors) to apartment,  but we didn't mind and we knew the rewards of the view :)

As advertised.  My mother and sister stayed there for my wedding  in early October and had a great time.  The garden is beautiful.  The kitchen area is lovely.  Everything was clean.  It is my favorite neighborhood in Brooklyn.  I'm sure my relatives will stay again.  Jay is very helpful.
We had a very pleasant experience at Jay Al's place.  Jay Al was an excellent host and the apartment is as seen in the pictures.  No complaints whatsoever!!!

I loved our stay at Jay's. The setting and beauty of her place was unexpected. The photos don't do the home justice. We were very happy. There was plenty of room to spread out. The little sunroom doubling as a place to snack and make coffee or tea was so cozy.
The neighborhood is beautiful, close to subways, little cafes and restaurants. Fort Greene was made a historical landmark in the late 70s so history is present and thick.
excellent host.  very friendly and prompt communication.  place was  bigger than I thought it would be.  would stay again.

J's property is beautiful. She is a gracious hostess, very thoughtful and welcoming. We had complete privacy in the basement apartment with our own private entrance. The apt is tastefully decorated and clean, the garden is beautiful to wake up to in the morning. The neighborhood is lovely, lots of brunch places within 1 to 2 blocks and an amazing coffee shop 1/2 block away. Fort green park is a short walk, we spent a few hours just roaming around the neighborhood.
I highly recommend this apartment. We had an excellent time!
Loved our stay!
Epic apartment laden with character! Stellar backyard, fantastically located near Fort Greene park! Why would we ever consider a hotel ever again?!
Lovely apartment in a very cute neighborhood. Very comfortable, adorable garden. Slightly longer walk to the subway then I would have liked but easy to get to. Thanks!

We had a fantastic stay in this beautiful garden apartment in a really cool part of Brooklyn. We couldn't fault the apartment or our host and would highly recommend it. A great first air bnb experience!

We've been travelling to NYC/Brooklyn for over 13 years.  We've never had two nights as quiet and peaceful as the two we spent here.  The neighborhood is quiet, yet close to anything one could want in entertainment, food or necessities.  The garden is beautiful (but you do have to be careful as there is some poison iv y growing).  As long as our family lives in the area, we will try again to stay here.

This is a great space-- quiet and private and actually very lovely. We particularly enjoyed being able to go out and sit in the garden when the weather was good-- it's so unusual to have your own private green space in NYC! Also quite convenient to a number of trains, and such an adorable neighborhood.

It was a wonderful place for our holidays. Everything excellent, we felt at home. Exquisite details on decoration and attention. The appartment is private and located in a very nice neighbourhood, near the subway and some good restaurants.
We were received by a very nice and kind woman, who was always available for us, and offered us help, information and advice, very useful to enjoy the amazing New York city. Thank you!!!
A very lovely apartment that suited our needs perfectly! Highly recommended.

Best place in Fort Greene neighborhood, and not just for the money, all around. The location is prime with all the great shops, cafés and restaurants within walking distance (I recommend Dekalb Ave. and Myrtle Ave.) This is one of the nicest and safest neighborhoods in I have stayed in in Brooklyn. Oh, and a cool Farmers Market in the Forte Green park every Sat. Jane was phenomenal. She made early morning accommodations to meet me upon check in and gave a bright eyed and bushy tailed tour of the place. Everything was super nice, loved the decor and it was very very clean...spotless! There is also a private outdoor patio that most people in Brooklyn would kill to have...

We stayed at Jane's place at the end of September and really enjoyed this garden suite. The place was very clean, nicely decorated and spacious, with access to a pretty garden and patio outside. The house is located on a beautiful and quiet street and is close to many great restaurants and shops. Jane was accommodating and responsive to all our requests. The only thing to be mindful of is that the bed is actually a pull out couch. We found it rather comfortable nonetheless.

We had a great stay at this apartment! Everything went very smoothly--we felt bad having been delayed in transit, but Jane met us with the key and explained everything very graciously despite the late hour. It was a nice set-up--a separate ground floor apartment with its own entrance, but the owner lived in the building, so we felt like it was easy to be in touch with her if we needed anything. As it happened, the place was great and we didn't need any help.

The apartment is nicely decorated and very homey. We liked the huge bathroom and the views of the pretty garden. We were nervous about the sofabed, but it turned out to be very comfortable, and we slept very well each night.

Fort Greene is a gorgeous neighborhood full of classic brownstones, and though we'd lived in New York before, exploring this area was a whole new adventure. The park is a short block from the apartment, and it is lovely. We also walked to Brooklyn Flea and many great restaurants in the neighborhood. There is quite a brunch scene around! (Our favorite place we tried may have been Cafe Paulette, with its classic French atmosphere--it is only a few weeks old!) We also walked to Park Slope a few times, another lively neighborhood which is not too far. Just be aware that most metro lines are a 10-15 minute walk--it was totally fine for us, and we spent most of our time in Brooklyn, but just know that getting to Manhattan is not a matter of a few minutes, if that is important to you.

We had a great stay and would highly recommend this apartment! It was comfortable and left us well-positioned to explore one of New York's most charming neighborhoods.

The mini studio was great! It was small and cozy, and there’s street parking available! And not paying for parking in NYC is amazing!! There is also a grocery store across the street which was super convenient!! The view was amazing! And getting to Manhattan was simple and only about 20min!
Thanks for the space and you’re amazing hospitality!

The space was one of the most cleanest AirBnBs we have stayed at! The location is perfect, about 15-20 minutes to the city, and with a beautiful view of the river. The bed was heaven on earth after a long day of walking around in the city. The hosts were extremely accommodating and took time out of their day to provide us with local tips. Check in process was easy and the hosts were easy to reach. Overall, we’d highly recommend their space as it made our first trip to New York a great experience!
Great place for the money

Street parking was often hard to find and ended up getting a parking ticket in one of the locations we parked. So be very careful with where you park. Also the five flights of stairs to get to the apartment were not mentioned in the ad. Could be good to Include for personnel with difficulty getting up stairs.
Super fantastic hosts with a love of the area and tons of knowledge they are willing to share.  Watch their videos!

Nazleen und Daniel haben uns alle unsere vielen Fragen immer geduldig und schnell beantwortet. Als wir etwas wegen geschlossener Läden nicht bekommen konnten, haben Sie uns sehr hilfsbereit mit Allem ausgeholfen.
Die Aussicht auf den East-River ist wirklich toll.
A must stay place. Not far from any location in specific. Easy access to transit to and from the city!!
Ok
place was fantastic. great room with balcony. the ferry is closeby which gets you to Manhattan very easily.
Fantastic location and a really amazing host, I couldn't recommend staying with them more!

Absolutely lovely hosts who definitely go above and beyond the call of duty. The apartment has everything you need and very cosy. The airconditioner works well, but there is no washing machine or stove, but there is a bbq and microwave etc. The apartment was very clean and quiet and it was lovely having a rooftop looking out towards the city. There are only stairs leading up to the apartment but they are worth the climb. The location is 45 mins on either the ferry otherwise bus and train to manhattan. The hosts have provided a refillable public transport card and also a phone with calling and internet credit, however, bring cash for the ferry as it is seperate from the metro card and the ticket machines dont like foreign cards. The area is quite trashy, but in a fun way. Nearby 30th Avenue Astoria is an excellent shopping and dining area. Scalpers at the airport will purchase your metro ticket if it is still valid for a few days. The air train at JFK is also seperate from the metro card and will cost $5.
Likely my favorite stay in NYC this far! The rooftop is definately the icing on the cake too. If this place is avail for even just part of your visit to the city GRAB IT!!... 😁

Nazleen’s place was absolutely wonderful. The view from the rooftop and the balcony was amazing. The room itself has a lot of natural light. Transportation around the area was very convenient. Nazleen and Daniel went above and beyond with the suggestions around the city. Overall, a great experience. Definitely recommend.

Nous avons passé une excellente semaine chez Nazleen et daniel. Le studio sur le toit avec sa terrasse privée (vue sur l'east river et une partie de Manhatan) est un vrai plus pour se détendre après une bonne journée de marche. De plus le ferry tout proche permet de se rendre en différent point de la ville facilement et agréablement. Parfait !

The Best hoster we've ever had!
Nazleen and Daniel have been very kind with us. They answered all our doubts all the time, they leaved us a mobile to use in our stay which save our lives with the transport everyday!! He also leave some Coffee and bath articles. The terrace was Amazing with these views and very clean. The appartment is not in Manhattan but it's well conecte with Times Square!! We totally recomend them!!
A cute and quaint place in Astoria. Naz and Dan are great hosts and provided many local tips and suggestions and even provided a mta card for tourists! Highly recommend staying here.
We had a great time at Dan and Nazs' apartment. They were very nice and always helped whenever we had a problem. Most of the days we took the ferry over to Manhatten and enjoyed the great view.
Really nice accommodation and the hosts are very friendly! Definitely recommend.

Un super appartement avec un rooftop et une vue de folie. Nazleen et daniel sont tres acceuillants et super sympa, l’appartement est tres bien équipé et proche du ferry qui mène a Manhattan. Un séjour de folie :)

The apartment is a bit out of the city but with 18,19 and 102 buses and N or W line underground you can reach the middle of the city within 45-60 minutes. With the lovely terrace the apartment is very good for take a break after a long walk in the city. Locals are very helpful. Apartment is well equipped,bathroom is big enough, bed is a bit soft but comfortable for 2 also. We were absolutely satisfied. PS: the metro card, local mobile and beers in the fridge were more then we expected!Many thanks!

Ming’s place was absolutely wonderful. Clean, aesthetic, well located and well stocked with useful items like tea, soap, etc. The check in process and general communication was very smooth. The internet connection was also very strong and the apartment was quiet at night. Would highly recommend anyone wanting to explore all that Williamsburg has to offer to stay here!

Ming was a wonderful host. He was always available to answer our questions and to help us with our needs.

The apt is in a central part of Williamsburg - very close to the subway, coffee shops, lots of good restaurants, shops and grocery stores. His apartment was clean and a perfect size for a couple.
Perfect stay. Great location. Clean apartment. It’s actually bigger than it looks in photos. Would definitely stay again.

Loved staying here! Super clean apartment, great location, couple bocks from the subway station. It's on a smaller street so more quiet at night which is great for New York City! Ming was very easy and pleasant to communicate with and helped with anything at anytime!
wonderful
Ich war den ganzen Juli 22 bei Ming. Es war grossartig. Das Appartement ist ideal gelegen, ruhig, sehr sauber und sorgfältig eingerichtet. Ich kann es meinen Freunden sehr empfehlen. Marc, Zurich

Ming’s retreat in Williamsburg was a fantastic place for my wife and I to ´feel like a local’ and enjoy the community of Williamsburg and also explore many aspects of New York.
The home had everything we needed such as a comfortable bed, a very quiet location, great amenities for home cooking and was a relaxing place after a day out and about.
It was a short walk to the subway that took us all over New York and we’d also recommend catching the ferry from North Williamsburg over to Wall Street and Manhattan. Ming was the perfect host and was available if we needed anything and it was so nice to arrive and find fresh flowers and cold drinks in the fridge. A great place to stay.
Ming was a great host! You’ll love their place.

Amazing apartment and the location is perfect - right in the heart of Williamsburg and a short walk to the subway station. The apartment itself was great; very clean and had everything we needed for our stay (and more)! Ming was a great host and provided lots of information prior to our stay and was always on hand should we have needed anything. Would thoroughly recommend this apartment to anyone coming to NYC and wanting to stay in Williamsburg!

Mings apartment was amazing. Quiet located but still only a few minutes away from many restaurants and stores. It is also only a 5 minute walk to the L-Train which goes directly to Manhattan.
The apartment was also extremely clean and the kitchen was well equipped. We felt very comfortable. The communication with Ming was also very nice and prompt.
Thank you Ming for a great stay!!

We had an amazing time at Ming’s apartment and would definitely stay there again. The place was spacious, very clean and organised. The kitchen was well equipped. And the location was great. There are lots of nice restaurants and bars around, the street however is very quiet and not noisy at all.

It didn’t bother us, but something to be aware of if you like to sleep in or are a light sleeper is that the heater started to make some noise in the morning starting from 6.30am. We were told about this beforehand though, so it wasn’t unexpected.
Sehr zu empfehlen! Eine ruhige, sehr hübsche Wohnung!
Great neighborhood and very clean space! Thanks Ming!

We had a wonderful time!  The space is private and lovely - the garden gives it an airy, even larger feel. J. was there to greet us, knows the neighborhood and was very accommodating.  We are looking forward to our next visit.
My dad loved the place and will come back.

Airbnb

Fantastic place for enjoying Brooklyn … or even Manhattan since it’s close to transit.

We drove in from Virginia and found parking within a few spots of the door in mid-afternoon. (Left the car parked there the rest of the weekend, but noticed a regular turnover of parking spots.)

Space is tastefully done, quiet … and really spacious. This is not a hotel room or a suite – it’s a full apartment. I enjoyed having coffee in the rocker in the kitchen/sun room every morning. (There’s coffee to be made or you can dash down to the corner and buy two bagels and two coffees for less than $5. We bought.)

The only hitch was the bed, which J. clearly states is a sofa bed. I slept (and napped) like a rock. My wife, who is half my size, complained that she kept rolling into me. Lesson for all of you: Don’t sleep with me.

We sampled the neighborhood restaurants, all very good, and strolled through Fort Greene park people watching New Yorkers being surprisingly normal.

Too cold for garden, but we enjoyed looking out at it. It must be spectacular in the spring.

Never used Airbnb before. We’ll be back. And we'll be back to Perfect for Parents, With Garden.

J. was very accommodating and answered all the questions we had before and during the stay. The room was convenient, clean, and cozy. I booked this room for my parents and they were very comfortable there. Thanks, J.!
Amazing place, really friendly host! Absolutely great place to stay in Ft. Greene, 1 block away from the park.

My kids planned a weekend in Brooklyn in April 2013 to celebrate my 50th birthday My daughter and I stayed here, and loved it so much, we came back again on May 16/17/18, 2014, to visit my son, who lives near by. The apartment is lovely, comfortable, and well furnished. The garden is beautiful and we enjoyed coffee, cocktails, and long conversations there. This neighborhood has great coffee shops and restaurants, and is within walking distance of Fort Greene Park. We especially love the Brooklyn Flea, Cafe Paulette, and Bergen Bagels.

J. is a thoughtful and considerate host. We are already planning another visit for late October.

J.'s Apartment ist ein wunderbarer Rückzugsort nach einem langen Tag in Manhattan. Die ruhige Strasse und der grüne Innenhof wirken nach den hektischen Grosstadteindrücken sehr erholsam. Die nahe gelegene Dekalb Ave bietet eine Vielzahl an guten und abwechselungsreichen Restaurants. Wir haben uns in der geschmackvoll eingerichteten und gemütlichen Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt.

Our stay was outstanding! We loved visiting with our two Brooklyn sons on the back patio among the rhododendrons. The shower was one of the best I've ever had, the bed was comfortable, and morning coffee at the Red Lantern/Bike Shop was just two blocks away.

We stayed here while visiting family in Fort Greene.  Location was perftect - close to the park and restaurants on Dekalb and Lafayette.  The apartment was very large and clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay! J was very easy to work with.

J's home is on a beautiful quiet street in Brooklyn. She was easy to communicate with and completely flexible about check in and check out times. The house is spacious and has everything you need. The back garden is beautiful and a nice change of pace for NYC. We loved staying here and would do it again!

J was a very nasty and negative person. From the first moment we met I felt I had to go out of my way to be nice just to get her to feel more comfortable with me. Her place is nice I will say that but she is the only person I have ever had a problem with in my entire airbnb experience!
Yes i felt welcome and the location is perfect!  The home is gorgeous and well appointed.

This is a very comfortable and quiet apartment in a great Brooklyn location, close to restaurants, bars, coffee, trains, and Fort Greene Park. The owner was very accommodating to our schedule and made sure we had everything we need. The apartment is large, the bed is comfortable, and the garden is private and relaxing. And all on a beautiful tree-lined street. A great choice.
J's place was fantastic!  Cool neighborhood, great apartment.  J was very accommodating on my arrival time.  Thank you!

Super location in pretty neighborhood. The garden provided a quiet retreat. J. was kind enough to rush home to greet us when we arrived earlier than expected. The place and experience were perfect for parents, indeed.

J is a welcoming and gracious host. The accommodations are exactly as described, and actually much better when experienced.  The apartment we had was the bottom floor of an exquisite brownstone, located in the middle of the Fort Greene section of Brooklyn. What we really liked, is the easy access to other parts of New York via the subway.  Easy walking distance to the Q (at DeKalb and Flatbush) which goes right to mid-town; the A&C (at Metro Tech) which goes right up 8th avenue through Times Square; and the G (at various stops) which goes to Queens through the Williamsburg section of Brooklyn.  Plenty of restaurants and coffee nooks for meals and bagels within easy walking distance.  J was easy to communicate with, and went out of her way to help us out when needed it.  This is an A-one stop for a New York visit.

This is a great place to stay! My wife and I stayed here for 2 days, over New Year’s, while visiting friends just a few blocks away. We drove in and there was plenty of free on-street parking. We arrived early and found a great place to have a cup of tea and a bit to eat before our host arrived, exactly when she said she would (J was very easy to coordinate with).

The place is beautiful – just like in the pictures. The bed is quite comfortable. As an insomniac, I was worried about the sofa bed, but I had no trouble sleeping. The kitchen was perfect for what we needed (microwave, sink, coffee pot) – just keep in mind there is no oven or stove top.

The neighborhood is fantastic, with plenty of shops and restaurants within easy walking distance. I wish we were there in warmer weather to enjoy the garden.

My wife and I highly recommend this place!

I had a wonderful stay at Alex's appartment. The location is perfect just one block from Central Park in a quiet tree lined street. There are plenty of shops and cafes within a block so you can pick up anything you need very easily.

The subway is also one block away and gets you straight into the heart of the city, shops, cafes, tourist sites.I would recommend walking though via Central Park.

If you are a museum fan then all the museums are in this area. So you are within walking distance from the Natural Museum for instance.

The appt itself is very quiet, no noisy neighbours. I slept well every day of my 14 day stay. The room is a Zen heaven and is decoured as a place of quiet reflection. After a day in the active streets of Manhattan it was nice to return to the quiet of the room too. Wifi is available and very good speed. There is a kitchenette for doing some of your own cooking. Shower is brilliant I have to say.

Alex was a truly helpful host and provided details of all the local amenities from cafes to tourist sites. She kept in touch to make sure all was going well through out my stay.

I will be visiting New York again soon and will definately be looking to stay at the Zen studio

Alex is wonderful human being and also a great host.
The apartment is very conveniently located for people who enjoy the proximity to Cenrtal Park and also close to public transport.

The apartment was immaculate and had everything I needed for my week's stay.  The location was awesome.  Only 1 1/2 blocks from Central Park and 2 blocks from the subway.  Great restaurants and shops, all within walking distance.  Excellent stay and I would stay there again the next time I'm in New York.

I stayed in the apartment for 5 nights during the first week of November 2011.

I really liked the fact that the apartment was immaculately clean (!), bright and calm. It is located in a great neighborhood in which you can find any shop you need within 2 blocks away.

With several subways also within 2 blocks it is perfect to visit New York City. Central park is also very close and beautiful!

87th street is quite calm so I found the neighborhood safe, also very late at night.

Host Alex provided enough tips for dinner, coffee and overall visits for 3 weeks instead of one!

Great experience, host & apartment!

Alex is a fantastic host. From day one she was timely and prompt with her communication with me and always approachable.
She is also incredibly helpful and willing to assist - she provided to me a lot of information and tips about the apartment, the neighbourhood and also New York City which was very handy.
The apartment itself is great - absolutely immaculate, comfortable and also quiet. It is located in a nice neighbourhood, conveniently close to public transport and other amenities.
It was always good to return to the apartment after a long day of being a tourist. I would definitely stay again.

The best way to sum up my experience at Alex's apartment is to say that all future trips to NYC will be planned around whether or not her place is available.

From the very first moment I contacted Alex, she was wonderful. Communicative, prompt, flexible, and a pleasure to rent from. My trip was very last minute, but she made sure everything was perfect and when I arrived at her apartment I couldn't have been happier. It was gorgeous, peaceful, very clean, and just like the photos. And the location? Amazing. Just a few blocks from multiple subway lines, Central Park, the Natural History Museum, and tons of great restaurants, bars, and cafes. I'm originally from NYC and I'm quite picky on location, but her place on the Upper West Side was a great homebase for my week-long stay.

Other than providing such a wonderful apartment, Alex also went above and beyond - calling to check on me when NYC wound up getting a freak mini blizzard during my stay and urging me to borrow her winter boots. Thanks for saving my feet, Alex!

Alex's studio was absolutely wonderful for our week and a half visit to NYC. From beginning to end, Alex was an absolute joy to deal with. She was extremely responsive and willing to help us work out the details of our stay. She even happily returned my coat by mail after I left it.

Her place is in a great location for museum visits, and generally for experiencing the Upper West Side like a local. The place has easy access to both the red and blue subway lines you can get almost anywhere with a single transfer at most. The neighborhood is very safe and there is a reasonable selections of shops, delis, restaurants, etc within a few blocks.

The apartment was immaculately clean and thoughtfully decorated and laid out. The only thing I wish I knew going beforehand was that it is a 3rd floor walk-up. It would not have changed my decision to rent this place, but I would have brought less luggage!

Thanks Alex for creating a beautiful and relaxing space in the midst of hectic Manhattan.

This apartment is a quiet oasis in this exciting city. You can never expect a better location: upper west side, quiet street, 1 or 2 blocks walk to central park and subways, many great restaurants and organic food markets. The apartment is very well-designed and extremely clean. The bed is large and VERY comfortable. What make this apartment more fantastic is the host. Alex is one of the most warm hearted person I've ever seen. Whether you've been to NYC before, Alex will take care of you from beginning to the end. Living there is a unique experience for us. It's feels like our home in this city.
Thank you very much for your room ! It's a great place to stay and you are very welcoming !

Nazleen's spot is very well kept. Clean and accurately depicted. We loved the rooftop views and how close it was to all the fun places in Astoria. The host was gracious enough to allow us a later checkout time. 10/10 would recommend.
Great view from balcony of east river. Convenient to ferry dock

The place is tidy and stylish with great location.
Naz and Daniel are amazing hosts and really made sure that our stay in New York was awesome!
Thank you once more :)
Gorgeus place with even better service .. Thanks guys fór everything... Can just recomended..

Wow! Nazleen is such a great host! Her and Daniel provide high quality information on places to visit and eat at while staying in the city. Their friendliness shines throughout the whole stay!

We had a late flight the last day of our stay, and it was of course the only day during our trip that it rained. We contacted Naz about a late checkout and she was totally understanding and accommodating. Definitely would be happy to stay here again!

Nazleen's place is a great place to stay! The self check-in is really convenient and the location is great for going into the city. The bus is only 100 feet from the door, you can see the river from the terrace, and the apartment is clean and comfortable:) I very much recommend staying there if you are looking for a trip to New York City:)
Wonderful view, place is homey!

Nazleen has been one of the best, if not the best host I’ve came across. Her place has an amazing view and is close to everything. She really goes far and beyond to make you feel comfortable and welcomed! I highly recommend booking with her.

Great room with a private rooftop patio. Great view of Manhattan. Ferry is a convenient way to get to Manhattan. Ferry is a five min walk from apt. Clean, quiet with lots of special touches. I highly recommend!
Pictures were FALSE.
I love everything about this experience I know you will enjoy yourself as well

Nazleen & Daniel was the best hosts I have ever met, they are so thoughtful to put a metro card to help people get around & they place is soooo beautiful & clean. At night time is the best because they beautiful rooftop have lights & at night when it’s lit up the view is magnificent👌🏼👌🏼👌🏼, y’all would not regret one moment or dollar.
Great place. Great balconies. Very accommodating hosts and easy to get into.

Daniel was a really helpful and nice host. There was a storm while I was staying. He came to check the flooding and asked me if I was ok at late night, very responsible host. I will definitely recommend to my friends.
Was a great stay, beautiful view. Nazleen was a great host. Eager to answer your questions and help.
Thanks! Enjoyed my stay

Great place!
Great view!
Nice and quiet place, easy bus access, and you have a supermarket in front of the house.
Definitively ill be back!

Logement sans ascenseur au dernier étage  avec terrasse privée et balcon privé, sans cuisine mais avec un micro-onde et un petit frigidaire, le logement est situé à 20 minutes à pied du métro et à 5 minutes à pied du ferry qui va jusqu'à Wall Street, le quartier n'est pas forcément génial comparé au reste de New York, mais il y a tout de même un supermarché juste en bas du logement, les hôtes sont très gentils et réactifs en cas de soucis. Seul bémol, la propreté n'était pas au top du top, mais était OK dans la globalité.
great place, good location, excellent host!!!
Very cozy! Nazleen was very sweet & attentive ❤️🙏🏽 Thank you so much Nazleen

Beautiful studio in a great location. The studio is larger than in photos, clean and had everything we needed. Nazleen and Daniel are amazing hosts and made our stay extra special. Nazleen is a great communicator, kind and flexible. Would 100% recommend this place and Nazleen as a host. It was so easy to reach Manhattan and other places we wanted to see.

Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen. Als besonders hilfreich haben wir das Smartphone empfunden, welches wir jeden Tag mitgenommen haben und das uns mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln durch New York navigiert hat.
Die Dachterasse der Unterkunft ist ein Traum und lädt zu gemütlichen Abendstunden mit Blick auf die Skyline ein. Nazleen war sehr hilfsbereit und immer erreichbar. Wir würden definitiv wieder kommen.

Super petit appartement avec un gros point bonus pour sa terrasse et la vue qui va avec.
L’appartement est un peu excentré mais avec le ferry cela se fait relativement bien !
L’appartement est fonctionnel.
L’entrée et la sortie de l’appartement se fait facilement !

Our host was on site when we arrived and showed us around the apartment, pointing out specific things that would be good to know during our stay. The apartment was nicely decorated and had everything we needed. The location was terrific, right near our son and daughter-in-law, who live in Fort Greene. We were able to walk easily to their apartment, to BAM, Prospect Park, and Pratt Institute.
We really enjoyed our stay and hope to come again.
Great place! Warm and spacious for Brooklyn - has nice garden out back. Good location near the park and not too far from subways. Really enjoyed staying here and my father liked it as well.

J was very accommodating for my mom's recent stay in Brooklyn. The apartment was exactly as described: a very well kept, beautifully decorated and clean apartment in a lovely brownstone with a backyard garden. We especially enjoyed the location - right around the corner from Fort Greene Park and walking distance to a wide variety of restaurants, cafes, and, if you're around on a Saturday, the farmers market and Brooklyn Flea Market. Thanks J!

Lovely garden apartment in great location in Fort Greene, Brooklyn. Clean and spacious! The bed was a pull-out couch but very comfortable. Towels were fluffy, shower pressure was super strong, bathroom was spotless; bring your own shampoo. I'm already booked for my next business trip to NYC!

This space is not only perfect for parents but for anyone wishing to stay in Brooklyn. We were warmly welcomed by J., the host. This home is a carefully restored Civil War era Victorian Brownstone. It is worth a visit to enjoy the interior. We stayed in the bottom level which has three rooms including the bedroom There is a kitchen area with windows that look out on a private garden.

The location is convenient with easy access to local restaurants, markets, and the subway. We found our visit was enhanced as we were able to experience some of the local Brooklyn culture. It is within easy walking distance of Pratt Institute.

perfect place near to the park and restaurant
Nice and patient owener
Clean and spacious in a great area. There is now a real queen bed rather than a pull out, which is great.

J was very welcoming and helpful.
Communication was great.

The apartment is in a perfect location - there are some amazing restaurants and bars around and it's close to the park and subway.
The apartment is quiet and peaceful.

All in all an wonderful stay.
Thanks!
Great location!

Nice location on a quiet street. Apartment is located on the bottom floor of a charming brownstone with access to a nice garden in the back.

The set up is a bit different than the pictures (bedroom is where the living room is pictured and living room is where the bedroom is pictured) but that does not affect the quality of the stay in fact enhances it as the room in the front can be darker for better sleep in spite of being on the street side. There is a real bed (not sofabed). Very nice and modern bathroom adjacent to the bedroom.

Kitchen facilities were perfect for us; small refrigerator, microwave, sink and coffee maker. Guests should be more mindful of future guests by leaving clean cups and silverware (we found coffee cups put back like they were clean but were not - the host should not have to inspect every cup, plate and piece of silverware on departure of every guest).

Wifi worked very well for us and there were lots of channels available on the tv.

Several Metro stops close by; getting into the city center is very easy. Nice diverse neighborhood where we felt quite safe walking home later in the evenings.

Host is very accessible if you need her and kindly offered the use of laundry facilities when requested.

We found several excellent restaurants within walking distance of the apartment and lucked out on arrival to find a parking spot right out front.

This was our first Airbnb experience; we would recommend staying here and hope to visit again.

We enjoyed staying in this comfortable, spacious, clean unit. J. was entirely accommodating, and it was fun to be walking in the neighborhood and see our host out and about too. This is a great location, super close to Fort Greene Park, but also within walking distance of the Brooklyn Navy Yard (interesting guided tours) and just a bit farther, Brooklyn Bridge Park (fantastic views, great public spaces). Downtown Brooklyn and the subway are not far. There are plenty of interesting restaurants close by. Hope to visit again!

J. was great! She was super accommodating and flexible as I had some communication problems with my parents at first. Her place was absolutely perfect for my parents. The location doesn't get much better for Ft. Greene and my mom is already talking about how she wants to come back. I highly recommend staying here.
I had a great time with nice host and cozy house and town.
The place was cute.  I wish I had more time to spend in the apartment itself. It was a great place for what I needed. The shower was awesome.

My mother and I had a lovely stay. J. met me when I arrived and gave me a tour and orientation of the apartment. Everything was as described - no surprises. It was tastefully decorated and well-maintained. The neighborhood is great - centrally located with lots of restaurants, coffee shops, and grocery stores, and Fort Greene park is a block away. We would definitely stay here again.

This was a beautiful, spacious place in a very nice neighborhood.  J. has decorated this so well and created a space that seems homey without being too obviously someone else's actual living space. Because she lives upstairs, you are not dealing with someone else's clothes and toiletries which often seems too intimate and invasive.  We did not need her help for anything since our son lives in the neighborhood but she seemed like she would be available if we had. We did not use the outdoor space but it looked lovely.  We would definitely stay here again.

Perfect for Us! We have stayed in "Perfect for Parents", private upper floor, as well as "Perfect for Grandparents", private entrance garden apartment. Both accommodations are architecturally pleasing, quiet, with comfortable bed(s), while providing all the amenities (restaurants, farmer's market, neighborhood parking, access to subway) of Fort Greene area.
J. was very accommodating and helpful during our stays! Whenever we go to Brooklyn we keep our fingers crossed that "Perfect for Parents" or "Perfect for Grandparents" will be available! Just stay here!
This is the best Airbnb I've had in Brooklyn. Great location. Great shower!

J contacted me with key and entry info...and the process was simple and easy. She makes it hassle free to stay there. The space was very open and felt like a home away from home. I maintained contact by email and when I returned "home" each night, she had fulfilled mu requests. The apartment is very quiet and in a good neighborhood...near restaurants, a great farmer's market and...near my son and his family.
Clean, pleasant, and very spacious for the neighborhood.

This was a terrific place to stay. The apartment was large and very comfortable and very clean The host was kind enough to let us leave our luggage late into the afternoon of our departure day. We liked the neighborhood. It is quiet residential. We would go there again.

An excellent place to stay! The apartment is very spacious and comfortable. The street is quiet and pretty, and walking distance to many great restaurants. The host was very accommodating with check in and check out, and showed us around the apartment when we arrived. Highly recommend!

This is the second time that I've stayed here and everything was as smooth and professional as the first time. The location is great with lots of restaurants and coffee shops nearby. The home is very comfortable too.

We loved the neighborhood.  We have traveled many times to Brooklyn and this is one of our favorite neighborhoods to stay in.  The apartment was convenient to many of the restaurants we like and also to our son's apartment.  It was very quiet at night and we loved that.  The apartment was comfortable and nicely decorated.  We would definitely recommend this apartment to others.
Great place, great view, great hosts!

Convenient location with lots of great venues nearby. Cozy little studio great for a couple on a short retreat. Nazleen extended our check-out time by 5 hours since we both work nights and sleep later, and we were super grateful for that!

It is a nice place to stay in order to visit the city. Traveling on the ferry proved to be fantastic! But the bus leaves you on the doorstep so some nights we prefered to travel back using the subway and teh bus. The place is clean and well mantained. I would suggest getting rid of the desk and giving that space for the kitchenette.

Eine sehr gute Unterkunft mit wunderschöner Aussicht. Die Dachterrasse macht sehr viel her und bietet einen tollen Blick auf upper Manhattan und die Skyline von Midtown Manhatten. Der Bus hält direkt vor der Tür und die Fähre nach Lower Manhatten ist 5 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt.
Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft.

We with my husband spent fantastic 5 days in these apartment.From the 1st letter till the last moment Alex was the greatest host ever!We were so happy to live in her apartment.She gave us great advices about area and during our trip was very helpful.The apartmet is like u see on photo-very clean,bright and sunny.There is everything you need-clean bathrom,wi-fi ,great area,super atmosphere in place,kitchen-if you want to cook smth-(but we didnt use it-there are plenty of cosy places around)the area is fantastic-7 minutes walk to National museum,5 minutes to Central park,very calm area with lots of restaurants and cafes.The subway is 7-10 minutes walk.Great place to stay in NY and to live.We definetely recoomend this place to all our good friends.After noisy day in NY coming back and spend evening in cafe near these apartments is a great pleasure.We were lucky that alex let us stay in her apartment and we will always have only best memories about  her hospitality and kindness.We will miss this place and for sure come back and stay there.

Despite the absence of Alex, everything was perfectly organized for our arrival.
(someone was there to greet us very detailed explanatory note on the apartment and the area, water bottle and breakfast provided).

The apartment is very clean, very comfortable, very functional, very well heated and very zen. Practical bathroom (towels, shower gel and soap provided).

We highly recommend it.

The apartment is close to metro lines 1, 2, 3 (about 5 minutes) and lines B, C, (about 8 minutes).

The neighborhood is very quiet and close to Central Park.

I stayed in Alex's apartment for 8 nights in the week between April and May 2014. The place is exactly like portrayed in the pictures and in her description, perfectly clean, warm and quiet. The location is ideal for visiting Manhattan, the red and blue/orange subway lines and a bus that brings you to the other side of Central Park are 5-7 minutes away: you can get anywhere in the heart of Manhattan in 20-25 minutes, at most. The possibility of being in the middle of Central Park in 5 minutes and enjoying a walk in the sun is priceless too.
But what really stands out about Alex and her place is that, from the moment you step in, you will feel her CARE for...everything: all the little details will make you feel like a respected host and will help you feel like respecting her hospitality.
If anybody will ever ask me for an advice of where to stay in NY, I will tell them to make sure to check if Alex's place is available!
J. was a wonderful host, our every need was taken care of.

J.was welcoming and very helpful with information about the neighborhood and how to make our way around the city. Our spacious rooms were in a beautiful art filled brownstone on a quiet street in a charming neighborhood. Parking was easy and there were excellent restaurants within walking distance. The beds were comfortable and the large garden area in the back was a great place to sit and relax in the afternoon. We look forward to returning.
J. was a great host. Checking in and out was a breeze, and any questions we had were answered quickly. The pictures are accurate, and the place was beautiful, clean and comfortable during our stay.

Comfortable and convenient!  We really enjoyed the neighborhood, the comfortable bed, and the interesting décor and art.  It was rainy during our visit so we didn't go into the garden much but we were still able to enjoy it from the large kitchen windows.
Nice place, great location, responsive and helpful host.
Fantastic apartment in a wonderful and quiet neighborhood. Very relaxing, but still easy access to Manhattan
Great space, amazing location, and a beautiful garden. I would definitely stay there again. Though I never met J, she made sure that we had everything that we needed to be comfortable.  A great find!

The neighborhood is vibrant and a little funky. It was Afro-punk weekend, which contributed.
Our host was available and willing to chat, and "stoop-sit."
It's a very nice apartment and garden, very comfortable.
J was very helpful and accommodating. Her place was comfortable, clean, and in a beautiful neighbourhood. Would definitely come back.

J was a perfect host - she let me in and gave me all information I needed without prompting. Communication was great and the place is lovely - beautiful old brownstone with plenty of space and great interior decoration.

Thanks for having me and hope I can stay with you again!

J was not able to meet me when I arrived at her lovely apartment, but she made good arrangements for me to get the key. I met J that evening and was very helpful getting me settled.
The apartment is big and very comfortable.
The kitchen was my favorite room.
I would stay here again.
J's place is fantastic! Great location. Comfortably appointed with everything we needed. Very quiet street in lovely neighbourhood. An easy 10 minute walk to the train to get into Manhattan.

This was our first stay with Airbnb and it set the bar pretty high. We were given a tour upon arrival to make us aware of all the amenities. The accommodations were warm and inviting, the mini fridge came in quite handy, and the shower was excellent. The television was big and cable was provided, but we were too busy with our trip to need this feature. Although the weather was quite gloomy, the outside garden area looked very welcoming. The bed was on the firmer side for my tastes, but my husband had no issue with it.

Jane was super accommodating. She met us later in the evening when we were able to arrive and she was so incredibly sweet and caring with my kids. This place is really perfect for parents though and I would definitely book it again.
My family was so very pleased with this beautiful apartment. Communication was great, home was spotless, amazing location. We would absolutely recommend it!

J's place is just as described. A lovely and spacious garden apartment in an excellent neighborhood. It was very comfortable for my parents' stay. Even though it does not come with a full kitchen, which we knew - J offered them to use the kitchen upstairs. J responded quickly and answered all our questions and was flexible in our arrival time. I will plan on requesting her place on subsequent visits and would recommend it to anyone.
"Perfect For Your Parents", yes!
Charming and spacious place that was perfect for my mother-in-law. Brooklyn garden unit in an authentic beautiful brownstone. Host was accommodating and communicative. Will book here again!

Nous avons passé un super séjour dans cet appartement.
L'accueil d'Alex était parfait, très chaleureuse et soucieuse que notre séjour chez elle se passe bien. Elle nous a laissé plein d'informations pratiques sur New York et ce qu'on pouvait trouver autours de chez elle. Elle a pris soin de nous demander en milieu de séjour si tout se passait bien et qu'elle restait disponible si on avait des questions.
En ce qui concerne l'appartement, il est idéalement situé, entre deux lignes de métro qui distribuent très bien Manhattan, tout proche de Central Park, très calme et c'est un luxe à New York! Bref si je devais retourner à New York il est certain que je demanderai a nouveau ce logement!

Alex was an excellent host, and I couldn't have been happier with my stay. The apartment is beautiful, airy, and quiet. I loved how it was decorated, and it was a welcome retreat at the end of the day. I was thrilled with the location, which was about a block and a half from Central Park, and a block and a half from three different subway lines. I even found it an easy walk to the Upper East Side through the park.
The apartment was clean, and the bed and bedding were very comfortable. Alex is a friendly and prompt communicator, and she even left me a list of nearby amenities (groceries, laundries, coffee shops, even sushi) that was very helpful. Would definitely stay here again!
The reservation was canceled 17 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

We had an excellent stay at the Zen Studio. Alex was a wonderful host from start to finish. She had very good communication and had quick responses.
