After a long day out and about, it was very nice to come back to the very comfortable apartment. It is in an excellent location with a short 1-2 block walks to two metro stations and conveniently located near great places to eat. The proximity to Central Park is also a highlight, as we were able to do several morning trips here. I would definitely love to stay here again on a future trip to NYC.

Alex's home is a wonderful oasis of calm in the centre of Manhattan that we felt so lucky to have found.  Alex also made us so welcome - was in touch early on to help organise our trip and checked in to make sure we were fine.  We could not have been made more welcome - amazing list of top tips for the area from local cafes, culture, museums.... lovely comfortable bed, fluffy towels. Gorgeous area - 2 mins from the park, 2 mins from great restaurants, lovely vibe.  Thanks for having us!

My stay at Alex's cozy and lovely apartment was perfect! The location, quiet neighborhood, convenient transportation and many many things made my NYC experience unforgettable. I never got the chance to meet Alex in person but she is very helpful and response quickly! Will definitely recommend her apartment to my friends!

Alex's house was lovely, just as described and shown. The neighborhood was nice and the very short walks to the subway lines was a huge perk. Alex herself was great and made me feel welcome. I would recommend her apartment highly, especially if you want / need to be on the Upper West Side, or, like me, needed a fast route to Columbia.

Alex was a wonderful host - so helpful, communicative, and generous in her time and effort helping us to settle in and enjoy our stay. Her apartment was in a lovely, quiet street, and was a brilliant place for some much-needed rest and relaxation after exploring the big city. The apartment was clean, bright and had everything we needed, and was only a street away from the nearest subway stop as well as Central Park. Would definitely stay here again!
A lovely place to enjoy New York life; Quiet apartment for writing and study; close to Central Park and several supermarkets, and most importantly, super nice host!

I love Astoria so enjoyed the area. We checked in around noon and we’re shocked to see we had 10 flights of stairs with lots of luggage to walk up. It says an apartment number and when we got to the apartment we couldn’t get in. Entrance is through the rooftop. Great room. We had some issues with the room being pretty dirty when we arrived but told host and they had it cleaned while we were out exploring the next day! Overall good stay for us since the city was a stopping point on our 9 day trip!
Nazleen was a great host. Communication was quick. They've sent us really helpful info on how to arrive to the apartment. Extras, like free phone with data, were really helpful.
The best choise ever! Highly recommend, the balcony view is amazing, and inside vibe is so cozy and calm

Instructions for check in were very detailed which made it easy and smooth. The view is really nice, you get somewhat of a waterfront view and the roof patio is completely private and comfortable. The bed was very comfortable, my friend and I slept very soundly. The A/C was a bit loud but it didnt bother us as we slept it was more of a white noise and it worked very well at cooling the place down. Nazleen was very easy to talk to and made sure everything was comfortable for us. Its very transport accessible, literally 30 seconds from the door. The only thing is it's a bit small for three people, luckily one of my friends couldn't come so it was just the two of us, but it would feel a bit cramped for three people unless you spent most of your day outside and just slept in the accomodation.

Thank you very much for everything. Location was super nice - walking distance to ferry was perfect for us. Arrival information was helpful. We totally fell in love with Greek’s part of Astoria - we recommend to try local restaurants (for example Akrotiri was super nice).
Nice place in a good location. A really good deal to enjoy NYC.
Very comfortable studio, location was great for us - we took the NYC Ferry from the nearby stop (only 5 min walk) to travel around. Nazleen was a great host, very easy to communicate with.

Die Wohnung erfüllt ihren Zweck und die Gastgeber schaffen die besten Voraussetzungen für eine angenehme Ankunft (Metro Card, Handy mit Datentarif). Das Apartment ist zwar nicht super optimal gelegen, wird aber so bereits im Inserat kommuniziert und schlägt sich entsprechend auch im Preis nieder. Trotzdem kommt man in 30-45 Minuten so gut wie überall in Manhattan hin. Wer eine günstige Wohnung in New York und hilfsbereite Gastgeber sucht, ist hier richtig.
Hermoso departamento! Con una vista increíble y en un barrio muy tranquilo. De muy fácil acceso a Manhattan. Nazleen es una excelente anfitriona! Si vuelvo a viajar allí, volvería a su departamento!

Nazleen’s space was clean and comfortable. It was the perfect sized studio for two people, very private, with an easy commute to Manhattan using the ferry. The walk to the ferry took only about five minutes, and wr were able to keep our car parked right across the street from the building, in the same spot for the entire weekend. Nazleen was very responsive and answered all of our questions. The view from the balcony was beautiful. We will definitely be back!

Very nice stay! The apartment is close to NYC Ferry where you can get to Manhattan within 15 minutes! There is a market on the same street and a bus stop close by. The quarter is quiet and you just need to count with the fact that in the night it can take about an hour to get back from downtown Manhattan for example (but the ferry ride is nice and comfy). Amazing view from the terrace is worth all this though :)

My partner and I stayed at Nazleen's place for 7 nights. Nazleen communicated well and checking in was very easy. The location itself for the price is good but definitely easier to use the NYC ferry to get to Manhattan which is a short 5 minute walk away. When entering the building it was not very well maintained and there were four flights of stairs. The entrance to the flat is on the roof terrace and the landing was nicely decorated but when you go outside it was not well maintained with broken glass etc. The view however from the terrance was beautiful. The flat is a good size for two people and we were out most of the time which helped. There is a mobile you can use with data which was super helpful to get around the city. Overall the flat was well equipped but unfortunately not as clean as we would have expected. We did not raise this with Nazleen as did not want anyone to access the flat whilst we were out. Nazleen also allowed us to checkout later which was very helpful.
Fantastic Host! Great Location! Highly recommend this spot! Epic View of the City!
Great place to stay, thank you Nazleen!

Our accommodations were on a quiet street in Ft Greene, handy to the Ft Greene Park, restaurants, cafes, and shops. Our rooms were large and elegantly furnished; the kitchen small but perfectly functional; and the garden peaceful and calm. For a couple this is a great place to stay for weeks on end; but if others are with you sleeping on the fold out couch in the other room, it is a bit awkward as the shared bath is off the master bedroom.
This is a lovely, stately, comfortable place to retreat to whilst in NYC. Highly recommended.

Had a wonderful time a J's place. Very spacious, amazingly comfortable bed, and she everything we needed. Safe, quiet neighborhood, amazing location. Great restaurants and coffee nearby. Also would be great for anyone who can't handle many stairs-- it's garden level, so it's two steps down and that's it. Definitely would stay there again.

We have stayed here three  times, for a week each time. It is everything you could ask for in a getaway. It is homey, very spacious and beautifully decorated. The kitchen is on the opposite end of the space so you don't have to creep around in the morning if someone is sleeping. And you couldn't ask for a nicer host. The neighborhood is lovely, interesting and people are very friendly. You can easily walk to the Brooklyn Academy of Music in ten minutes, where we saw three first run movies. There are plenty of bars and restaurants and you are close to Fort Greene Park and public transport. You won't be disappointed!
This is our second time staying with J and, as seems to be a theme, everything was perfect.

Jane has decorated this Brooklyn garden apartment in a way that synced with our own eclectic tastes in detail. The location was perfect for our needs when visiting a nearby friend it gave us our own space.

I cannot recommend this apartment enough. Beautiful, clean, excellent location and excellent host. What more could you ask for? J. was incredibly accommodating of our needs and did everything she could to make sure our stay was lovely. Would absolutely stay again in the future.

We enjoyed the proximity to several subway stops.   We were within 30 minutes combined walking and riding time on the subway to anyplace in manhattan.  J's place is close to good stores, drug stores, a nice wine shop and good restaurants. The place is exactly as pictured.  We really liked the historical brownstone building.  We felt safe.  J was very responsive and helpful.
Excellent apartment.  Great location.  The outdoor garden was beautiful.  The host was very nice and helpful.

We used to live in the neighborhood and wanted to stay there during our most recent visit. All the reviews were great, so we booked. When we had a few questions, communication was easy and J. was helpful.
The place was clean and comfortable and more beautiful than the photos, as good as they were, depicted.
We'll look into this again next time we visit.
A very comfortable stay, close by to wonderful restaurants and transportation and located on a beautiful tree lined street. We would definitely stay there again when visiting family in Brooklyn.
we really like the Fort Greene area of Brooklyn and we really liked this particular airbnb  - delightful place, slept well

Lovely apartment. Would definetly recommend. It doesn't have a full kitchen but all the amenities of a hotel room plus charm and a garden.
Was perfect for our brief trip!
Thanks J!

Definitely perfect for parents.  Garden level with pretty garden.  No stairs to climb.   Very roomie ....large bedroom with bath,  large living room but small kitchen with microwave and refrigerator only.    Clean and J was always right there if anything was needed.  We would definitely return.  It was perfect for us as it was only down the block from our daughter's place .   Hairdryer included .   Felt very safe in neighborhood and great eateries .   Love Brooklyn !

J was a fantastic host, the apartment is beautiful and the location in Brooklyn is  great with lots of restaurants and cafes within walking distance.  We spent 10 days there and enjoyed our time a lot

We loved this space. The apartment was comfortable, welcoming and spacious. The garden was a lovely space to have tea and read in the morning. So may little thoughtful touches made us feel very welcomed. J was very communicative and helpful. We HIGHLY recommend this lovely AirBnB!
Wonderful stay, lovely garden and convenient to everything! We will return!

Had a great stay. I booked this airbnb for my mother and myself. J generously made the pull out couch bed for me. The kitchen nook was a great place to have coffee in the morning. I love fort greene so i thought this was a great location.

Keith's appartment is really a very nice one.
First it is really spacious.
A big kitchen, a nice master bedroom and a very nice living room with a huge and confortable couch and a huge flat screen.
The extra bedroom is on the small side and is not very adapted for an adult. Would be perfect for children.
The bathroom is clean and has natural light.
The neighborhood is very convenient: a ton of convenience stores nearby, one or two grocery stores within 10 minutes walk, a lot of restaurants within 5 minutes walk;
Central Park is just a 10 minutes walk and Times square is a 15 minutes subway ride (line 2 or 3 at 125st st and Lenox).
We had a very nice stay, and Keith is a wonderful person (several of his books are on display in the living room with some other trophies).
Keith's apartment was ideal- roomy, attractive, clean and very close to public transportation and neighborhood restaurants, and he was very easy to coordinate with. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
The apartment was perfect! Very nice accommodations, everything I could need. Keith is great host!

From the start of the process, Keith was fantastic. All of my questions were answered promptly, and made me feel comfortable about the new process for me. Even when I had an issue with paypal Keith was really understanding.

When I arrived in New York I rang Keith up and he was at the appartment to hand over the keys and he even bought us some juice and fruit. A really nice touch which wasnt expeced at all.

The appartment is fantastic with many odes to Keith's interesting life. It was a pleasure staying there and would definitely go back if in New York again. It was a little further away from downtown than I expected, but only a few minutes walk away from central park, and the apollo theatre is just a couple of blocks away. Subway links are really good to almost all of New York from the 125th St stations which are really close by as well.

I would strongly recommend this appartment to anyone who was looking for a place to stay in Manhattan.

Keith was great. His apartment was fab and Harlem is a great place to stay in New York.

Thanks for everything Keith!

Our stay at Keith's apartment was GREAT!!! He was there to meet us as we arrived, showed us around the apartment and made sure we had everything we needed. He left excellent house guidelines and things to do around the area and transportation directions. The day we left he was there to make sure our stay was good. I would be sure to stay at Keith's apartment again on my next visit to NYC. He is an EXCELLENT host!

Keith's place was fantastic!

Communication: Keith is so easy to keep in contact with. He was quick to respond on air bnb and off. He never left me in limbo and was uber helpful with anything we needed.

Access to public transport: It's the perfect location for anywhere you want to go in NY. You're only a 5 minute walk from the 2 & 3 express trains (which take you to manhattan in less than 20) and a 10-15 minute walk from the 6 which takes your to the Bronx in about 25 mins.

Neighborhood: Great neighborhood! I felt safe 100% of the time. The apartment is close to great restaurants, pharmacies and markets. There's also a Marshall's and H&M 10 minutes away.

Apartment Itself: Keith's apartment was clean and had all the amenities we needed during our trip, including internet. It's comfy, the decor is great and Keith has a wonderful library.

Overall: I'm telling all of my friends who are going to New York to stay at Keith's. I'm definitely staying there again if it's available for my next trip.

Keith's apartment really made our stay in NYC wonderful!  It is more beautiful and interesting than the pictures can portray.  Keith was the perfect host - he met us at the designated time, showed us everything about the apartment and shared great information about the neighborhood.  He even left us some food in the refrigerator and snacks to get us started - what a lovely surprise! Keith is a very friendly person - we enjoyed meeting him very much!  The apartment is in a perfect location - the neighborhood itself was great and it is just a few blocks from the subway to Downtown and a few blocks to Central Park.  We hope Keith's apartment is available for our next trip to NYC!

In the beginning of November we arrived to New York City for our first time and stayed at the Keith's apartment for three nights. Unfortunately we did not meet Keith, as he was out of the city, but as per our communication he is a very nice and responsive host.
It was very easy to find the place, as Keith gave us the full description. Also he left us a detailed house manual and a note with advices on NY places (restaurants and cafe) which was really helpful. so we did not have any problems with operating any stuff in the apartment, Keith even left us the keys to his bycicle that could be used during our stay.
The apartment is located very close to the subway station and some blocks to the north side of the Central park. The surrounding area is quite and noiseless, nothing disturbed us from the outside. So we hade a good time at this nice apartment.

Michael is the man! Funny, smart and brilliant. His place is awesome, in a cool neighborhood and easy to get around Brooklyn or to Manhattan.

Thanks again for restoring my faith in New Yorkers!
Great Apartment, huge room, lots of privacy. Michael was very helpful and sincerely kind.
Great and clean appartement, great neighborhood. Michael is a great host. Zero complains.

Michael has a gret apaetment, well kept, clean and with amazing view. Michael is a great host, very freindly and warm. we loved stying in his apartment. the room is very comftable and full of sun light.
we loved spending time in the apt. and with Michael, and we enjoyed staying there. Naturally we highly recommend staying at his place.

Michael was an awesome host and the room was the perfect size with all the necessary amenities! He is so kind and laid back, he is the perfect roommate!  His apartment is very clean and comfortable, and the location can not be beat.  Staying in Michael's private room was my first experience with Airbnb and I would definitely try to stay there again the next time I need a place to stay in NYC.

Michael is a real gentleman.  We spent over a month at his very well located apartment and were very happy to be there.  Michael works long hours so we didnt see so much of him but whenever we did had some great conversations.  He is a truly thoughful man with lots of insight and had some great tips to help us enjoy the area.  We spilled out into the living room with our computer and had access to his widescreen which was great and the kitchen was fine for extensive cooking.  Our only problem was that the bed was a bit to small for us large/long Aussies.
Michael is such a nice person, it's been great!

Staying in NYC with michael has been a great experience!
The apartment is stylish, confortable, close to everything. We felt at home the time we spend there. The room is large with a nice confy bed.

Michael is symply amazing! We had great chats & gave us great ideas to discover the city!

We will go back to Underhill next time we visit NY for sure!

Michael is a great host: very friendly, laid-back, knows his city and gives lots of good recommendations. The apartment is very clean and spacious. The area is fantastic and offers easy access to several subway lines. Thank you Michael!

J's place was, as advertised, great for parents! My MIL and Brother in law were in town to meet our new baby so we needed something close (we live in downtown Brooklyn) and spacious. The location was ideal and J was an exceptional host. She met me in person to give me the lay of the land, which offered plenty of space for the two of them. J had an extra room available at the time of their stay and graciously offered it as well at no extra charge. The garden was a big part of why we booked the place, and it was gorgeous. J had warned me ahead of time about the mosquitoes...I would recommend bringing repellent if booking in the summertime, they were pretty aggressive! Overall very happy with J's place and her generous hospitality.
great place to stay! Super cute and super attentive host!
J's place is the perfect place for us to stay when we visit our daughter in Brooklyn.  J is quick to respond and helpful with any questions.  We hope to stay there again in the future.

Irene's space is new and fresh, and very comfortable. She was a most pleasant host. My only reservation is the location, which wasn't the best for me, but might be for you! I'd stay there again anytime.
Irene's space is clean, quiet, & comfortable. Her location in East Harlem is convenient to the 6 train. Irene is a great host, very accommodating for check-in & check-out.

We had a great experience staying at Irene's apartment. It was clean and neat, and just as described and shown in the pictures. It's two blocks away from the subway, so it takes around 15 minutes to make it to downtown.
Irene was a great host, and luckily very flexible with check in and check out times.
We would definitely recommend staying at her place.
Thanks for everything Irene!
very good accomodation

Irene is very friendly and considerate.

The apartment is nice and clean, has a very comfy bed and lots of light during the day.

A great location.

Thanks to Irene, my girlfriend and I had a great time at in New York CIty over New Years Eve!! We recommend this place to anyone. Irene helped us a lot to arrange our stay. Her apartment is very new and clean.

The neighborhood is supposed to be very safe. We saw some creepy people on the streets which made my girlfriend feel uncomfortable. Other than that the neighborhood is quite nice. Access to the subway is very close and convenient.

The location of the room is awesome. It's in Manhattan and less than 5 minutes' walk to subway, which can basically take you to anywhere in NYC.

The apartment is in a quite modern building with good security. Since Irene was out travelling so her husband took care of me. He is super nice and introduced me all the facilities that I can use in the apartment. The room is cozy and very tidy. The bed is very comfortable. The best thing is that I have my own room and bathroom. Btw, the bathroom is large and clean.

Cons: There are not a lot good resturants around, but hey you have the whole city to explore. Also, the price can't beat in Manhattan.

The room and the bathroom were very clean!! The bed is big and comfortable, the room needs a little more light, it has a small lamp. We sleep comfortably the building was near to food, grocery stores and subway. The Central Park is not far from there.

Recommendable 100%.

The appartment was exactly as in the pictures and very clean. Irene was not at home, so her husband showed me the place and gave the keys. He was very flexible with the arrival time.
However, the neighbourhood seemed a little creepy to me, especially if you are travelling along,
我们在这里过得很开心，Keith的房子位置在中央公园往北。距离地铁站走路不到5分钟。虽然走路去各个景点可能花费比较长的时间。但是曼哈顿的地下交通很发达。公寓周围有很多快餐店，还有几家中餐馆和超市，很方便。房子的价钱相对合理。但是，如果我再次去旅行的话会以相同的价钱，租相对往南一点的房子。

We enjoyed to stay at Keith' apartment. It was very comfortable , and big enough, the bed of the master bedroom was comfortable, the only thing is the air-matress of the second bed which it has deflated ( Keith promises to repair it). Our daughter slept on the sofa which was big enough. Keith is very kind (he brought cake and juices for us for our arrival ), he left us in the apartment until our departure, he is a very interesting person. We hope to see him again .The  area is very quiet . We came late sometimes and there was no problem. To go to midtown and Times square, there is an express subway ( 15mn), and differents subway lines and buses . We can also walk to Central Park .
Nothing to say about the rental. Great apartment, great host. Will be back for sure.

Nous avons séjourner 9jours chez Keith, lappartement est fonctionnel. Trés bien situé à harlem il n'est pas loin de central park et  le metro est au bout de la rue. En plus c'est une ligne qui dessert presque tout NY. Notre voyage s'est fait en transport en commun grâce à ça. Keith est un hôte disponible qui répond trés rapidement aux mails.

Keith was an amazing host! His apartment is great and well located - it takes about 10-15mins to the A, C, E and 1, 2, 3 trains. If you get the express trains, you'll be in Midtown and Downtown pretty fast. I felt safe in the area, even when I arrived late at night.

He wrote an incredibly detailed manual with everything you need to know about NYC, the apartment, transportation, shopping, etc. The apartment has a bed and a really confortable couch on can sleep on. The kitchen has everything you need to have breakfast or quick lunch. The apartment is also equipped with AC, which turned out to be pretty useful for us!

Keith replied to my e-mails super fast and is a great guy to deal with. I had a great time in NYC and would definitely stay again at his place!
