It was located near 3 subway stations so it was very accessible from the airport(s) and it was also super easy to get around Brooklyn and to Manhattan. The apartment was cozy and clean with a really nice kitchenette. Jane was very prompt in responding to messages and was very welcoming when we arrived. In a beautiful neighbourhood near lots of coffee shops, restaurants, and parks!

Jane's place was great - a great location, and clean, spacious, and comfortable for my husband and I and our 7-month-old. Jane was very responsive when we asked about check-in and check-out procedures. We didn't end up using it much, but the garden was beautiful, too!
A wonderful place to stay if you want a feeling of what Brooklyn used to be and is now.
It is exactly what you see in the pictures. The subway station isn't that far and it's a quiet place and Irene and her husband are wonderful hosts.
As advertised, it was a great place for my parents to stay while visiting. Jane was very responsive and accommodating.

I highly recommend Jane's place as somewhere to stay in Brooklyn.  The space is very spacious and Jane is incredibly accommodating.  From start to finish, Jane was great at communicating with us to ensure that our weekend stay was everything we needed.
Anfitriões educados e receptivos. Quarto e banheiro fiéis ao exposto pelo anúncio. Fica um pouco distante dos principais pontos da cidade, mas tem um metro bem próximo que atravessa Manhattan.

El sitio esta lejos de los lugares turísticos emblemáticos, sin embargo a 2 cuadras pasa la línea 6 del metro y es fácil conectar, también está cerca el lado norte de Central Park y será una linda caminata atravesarlo.
Existe ruido de los vehículos que pasan por la calle, si eres de las personas que necesita absoluto silencio para dormir, no es recomendable.
Irene y su esposo son muy atentos.

If you’re going to be out all day this is perfect. It was clean, comfortable, close to trains, rentable bikes, and Central Park. The neighborhood was a little gritty, I didn’t want to hang out there, but I still felt safe. Irene and her husband were very welcoming and accommodating. I would stay there again.
great place to stay, would do it again. Irene is awesome and the communication worked pretty well!

Beautiful apartment in the Fort Greene neighborhood. A very short walk from the park, subways, and many fantastic restaurants (get brunch at Olea, especially the eggs + salmon or the French toast that includes seseme seeds). After spending the day in Manhattan, I very much enjoyed sitting in the quiet backyard with lovely trees and ivy for an hour. The backyard is also quite visible from the living room and mini-kitchen, which makes the whole place feel like a great oasis. Only small thing was that the wifi  was a bit slow, at least in the bedroom. Ooh...on the plus side, also a very nice bathroom and shower. Easy to walk or hop on a Citibike to nearby neighborhoods too. Hosts we're very responsive and easy to coordinate arrival with. Overall we really liked our stay in Brooklyn, and definitely feel like this place was a part of that.

Jane is a great host - she checked in with us during our visit to make sure we had everything we needed,  The flat is lovely, the street quiet, the neighborhood and park vey nice - a great respite from the hustle bustle of the city for those of us visiting from more rural areas!  We'd definitely stay with Jane again if the opportunity presents itself.
big, comfortable space very nice.
Jane is a fantastic host. She was super accommodating and made our stay extremely comfortable.
Jane is a fantastic hostess. She was very responsive and helpful. She has a beautiful place in Ft Greene.

Alojamiento preciso para un viaje intenso de 9 dias en Nueva York. Irene y su marido nos recibieron muy bien. Pudimos utilizar la cocina, usar microondas y utensilios para comidas rápidas. El barrio en la noche parece poco seguro a veces, pero la verdad nunca tuvimos problemas llegando a las 2 am. Hay un bar en la esquina que reproduce todo el tiempo “In da Club” de 50 cent (Un clásico, pero nos mareó escucharla tanta veces desde nuestra habitación hahaha). Por otro lado, tiene una muy buena conexión al metro en donde puedes llegar al midtown en tan solo 20 minutos. Además,  queda muy cerca de Central park, también puedes encontrar un supermercado a buen precio, ATM y además conexión a buses. Un gran saludo a Irene por su hospitalidad, saludos!!

The place is very convenient, you have everything you need in it, the private bathroom is a major plus and very rare for the price ! The apartment is near the metro line 6 which will allow you to go anywhere in few minutes. It was my first time in the city and I felt safe even at night.
Irene and her husband are very welcoming and helpful. I recommend ! :)

Really like the hospitality by Irene & her husband. Enjoyed my stay, I found this place to be a bit far from downtown although  it’s a 10 mins walk to upper east side of Central Park. 40’mins from Times Square

Irene y su esposo son muy amables. Irene siempre responde con prontitud. El transporte público queda cerca, la mayor parte del tiempo llegamos tarde y nunca tuvimos problemas. Algunos aspectos a considerar: llevar calzado personal (pantuflas) para cambiar al llegar al departamento, tu propio jabón (se nos entregó uno en barra que ya había sido usado), las fotografías no se condicen con el orden y realidad del departamento (estaba más desordenado).
Everything was as expected, would absolutely recommend. Check-in and check-out were super easy, the hosts were discreet but very responsive, the private bathroom + air conditioning were great
Solid stay, a bit far from the city but easily accessible via subway. Neighbourhood was near different types of food and host was very accommodating

Irene et son mari sont des hôtes très accueillants, discrets et très agréables.
L'appartement est conforme à la description, propre et pratique. La salle de bain privée est un gros avantage.
Le quartier est un peu éloigné des principaux points de visite mais la ligne 6 du métro est très proche du logement et permet de rejoindre le centre très rapidement.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour et recommandons cet appartement !

Irene’s place is one of the best property you would find in and around New York City.

Irene was available to welcome in when I checked in. Gave all the instructions needed to settle down well. She is friendly!

Subway is 6 min walk from the property. The area is pretty much crowded so you won’t feel unsafe walking around alone! Has good restaurants around too!

Irene is helpful and also suggested me some good shops around for shopping! Room was clean and nice!

I will definitely come back to stay here!
Irene and her husband are so friendly. It is a good place to stay.
Very nice

Das Zimmer liegt relativ ruhig im fünften Stock eines Wohnhauses. Man hat ein eigenes Bad. Sehr nette Gastgeber. Metro und guter Supermarkt (auf dem Weg zur Metro) in weniger als zehn Minuten zu Fuss. Preis-Leistung gut. Würde wiederkommen.
FANTASTICO, UN LUGAR MUY AGRADABLE

The bedroom/ bathroom are fine for a short stay. The location was very good
being in east Manhattan and just 2 short blocks to the subway. The elevator was in working order and the apartment was clean with access to the kitchen. This
is a good value place given NYC prices.
Os anfitriões foram muito simpáticos. O local corresponde ao anunciado, perto de transporte público e para quem gosta de caminhar, consegue se localizar bem!!  Gostamos muito da estada!

Irene and her husband were very kind to accept my reservation a bit last minute . Check in was smooth, the unit is in a new building and warm and cozy. You have a private bathroom and it’s off a main street near subway and central park in spanish harlem.  I would recommend this unit and the hosts were kind and attentive when I needed them. Thank you!

Irène est une hôte discrète et disponible. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
L’appartement est propre et proche d’une ligne de métro.
Nous vous recommandons ce logement.

I had a great time! The room was clean and cozy and the private bathroom was an amenity very much appreciated. Irene and her partner were very nice, open and welcoming. The metro station was only a five minute walk away so it was very easy to get around. Lots of smaller shops and inexpensive (but very good!) cafes and restaurants close by. Communication went smoothly and promptly.  Would gladly stay here again when visiting NYC.

I wasn't sure about the neighborhood at first but after arriving and walking around, the neighborhood is not upscale but was perfectly fine.  Irene's place had everything we needed.  Good communication, close to Central Park and the subway to take you downtown and a good value.  I recommend it.
Irene and Sylvan were great hosts and the apartment location is convenient for museums and Central Park.
Great place! clean and comfortable and is very close to the subway station.
It was a nice stay

Irene was a lovely host but also a lovely person. She was very easy to deal with and made understanding the housing instructions so much easier. Irene was also responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Would recommend!
Irene and her husband are very friendly and discrete. II hardly felt that anyone stayed in the apartment. The bed was great and comfortable. I would stay there again.

Karene's place was awesome, very clean and cozy. Located in a cool neighborhood with lots to tghings to do around. Definitely would like to stay at her place again another time. Great first airbnb experience. Karene is very friendly and helpfull easy going person who knows how to make you feel at home.
I recommend this place!

Excellent host, Karene was very helpful and accomodating to us on our stay. The apartment was fantastic: clean and comfortable.Great area to stay. In the heart of the West Village. Close to restaurants, bars and subway station. Absolutely brilliant first experience with Airbnb. Thanks again Karene!!

It's impossible to describe how much fun my girlfriend and I had in New York while staying at Karene's place - largely facilitated by the perfect location of her apartment and the comfortable environment we had to relax in each day when we wanted to take a break from the bustle of New York.

Karene's place was clean, very cozy, comfortable when it got too warm outside and situated perfectly in the heart of the West Village.

Karene herself went out of her way to ensure we could get in when our flight got delayed late into the evening and was full of suggestions for things to see and do while we were in town. I can't wait to go again, and if it's free I'll be a repeat visitor!
The host canceled my reservation 17 days before arrival.

Amazing studio, beautiful and light with an incredible view, both the flat and the building were spotless and also in a great downtown location.  Patty was an excellent host, she offered to help with anything I needed and left me to enjoy the place!  I can't wait to go back :)

We arrived at Pats studio late Friday night, actually an hour later than planned, since one of us lost our baggage at the airport.
Pat wrote us an e-mail asking when we would arrive, but despite us failing to reply (because of the missing bag), she was ready when we arrived at around 10-10:30PM.

We were equipped with three sets of keys, which was really nice.

The studio was clean an exactly as pictured on Airbnb.
It was clean and we were left with plenty of towels and clean bedding/sheets.

It was really nice, that no one actually lived in the studio, which meant we had tons of closet space, and there were even umbrellas for us to use.
The high ceilings made the room seem much bigger, and we could comfortably sleep three people together.

As mentioned Patty was the perfect host.
She wrote us an e-mail with tips to good places around the area, and she checked up if we were ok by mail, which meant we had full privacy.
She even excused the rain (it went on for 7 days in a row)

The area is Chinatown as we expected, some might not enjoy the hustle and bustle, but we enjoyed it.
The Meatpacking District, Chelsea and Soho is close by, and it was a good base for being a tourist in NY.

All together we will recommend the studio and Pat as a host any time.

Our stay here was great, the apartment is very well located, in the heart of chinatown, close to the subway and at walking distance from little italy and some other cool places. Patricia is a perfect host, nice, kind and very helpful. We would love to come back to her place!

The apartment was absolutely wonderful! Pat is a great host, very willing to meet any need we had. The apartment was clean, very neat and welcoming. It gets REALLY bright in the morning with the huge window, which i LOVED! The location is awesome as well. Its a quick walk away from a few different subway stations making transportation a breeze. There's a laundry mat downstairs which is both useful and convenient. Overall, a great place to stay!

Jane,
Thank you so much. You have a beautiful home. Your hospitality and flexibility was above and beyond all expectations.
I am looking forward to a future stay with my husband.
Great place. Comfortable and private. Very kind host who will anticipate your needs.
This is a quaint place with a ton of character. Great value and awesome location! Recommend 💯👌🏼

This is our second stay here because it is in such a lovely area near Fort Greene Park (and around the corner from our son's place).  It is really comfortable and stylish and Jane is great at helping you (personally welcomed us in case we had questions, gave us late check out, etc.) and the place is very roomy with a living room and garden out back.  The small kitchen is fine for breakfast with small fridge, microwave, kettle and coffee maker and she offers a kitchen upstairs if you contact her.  Also, she has laundry facilities upstairs.  I definitely recommend this place as a lovely spot in one of Brooklyn's nicest areas.

Jane biedt een basement aan, dus je komt in een kelderverdieping. Met ramen boven de grond en een tuin aan het gelijkvloers achteraan. De locatie is schitterend: rustig, groen en met veel ruimte. Het bed is fantastisch als je goed wil uitrusten.
Je bent in Brooklyn, dus als je naar Manhattan wil moet je altijd een hele tijd metro doen. Het verblijf echter is een ware oase na de drukte van de stad. Er is bereikbaarheid naar alle kanten.
Denk eraan om zeker in de DUMBO area rond te lopen: een geweldig voorbeeld van stadsvernieuwing en -uitbreiding.
Brooklyn zelf verdient uitgebreide aandacht, met het Fort Greene Park dichtbij en iets verderop het prachtige Prospect Park.
Jane's place was wonderful! The space was much bigger than I expected and was extremely accommodating. Jane provided everything we needed for our weekend stay in Brooklyn.

Great spot with lots of charming details. After a long day of work, it was the perfect place to unwind and relax with many of the comforts of home. Jane was super accommodating to my late check in and communicative throughout my stay. I’d happily be back!
Beautiful and comfortable space, great location. Jane is a very responsive and generous host.
Location is ideal for walking to fun places to eat, drink, and shop.  Home is spacious and very clean with charming decor,  plus a pretty courtyard for outside time.  Jane was the perfect host.
Such a good place to stay.  A lovely comfortable home in an area with character a little away from the main busy tourist areas but with easy access into all the central parts.

This is a spacious, comfortable and attractive one-bedroom apartment, with a garden out back.  There is a small kitchen area with a small refrigerator, table and chairs, coffee making equipment (plus coffee, creamer and sugar),  and microwave.  The location in Fort Greene is close to the park, to many restaurants and bars, and in our case, to our son and daughter-in-law.  We very much enjoyed our stay.
Muyyyy lindo departamento!!!!! limpio, comodo, grande!! Patricia nos atendio muy bien y no tuvimos ninguna inconveniente! fue muy amabl con nosotras! con mucho gusto volveriamos a su studio!

This venue is the lower level of a brownstone house on a quiet street near Fort Greene Park. Enjoy the eclectic and roomy vintage interior. We enjoyed staying there and found the neighborhood to be a source of wonderful restaurants. We particularly liked dining at the Point Brooklyn underground restaurant mall on Flatbush Ave. That's a definite winner along with Miss Ada and Bisou Bisou. MTA buses are a short walk away and subway is about 12 minutes (A and C lines), a bit longer to the R line.

This is a beautiful garden apartment in a meticulously restored brownstone on a quiet street. The Fort Greene neighborhood was lovely and fun to explore. The apartment had everything we wanted for our 5-day stay.  Rooms were large and furniture commodious. Everything was clean and in top shape. Jane thoughtfully provided all kinds of supplies, down to tea, coffee, napkins, and an MTA map for our use. Access to the tranquil garden outside the back door was an added delight. We enjoyed the decor, which reflected a quirky and sophisticated design eye. Jane gave us a helpful tour when we checked in and answered questions immediately by text.

Patty's place is the perfect location, right near the hustle and bustle of china town but nestled in a quiet pocket so you still have peace and privacy. You are a 10 minute walk from some of the beast vegan eateries  the city has to offer- check out tinee, counter and babycakes- all will blow your mind. The place is close to the subway so you have central park and broadway right at your fingertips. Patty is a great host, felt like were at home. She is super helpful, my luggage didn't arrive for 5 days and she was more than happy to wait for it so we could enjoy the city. The apartment has everything you need to make your stay in new York the best eva.

It was a really nice trip ! The apartment is comfortable, pleasant, shining, like we imagined it !!!

The area is cool and closed to the subway !!

A perfect place and a perfect host. Patty was really welcoming to us !!

We recently had a very pleasant & comfortable stay in NY!

Patricia is a very attentive en friendly host (she even provided us with candles during the hurricane Irene, just in case of... luckily we didn't need them :-) The appartment is nice, clean & centrally located and perfect to stay with 2 people.

I stayed at Patty's apartment for one week with two friends and it was perfect! The apartment was very clean and I especially loved how it is decorated as it makes you feel that you actually live there. Patty was a great host, really welcoming, friendly and helpful. Many, many thanks again :)

The apt was perfect, clean, comfortable, full of light an perfectly located, just a walk from shops, bars, restaurants... and 5 minutes from a few subway lines.

Patricia was very kind and helpfull, she gave us linen, towels and anything we needed.

We certainly would repeat.

We stayed one week in the appartement.
Accept for the noise in the town, I think that is everywhere! We had a wonderful time. We live very quitfull.
Pat was very helpful and gave us adresses where we should go.
Also we could leave our stuff in here appartement on the day we had to leave.
I can recomend her appartement and go back as soon as it is possible.

Petra Blokker

We had a great stay! The apartment is very cosy, clean, the neighborhood is safe and the subway is very close. We spent almost two weeks there and Patricia was a wonderful hostess. She is kind and helpful ali the time.

We recommend it!

Definitely recommended, both host and apartment. What we liked best about Patty's studio: it's very spacious and gets a lot of light (in fact, there's also quite a view!). The large room provides you (unusual for most of Manhattan) with a lot of space for your luggage or shopping bags. All in all, it’s a great place to come home to. You can cook your own meals or get a coffee from the Chinese bakery downstairs, listen to music (Patty provides an iPod docking station), and get a good night's sleep on either the mattress "upstairs" (beware that there is a ladder) or the sofa. We also found it to be very quiet for New York, bare for some funny radiator noises. Also appreciated: lots of linen, towels, hair-dryer, good water pressure. The one small problem we had was speedily fixed by Patty (thank you). Last but not least: Chill, friendly vibe in the building.

Design-lovers might care to know that Patty's loft studio is a perfect example of the vintage/industrial trend. A balanced mix of comfortable (extra blankets) with intentionally unrefined materials (hardwood floors, tool kits). I loved it, and found it especially fitting since the building is located where the Lower East Side and Chinatown merge: an area that is also not conventionally "pretty", but all the more exciting with its restaurants, bars, galleries, people-watching opportunities. Be sure to ask Patty for suggestions on where to go. She has some great tips – and we’re now obsessed with "Joe's Shanghai" and the "Fat Radish". So yes, you can easily hop onto the subway and get to the usual tourist spots, but the neighborhood itself is definitely worth checking out.

WHAT A GREAT Time we had in Pattys Appartment. I loved it! It is perfectly located, only 3 mins walking distance to the underground, Soho, the Village, Little Italy - even century 21 was in walking distance :-) (not the best idear, we needed a taxi to bring us AND our full bags back to the Appartment)
I felt so at home, that I was very sad, when I left after 10 days!
We had plenty of towels, a hair dryer (very important for girls) the kitchen was fully equiped - I had a wounderful time and I will book Patty´s Appartment again - the nex time over!
Great location and easy check-in. Jane’s home was comfortable and spacious.
Not at this time.

Just a great spot in Brooklyn in a nice neighbor just a block from Fort Greene Park.  Great value and very well titled, as we were visiting our daughter nearby.  Would go back if available the next time we are there.

It was hard to say goodbye after spending a week in this lovely garden apartment and peaceful neighborhood. Historical charm with modern amenities (best shower pressure ever!). High quality linens and towels.  Great location for dining, shopping and just a few blocks to "C train" subway that will get you to SOHO/Manhattan in about 15 minutes.  We wanted a Brooklyn experience and this location checked all our boxes.  Wonderful local restaurants (Walter's is just around the block-craft cocktails and comfort food), artisan boutique (Feliz- around the corner), small grocery and wine shop just a block away. We also explored Williamsburg and Boerum Hill neighborhoods (both under 2 miles of Fort Greene).

Jane has decorated her home to give it a very homey feel. For travelers who are looking for a higher end accommodation, this is the place for you. Jane’s home is located within an amazing neighborhood with fantastic restaurants and shops in walking distance. The subway can be picked up in several locations within a 10 minute walk. Not for everyone but we loved walking the neighborhood and integrating into the community. Right down the street is Fort Greene Park. A lovely park that houses a farmers market on Saturdays. I wouldn’t think twice about staying with Jane again.

our experience at karene´s place was awesome. the apartment is well sized for a whole week stay or more. we found it very clean, well furnished and welcoming. karene has been very responsive from arrival until the end on anything from places to go out, visit and the sort. if you want to stay in a cosy place in new york city close to a lively neighborhood this is the place

Karene was the best intro to Airbnb we could have asked for! Quick to respond, detailed and very personable, she made sure that all of our questions were answered and that we were well prepared for the arrival. No problem with getting address and contact info well in advance of our arrival, and she accommodate our late check in and late departure times due to crazy flight schedules. The photos of the apartment were modest, to say the least - the place was spectacular! A beautiful full size 1 bedroom apartment with all the amenities (she even left us a variety of coffees, towels, etc.). The location was stellar - in the heart of the West Village, within 5 minutes of the subway, shops, amazing restaurants, etc. Of all the apartment rentals we have done in NYC, this was the best. No problems whatsoever. It's not a matter of 'if,' but WHEN - we will be back! Thanks!

Karene's place is fabulous - great neighbourhood, beautifully clean and very easy to like.  Karene was very welcoming and super easy to deal with. I had a great time in NY (again!) and staying here had a lot to do with it. Thanks Karene, I'll be back!
Our experience in Karene apartment was amazing! The apartment was clean, in the perfect location and great for a couple. But most of all what we really appreciate was the kindness of the landlord!

We had a fantastic time - lovely apartment, brilliant location - it was our first time on Airbnb and was a great experience. Our host was charming and thoughtful, the actual apartment clean and spacious, we hope to be back soon

My stay at Karene's place was flawless. The apartment is gorgeous: immaculately presented and surprisingly spacious. Bonus points for the bed (a good, firm mattress) and the shower (plenty of water)! As for the location, I honestly can't think of a more convenient block in the West Village -- and if you're looking at rentals in this area then you already know how special the neighbourhood is. Karene herself is a welcoming and considerate host: she went out of her way to accomodate me, and she was always available to answer my questions. Thanks, Karene!

Karenes apartment is in a wonderful location in the village - Magnolia bakery is just around the corner, it's a short walk  to Chelsea Market and there are lots of lovely boutiques and restaurants very close by. The apartment itself is pristine with a great shower and a very comfortable bed. What made my trip most enjoyable however was Karenes kindness and helpfulness. She was the perfect host - taking time to make recommendations and generally going above and beyond to make sure our stay was flawless ... and it was :-) I hope to stay at Karenes every time I visit New York.

We liked the apt of Karene Very much. It was very clean and beautiful with a good kitchen, good coffeemachine and an amazingly good and beautiful shower. The neighbourhood is I think one of the nicest of New York City. Contact with Karene was nice and efficient.
Onno
Our stay at Karene's apartment was perfect. She was there to greet us and the place was clean and lovely. There couldn't be a more perfect location for exploring New York City.

Karene is a wonderful host who is available 24/7 to make sure that you have the best stay possible! We arrived to find free wifi, a bottle of beautiful wine and a clean & comfortable apartment in one of the best locations in the West Village!
A beautiful building close to shopping, bars, restaurants & grocery stores this is a seriously fantastic place to stay in NYC.
Loved it & will definitely be back!

Our experience in Karene's apartment was marvellous! the neighbourhood is incredible, everything is round the corner, cafes, restaurants, the best shops.... Karene is such a good person! everything was simple thanks to her... we can kept our luggage the day we arrived and the day we left, everything was clean and comfort, the apartment is really sunny, even better that you can see in the photos. The bed is confortable and the bathroom is perfect. We really feel at home! specially when Karene invited us with a bottle of Argetine wine the day we arrive!

Loved the space & Karene!! It was a horrible start considering we missed our 1st night due to weather delays to the city, but keeping in communication with Karene made it easy when we arrived.  Although we never met for the duration of the trip, she was still very accommodating to ensure our stay was as comfortable as possible. In short, this will be my "go to" every time I have business in NYC. For your local pleasure, there's a Starbucks up the corner block, shopping/pizza on Bleeker, subway access, and walking distance/short taxi to the nightlife/restaurants of the Meat Packing District. Enjoy yourself!!

Beautiful garden apartment. 10min away from C and G train and a short walk to Fort Greene Park.  I booked this place for my parents as they were going to be in town for a short 3-day visit. Location was perfect for us as we live in Fort Greene as well. Jane was quick to respond to my messages through Airbnb and via text as well. My parents loved staying here.

Terrific location in my all time favorite Brooklyn Neighborhood. Conveniently located near some of the best restaurants and cafe's in the area. SUPER close to the park. This space is big and beautiful. We felt very cosy hanging out in the space. Privacy was top notch. Only downside was the cold, but Jane provided PLENTY of extra blankets and added space heater to combat the February chill. A small price to pay for big beautiful windows and lots of gorgeous open space. Would gladly recommend.
Beautiful and tasteful home with character and charm!  Well maintained and hosted by a friendly and helpful host.
This space is very comfortable and quiet for Brooklyn.  It is also very near many things like restaurants and Fort Greene park.

Jane's apartment is spacious and very well decorated.  She is a great host and gave us loads of tips for our trip. The space us totally private.   The area is excellent near the Subway.  There is a fantastic restaurant a couple of doors down called Smooch breakfast and dinner amazing.

Jane’s place is definitely ‘Perfect for your Parents’!  We stayed there over a weekend while visiting our daughter who lives near by.  It is very cozy and a great place to relax and enjoy family time.  The neighborhood is terrific with lots of little shops and restaurants.

Jane's place is lovely and comfortable, and as described. We enjoyed the space and location. The closest subway station into the city is about 10 blocks, so we took the local bus 38 down DeKalb Ave, using the metrocard. The neighborhood is nice and fairly quiet (it is the city after all!) and it was a good place to stay while going back and forth into the city. There are cafes and coffee shops nearby and a Whole Foods about a mile away.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfy place in Brooklyn. Jane was incredible host, quick to respond to any issue/question and kind to accommodate tricky check in/check out. All the positive reviews/ratings are warranted. Would not hesitate to stay again.

We had to find a last minute solution for our citytrip and we couldn't have been more grateful for Jane's hospitality. We were checked in within the hour in an amazing apartment. Spacious, clean, stylish. Wonderful big bed and super quiet nights (dark and no traffic). We loved the many subway options available from Fort Greene. Manhattan, Williamsburg, Queens, Carroll Gardens- all easy accessible from the apartment. Hope to be back soon. Thanks again Jane!
Jane is an excellent host and her apartment was just perfect for spending a weekend in Brooklyn
Great and very large ground-floor mini apartment with access to shared back garden! Handy location

Jane‘s place very quiet, located in a very interesting neighbourhood with lots of subway options nearby and, bonus, there’s an attractive garden with birds for your morning coffee or  before dinner drink.

Wir verbrachten zu viert (2 Erwachsene, 2 Teenager) eine sehr angenehme Woche in der Unterkunft von Jane. Die Bilder geben einen guten Eindruck von der Wohnung. Das Apartment im Gartengeschoss hat zwei Räume, allerdings ohne Türen dazwischen. Im Schlafzimmer gibt es ein bequemes Doppelbett, im Wohnzimmer eine Klappcouch mit eher weicher Matratze. Das Badezimmer ist nur vom Schlafzimmer aus zugänglich. Man hat Zugang zum Garten, den wir allerdings nicht genutzt haben. Die Küche ist (wie beschrieben) nicht voll ausgestattet. Die Wohnung befindet sich in einem ruhigen, wenig touristischen Quartier mit den typischen Brownstone-Häusern. Zur nächstgelegenenen Subway-Station (DeKalb Av. oder Lafayette) sind es ca. 10 Min. Fussweg, von dort ca. 15 Min bis Manhattan. Wir haben  im Cafe Paulette gefrühstückt oder bei Bittersweet Kaffee+Teilchen geholt und uns in den Fort Greene Park gesetzt. Abends haben wir mal das "Walters" ausprobiert (gut, aber sehr laut). An der DeKalb Av. sind noch weitere Restaurants in Laufweite.
The space lives up to all expectations. Great way to experience Brooklyn.
Jane's place was wonderful. Lots of space, great amenities, and a great location near the park. It felt like home away from home.

This apartment is very conveniently located within walking distance of restaurants and shops in Futon Mall.  We enjoyed the eclectic furnishings and history of the apartment.  Jane was a very accommodating host.
Great space and great host really enjoyed our time there

Karene's apartment is fabulous in a wonderful area of NYC - perfect for a couple, super close to public transport, great shopping & the Hudson river (great for running/walking etc), lots of great restaurants, cafe's etc. If you want to live like a local then Karene's apartment is perfect. There's even a police station next door so you feel safe.
The actual apartment is funky, airy & bright & most importantly clean with plenty of storage space so you feel right at home.
Karene was such a pleasure to deal with & went out of her way to make us feel welcome. She also gave us great tips about the local area & made great recommendations of things to do & see.
We could not have asked for a better apartment in a better location or for a better host for our first trip to NYC - highly highly recommended.

I've just returned home to England from a four week holiday in Karene's apartment and am delighted to say that it was superb. Not only was it everything that Karene's photos and description presented but it had the added benefit of a newly completed rooftop terrace. The apartment offered everything I was looking for in the most fantastic location right in the heart of the happening West Village. Karene was an excellent host giving me lots of suggestions for places to eat and boutiques to shop in, several of which I went to. I've been to NY several times and have previously stayed in hotels. Having had such a fantastic experience at Karene's apartment, I'd have no hesitation in booking to stay with her again.

This was our first experience with Air BnB and we could not have hoped for a better host than Karene. The flat is in an amazing location and nothing was too much trouble.

Having been to New York many times (>15) over the years,this is a great way to experience the best of NYC.

Karene's apartment was so lovely. I felt very at home from the moment I arrived. It was perfect for my stay in New York and couldn't have asked for a better location. Karene was an amazing host. So friendly and helpful. Would definitely love come back and stay again.

We loved our stay in Karene's apartment. The location was superb, even better than expected. The studio was clean and cozy providing the respite needed after a long day exploring the city. We were close enough to the subways to get around the city, but also enjoyed just walking around the West Village. You have world class restaurants literally outside your door, as well as an old school diner just around the corner. I especially enjoyed the closeness in proximity to all the world class jazz clubs. We had a wonderful vacation and attribute a lot of it to our stay in Karene's apartment.

Karene was a great host to my parents who visited me in nyc from the netherlands. West village is by far the best neighbourhood to set up base camp (i have been living around the corner for the past 3 years) and karene's apartment in particular. Next to AAA location there is no shortage of fresh sheets, towels, thee, coffee etc. Most important, the place is spotless clean. Karene makes you feel at home in the greatest city of the world.
Maarten

I have been to NY on a number of occasions and this was by far the loveliest apartment i have stayed in and far superior to an overpriced hotel room. The area is stunning and close to everything you might need including shopping and transport links. The apartment was spotless, light and airy and the perfect base for work or play. The free wifi is a bonus. Karene was a great host and answered any queries promptly and courteously. I will absolutely go back on my next trip. Its a popular apartment so I will make sure I get my dates sorted quickly.
Karene's place is roomy and comfortable. Our ten-day stay was trouble free. The neighborhood is delightful, a perfect home -base for exploring the city, particularly lower Manhattan.

Karene's place was clean, convenient, and just what we were hoping for in regards to our stay! An amazing location allows you to explore the west village and its array of great restaurants, bars, shops, etc. We will definitely be back.....thanks so much Karene!!

Great apartment!  Karene is a superb host, very easy to communicate with.  The apartment is even nicer than it looks in the photos, and very, very clean and comfortable.  The neighborhood is one of the best in manhattan, and the subway is just around the corner.  My wife and I have rented many different apartments in the city, and we look forward to staying in this apartment again!
Second time stay, wonderful place, location and host, just as last time. Many thanks Karene!!
Karene's apartment is perfectly located in the West Village. It is clean and chic and it is a joy to stay there. Karene was lovely and very accommodating. All in all, a great experience!

The appartment was very nice, sunny and clean.
Karen had left the keys for us at some friends and it was very easy to get them.
There was just a little problem with the router. We let her know and she immediately found a solution for us.
If we ever come back (which we would love to!!), we will contact her for sure!!
The apartment is exactly what it says..."Sunny and Clean". In fact, it's sunnier and cleaner than the photos! Karene is friendly, down-to-earth and helpful. I will definitely return.

For starters, Patty's apartment was just beautiful. From the moment we stepped in, it felt like 'home'. It's a great location if you like a really hustle bustle area and vibe of the city - Chinatown is intense, but really fun! Patty was a great host and was keen to make our stay comfortable by providing us with tips on places in the area to visit and letting us know that we could contact her at any time to ask any questions. I'd definitely recommend this apartment to stay when you visit New York - I know I would love to stay here again next time!

Wow - this is the most fantastic place to stay in NYC - so much character and very convenient to everything. Patty is a beautiful host and couldn't have been more helpful. She also has a delightful son who delivered fresh pomegranate seeds to my apartment one night :–) The view of NYC from the huge window in the apartment is amazing - you could sit there and watch the world go by. Soooo much better than a tiny anonymous hotel room. The ladder up to the loft sleeping area is sturdy and safe and it was fun sleeping up there. Chinatown itself is a vibrant bustling community and close to Little Italy, Soho, TriBeca, Lower East Side, Ground Zero - all fabulous places to explore. There are lots of great cafes, art galleries, shops within easy walking distance of the apartment and the uptown subway is close by so it didn't take long to get to the hub of the city. I would definitely go back to this place and thoroughly recommend it. Thank you Patty and Charlie!

Myself and two friends stayed in patricias apartment and we were very comfortable here. The place is clean and cosy and has all the amenities we needed throughout our stay. It is also very convenient, close to the subway and had plenty of places to have a drink and eat close by.

Patricia was a lovely host and very helpful by telling us where to go in the area.

We very much enjoyed our stay, and highly recommend it to anyone!

Patricia was very responsive to my emails and text with every questions I had. And her loft is soooooo cool. It's a quintessential New York artist's loft. It's very clean and comfortable. Great view and great neighborhood. And once inside, it's amazingly quiet for Manhattan standard. It's much more spacious than the photos and also very romantic.

I can't wait to go back!

Thank you Patricia!!!

Great place in a great neighborhood. so many cheap and excellent places to eat, and quick walk  o the bars and boutiques in the Lower East Side. Close to F train and multiple Trains at Canal St. Studio is light and bright. Elevator is a plus. Patty was available though we had no problems during our stay. Would recommend!

Patty's apartment was the perfect base for our adventures in NYC. The apartment is basic but very comfortable, and has lots of charm and character. The apartment is well-heated, the hot water plentiful, the kitchen well-equipped, the wi-fi fast, and outside noise minimal. We slept well in the loft bed, and I enjoyed many morning cups of tea curled up on the big sofa. The location in Chinatown/Lower East Side is amazing - close to the subway, shops, Wholefoods, good coffee, great food. The apartment is very private, but Patty lives close by if you do ever need her help/suggestions, and she always responds quickly. I  highly recommend staying at this apartment.
Place was excellent and had plenty of room! Patty was supper accommodating.  Would definitely stay here again!
Patricia is a GREAT host, also is her studio. Everything you may need is available in the apartment, it's much much better than I supposed! Really worth to stay in!
We had a great stay in this nice spacious studio. Lots of nice places around it and not far from SoHo and East Village.

I stayed at Patricia's studio for a week with my sister and mom. We had an absolutely amazing time in NYC and much of it was thanks to the accommodation.

The location is fantastic - close to public transport links to uptown and within walking distance of Soho and Little Italy. The neighborhood is so vibrant, colorful and buzzing - we absolutely fell in love with it! it can be a bit noisy not to the point it would keep you up at night.

Keys pick-up and drop off was seamless and Patricia made for a great host. She answered our questions in very timely manner (including tips on hairdressers :) and made us feel very comfortable.

The studio itself had everything we needed but to be fair - we didn't spend much time there. In any case, all the basics for a comfortable stay are available: plenty of extra blankets, clean sheets and loads of towels, hair dryer, fully equipped kitchenette. the building also felt very safe and it has the great advantage of a lift!

Patricia left a list of recommendations, including the coffee shop downstairs. we had breakfast and coffee there every morning and loved it to bits! A must-try restaurant right around the corner is Bacaro - great food and about 5 min walk.

The only thing I could mildly complain about (and that's only to prove i'm trying to stay objective) is the funky smell of fried garlic that drifted in the studio early in the morning. Then again - I take that as part of Chinatown's charm.

I would absolutely recommend the place to other traveler and would love to have the opportunity to stay there again.

15 days in NYC : what an enchantment ! Big, busy and green, the city has much to offer to French tourists! Museum, buildings, shops, food,parks... there is something to discover in each place, in each street of Manhattan.
And American peopleare very nice and helpful.

It is a very nice loft. Everything is exactly like on the pictures. You have everything you need, and the host is very helpful. It's nice and clean. Everything is in walking distance, and it,s easy to get arround.
We would definitly recommend this place, and it probably won't be the last time we will stay here.

We had such a great time staying in Patty's apartment. We only saw Patty a few times during our stay but she was always very friendly and helpful. The apartment is small and simple, but you don't feel boxed in as it has a very high ceiling and a big window looking out towards downtown. It's in a great location in Chinatown, we found it was the perfect hub for walking to Williamsburg (over the bridge), Soho, Bowery and the LES, and it's close to a bunch of subway lines to get you to pretty much anywhere else. For us, it was the perfect New York experience, thanks Patty!

We stayed at Patty's nice appartment from May 17th untill May 23rd 2012. We had a great time! Her appartment was just as posted on the internet, very light and spacious and clean.
When we arrived we were welcomed by her friedly son who showed us around and gave us the keys. There was also a personal note and a bottle of wine from Patty to welcome us in her appartment. We felt right at home!
Patty was also very helpfull to us. She gave us handy tips for restaurants, the subways, cabs and much more. There was one time when one of our keys did not work properly and she was right there to fix the problem and gave us another set of keys. She even brought us freshly baked and delicious brownies one night, much better then at a hotel :). The WiFi at the appartment was also great. We could stay in touch with our family and friends at home and look up information on the internet for our sightseeing the next day, perfect!
When the time came to leave to go home she called a carservice for us to take us tothe airport, for $10.- cheaper than a cab!
We had a perfect stay and recommend Patty's place to anyone! If we come back tot visit New York again, we will certrainly stay here again, thanks Patty for a wonderfull week in NY!!!

Wendy & Aline from the Netherlands

My boyfriend and I had an enjoyable stay at this apartment. We found it to be very homely and in a convenient location. Patricia was very helpful and very prompt in responding to any queries we had.

The apartment was spacious and there was plenty of wardrobe space to store our things. The bed (up in the loft) can at times get hot but there are ample fans and an air-conditioning unit and also the couch can be used as a bed if it gets too unbearable.

We would stay there again. Thanks Patty.

My girlfriend and I spent 5 nights in Patricia's studio to explore Manhattan. We had a great time. Patricia was there to greet us when we arrived. She was very nice and gave us some helpful suggestions for our stay. The studio itself was very bright and well equipped with everything we needed to be comfortable.

Actually our score would be more like 4.5 stars! We loved staying in the apartment and living in Chinatown, which is a vibrant community in a great location. Patty was very helpful and left us some very useful notes to start us off in NYC. There is a great view from the window. We specially recommend the cheap and cheerful breakfast at the Cup and Saucer across the road. A launderette downstairs from the apartment is also very conventient.
it was comfortable,convenient and made our stay in new york a plheasent one,we would stay again here,chna town was fine and in retrospect a good choice, the loft was an experience but comfortable.

Thanks to Patty for creating this nice and comfy place in this great city. The appartment had all we needed, nothing to be missed. The building is not the newest one, but once you are inside the appartment, everythinng is nice and calm. You will hear cars and stuff a little from the street but not very much since the place is in the 6th floor. It's great to see the freedom tower out of the window when you ake up! Be prepared to climb a ladder to get into bed, this might not be comfortable for everybody. Sleeping comfort is okay, be prepared that the bed has not the thickest mattress but we have slept very commfortably. Don't be surprised to be waked up early in the morning by bakery smells from the palce downstairs...you might get hungry at 5.30 in the morning! Overall, a really great place in a super interesting neighbourhood and a place to "come home" to after a busy NYC day. We would definetly recommend it and get back to this place if we visit again.

This place is clean, cute and in a cool location. The apartment felt spacious for the two of us. The beds were comfy and there were plenty of fresh towels. My short friend slept on the sofa bed downstairs and I slept up in the loft - watch your head up there! Nice that the apartment is on the top floor so there is no noise transfer from above. The building has an elevator. Bring earplugs to help fall asleep at night as the street outside is a bit noisy. Our host was responsive and provided excellent suggestions on local eateries, pubs and coffee shops. The Cup & Saucer diner next door is a great spot for a warm hearty breakfast. We bought fresh fruit from the Chinatown markets, Little Italy and Nolita are right outside the apartment. The East Village is only 3 subway stops away - great spot for dinner. We enjoyed being so close to the East Broadway subway station.  The F train took us to Midtown, Broadway, and Central park. We would stay again!

Terrific location on a quiet shady street in Ft Greene.  Just a block from the park and very convenient to nearby restaurants and shops.  Jane is an excellent welcoming host, and the space is very roomy, welcoming, well appointed and spotless.  We had a great visit with our daughter.  “Perfect for parents” indeed!
Jane place is very well located, close to restaurants, parks, subways, and shops. the neighbourhood is great. Jane is a lovely host.

This place is definitely one of the best AirBnB’s in NYC.  Incredibly comfortable, sparkling clean and well-situated in my favorite neighborhood in Brooklyn.  Jane was very accommodating and communicative.  I will absolutely be staying here again!

The apartment was beautiful, clean, and very comfortable. The design was polished. The location was a perfect launching point for our trip. This was our first vacation with our baby so we were a little nervous about where we would stay. The space was roomy enough for our portable crib, sparkling clean, and temperature controlled perfectly!

La casa es muy bonita, está muy bien situada, y es muy amplia.
El jardín un poco descuidado
Tiene aire acondicionado central que es muy importante en verano.
Con muchos detalles , televisión plasma, microondas, tostadora.Todo lo necesario para una feliz estancia
Excelente!

My family and I really enjoyed staying in this home next to Fort Greene Park. We found it to be a great launchpad for all the great things to do in Brooklyn, Manhattan, and other surrounding areas. The home itself is super-comfortable and stylish - it's a very authentic Brooklyn experience. My 4-year old said that staying in Brooklyn was the highlight of his trip.

All of the logistics associated with our stay were very easy/straightforward so we consider Jane to be a genuine Airbnb Superhost, for sure.

Lastly, the markets, coffee, and dining options on Dekalb Ave are awesome.

Really charming place on the bottom floor of a brownstone on a pretty, quiet street in Fort Greene. The backyard was also lovely. Jane was very helpful with some good recommendations for the neighborhood.
Great place to stay, in my favorite neighborhood in NYC.
Just as advertised, this is really a lovely spot in a fantastic neighborhood.

Communication with Jane was very smooth and she was kind and accommodative with relatively late check in (9pm). I live in the neighborhood too and rented it for my brother’s couple and they loved it. Would happily get my family to stay here again.
This is a spacious garden apartment in an easy location in Fort Greene. Jane was very helpful and quick to respond.
A very nice apartment in a lovely neighborhood: convenient and comfortable.
This place is amazing! Our first time in NY & we are so glad we chose to stay here. Beautiful, comfortable & easy walking distance to restaurants, shops & the subway! Thanks for everything Jane!!
Perfectly placed, private and practical. It’s a garden flat that is light filled, spacious and well appointed. I had a great stay and would recommend.
My high expectations were fully met. Jane's place was roomy, clean, and in a great location. She responded promptly to questions and there were no problems at all.

Jane advertises this spacious (slightly below-)street level apartment as 'Perfect for your parents', which might be true but it is more than that. It is even perfect for a father and son! We (father (56) and son (17), Dutch) spent a very comfortable time here, Jane was kind enough to set up both large beds in separate large rooms so we could both have a sound and well deserved sleep straight out of JFK (good connection via AirTrain and subway) and the following night. There is a charming park around the corner, with an interesting history, and you can find a fun farmers market there as well on saturday mornings. The building is a classic brownstone building, in a classic brownstone street, with a nice atmosphere and almost no traffic. I heard no sounds at all at night from the street, nor from Jane who lives above the apartment. She was very welcoming, explained the essential things clear and to-the-point, and is very happy to answer questions, although we didn't have any. Plus The apartment has the biggest tv-screen I've ever seen, with more channels than I could count. And garden doors that open to the spacious garden, but we kept them shut because it was November...;) TL;DR: great apartment, great neighborhood.

A wonderfully spacious ground floor apartment with a large back garden.. Lots of old world charm; parquet floors, tin ceilings and wood paneling. Kitchenette and bathroom are nicely tiled and modern. Location was great; on a block of typical Brooklyn brownstones, just a very short walk to restaurants, markets and Fort Green park. Jane was flexible and quick about responding to questions. We'd definitely stay there again.
Jane’s apartment was clean, convenient and comfortable. It had everything we needed and Jane was very responsive to our questions in advance of our stay. We hope to be guests here again.

After six hours worth of delays we arrived at Patty's apartment late in the evening, but even so she was extremely forthcoming and did not hesitate to make us feel welcome immediately!
Our week at her apartment was truly wonderful.

More than anything we found that the location of the apartment was absolutely amazing - located in a wonderful area with shops, restaurants and funny boutiques. There were many days when we just walked around the area, checking out the nearby Tenement Museum and trying out different delis! Not to mention the coffeeshop and laundromat downstairs, as well as the deli on the corner which made our relaxing vacation even more so! Also, beware of the view from the apartment - it's stunning!

We had a very comfortable stay, the beds were perfect for us, the kitchen was great to have in the mornings for a cheap breakfast and coffee, and all in all we would really recommend staying with Patty to anyone ever going to New York!

Patty is the most helpful, nicest host ever! She went over and above what a host had to do. We were staying at her apartment during the time of the hurricane and she made sure we were ok.

The apartment itself is exactly how it looks on the photos - its very specious, with lots of natural light and a comfortable futon bed - we would DEFINATELY stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone who would want to stay here.

we really appreciated to stay at Patricia 's place. It was clean, confortable, bright and the view from the window is very nice. Location is central, in chinatown, with good restaurants around. The subway is close, allowing to explore the city easily.

My girlfriend and I stayed for five days in the appartment. We had a great time. The appartment is located near the subway (both B & D lines on Grand Street and line 6 on Canal Street) which is great if you are going Uptown (or further Downtown). The appartment is clean enough and has a stowe and refridgerator if you want to prepare food at home (no microwave owen though). I would recomend it to any one who are looking for an inexpensive stay in Chinatown.

In my opinion, if you want to really experience New York, you have to stay at Patty's. Located at the heart of Chinatown, you really are in the thick of the action. Just minutes away from the Grand St subway station (so convenient) and literally sandwiched between a laundromat and 24 hour deli (try their wraps and hot sandwiches; one of the yummiest tasted), Patty's apartment was perfect. Cozy, it boasts a comfortable where the bed is (you have to climb up a ladder though) and the view oversees part of Manhattan bridge and some parts of the city. We were up early on our first morning and the sunrise was breath-takingly beautiful! And the apartment is accessible to anywhere, you can reach Times Square in 20mins and Broadway/ Lafayette in 10 mins! But if you are expecting a really clean neighborhood, be warned - this is indeed Chinatown. But I think that just adds character to the neighborhood - makes everything about nyc even more interesting and colorful. Every morning there will be folks practicing Tai-chi. Plus the area is really safe - how can it not when the fire station is parked just next door? We loved it here! Though on the first day and for a couple of days after, the elevator stopped working (and we had to carry our 23kg luggage up to the 6th floor.) and the heater totally gave up on us (all thanks to hurricane Sandy!), Patty was really helpful, easily contactable and ensured we got what we need to make our stay really pleasant. She even got us a better portable heater (bless her). Patty, thank you for everything - we'll definitely see you again when we're in nyc (we're already planning a summer trip haha!)

Love, Elly & Bey

Perfect! Inside Chinatown. Nice clean Loft with a great view to the Financial District and Ground Zero. Patty is very helpful and friendly. Thanks a lot for everything.
Many shops and restaurants nearby. Taste the bakery at the ground floor. Nice people and sweat things for breakfast mmmhh. Not only chinese food and shops. At Orchard Street we find fancy shops, Galleries and good restaurants. We will come back .

patty was a great host. She was there when we needed her and had good local knowledge which was helpful. The room was exactly as you see in the photos. great location, super easy to get everywhere from there. It was the perfect base. thanks Patty.

Patty is incredibly helpful and she make my stay in NYC a sweet and warm one . She is always available to ask questions at any time.
I never regret choosing her loft to stay which is convenient to get around using subway (Grand or Canal) and has convenience shops, groceries, restaurants and eateries nearby. I love the high ceiling which makes the loft looks bright and cheerful and the decor.
I would definitely stay here again or recommend her to my family and friends.

My partner and I absolutely loved our stay in NYC, and more importantly, Patty's apartment. It's a great location with loads of great cheap eats nearby and several subways, although my partner and I preferred to walk. The apartment is really great and has plenty of character and a cool view. Our stay was in December and the heating in the apartment was excellent, perfect for a pair of Australians not used to the cold. Patty is awesome and super kind! When we return to NYC we will definitely stay here again!
My parents had a great stay here! I was happy with everything!
Came in for one night for work.  Fabulous value compared to hotel.  Jane was super fast responding and check in and out was very smooth.
Great space and great location
Wonderful place

Très bel endroit où séjourner. Emplacement idéale à Brooklyn dans un quartier typique. Commerces à proximité et bar + restaurant très sympa aux alentours. Métro à 5-10min de marche. Merci Jane pour votre accueil ! Je recommande !
This is a lovely garden apartment in The Ft Greene neighborhood - great location for visiting Brooklyn and Manhattan.  Spacious and comfortable..    Jane was a super host...  I hope to go back soon.
She is so kind. The house is beautiful and retio~I love it
Second time booking with Jane. Great place. Great neighborhood. Comfortable bed, luxe linens, awesome shower! Sunny kitchenette with garden view.

This place is a gem! Quiet, comfortable, stylish, great location!
Bed is comfortable, plenty of room to relax after dinner or sightseeing, and a great shower!! Jane was amazing with her responses and accomodated our needs. We will definitely stay here again when back
In BK.
Just an excellent place to stay

Jane's place has a stunning garden just one block from Fort Greene park. She was very responsive and accommodating - including upgrading the wifi router when we were having connectivity issues. Checkin and checkout was seamless.
Great host. Place was spotless and the open concept throughout the house is amazing.  I would definitely stay again. Thanks again Jane
Beautifully decorated and a great location! Jane was very helpful and accommodating. Would definitely stay again!
Jane was a lovely host. The hospitality was outstanding and the home was sparkling clean. I would highly recommend staying here for a relaxing getaway.

I wanted a short stay for rest and relaxation, and this beautiful place was definitely it. Jane was very accommodating with my last minute booking. The place is absolutely beautiful, and the back yard is peaceful and serene.Great location, area very quiet. Will definitely stay again in the near future.
This place was fantastic! Very cute, comfortable, clean, loved the location. Would definitely stay again!
Just as advertised and a bit more, we would stay again, hopefully COVID is gone next time but great nonetheless!

Nice stay in NYC; location is good (although one needs to consider Chinatown isn't the most beautiful part of the city). Appartment is clean (although it could use a finishing touch) and spacious enough for 2. Service and information provided by Patricia is excellent. We were overall satisfied with our stay in this appartement.

Patty's apartment was a great place for me and my two friends to spend a week touring the city. It is conveniently located near several subway stations that made going uptown or downtown very easy. You can't beat all of the cheap food nearby in Chinatown and Little Italy. The apartment is pretty old but is kept very clean (and has an awesome view out the window). Patty was super generous to set up an air mattress for us in addition to the couch (which doubles as a bed) and the bed in the loft. We were all very comfortable in the room, even though it seemed we were hardly there! It was always the perfect temperature.  Of course, this is in Chinatown, which isn't the most elegant part of the city, but this really was perfect for what I needed in an apartment. Hardly had any contact with Patty, but she was always available for when I needed her. Thanks, Patty for an awesome stay!

We had a lovely stay at Patricia's apartment. Great location in Chinatown, close to subway and easy to get to from airport. The apartment is cosy and clean with working appliances, nice decor and lots of blankets and pillows to keep you warm and comfy. Plus the futon is super comfy! Looks just like the photos. Patricia is helpful, accommodating and flexible with checking in and out times. Thanks Patricia!

We had a great time at Patty's place! The apartment is really beautiful, just what you imagine from looking at too many movies set in New York. The location was perfect for us, with delicious dumplings just down the street and some of the best bagels we've ever tasted a few blocks away. All in all, it's a very interesting and vibrant neighborhood. Getting around town is really convenient too, since the subway is located close to the apartment. Patty was an excellent hostess, very helpful and flexible! She helped us out with the wifi and let us keep our luggage in the loft after check-out.

Wonderful apartment, great location and very responsive and accommodating host. Karene lives up to all her five star reviews.

There's windows in every room and the natural light is lovely. Karene told us to help ourselves to the food and we had English muffins and bagels that she left in the freezer, as well as, butter in the fridge - quite a bonus!

We have rented lots of apartments in the past ten years and this was the most pleasant stay and we hope to stay here again.
The apartment is really great und the location is perfect. Karene was so friendly and helpful. All in all a wonderful stay in West Village. We come back for sure.

Karene's apartment was in an amazing location and truly picturesque New York.  Clean, comfortable and very nice, we had a great stay here and  I would definitely come back and stay again. Karene was helpful and close by so if we ever had any questions or needed anything, she was down the street. Definitely a positive experience.

If you are looking for an ideal apartment for your stay in the West Village area, you have found your place. No need to look further. Karene's apartment was a perfect home away from home, and Karene was a wonderful host. The apartment is super clean, and exactly as pictured. In addition, Karene provided all of the little things like a hairdryer, umbrella, extra towels, etc. She was also flexible with check-in and out times, etc. Karene also quickly answered my questions about the area, and even recommended a great sample sale. :) Staying with Karene was like staying in the apartment of a sweet friend where I had lots of privacy.
I have absolutely no hesitation recommending this apartment, and I look forward to a future visit. If you decide to stay here and it's available, lucky you.
- F. Myrtle

Loved staying at this beautiful apartment in the West Village!  Very clean, sunny and surprisingly spacious with a big bedroom (including empty wardrobes so you can unpack!) and large windows facing the street.  The building has an awesome rooftop area and a laundry. Great location with cafes, restaurants, bars, shops and subway very close by.  Karene was super helpful and accommodating.  We would definitely stay here again!

First time with bnb and was undoubtedly a great experience. Very nice apt, clean, comfortable, nice bed and shower, with all the supplies you may need, superbly located. Suitable for a couple. Subway within a 5 min walk. A 24h restaurant around the corner. In the heart of the Village, by far the best place in NYC to stay. Want a "new yorker" experience? Here you go. Above all, a kind, gentle and supportive host. What more one can wish? Thank you Karene!
Wonderful place and experience - would love to book this apt again in the future!

Second time in the apt and nothing to complain about. Always clean. Check-in/out times eased by the host as long as she can, very patient and supportive. Location unbeatable. If one is looking for a cool place to stay, affordable ( less expensive than a hotel ) and convenient in all aspects, say, subway access, pleasant neighborhood, diversity of food & music around, give it a chance. No worries after all, just fun in NYC!!!
Karene's place is in a beautiful building in a fun neighbourhood. She was a welcoming and experienced AirBnB host. The place was very clean and looked like the photos. I would stay there again!

We had a wonderful stay in ny and this apt- we love it. The roof terrace is fanastic. This space is perfect for exploring the area, there are many shops and great restaurant in the environment. The apartment was just as advertised: clean, bright, comfortable. Karene was welcoming and helpful. Great neighborhood.

Great location, in heart of West Village area.  Plenty of cafes/restaurants close by. Very comfortable home away from home. Would like to book again if visiting New York.
A fantastic apartment in a wonderful location - light and airy, spotlessly clean, with everything we needed for a very enjoyable stay. Highly recommended!

I cannot even begin to say how lovely Jane and her home was. The place itself is beautiful, very ornate and the details of the place are amazing. The space was even larger than the pictures. She helped us out-of-towners navigate the subway, parking, and was friendly and quick to respond to any questions or inquiries. We will definitely be back in the future!

Jane’s place is well-appointed and had everything we needed - a well-stocked kitchenette, comfortable beds, a clean bathroom with great water pressure, and lots of charm. It also has a fabulous outdoor space.

Check-in and checkout were easy, and Jane was very accommodating. She offered to make up the pullout couch for us before we arrived, which was helpful.

The property is located on a picturesque, tree-lined street. We took a road trip to visit family and easily found street parking nearby. The location felt safe and although we didn’t go out much because of the pandemic, it’s within walking distance of lots of coffee shops, corner groceries, and restaurants. We visited beautiful Fort Greene Park a number of times, about a block away. There’s a great farmers market there on Saturdays.
Lovely comfortable apartment.  Beautiful  backyard and great location.  Jane is very accommodating and thoughtful.  We had a wonderful stay . Would cone back again
We’ve stayed here twice and will reserve again. Large rooms, large and comfortable bed. Lovely outdoor space. Convenient location close to the park.

Karene's apartment is located just few steps away from Bleecker Street. It's in an exciting location and convenient in the West Village.

Karene is a terrific host. She is responsive to e-mail and text messages/phone calls. Karene met us when we checked in and gave us a list of favorite restaurants and things to do in the neighborhood. She went over everything in the apartment including working the TV/cable box, coffee maker, microwave, water purifier, etc.

She provided an empty closet to hang our clothing with plenty of hangers. A dresser of drawers was also available. Karene had cleared space in the refrigerator and freezer for us too.

Although the apartment building is old, we found the unit it to be spacious and clean. Everything worked well including the plumbing, air-conditioning and lighting. The wireless Internet worked very immediately and was quite fast. The apartment is large (by New York standards) and is very comfortable.

Previous reviewers commented about the bed. My wife and I both were very comfortable on the bed and felt refreshed the next day. The bed was firm, although not too firm.

The apartment building shares a rooftop with the building next door and provides absolutely stunning views. Regrettably, we did not visit the rooftop until our last morning. Had we gone up sooner, we would have made it part of our evening routine. The rooftop has a lovely seating area to enjoy a glass of wine and observe the sunrise or sunset. From the rooftop, you can observe the Empire State Building, the progress of the Freedom Tower and other amazing sites.

We have been traveling to NYC for the last seven years, at least three times a year. We've stayed in at least 25 different New York hotels varying from the very expensive to the least expensive. After staying at Karene's apartment, we would avoid staying in NYC hotel rooms if possible. A rental apartment simply gives you much more for your money.

It would be a pleasure staying at Karene's apartment again.

My friend and i wanted to experience New York like a New Yorken so we stayed in an apartment in West Village for 6 days. It was awesome. The place was spotless and so nice and bright. It was in such a convienient location. I would definatly be staying there again if i can.
Karene's place is great. In an awesome location, apartment is very clean and inviting. Nice bed, linens, fresh flowers made us feel very welcome. I would definitely stay again.

Karenes place is exactly like the pictures show & the neighborhood is the best in New York. Karene is very accomodating & caring as well. We would definately stay here again!

Nadja & Rikard

my daughter and i very much enjoyed staying at Karene's charming village apartment. The location is unmatched and the roof terrace is such a bonus in NY.great view, friendly neighbors and Karene was a wonderful host... very responsive and great to deal with. next time we come to ny we hope the apartment will be available.loved it

Again I had a great stay in ny and this apt. The space was clean and fresh. Karene, thanks for the funny excursion to harlem.
We had a great stay at Karene's! Fantastic location, great flat and the rooftop terrace is amazing. Karene was a very helpful host. Would definitely love to come back next time we are in NYC

We stayed in Karene's place for a week & it was fantastic!  You couldn't get a better location & Karene was a very helpful & flexible host.  The apartment is huge for West Village standards, was very quiet and clean.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Karene & her apartment & look forward to staying with her again in the future.

Karene is a super Host! She just knows how to make you feel welcomed. After our self check-in (Karene was working when we arrived) she came by to make sure that everything was alright. One of the highlights is definitely the roof terrace. We've spent some quality moments up there and got a few more tips about where to go when we met Karene on the terrace.
It wasn't our first time in NYC but it was by far the best time and that is thanks to Karene and her lovely Flat.

Absolutely great. This was the nicest place I ever stayed in NY. It's tastefully decorated (no clutter!) and spotlessly clean. I didn't meet Karene but she arranged for me to pick up the keys nearby & she could be reached through text messages and email & always replied promptly. Highly recommended.

We just had a 10 day stay in Karene's wonderful apartment. Everything was perfect. Clean, cozy apartment that is bigger than we expected from the pictures. Perfect location in West Village with great shopping, restaurants and transportation nearby.
Karene is a great host. Responds quickly and is very helpful with suggestions for things to see or do.
We highly recommend Karene and the apartment and we would love to be back next time we visit NY.

Fantastic apartment in a great location.  Easy access to subway and great restaurants, bars and shopping close by.  Very spacious and clean.  Karene was great at communicating with us and very easy to deal with.  Highly recommended!  We would definitely stay here again.

This was our first time in New York and Karene's apartment was absolutely perfect! We couldn't have asked for a better location, we walked nearly everywhere we went. The apartment was clean and had everything needed for our 8 night stay. Karene was very helpful and answered any questions we had, we will be back!!

There was a problem with collecting the keys which meant waiting for 2 hours in a bar around the corner in the middle of the night - not ideal after 22 hours awake. You are in the middle of three subway stations (although be prepared to walk a lot in NYC, the subways are quite spaced out and we ended up walking miles and miles a day). Patty left some useful tips in the apartment, and there are many
great bars and restaurants nearby - Joe's Shanghai was a favourite. After the initial handover, we never saw Patty - although she lives along the corridor, and we could knock or reach her by text if necessary. All in all, staying here was 10x better than a hotel and I'd return in an instant whenever in New York.

We had very good time at pattys appartement (very cute and confortable). The subway was also 5min away from it. Perfect place for beeing, when you visit new york. Patty was very helpful when we had questions. Best regards!

The apartment is a very nice place to stay!
(Chinatown/Lower Eastside and cloase to other districts like SOHO, TRIBECA...)
Many nice restaurants and bars are located in walking distance and the place is also close to several Subway lines! The apartment itself was nice decorated and we had all the necessities we needed for the stay!
- Thank you Patty, also for the very detailed informations you gave us, we had a great time in the city!
We would stay anytime again in Patty's apartment and can recommend it highly!

Patricia's apartment is the perfect place to explore New York.It is handy to everything anyone would need for any length of stay.I was doing a course and I just loved coming home at the end of the day to the warmth and cosiness.It felt like home very quickly.
It is roomy and and is equipped with everything you could want including food items.This was a huge plus as I did not have to bring much from home as everything was here.
Will certainly stay here again when I return to new York

We had a great time at Patty's place! Everything is exactly like on the pictures. The loft is very cozy, comfortable and clean. It was well equipped with everything we needed during our stay.
