Patricia gave us very detailed information, she is accommodating and flexible with checking in and out times. We would definitely stay here again and recommend both host and apartment!

We had 5 wonderful days in this apartment! It's a perfect starting point for exploring the city! Soho and financial district can be reached by foot for everything other 2 metro stations are around the corner ! The apartment has everything you need for your New York City Trip. The host Patricia helps you and lives on the same floor!

Me and my friend had 12 amazing days in New York. It was the first time we were in the U.S. and the entire stay was absolutely fabulous. The apartment in Chinatown was just like the pictures and it was situated in a perfect location and very close to various subway lines. Patricia was really nice and helped us whenever we needed it.

The apartment was very cozy and clean. However, it was often very hot in the apartment during the day. but since there were several fans and a airconditioner was not a problem.
The same day we arrived at the apartment we had the opportunity to meet Patricia personally and she gave us a few pages she had written about various good restaurants in the neighborhood, attractions, etc. which was very helpful for us. As our plane landed early in the morning we could not get full access to the apartment because the cleaning was not quite ready. However, we could leave the baggage in the apartment, which suited us perfectly.

We would love to come back and stay with Patricia next time we are in the United States!

First off, this was my first ever AirBNB experience, and it was great. Patty was a great host, very easy to get ahold of, and responded quickly. She was very friendly, and left a great list of suggestions in the area. I would give Patty 5 stars as a host for sure.

The apartment is very cute and comfortable, I shared the room with my best friend, she slept in the loft and I slept on the daybed. We never once felt cramped or crowded or in each others way. The pictures are an accurate representation of the unit. The location is great, close to the Grand/Chrystie subway station. It gives you a great authentic NYC experience. The 24 hour deli/market under the building was very useful. We stayed out until 5 am most nights and never felt unsafe in the area or walking back from the subway station.

The only Con I can say about the place was the heat. That is beyond Patty's control and she checked multiple times to make sure we were comfortable. The AC unit works, but it does not cool the whole unit. Being from the South we cling to our AC, so after walking all day in the NYC heat we would come back to a hot apartment. We kept the blinds closed to not let in any extra heat and it was still hard to handle. The bathroom is also very spacious by NYC standards but it has very little ventilation, so since two of us were trying to get ready it often felt like 1000 degrees in there, so we would shower with the lights off, to not add any extra heat. This is a personal preference as far as temperature is concerned and may not be an issue for everyone.

Overall, I would 100 percent recommend this apartment, just know that it may be hot in the dead heat of summer.
This apartment was wonderful and I felt very confident that it was clean the moment I walked in. I would absolutely stay here again.
There is a lovely garden and a nice living room with a big tv hooked up to cable.  The wifi is good.  And the shower has great water pressure.  It is a very cute apartment in a lovely location.
Jane's place is fantastic.  Great location, perfectly clean, and comfortable.  Jane even left fresh flowers for us in the kitchen, much appreciated touch!

Lots of light in the kitchen, huge comfy couch + ottoman. Quality wood floors and tile bathroom. I felt like I had a calm retreat in the middle of Ft. Greene.
Jane’s space is perfect for a special city stay. Jane herself is thoughtful, attentive, and kind. We’re grateful to her for letting us stay there twice now.
great place great host

It’s hard to describe just how beautiful this location is. If the huge, sunny backyard isn’t enough roaming ground for you, you’re just a few paces from Fort Greene park. There’s a real feeling of serenity and charm here.

We had a lovely stay at Jane's beautiful apartment and garden.  So spacious and comfortable (particularly the king size bed!). Jane’s place was great. Very spacious. Amazing outdoor space. Unique light filled kitchenette. High end bathroom. The neighborhood is full of restaurants and cafes. Very quiet and good internet. Jane is super easy to communicate with and a lovely host.
Great place and conveniently located for our needs.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Janes. The location was ideal for us. The listing well represented the apartment and the back yard was a beautiful retreat. We intend to come back!

Loved this place.. the apartment and garden were beautiful and my parents felt very comfortable here. Very close to the park and my father happily explored the various shops/ restaurants close by. Thank you Jane for being a welcoming host!
Great host, great place.

Had a wonderful few days at Patricia's place. The apartment is cosy and functional, and a good vantage point from which to explore Manhattan. Patty's apartment was in a great location in Chinatown, easy walking distance to subway stops and slightly off the tourist trail. Once I got the keys I didn't need to contact Patty again, which is about the biggest compliment I can give! Her new air con works well even on really hot days.

Would definitely stay again!

Nice equiped, homely, clean and comfortable place to stay.
Location is perfect. Patricia has an eye for detail. Would absolutely stay here again. We will recommend our friends for this appartment.
Thanks to Patrica for the warm welcome, hospitality and tips.
Patricia is a lovely hostess. The apartment is clean, comfortabel, well equiped, and perfectly located. Would definately come back!

My girlfriend and I stayed at Patty's place and it was absolutely perfect. The apartment has all of the basic necessities and Patty's recommendations on places to eat in the area are spot on. Thank you Patty!!

Great place in Chinatown, very convenient to everything as the subway is 2 blocks away.  Patty is available if necessary and has good tips about the neighborhood.  We had a fantastic time in NYC and hope to come back soon!

If you like to live for a few days at china town neightbourhood that 's your apartment. It's very close to downtown and you can use the subway to arrive quickly to midtown and central Park. Very good experience!! Thanks Patrice!

Patty's flat is exactly as described, cosy, super well located, and has all you need to spend an amazing time in NYC (ie umbrellas, waterproof, hair dryer and air con etc....)

Great all in all.

Great apartment in Chinatown and really good value. The space is just like the photos and the loft is quite comfortable. Patty was a great host and really proactive. Definitely recommend this apartment if you're looking for a comfortable, clean and great apartment in Chinatown/LES.

Patricia’s Wohnung ist noch viel schöner als auf den Photos! Wir fühlten uns sofort wohl, es fehlte uns an nichts. I highly recommend Jane’s garden apartment for anyone who is in need of a relaxing getaway in a quiet, residential neighborhood.
A beautiful home in the heart of a beautiful, quiet Brooklyn neighborhood.  One block from Fort Greene Park, and within walking distance of everything you could want during your stay.
Clean, beautifully decorated, well-appointed.

This spacious, comfortable, interesting and beautiful apartment was perfect for us (and we ARE parents!).   It was a return after our first stay there eleven years ago.  Jane is a thoughtful host and easy to communicate with.

This is a great find!   The location is perfect.  Top restaurants are within a 5 min walk and Ft Greene park a block away.   The apartment is huge and you really feel like you are staying in a friends home.    The garden in the back is quite nice too.  I would stay here again.   Very quiet too!!
This rental is spacious, clean, and in a vibrant part of Brooklyn.  Jane was friendly and accommodating.   I would stay again when back in the area.

I have nothing but good things to say about Jane's classic Brooklyn brownstone. This spacious apartment is located on a quiet tree-lined street, the decor is tasteful, the furniture is comfortable, the space is clean, and the hostess is friendly, responsive and extremely accommodating.

Great location. Easy check in and easy communication.
Jane is a great host and her property is well appointed, spotless and in a great location.  Stay here - we will do so again!!

Jane was a wonderful host.  We had everything we needed, and the space is large and beautiful.  It was sparkling clean!  We really enjoyed having the outdoor space too. Stop looking now and book this location!

I reserved Jane’s place for my mom’s visit to the neighborhood. Just as the title suggests, it’s perfect for parents. She really enjoyed her stay. The location is perfect a block away from Fort Greene park and all the great restaurants on Dekalb. The apartment itself is clean, extremely quiet, and well-furnished. My mom looks forward to being able to stay there again.
We had a perfect time in NYC. Patty is a great host, the apartment was very clean and is equipped with everything you need!

For an authentic New York experience, this is the place to be. Pattys space is amazing! I stayed here for a month over the Christmas and New Year holiday period. I had touched base with Patty the day before my arrival to coordinate my check in time and was promptly welcomed by Patty and her friend, Renee as soon as I got out of the taxi after a 7 hour flight. This immediately put any nerves to rest as I was travelling alone and had never stayed in Lower Manhattan before, and was naturally a little unsettled as I was arriving in a strange new area late in the evening. The building doorway is slotted in between stores on the bustling retail strip of Canal St, so it is a little hard to see at first glance but is very secure with 2 locked doorways, a buzzer entry and intercom. Patty showed me around the studio and how everything worked before leaving me to my own devices - Everything is provided for a comfortable stay... basics such as toilet paper and wine, just to hold you over until you get the chance to grab some groceries, kitchen utilities, fresh towels, linen, extra bedding if needed.. there really wasnt anything that was missing. The space itself is absolutely beautiful with high ceilings, artistic decor and is very clean. There is a huge west facing window which has a perfect view of the Freedom Tower - (admittedly I chose to shift the sofa bed so that I could see the view as soon as I woke up in the morning.. it really is that great). As a host, Patty was always willing to help out and was literally a few steps away, down the hall. She is warm, inviting and has so much knowledge of the area that is really an advantage for anyone wanting to explore the city like a local. Patty emailed me with some interesting places to visit during my stay and made sure that I was always comfortable in my surroundings. I had even knocked on her door to say hello a couple of times and she welcomed me in for a chat as if I were a real neighbor. The building is on a true Chinatown street which borders Little Italy and LES. There is a 24 hour deli right downstairs that make fresh sandwiches and an asian bakery that sells great coffee & breakfast (thank you for the tip Patty). There is a karaoke bar across the street and a fire station next door, aswell as dollar stores, bars, restaurants, hair and nail salons and fresh fruit/vege markets scattered around the neighbourhood. The area is very safe - It is within a 5 minute walk to the subway station which will take you direct to Times Square, 10 minute walk to Little Italy and SoHo (a shoppers dream). For those who enjoy the local nightlife it is about a 10 minute walk to all the bars...

Our family of 3 stayed for one week.

The apartment is about 3 blocks from the subway.
Chinatown is an interesting area to stay after West Village, good to see different parts of NYC.

Patricia left some notes on the area, which helped.

Loved the bagels from across the road.

The perfect place for visitors who know that there is *a lot* more to New York than Times Square and the Statue of Liberty. Patty's little loft is located on the cusp of Chinatown and the Lower East Side and perfect for strolling around downtown Manhattan or strolling across the Williamsburg Bridge to Brooklyn.

The place is great (unbelievably great for the price) and Patty is a dream. Super friendly and totally hands-off. Basically, she's there if you want her to be and isn't if you don't. We love Patty.

The apartment was exactly as depicted, very well located, everything we needed and Patty was a wonderful host. Very accommodating and helpful. The place was very homey with lots of personality and we would rebook in a minute!
The apartment was perfect, clean, comfortable and perfectly located. Patricia was very kind and helpfull! I had a wounderful time and I will book Patty´s apartment again

What an absolutely great apartment and an absolutely great host in Karene!!! Perfect combination of being aesthetic and comfortable. I would 100% recommend this  apartment.

I had an mazing stay the apartment is super cute and very well located. I wih to be back next time i will be in NY thank you Patricia for having me.
Thank you! We loved our stay here and your the place is so cosy and homely. Hopefully we'll be back soon. Thanks again x

Patty was away for the weekend so her son Henry helped us check in and was very helpful. We arrived early so they kindly stored our bags in their unit just down the hall. When we got into our unit my 18 year old daughters head nearly exploded from excitement. It's a very 'New York' style of studio flat with a lovely view, especially at sunrise when the buildings all turn red. We took a massive bag of washing (nearly everything we own as we have been travelling three weeks) to the laundry downstairs and had it all washed and folded for us for only $12.50. We had dumplings for dinner literally around the corner at Prosperity Dumpling $2.70 for ten! They were so good we had them three nights in a row! The unit is clean, warm even in record low temps, and exactly as pictured. It is a little noisy and the beds a little hard but other than that I highly recommend it. We would definitely stay here again.

We loved Patricia's apartment, and Patricia herself was a very helpful host. The neighborhood is great with good restaurants and bars close by. The place was perfect for me and my two friends with all the facilities needed. We really enjoyed our stay!

Perfect location if you really want to explore the city. East Village, Soho, Little Italy just short strolls away. And everything else is a quick cab ride. All the comforts of home and amazing natural light coming in. Trinkets and great pieces that tied the room together very well. So much character! Described as "cozy", it was more than enough room for two to be comfortable.

Although, we didn't get the chance to meet Patty, she was a gracious host allowing us to check in at 8am after a long flight. She also provided a list of things to do in the area. We felt safe in the building and neighborhood.

Would stay again! Thank you Patty :)

My two friends and I spent a week in Patty's appartment and we had a great time! Everything was perfect and Patty was very flexible about getting and giving back the keys. She welcomed us and took time to give us adresses and many things to do. She was very helping. And when of my friend's flight was cancelled, Patty welcomed her the whole week end in her own appartment. I've never met such a person. She's one of the most wonderful things in NYC!

Really great studio and amazing location (in the busy Chinatown! ) close the best neighbourhood of NY! We arrived very late and Patricia was waiting for us. In the studio you can breath positive energy and an armonic atmoshere. Lovely view from the big window. Our holiday was perfect thanks to Patricia's studio too! Super recomended!!!

Absolutely exceptional,
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement idéalement placé au cœur de Chinatown. Patricia nous a accueilli avec gentillesse et a su se montrer discrète tout en restant disponible. Toutes les commodités de transport ou de restauration (Délis, restaurants) sont aux pieds de l'appartement. Je le recommande pour les personnes qui veulent s'immerger au plus profond de manhattan.

Wir waren eine Woche in Patricia´s Apartment! Alles war großartig. Das Apartment liegt in jeder Hinsicht sehr günstig. Metro ( Verschiedene Linien ) schnell zu erreichen, alle erdenklichen Essenwünsche werden um die Ecke erfüllt und einen Kaffee am Morgen gibt es gleich unten im Haus ( 24 Std. Deli ).
Das Apartment liegt im 6. Stock ( Fahrstuhl ) und ist mit allem ausgestattet, sehr gemütlich und hat seinen eigenen Charme ( Industrie-Charme, supercoole Aussicht ).
Wir waren rundherum zufrieden.

Patricia était particulièrement accueillante et nous a conseillé des endroits sympas dans le quartier. L'appartement est très bien situé, central et à proximité de plusieurs métros. Si je retourne un jour à NY, je reviendrai avec plaisir chez Patricia !

We spent two weeks in New York and were very pleased with the apartment. It is nice and bright, it has lots of character and the view from the window is spectacular. Patty was very welcoming and immediately offered to change the couch into a double bed as the loft access was a bit difficult for me. It’s like she states in her description: we felt totally private, but she was there to call us a taxi back to the airport and she immediately contacted us about an iPad we accidentaly left behind. Thanks for having us, Patty. We had a great time in NYC and we will definitely recommend you to our friends and family.

Notre séjour dans l'appartement de Patricia
a été très agréable. Nous avons trouvé un logement très propre avec du linge de maison à profusion.
Les literies sont confortables.
A notre arrivée, nous avons été très bien accueillis par le fils de Patricia qui nous a donné quelques indications sur le quartier.
Au niveau de la localisation, de nombreux métros desservants différentes lignes sont proches du logement. En bas de ce dernier se trouvent des commerces et des restaurants.
Pour terminer, Patricia s'est occupée de notre retour à l'aéroport en nous envoyant un véhicule avec chauffeur qui était à l'heure
et à moindre coût qu'un taxi.

We had an amazing stay in Patty's apartment.  The space is so cool and in the perfect area.  Easy to get to all the different areas and fantastic on an evening with plenty of arty bars and different restaurants.  We will definitely stay here next time- we are already planning our next trip!

Patricia was very flexible and accommodating upon the several delays of our arrival. She assured us that it would not be a problem and to have a safe travel to get there. She also checked in with us upon arrival to insure we had everything we needed. Upon departure she helped set up a car service to get to the airport which was extremely helpful for our early flight. She went above and beyond! We highly recommend renting from her.

After us Patricia had described exactly everything there was to arrive no problem with the Airtrain or Metro in Chinatown. Thus, we were able to save the taxi fare. We were warmly welcomed by Patricia, and you gave us the same valuable tips where you can best shopping, bars and restaurants  etc ... The apartment was nothing to be desired, it was very cozy and clean, everything we to live and feel needed was available. The apartment is located in a very lively district, it was fine to get to know the time, we were able to sleep soundly anyway. All in all, we would always hire the apartment again. Many thanks to Patricia.

Our time at Patty's apartment was great, it was the perfect base for us to explore NY, and had all the amenities needed (and more) I bought towels, an iron etc with me and none of it was needed. Our flight was delayed and Patty stayed up late to meet us, she was extremely helpful. We'd stay here again, oh and the view of the new World Trade Centre is beautiful! If you like a little eccentricity, and don't mind staying somewhere that's artfully rough around the edges, this is a good bet for you.
Chinatown authentic studio apartment/loft. We where greeted by Patty who made us feel at home. The neighborhood was great and in walking distance to Soho's great restaurants and shopping.
Our stay was perfect! Jane’s place is charming and in a wonderful neighborhood.

This is a beautiful garden apartment with all the architectural details one could hope to see in a brownstone. It’s also comfortable and located in a neighborhood with great restaurants, coffee shops, a nice park and transportation. Check in was easy and the host’s communication was simply the best.

This is a beautiful place to stay in the heart of a wonderful neighborhood and only blocks from a lovely park. We loved everything about the space and it was great to have the garden, which we used often. Jane is a wonderful host.

This cozy, quiet sanctuary is even better in person!!  Jane is an incredible host, making sure we had everything we needed.  The personal touch of greeting us when we arrived was so lovely.  The place itself is BIG by NYC standards and so nicely decorated.  The bed is comfortable and the huge bathroom feels absolutely luxurious.  The big tv and comfy leather couch were perfect after a day of walking around the stunning neighborhood of Fort Greene.  This place is a GEM and we will definitely be back!!
Perfect place to chill and use as a home base in a fantastic apartment on a beautiful street.  Jane is an incredible host.

Great stay! Exactly as described. I took advantage of the back patio which was lovely. Very close to Locals BKNY which I went to every day for breakfast (delicious and the people were very nice!). Very close to Fort Greene Park which was also fantastic.

10/10 experience.  The apartment and decor were so beautiful, in a great location, and huge.  The pictures don’t do it justice.  You will not find a better deal to stay in Brooklyn.  Most importantly, that was the best shower I’ve ever taken.  It’s gorgeous, and the water pressure is like a fire hose.  I felt like I was drowning in the most enjoyable way ever.  I am contemplating booking another night for the shower alone.

Everything was just as pictured and advertised.  We had a very enjoyable stay in this lovely home and neighborhood.  Jane was very responsive to our needs and also respectful of our privacy. I especially enjoyed early mornings reading in her lovely back yard.
Such a beautiful space inside and out
Great stay, very convenient and beautiful space

We loved everything about this beautiful garden level apartment in Clinton Hill, a nice area of Brooklyn near Pratt, and very close to beautiful Fort Greene Park. It is stately and historic feeling, very spacious and clean, comfortable bed and linens, large bathroom and shower with all amenities provided. Uniquely appointed, with interesting books and artifacts/art, and Living room opens out to a beautiful garden space. Kitchen was more than we needed, with coffee and tea provided. AC works well, though we didn't need it much. Host Jane lives in the brownstone, greeted us and showed us the details of the space.

Jane’s place is nice in many ways. It is spacious, elegant, clean, well located, and has an outdoor area. She lives upstairs, she was communicative during check in, and I appreciated that she lent us her iron and let us check out a few hours late. However the kitchen is non existent so definitely don’t expect to do cooking here. The mosquitos are TERRIBLE and you get swarmed when you enter and exit. Unfortunately there was extremely loud construction most days we were there and you could hear everything going on upstairs (thin walls and creaky floors) so we got horrible sleep the whole time.
We very much enjoyed our stay. Jane is such an accommodating and friendly host. And her place is very comfy, cool, and perfectly located. We'd definitely stay here again. Thanks!

What a find! This is a beautiful (and spacious!) apartment in an amazing brownstone on a fantastic tree-lined block in an INCREDIBLE neighborhood with so many great dining options. We stayed here while we were moving our kid into Pratt and we couldn't have been happier with the accommodations.
This is a great stay in a great neighborhood. Jane is an amazing host and the stay couldn’t have been better. Thank you Jane!
The pictures don't do it justice! Beautiful space, great neighborhood, great host! I highly recommend staying here!
Great place, lots of room and fantastic location.  Jane is wonderful - communicative and helpful.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The building was in a great location and the neighborhood had so many eateries within walking distance. The apartment was clean and very spacious and the little kitchen area that looks over the garden was the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee. We very much liked the decor and the historic elements of the brownstone that have been kept in tact. We will definitely rebook the next time we find ourselves in the city!

L'appartement est idéalement situé à Chinatown (à 8min de Soho, 5 de Lower east Side, 15 de East Village). Plusieurs stations de métro sont très proches.
Patricia est adorable, elle nous a laissé une liste de restos dans le quartier et était disponible pour répondre à nos questions. Bien qu'elle ait eu un problème de femme de ménage le jour de notre arrivée, l'appartement était tout à fait propre et fidèle aux photos.
La seule chose qui selon moi peut poser problème dans cet appartement ce sont les 6 étages d'escaliers à monter à pied (l'ascenseur était en panne durant la majeur partie de notre séjour). Après une longue journée de marche à NYC, ces escaliers sont épuisants (ainsi que pour monter et descendre des valises). Je déconseillerai donc cet appartement aux personnes réduites physiquement.
A part cela, je recommande vivement un séjour ici et je reviendrai avec plaisir!

The apartment is nice and well equipped. Patricia was there to welcome us and explain things. Chinatown was a good neighborhood  with lots of shops and transport nearby. We very much enjoyed our stay in Patricia's studio.

Patty is a great host.. She helped us out with some local restaurants and great shopping near by.
The apartment is in a great location, close to everything.
Its a great clean apartment, nice big bathroom. It was great to relax and unwind in our own space

Patty was an excellent host throughout our stay. She remained in contact with us throughout our visit and arranged for someone to meet us upon our arrival, which was appreciated. I cannot recommend the apartment enough - it's in a fantastic location, a great view towards the financial district and is perfect as a launchpad to the rest of Manhatten. It was also easy to get to from JFK. Patty left a list of recommendations for us to browse and we visited a few: favourites include Goodfellas for fantastic pizza and Kossars for bagels. However, if you wanted to eat in then all you need is there. The laundrette right next to the block of apartments is also worth bearing in mind. It cost us less than $10 to do two people's worth of laundry from the last ten days!!

All in all, this little flat is a fantastic place to stay in NYC and I'd recommend it, and the host, to our friends.

What a fabulous apartment. Karenes apartment was immaculately clean, with more than enough space for 2 people. It is in an excellent location, in the heart of lovely west village.  The rooftop garden is a bonus allowing beautiful views and an outdoor space to relax. I would highly recommend this apartment for a couple wanting to explore all that new York city has to offer. Melissa

First Airbnb experience and exceeded our expectations by far! Apartment was better than in the pictures, well organized and clean. Nice neighborhood and public transportation options. Didn't meet Karene but key pick-up and communication worked very well. Roof-top deck is a huge plus to relax after a hectic day in the city. :)

Great place to stay; exactly as described. Clean and comfortable apartment in a great and lively neighbourhood. We really enjoyed our stay, especially drinks on the roof deck. Karene is really nice and helpfull; there when you need anything.

The apartment is perfectly situated for exploring New York with easy access to subways and within walking distance of so many places. We followed Karene's restaurant suggestions and were very pleased with the choices. Very welcoming with helpful suggestions and a lovely bottle of wine. A very clean, charming and excellently placed apartment.
Would certainly use again and recommend to friends and family.

We stayed at Karene's apartment for 2 weeks. It's perfectly located in the lively West Village with plenty of restaurants. The subway station's are within walking distance (5 minutes max).
Karene organised a big surprise for us when she discovered that the water was turned off during the daytime (for just two days) due to construction work in the street.
The roof-top terrace is ideal for having a drink and relax. Also the laundrette downstairs is practical. We'll recommend this apartment to anyone who's looking for a nice stay in New York. Staying here will make you feel like a New Yorker rather than a tourist.

We thoroughly enjoyed our 11 day stay in Karene's apartment which not only met but exceeded our expectations, in an excellent location close to some of Manhattan's key subway lines. Though just one bedroom, it's a clean, spacious, light and airy apartment, simple but comfortable and homely, stocked with everything visitors need. Its walk-up one flight to the floor above the street means it feels excitingly linked to its neighbourhood while nevertheless feeling separate, peaceful and safe. We were always able to relax and unwind after long days of walking off the Big Apple :) The building's rooftop access is another excellent feature of which we made good use! Karene herself is a charming and perfect host: even though she was unavoidably detained during our visit, she could be contacted readily by phone or email and she always responded swiftly and helpfully to our various questions. We had no trouble settling in. She is a truly generous and thoughtful host. We totally loved the historic charm of the West and Greenwich Village area. For us it was the perfect place to stay and we would absolutely stay here again! Thanks again Karene :)

We had a great time staying in Karene's apartment. The location is brilliant. Lots of amazing eateries all in walking distance, we were spoilt for choice everyday (do yourself a favor and get a toasted sandwich at Murray's Cheeses - Oprah endorsed!). The best thing about the Village is you are still walking distance to the hustle and bustle of NY. We walked to Times Square, Central Park etc. It was the best way to see everything. The apartment itself is small, but big enough for a couple. A little on the noisy side, but they were doing road works outside our window most of the week so probably more bad luck for us than anything else. Lastly, the rooftop is stunning. Sweeping views of the city which are breathtaking - which was further complemented by the bottle of wine waiting for us on arrival.

We stayed in Karene's apartment for a week and it was perfect. We found the location really convenient - close to lots of restaurants, shops & only a few mins walk to the subway.
The apartment is a great size for a couple and comes stoked with everything you would need. Karene was very helpful and always easily contactable. Her apartment was a fantastic little home away from home!

We had a wonderful two weeks staying in Karene's apartment- it was a cosy, comfortable and convenient place to be!
We would recommend it to anyone coming to New York.
Thanks Karene!

The location was amazing and Karene was a fabulous host! Everything was so close and we really felt like we were locals. Karene checked in with us throughout our stay and was so efficient, it made our stay so enjoyable. We will definitely be back, couldn't rate this apartment highly enough, it definitely lived up to expectations.

Everything about this apartment was excellent - location, beautifully styled & very clean, and wonderful communication with Karene who checked in with us regularly to ensure all was well. Would love to stay here again next time I find myself in NYC, highly highly recommend!
Amazing place to stay in Fort Greene. Walking distance to the park and great restaurants and night life. Jane's space is cozy and spacious.
We loved the location and the beautiful original details in this typical brownstone.  The eclectic decor was warm and cozy and fun.  Jane was great.
Jane’s space is lovely! Wonderful neighborhood and location. The space was just right for what we needed and communicating with Jane was easy and timely.

The location is fantastic, near lots of different subway stops and good restaurants and cafes. The airbnb is clean and well equipped and Jane is incredibly accommodating. Couldn’t recommend it more highly!
Our second stay in this fabulous apartment while visiting our kid at Pratt. An amazing and spacious apartment in a fantastic neighborhood. So many great dining options and such a beautiful block!

Everything was as it appeared in the listing. The place felt very spacious for the three of us and our teenage daughter found the pullout bed to be very comfortable. Finding parking on the street was a little tricky and there are certain days when cars have to be moved for street cleaning. Jane helped us immensely by moving our car for us during the cleaning period and then got us the spot right in front of the building! She was also helpful in recommending restaurants and places to get groceries. Ft. Greene park is very close and it was easy to walk to several subway stations.
Lovely place, and a very convenient location on a quiet street. Jane was very responsive and accommodating. We would definitely stay here again.
Jane's place is great and perfectly described, my mother loved it!
Jane's space is so lovely, in a perfect area, extremely comfortable, very clean, and she's prompt and communicative about anything and everything. I would 1000% book again, no hesitations!
Great apartment in a very nice area.

We had a wonderful stay at Jane’s place for a couple of days while visiting our daughter in NYC. The location is perfect, wonderful walkable neighborhood, safe, lots to see, good restaurants and beautiful park. We had everything we needed in the apartment. The bed was particularly comfortable and roomy. Jane was delightful.  Easy to communicate with and prompt responses. Highly recommend Jane and her beautiful garden apartment in Brooklyn.

great place. 9 out of 10. it's very cozy, quiet and comfortable. lovingly furnished. location is great.

The only downside is the kitchen is tiny to the point of being borderline unusable. calling it a kitchen is a stretch.

This self contained apartment is on the lower ground floor of the host’s property and is spacious with a lovely homely feel. There are multiple subways with a 10-15 mins walk from the apartment with direct routes into Manhattan in about 20-30 mins.

Would definitely stay here when visiting NYC again!
I loved staying at Jane’s place. The apartment is really large and super cozy. The neighborhood is amazing too. I always stay in this part of Brooklyn and will definitely book Jane’s apartment again.

Wonderful apartment, met our needs well. Very comfortable, quiet. Great neighborhood, good local restaurants, short walking distance to subway. Our host checked with us a couple times to make sure things were OK.
This might be my favorite Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in! The space is spacious and perfectly located. 1 block from the park and down the street from the main area with shops and restaurants.
We had a lovely stay with Jane! Her place was beautiful and neat and the location is fantastic.
We spent some days for holidays in NYC and I can say the apartment was perfect, near a lot of Metro stations and a quite easy walking distance form the Brooklyn bridge.

We stayed at Chaya's place for a week with our 2 kids. We had a wonderful time there, it was such a relief to have all that beautiful open space to come home to after an activity filled day in New York. The loft has a really peaceful feel to it, and it is surprisingly quiet during the night even though it is just around the corner from Bedford street. We loved the sauna, makes me wish we had one at home too...
The apartment is well located, just a block or two from the L train, so getting to and from Manhattan is a breeze.

Our third stay at Karene's apartment, always a good experience. Definitely recommended. A cozy place, an amazing spot in NY (in my opinion the best) and a lovely host, very accommodating. In heavy winter an always warm bedroom awaiting, which was really important this year. Nice bed, nice shower. One flight of stairs, no big deal with luggage. Subway just one make a right/left away. Three times there folks, know what I am saying. Still thinking about it? Hurry up and book it fast!!
The reservation was canceled 63 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

This was our first Airbnb experience and we are really happy with it.
We have spent 6 weeks at Karene's place and had a wonderful time.
The apartment is very cosy, clean and well equipped, we felt like home!!
Karene is very nice and welcoming. She will help you on any matters and respond very quickly if you have to contact her.
We truly recommend this place for a short or long stay.

Karene is a very thoughtful host. Because we had stayed with her a few years ago and had a good experience, she FedEx'd her keys to us because we would be arriving to her apartment after a long tour of Israel and didn't know what time we would arrive. That's going the extra mile and it was very much appreciated. Her apartment is immaculate and very comfortable and it's in a great neighborhood. Our son and his family live a few blocks away so it was very convenient. We visit often and know the neighborhood and the great restaurants that are literally around the corner on Hudson.

There's windows in every room including two in the bathroom so it's very cheerful and a good place to be.

Just a FYI for future guests, the laundry is located in the basement (which is very common). You need to walk down the stairs outside between the buildings. Fortunately I did my wash after a rainstorm and not during. The steps were wet and I just walked carefully. This was not a deal breaker and truly a New York experience for this suburbanite.

This is my first time in NYC and I love Karene's apartment. It was very clean, spacious, bright with natural light and very cozy like home. I stayed here for one month and I had no problem with the apartment at all - the bathroom, the kitchen - everything worked just fine. The location is great too. Close to everything with lots of great restaurants near by. I can walk to my school on fifth avenue very easily and the subway just mins away. Very convenient. Karene is a wonderful host. She met up with me on the first day to showed me around the apartment and gave me list of places to check out. She was very easy to communicate, very helpful and always accessible. She kept in touch with me during my stay to make sure that I have a comfortable stay in her apartment. I had to extend my stay for one night on a very short notice and she made it possible. Thank you so much Karene for all your help. Very appreciated :) I will definitely stay here again when I come back to NYC.

Karene was great. Easy to contact, gave me the full lowdown on the local area and even, very sweetly, left a lovely bottle of wine as welcome. The apartment was amazing. In the heart of Greenwich Village, just off Bleeker Street - at the end where all the boutiques are - and just round the corner from the incredible cupcakes of Magnolia Bakery. The apt. was cool and airy even though the weather was scorching in New York and really quiet despite being in the heart of the village. Can't recommend it, and Karene, highly enough!

Fantastic apartment in the heart of Greenwich Village. Very clean and comfortable, less than five minutes from the subway. It has a communal terrace with wonderful views. Karene was a perfect hostess. Thanks Karene.

I had a wonderful stay at Karene's apt. It's super located, in the heart of West village. The apt is very spacious, bright and cosy. Stayed 6 weeks and everything worked fine. And Karene is a wonderful host. Hope to come back to Karene's apt in my next vacations in NYC.

This was our first time staying at a airbnb listing and the experience was extremely positive.The listing was just as described and Karene was a terrific host who settled us in and supplied all the essentials of apartment living in a truly comfortable, clean, and well designed space. Since our stay was quite long we were traveling with more luggage than normal and the apt had more than sufficient closet and drawer space for our things.
We are familiar with quite a few different neighborhoods in Manhattan and can't say enough about how wonderful it was to stay
in the West Village this time. It is filled with wonderful eating establishments and shops and it is also convenient walking distance to so many other interesting neighborhoods. Karene's apt. is in the perfect location to take advantage of all that the West Village has to offer.
My husband and I would not hesitate to recommend this listing
to our friends and we would love to return there for another visit
in the future. Thanks Karene

Wonderful stay at Karene,s. Apartment offered everything I needed during my stay. The area has so much to offer and never ran out of places to eat and things to do. Karene was always available and responsive. This was my second stay and will definitely stay again

There's no place like home but Karene's apartment runs a very close second. The location is brilliant; just around the corner from the best boutique shopping strip in nyc and dozens of great restaurants . And, when you're done eating and shopping, you'll find the apartment a comfy, cosy, home away from home.

Our stay at Karene's apartment was perfect! The place is cosy and warm, even during cold nights, the bed very comfy and the blanket super soft and warm too.
Karene has been a great host, always available by phone and super reactive when necessary.
The kitchen has everything you need for cooking and have breakfast.
Definitely a place to stay for a good trip in NYC.

Great location and a wonderful stay! Quality restaurants, cafe's, boutiques and subway all very close by. Beautiful street and neighbourhood. Karene was in touch in advance, very helpful and made the arrival extremely easy -  also touching base during my stay to make sure all was well. Thanks again Karene - a fantastic place to stay in NYC!

My stay here was fantastic! The apartment was beautiful, it had everything needed for a short/long stay and it was in a great location. Karene is so lovely and was always really responsive when I had any questions at all.

I'd highly recommend a stay here, I will definitely be going back! :)

The flat was perfectly situated just a few yards from Bleecker Street and very close to the subway. It was comfortable,  well equipped and very clean. The only drawback was sound insulation, street sounds could sometimes be a bit disturbing. The general impression of the flat was quite good and we would gladly return. Our host was very nice, hospitable and helpful and really made us feel welcome.

Karene's apartment looks exactly like the pictures. It was very clean, quiet and convenient, next to many restaurants and bars and a block away from a subway station. Karene was very responsive and helpful. We enjoyed a lot our stay and would definitely recommend her place to anyone who would like to explore the city!

From arrival to departure our stay at Karene's place was perfect, the keys were waiting for us exactly where she said they would be and the apartment is exactly as pictured and described. The West Village location is amazing and we spent the week pretending to be real New Yorkers :) Communication with the host via e-mail was friendly and we had no need to contact Karene as she had already provided all of the information we needed.

Karene is a great hostess. She made us feel very welcome in her lovely appartment in the middle of West Village, gave us excellent tips and was very responsive to any questions. Her appartment is just perfect and we felt immediately at home. It was so much more than we could have hoped for. Karene, thank you so much!

So Karene met us at the apartment and it was similar to what we expected. In this case, the old adage of location, location, location is highly relevant.
Location#1 - There are great restaurants, shops, bars, music, the Hudson and more all with a few blocks - you are in the West Village where New York never sleeps!
Location #2 - the police station is next door so sirens. The restaurant across the street is great but they throw their trash out at 1AM pretty much every night and it is picked up between 5-6AM every day. The windows are old so all noise comes though - earplugs are a must as music was not enough.
Location#3 - inside of the apartment - needs to be updated. While it is comfortable in size for 2 on a temporary basis and Karene has outfitted it with necessities, the inside needs to be redone - which Karene advised would be coming soon.

We had a great time and loved having Buvette, Cowgirl, Tartine and the Jazz clubs all a short walk away.

I stayed here for over two months and every aspect of my stay was perfect. I've been coming to NYC every summer for the past few years and this apartment was the most beautiful, the least cluttered and felt the most like a home away from home. I was so sad when I had to leave! Karene was a most gracious host, helpful but not intrusive. And gorgeous to boot! Stay here, don't give it a second thought. (But know that summers are MINE, till the end of time. Haha)

EIN BIJOU MIT STYLE
Karene hat uns herzlich empfangen. Auch Ihr Gastgebergeschenk (eine Flasche Rotwein) war jeden Schluck wert. Nochmals vielen Dank Karene.

Die Dachterrasse war unglaublich toll. Sehr gepflegt und ruhig. Meine Freundin und ich haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Wir können diese Wohnung wärmstens empfehlen.

As so many others have said, Karene's place is in the BEST neighborhood location!  I ate a few times at Quarter on the corner and a waitress even gave me a hug the last time! Karene is hospitable and gracious, regularly checking in by message and willing to help if necessary.  W 10th can get a little noisy in the morning with trash pickup, deliveries, and buses, and this was a month of additional construction as well...  I found it all rather invigorating.  The apartment was very clean and welcoming with plenty of room. There are plans in the works for updating the kitchen area, which will be cool. It was easy to use the shared laundry facilities in the building. Life is good in this place!
We had an amazing time in Karene's wonderful apartment. She was a great host, excellent communication and we had everything we needed. Highly recommended.

Karene was fantastic - she went out of her way to make out reservation possible even though it was back-to-back. She then check-ed in with us regularly to make sure all was in order. The apartment is perfectly located, in good condition, and exactly the right size for a NY visit.
Lovely apartment in perfect location. Karene met me to show me around the apartment at my arrival. Very happy stay.

We had a great time staying at Patricia's. Everything was smooth and easy, and there was plenty of space. The loft bed was quite hot but Patricia thoughtfully provided fans for up there. The area was interesting and there was always something to see. Thanks Patricia

Patricia flat is fantastic and is a perfect location near soho, nolita and little Italy, the view is fantastic. Patricia is very nice, she gave us a lot of good advices and helped us to get to the airport on our last day. I highly raccomend this place.

We thoroughly enjoyed Patricia's place. If you are looking for the New York funky artist loft experience, this place is wonderful.  The apartment was spotless and completely ready for us when we arrived. Patricia remained available for questions throughout our stay. Location is very good. Nothing negative to say about the place. I thought is was great value for the money. I will definetely be back.

The apartment is great and Patty herself is very accommodating. It's good to know she's down the hall of you need her but otherwise she left us to our holiday! We liked the location in Chinatown, really convenient for trips to Brooklyn as well as heading uptown. Definitely recommended.

L'accoglienza di Patricia è stata ottima, ci ha aspettato nonostante il ritardo di due ore da parte nostra.
Si è mostrata molto disponibile nell'aiutarci a capire i punti di riferimento e come muoverci a New York.
La descrizione dell'appartamento era corretta.
La location ottima.

We enjoyed a smooth arrival with Patty, who was there to greet us when we arrived. After showing us the ropes and giving us a handy list of recommended places nearby, she gave us privacy to get settled in.

The apartment itself was perfect for us—very NYC, and just the right amount of space. It's a former jeweler's shop, so the walls are quite thick—I swear we didn't hear a neighbor once for the week we were here. It's also spotlessly clean, which is one of the things I value the most in an Airbnb.

We've stayed at many Airbnbs over the years, and this was by far the most well-stocked. There were full-sized toiletries in the bathroom, including unique products that I assume were left behind by Patty's international guests. The kitchen has the essentials and bonus treats, like lemon tea.

We slept on the pull-out sofa bed since it was supposed to be a bit warm, and it's the best night's sleep I've had outside of my own bed. Since you're in a city, I would recommend bringing earplugs for the AM traffic noise, but turning on the A/C unit in the window helped with 90% of the standard city sounds.

Would stay again in a heartbeat! Great value, great location, great overall.

Despite the mixup with the arrival time Patricia was very welcoming, friendly and accomodating to our needs. Helpful in providing local knowledge on food and shopping in the area. Location suited us and what we were in New York for. The apartment space was good for three woman, would be a tight fit for any more. Only negative was the beds and the pillows - were not comfortable and we are in desperate need of a good nights sleep. The hustle and bustle (sirens) from the street were all part of the New York experience. Laundromat downstairs and local diner across the road were a bonus.

Patricia made us feel welcome despite us running an hour late due to transportation issue from New Jersey.  We really enjoyed staying in the apartment and it was very convenient, and well stocked.  Noise was an issue but I suspect this was common in New York and you'll need to bring ear plugs.  Brooklyn is very easy to get to from Patricia's apartment, but travel to upper Manhattan does take 20 - 30 minutes on the subway. Chinatown is very cheap to stay in compared with the rest of Manhattan, and there are extremely cheap take away eateries nearby ($4 - 5 for a box of rice with meat, $1 buns).  We did leave the apartment without successfully contacting Patricia, so we hope she got the keys, and the cleaner can access the apartment in time for the next guests!

We never got to see Patricia because of the busy schedule we had, but that made no difference as the apartment was as described, it was nice and clean, had everything you needed, even if you wanted to eat in. It was in a good area  “China Town” which is a great place just to walk round. The "Freedom Tower" could be seen from the window, that and Brooklyn Bridge was about 1 mile away. and easy to walk too if your a walker like us. There was a great American diner close by “Cup and Saucer” where we had our breakfast, and for an evening meal the “Pies & Thighs” just down Canal Street was great also.  Sleeping in the loft was an unusual, but enjoyable experience also.  Great value for the money, would recommend to anyone, and would stay there again next time we visit New York.

We had a great time in NY and staying at Patricia's was a joy. She is an excellent host and very helpful. I contacted her early and she responded to all my questions promptly. She was there to meet us and she lives just down the hall. This saved the day as she printed out concert tickets for me last minute! Her list of tips we followed frequently. The loft is just as described and even more spacious than in the pictures. The pull out bed is big and comfortable. I agree with other reviews about the location - perfect launchpad. The only fault I can find the is the the window. It is big with beautiful views but wind blows in around the AC - unit. This seems to be a NY type of thing though as I noticed this in other places.
All in all, this a fantastic place to stay and a bargain. I recommend it highly.

This loft was incredible.  I last lived in NYC in a Soho sublet and Chaya's loft easily surpasses even that experience.  The kitchen had everything we needed.  The bed was wonderfully restful and the shag rug by the wall-sized projection system had memory foam underneath.  Not to mention the sauna.  And all this for less than what we were prepared to pay for the Hotel Chelsea.  My friends were blown away.  We hope our next vacation to NYC corresponds to one of Chaya's vacations.

Simply AWESOME! We felt right at home at Chaya's loft.  It was clean and beautiful.  All the comforts of home. Maybe too comfortable.  We didn't want to leave! The location was perfect. WAY better than staying in a hotel room.  Worth every dime and then some.

Beautiful loft. The best place I've stayed in NYC. Hands Down! So many cool touches to the place. The kitchen is great and we had several dinners here. The rug is super comfy! The place was super clean.
The loft is very close to the subway (1 stop from Manhattan). Bedford ave is full of interesting shops, bars and nightlife. nearby I recommend the following:

shopping- Williamsburg flea market on saturdays, Bird, Meg

eating out: Diner, Marlow and Sons, Bozu, Walter's, Five Leaf, Fette Sau, Saltie, Egg, Pies n Thighs

bars: Union Pool , Hotel Delmano, Brooklyn Bowl

I would definitely recommend this place to friends and stay here again.
Nice place, and although I didn't meet Chaya, talked to her on the phone and we worked everything out great.

Chaya's loft was in a perfect position for exploring both Brooklyn and Manhattan. We were slightly disappointed with the level of cleanliness when we arrived (we couldn't tell if the bed had fresh sheets or not, for instance), but that said, we had a comfortable and enjoyable stay over all.

Chaya gave us some good tips for the area. We ended up trying Best Pizza (on a night we had to stay in and wait for a lost bag to be delivered by an airline) and it was great. I can also highly recommend Diner for brunch!

The photos don't do Chaya's place justice!  Without exaggerating, we couldn't believe our eyes when we first walked in.  It was huge, a very cool layout, and beautiful.  They have their own sauna!  Is this normal in Brooklyn?  We had 3 people in our party and visited at the end of august for 4 days/nights.  Hurricane Irene had caused nyc to shut down the mta and it looked likely we were going to spend 2 of the 4 days stuck inside.  Despite this, we were very thankful to have such a comfortable space that felt like home.  It was a very special trip and this space had a lot to do with that.  Thank you, Chaya!  Your place would be my number one choice to stay in NY!

Chaya's apartment  is amazing and even nicer than it looks in the photos.  The location was perfect for exploring Brooklyn and so close to the subway that you can be in Manhattan in no time at all. We also stayed in a nice hotel in SoHo on our trip but it didn't even compare to how good Chaya's place is, we would recommend it to everyone. Thank you.

We loved Chaya's apartment.  It is very well appointed including the kitchen which had everything I needed to cook up a storm.  The bed is so comfortable that it rivals my own at home.  We really loved the projector and watching football and movies on the huge wall.  The neighbors are very quiet, and the neighborhood is great and so quiet despite being just feet off of a main street. It is a perfect place to hang out even though getting away is easy with  the subway only two blocks away We are definitely planning on staying here again

Nathalie's brownstone truly is eden in the hood. What makes it even more special is that Nathalie is an easy going, friendly and welcoming host, who very much leaves you to it, but you can call on her any time for a chat or for help.

The apartment is stunning and is beautifully decorated in an antique style, with every attention to detail. It it were a hotel, it would definitely be one of the best suites. The sunny terrace is a massive bonus, it's lovely to sit out there and have your morning coffee, while everything you might need has been thought of. It's a home from home.

The neighbourhood is great, real people, friendly and helpful. There's loads to check out nearby, further down Fulton Street. When I was here there was a great art fair, and Habana Outpost, with outdoor film screenings and frozen margaritas is a must. Manhatten is a 20 minute sub ride away, but Times Square will feel so fake after you've stayed here, I guarantee it.

Would highly recommend Nathalie as a host and her brownstone as a place to stay in New York. I had a wonderful time. Thanks Nathalie.

Karene's place was perfect! I stayed at her apartment for a whole month and enjoyed it very much.
The location is great - close to public transport and the West Village cafes and restaurants.
The apartment is fully equipped with everything you need - full kitchen, clean sheets and towels. The building is clean and well maintained as well, including the laundry room and garbage room.
Next time I'm in the city, I'll definitely try to book this place again.

I stayed at Karene’s West Village apartment for about a month. Great space, amazing location, and Karene was a terrific host. The apartment is clean and looks like the photos. I would recommend this booking without hesitation to anyone looking to enjoy all that the West Village and NYC have to offer.
Great apartment, wonderful location, so clean, karene was such a great host and very good communication. Would highly recommend

I stayed at the apartment for 3 months and it was perfect. You can’t be in a better location than where it is, close to bars, shops, loads of restaurants, clubs etc and really close to other parts of lower Manhattan. Karene was extremely hospitable and very quick at responding to any requests. She is very kind hearted and always tried her very best to make sure I was happy and comfortable. I hope to stay here again, I would 100 percent recommend this apartment and landlord!

Karene was a perfect host, kind and quick to respond. The one bedroom apartment is clean, nice, and located in arguably the best neighborhood in manhattan. I loved staying here and would recommend it to anyone who is seeking a convenient / lovely nyc stay.

Karene’s place was fabulous and in the most excellent position. It was a really great New York experience!! The apartment was perfect for our three month stay and near many top restaurants and bars. It was a quick five to eight minute walk to the subway. Very handy!  The West Village has the best atmosphere and being near Bleecker Street and walking distance from Soho was a major bonus! Karene was very friendly and helpful and available to help out if needed. Overall, a great stay and we would love to come back! 😀

I’ve stayed in this beautiful, sunny apartment for 2 months (Jan-March) and my stay was incredible. The apartment is in an amazing location in West Village near great amenities, shops, bars, restaurants with great public transport. I was there during the winter and the apartment is warm and cozy. Karene has been the best host. She is friendly and attentive. She was super quick in answering my calls and texts and she went out of her way many times to make my stay as comfortable and easy as possible. I’d highly recommend staying here.

We spent 2 months at this apartment and really enjoyed. The location could not be more perfect. Karene was very communicative and our stay included cleaners every other week which was nice to have. The space was warm and cozy. Lots of sunlight all day through the bedroom windows that reached into the rest of the apartment through french doors. I’d stay there again next time we come to NYC.
Karene was very attentive and responsive. All needs are met. Spot is super clean, spotless. The most amazing location!! Really cute windows, great natural light. Don’t miss on this one.
Love this place! Would 100% stay again. Perfect location, amenities, and spacious room! Didn't feel too cramped, was perfect for one person and very clean.
Would 100% stay again! Great location, clean place, and easy communication with host

I highly recommend Karene’s place! This is a great apartment in a great location. Conveniently located for transportation and in a great part of the neighborhood and quiet. The apartment has strong WiFi that can support a full day of video calls, if you’re WFH, and comes with a desk and chair. It also includes lots of closet space and the place is very clean. The big windows make it a very sunny, bright, enjoyable place - and that’s not even including the amazing roof top.

Karene is a great host - she’s very responsive and accommodating! When she wasn’t available to meet me when I checked in, she sent detailed and super clear instructions (with pictures!) that made it a breeze. Throughout my stay she was very communicative.

Karene was a tremendous host, and her place was amazing!  There was so much great light, and the apartment was spotless.  This was the sixth apartment I've rented in NY on a short-term basis (I stayed in Karene's place for seven months), and her place was the best-stocked of any apartment I've stayed in: spices, oil and vinegar, lots of kitchen equipment, cleaning supplies, etc.  There was also a ton of storage for an apartment that size.  And I can't say enough about the neighborhood.  The West Village is such a fun place, and a terrific Italian restaurant and wonderful coffee shop with super friendly baristas were literally right across the street.

Beautiful and cosy apartment, in the nicest area of Manhattan. The apartment is bright and calm, well organized and with lovely taste.
Central to the city, close to metro, restaurants, shops and theatres, the perfect place to stay.

Our stay aw Maison Des Sirenes was enjoyable for its comfort, quietness and amenable layout. It fit our location needs for this visit with variety of amenities nearby (ie. groceries, nice wine store, subway. I would definitely return as a result and recommend it as well. On a star qualification I would rate it a 4 with a lot of value for the money.

Nathalie is a fantastic host!  She was available to give us advice and directions whenever we needed them.  Maison des Sirenes is beautiful.  It feels so much like home.  The apartment is decorated eclectically, and is very clean. The kitchen is well equipped.  Nathalie has also made restaurant and site seeing guides for her guests to use.  There are plenty of maps available too.  We used the bus map a lot! Williamsburg is not too far away, and has a neat vibe to it, with yummy food and fun shopping.  We ate at Bliss and stopped into a shop called Whisk, before we went to see a show at the BAM.  We also had an amazing dinner at an Italian restaurant only a few blocks away called Saraghina.  Nathalie recommended it to us, and we loved it!  I must be honest and share that I did have concerns about the neighborhood at first because my sister and I were the minority, which is a huge switch coming from white suburbia.  However, nobody bothered us, or even gave us a sideways glance.  I think our discomfort came from our own selves.  We ended up putting our concerns aside, and walked to dinner in the evening and had a great time.  I want to thank Nathalie for being so welcoming and hospitable.  We would love to come back!

Nathalie's place is just amazing. We felt in lovewith it as soon as we saw the pics here, but what you find when you get there is even better. Nathalie is super nice and helpful if you need her but even when she lives downstairs you won't even notice her unless you search for her. The apartment is decorated just as seen in pics, but there are beautiful details that you only see once there, such as candles, cd player with relaxing music, everything you may need in kitchen and bathroom and a beautiful terrace that we'll defnetely come back to enjoy in summertime! The place is sooo charming and you can feel the good energy as soon as you go in, it's really like feeling at home!
The neighborhood is save and the subway is close. While staying there we had to take a few flights and the location is just perfect for reaching the airport (by bus, subway or taxi).
Thank you so much for everything Nathalie, it was a great experience and we'd definetely recommend your place to our friends.
Easy to deal with and friendly. Very close to Williamsburg bridge.

Great week at Vivi's place.
I spent a week with my two daughters in Williamsburg. The appartment is ideally located between the J and the L subway, both one stop to Manhattan. Great restaurants all around without the feeling of crowdiness you've got in the east village.
The appartment is nothing like luxury, but a clean and nice place.
So, if you expect a 5 stars hotel, this is not your place. But if, like me, you prefer to stay at your friend's place when visiting a city, this is perfect.

The flat was nice and comfortable, the neighborhood (Williamsburg) is great, cool bars and shops, and very well located (only 1 stop away from Manhattan).
Besides, Viviana was very nice and easy to deal with.
Thanks for all !

Viviana's place is a beautiful, clean and nice apartment.
Viviana was such a great host, she helped us a lot in our stay. Besides she makes awesome colombian food in Smorgasburg Food Market, just a few blocks away from the apt.
The neighbourhood was perfect. Lots of bars, restaurants, markets and everything you should want (and really nice) just within a 4' walk. And really easy access to Manhattan. JMZ and L trains just a few blocks away.

Higly recomended.

Vivis Apartment is really located in the heart of Williamsburg, a young and lively neighboorhood. The apartment is comfortable to live in for two people (we stayed there for a week), lovely decorated, clean and with a super comfortable bed. Vivi is very nice and cooperative host. It's only one subway stop to Manhatten, you can get there really quickly. On weekends, there's a lot going on in Williamsburg, nice places to have brunch, flea markets and more.
The one and only downside is the small and old bathroom, wouldn't recommend this for people who need space in their bathroom or want to stay longer than a few weeks. Though we always had hot water and it was clean!
But in total, we totally recommend this place :)

Patty's place was awesome! If you're ok in being in the downtown area, this is the place to book. Patty was extremely hospitable by making sure that my friend and I were in good hands. She recommended places to visit and eat and when welcoming us, she gave us a run through of her flat and what to do when checking out. Her flat, as mentioned earlier, is so artsy, quaint and homey! When needing to retire from a day's filled with people on Broadway or from a visit to a museum or two, Patty's place is just the place to relax. I highly recommended her place. :)

Jojo

The apartment was perfect for what we needed and Patricia was great. I would highly recommend staying here if you fancy something a bit different from the usual hotel chains. There are plenty deli's and diners nearby and it's only a short walk to the underground. The apartment itself has everything you could need and is spotlessly clean. We wouldn't hesitate to return.
As pictured and  great host. Perfect location. Had the best time. Thanks Patricia ❤️

Absolutely delightful! Patricia greeted us on arrival - quite late, but it was no problem for her. Beautifully presented apartment. No noise at night. Lots of tips on where to eat and visit locally. Fantastic location. Within walking distance of East Village and Soho. Excellent little boutiques and coffee shops nearby. Can't recommend Patricia more highly. Will definitely visit again.

We had a great time at Patricia's place. Spending 9 days there, it was the perfect place to stay. Exactly as described. She was very helpful and gave great tips for what's around the neighborhood. Great location that is quiet but very close to main subway stations which take you straight to Central Manhattan. Loved the experience. Highly recommended.

Patricia was a great host and made us feel very welcome. She met us in the apartment when we arrived, talked us through everything and told us a little about the area (she had also printed out lots of useful info which was really handy).

The apartment had everything we needed. It's quirky and you need to climb up and crawl into the bed which is on a mezzanine level with a number of pipes to navigate around. But cosy and warm up there.

I'd happily recommend this apartment and host.

Hi! I would strongly recommend Patricia as host! I've been in NY for 8 days, the apartment was clean, with a beautiful view and fully furnished. I really felt like at home. Patricia is a very nice host, she was helpful and thoughtful. Furthermore, the apartment is in an amazing location, you can reach any place in a walking distance or take the trains, you have several lines all around canal street.
I would definitely love to stay at her apartment again.thank you Patty, hope to see you again soon!

Patricia's loft was the perfect space for our weekend trip to New York! The three of us had plenty of space and slept comfortably. The view from her window was lovely and provided great natural light. The location was very convenient. Despite being in the city for the big Jonas Blizzard, we had a wonderful time and made a lot of great memories. Patricia was extremely helpful and made sure we were taken care of, especially during the special weather circumstances.

We stayed for 5 nights in Patricia's apartment. It was in a handy location near to the tube. Patricia was very helpful and made it our trip very easy, especially as we had a 5 month old baby with us. I would recommend the use of her apartment.
I had an excellent time in this apartment. The place was great and Patricia was very welcoming and helpful. I would definitely consider renting it again if I went back to New York.

My friend and I had a great time at Patricia's apartment. I didn't get a chance to meet her myself, but my friend said she was absolutely lovely, very welcoming when he checked in. She was available if we needed her, which was important. She left some amazing recommendations (very well-organized) for food, nightlife, etc. in the area that we loved. The area is very hip and close to a lot, which made it ideal for our stay.

Whenever I texted Patricia, she got back to me very quickly and was really accommodating. She even let us keep our bags in the apartment since we had evening flights. The place was very clean and there was a cleaner doing a full clean again after our stay when we went to pick up our bags. She had the beds made up, tons of blankets and anything else we'd need, towels galore in the bathroom, and toiletries for use if we needed them.

The place itself was very cute. It was bright and airy and had a great view of the city. It felt like an artist work space and even has an old safe used for storage and an old floor safe, which was really interesting. There were interesting architectural features in the apartment, yet it was also comfortable and had everything we needed. There was an elevator so no schelping our bags to the 6th floor - thank God! It was surprisingly quiet except for a few hours, 8-11 or so, for being in such a busy area.

My only criticism, and it's something Patricia has no control over but worth noting for people that this would be make or break for, had to do with the cigarette smoke smell in the evenings. Each evening after 10 I noticed that there was a pretty strong smell of cigarette smoke, particularly up in the loft area. It seems that the next-door neighbor is a heavy smoker and for some reason that was the time of day that I could really smell the smoke coming through the wall. It was a bit uncomfortable for me, but overall okay. I know that someone that really has a problem with cigarette smoke might be bothered by it and so this wouldn't be the best choice for those people.

Everyone else, stay here. It's fab!

this flat is very confortable, near to some subway stations. I stayed there for 5 nights with my sons and I stayed very well. It's very clean. If you want to cook something you have all the necessary. Patricia is a very nice person, she can help you if you need something. The only thing that can be improved is the frame of the window....in the windy days the air enters into the room and can disturbe.
I recommend you this accomodation however!

We spent five days as guests of patricia in her apartment in the middle of chinatown and it was great!
Patricia is a very nice and helpful hostess who provided us with valuable tips. The key handover worked flawlessly and we were taken on a very warm.
The apartment is very conveniently located and you can easily reach every part of the city with de subway. The next station is only about ten minutes from the Cana Street.
We had a stunning view from the window on the one world trade center.
We would as hostess recommend Patricia absolutely !!
Thanks for this very pleasant stay!
kind regards
Tina
Lovely stay. Fantastic location. Patty was a great host.

The accommodation was perfect with a 24 hour store below. Patty was amazing and made us feel much at home. We loved not being in a hotel and enjoyed the location with two train stations close by. Easy walks to all major parts including little italy and brooklyn bridge.  Would recommend to anyone and will be back to stay.

The apartment was fantastic - just the right size for both of us and with an amazing view to Freedom Tower. Patricia had left some very good tips and recommendations which we definitely hit up. I had the best bagel in my life! Everything that you want for a stay is there and although we had good intentions of cooking a meal in the apartment, Lower East Side and the East Village just had too many enticing eating and drinking options. The subway stops are all very close by and convenient to most places so it is really ideally located. We didn't meet Patricia on arrival but she had arranged the keys for us and she is only in the apartment down the corridor. When we did meet she was warm and helpful and even organised cheap transport for us to the airport.

Patty made us feel very welcome, the place is cute and the location is superb. Patty will let you know anything you need to know about the area and the good places to go.
Easy access to Grand St or East Broadway subway station.
We had a great stay and can only recommend her highly.

Dear Patricia
it was a great pleasure to meet you and your family/friend- und to live in your really wonderful "studio".
The view outside is gorgeous at every time and every wether.
Thank you for your hospitalty and great tip:
"The Cornelia Street Cafe" 29 Cornelia Street, Greenwich Village
with live music in the atmospheric little basement und tasteful steaks.

We were able to do very interesting things only in walkable distance:
walking over the Manhattan Bridge - beside the Dumbo (under the Brookling Bridge) nice places to be - sometimes live music..the amazing view to Manhattan by sunset (and after..) from the little "beach" - and back over Brooklin Bridge.
Directly the "Eldrige Street Synagoge" - when interesting in old jewish history of Manhattan
Great food surround, great markets, people...
And later :coming home at the cosy flat!! Here we felt immediately at home...

Thank you, thank you, thank you.
Best regards
Sabine & Jürgen

Patricia's place was perfect for myself and my two sons. It is bright, clean and comfortable and in a great location! Patricia was very welcoming and available if we needed her for anything. I would highly recommend staying here. We had a fabulous time!

The apartement is REALLY cozy, and Patricia is an excellent host. We felt very much at home, and it was always a wonderful feeling to come home after an exciting day in this fantastic city.
The location is cool, especially if you like the Lower Eastside, Tribeca and Brooklyn, and we also loved walking up to the East Village and SoHo. Traveling further uptown or to the West Side is no big deal either. And we've got around A LOT. We loved to live on Canal Street, exactly where Chinatown meets an arty, cool, rising neighborhood.
The apartment is clean, and has a very personal touch. It has a lovely livingroom/kitchen and a nice bathroom. The "bedroom" is special, but we loved it. The flat is on the top floor and you have a nice view. There is an elevator, but it must be the slowest in New York: it took exactly the same time to bring us to the 6th floor as the one that took us up to the 66th at Rockefeller Center!
Thanks Patricia! We had a great stay!!
Patty非常好，还有十分可爱的Charlie，公寓就在曼哈顿唐人街，有我们想要的一切！

Patricia did I wonderful job making us feel at home. She had information on all the nearby restaurants, bars, cafes, shopping centers, and transportation instructions. There was an electrical issue during my stay and she had it fixed within hours. I would come back and stay again.
The appartment was really cozy with a great view of the Freedom Tower. The location on lower east side is just great with a lot of good restaurants just around the corner!
Patricia is very friendly and help us set up. The place is at a great location. And there are a lot of restaurants nearby. Love this room, especially the loft!

I visited New York for a weekend with three friends and we were instantly smitten with Nathalie's gorgeous home. It's spacious (plenty of room for four people), convenient, and above all, replete with personality and character. Throughout the trip, my friends and I remarked countless times how glad we were to be staying at Nathalie's place in Brooklyn; not only did we get to see interesting neighbourhoods many tourists never experience, returning to Maison des Sirenes at the end of the day always felt like going home.
