There were thoughtful touches or details in every corner - a hairdryer and towels were provided, the kitchen was stocked with pots/pans/utensils, binders were stuffed with restaurant recommendations. The terrace was also marvelous - perfect for winding down at the end of a long day in the city.

Nathalie is a lovely host too. We were stuck in traffic while driving to NYC and arrived hours late -- at 3 a.m.! -- and Nathalie remained ever gracious and friendly, staying up to welcome us. I feel really lucky for finding Nathalie and her apartment and I would be more than happy to stay there on any return visits. I recommend it wholeheartedly - thank you so much Nathalie!
The apartment is warm and cosy. Travelling from there to Manhattan is very easy. Nathalie leaves recommandations and reviews to her guests. Really helpful!

Me and my friend Veronica stayed for a week in Nathalies lovely appartement! We had a perfect stay and Nathalie was helpful and kind. The terrace was lovely for a cold beer in the late summernight or for an early breakfast! I will absolutely recommend this appartement for my friends! Johanna

Amazing time...
Her place is so cute and has everything you need
Love the neighborhood will definitely go back next time I'm in NY..Saranghina the italien restaurant around the corner is amazing a real pearl in the hood..: ) I loved everything about my stay at Natalie...

The apartment is beautiful.  Nathalie is kind and gracious.  The neighborhood is so amazing.  (My two girlfriends and I came to New York with no plans - just to relax.  Three 50 year old white women wandering around the neighborhood.)  We did not meet one person that was not friendly and welcoming. There are little stores and any kind of food you desire.  We took the subway to Manhattan (I definitely recommend the Carnegie Deli - split the order with someone!!)  It was so nice to come back to Maison Des Sirenes at the end of the day and relax.  The Italian Resturant in the next block is not to be missed.                While this is not the normal "bed and breakfast" experience of having someone spoil you - I will recommend this place to everyone. What a wonderful adventure.  Thank you Nathalie!!  Dee, Linda and Julie

Nathalie apartment was so lovely! It was clean, beautiful and had all the necessities for a short stay, and we really enjoyed exploring Brooklyn and Manhattan and then coming "home" to a comfortable and airy place to relax, especially the terrace. It was easy to navigate the subways to her neighborhood, and the neighborhood felt very safe, even coming home late. Also It is important to mention, Nathalie is reliable and always available.

I highly recommend her apartment.

Nathalies apartment was beautiful and extremely clean. You can tell that she enjoys hosting visitors. We enjoyed the roof terrace and were blessed with some lovely weather although with all of the things we wanted to do could not spend enough time there! Nathalie is very helpful and has a lot of information on where to go and things to do in New York. I would definitely return there. Thank you Nathale for making our stay enjoyable.

The overall experience at Nathalie's was a good one. It was very spacious (enough for 3 beds), clean, and quite convenient to Manhattan. Other pluses: she had binders full of good reading material about NYC, Direct TV with tons of channels including premium channels like HBO, and a great terrace to unwind from the day. All of which would make me not hesitate to stay at her place again! There were some minor issues though: The bath tub (despite being clean) is a "bend down and spray" tub which made showering in the morning a bit annoying. During the day, the area feels very safe but late at night it can be a bit dodgy. We had a drunk guy follow us after we got out of the subway begging us to buy him a beer. I suppose this could happen anywhere in NYC. All in all, though I would rate my first airbnb experience a good one.
Thanks Nathalie!!

The apartment was beautiful, spacious and comfortable. It was much more convienent than a hotel. We had one small issue with the toilet overflowing, but Nathalie was responsive and helpful. I appreciated the travel guides that Nathalie created. The neighborhood was welcoming, but a long walk from areas that we were interested in shopping and eating at.

I had such a lovely time in Nahalie's beautiful apartment, I was drawn to it from the beginning and was not disapointed. There was nothing that I was in need of that wasn't there, I even found a socket adapter.
If I were ever to return to New York, Nathalie would be my first contact.

I stayed in Viviana's nice apartment with my mother for 9 days, and we really enjoyed it. The apartment had what we needed and the neigbourhood was excellent. If you are looking for a luxurious apartment, this isn't the one. If you are looking for a small, cosy apartment in the most lovely and inspiring borough with a lot of mixed cultures, a really easy and quick transport to manhattan and a very, very nice host this is the apartment. If I return to New York one day, I would love to stay here again - thanks Vivi, we had a really grat time :-)

We stayed in Vivianas apt. for 2 weeks and enjoyed it 100%.
The area felt safe and had everything we needed from food to shopping practically outside the door.
Viviana was very sweet and helpful, we arrived late at night and she filled the fridge with things for breakfast the next day. (Thank you!)
The apartment is clean, cozy and right next to Bedford ave. The bed is great and the bedroom pretty much silent at night. Kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need for preparing all your meals (if you don't chose to eat out at any of the great restaurants, cafes or delis within walking distance from the apt.).
You've got easy access to the subway and Manhattan from both Marcy ave and Bedford ave.

We really recommend staying here!

We loved our stay in Vivi's place! This cute apartment is in a great location, right in the heart of Williamsburg with easy access to two subway lines. Vivi was a perfect host and was very quick to respond to any queries. I would definitely return to her place when I'm next in NY!

Recien llegamos de estar en lo de Viviana, pasamos alli una semana con mi novio y volvimos encantados. Ella es muy amorosa, nos explico todo el primer dia, y quedo en contacto para lo que necesitaramos. El departamento es muy lindo, espacioso y silencioso, limpio, con lugar para cocinar y descansar. El barrio es muy comodo y tranquilo, esta a pocas cuadras de la movida de Williamsburg, a distancia caminable del subte a Manhattan y restaurants, sin tanto ruido como la zona centrica. Lo super recomiendo para dos personas que busquen tranquilidad estando en un barrio canchero.

We enjoyed every single day at Viviana's apartment! Everything was clean and we didn't miss anything. Williamsburg is a very cool area with s lot of cosy cafes, bars and shops! I can definitely recommend Viviana's apartment!

We really enjoyed our stay at Viviana's place! The apartment was very warm and cosy, which we were very grateful for as New York was wintery and cold when we visited. The apartment was always toasty warm which was great! Viviana has a super comfortable bed which was  such a bonus. The kitchen was well-equipped, although it would have been handy to have a kettle/microwave for the odd occasion. When we first arrived we really appreciated how clean and tidy the whole apartment was. The bathroom was very small and old but we managed just fine. We were surprised to discover that we were not allowed to put any toilet paper in the toilet, due to the age of the building. This was not an ideal scenario, but we managed. On the whole we were very grateful for our host and her hospitality during our stay in New York.

Viviana was very welcoming and kind. The apartment was nice and well located, although smaller than it looks on pictures and a bit noisy.
Nice neighbourhood, 10 minutes walk from subway L, which drives you directly to Manhattan in a few minutes.
We enjoyed our stay.

My stay was good. Nice neighbourhood, you can live and cook well in the apartment. The only problem I encountered was that in the cold winter the apartment can get very cold, or very warm depending on the heater (which can not be controlled manually). But that's something you just have to deal with... Vivi offered me an extra heater but then the heater decided to get really really hot, and there was no way to turn it lower so I had to open all the windows... Anyway, I think it's a good apartment especially in summer if you're out all day...
Wonderful location. Easy process for checking in and out. Efficient and comfortable layout.

Viviana was very nice to us and was super accessible via email.  For the price and proximity to Williamsburg the space was nice.  The apartment was clean and cared for and it was walking distance to great bars/restaurants.  But as for the neighbors and the street noise level - you can hear everything going on down on the street below, music blared from the apartment beneath us all throughout the day into the night on most days, we were woken up several times during our stay by these same neighbors who were yelling profanities at each other at 4am.  We realize this isn't Viviana's fault and it is beyond her control but what would have been a very pleasant trip was soured by the other building residents.

First I liked the appartment a lot, second I liked Nathalie and her family a lot and third I liked the neighborhood very much, too. So what else is there still to say? ;-)
The bed has just the right tightness to provide a great sleep, the terrace has a cool urban vibe, the kitchen full of useful things, the decoration is romantic and shabby chic and I personally loved the speedy WIFI-connection - combined with the special atmosphere and nostalgic charme of the whole house it is a perfect place for a pleasant New York stay.

Habiter dans cet appartement fut une expérience beaucoup plus agréable que l'hôtel. Et que dire de l'endroit! Décoré avec finesse et goût, la maison des sirènes 1 est un lieu où il fait bon vivre... Nathalie est à l'écoute des besoins de ses locataires et sait mettre les gens à l'aise par sa gentillesse. C'est un endroit que nous recommandons chaleureusement. Merci mille fois!
Claudine

We stayed at Viviana's apartment for a week over New Year. The apartment is exactly how it is pictured, very cosy, clean, warm and very New York. It was perfectly located with just a 10 min walk to the nearest subway and just around the corner from Bedford Avenue with it's many bars, coffee shops and cute boutiques.

We didn't meet Viviana but she was very quick to respond if we needed anything.

Would definitely stay at hers when we go back.
As advertised, all good.

Small but cosy in a perfect location close to everything in Williamsburg. Vivi was away when we staid but quick in answering any questions, we had a late flight and she let us stay beyond the check out time. I have only positive things to say.

Vivians place is clean, amazing locations and very homely.
Easy to access and close to both transportation, good dining areas, shopping and bars. Perfect Williamsburg location.

Vivian was quick to answer and really nice about everything.

I can only recommend Vivians apartment if you are looking for a good stay in Williamsburg

We liked the feel of Viviana's apartment on arrival and felt the photos were not as good as the actual space! We arrived late in the dark and once we found the key box (look down) entry was really easy. The apartment was clean and well equipped. The neighbourhood was pretty hip with lots of food and drink options. There were unfortunately 4 days of plumbing issues. The kitchen sink is the only sink in the apartment (only a bath and toilet in the bathroom) and it blocked. We had to wash our dishes, clean our teeth, wash our hands and take a shower all in the bath for 4 days. Not ideal! Viviana really kept in touch through this issue and sent friends to try and help, but the building supervisor was away and despite her efforts from afar the sink remained blocked.

Simplemente Perfecto , Ubicacion , Limpieza , Confort
La Atencion y Amabilidad de Viviana culmino para hacer mi estadia Perfecta Gracias Viviana por recibirme en tu Casa

Patty was a terrific host, she made us feel very at home in her beautiful apartment from the minute we arrived. She always answered my emails straight away and helped us find our way to the apartment from the airport. Patty also booked us a ride back to the airport when we were leaving. (Thank you Patty I really appreciated everything you did.)
We had an amazing view of The Freedom Tower. Patty had left us information on everything that was around us which was fantastic and made it a lot easier to find things. The location was PERFECT for us and close to everything we wanted to do. The subway, cafes, restuarants, bars, laundry & Deli (downstairs). We would drop our laundry of in the morning and pick it up in the evenings when we got home (very cheap too).
The apartment was very clean, cannot fault this apartment I loved coming home after long days out walking everywhere. It had air conditioning, and cable TV, Wifi, everything you needed was there. Beds were comfortable, 2 double beds. I'm so glad I stayed here and not a hotel! It really felt like home.
We walked to The Brooklyn and Manhattan Bridges which were close by. I was never concerned about my safety walking around this area, streets are very open and there are people everywhere. The apartment is very secure. it has security doors downstairs and you feel safe at night when sleeping, no worries at all.
Big THANK YOU to Patty, we would definitely stay here again, thank you for allowing us into your beautiful home.

We feel so lucky to have stayed at Patty's place. The studio is a really cute space with plenty of room by NYC standards! Patty was a really accomodating host - taking care of my bags during the summer and not batting an eyelid at our 2am check in after our 14 hour flight delay! The location is fab - a short stroll to the lower east side, Noho, and right above a 24 hour deli. The Chinese coffee shop downstairs was a fun way to start our day.  Party organised a driver to JFK and was available any time we needed (but everything is so well set up we didn't have to call once). Thank you so much Patty for such a wonderful stay!!!! We hope to come back soon.
We had a very pleasant and comfortable stay in NY! Patty was a very lovely and helpful host.  We very much enjoyed our stay, and highly recommend it to anyone!

We thoroughly enjoyed our 9 night stay in New York.  Patty's apartment is a good base to use to reach all of NYC. It's location on the border of China town and Lower East Side is perfect to reach most of the touristy places in lower Manhattan, midtown and Brooklyn by foot or the subway. The area is lively, colourful and friendly and we always felt very safe. It's  also very easy to access the whole island via the subway. There were lots of eating places nearby including the famous Katz deli which was fun - China town is on your doorstep. We used the laundry wash and fold service downstairs which was very cheap ($7 for 7lb) . The apartment is very close  to Grand St subway and we found the subway very easy to use with the help of google maps which gives all the connections. Because of the warm weather Patty suggested we  sleep on the sofa bed downstairs which we found  very comfortable.  The air conditioning kept us cool during the hot weather.  The apartment has everything you might need for a great holiday in NYC.
Patty gibt sich sehr viel Mühe den Aufenthalt zu einem Erlebnis zu machen. Sie gibt viele hilfreiche Tipps.

Patty was not there to greet and acclimate us but her son was.  She came over after work and was warm, accommodating, and very helpful. We then communicated by text messaging which was very effective in problem-solving.  The neighborhood is on the cusp of Chinatown in the lower East side, not beautiful but nicely located and easily accessible to subways. The view from our  apartment was magnificent, especially of the impressive World Trade Center.  The apartment itself would be more appropriate to younger, fitter folks who could take advantage of sleeping in the loft. Getting up and down with a very tall ladder did not work for us.  That said, we made it our temporary home and it suited our needs once we got used to the realities.  Finally, our host was great and very responsive to our needs.
Perfect for daytrips near chinatown/downtown. Very clean apt with nice view to the new wtc directly out of the window.

The apartment was fantastic, just the right size and a great location to explore some of the best neighbourhoods in both Manhattan and Brooklyn. The apartment has a very homely feel and offers stunning views of One World Trade Centre. There are plenty  of amenities if you wish to cook however Lower East Side has so many restaurants you will never have to (Fat Radish and Dimes thoroughly recommended). I would definitely stay at this apartment again, thanks Patty!

Patty went out of her way to make us feel at home, even arranging for us to store our luggage and organising a car to the airport on our last day. Her apartment is lovely and clean, with all the expected amenities; it is also extremely well-located with great food, drink, and museum options close by as well as easy subway connections to the rest of nyc. I would recommend staying here.

Patricias place was great we loved the loft bed area did not smell any smoke at all and we found the bed and pillows super cozy and comfy we loved it as it was a awesome way to end the day from walking all day.
The subway to times sq/downtown/uptown so many places is outside the door of patricias and walk right you will come to a starbucks 5-10min walk and subway is right there.
Patricia was easy to communicate with and we really enjoyed it there, only thing if you need wifi with a decent download and upload speed then you should ask patricia if its fixed that was the only problem for us and if you need it for work as it is now you can barely web browse.
Patricia did offer for us to use her room to be closer to modem so she really did try whatever she could to help and also offered to organize a driver to the airport.
Cheers pat thankyou again.
Great location with easy access to subway and restaurants. Very easy to deal with Patty and nice polite neighbours. Thanks
The apartment was like a little Parisian garret! Great location for exploring downtown Manhattan. Clean beyond words. Quirky. Lots of supplies if you'd forgotten anything. Overall a great stay.
Great location, comfy apartment, great view of Freedom Tower & lots of recommendations re places to eat in the neighborhood which were all really good.

Excellent location next to many train lines to get you anywhere you need to be in the city as well as good restaurants and bars! Patricia was great and the apartment was cozy and warm! (despite it being a record cold week in January)

Stayed a Patty's last weekend. Was a really great authentic feel to being in NYC rather than being in a hotel. Felt like we were at home and the apartment was really comfortable and cosy. Location is really close to loads of things to see and do. Would recommend staying here for young couples and friends exploring NYC. There's also a great little deli right downstairs where you can get snacks and sandwiches, it's 24 hours too! Maybe not ideal for elderly or disabled people as there is a ladder to the mezzanine bed which could be hard for some to navigate. It was perfect for me! Loved it.

Party's Studio in China Town/Lower East Side was absolutely perfect for my partner and I. We stayed 10 days and explored all that NYC and Brooklyn had to offer. So many great bars, restaurants and galleries walking distance from the studio. Also many subway stations to get you anywhere you need to go. Studio itself is just like the pics. The bathroom was clean and stocked with soaps etc. Patricia was a delight to deal with upon check in. Patty had also recently upgraded the WIFI and so it now works great in the studio itself. There is also NETFLIX AND HBO and all that if you need a night to chill.
If we are ever lucky enough to be back in NYC, we will stay here again.

Patty's listing was everything we needed for our stay in NY. The location was so perfect and it was super easy to get around. The amenities worked great (wifi, tv, water pressure, etc), and the bed was cozy. Definitely a great choice for folks traveling on a budget. Thanks for everything, Patty :)

We loved the loft! Patricia was not there when we arrived but left the key at the bakery downstairs and then help us find parking later in the evening. Not an easy area to find parking; without her help, it would have been difficult. The place was clean and comfortable. The bed is a little bit like a futon and yes, it's a bit athletic to get to it, but we enjoyed the space and the view. We recommend it and would come back!

Patty’s apartment is really cozy and was a perfect stay for our 4 days in New York. Located in Lower Manhattan/ Chinatown you can reach any place in the city very conveniently. There are also many bars and restaurants close by.
The apartment itself has everything you need for 2 people. The bed is very comfortable (but you have to decide for yourself if you like it to climb a ladder to go to bed). For us it was not a problem. The flat is clean and has all the amenities you need. A big plus is that you have a nice view from the big window and it makes the apartment really bright.
Unfortunately we did not had the chance to meet Patty. But we had been in contact why SMS and she took great care that everything was fine with us during our stay.

We had an absolutely lovely time in Nathalie apartment. It was such a joy to be there as the decor and detail in every inch of the space has been extremely well thought out. Fantastic light, perfect location and a really great atmosphere.

It has inspired me to work on my apartment!

A real home from home and very well organized in terms of keys etc.

Thank you!

Enjoy our stay.   Very spacious for a family of 4.   We slept very well with the REAL bed !!!   Always nice to come back to Nathalie's place after a long day walking.    Also very convenient by metro to Chinatown.

Nathalie was beautiful, friendly and very helpful! The apartment was decorated beautifully. It was very clean and the one we stayed in had a great enclosed terrace space with outdoor seating as well. The apartment is close to public transit also. This place is a great deal! So glad I decided on this place.

Une immersion fantastique dans un quartier en devenir.

Merci Nathalie pour votre accueil et votre disponibilité lors de notre séjour (conseils, astuces...!).
La maison des sirènes, c'est LE refuge pour découvrir et vivre New York intégralement.

Nous espérons faire vivre cette expérience...avec nos enfants lors d'un prochain voyage !

Nathalie is an incredible host!

Extremely nice, polite, cheerful and very very caring. When our friends asked my family how the trip went, my mum's first reaction was "our host in NYC was charming".

The apartment was simply wonderful. Spacious, clean, neat, beautifully decorated and felt like home. I traveled with my parents and they are do not sleep well everywhere, but they said the beds were extra-comfortable.

It is a short 5min walk to the nearest metro and you really get to downtown Manhattan in 20min. The neighborhood was safe too.

One word can sum up our experience - PERFECT!!! Thank you Nathalie!

La maison des sirènes est magnifique, aussi sinon encore plus belle que sur les photos. J'y ai bien dormi, apprécié l'air climatisée pendant cette chaleur estivale et découvert un quartier intéressant. La rue Lewis a plusieurs petits commerces vraiment chouettes. Le quartier est sécuritaire, nous étions deux femmes et peu importe l'heure à laquelle nous nous sommes promenées, il n'y avait aucun problème. Une belle fête de quartier a eu lieu le samedi 11 août mais dès 23h, tout était calme, les voisins sont respectueux!!! Nathalie est facilement joignable et très avenante, très gentille! Bref, c'est un bon choix que de réserver cet appartement :)

Great location to explore NY. Very comfortable, cosy and well-equipped. Hurricane Sandy troubled our NY visit, but we were very lucky to have this place as our shelter for the storm. Host Nathalie did everything to help us and make it comfortable. Many thanks.

The apartment is very charming, lovely decorated and the neighborhood safe and quite, except for few times when ambulances would go by.
Nathalie was very helpful and accepted us, both families with children. We didn't have a problem at all going in and out at wee hours of the night.

Nathalie made sure we had a wonderful stay in her apartment. It was very well decorated, very clean and had everything we could ask for during our brief stay. I could tell she put a good amount of effort into setting up the apartment to be both visually appealing and functional for her guests.

Nathalie provided very detailed instructions on how to travel to and access the apartment and gave several good recommendations for local places to shop and eat.

The apartment was just a short 10 minute walk from the subway station and we came and went even late into the night with no worries or issues.

I highly recommend staying with Nathalie if you get a chance. Her excellent reviews on AirBNB are well earned.

The apartment was very spacious, with high ceilings and room to relax after a busy day in the city. The twin daybeds were quite comfortable even for one person in our party who has a bad back, The A/C was great, only a window unit but kept the entire apartment nice and cool. My in-laws very much enjoyed their mornings on the patio. The neighborhood was also great. I felt safe even as our group was returning after dark. There was plenty of street parking nearby.

Natalie was a lovely host, easy to work with and has everything set up for easy check in and check out.  The pictures on the website do not do her apartment justice.  It is decorated quite nicely and is very comfortable and large and clean.  Parking was also relatively easy, which was a plus. It is a great value and we had an excellent stay there!

Group of four from UK staying. Great stay, the apartment was lovely, big, bright, spacious and clean. The beds were all very comfortable, the bath shower was powerful and it was heated nicely in November. Would recommend.

Quel bonheur que cette maison des sirènes, quel bonheur de ressentir sérénité et plénitude après une journée touristique ou de shopping intense.
Situé, dans une rue calme et pleine de charme de Brooklyn, l'appartement se trouve à 5 minutes à pied du métro, permettant de se projeter rapidement à Manhattan. Il est magnifiquement décoré et l'on y est tellement bien.
J'espère avoir l'occasion d'y retourner.
Merci beaucoup Nathalie de nous avoir accueilli.

Beautiful and Charming indeed. The details and decor is very sweet and comfy. All in all a really great experience.
Merci!!

Appartement bien sympa dans un quartier calme. La terrasse extérieure est également bien agréable. Un peu plus de rangement/penderie pour les vêtements serait top.

Nous recommandons en particulier pour le calme et pour le charme de l'ancien
Wonderful place! Nathalie was so nice and accommodating and made sure everything was ready by the time we arrived. Definitely recommend and would stay again :)

I have had 3 boats and an apartment up on airbnb. I try to do exactly what Nathalie does. Open up a warm, cozy, personable and charming place to stay.
Nathalie's apartment is 5 star! I loved the beds, the decor, the east coast woodwork. The cool patio in back. Tub and shower were great. I met Nathalie, and she was superb. Look no further this is the spot.
Its close to the train. Never felt unsafe. And of course, its NY, so you can find some really good food in walking distance.
Patty's place was exactly as described. She was very accommodating and flexible with check in and out times. Location was good and never felt unsafe. Close to subway stations, easy to get around.

The Apartement was so pretty and WE had a wonderful time in NY. Patty was so kind and we were able to walk almost everywhere from the apartement. If we come to NY again we will definitely stay here again!
Danke für die nette Betreuung. Gerne wieder

Patty ist eine sehr aufmerksame Gastgeberin und das Studio ein echtes Juwel. Die Lage ist sehr gut - alleine drei U-Bahn-Stationen sind in Laufweite, so dass es auch vom Flughafen mit dem öffentlichen Nahverkehr gut zu erreichen ist. Das Studio ist ausreichend für zwei Personen (für vier vielleicht ein wenig zu klein) und es hat alles, was man benötigt. Die Küche habe ich allerdings nur für's Kaffee kochen genutzt...Die Aussicht auf das World Trade Center ist grandios. Im Gebäude selbst fand ich es ruhig; man hört aber Straßengeräusche - allerdings halte ich es auch für unwahrscheinlich, dass man etwas in NYC findet, wo man keine Geräusche hört. Es gibt ein Rollo für das Fenster, dieses geht durch die Klimaanlage allerdings nicht ganz zu schließen, wer also sehr lichtempfindlich ist, könnte ein Problem haben. Ich war alleine unterwegs und habe mich immer sicher gefühlt. Der Deli unten im Haus ist ebenfalls ein absolutes Plus. Ich würde das Studio uneingeschränkt empfehlen. Vielen Dank nochmal!

Patty est une hôte extra. Nous avons eu un bagage perdu par notre compagnie aérienne, elle s'est rendue disponible pour le réceptionner. Le quartier est absolument génial. La vraie découverte a été le DINER juste en face de chez elle, le CUP & SAUCER, nous y avons pris tous nos petits déjeuners, l'équipe est absolument géniale. Il y a pleins de commerces autour, de petits bars et restos sympas en allant vers le métro "east broadway", bref, le bonheur intégral. À recommander chaudement.
Patricias flat is really beautiful and in a great location for exploring Manhattan. She was really helpful and easy to contact with lots of great suggestions. We had an amazing time here thanks!!

Patty was kind and patient with us. When we needed her, she was there for is. The view of the Freedow Tower is breathtaking. Subways are nearby and a lot of things to do. Thanks for the great time! We enjoyed New York because of Patty.
To make it simple for the next, just a superb stay!! Thx Patty

We absolutely loved Patty's place! It's in the perfect location - so close to soho and east village. The apartment is very comfortable and cosy and Patty was so welcoming. We would definitely stay here again! Thanks again Patty!
Amazing. Looks just like the photos. Would recommend to a friend x
Great communication and flexibility. Best value for location.

Nathalie was very welcoming and communicated very well and promptly. She left us very clear instructions on everything about the apartment and was very gracious. The place was absolutely wonderful, clean, charming, and very beautiful in its historic details, furnishings and international decor. We felt warm and cozy on the rainy cold days we stayed there in December. Our elderly mother was very comfortable and it meant so much to her to have a place where her family could gather. The kitchen was well stocked with everything needed. The light and layout of the apartment was excellent, and the backyard upper deck was beautiful and private feeling, like the rest of the apartment. We would have enjoyed using it had the weather been better. The pictures show the place very well, but the details of the two fireplace mantel pieces, the old plaster moldings, the wood work and chandeliers were wonderful to see. All in all, a great place for us to land for our family gathering in a perfect neighborhood. We are very grateful, Nathalie!

Logement sympa à la décoration soignée, conforme aux photos. Très confortable pour 5 personnes. Nous y avons très bien dormi. La terrasse est un petit plus par beau temps ! L'hôtesse est à l'écoute et à la disposition de ces clients !!! A recommander.

What a wonderful apartment! Beautiful touches throughout and clean. There was lots of room for the three of us friends, especially when Nathalie made an extra effort to make sure our tall friend had a double bed. The patio is a lovely addition. The neighbourhood is a bit "up and coming," but we had zero issues there and completely enjoyed our stay. I recommend the little organic food shop on the corner of Throop and Halsey, I believe it was. Make sure to check out Brunswick cafe on Marcus Garvey Blvd for coffee or brunch!
The house is absolutely gorgeous. The neighbourhood was fantastic. Very lively and friendly. The charming terrasse makes the whole place worth it.

This apartment is really one of a kind in the very best sense of the word. Nathalie strives to give it the atmosphere of a Parisian place, with much success.
Nathalie was very responsive and gave accurate instructions.
Chapeau!!!
Great neighborhood, cute apartment, patio must be amazing in spring/summer.  Thanks Nathalie!

I loved my experience in Nathalie's apartment.  The apartment is a jewel of Brooklyn history and has so much character.  It made for an authentic community experience.  Nathalie is a wonderful host and so welcoming.  There is easy access to the subway.  I enjoyed my week in NYC and would definitely come stay here again!

Eine sehr schöne und geräumige Wohnung, in der sich vier Leute keinesfalls auf die Füße treten. Mit der Subway fährt man in 15 Minuten nach Manhattan. Das Viertel ist sehr in Ordnung und noch nicht wirklich gentrifiziert aber keinesfalls gefährlich. Man bekommt einen guten Eindruck vom ursprünglichen Brooklyn. Wir waren mit zwei Kindern (11 und 13) da und hatten großen Spaß in dieser aufregenden Stadt. Die Kommunikation mit Nathalie hat von Beginn an wunderbar geklappt. 100% Empfehlung.
Nous recommanderons votre appartement si l'occasion se présente. La déco était comme prévu, à notre goût. Le quartier calme, les lits très bons. Que du bon.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour chez Nathalie à Brooklyn. Facile d'accès, restos, marché et métro à proximité. Appartement charmant, lits très confortables et terrasse invitante pour se prélasser et prendre l'apéro. De plus, Nathalie est toujours disponible pour répondre à nos besoins . Une adresse à retenir !

Beautiful home,beautiful decorations. I wish my house looked like this. Everything we needed was there.  Instructions on how to get places,  suggestions on where to eat, constant communication with Nathalie. The only thing I suggest is to get there early, park your car nearby and not move because parking is problematic.  Cannot wait to come back. Thank you Nathalie!

Nathalie's beautiful apartment was a comfortable place for my mom and aunt to rest each night after exploring New York for the first time. Larger than expected, it would be a good place for a family or group. I wish I had taken advantage of the private balcony deck!

Nathalie was an absolute treat to have as a host. She gave great suggestions for nearby hangouts/restaurants and was very helpful with any questions or needs we had during our visit. Her beautiful bohemian style home is in a super convenient location, sitting just a few blocks away from the C train to Manhattan. Highly recommend! :-)
Lovely place to stay with our two girls (6,8). Loads of character and we particularly loved to patio.
The house is really beautiful! Nathalie is also very nice:) I would recommend this place!
Great place & great location in the heart of Bed Stuy! Will definitely stay here again next time in NYC.

Nathalie was a gracious and responsive host! Communication was excellent and the place was as advertised. We had to leave early due to a family emergency so we only were able to stay one night. Nathalie was very understanding as our plans changed. Great neighborhood with excellent bars and restaurants in walking distance.
The host canceled this reservation 7 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Nathalie's place was great! Perfect for a couple. We loved the layout. Very spacious, especially for a New York apartment.

A warm, comfortable, and beautifully decorated house.
I was very comfortable during my trip to New York.
The subway is not far away and the bed is in a very relaxed state.
The antique bathtub in the bathroom is also very nice.
Nearby restaurants also offer very good food.
However, it is a bit far from traveling in Manhattan.
Nice cosy apartment, great neighbourhood. Easy to communicate with. Perfect place to explore NYC while having the relaxed atmosphere of Williamsburg.

While the apartment was cozy and relatively clean, the stovetop and oven were barely useable. The biggest challenge was the bathroom and shower. There was no sink in the bathroom and it was hard to use the kitchen sink for all our needs. The shower had no shower head and it was like standing under a garden hose.

A very comfortable place to stay that is located close to Chinatown, Little Italy, and the East Village.  Patty gave us a very warm welcome and didn't leave us until she was sure we were all set up and ready to explore

We had a wonderful stay in Patricia's cozy little apartment. We were 3 friends staying together and it was perfect for us. Clean, air con (amazing to have in the heat), nice beds, fresh towels, amazing view from the window and we felt very safe. It was also in a perfect location and we could walk to many nice restaurants, good shopping areas and cool bars/clubs/karaoke bars. Patricia was also a lovely host, and the communication was great, always quick answers and very helpful.  All in all it was the perfect place for us to stay, and I will for sure want to stay there again next time I go to New York.

We had such a great stay! Everything was absolutely perfect. It was our first time in NY and it could not have been any better. It turned out the flat had a perfect location for all of the activites that we wanted to do – we walked most of the times. We also fell in love with Chinatown. Patricia is wonderful – she gave us a lot of tips at the beggining of our trip, it was very helpful. Overall, an incredible experience that we highly recommend!
Beautiful, clean loft close to tons of great restaurants and the subway. We were delayed for hours and Patty waited for us to check us in. Definitely recommended :)

We really loved this place! Our travel plans flying into NYC got really messed up and Patty was super accommodating allowing us in right away when we arrived. The apartment had everything we needed and location was great! Would stay here again for sure!
Alles war wie wir es erwartet haben! Wir würden jederzeit wieder bei Patricia buchen!!

The apartment was great! It’s in a perfect location, near lots of shops and places to eat, without being too noisy and busy. Having AC was a big plus too. Patty was also very accommodating and helpful. Would definitely stay again!

Patricia's place was amazing! It was a cute little artsy studio with plenty of room for three of us. There is an adorable loft and the couch was made up as an additional bed. The place had everything we needed and more including a view of the world trade. The location was on point with a 10 min walk to China town and little Italy. There was also a 24hr convenience store downstairs which came in handy. Overall I recommend Patricia's place and I can't wait to come back!

Wir hatten eine gute Zeit in New York. Patty war eine tolle Gastgeberin und das Appartement war toll. Sehr individuell und perfekt gelegen. Subway in der Nähe und das beste chinesische Essen was man sich vorstellen kann. Für uns steht fest: wir kommen wieder.

A great location in lower Manhattan with lots of Asian food choices nearby and a 24-hour deli very close. A short walk to Grand St and East Broadway subway stations. The apartment is older style, but has all the main things needed for a good stay, except laundry facilities. The wifi and air conditioning worked well, but we didn't use the latter much and slept on the main floor rather than in the loft. The room was bright, with a good view of the One World Trade Center (Freedom Tower), and secure. Patty was a great host, though we didn't actually get to meet her, very responsive to communications, and organised airport transport for us when we left (much cheaper than a taxi!). There was also a lot of info about restaurants and so on provided in the apartment. In general, a good, affordable apartment in Manhattan, with easy Metro access to the popular tourist spots, and no shortage of food nearby.

Patty's place is brilliant! What a great location for exploring the city and also sampling the nightlife that the lower east side has to offer. I couldn't recommend her hospitality more highly, really helpful but also left us to our own devices which was great. You won't regret staying here!
Everything was very nice!!!!

Patti is a great host, she made us feel welcome and was very accommodating. We arrived early and left late and she let us leave our bags no problem. She was warm and helpful and we have no recommending her place. Chinatown is quite an experience! But Patti's place is quiet so you aren't disturbed. Good aircon and felt safe.

Es hat alles super geklappt. Pattys Appartement ist sehr gemütlich, sehr individuell und mit viel liebe zum Detail eingerichtet. Patty hat mir eine absolut ausführliche Wegbeschreibung geschickt, so dass wir ihre Wohnung sehr leicht  gefunden haben. Die Schlüsselübergabe sowohl bei der Anreise als auch bei der Abreise waren unkompliziert und entspannt. Ich kann sie als Gastgeberin zu 100% weiterempfehlen.

Pattys Appartment liegt im Stadtviertel Chinatown im Süden Manhattens. Es war groß genug für 3 Leute mit bequemen Betten, einer Küche und einem innenliegendem Badezimmer mit obenliegenden, teils offenen, Fenstern ins Zimmer. Es ist charmant eingerichtet und zweckmäßig! Wer sehr empfindlich gegen Lärm ist könnte sich an der Einfachverglasung zu Straße hin stören. Ich denke aber, dass allgemein der Lärm der Stadt in allen Unterkünften zu hören sein wird. Teilweise hat es am Fenster etwas gezogen, da die Klimaanlage mit "Wellpappe" abgedichtet ist. Dafür stand aber eine elektrische Heizung bereit.

Die Kommunikation vor und während des Aufenthaltes klappte einwandfrei. Fragen wurden von Patty so schnell wie möglich beantwortet. Da wir am letzten Tag erst in der Nacht geflogen sind konnten wir nach Rücksprache unser Gepäck in Pattys Wohnung (die direkt nebenan ist) unterbringen. Auch unser Check-Out, der sich um eine knappe Stunde verzögerte war kein Ärger wert.

Die U-Bahn ist in 5 Minuten fußläufig zu erreichen und fährt vieles ohne Umsteigen an!

Alles in allem eine super Unterkunft mit wunderbarer Gastgeberin!

Danke Patty für den schönen Aufenthalt.

The pics definitely reflect a funky space but there's always a fear of what can accompany that. I was very pleasantly relieved to find that the space is clean, smells good and is very comfortable. The high ceilings and lots of storage help a lot so although it's a studio, you're not on top of each other.
Loved the space! Ideally located and easy access to subways. A safe area. Lots of charm. Patricia was very helpful and responsive. She even booked a car service for us to return to the airport!
Patricia's place is wonderful! I had such a lovely stay it was wonderful. Perfect location and Patricia was so easy to communicate with :) Thanks!

This place is amazing. I was blown away at how adorable it was set up, and that view, oh my! You can see the freedom tower right from the window. It was close everything we wanted to see, and bed was super comfy. Patricia was there when we checked in and then let us leave our bags after check out as our flight was later which allowed us to wonder a bit more. There is a 24 hour deli/convenience store right downstairs which was so handy. It was truly perfect.

Après des journées bien remplies de visites pendant la dernière semaine de décembre particulièrement froide, nous avons bien apprécié la chaleur de l'appartement et le confort de la literie.
L'appartement est spacieux, lumineux, bien équipé, on s'y sent comme chez nous.
Nathalie est soucieuse du bien être de ses hôtes.
Je recommande.

We had such a cozy time <3
smooth and easy going stay.

This lovely, spacious Brooklyn flat has a great location and a beautiful, comfortable aesthetic. Nathalie is very good at communicating, too. Next time I am in town, I will be sure to look into staying here again!

Absolute perfection for us. We loved our stay with Nathalie. Her attention to detail, size of the beautiful apartment and gracious touches were absolutely appreciated. We love New York City but it has become impossible to find a beautiful place that is priced for travel. Nathalie provides a calm, very stylish oasis and we loved it. 5 stars for everything. Thank you Nathalie!!!

logement authentique, spacieux et confortable pour 4 dans un quartier très agréable de Brooklyn (le Bed-Stuyvesant) avec plein de petites adresses à découvrir pour se restaurer.
bien desservi par le métro et les bus.
Nathalie accueille ses voyageurs (même en son absence) avec des indications et des consignes claires pour les renseignements nécessaires.
nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour d'une semaine à La Maison Des Sirènes!

Wonderful stay. Spacious flat, comfortable bedding, etc, and an excellent outside terrace. Great area, with easy links into the rest of Brooklyn and one subway ride into Manhattan. Nathalie was responsive and helpful too. Would recommend!
Nathalie's home is a great spot, very stylish in a cool, accessible part of Brooklyn. Nathalie was a really helpful host too and replied instantly with any queries we had.

Logement très agréable et très bien équipé. La terrasse est un vrai plaisir.
Le quartier est aussi très bien, calme mais avec des commerces de proximité et une rue commerçante toute proche.
L'accès au métro est à une distance très raisonnable et le bus est encore plus proche.
Nathalie est très disponible.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Une adresse que nous vous recommandons.

Appartement très agréable. La terrasse un vrai bonheur au mois de juin ... Le quartier est tranquille malgré une première impression un peu inquiétante. Il faut le temps de s'habituer car le dépaysement est total, en tout cas pour des français ... c'était super !
This place is wonderful, very safe and a great location. Our host was so helpful and we had no problems.

This was our first time to travel to New York. I can not recommend this place more! It was clean and close to everything in Lower Manhattan! Patty was nice to let us drop our luggage off early before exploring the city for the day! She even helped us with subway routes! We felt very safe at this location and would definitely stay again! Patty even booked us a car service back to the airport, which I highly recommend it was $20 cheaper than uber! Thank you for everything Patty!

Patricia’s place could not have been more perfect for our weekend getaway in NYC! The space was amazing and the bed was so cozy! Patty was very helpful and while we did not meet her, we were in constant contact the entire time and she even arranged us a car to the airport. We will definitely be back to stay at her lovely apartment!
Si busqueu un apartament funcional i com nou aquest no és el vostre apartament. Però si busqueu un lloc amb encant, viure en una autèntica casa brown stone, aquesta és la vostra tria.

Very cute and spacious, all open space so no bedroom privacy but that worked out great for our family
Great location to subway and markets
Everything was just as described and we had a wonderful 4 days stay in Nathalie's apartment

L'appartement de Nathalie est très agréable. On a beaucoup apprécié la terrasse. On peut également se garer gratuitement dans la rue. Le quartier est très calme. Cependant, c'est un peut loin en métro de Manhattan.

Our stay was great. The location is in the heart of Brooklyn - a close car ride to the airport, parks, Williamsburg,  shops and restaurants. A short walk to the subway if you feel like going to Manhattan or DUMBO. It was quiet at night and Nathalie was quick to respond if we had questions.
The bohemian decor was awesome. Beds were comfy with crisp white sheets. Plenty of room for 4 people. The patio was great for breakfast, coffee or a glass of wine.
Absolutely gorgeous studio apartment and super close to transportation into Manhattan and delicious food!
The apartment is fine, but it is way too old. Some furniture was broken. Everything was clean and the instructions at arrival were perfect

A wonderful apartment on a friendly block. My partner and I were only in town for a couple of nights but loved staying here (and especially loved Bohaus right around the corner - plants and coffee!!) - I can’t recommend Nathalie’s apartment or hospitality highly enough.
Lovely space and deck, would stay again! ❤️
my inlaws seemed to like it

Es una buena opción para estancias tanto cortas como largas pues tiene todo lo necesario y ademas queda muy cerca del metro linea C que comunica con Manhatan.
Destacaria sus comodas camas, cosa que se agradece mucho despues de un día de andar y andar por NY.
Baño y cocina completos!
Y una atencion personal y rapida por parte del Nathalie.
Gracias Natalie...volveremos!!!
Cozy & comfy place. My friends and I really enjoyed this home. Great location, super close to metro and some of Brooklyn's best bars and restaurants.

Nathalie’s place is amazing! Very bohemian and cozy. Made me want to just curl up with my book and a cup of coffee and enjoy the space. The apt is also conveniently located to restaurants and coffee shops plus excellent smoothies at the corner market. And I’d you’re up for it, running/walking distance to prospect park. Highly recommend for cleanliness, location, and excellent communication

Great place! Its very well located and we loved the style of the apartment. Nathalie was very and we really appreciated all the tips she left for us in a little book. Would definitely stay there again!
Thank you for beautiful stay! Great place, nice location, everything smooth.
Amazing! Can’t wait to visit again! The apartment, the neighborhood, the people! Thanks, Brooklyn!
We love the apartment, close to everything and very lovely, beautiful and cozy.
Enjoyed our stay!  Cute apartment!

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt bei Patty in New York. In ihrem Apartment kann man in das Gefühl eines New Yorkers eintauchen. Patty war sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Ein guter Ausgangspunkt um Manhattan zu erkunden.

Patricia was an amazing host and welcomed us, even though we arrived ahead of the scheduled time!

The appartment is super cosy and we loved the bed! And the view of the freedom tower while having a cup of tea was priceless!

The locations is perfect to explore Manhattan by subway, as there are 4 stations in walking distance!

The neighbourhood has plenty of restaurants and little cafes/delis to explore. But the appartment offers also everything for a relaxing night at home with the kitchenette, TV and comfy sofa!

I will definately be back and highly recommend to stay here!

Thank you very much Patty!

Patritia's apartment was amazing! As first time travelers we always felt safe and at home in the room and the surrounding area. It has an incredibly authentic vibe! No negatives I can think of whatsoever and we will definitely be looking to return in the future. Patty was a great host and always easy to get a hold of. Has a great local knowledge and was very helpful in finding hidden gems that downtown NYC had to offer. 10/10 would reccomend.

Staying at this studio in Chinatown is one of the best travel experiences I have ever had! The studio literally screams New York! Patricia had excellent communication with us and was most caring. Thank you for a truly wonderful time and I hope we'll be back! Cheers!

Patty was a great, friendly and flexible host, it was very easy to communicate with her. The flat was homely, relaxed and clean. We visited in February (though a very warm one!) and it was comfortably warm inside. Also, it was quiet, no noise from neighbours and hardly any from the street. The bed was soft (yes, futon style but soft) and the bedclothes were good. The location is very good, subway is a short walk away and there’s plenty to see within walking distance. Highly recommended!

Patty is always open to us as guests and supportive all the time. The room is also wonderful and accessible to all of NYC or Brooklyn landmarks.  Also nice view! We had some small troubles during our stay but Patty was very responsible for all the problems and helped us a lot. Thanks for making our NY stay awesome! Our greatest gratitude from Japan <3

Nous avons eu beaucoup de chance de rencontrer patricia pendant notre séjour.  Elle a été de très bon conseil pour trouver des adresses ou pour rentrer à l aeroport. L appartement est très mignon et très bien placé à 5min du quartier SOHO et en plein coeur de chinatown! Un bonheur! Nous recommandons largement son logement et espérons pourvoir y revenir!
Patricia's home was lovely. Exactly what we were looking for. The neighborhood was perfect!
The space is just as advertised, very cozy and cute. Check in was very easy and Patricia provided the contact for a car service when we left. All in all, great stay.

My partner and I just stayed in this loft for 5 nights. We absolutely loved the place and the location was great also. Patty was lovely & thoughtful. Honestly, we wanted to stay and live there forever. Would 100% come back and reccomend to all others!

This location was ideal! So close to orchard street which is super bright and filled with energy, new restaurants, awesome local shops--our favourite place for shopping. We loved the space a lot too! Very cute and cozy--I want to live here! So nice to come home after days exploring to such a real, comfortable living space. Lots of nice details, very comfortable bed. I'd stay here again if I came back to New York, definitely!
Great place for an authentic and unique way to experience New York City. Patty provided several recommendations and communication was great.

Le logement de patty est génial pour passer un bon moment à nyc. Le quartier est très cosmopolite,  et très vivant quelque soit l heure de la journée.  A 10 min à pied de SoHo , et très central avec les différentes lignes de métro.  L intérieur du studio est très sympa.  De la fenêtre on voit le wtc1.. ! Tout est propre et pratique.  Très bon accueil de patty le jour de notre arrivée. Je recommande ! !.

Très beau séjour chez Patricia. Très bon emplacement, proche du métro et du centre. Une hôte très sympathique, accessible en cas de besoin et très réactive. L’appartement est très bien pour un séjour de visite. Il manque de rien. Je vous le conseil vivement.
Superbe ville tout était bien

Je recommande vivement l’appartement de Patty. L’appartement était conforme aux photos, bien situés proche métro et restaurant dans un quartier sur et animé. Patty a été vraiment très réactive et arrangeante a notre arrivée et lors de notre départ. Elle nous a aidé à trouver un transfert aéroport à prix très intéressant. Thank you again for everything Patty.
Great place, Great location! We had a lovely time here

Charming spacious apartment. Very comfortable bed and pillows. Extra towels. Elevator for convenience. Key retrieval is from a lock box a few blocks away in the back of a deli- be sure to arrange access code ahead of time. Patricia was available and quickly responsive to our confusion about getting the key. The Lower East Side is a fun, artsy area with lots of good food. The entrance to the walkway across the Manhattan Bridge can be seen across the street from the apartment.

We had a great stay at Patty’s place, it’s a great location with a spectacular view and felt very secure with lots of great food places within walking distance. Patty was a wonderful host who was very helpful and quick to answer to any of our questions, would remcommened staying here to anyone.

Wir hatten einen super schöne Zeit in NYC und diesem Appartment.
Sogar als wir viel zu früh zum Check in gekommen sind (ca. 1,5 std) war das für Patricia kein Problem. Vielen Dank dafür! Auch die Tipps für umliegende Restaurants und die schnelle Antwort bei Fragen waren sehr hilfreich. Die gesamte Wohnung und vor allem das Bad waren sehr sauber und es ist alles was man braucht vorhanden. Auch der Lärm der Straßen war verhältnismäßig wenig - wir zumindest hatten keine Probleme mit dem Schlafen. Der Deli direkt im Haus ist natürlich ebenso ein riesen Pluspunkt!!
Wir hatten eine super Zeit und beim nächsten mal NYC fällt die Wahl bestimmt wieder auf dieses Appartment!

Lägenheten förstärkte känslan av att vara i New York, den var väldigt charmig och hade en kombination av industriell och bohemisk stil. Läget var helt fantastiskt och det var enkelt att ta sig överallt via tunnelbanan. Patricia var en väldigt bra värd, svarade snabbt och var oerhört hjälpsam vid behov. Vi tre som bodde här kan alla rekommendera lägenheten starkt!
Patty's place is truly amazing. Super clean and nice, everything is available. Great location for tourists. Will absolutely rent this apartement again if we ever come back to NY!
Appartement génial ! Décoré avec goût  et avec tout ce dont on peut avoir besoin. Patricia est une hôte très attentionnée, et toujours disponible. Quartier très animé et proche du métro.

Un super séjour dans un super appartement! Vue incroyable, logement hyper bien situé, central, bien desservi par les métros, Patricia est une hôte très arrangeante
A recommander +++

This is a cool, bohemian loft! Great location above a 24-hour deli with ATM and lots of food opps nearby. It is not luxurious, but it is cosy and gets great natural light! We stayed for four nights during a heat wave and the window air conditioner kept the loft comfortable. We were a party of three, and our teen slept in the overhead loft platform while my husband and I shared the main-floor sofa bed. The loft platform made me a bit nervous with its exposed pipes and electrical, but my son loved it even if he bumped his head a few times. The bathroom was very well stocked with plenty of towels and was very clean. We initially had an issue with some musty bed linens on the sofa bed, but Patricia had left plenty of extras on-site and we were able to redress the bed. Patricia was very easy to reach and very flexible with key pick-up as our ETA kept changing during heavy car traffic. I would recommend this loft to people who want a youthful/boho New York experience. Great neighbourhood. Patricia left a well-curated neighbourhood guide that we referred to during our stay, also. Lots of access to transit, taxis and for drivers, parking.
Well located apartment in the heart of Chinatown.
Clean, cozy with comfy beds and AC!! Best host ever!!
L'appartement de Patricia est très bien situé (proximité du métro) et avec une belle vue sur la freedom tower.
Patricia’s apartment was well-kept and located in a lively area. She kept a useful guide on where to eat and what to do.

This apartment was exactly what I wanted it to be and more, it was light, stylish and ridiculously comfy. Patty was great in making sure everything was okay for us. The book of suggestions of where to eat, shop and see was super helpful. Thankyou so much for an amazing time. We both loved it!!!!

Un grand merci à Patricia pour son accueil et sa disponibilité. Cela a été un vrai plaisir de retrouver ce petit cocon en plein chinatown pour notre second séjour à New York. L'appartement est idéalement situé prés d'une station de métro qui désert aussi bien Manhattan que Brooklyn. Nous recommandons à 100 % ce logement.
Een fijn appartement midden in Chinatown, prima ligging om alles te doen in  Manhattan

Just perfect. We loved the whole
area. So much delicious food around and Patty was very helpful.
Viviana’s place is great. Best possible location in a quiet street, yet close to everything you would want Williamsburg. The space is on the small side, but it’s comfortable. Would stay here again.
Nice place to stay.
Great location of Vivi's place. Great communication!! I would recommend this for others.

Abitazione confortevole, pulita e ordinata in uno storico palazzo nel quartiere di Williamsburg. Ubicato in una laterale della Bresford Avenue, via principale di Williamsburg dove ci sono molti ristoranti e negozi, a 10 minuti dalla fermata della metro, comodissimo per raggiungere Manhattan in poco tempo.
Inoltre Viviana è un host affidabile, sempre disponile a domande e/o richieste.
Questa casa ha un posto speciale nel mio ricordo di NY.
Grazie!
Great Airbnb in a great location!! Nathalie was also super helpful + responsive!! I would definitely stay here again!

Appartement plein de charmes bien équipé. Proche du métro et des commerces. Nathalie est une hôte accueillante et attentionnée. L'appartement permet de se poser après une journée chargée à Manhattan. Sans aucuns doutes, un excellent rapport qualité prix pour découvrir New-York.

Séjour très agréable. Appartement très chalereux, parfaitement propre. Nous y avons séjourné du 1 au 11 mai 2019. Le matin, petit déjeuner sur la terasse au soleil. Appartement très bien situé à 7 minutes à pied de la ligne C. Hôte très réactive et toujours à l'écoute. Excellent séjour.
Muy buen apartamento. Correcta relación precio calidad.
Le logement est bien conçu et très bien situé, les explications sont très claires pour trouver  ce dont on a besoin. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à New York
Die Wohnung liegt in einem schönen Viertel und ist von der Subway aus sehr gut zu Fuß zu erreichen. Das Appartment hat eine Terasse. Wir waren zu viert dort und hatten eine schöne Zeit. Zu Empfehlen!

Appartement atypique et chaleureux dans une rue très calme. Proche du métro et du bus. Un havre de paix agréable à retrouver après l'agitation de Manhattan. Terrasse agréable. Hôte très réactive. A refaire.

Nathalies appartment is a good place to stay for a NYC visit. The rooms and beds are comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped. A highlight is the terrace where we enjoyed our breakfast. An additional wardrobe would be nice.

Three sisters stayed here for two nights. We came by train, and it was easy to navigate from Penn Station to the subway station, then the (slightly under) 1/2 mile walk to the apartment. The neighborhood is very peaceful day and night. Nathalie was great about communication.

This apartment is on the second floor, and the staircase is kind of narrow (my sisters had big suitcases!), but just one flight. The apartment itself is lovely, large and has a great layout. It's one big room, with a sitting area and two beds on one side, kitchen with table in the middle, and queen bed on the other. The bathroom has a big tub and Nathalie's set up the shower curtains so it's easy to use it that way without spraying water all over. The enclosed outdoor space is pretty, but it was too hot for us to want to use it this time.

The air conditioner cools things down perfectly, and the bedding is comfy and towels plentiful. Nathalie has a fun sense of decor and that made this space extra special. We felt like it was a good value, and a great home base to explore NYC!

Nathalie’s house is exactly what you need to relax after a full day exploring the city: it’s located in a quiet but vibrant neighborhood, close to cafes and supermarket and just a five minute walk from the subway that will take you to downtown Manhattan or dumbo. The house is spotlessly clean, beds are super comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped, so if you want to cook your dinner and enjoy it in the patio outside, you can! Nathalie was a very gracious host, very responsive and gave me a precious hint when I was looking for a stroller. Highly recommended!

Nathalie’s place was wonderful. It was everything we needed for our weekend trip with a group.

The location was pretty convenient. About 10 minutes walk from the subway station and there was a little bodega around the corner that is open 24 hrs for all the needs for our trip.

It was one of the hottest weekend in the city but thank goodness for the AC! It took a little while to cool down the whole place but we were able to sleep well at night.

We had a request that came up at last minutes but she was very understanding and flexible.

I’d definitely recommend her place to anyone traveling with a group.
This apartment is so lovely and  comfortable. My family of 5 was enough space for all of us. Neighborhood is quiet and Nathalie was great at keeping in touch. We enjoyed our stay so much!

I read A LOT of reviews from A LOT of available places to stay in Brooklyn.  So, I knew Nathalie’s place would be great.  I have always wanted to see the inside of a Brooklyn brownstone after seeing them over the years.  I wanted to experience what they were like and feel their history—while having a few modern conveniences like air-conditioning, a refrigerator, etc.  Nathalie’s place was perfect.  I stayed there 4 nights with my husband and 2 sons—ages 23 and 16.  We had plenty of room and were very comfortable.  It was great to have a roomy, cozy place on a lovely street to go to after sightseeing all day.  The subway was conveniently located only a 6 minute walk away.  Perfect!
Nice place, very quiet  in the middle of brooklyn! The terrace is fantastic for the breakfast or for a quiet moment after walk  in Manhattan !
Charmant appartement et chouette quartier

Appartement avec beaucoup d'âme et de cachet. Terrasse super agréable. Tres bonne literie. Quartier plutot calme et rue jolie et arborée.  Nous avons passé un tres bon moment chez Nathalie. Nous y retournerions certainement.
This is a beautiful apartment located in a great neighbourhood in Brooklyn, with easy access to the subway. Would highly recommend!!

Nathalie held everything she promises in her description and more. 5 of us had plenty of room and the kitchen was perfect for cooking elaborate dinners. You will have an absolute great time and feel right at home.

Wir waren zu fünft (3 Erwachsene und 2 Jugendliche) in Nathalie‘s Apartment und wir hatten eine tolle Zeit! Es ist genügend Platz, Geschirr und Handtücher für alle vorhanden. Die Betten sind groß genug und sehr bequem. Die Terrasse ist toll!
Das Wohnviertel mit den typischen Brownstonehäusern hat uns sehr gut gefallen. Super Anbindung (keine 10 Gehminuten) mit der Metro (C-Line) nach Manhattan oder Downtown Brooklyn. Fernab vom typischen New York Tourismus spielt sich hier das wahre New Yorker Leben ab. Es gibt genügend kleinere Shops und mindestens 2 Supermärkte in der näheren Umgebung.
Wir haben uns rundum wohl und sehr sicher gefühlt und kommen auf jeden Fall zurück!
We had a great time staying at Nathalie's ! Great location and perfect atmosphere. Thank you !

Nathalie's place is so beautiful. It is very special, not at all generic or cookie-cutter. It is clearly a home with a lot of history. She is very attentive to details and you will find a kitchen stocked with many utensils, all set up for cooking. The neighborhood is wonderful and I visited some of the places she suggests in her tips. I appreciated her helping me in and I found the checkout process to be super simple. The bed is comfortable and it was very clean. Communication was very easy as well. A truly lovely way to see the city!
The apartment is cozy and warm. Beds are comfy and there is everything you need for a short staying in NYC. the neighbour has a lot of bars and restaurant and the subway is 5-7 mins away.
The rooms are very good, the facilities are very complete and the location is not far from the subway station.

Viviana’s place was just like the listing, great location and the bed was very comfortable too.
Would stay again!

My two young adult daughters and I stayed 16 nights at Patty’s place. There was plenty of room for the 3 of us. The place was clean and the bathroom was well stocked. Surrounding areas offered a choice of eating places to suit your budget with a range of cheap quick eats to higher end restaurants. Choice of 4 subway stations all within a kilometre made getting to your activities and sightseeing destination easily and a timesaver. We felt safe in the area even when out late as there were still people about in the streets although we made a rule to catch a taxi if getting home after midnight. The building is well secured with 2 key access  security doors and the apartment has a lock, deadlock and bolt. Patty offered you all the privacy and it was a great place to come home to rest and plan your next day.

Het is een Superleuk appartement, wel wat oud en de ramen zijn wat dun, ( oordopjes zijn een must voor het geluid van de straat ) maar je krijgt wel meteen het New Yorkse gevoel en voelt je als een local,
Er is prachtig uitzicht op de observatory tower en er zitten erg veel leuke betaalbare restaurantjes
Ga vooral eten bij Vanessa dumplings
Het is erg dichtbij de metro je bent overal zo
Naar financial district en de Brooklyn Bridge is het te lopen
Perfect apartment in a great and buzzy part of town. The subway on Grand St was only a 5 min walk away. Really cosy apartment with the most comfortable bed!! Had a very memorable holiday

A cosy home away from home with an inviting vibe. I travelled alone and felt quite safe in the building.

The kitchen is well equipped and people have left bits and pieces from previous stays that come in handy. Lots of places to eat nearby.

If yr like me and enjoy having some downtime on yr trip there are two streaming channels to keep you occupied...and the view is amazing. Depending on where yr from, it may seem expensive, but is actually good value for what you get... I had a much better outlook and stay than friends that stayed uptown in soulless chain hotels.

Can recommend. Best. C
Alles wunderbar! Patty ist sehr hilfsbereit und es hat alles super geklappt! Danke!!

Patty’s place is great! Convenient location, super comfy beds, clean space, and a great host. Patty accommodated a flexible check in plan, and even offered to arrange car service back to the airport at the end of our stay. I highly recommend her studio in Chinatown. Thank you Patty, for hosting us!

really nice place to stay, especially to feel like a temporary local in Chinatown/Lower East Side. Subways are a few blocks away (B/D in one direction & F in the other direction), so major midtown sights are about 30 min away. it’s also walkable to Brooklyn Bridge.

what was really helpful about this particular place was that we were arriving in NYC early, and our host was willing to store our luggage for several hours until our room was ready. that was a major help! and same thing when we left...she let us keep our luggage in the room while the room was being prepared for the next guests.

she also willingly offered her expertise to anything we might need. we would consider staying again.
A beautiful apartment with the perfect typical New York feel. Easy 20 minute journey to midtown, and a lovely walk to brooklyn bridge. Will definitely stay again :)
We had a great experience! Patricia had so many thoughtful touches and lots of great recommendations for the area. The location was amazing and made it really easy to get around the city.
Great place! The location is fantastic. We plan on booking it again in summer if it is available.
Loved this space! Amazing view of World Trade Center ❤️ Great location in Chinatown. Has an elevator. Comfy bed. Would book again!

Patty’s place is lovely, she includes plenty of things you might need and even things you didn’t think you would (umbrellas!) she even had the beds made for both me and my friend when we arrived. The best part is the little touches throughout the apartment and the lovely view that you just can’t beat for the price. We had 0 issues and plenty of hours of comfortable sleep before long days out, Don’t pass on this one if you can!

We loved our time at Patty’s! She left a long list of recommendations for restaurants and things to do in the area which we really appreciated! I had a question about checking out and she responded immediately. I was impressed. I would stay again!

We had a lovely stay. Apartment is in a great location near subways, Soho/Nolita, Brooklyn Bridge etc., tonnes of great stuff within easy walking distance. Fab view, very comfortable bed and loved the decor. Patricia sweetly waited up for us for check in and was really helpful when we arrived despite it being quite late. Apartment had everything needed and lots of great tips and advice left behind. Apotheke off Bowery was a great find, and Dirt Candy veggie restaurant just a few blocks away.

Patricia’s space was just ideal for what we wanted. Perfect location and sweet apartment. Plenty of towels and all the necessary kitchen items. Only downside was the lift .. I’m not a fan of lifts at the best of times so I took the 6 flights of stairs everyday. Lift is small and slow..not suitable for those with claustrophobia. This doesn’t bother most people, but worth noting for those who don’t like lifts. Thanks Patricia xxx

Awesome communication and service. Patty was very welcoming and we really enjoyed our stay. The loft is really comfortable (it was freezing outside but inside was super cozy) and the deli downstairs is sooo convenient. There's so much to do close by and lots of transport options. Highly recommended.

This apartment is in a great location on a quiet street. It is an older place that shows its age but comfortable. We were moving our daughter to Brooklyn, so the location was perfect for us. If you are going to be busy and just need a quiet, no frills place to rest your head, this is a good choice.

This is the first time that my  husband  and I traveled  to Brooklyn/NY with our children, who  are  17, 15  and 12. We loved  staying  here. It was perfect for us and really gave a taste of what it might be  like to live in NY. I love old homes and this one had beautiful architectural detail. Nathalie was extremely responsive. The neighborhood was wonderful and we felt like we were home. Wish we could have stayed longer, but we will definitely be back to visit again.

Nathalie’s place was a good fit for my boyfriend, myself, and best friend. The layout was such that we could each have a side of the studio style space, but still maintain some privacy. I would only recommend for close friends/family. Nathalie was also able to offer me a slightly later checkout time, which was appreciated. It took us about 35-48 minutes to get to the village/midtown on the metro. Overall, it was an easy location. It’s an older brownstone and it shows in many areas. For anyone who is hoping to sleep past 730a, this location might not be for you. There are no curtains in the main room, therefore the sun comes through quite early. The people upstairs have children, and their day starts around that time as well.
Funky place with easy access to Manhattan.

Nathalie es una muy buena anfitriona. El departamento es muy cómodo y con un muy lindo estilo. La ubicación muy buena a 700mts del subte A y E. Por el barrio se camina tranquilo con calles bien iluminada y con varios locales de comida , supermercados y lavaderos . Muy recomendable para unos días de paseo por NY.

This is a very comfortable, relaxing flat. It was warm and cosy, and the terrace space really gave it an airy feeling. The location is great for the subway, bus - easy transfer to Manhattan and from JFK.

Neighbours were friendly and Nathalie's suggestions for eating locally were first-rate. I would also include Nagel's Bagels, 378 Tompkins Ave (go early as they sell out quickly) and El Jeffe, 1483 Filton St (Mexican takeaway and frozen margaritas).

A great value Airbnb in a safe, authentic neighbourhood - a small oasis in which to recharge for the next day's sightseeing. Everything went smoothly even though our host was away forthe holidays. Highly recommended.
It is a charming, cozy space with lots of character. My sisters, niece and I enjoyed cooking together, snuggling up chatting and laughing in what felt like a sweet vacation cabin In country.
Excellent séjour chez Nathalie. Nous étions ravis de retrouver cet appartement chaleureux et confortable le soir.

Natalie's place was stylish, eclectic and comfortable. The balcony and living rooms a were definitely our favorite. A big daybed full of pillows on the balcony was perfect for us to enjoy the cool night air and each other's company. There are many comfy places to lay your head and sage to clear the air and unwind. Great value for such a large space.

I’ve been to a lot of Airbnb’s in Brooklyn, but this is by far one of my favorites.  The place is clean and very very cozy.  If you sit down to watch tv you might just wind up napping.  The place is amazing, from decor to patio, to the way everything has been arranged.  Even the old style bathroom was cool.  If it wasn’t for Covid there’d be a lot of bars open nearby.  Still, a great experience if you want to stay in.

Nathalie’s home is an absolute dream in the heart of Bed- Stuy. Booking couldn’t have been a simpler process as Nathalie is extremely communicative and responded nearly immediately. Read the rules! Everything is very clear! No stress check in, arrive and use the lockbox whenever you’re ready. Once you open the door you’re going to fall in love and want to cancel any and all plans to go out (you’re also going to wake up on Sunday and immediately extend your reservation.. just trust me and book Sunday night as well.) The backyard space paired with a glass of wine and the essence of whatever vibe is happening on the block is prime entertainment in and of itself. You’re in the heart of Bed- Stuy with access to the train only a few blocks down giving you the accessibility to explore whatever part of town you’re in the mood for although you can find almost any vibe you’re looking for within a few blocks. Early mornings in Nathalie’s space was really prime time though, the natural light that streams through all the windows in the apartment was so beautiful to wake up to. As someone who’s been traveling to New York over the past few years, Nathalie’s home was genuinely everything I could’ve asked for. Do yourself a favour and experience it for yourself!!

Nathalie's home is lovely with really interesting decorations. She was also very responsive, even when I was having wifi trouble. (Thank you very much!) I'd recommend staying in Nathalie’s brownstone.
Love the space and the patio! A true brownstone on a Brooklyn treelined block, absolutely gorgeous.
Beautiful apartment, tons of natural light, great host and perfect location
Beautiful place. I stay coming back for a relaxing time. Nathalie is great.

Our stay at Nathalie's place was quiet, cozy, and restful. Her place is in Bed-Stuy on a quiet block, but close to some of the main streets in Bed-Stuy and Crown Heights. We spent our days reading, taking baths, and eating pastries and pizza from nearby Saraghina. Nathalie's prompt communication and contact-less check-in made for an easy arrival & settling in.
The apartment was beautiful and I had a great stay there, I would definitely recommend it.
Great location close to everything.         Perfect for our family of three. Patricia was very responsive and friendly. We would be happy to stay here again.

Patty’s place was great. A cozy apartment to return to after long days of exploring New York.
