So much to see and do in this part of the city and we appreciated how accessible the subway was. Patty was always helpful and offered great tips on where to eat close by. I definitely recommend this space.
Great place in Chinatown - love the artist vibes and the high ceilings.

Absolutely loved our stay in the apartment. Exactly what we were looking for from our NY experience, the apartment is cool and quirky and a lovely place to be in with an amazing view out the window. Very close to Grand St subway station as well so a great base to explore, would definitely recommend to someone who doesn’t want a typical hotel experience and wants to feel like you live in a city.

This apartment was perfect for me and my 12 year old son. Quirky and stylish but also very comfortable and spotlessly clean. My son loved sleeping in the loft area and i was very comfortable on the sofa bed downstairs where i had a great view to no 1 wtc while lying in bed!! The kitchen and bathroom facilities were great. The location was a real revelation as have previously only stayed in mid town hotels. We could walk to lots of places and also had a choice of metro stations nearby. Lots of decent eateries on the doorstep. Patty met us on arrival and talked us through all the amenities and also organised a car back to the airport for us when leaving. Her and her son dealt calmly with our mini crisis as we left (son left his phone and coat in the locked apartment!!!)
Would definitely recommend this place and would stay again if available when/if i'm next in NYC.
Checkin and out was a breeze and our host had great recommendations in a pamphlet they made. Easy access to the metro. Plenty of linens for 3 people for 4 nights.
Patricia is a friendly host and her studio is clean and cosy, you can find almost everything you need. Good and safe neighbourhood. If we go to New York again, we will book Patricia’s studio.

Le petit appartement de Patty est composé de meubles et objets très hétéroclites mais c’est ce qui fait tout son charme. Nous l’avons trouvé dans un état de propreté impeccable.
Le lit de la mezzanine est un peu dur tandis que celui du bas est un peu mou. Il y avait quantités d’oreillers, ce qui était très confortable.
Il est un peu bruyant mais nous sommes à New York. Et il est situé au 6e étage ce qui réduit le bruit de la rue.
L’environnement est très animé et il est agréable de se balader dans les rues avoisinantes qui sont tout de même un peu sales.
Patty est très sympathique. Nous sommes arrivées assez tard. Mais cela ne l’a pas gênée et elle a organisé pour nous la réservation d’un taxi pour notre départ vers l’aéroport.
Oui, je recommande ce lieu pour loger à New York.
Anne-Françoise

Perfectly located, nice and cosy flat to stay in South Manhattan close to Brooklyn and everything.
Highly recommanded :)

My partner and I stayed at Patty’s apartment for several nights and it was perfect! We felt very safe in the neighbourhood, the view’s awesome and there were lots of great cafes and restaurants close by. It’s also a short walk to a number of subway stations, which made getting around Manhattan and Brooklyn super easy. Patty was also an excellent host and kept in touch throughout our stay. Highly recommended!
Our stay at Patricia's was amazing!  She was so communicative and helpful, and her place is awesome - great location, easy to access, and super cute. We would definitely stay there again!

Sehr individuell eingerichtetes Appartment. In Küche und Bad war wirklich alles, was man brauchen könnte. Für empfindliche Ohren durch die trubelige Canal Street evtl etwas laut. Uns hat das aber nicht gestört. Die Gastgeberin ist super freundlich und hilfsbereit und wohnt auf dem gleichen Flur.
The space is gorgeous and in a great location. Patty is a great host and went above and beyond.
Amazing place! Communication with Patricia was quick and easy and she answered all of my questions. Unit was clean and cute. Definitely a great place to stay

Great spot in downtown Manhattan, close to several subway stations. Their was a convenient 24 hour deli right under us, and a laundromat just a few doors down. The places was rustic and cozy and clean. Patricia herself was friendly and attentive, giving us some good suggestions on where to eat and where to go.  We would definitely stay here again next time we’re in New York.
It's Manhattan.  This is a good price.

We had a great stay in New York. Patty was super helpful.
Location of the apartment was great and we loved the area. China town and little Italy right on the door step. Good food and bars, don’t be afraid to wander around you will find some right gems. Grand street metro only a short walk away and also metro station on Canal Street itself. Great food in little Italy and also found a great place called The Antique Garage up in Soho area. The High Line is a great place to visit as if the Chelsea market. Patty was a great host and even arranged a local taxi service for our return trip to JFK airport at half the price of the yellow cabs.
Felt completely safe in the area.
Thanks Patty

Appartement très bien situé. Très propre. Bien équipé. Merci à Patty pour nous avoir laissé la possibilité de laisser nos valises à l'appartement pour profiter de notre dernière journée jusqu'à 6pm.Elle nous a même réservée un transport pour notre retour sur JFK au pied de l'immeuble. Encore merci Patty
Perfect location in NYC ! Perfect price! Perfect host !

What a beautiful home in a perfect location!
From grandparents to grandchildren, everyone was very pleased with the accommodations. We found some great restaurants nearby, caught a Broadway show, and cooked some great meals in the kitchen.
I hope we make it back someday to stay again!

Nathalie’s place was just lovely and I wanted to write a very honest review for future guests to know exactly what their receiving. I’ve stayed in over 200 Airbnb’s throughout my four year travels and this apartment really stood out for me. The apartment is definitely much more beautiful in person with hand picked pieces that were really put in with love and care. I honestly expected it to be a little dusty because there was a lot of antique pieces but nope, I really felt like home, each pillow I laid on smelled fresh, everything in the apartment was thoroughly cleaned, it just made me feel so comfortable. Nathalie took care of each aspect of the apartment making it warm and cozy with absolutely gorgeous finishes. I loved her style and sense of cleanliness, really would have stayed longer if I could.

Also, the neighborhood was quite lovely as well. Lots of art, culture and great food, transport right at your feet.

Nathalie was always prompt in communicating back and making sure my stay was going well. This was an awesome place to stay, I thoroughly enjoyed my time here and I hope there will be availability in the future.

Thank you kindly Nathalie for having us, we really appreciate your hospitality.

Nathalie’s place was amazing ! Everything was clean and I loved having the full kitchen so I could cook . The terrace was amazing and Nathalie responded very quick when we would communicate.
The sunlight coming in through the windows in the morning was outstanding! And the place was laid out very very well. I loved all the decorations and everything and it was very peaceful! I would definitely stay again!
Very cozy spot! Great place to spend the day in just relaxing but also centrally located to head out into the city. Would stay again!

These pictures don’t do Nathalie’s home justice - as great as it looks, it’s even better in person. So unique, amazing natural light, and you can tell how thoughtfully everything has been chosen in the apartment - overall it’s one of my favorite places I’ve stayed. Great location & Nathalie was super communicative & accommodating as well. Would love to stay again in the future

Nathalie’s place was a perfect spot for my mom while she visited me in Bed Stuy. Easy check in and check out, perfect location, beautiful decor, and a private terrace! Will definitely book again. Thank you Nathalie!

Wonderful apartment that feels super unique and cozy, with the deck space outside it's the perfect spot for a staycation and close to tons of great food! Loved the time here and would definitely come back again!

Such a cute space!!! Probably the most adorable apartment I've ever stayed in. There's a nice little PRIVATE back patio that's great for warmer nights :) The whole space has a very charming vintage feel. The train is a fairly close walk and so are lots of good delis and restaurants. Friendly neighbors as well.
An amazing little place in a great part of town.
Great location in the neighborhood; host was very responsive when I had a question.

A charming stay! Five of us were able to stay comfortably. Outside terrace was such a treat, and there were places to eat/drink coffee within walking distance. Nathalie was communicative about our needs! Appreciated the details in the apartment – furniture, fireplaces, little reading nook. Space was bigger than expected too. We had two cars to find parking for, and it was fine – took some time to find spots at night but was not bad for NY standards at all, were still able to find spots only a few blocks away farthest.
Nathalie’s place was super cute, tidy, and is surrounded by fantastic restaurants. She was super prompt with responses to our questions and overall a lovely hostess!

This classic Brooklyn brownstone has has an artistic-yet-relaxed style. Very comfortable. The location is superb-- near wonderful restaurants and coffee shops. The host provides clear instructions and answers questions quickly.  So glad I chose this Airbnb.

This was a very charming location, peaceful. The back balcony is great to just relax on for a while, especially if you walked around much of the area.  Family had truly a great time and would love to do it again if the opportunity ever arises.

Nathalie’s apartment was perfect for us. We are a family of 4 and were bringing our oldest daughter to college. The apartment was clean and comfortable and the back porch was a great added bonus. I loved the bathtub and the whole building has very good vibes. We had everything we needed and Nathalie was very good at communicating. Would definitely stay here again!

Nathalie has a beautiful home with a back deck. The space is basically an extended studio loft so there is no private room. The home is more beautiful in person and has a European and South American flare to the space. Just be aware that there are not really blinds / shades in the apartment so if you are planning to sleep in, be sure to bring an eye mask. Also the cleaning fee does not include trash removal or fish cleaning, and you are not permitted to use additional sheets unless you want to pay an additional fee. Otherwise - it is a great neighborhood with great restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance. And is a cheap Uber ride to almost every destination! Great spot for a weekend trip!
The reservation was canceled 70 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

You are missing out if you do not stay in Patty's suite in Chinatown!  My daughter and I had the pleasure of staying there for three nights and four days and had the most wonderful nights sleep because of the extremely comfortable bed and plentiful pillows.  The suite is clean, cooled with AC and beautiful , it made for a perfect home away from home!  The location was great and subways and other public transportation were close and easily accessible!  We were not able to meet Patty (who was very accessible by email while she was on vacation), but we had the pleasure of meeting her son Henry, who was the warmest, nicest, friendliest and most helpful host one could ask for.  We arrived very late and he still greeted us with a smile!  We also utilized and appreciated the information packet that Patty leaves for her guests, who want to make the most of their stay.  The privacy of having an apartment to ourselves was GREAT!  Patty's place is to great to miss!

Patty's hospitality was amazing and she made sure to check in with us regularly. The check in and check out was very flexible and easy. The place was better than expected and everything we needed. We were out and about most of the time but coming back and resting was very peaceful. We barely heard any noise and the place was close to lots of things - subway, food, bars. I would recommend this place to anyone and would definitely stay again.
Great value and comfortable place to stay while visiting NYC.
附近有2个地铁站，很方便，房东亲自接待我们。

Patricia was a wonderful host. Great communication answered any questions swiftly and precisely. We needed to get to the airport and Patricia organised a car for us to arrive that morning. Patricia booked it the night before and followed up with a text message to confirm the booking. I would highly recommend staying here and Patricia is there to answer all your questions.

Jason
Patricia's apartment is confortable and in a good position, you can easily reach downtown walking. Patricia is a good host, helpful and kind. I suggest this apartment for short trip!

Patricia welcomed us in person, which is always nice. The apartment, in an old Lower East End building, is very charming. The mezzanine bed can be hot in August, in spite of air conditioning, but the fans help a lot and we slept well. The apartment is very well located, a short walk away from Brooklyn Bridge, the Village, Chelsea, and other interesting, and lively parts of the city.
Patty is a really great host good communication great hospitality. The appartment is slightly different from what we expected

The reviews are true! Patty’s place is awesome and Patty herself is SO COOL! I flew in on the red eye and was in the city at 7 am but Patty was totally happy to take my bag while I went out and explored. I got back around 11 and the maid was just starting to clean but I was totally exhausted and ready to sit down...the housekeeper/patty let me hang out on her couch until the place was ready. That was SO appreciated, I was so tired I was about to fall over! The apartment was perfect for me as a solo traveler and I looooooved the view of One World Trade out the window from the bed. Great stay, would stay again!

Die Unterkunft war wunderbar. Eine wirklich fantastische Aussicht.
In der Nähe vom little Italy und man war sehr schnell am times Square.

Die Kommunikation war sehr wenig und es hat wenig gedauert, bis es eine Antwort gab. Zwischenzeitlich habe ich mir schon Sorgen gemacht, dass ich kurzfristig eine andere Unterkunft benötige. Schlussendlich hat es dann aber geklappt. Den Schlüssel haben wir in einem Gespräch mit noch nicht mal drei Sätzen bekommen. Check out war ebenfalls unkompliziert.
Cozy place in the middle of culture, food, and next to several hidden cafes. Awesome park nearby :)

Great location, great apartment. We love walking and it conveniently located within reasonable walking distances to downtown. Uptown, great transport links. Patty was a fab host explaining everything and organising for transfers for us back to the airport.
Location is perfect so close to everything we wanted to see. Patricia was really friendly and had lots which of great tips for local places to eat which we used a lot.

We enjoyed our stay at Patty’s place so much! It’s a great loft studio in the bustling and arty lower east side/Chinatown hood, with great restaurants and nightlife steps away. Patty was super communicative and easy to call/text with questions. Highly recommended.
Very convenient location, great transport links. The apartment felt safe, and was clean and quirky. Patty was a great host!

Patricia, as a host will go out of her way to be as helpful as she can be. The apartment was spotlessly clean, well situated to explore all of New York and well equipped. Patricia was there to greet us and rang a taxi for us to return to the airport. We had a great stay.

simple and comfy one-room location with nice view. everything you need is there. countless nyc hotspots (lower east side, china town, little italy, east village, soho, tribeca, meatpacking district, financial district, greenwich, brooklyn bridge, brooklyn heights) are within walking distance. communication with patty was quick, friendly and easy.
Clean. Comfortable. Great location to everything in Manhattan we wanted to see. Our host was very welcoming and accommodating. Beds were super comfy. I would stay here again.

Funky cool but thought out in it’s decor, Nathalie’s place gives you all you see in the photos, yet feels even bigger in person. The access to outdoor space was great. I loved that fresh air. Good cotton linens and a large enough bathroom with a sweet window! (No shower tho). Great kitchen and large up front room with even more slewing options. The BedStuy details are present everywhere. Enjoy!
This is a fantastic place to stay. Great location and amenities, and Nathalie is a wonderful host. I will definitely book again!

My sisters and I enjoyed staying at Nathalie's beautiful brownstone for two nights. The space is clean and comfortable and we had a lovely evening watching the clouds change colors with the sunset on her private patio. Her place is also walking distance to a spot with great bagels and other with some delish biscuits. Communication with Nathalie about how to properly lock the doors was quick and easy. We would definitely stay here again.
The apartment is beautiful and spacious - we had a great stay!
Great place to spend a night in. Good location, fast communication. Only minus is the shower, but could be that we didnt figure it out
Value was great and our family fit comfortably in the space.
Nathalie was a great host:  good communication, offered suggestions of area businesses, good instructions. Loved staying in this Brooklyn neighborhood. Would definitely stay here again!

Beautifully curated space convenient to subway, restaurants, stores, etc. Check in details were very specific and helpful. Host made sure to be available if we needed her. Highly recommend if you’re wanting a beautiful, aesthetic space to feel like your home away from home.

Det er en super hyggelig lejlighed og et meget centralt sted

The place is super charming. Nathalie was flexible with us (our flights got canceled and rescheduled for a day late and she easily accepted our adjustments), and communicated quickly through any issues. The place is a little bit drafty so on colder nights it was a little chilly, so I recommend warm pjs if you get cold easily but there is a space heater which made a huge difference after the first night! Just something I think about so thought i would mention. :) no issues though and everything was neat and as explained! The area is in a cute part of Brooklyn and about an 8 minute walk to the metro to go to manhattan. Super easy to get to and quiet place with plenty to do near by as well!
I loved this place. Great location and super cute apartment. Also super quick response time!!

Absolutely amazing stay at Patty’s place in Chinatown. If you’d prefer to stay somewhere with real character, rather than a faceless hotel, this is the place for you. The apartment itself is full of character and original features - expect it a little rough around the edges, but in a good way! The grocery store underneath does decent coffee and the little Chinese cake does great sweet bread - both CHEAP. Patty herself was super accommodating, allowing us a late check out and arranging a car to the airport for us. The only possible reasons this apartment might not be for you is if you need a quiet place to sleep (there’s tons of outdoor traffic noise, to be expected in New York!), you suffer from claustrophobic (the lift is small, slow and hot!), or you have any issue with being a 10/15 min walk from the underground. Wonderful area of cute brownstones and just the right balance of being in a bustling city and a quaint neighborhood - just around the corner from Atlantic Ave shops! Three floors gave us plenty of space for our family of 5 to have room to spread out our stuff and gather around the dining room together.  I wish it wasn't as cold as it was to enjoy the spacious backyard and outdoor deck.  But my boys were able to shoot hoops at the open court across the street.
We stayed over Christmas and the house was cozy and comfortable. Plenty of cooking supplies, which was great as we didn’t want to eat out. We felt very at home!

Laurelle's place is in a great location, very close to great restaurants and shows! The apartment is clean and cozy with a great shower! Laurelle is wonderful to deal with very quick to respond and accommodating.  Would definitely stay here again.

Staying at Laurelle's apartment was a real treat! It is conveniently placed and walking distance from several restaurants, theaters, bars and subway stops. When we weren't out exploring the city, we were comfortable and entertained in Laurelle's apartment with access to a computer and television. Thanks, Laurelle!

We couldn't have asked for a better apartment, location, or hostess! This place is a wonderful little studio with so much character right in the heart of the city. Laurelle was always available to answer questions. Fantastic overall experience and highly recommended!

Good location.Laurelle is very kind and the apartment is near to all New York attractions. We only had some problem with some beattles in the bathroom and in the kitchen. I think is a New York old problem. She told us she's going to extermite them.

What a fantastic location! Very short walk to Central Park and Times Square and near a subway station and Whole Foods store. Laurelle was very welcoming and the apartment was clean and tidy for us. We were also able to leave our bags during our last day and return later to collect them, which was a big help. The neighbourhood was very safe and for first time New York visitors it was a great place for us to be very inexpensively.

My boyfriend and I stayed at Laurelle's place from Sept 1st to Sept 5th and it was absolutely Perfect!! Great location, great apartment, great host! It was just a couple of blocks from Central Park and Time square without being too crowded or loud. Subway lines are very close too! We were so pleased with everything. Thank you so much Laurelle for making this trip a fantastic one!!

We stayed 5 nights at Laurelle's place and it was great.  Easy and flexible check in and out, plus access to her computer! The flat is central and quiet, a nice addition is hearing the clip clop of horse/carriages driving by.

We stayed at Laurelle's place for one night on 12/18/10. She was a gracious host and thankfully didn't mind that traffic put us over an hour late to check-in! The apartment was clean and inviting and the location can't be beat. We had a fabulous stay and would definitely stay at Laurelle's again.

We stayed with Laurelle for New Years Eve weekend, and it was a wonderful visit. Her apartment was walking distance from good restaurants and she was really helpful in giving recommendations. Her apartment was eccentric and quite a relaxing place to be. We will stay there again the next time we return to the city.
Super!
Great location, very clean, and quiet.

Laurelle was very hospitable and easy to contact. Her place was perfect for two people to stay in and the location was great. The building is quiet and the doorman was very helpful and sweet! The apartment is close to the subway and walking distance from several bars and restaurants in the area. I highly recommend it!

Perfect location close to the subway, Central Park, great restaurants and delis. So as a base to discover Manhattan it's absolutely spot on. The apartment itself is as described, located in a relatively calm street away from the crowds and a positive plus was quiet neighbours in the building. Laurelle was a great host, both in communicating before, during and after the stay, Couldn't be better!

This place was as nice as described on the website. We loved it and we would stay there again: great location, the place was quiet, welcoming and very clean. The bed was good and the shower very nice. Laurelle was very helpful and nice. We loved it!
We highly recommend this place!!

Laurelle's studio is charming, cozy and perfect for two people. Located in a very nice area of Manhattan, with a comfy bed and good shower.

We felt like locals and had a really cool experience. It is close to lot's of nice restaurants, bars and delis. Walking distance from Central Park, Times Square and all major metro lines. There is a doorman, elevator and it is very well equiped.

It could be a bit more organized and clean. I also suggest to make some more space to leave gest's personal luggage. Apart from that the place is perfect!

We stayed in Laurelle's apartment for 5 nights in July 2011.  The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos.  It is situated in a very good location and within easy walking distance of Central Park and Time Square.  There are also some very good restaurants in the area.  Laurelle was a very good host and recommended things for us to see and do in the area.  I would definitely stay here again.

Thanks to Sarah for being available before this trip to answer our questions, needs (travel bed), and for offering us good tips on site. The accommodation was perfect for our large family. Located a short walk from the subway, it was easy to get to Manhattan quickly. The garden was perfect for the children. I will return to this accommodation without hesitation.

This home was wonderfully accommodating for our family of five, and it’s situated in a beautiful neighborhood close to public transit, making it easy to get around!  We are looking forward to our next visit.

Super cute and extremely spacious for our stay! Love the decor and the home really has anything you could need — from the well equipped kitchen, to washer/dryer etc.  The hosts communicate clearly and honestly and are available for any questions. My sister lives in Brooklyn and I will definitely be staying again next time I visit!
Wonderful place, stellar location
Beautiful brownstone in Brooklyn! Great spot for a large group of us, hugely spacious with a large backyard area. Felt very home-y. Sarah was incredibly communicative and helpful throughout our stay.
House and location are excellent. The yard was a wonderful bonus and great for our family. We’d stay there again in a heartbeat.

Great value, large brownstone in perfect Brooklyn location in Boerum Hill, close to subways, shops, and parks. The backyard with trampoline, treehouse and slides was a rare bonus that our kids loved. This is very much the host family’s home, and is well equipped. The host is very responsive and helpful.

Charming home in fantastic Brooklyn location, near the N, 2, 3, and more lines, with plenty of space for a large family gathering.  The artwork and extensive library added to the rich ambience.  Large dining room and outdoor eating space allowed a family feel.  Generous pantry and well stocked kitchen were unexpected advantages.  Highly recommend.

Great historic house. very comfortable living area and kitchen. Fantastic French bakery 8 minutes away "bien cuit" and easy for public transport.
Sarah was very quick to respond.

We had a great time staying at Sarah’s place. Their house is gorgeous and spacious, and in a great location. Sarah communicated with me before our stay and the hosts checked in on us after we checked in. I would definitely recommend.

Sarah's home was the ideal base for our family Thanksgiving trip to Brooklyn.  Sarah and Josh were thoughtful, communicative hosts, and their home has all  the charm and quirks of a 19th-century NY townhome, which we appreciated. The location is fantastic -- nice residential neighborhood just a short walk away from the subway and all the great shopping surrounding the Barclay Center.  Families with small children will love the backyard and neighborhood playgrounds.

If you want to experience a very well-located classic Brooklyn Brownstone, Sarah and Josh’s place is for you.  Their lovely home hosted our large family over Christmas and we made wonderful memories together in their well-stocked kitchen and comfortable living space.  Our only regret is that it was too cold to use the amazing kid friendly backyard.  Sarah and Josh were very responsive to our needs and made us welcome.
Dana is a great host: very flexible when my plans changed. There are great views of Manhattan from the roof deck. It was royally hot when we visited but the two AC units kept it super cool inside.

Dana was most accommodating, checking me in early and coming to my technological rescue with the TV etc. His staff were very helpful, and the rooms were great, in a very quiet part of Brooklyn and totally decked
I would definitely stay there again and recommend great value for money
Dana was very understanding of our needs and the whole staff was great! This was definitely a great deal and a great place to stay.

We had a great time staying at the loft. It was comfy, cozy and they have a great aesthetic for design. The terrace was a huge bonus and had a great view of Manhattan! It was a great place to unwind after sight-seeing or for getting ready to hit the town.

We also like the Greenpoint-Williamsburg area, tons of great bars, restaurants and shopping. Thumbs way up!

The place is amazing, and even though it seems to be a bit far off the city (williamsburg/bedford ave or manhattan) it is simply a good experience to stay at the Box House Hotel.

The rooms are awesome, clean, tidy, air conditioned, equipped with everything you need. The terrace is beautiful and if you are lucky enough you have an astonishing view on Manhattan's skyline. It's crazy.

Dana is a great guy in general. Very kind and helpful. In our case we had one particular problem. Unfortunately the hotel was overbooked, so we first had to move across the hall, then to another hotel for two nights. However Dana and his assistant made it pretty seemless for us.

Love the location: At first you think it might be inconvenient but your wrong; crossing the Pulaski bridge to catch the subway is an easy walk. As well, walking up to the restaurants closer to Greenpoint Ave is easy.  It's been hot in NYC but the AC in this unit rocks. Good WIFI! Apple TV! View of Manhattan! Deck! and Dana! Really easy to make arrangements with Dana and quick response to all queries.
It was a great stay in Brooklyn. We loved the place! The staff is nice. We stayed more than one week so we got all the attention, cleaning, etc. Thanks!

A + !
Very convenient location. The apartment was super clean, well equipped and as a bonus well decorated. We especially enjoyed the terrace. The sofa-bed is very comfortable, we slept like babies.

Dana was very nice and accommodating when we asked for a different kind of room, and also when we arrived *late* for our expected check in.

Only thing: they are renovating the whole building, so it gets a little noisy in the mornings, during the week. They start at about 8-9 am.

I would definitely recommend to a friend!

The loft was in a wonderful condition, everything was well functioning and clean. It was fully equipped with all items I could imagine I would need for a stay away from home and even the décor was very appealing. Very charming: hints and brochures for tourist activities and also information on home delivery/take-away and restaurant places as well as a cookbook in the kitchen. I definitely enjoyed my stay there.

The communication with Dana and the reception on my first day very perfect, everybody was helpful.

The location is cool in a kind of mix between industrial area and normal neighborhood with cool coffee shops and diners as well as restaurants in a few minutes walking distance. Also, subway and bus stop are only max. 10 minutes away.

We really enjoyed our stay in Greenpoint over a long weekend. It was everything we expected and the location was great. Communication with the host and the service was perfect. I can strongly recommend this apartment!

We had an amazing stay at the box house hotel ! The flat is great, you have all the convenience you need, it's clean and quiet. Dana is always there when you need something.
Great location to visit NY as it is only 10 minutes from the subway station 7 that goes directly to Grand Central and Times Square in 10 minutes. The area of Greenpoint offers coffees, diners, supermarkets and small restaurants and the Greenpoint subway allows you to visit Brooklyn easily. We'll definitely go back there for our next trip in New York !

The appartment is really perfect for visiting New York, just ten minutes walk to the Metro and then just one stop fr.o.m. Central Station. Any hotel or appartment at à smilar standard or size at Manhattan one stop from central areas would cost ten times more. The appartments are really nice and the staff is very friendly and service minded.

The area doesn't look nice, but there is a good supermarket close, easy to park at no cost and we felt safe. If we wanted to go to a restaurant, we always went to Manhattan since it is so close.

They recommended to take a taxi from the airport, but actually all airports have busses to Grand Central and if you don't have to much luggage, it is then easy to take the Metro one stop and take the 10 minutes walk.

We could not use the terrace due to the heat (100 Fahrenheit in NYC) and due to the noise from the big road close. Im not sure if the extra cost for the terrace is worth it, but it is a good price anyway.

This is definitely our prefered choice if going to NYC again and we will recommended it to all our friends.
Great Location!!!

We stayed here for a week and really enjoyed the central location.  Times Square, Central Park, subways, supermarkets and hell's kitchen restaurants were all easy walking distance.  Tommi was super helpful with directions from the airport which made connections much easier.  The apartment is surprisingly quiet given the busy city is right there.  Using the laundry facilities in the building was also handy towards the end of our stay.  We also used the computer at the apartment for getting on the internet to book things and check out things to do.  The photos are exactly what you can expect, it's not a huge place but doesn't claim to be, it's still muh better than a hotel at a similar price!
great place

Quiet, safe, comfortable, charming.  Superb location.  Great value.  Laurelle was a kind and considerate host, and great with communication.  The Midtown Pied-a-terre will be at the top of my list when I visit the area again.

Love, love, loved it! Brilliant location, beautiful apartment, lovely host. Not a bad word. Hot powerful shower. Comfy bed (if your under 6ft 4 and not a big sook). Close to delicious food- both restaurants and markets. Super close to great shows and times square! Will def stay here again on next visit. Thanks!
Highly recommended. great space, great location, and very gracious and professional home owner.

Tommi's place was clean (smelled of cinnamon) and set up to accommodate our needs perfectly. We needed an extra bed which Tommi helpfully set up for us in advance. She also left little post-its for us that explained everything we needed to know - the locations of tucked away power outlets, where the kitchen utensils were etc.

She was also a great communicator - replying to emails quickly as well as keeping in touch via SMS to make sure we were settled in OK.

I would definitely consider staying here again.

Wow, was so nice I enjoyed my stay so well I hardly knew I was there !! Went by much too fast !!
Thanks Tommi

Tommi's apartment is just as described. Perfect location - grocerys, restaurants, fast foods, pharmacys, closest subway 2 blocks away, central park just 5 blocks - everything you need by walking distance. It has a confortable bed (but taller people may have problems), a nice kitchen (doesnt have a microwave) and a bathroom (with a body mirror!)

Tommi is the most wonderful host, always helping when needed (when we didn't know how to use the tv, or to close the windows), she let us use the apt telephone to make local calls and even though she wasnt in town she send a friend to deliver the keys and was always there to assist us.

The things I wasn't very glad about was the lightning, witch are very poor, even if you turn on all the lights and the bathroom curtains witch doesnt close very well and overflows the bathroom.
Also, the tv is old and it's kind of difficult to deal with it, but you won't go to NYC to watch tv so thats fine. Other than that, great stay and would definatelly book again.
Excelente ubicación. Muy amable el trato con Tommi. El apartamento es acogedor y cálido.

We had a great stay at the apartment. Location was absolutely fantastic, literally walk out the door and you're in Central Park and a short walk gets you to the heart of time square. Apartment itself was great, warm and cost and had all the amenities we could have asked for. The host was also extremely helpful and very easy to get along with.

Tommi's place is nice and cozy, and perfectly located for the main touristy area as well as some nice bars and restos in Hell's Kitchen area. Communications with Tommi were always timely, and friendly.  I recommend the place for a couple more than for friends.

Our time at Tomis apartment was great! The apartment is just like the pictures, there is even a full mirror, which was great! It's in a great location, close to all the main subway lines, we could even go to Times Square walking! And Tommi was a great host, always helpful.
This studio flat in Midtown was a great location and cozy and comfy.  And Tommi was super helpful about seeing to our needs!  Had a great time.

Thank you so much Tommi for having us in your home!!!
The location is truly perfect. Cafes at your doorstep and the park from a few blocks away.
The studio is cozy and so inviting. The bed is super comfy and the shower was great!
Thanks for making it so easy Tommi.

We hope to stay again:)

Cx

WOW!  What a great stay.  Perfect location.  Happy to see there was an Elevator.  Parking Garage on the same street.  Tommi was very nice and accommodating.  the space was comfortable and perfect.  Plenty to do within walking distance.  If you are looking for a place in Midtown.  Stop looking.  This is the place.

We loved Matthew´s place. His apartment is very spacious, clean, organized and with a nice backyard (something not easy to find in NYC).The apartment seems to be newly renovated so everything looks brand new. The apartment has an independent entrance, so you feel like you are staying at a house. The area is very nice, QUIET and SAFE, and a very resourceful neighbourhood with a great park a block away. The subway station is at the corner and bus stops are a block away so it was very easy to move around the city. There is a bus that goes downtown all the way to the Financial district with a very beautiful scenery along the way.

Matthew was all the time very attentive to our needs and as he lives on the apartment above it is very easy to contact him.

All and all we had a great time in NYC and Matthew´s place was a key part on it. The price is a bargain and We certainly recommend it and we hope to stay there again.

Dear Matthew and Ali,
Thanks for everything. The apartment was perfect and you both are fantastic. You were very kind and helpful to us.
For anyone who wishes to rent this big apartment with a great backyard I recomend it. My boyfriend and I spent 20 days in it and we got to know the owners a bit. All I say about their kindness it is true.
Even the place is a bit far from downtown it has the advantage to have a subway station right in the corner which is at ease (having into account the distances in NYC). It is clean and the bed is new brand. Matthew lives upstairs, so everything we needed we just knocked on the door. And he allowed us to use their Internet as much as we needed. Thanks so much for that!
The neigbourhood is quite and safe. So what else could one wish?

Highly recomended!!!

Matthew and Ali were very helpful and gave us great tips on what to see and do. The apartment is spacious and was very clean. It had an outdoor courtyard which pleasure to see.  Matthew even had some snacks for us upon our late arrival on the first night. The subway and buses are steps away from the apartment and we always felt very safe in the area. The bed was very comfortable.  I recommend Matthew's apartment for an enjoyable stay in New York.  Thanks Matthew
Excellent experience.  Highly recommend.

Great apartment.  He and his girlfriend made us feel very welcome.  The apartment was near the subway which made it very easy to get around the city.  I highly recommend staying here and would stay here again when I come to NY.

We had a wonderful stay here. The place was spacious, clean and comfortable. Matthew and Ali have fitted it for maximum ease and comfort and everything is laid out in an easy and accessible manner. They were friendly and helpful hosts who we felt comfortable knowing we could go to if there was anything we needed help with.

The location is fantastic. The subway is almost right outside the door, just a stone throw away however the street retains a quiet feel and we were never disturbed by noise during our stay. The trains servicing the stop gave easy access to Times Square, Union Square, Central Park and further afield.

For anyone planning a trip to New York, we highly recommend staying here.

Personification of great hospitality. Came to my rescue twice when i had no place to stay. Excellent communication. A cozy apartment near an amazing location. Everything in a walking distance. Tommi has been very professional in detailing out everything that one needs during a short stay. Love the apartment!

We were very happy with the location which was absolutely perfect! I also very appreciate the responsible and reliable attitude of Tommi, who responded us always immediately and was very helpful with everything. The cooperation and personal attitude was 100% satisfaction.

Tommi (Laurelle) was very helpful and informative and answered any communication very quickly.  Her apartment is in a great location, with lots of nice bars and restaurants close by and not far from Times Square and Broadway.  There are no stairs to enter the building and there is a lift, so perfect if stairs are a problem.  The apartment is small but works well for one or two people.  There are a lot of personal belongings in and on every surface in the apartment and a completely full fridge so very little room for hanging clothes or storing food, and no microwave.  The TV is old and must be turned on and off via a switch on the TV. Laurelle was very kind and helpful, a lovely host.

This place was great, perfect distance from everything. Plenty of restaurants and stores around within walking distance. We stayed here for New Years and walked to time square for the ball drop. The apartment itself was cozy and just what we needed for the stay. Tommi was great and i would stay here again.
Un super emplacement !! Je recommande à qui veut visiter Manhattan !! Hôte adorable, qui vous indiquera de bonnes adresses. Idéal pour un couple.
Great location.   Very nice building.   Small but nice studio.  Perfect for solo or couples.

La comunicación con Tommi ha sido muy buena desde el principio. Estaba en el piso para recibirnos, a pesar de que el avión llegó con retraso y me escribió durante la estancia para asegurarse de que todo estaba bien. El apartamento está bien situado y dispone de todo lo detallado en el anuncio. La cama es cómoda y la ducha funciona bien. Sin embargo, las sábanas tenían manchas y agujeros, la cortina de la ducha presentaba moho y, en general, el piso no estaba tan limpio como nos hubiera gustado.

Appartement très bien placé entre central park et time square. à 3 minutes à pied du métro. Tommi est vraiment très gentille et nous a très bien accueilli. Le logement est très sympa, il manque juste une table et une armoire pour mettre ses vêtements. Mais lors d'un séjour à New-York on est plus dans la rue qu'enfermé dans un appartement :)
This apartment was super cute and in the perfect location! There was a doorman and elevator too which was a plus. I would recommend this place to anyone.

The location was great and Tommi was very helpful and accomdating. The apartment is a bit small and crowded, so there was not a lot of place for personal belongings. Also, there is a strong smell of incense and aromatic oils in the apartment, which can be problematic for people with allergies.

Tommi (Laurelle) was a great host. Nice, helpful and answering any questions very fast.
The apartment was in a great and safe location close to Times Square, Broadway, Central Park and Metro Stations. Nice Bakeries, Restaurants, Bars, small Supermarkets were very close.
The apartment is small and as shown on the pics. A bit crowded, so not a lot of space for our belongings. but ok for 1 week.
Laurelle, thank you. You were a lovely host.

We could not have asked for anything more! Tommi (Laurelle) was a wonderful, gracious hostess. The space is quirky, cute, and the location is ideal! We rarely needed to use Uber, many activities are well within walking distance. Highly recommended!

The house was very confortable !
Nice ubication near subways and a lot of restaurants. Downstairs there is a doorman so u will be secure and safe.
Laurelle was very kind with us, easy to comunicate and very respectfull. She
help us with all that we need. Great host, reccomended 100%!

The location of Laurelle's (Tommi) home is perfect. Safe neighborhood and walking distance to restaurants, CVS, Central Park, coffee shops, etc. Also close to transit entrances, so we never had to take an Uber or cab! Loved the vibe of this unique little apartment. Laurelle greeted us upon check in to exchange keys and share recommendations for places nearby. Overall, we had a positive experience during our weekend stay!

This apt. has a really groovy, funky decor and vibe - tons of character - I loved it!  I felt very comfortable there. It's small but not at all cramped. Laurelle (Tommi) was super responsive and a good communicator, and very friendly and welcoming. All the info was clear and there were no surprises with her place. The building is safe and I felt very comfortable staying there as a single female. The building itself is on a quiet residential block, but the street one block away is chock full of restaurants, bars, cafes, diners, grocery stores, drug stores, etc. A great location convenient to all that Midtown has to offer. Enjoyed my stay very much!

Tommi's place was a nice place to stay in New York. She was extremely responsive and very nice about everything. The apartment was very busy with her stuff, but that wasn't bothering much. The location is great.

Her place is great!
I live in NYC but needed a place to stay for the weekend.
The neighborhood is great, so many good choices of places to eat!
I never got such a good nights sleep.
Her apartment is so relaxing even with the liveliness of the neighborhood.

I had such a great time and pleasure staying with Teri. This place is a gem in New York, clean and neat, walking distance to all the trendy restaurants in Harlem, and most important of all, the place is warm and welcoming. Teri is a sweet and charming host; She is a lovely friend to talk to and connects to her guest from her heart.

awesome~ awesome! just awesome!! i would go back for sure. he's nice guy, provided everything.. i love his place~~ :) easy to get subway sta. just purfect~
thank you matthew~

The appartment of Matthew is verty comfortable situated in à safe neighborghood. You can reach downtown NY in 10 min by Metro. I woud certainly recomment this place.Thanks for let me stay in this appartment Matthew
Marx

Matthew was such an excellent host! The house was in perfect conditions and very close to the metro station. We wouldn't hesitate to stay there again or recommend it to friends.
Thanks for everything :D

We had a wonderful experience at Matthew's apartment. He was a very helpful host with details big and small. The apartment was in a quiet area and conveniently located close to the subway. The space was simple but it fit our family's needs very well. I would highly recommend a stay with Matthew and look forward to coming back.

Staying at Matthew's place in Harlem was a relaxing, cozy experience. The apartment was very clean with great extras like the snacks in the kitchen as well as the bath products. Although we didn't speak very much during the trip, he was always checking up on us to see if we needed anything. The location right next to the subway worked well since we like being in more than just midtown during our visit. The price was fair and I thought it was a plus not to have to pay a security deposit. Matthew was also flexible during our departure which helped make airport day less stressful and that was appreciated. I would definitely recommend Matthew as an excellent host. Thank you!

A wonderful place to call home for a stay in NYC. The apartment is as advertised. It has a very comfortable bedroom. The closets have hangers and drawer units so that you can really unpack.

The kitchen was very servicable and Matt offered to supplement any pots/pans/utensils we were short.

The living/dining area was well appointed and very comfortable.

The location was wonderful - 200 feet to a subway stop and not further to a bus stop.

As a host Matt went out of his way to welcome us and make sure we had what we needed.

This was a great home away for home.

Matt was a great host!  He communicated with us before the trip, making sure our plans were going well and responded quickly to messages!  He gave excellent directions and we found the place with no problem.  The apartment was amazing and we have no complaints about Matt or the place!  Great location, amazing place, I would love to stay there again!!

Simply the best place to stay in New York!!!!! The apartment is exactly like on the pictures. Matthew was a very nice host, always making sure we had anything we needed and that we were enjoying our stay.
The subway is rignt next to it, and the busy 125th street is only minutes away walking. I recommend this place with no hesitation and look forward to staying there again!!!!!!!

Matthew was great. The apartment was lovely and spacious as pictured. I did truly feel at home. The apartment was situated in a very quiet and peaceful neighborhood and I couldn't have asked for more.

Thanks for your generosity and your hospitality.

Susan

Mathew is a wonderful host. His place has everything that you need to enjoy your visit in the city. Maps, directions, menus, and other informative information can be found on the desk. Mathew is also helpful and only a phone call away if you have any questions. Right next to the subway so very easy to get around. Across the street from a park so if traveling with a pet like we do it is great.

We would recommend staying here to anyone visiting NYC. Kid friendly, pet friendly.

Matt was extremely accommodating from the jump. He made sure I had everything I needed, even though I had arrived earlier than I expected. Matt also made a great effort to check on me after the fact. He even helped with a quick subway question. The previous guest didn't exactly do the best in keeping the place up, but he made sure he brought it back to where it should have been.

The property itself is definitely a home away from home. Comfy and spacious enough to settle right in. The neighborhood is nice and safe. It gives you a real NY feel. The B and C train is literally right outside, ready to take you anywhere you need to go. I will definitely be staying there again soon!

This space is wonderful. It feels like home and is very close to public transportation lines- we were able to get anywhere within just minutes from Manhattan to Brooklyn to the North end.  Matthew is a great person, very helpful, and everything was a pleasure-from the stay to our relations.  Highly recommend this place and Matthew!

Good flat. Can't imagine anything so close to subway and so super calm at the same time. Neighborhood is indeed safe. Matthew is very nice and helpful person and his girlfriend also.

But if you are medical quality cleanness freak i'd recommend to find something else. :)

Anyways, its very good deal for this price.

Great stay! Location a little on the outskirts but you can still walk to subways and shops/restaurants...the complimentary taxi service is really convenient. Sort of nice to get away and decompress from the city. The staff here were all helpful and very accommodating. Would definitely recommend to someone who doesn't mind being out of the city and/or on a budget.

Giving it My FFF +++ :)
Even though maybe I shouldn't because I should keep it a secret ;)

I'll stay with Teri ANYtime again! As a matter of fact I wanted to book another stay right away, but to my dismay, but not to my surprise it wasn't available! Until next time!
Great host for my first time in the city. Lives in a bustling area just a minute's walk from a supermarket, entertainment and the A train; 10 minutes walk from Columbia University.

What can I say about Teri and her perfect pad in buzzing Harlem without seeming like I'm gushing! Teri is full of gorgeous and positive energy, and so generous in the giving of her time, advice and local tips.

The bedroom is incredibly spacious, and Teri's home is a warm reflection of the interesting and beautiful person that she is. It's situated so close to the subway, that you can be downtown Manhattan in a flash or alternatively, hang out in Harlem at the great cafes, bars and other night spots.

I can't wait to catch up with Teri next time I'm in NYC!

Unbelievable! I haven't been in that area in a while, and the description was spot-on: it IS the best area in Harlem and I had an absolute blast. The apartment was clean, Teri was amazingly accommodating, friendly and just a beautiful person to be around, and the area offered more than I had time to explore. Just book it-it will be the best experience.

I was really impressed with the friendliness of Teri and the surrounding neighbourhood.  Her home was warm, artistic and comfortable.  She made me feel welcome and like I was a friend and not just a guest.  Thanks so much Teri and all the best on your future adventures.

Teri is charming for sure and just awesome overall.  The room was spacious, clean and very comfortable.  The neighborhood is also very welcoming with sidewalk cafes, nice restaurants and cool places to get a drink and listen to music within just a few blocks.  Teri's recommendations for local restaurants and coffee shops were all great.  For runners, you can start a run in nearby Morningside Park and then connect to Central Park -- you are just 10 blocks north of Central Park.  Getting around is also easy as there are subway stops just a few blocks north and south.  Columbia University and CCNY are both within walking distance.  Highly recommended.

Teri is a great and welcoming host. The place is exactly as described. Its clean and neat and the location is great. There is a large closet for storing your clothing.
The apartment is quiet although you can hear the street, which really just means "New York" to me.
Fredrick Douglass Ave has a lot of restaurants, Morningside park and Columbia is a short walk. The 125 street subway stop is very close and have lots of options including express lines that will take you anywhere in Manhattan end beyond.
I would stay there again and I recommend others to do the same

I Absolutely loved staying here for 1 month! Teri is super friendly and easy to get along with. The apartment is clean, comfortable and in an amazing location, with the Express and local trains very close on 125th St. There is also an internal laundry, which was a nice surprise as this can be hard to find in nyc. The neighbourhood is safe and I wouldn't hesitate to stay with Teri again :)

It was a great stay at the box hotel. the staff was professional, the room clean and spacious, and everything went as planned. thank you for a very nice time at the hotel, i will definitely recommend the hotel to others who come for a visit.

This was our second visit to the Box House, and I don't think we would chose to stay anywhere else in New York from now on. With our own spacious high ceiling apartment, we could prepare and eat our own breakfast - and one evening dinner. North Greenpoint has character and charm that Manhattan doesn't, some great local restaurants (check out the fantastic newly opened Glasserie, just round the corner, or the hugely popular Five Leaves). Don't be put off by the location in an industrial/Polish area, it feels authentic, and the hotel driver will deliver you (or pick you up from) anywhere in the locality in their own taxi.
Beds are extremely comfortable, and furniture more than adequate. Decor is modern/funky. Service at the desk is helpful and friendly. The place has a homely feel - its not large or impersonal.
Access to Manhattan is easy - 2 stops on the 7 from Vernon/Jackson (a 15 minute scenic walk across the Pulaski bridge or a drop from the driver) gets you to Grand Central.

We had a great time!  The staff is very friendly, the rooms are large and very fun.  The terrace is nice to city-watch on.  And I enjoyed getting to know Greenpoint a bit.  What a great neighborhood!  We loved going to Milk and Roses each morning for breakfast.
Great apartment, everything is new and fresh.  Front desk staff is there to assist and always with a smile.  Attractive value in the middle of a booming neighborhood.
Well worth the price!  You will not be disappointed if you get the opportunity to stay here!  Clean, Friendly, Convenient and worry free!
Huge room, comfortable, clean, great location, great staff.

The hotel surpassed expectations. It's really easy to get to Manhattan on the subway (line 7) but the service is unavailable at the weekends at the moment. It's about $20 at the most in a taxi as well.

The rooms were extremely clean and well furnished, the beds were comfortable and the maid service was excellent.

We booked last minute as our accommodation cancelled but it worked out for the best as this place was incredible. Couldn't have asked for more :-)

A nice little north Brooklyn neighborhood with a subway stop within walking distance.  If it's cold or rainy, they have a shuttle to take you places nearby.  The employees were all very friendly and professional.  I would definitely recommend this to friends and family.

The Box House Hotel is wonderful, frankly. It was comfortable, elegant, unique, and perfect for my new husband and I for our wedding weekend. The staff was fantastic and very friendly. We stayed in a room with a terrace, which looked out at the bridge that connects Queens and Brooklyn, so it didn't have an exceptional view by any means. But it was large and nice to sit out and have a beer or eat breakfast. We had an entire kitchen, with convection oven and stove top, which made me want to cook - but I didn't. We did use the dishes, though, and they were washed every day by housekeeping.

Three things to note: 1) as far as I can tell, there is no elevator, so if you have mobility issues you should tell the hotel so they can book you in an appropriate room; when we arrived, we were personally escorted to our room by Mr. Singh, who carried our bags up the stairs for us and told us the history of the hotel, which was lovely; 2) there's no phone in the room, so you have to call the front desk from your cellphone, which was strange but worked; and 3) there was a 3-night minimum, which was a bummer for a lot of our wedding guests who would have loved to stay there with us but only for two nights.

The apartment is very private and well equipped. It is extremely close to a subway station that conveniently allows you to travel wherever you may need to go. There was some initial confusion in that we arrived at the apartment and Matthew thought we were arriving the next day, but he quickly prepared the room and all was fine. Matthew is a very friendly, helpful and gracious host and I would not hesitate to recommend his apartment.

Firstly, a special thank you to Matthew - a great host. He texted us everyday while we were enjoying the city to see how things were going and if he could help - awesome. Great apartment - we were in Times Square on a Saturday with the millions also there! It was so nice to retreat to the sanctuary of the apartment, curl up on the couch and spend a little time in the back-yard garden. Great value for money and enjoy the peace of this easy to get to retreat.

Mike and Nada
Teri was a delightful host, and the apartment was pretty much perfect for my needs. Nice area, with places to eat and a really nice supermarket nearby. I had a great time!

Me and my wife were traveling in the USA on Christmas and Teri is one of the greatest people we have ever met. The room was very comfortable in a very good neighborhood with shops and restaurants. So it was a big luck to be Teri's guest.

Teri is a fantastic, generous host who goes out of her way to make you feel welcome in New York! The apartment is wonderful and so is the area. This was a repeat stay and with good reason. Highly recommended.

Matt was a great help during our 5 day stay. Always available for our concerns/questions.   If/when we return to NYC I would look for another place to stay since we would prefer a different location.  The studio could have been cleaner.

I would definitely recommend this flat!

* About the area/neighborhood: You definitely notice that the area gets slowly gentrified by the folks up from Williamsburg - so you have really nice and hip restaurants around you (--> 'DUN' and 'The Black Swan' are awesome. The distance to the subway is about a five minute walk. There you got trains up to Manhattan and down to JFK and the Rockaway 24/7. But if you are going to do a 'Manhattan trip' you should consider that it takes about 30/40 minutes with the C-Train to places like Times Square or 53rd/5th.

All in all: A lovely appartement in an up and coming area with convenient connections around the clock!

I highly recommend.
Jennifer was very Kind And helpul ! I think a Real NY Woman ! Her flat is small but we slept very Good there , And as there is no daylight in THe room , we slept soo Long !
My stay in East Village was really, good, it is an area to be discovered at night and Jennifer's apartment is perfect for that. As for Jennifer, she is really kind and helpful.
She was very polite!

It was a pleasure to stay at Jennifer's place. She is very responsive and super organized! It was great to be in such central location and have all things go smoothly during my stay. I highly recommend staying at her place if you have a chance.

Me and my son had a great time with Jennifer. She represents the other New York: very laid back and all about sharing. The neigbourhood is very nice. Katz's Deli is around the corner, and Chinatown and SOHO are within walking distance. So no complaints at all. Thanks, Jennifer.

I spent two days in New York. The location of Jennifer's flat is perfect for discovering SoHo, Tribeca and the Financial District incl. Everything real nice, room and flat were exactly as described, Jennifer is nice and easygoing, everything was smooth and from the moment I walked in, it just felt like home.

Ah, and the location is awesome: LOTS of things are reachable on foot, and there are three metro stations a couple of minutes away (Broadway, 2nd Ave and Essex), by which you can go just about everywhere in NY.
jederzeit wieder
I had a great time staying here. The location is perfect and the host was very kind and generous. I highly recommend it.

Approved quickly and super friendly, this place did me well for a quick one-night stop over in NYC. Cosy apartment, good sized room with all the amenities (big tv, wifi, etc) and a perfect location for some really great bars and restaurants. I can recommend Alder, on 2nd and 10th. About a 10 min walk away.

Jennifer was a friendly and nice host. She helped me with every question and struck up very intereeting conversation.She even let me use her computer. The room is cozy and bothroom clean and accessible. Kitchen is a little cluttered and I took a fall going onto the bedroom(Probably my fault) as there was a step down which I am not used to.It is a 3 flight walkout so that can e tough with a lot of bags-but it wa fne for me. Neighborhood is great with neat rstaruants and good bagel place.Nearby subway/Jennife is really ncei and interesting ane I would stay there again.

The room that I rented was lovely and very comfortable. The neighborhood was nice and the location was close to a subway station, grocery stores, and options for food. The host was also very hospitable - I would definitely come here again!

Angela is a lovely host. She keeps the place clean, responds to messages quickly, and goes out of her way to make sure her guests have everything they need. She made sure to turn up the heater on colder days, which I really appreciated! Other guests were quiet and I hardly noticed them, which was perfect while studying for exams.

Angela was a wonderful host. The place was always clean since she would come by once a week to clean the house. The rooms were spacious and the building is very close to the subway station. I spent a wonderful 4 months staying at her place.

Great location! We loved staying in Crown Heights. There were wonderful coffee shops and restaurants nearby. The room we were given was not exactly the one pictured but it was fine. Angela was amazing! Note: Coin Operated Laundry On Premises

I’ve stayed in a bunch of air bnbs and Angela was by far one of the best hosts. She kept the place super clean and even offered to take care of the laundry throughout my stay. She responded within 5 mins of me needing anything. She was happy and always willing to go above and beyond for anything I needed. She’s a sweetheart and she made it feel like it was my own home. Definitely recommend this place to anyone

Angela's place was a great stay, clean and nice. Angela came to put new sheets and clean the room most of the weeks. I would ask to give an heads up about cleaning day ahead. One weekend there was inconvintae because of few hours of unexpected renovation in the place.
2 main issues to put attention to:
The room window is turning right to the street so curtains needs to be closed at all times unless you want people to peek you. Laundry in the basement is very convince BUT it used by the whole building so expect random people to enter the apertment at any time with their own key. ( I would suggest Angela to at least limit laundry time )

Spacious room at excellent location. The washer and dryer within the same premise saves a lot of hassle. 3 mins walk to subway station and grocery stores. Friendly and very responsive host. She provides weekly room cleaning and linen change which is out of my expectation!
Angela was a great host. Great location. Spacious bedroom with comfortable bed. Very good value. Enjoyed my stay!

The room was spacious and comfortable, and there were ample amounts of storage space, more than what is shown in the photos. It was on the first floor, so getting heavy suitcases inside is very convenient. Laundry’s in the basement with detergent and there’s a rack to dry your clothes. The kitchen was also stocked with all of the essentials and a good selection of spices are available. Angela is also a great host, she’s very responsive and comes in to keep the space clean on a regular basis. She also graciously accommodated me when my parents came to stay with me for a week. Overall I had a very comfortable stay for 3 months and I would recommend this room to all travellers!

This Airbnb stay was very interesting. I stayed for 10 weeks over the summer. I noticed a couple of issues as soon as I got there but didn’t make a big deal about it (the lighting fixtures had changed from what’s pictured, the pots/pans had a lot of scratches and plastic spatulas were melted, I had to buy clips to raise the curtain in my room so I could feel the air come in from the window unit). A couple more weeks there I noticed that Angela, the host, was around a lot, often times doing her own personal laundry at the unit even though she didn’t stay there. I appreciated how clean she kept the place but it also felt like an intrusion of privacy seeing her there so much since she didn’t live there.

She maintains the place herself and sometimes it’s not always done well. The curtain rod in my room was hung up with nails instead of screws and fell down once, meaning I had to sleep without any privacy since my room faced the street till it was fixed. She replaced the front door and for a couple of days the front door didn’t lock because the old lock didn’t fit the door. I pointed out several roach sightings to her. CThe first time she came over and cleaned the kitchen. The second time, I suggested that an exterminator come out and she said that extermination wouldn’t come again till October.

I knew that I would be sharing a bathroom with a person but I wasn’t expecting two. After a month of living there, my previous flatmate left and someone new moved in with her boyfriend. Angela didn’t give me a heads up about this. I only figured out when I constantly saw them around the place cooking.

The place was affordable for the summer and I really enjoyed living in Bed Stuy, but this Airbnb experience wasn’t my favorite.

Angela’s was great and her place was great as well. She was very helpful and very easy to communicate with. My girlfriend and I stayed at her place for a month and she would actually wash our bedding every other week for us. Would highly recommend this place to anyone wanting a low cost, nice, easy Airbnb to stay in for NYC.

We stayed at Laurie's place for one night in september, and that really was much too short. We really liked the hostess, her amazing house and the neighbourhood. Brooklyn has a lot to offer, and so has Laurie. Won't forget her waffles! Next time we will stay longer!

It's a really nice quiet room on a great block with lots of bars and stores nearby. The kitchen's a bit messy but the bathroom and bedroom is perfect. Jennifer and her friend are both great people, we really enjoyed our stay.
Nice apartment in a convenient area - close to the subway and lots of eateries.  The room itself was clean and comfy and we enjoyed our stay.

Jennifer is very warm and welcoming. The room is comfortable and very quiet. The neighborhood is wonderful. The last really bohemian area in Manhattan. Chock full of bars, restaurants, shops, etc. A short walk to the train, the Lower East Side, Chinatown.

If you like Vietnamese food, be sure to try the V'nam Cafe for pho and banh mi.
Everything I was hoping for. Warm, clean and safe. Great location.

I stayed 6 nights with Jennifer in December and had a great experience. Her apartment is centrally located in the lower east side, with close access to the Subway and walking distance to bars and restaurants. Jennifer was very accommodating and had interesting knowledge about the neighborhood. It was nice to have a laundry/dryer in the apartment. Thanks!

This is the perfect place to stay in New York, in Alphabet City in  Lower Manhattan. Jen was the perfect hostess, & made sure I was comfortable & had everything I needed. She gave me lots of information about he the locality. Could not have wished for a better stay.
Jennifer was really acommodating to our last minute booking and she and her room mate were both friendly and welcoming.
I had a great time staying here. Great location; it's near a lot of good restaurants . perfect for those on a budget. Jennifer is fun and generous. I highly recommend it.
Très bon séjour chez Jennifer, notre programme assez chargé ne nous a pas permis de passer trop de temps avec elle, dommage! En plus le quartier est extra! Je recommande vivement.

Комната оказалась действительно очень уютной! В квартире есть все необходимое. Хороший интернет, все туалетные пренадлежности. Очень удобное расположение, метро совсем рядом. Хозяева приветливые. Все очень понравилось.  Everything was excellent!!!
Jennifer is a great host! I'm really glad I spent a night there before I flew out of New York. Only wish I could stay longer. Also alphabet city/east village are great neighborhoods!!!

We did not see Jennifer but a friend of her. The check-in was easy and it was possible to let our luggage in the kitchen our last day. The apartment is very well located and the room very clean. The little negative

We enjoyed our stay at Jennifer's place. Leslie was very friendly who gave us lots of kind tips to move around NYC. Will be back again to stay at this place next time when I come NYC again.

I had no problems with the host or the listing.  The room was cozy and maybe a little warm, but they had an A/C unit in there and it kept the room temperature fine.  The building is easily accessed and only a block or so from Houston.  I would stay there again if the opportunity arose.
Jennifer's place was great! Located in a cool part of the city and close to the subway. As a hostess, Jennifer was very friendly and helpful with coordinating my arrival. Would stay again!
Jennifer has a nice cosy apartment in an excellent location in NYC. She anticipated and provided everything we could possibly need and we had a great time!

L'hôte a été très accueillante. Nous avons discuté avec Jennifer pendant 5 minutes seulement mais elle a été serviable. L'appartement se situe près d'une bouche de métro, ce qui est très pratique. Jennifer was a great hostess, helping me , at the last moment, so I could stay near my daughter's apartment. She went out of her way to assist me.   Classic east village apartment, augmented by a great TV and air conditioner.

Great neighbourhood to hangout in for a few days...
awesome host , didn't see each other too much ( I was out exploring most of the time ) but felt like I was at a friends house ,not someone I just met......

I enjoyed the stay.  It is very close to the F line so it's pretty convenient.  Although I didn't get a chance to meet Jennifer, she had a friend open the door and drop off the keys for me which worked well.  The apartment itself is quite small and old, but it provides a cozy feel and it had everything we needed.  Highly recommended!
Very nice neighborhood with plenty of restaurants.  I did not meet host, who was out of town, but she was very easy to work with and she had a very nice friend set me up.

I spent 2 magical months, living in the city while I attended college in Union Square. Jennifer's spot is perfectly situated with tons of bars and restaurants all around. Her apartment is smallish and cozy and perfectly New York like. The east village is really vibey area, with lots of young arty people and I often bumped into few celebrities just walking around between the streets. I made full use of the furnished kitchen and cooked most nights, which was great to save money. Having a washing machine and tumble dryer in the apartment was a godsend, I was able to do laundry whenever I wanted. My room was very quite and dark which made it perfect to sleep in and block out the New York City noise. Jen herself was very hands on and was easy to get hold of, if ever I had a problem or query in the apartment. Overall I had a great experience living in the East village, and would recommend Jen cozy apartment to anyone looking to have a proper New York type of experience in an area filled with young interesting locals and away from the gimmicky tourist midtown areas.

our stay at Jennifer's in NYC could not have been better. She is great! we had some really interesting conversations about art, literature, ... and the location could not have been better. highly recommended!
Had a great time staying at Jennifer's! It was my second time there. It's a great apartment in a building with lots of character, in really vibrant area and Jennifer is good company. Recommended.

We spent one week my boyfriend and i at jennifer's place. The Room looks like the description. The neigjborhood is composed of many bars and little restaurant to go out after a long day of visit. Jennifer is a lovely host, and we had very good Times with her. The appartement is well located and perfect to discover Manhattan and Brooklyn. Defenetly the place to go!

I was in NY for one month and Jennifer was very accomodating and I will stay again. Most of the time I was working with my websites from my cozy room If I was not visiting venues with live performing artists/bands. There are lots of restaurants and food places in the area.

Nous n'avons pas rencontrés Jennifer mais Geoffroy, qui s'est montré très discret. A 2 blocs d'une station de métro, ce qui est vraiment pratique. Et plein d'endroits accessibles à pied.

The apartament is well located and the neighborhood is very nice (lot of pretty restaurats and pubs where you can eat whatever you want!!)
We went to NY in December and the apartament was confortable and warm (maybe too hot). Our room dind't have a window and in the kitchen there wasn't any table (where we were supposed to eat??)!!! Anyway we spent an amazing week in NY!

We enjoyed our stay in the East Village. This location was convenient as the metro is nearby, and there are many fantastic food places around (Katz, Supper). This place was very affordable for a stay in Manhattan. The room was cosy and very warm, which was great for our Winter stay! There was also an AC unit in the room in case it got too warm. Note that this is an old building with no elevator so all luggage has to be carried up 3 flights of stairs - pack appropriately for this!

Jennifer was not in town when we visited but her roommate Geoffrey was friendly and welcoming and mostly hung out in his room.

The only issues we encountered with this place were with the bathroom - the door could not be fully closed and locked, and the hot water from the shower was irregular and would turn cold intermittently. Guests should also be warned about the hot metal pipe in the bathroom that is not fully insulated - it is VERY hot and burns if accidentally touched.

Aside from that, this apartment was cosy, warm and an excellent place for our first trip to New York. Highly recommended!
Matthew's place was as advertised

Matt's apartment was fantastic and equipped with everything you could need whilst away. The subway is literally 30 seconds from the door so could not be more convenient. We loved the fact the flat was really spacious, with really comfy sofas and a big dining table! The bed is about a king size and is memory foam, really really comfy. Matt was an an excellent host and went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable. I couldn't recommend this flat more- we will be hoping to stay again when we return to NY!
Great location,  all kinds of transportation nearby and a wonderful host.

Matt was a great host.  He made it very easy to check in and even greeted us when we arrived. The apartment was great. Plenty of room and close to the subway. We stayed for a week and will definitely stay there again if we have the chance.

Matthew's place was amazing! The proximity to uptown and downtown trains made it easy to get around.
