We loved the location as it got us away from the craziness of Midtown but we remained close enough so we could go out in the morning for the day then return for a re-charge before heading out for the evening. Matthew was a great host and was always available (in person or via text) if you needed anything. His suggestions on what to see in the area were so welcomed! The apartment was very quaint and charming. We hope to return one day!!
Great and quiet place, excellently located nearby the subway. Communication with Matthew was great, both before and during our one week stay.

An excellent place to stay for a couple and in a great location.  Very close to the subway station, a lovely leafy, quiet area of Harlem with a park nearby.  Great host you is very welcoming and helpful. Would recommend staying here.

I had a wonderful stay in the ground floor apartment. It was very comfortable and so close to the subway as advertised. I appreciated the awesome communication whenever I needed something and I am now forever spoiled by having an entire apartment to myself versus a bedroom in a hotel. I will stay here again!
A+++++++++++++++++++++!

Matthew's communication is great! This was a perfect apartment for me and my son while he attended Harlem School of the Arts for one week. The apartment is equipped with everything we needed to make it through the week.

It was definitely a home-away-from-home while there. The bed is comfortable, which is probably why I could never get my son to wake up each morning! Plenty of closet space, and washer/dryer combo, microwave, refrigerator, stove/oven, hair dryer, iron & ironing board all worked just fine.

The subway station is super close to the apartment, so it was great for us.
The neighborhood is really quiet, especially compared to Time Square and Midtown! There were not screaming people on the streets, etc. Matthew recommended the restaurant The Edge, which is a very close walk, and the food is amazing! (We ate there twice!) Manhattanville Coffee, ACP Coffee, and Sugar Hill Cafe are all good spots I tried. Would definitely stay here again if we need to stay in Harlem. Great experience. Thanks, Matthew!

We had a great two week stay at Matt's apartment. The location is ideal for getting around the city by subway, 2 mins walk to a stop for the B and C trains that get you to midtown in 20 mins. Central Park is close (c. 20 quick walk or 7 mins on subway) and great for jogging, museums and people watching. Harlem is full of unique restaurants, especially African - we ate Ethiopian, Senegalese, Somalian and Ivorian food. Matt was welcoming and checked up to make sure everything was ok. The apartment is downstairs in a brownstone so is a little dark during the day but has access to a nice outdoor area at the rear. Bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is small but has everything you need to cook basic meals at home.

So this was our first time staying at an AirBnB in NYC, so we were a little nervous about what the experience would be like. After having stayed at Matt'x spacious, comfortable, quiet home, all I can say now is that we are ruined for hotels, and that the only reason we would not stay at Matt's place again is if it were not available. 😀 Besides the fact that staying at this location resulted in our most relaxing NYC visit ever (we go every year) Matt is a great guy, friendly and very helpful, and responds to any questions in a timely manner. We both really liked him, and can't say enough about him. And the location is ideal: subway is a 2 minute walk away, there's a grocery within walking distance, and the backyard was so peaceful for breakfast in the morning. It really felt like our home away from home, and we look forward to staying there again (and again). 😀

We loved so much staying at Matt's. He is such a lovely host who tries to make sure that you are absolutely comfortable at his place. We found very convenient that he lived upstairs and that we had a washing machine, so we didn't have to bring too many clothes for our 12-day stay.
It was also great that it was literally one minute walk from 135th St / St Nicholas Ave (which has one exit on the 137th). We could easily move around and (if needed) change to an express train on 125th (just the next stop).
The place was really quiet, which is great after spending a whole day in such a noisy city. We also enjoyed eating breakfast every morning outside. The place was very spacious and we were really had a great time staying in Harlem.
Thank you, Matt! We hope to see you again soon!

Matthew's apartment was comfortable, spacious, clean and very well located for subway. He is a great host and very helpful and generous with his time. He provided much useful advice for us first time visitors. It really helped make NY a great experience.
Great location and a great host
Ubicación buena en un barrio residencial tranquilo. El metro está literalmente cruzando la calle y dos calles más abajo hay restaurantes y supermercados.
Apartamento próximo ao metrô. Matthew foi muito disponível e educado !

Matthew was a wonderful host. Made us feel really welcomed and comfortable. His apartment was lovely, spacious, clean and super close to the subway.
I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone who is thinking of taken a trip to New York and would defiantly go back again!

We loved NYC, people are so nice, starting by Matthew on the first day. He is a super host, very kind, helpfull and gave us a lot of tips about how to get around the city, safe, food, things to do... We met him in person as he lives very close. The appartment is nice, confortable, clean, with all necessary amenities. Close to subway. The neighborhood is safe, quiet and tipycal. There is a supermarket two blocks away and is easy to go to another shops by subway. We hope to come back!!!!

Matt's place was excellent. Super close to public transportation and short blocks away from a main street of dining, stores, etc. The location is amazingly quiet, being surrounded by a major street and all. The unit itself was sufficient. It had everything we needed to feel just like home. We stayed for a week during NYE weekend and it was outside temps of under 10 degrees. The unit's central heating was not strong enough. It was record lows in New York that week. Luckily there was a little portable heater that was really strong. That little guy really warmed up any room we dragged it to. Overall had a great stay and an amazing time in New York. Matt was very helpful during check-in and gave us plenty of tips to get around. Thanks again!

Matthew's apartment is beautiful, spacious, and even more beautiful than in the photos. It is filled with lovely details and everything you need for a comfortable stay in New York. The subway is half a block away so moving around is very easy, but the neighborhood is quiet and lovely so you get a perfect night's sleep. Matt and his wife are exceptional hosts, always available when we had any questions and really lovely people. I would totally stay there again!

Matt’s place is an a great location for getting around the city. You literally can step off and onto the subway in minutes and get down into midtown quickly. The apartment is very quiet and you can literally here the birds tweeting outside. Occasionally you can here them scuttling around upstairs but that’s typical for NY. The apartment has consistent hot water for showers. The WiFi runs fast and the tv plays great old tv shows and movie musicals throughout the day and night. I happened to be here in the beginning of summer when it was sweltering hot and it was pretty comfortable inside the apartment. Matt is very hospitable and responsive and I met him as I was heading out and he is very welcoming and friendly.

Matthew was an absolutely wonderful host. He was very attentive and easy to communicate with. We had a lightbulb go out in the living room  and he replaced it within the hour. His knowledge on the neighborhood was great. We enjoyed the local coffee shops and restaurants based on his recommendations. My family and ilI would absolutely stay at his Airbnb again.

All in all a fantastic value and perfect spot - not remote at all, but feels like an oasis. Matthew's place is a lovely, restful spot just a hop away from the bustling pace of the rest of Manhattan. My husband and I had intense and stressful work to do downtown and in White Plains, and Matthew's place was so convenient to both areas. It's just steps away from the subway, but a world apart in its peace and quiet. Matthew is generous and responsive. We took advantage of the sweet backyard space. The whole apartment is so spacious and comfy, and there's a washer and dryer to boot. Didn't have time to use the kitchen but it has all the fixings for guests who want to cook. The Harlem neighborhood is full of history, liveliness and good eats. It's a joy to stay there.

Great host, always ready to help and give advices about places to go in New York, and a very convenient place next to the subway and various grocery stores, in an incredibly quiet environment - especially for New York. The backyard is great in the morning, you can hear the birds sing. We'll definitely come back to this place when staying in NYC!

Appartement génial emplacement exceptionnel près du métro (1min à pied) nous n’avons pas eu l’occasion de rencontrer Matthew malgré sa disponibilité car nous rentrions trop tard mais appartement au top avec tout ce dont nous avions besoin hôte très réactif et disponible rien à redire 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼 Merci Matthew !

Matthew's place has really been a home away from home. His space is lovely, beautifully maintained, and a quiet escape from the energy of New York. We have been fortunate enough to stay with Matthew for over a month, and it's been one of our very best Airbnb stays to date. If you find this place to be available, then don't hesitate and book right away. Matt's place is definitely a gem, and you won't regret a minute of it.

I truly enjoyed our stay at Matthew's. It was quite a wonderful experience, and it began to feel like home. My fiancee and I instantly felt welcomed upon check-in and Matthew was very helpful, and aided us whenever we had an issue or concern. He was thoughtful, and even got us a little fire cauldron for winter nights. It's a beautiful space, that feels warm and inviting and the backyard space is such a rare entity in NY we soaked in all the time we could. I truly enjoyed our stay here, and if it's available you will too. Don't hesitate and book now! It' won't stay available for long.

Great place in Brooklyn and close to NYC by sub. (no risk at all).

Correct room, good and quick breakfast!

Merci Laurie pour votre accueil chaleureux.

Et entrainez vous pour une partie de Tennis WII avec Peter sut le central parisien.

Four star. What a wonderful hostess she is. Very knowledgable about Brooklyn and especially where the good food is. The house is comfortable, attractive, quiet, with great beds and an excellent shower. I only did morning coffee, but there was fruit, cereal, breads, fresh orange juice if I wanted. Laurie and Peter, her son are the best.

Well.....here's the thing....

To begin with, New York is the greatest city in the US. Period. Second....Brooklyn is the biggest little hamlet of niceness that exists in New York City. From Wms burg back to Park Slope....great.music...GREAT FOOD, and yet quiet on the street.....this is life as it should be. Now couple that with Laurie's expert tips on the neighbourhoods and her son's graciousness......it cannot be beat! We just finished our holiday and still ...we want to be right back. Laurie and Peter's place is everything and then some. And they has good tea with breakfast too!!!

Eric and Stacey

When you stay at Laurie’s place in Brooklyn’s Park Slope, you end each day of New York fun and exploration by going ‘home’.  It’s warm and welcoming, clean and comfortable, filled with lively art, loads of sun, and is home to 2 beautiful big-eyed cats. This large home is on a quiet street so you aren’t kept awake by street noise, traffic, and lights. Still, it’s close to the action. There are restaurants galore and quick and easy access to Manhattan and other NY areas via all major subway lines. Laurie and Peter are able and eager to advise you on the many attractions and activities in the area and across the city, and the best travel options, to and from.  I’m so glad I found this wonderful and affordable accommodation in New  York where hotels are famously impersonal and over-priced. I’ll be back, for sure. Thanks Laurie and Peter!

Great couple, friendly, respectful.  Comfy bed, nice desk (if needed) and roomy closet.  You do hear street noise, but ear plugs are provided (I was fine without them).  They live on the top floor and there is a great view from the roof.  Do be prepared to walk up a few flights of stairs...but hey, that's NYC.  If your looking for an authentic Brooklyn experience, this is the place!

We had a very good time at Gus and Holly's place. The apartment is very close to the subway, and Manhattan is only about 10-15 minutes away. They were great hosts, helping us decide what to do during our stay, and it was nice to get to know eachother while enjoying a glass of rosé. Thanks a lot guys!

My trip to NYC has been a fabulous experience. My 8 days stay at Gus and Holly place was absolutely wonderful. This was the perfect place for me to find my feet in New York. It’s a lovely apartment and the room was perfect. Just over the corner you have access to the cafe, grocery, and bakery store and just beside the apartment you can buy ice cream. Great for hot summer day!!!! The apartment is very close to the subway (4 min), and Manhattan is only about 15 minutes away and you have access to all the subway lines. Roof top have an amazing view on Manhattan. Highly Recommended!

The location is great: you can access 3 different subway lines from here. Although I used the L/G train the most.
The room is very clean: no need to be afraid of bed bugs here
The room has A/C which is crucial in the nyc summer.
The hosts are very friendly and are familiar with travellers and their needs.
I would definitely come back.
Its walking distance from some great restaurants and the main street in Williamsburg.
Staying here equals winning.

We had a terrific experience in this apartment. It was very homely and the hosts were lovely
and helpful. Not far at all from Manhattan and close to the interesting parts of Brooklyn. I recommend staying here to anyone.

Lovely couple, lovely apartment, lovely location. A great place to stay if you want to experience the laid back vibe of Williamsburg as opposed to hectic Manhattan. Fantastic local amenities and very close to the subway. To top it all off, the have three amazing cats who love to socialise too.

wow, we had such a great week in New York. Gus and Holly are really nice. The apartment is swell, and we felt so welcome. Perfect location for subway and amenities, plus many interesting shops, cafes and restaurants. Thanks so much!

Holly and Gus were truly amenable hosts. The apartment is cosy,centrally located in Williamsburg Brooklyn, so you are close to all ammenities, transport and good coffee! A great rental for solo travellers discovering NYC, of which Manhattan is only a few stops on the subway. Book it!
My experience was excellent!!! Holly & Gus are greats hosts. The apartment is centrally located very close to the subway and all amenities, thank you very much!!!

Excellent, wonderful, mean, topping, superb, fantastic, tremendous, marvellous, terrific, mega, sovereign, awesome, dope, admirable, first-rate, wicked cool, def, brill, boffo, bitchin’, chillin’, GR8, sweet, rad, amazing, gnarly, fun, groovy, dank, fantabulous, phat, tubular, boss, nice, best, rockin', chill, hip, ballin'... In one word: yeah!

To experience the real New York, stay in Brooklyn with Laurie.  Her comfortable, quiet home is full of art, books and music and Laurie is a terrific ambassador for her neighborhood.  Manhattan is a short (15 min.max) ride away on the subway, and there is a ton of great activities right in Brooklyn including the outstanding Brooklyn Museum, Botanical Gardens and many little character bars and restaurants right around the corner from Laurie's place.  Stay here, you'll love it.  Highly recommended.

Laurie's home was a wonderful respite for us after long fun-filled NYC days. Traveling via subway just a few short blocks from her house got us everywhere we wanted to be with ease. We saw 6 shows in 5 nights and never had any trouble coming home late. The room was spacious and very clean and located on the top floor away from the living areas. There is a private bath and plenty of privacy. Laurie was so welcoming that we quickly felt as if we were visiting a friend. I would highly recommend her rooms to anyone.

Fabulous! My family had a great time in New York thanks to Laurie and her wonderful home. They felt welcome and the fact that she shared all the neighborhood treasures with them was priceless. The next time we go to New York - we're staying with Laurie! Thanks Laurie!!
Peirce, Eli and Sylvie from Santa Fe, NM

My friend and I had a wonderful week at Laurie's. It's a beautiful house and it really looked like the pictures on here! Laurie's a very friendly and laid back host with lots of good tips and information and materials to look through. Happy with the room, too - this was located next to a lovely bathroom. And the neighbourhood is very nice, too - great brownstone houses and nice coffee places, restaurants and shops, all nearby. As well as Prospect Park - we were lucky to be there for the free Sharon Jones concert. But again - without Laurie we probably wouldn't have known that this was on! Nice fruit salad, croissants and coffee in the morning, Internet access no problem and good chats with Laurie. It was our first time in NY and it was so much nicer to stay privately than in a cheap and nasty hotel room. I can highly recommend staying in Brooklyn and especially with Laurie. (Didn't meet Peter who was in summer camp, but one of the cats was there - super cute!)

Laurie has been a perfect host, we spent marvellous days in New York City also thanks to her suggestions and help. The house was so nice and the atmosphere so friendly that we are looking forward to he there again! Thanks a lot!!!
Kind and excellent hosts, and the location was top notch. We might never stay in Manhattan again.

GUS AND HOLLY ARE AMAZING!!!We had a great time in New York staying at their place. They were incredibly helpful and fun. The house is great and the location is wonderful aswell (very close to the L train). Will definately be hoping to stay with them again when we make it back!!!!!

Ps. they are awesome.

Pss. to the max.

We had a great time at Gus´s place. The two are great guys, the apartment is clean and comfortable and the area is just perfect. Easy to get from A to B or just stay around and enjoy Willibrooklyn. And yes...the cat´s are really fat. 5 Stars and a huge recommendation...
I had an excellent time at Gus' place, great location and very comfortable place. The cats are lovely (especially Vicious :-)

I was in NY for a 1-week-course and stayed with Gus and his wife. An easygoing, welcoming couple. The place is well connected with Manhattan (the L-line) - I managed to get to Hunter college within 20-25min. The room was clean and comfortable, the WiFI connection was fast. However, due to the noise from the street it is a good idea to bring earplugs (although I think the windows will be replaced soonish).

Really like Gus & Holly's place, it was well located close enough to the action but in a relaxed setting. Their are great eateries and bars close by which Gus will point out to you. Would definitely stay with them again next time I am in NYC.

Gus and Holly are very welcoming, and they have a very spacious apartment (especially for New York!) that is very comfortable.  They were happy to have a chat, and we hope we can stay with them again!

We really enjoy the time at Gus place, the house is very well situated and the room is very nice and warm.  I you want to enjoy Williamsburg but being close by to Manhattan these is a very recommendable place to stay. Don´t be worry about the cats, they are fat, but also so polite and friendly.

Gus and Holly were super friendly and the apartment was great. Like all the other reviewers, we enjoyed the easy access to the L/G train and the amenities on Grand St. We had a fantastic time using Williamsburg as a base for our first visit to New York and would definitely stay here again in the future.

Gus is a great host and super friendly, the appartment is in a fantastic location in the coolest part of brooklyn and only 5mins by metro to the centre of manhattan for all your touristy needs and the 3 fat cats are a joy to come home to after a hard day of having fun...
An all round good place to stay if you are planning a trip to the big apple.

The room is CLEAN and PLEASANT.
The flat is CLOSE TO MANHATTAN with the L train.
The neighborhood is NICE.
The cats are cuuute !
And Holly and Gus are AMAZING.
I loved my stay in their flat. I spent 6 weeks I will never forget. I'll miss them.

Gus and Holly are great!  The apartment is cute, cozy and really well located, and the room is warm and quaint with a decent view of some Manhattan skyline.  Vicious is the best cat of all time.  The bed is super comfy, the little desk is perfect for working on your laptop, and there's lots of hangers in the closet so your clothes don't have to stay wrinkled up in your suitcase.  Everything you need is close by.  Thanks guys!!!!!!!  xoxoxo

An excellent base for a trip to New York City. Close to L subway which is one stop from the heart of Williamsburg and a few stops from Union Square in the centre of Manhattan, from there you can get almost anywhere in the 5 boroughs.
I only met Holly as Gus was away on business. She was very friendly and welcomed me into her home, gave me my own key and left me to get on with my holiday.
The apartment is warm and cosy, the three cats are a little shy and very sweet.
The neighbourhood felt safe to me, there is a great chinese laundry just round the corner and two 24hr shops and a 24hr diner in easy walking distance for those that intend to make full use of the city that never sleeps.

It was a really comfortable place. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The location was also great because the station (L train) is close to this place. Almost everyday, I came back too late but She didn't say anything and then said "make yourself comfortable." I really love this place and if I have a chance, I will stay at this place again! Thank you Gus and Holly:) I really appreciate your kindness.

The room is cosy and very comfortable. The street just below can be a bit noisy but Holly and Gus provide ear plugs for those with a lighter sleep (it didn't bother me much). The neighborhood is incredible: great coffee, tasty bagels, and loads of cute boutique shops. More, the house is perfectly located being close to both the L and the G trains -- about 10/20 min to Manhattan -- and to a nice food store on Union Ave. Gus and Holly are super nice and laid-back, which made me feel at ease in the house. The cats are great too! I would definitely recommend this place to others.

We didn't get to meet Jennifer however she communicated well with us and arranged for her friend Geoffrey to meet us and provide us with everything we needed. The room was clean, warm and the apartment was in a great location. Definitely recommend for a stay in the East Village.

This is a quindessencially East village apartment, it’s quircky,a little rough around the edges but charming and very cosy. The room is quiet and private, you can lock the door. There isn’t much light that comes into the room for you look onto a wall on the side of the building, the window doesn’t open but the air conditioning unit works very well. I lived here for a month in January. The washer machine and dryer were brilliant. The kitchen is small and part of the main living space, which has a desk in it as well, being a small apartment, there isn’t room for everything, so I ate in my room. There’s a small window in the living space, again it gives onto a wall, so you don’t get a lot of natural light. The hobs work well, I didn’t use the oven. The bathroom wasn’t the cleanest but the shower works well, although the hot water can get very hot, you have your own bath mat and towels. The bed is very comfortable, there s space to hang your clothes and some drawer space. The wifi works very well. Geoffrey (your flat mate) is super sweet and was a lovely considerate person to have around, very quiet, super kind and helpful and great fun if you do want to a chat. The flat is perfectly positioned to explore the East village and very close to the subway. There is also a great 24hr deli just downstairs, great coffee shops, a juice bar just down the road and as well as a super market,there is a more high end food market shop on the corner. Jennifer is a super effiscient communicator,clear, kind and is very helpful. Sadly we didn’t get to meet.I had a great stay. Thank you Jennifer.

Jennifer is warm and personable, made feel welcome and at home.
She was quite helpful on how to get to her place from JFK. As I did not want to take a taxi.
It was like staying at a girlfriend's place. I had been to the city before so I already had a feel of where I wanted to go and what I wanted to do.
I enjoyed my stay.
Very cosy and clean flat in the middle of East Village and very close to LES. Jennifer is very nice and knowledgeable about the area. Will use again.
The place was in a great location, walking distance to everything and my room was very private.

We didnt meet Jennifer but she arranged for her friend Geoffrey to meet us.
Her room is clean and private (you can lock the door). The AC cooled down the room pretty fast.
The bathroom wasn’t the cleanest but the shower is good.
Aside from the bathroom, this apartment was cosy and an excellent place for a trip to New York. Subway and a lot of restaurants are in walking distance.
We enjoyed our stay! Thank you Jennifer!

We had a very pleasant stay at Jennifer's place. Everything was exactly as described. The location is conveniently located to all the sights and in 5 min walking distance from the subway. The communication with Jennifer was very easy. Wa had a very good time and would always come back. Thank you, Jennifer!

We had a pleasant stay at Jennifer's. She and her roommate were very nice and easygoing people. The communication was really easy with Jennifer she always responded if we had questions. The neighborhood was convenient, close to the subway and nice restaurants. The room was as it shown on the picture. The A/C was good, cooled the temperature down in few minutes.  I would definitely stay there if I went to NYC again.

The location is great, close to the subway.
The room is quite private with a good A.C. and looks better than the picture.
Jennifer is very easy going, helpfull and friendly.
I had a pleasant stay at Jennifer's house!

Jennifer is a very kind and easy going person. We had our privacy, which was good. She wasn't home that often, when we were home but when we met we would talk about our day and she would recommend places to go. Jennifer welcomed us the first day and showed us our room and explained the house rules.
The describtion af the apartment did somewhat meet our expectations but we wish that Jennifer had mentioned that the room doesn't have that much real daylight shining in and the view was the wall of the building and therefore we couldn't see what kind of weather it was and fresh air was not possible in the room.
The neighborhood was really nice and cosy. There would always be people in the streets and in the many restaurants and cafés.

We had a wonderful stay at Laurie's beautiful home in Park Slope, Brooklyn. The beds were very comfortable and we were able to have a washroom and washer/dryer right next door to our room which was very convenient. We would recommend bringing small luggage as the room was on the top floor of a 3 story walkup and the stairwells/hallways are very narrow, navigating that was a bit of a challenge, but that is minor. The subway station was quite close, and it was an easy commute into Manhattan, getting to the upper parts of Manhattan took awhile, but its nice to sit and relax on the air conditioned train after a long, hot day of sightseeing. Laurie was super friendly and helpful, and had many suggestions for things to do and places to see during our stay, it was really nice to have the advice from a local who knows her city! Our only complaint would be having to watch out for the escape artist kitty every time we came back to or left the house, there are two sets of doors at the entrance, but the space between them is very small, and we had to enter and shut the doors one at a time, while trying to keep the kitty away. It was very frustrating and time consuming, and if someone else left the inner door open, it was very hard to keep him from escaping, he got out twice during our visit :(

All in all, it was a very pleasant visit, thanks again for your hospitality Laurie!

The house is in a great location in Brooklyn - very close to Manhattan via the subway. The rooms were lovely, quiet and clean - very comfortable beds! Laurie was such a lovely host, she went out of her way to help us with directions and in deciding what to do out of all the choice there is in NYC! She even found a bed for us early on the first morning when we arrived after a 32 hour trip! (thanks Peter - love your comic/ book collection). The 2 cats are sweet, as were the squirrels running along the phone lines outside. And despite Lauries claims that it wasn't at its best, the garden was just gorgeous.
Thanks Laurie!!PS still remember that gluten free bread - was amazing!

Laurie
-gave lots of info re where to eat, how to find out about cheap tickets, how to get around etc
-gave us free rein of her pc for internet browsing
-showed us how to use her great coffee machine
-had a lovely room with great bedding
-was fascinating to talk with
-lives in a lovely house in a pretty street

We stayed at Jennifers for a week. We arrived a little later than planned, but that was no problem for Jennifer. Jennifer was really easygoing. We loved the neighbourhood, East Village, with its nice little beer bars. The room was a little hot but with AC. It was a bit chaotic in the apartement. The wifi didn't work the first few days but Jennifer let us use her computer for internet. If you want a cheap accomodation in a great neighbourhood, this is the place to go!

This is the perfect place to stay if you want to explore NYC. Access to the subway couldn't be better and Williamsburg is a very interesting neighborhood that has a lot to offer in itself. Excellent coffee, pizza, bakeries, shops etc. It had everything I could've wanted and most importantly Gus and Holly are great people.
I'd stay here again

Nice stay at Gus and Holly´s - the location is great, close to subway with a short ride to Manhattan. The room is small, but holds everything you need. Spend a week here, and would definitely come back if I´m ever in New york again. I can really recommend a stay here :o)

The perfect trip for us!!! Williamsburg is really THE place to be in NYC! Close to Manhattan and the L&G subway, Williamsburg has a lot to offer (good restaurants, shops and bakeries...) The flat is clean and quiet (earplugs are still necessary for the night because of the street)
Further more, Gus and Holly are the perfect hosts : funny, laid-back, nice and kind... we went to a restaurant together for our last night, that was amazing! And listen to Gus, he has the best advice on everything you can do in NY!!!

Gus and Holly have the whole airbnb thing sorted. They're happy to give you the run of their place, answer your questions and yet also give you a lot of privacy. Every amenity you could need is within walking distance (laundromat, car service to airport, M and L train). It's an easy walk to Bedford Ave or the river. The air conditioner was a blessing in summer which Gus installed the day we arrived. Their apt is not super clean, it is their home, and they treat it as such - so don't expect it to be like a hotel. The cats were a strange mix of timid and curious - they are in a constant state of confusion over who you are, but harmless. I'm actually allergic but had no problems with them. I never felt uncomfortable or unsafe staying here, and once my partner left, I stayed 5 nights by myself here. I recommend breakfast at second stop on lorimer - great coffee, cheap bagels.

I stayed with Gus and Holly for 18 days and it was a fantastic expereince, they were friendly and sociable, helped out with directions, and treated me just like a housemate. The area in Brooklyn is great too and just a short walk or subway ride to Bedford Avenue, and very close to Manhattan by Subway. It was really a perfect home away from home while I was in NY and at the end of a long day I could come back and watch TV and talk about my day with them. The Bed is suuuuper comfy and its a cosy room. Thanks Gus and Holly for making my trip so great. I will definatley stay there again next time I visit the NYC.

Gus & Holly are great hosts, and so are their three cats. They really enjoy having people over and they gave me plenty of space for me to feel at home. The apartment is nice, clean, and very cozy. The livingroom photos don't actually show all the light that comes in through the windows, and they have just painted and added new Ikea furniture. The ample kitchen has everything you need, a big fridge and a good stow. And there's a great roof when one can relax and watch the sunset over Manhattan.
The room is a bit small but perfect for its prize. It's just across the front door so you can go in and out freely without disturbing anyone. The bed is very comfortable, and there's plenty of room for clothes in the closet and drawers. The only downsize is some street noise and a rather loud AC, but it can all be easily solved with earplugs.
Location is very good, with great bars and restaurants at short walking distant, like Union Pool, Barcade, the Commodore, and Dumont. It's just one stop away from the touristic "heart" of Williamsburg (Bedford Av), and 10 minutes away from Manhattan.
It's definetely a place I would come back.
Worth every step of the walk up! Not fancy, but homey & comfy. Just the way we like it! Responded promptly to our request for info which was much appreciated.

We stayed at Gus and Holly´s for 14 days, and all in all it was a fantastic stay.
Their apartment is situated in a great area with lots of restaurants and shops nearby. It is also close to the subway, which we used almost everyday.
Gus and Holly are very open people, easy to talk to and they did their best to answer any question we had. They are good at helping and also leaving you on your own, if that´s what you need.
Their apartment is quite big and we were welcome to join them in their livingroom at any hour. Our room was fine, the bed was comfortable, clean sheets and towels are available. There was also aircondition, which we couldn´t have lived without:-)
My boyfriend and I both agree that we would very much like to stay at Gus and Holly´s again and we´ll not hestitate recommending the place to any of our friends:-)

Best,
Allan and Marlene

If you stay at Gus and Holly's you will not regret. They are very nice people and great hosts. We stayed at his apartment for 10 days while they are on vacation. Although they were out, the communication was great, they give us ALL the information we needed and responded all our questions and we have very good vibes since the first day. It's a pity we can't meet us in person. We take care of their 3 cats and it was a easy thing because they are lovely and mellow. The apartment it's awesome. Big, clean and cozy. I think it's in one of the best places in Williamsburg. Close to great restaurants, bars and night clubs where you can find good music. Close to the subway where you can reach Manhattan in 15 minutes.
It's a grate place with great hosts.

Just got back from a lovely trip to the East Coast, and a stay with Gus and Holly! They were wonderful hosts-- very gracious, accommodating and fun. The space was clean and comfortable, though got a bit crowded with our massive luggage. :) The best part of our experience with them were the fabulous restaurant and site recommendations they offered. Take advantage of their vast knowledge of the city! Thanks for a great stay!

I stayed with Gus and Holly for 18 days and it was a great experience. They are a lovely couple, kind and friendly, and always willing to help you out if you have any questions. The three fat cats become your friends immediately! They hardly make any noise!

The room is rather small but very cosy. You have everything you need, including a big closet with lots of hangers! One disadvantage of the room is that it's quite noisy because it is situated on the street side. But therefor there are always earplugs right? :)

You also get some information about New York and a map of the Williamsburg area. You are very close to 3 Subway stations so it's very easy and fast to get into the city!

My husband and I stayed with Gus and Holly for a week, and honestly, we would not have loved our trip so much if we didn't stay here. They live in a great neighbourhood with lots to see, eat and drink (not to mention every resto they recommended was excellent!). It was a great, more low-key place to rest after spending a day around town, even better that it was less than 30 minutes from Manhattan via the subway. The room was cozy and clean, and Gus and Holly were laid-back and fun to be around. We'd definitely stay here again!
They are wonderful hosts and I had a really really good time with them. Thank you so much and definitely highly recommend!

My friend and I stayed with Gus and Holly for 4 nights, the apartment is stunning and they are great hosts! We felt very welcomed and at home.
Great location for subway, bars and restaurants.

I stayed with Gus and Holly for seven nights and couldn't have asked for a better experience.

The room was a good size, with more than enough closet room for suitcases, clothes, etc. There was great wi-fi access and the place is only a short walk from several subway lines, meaning you can be almost anywhere in the city in 15-30 minutes.

Most importantly, Gus and Holly were fantastic hosts. They were incredibly accommodating, offered great advise and kindly lent me a hand getting my holiday back on track after I experienced a small setback. Wonderful people and a wonderful location.

The room is cosy and very comfortable. The appartment is centrally located in Williamsburg Brooklyn and I felt at home for the 3 nights I stayed at Gus's place (which also may have to do with the prints of Tintin in corridor :) He was a great host and the cats are so cute. Thank you so much.

Gus & Holly were the best hosts you could imagine! Friendly and welcoming at all times, absolutely easygoing and always of help. The room and the apartment are exactly as pictured - with a very comfy bed and a great view. Also the location of the apartment is perfect if you prefer the laid-back Williamsburg vibe to the Manhattan bustle - it's just a few subway stops away from Union Square anyway. I had a great stay and I hope I can return soon. I give all the stars I have to Gus & Holly!

We felt totally comfortable at Gus and Holly's. The room is small, but totally suited our needs. The area is great as well, walking distance to great restaurants and bars, shops, and the subway. The perfect first experience in Brooklyn!

Stayed Gus and Holly's for 7 nights. As other reviews said they are very laid back and very helpfull when you need some help.
Gus told me there were really good coffee shops in the neigbour.
I have tried three of them. One is Second stop at Lorimer st, the other is Gimme at also Lorimer st and Verb cafe at Bedford Ave. They are all amaging and have good vibe. If you are coffee lover, you have to stay here. Location is superb. you would be surprised how convenient it is to go to Manhattan. So just book. Definitely no reglet!

I spent my last few days in NY at Gus and Holly's place.. It was my first time ever with airbnb and even the first time I was hosted by "strangers". Well I felt totally comfortable, they are friendly, welcoming, easy going and laid back so I couldn't ask for a better experience. The neighbor is perfect both if you will spending time in Williamsburg and in Manhattan, cause their house is really a short distance away from Lorimer subway (L). The room is big enough for one person but I guess it can be fine even for a couple. I already miss NY!!!

We had an amazing time staying with Gus and Holly. The room and their apartment were perfect for our 10 day stay. We had the best  NY experience thanks to Gus and Holly. They are really open and friendly, will happily answer all your questions and know the best spots to visit, eat and drink. Their apartment is just a few stops away from Manhattan by subway and is situated in Williamsburg, which is a great neighborhood. If we visit NY in the future we'd definitely stay there again!

Gus and his girlfriend like to entertain and have busy lives, so staying here is like jumping in on that. Gus was nice, and responded quickly regarding arranging for keys and timing. Getting in and out of the apartment was easy, and the location was good. The place was clean, and made for a good place to crash for a couple of days.

Gus and Holly are wonderful people and great hosts. I dont know if I will ever stay anywhere else in New York again. They are pleasant and considerate and made me feel very welcome. I highly recommend staying with these two especially if you are looking for a quiet relaxed spot in the busy city.

We have spent in NYC a 1 week and stayed with Gus and his wife, very easygoing and welcoming couple! We had an excellent time at their place.
The room is a bit small but comfortable. The apartment is ideally located with great bars and restaurants within walking distant, plus it is on the top floor-great view over Manhattan. Their cats are lovely!
Thank you guys!

Staying with Gus was a great experience.  He an his wife were incredibly friendly and he took the time to let me know about great places to eat and shop in the area.  It's a nice apartment, in a great part of town.  The apartment is a few blocks from the L train, from which you can easily go almost anywhere in Brooklyn and Manhattan. Also, the room is very nice and well-kept, and it's right near the front door, so you don't feel like you are invading their personal space whenever you come and go.  Of course, they don't mind you hanging out and using the kitchen and communal area either.  I don't have enough good things to say!  How's this: I came to New York to do a comedy show, and they came and saw my show! How crazy is that?

First time using Airbnb, and I couldn't have asked for two better hosts. I knew Gus and Holly were going to be at a dinner party when I arrived Sunday evening, and they were sure to arrange everything with me ahead of time for my smooth arrival. I got a little worried when I arrived and couldn't find the key like we had discussed. It's reassuring to know Gus and Holly have a considerate older-lady neighbor who brings their mail up all those stairs...which happened to include the key Gus had arranged for me to get into their apartment. Despite this tiny mixup, I gave Gus a call and he immediately came from his party to let me in. This slight hiccough did not bring my first airbnb experience down at all; it reaffirmed how trustworthy Gus and Holly are as hosts. I felt totally comfortable staying with them. They made me feel at home, were easy to talk to, provided fresh towels, and gave me great suggestions. (best hamburgers in town one block away btw) I would definitely stay with Gus and Holly if I have the chance again. Props go out to Sid, Vicious and Charlie (the kittehs)

Gus and Holly are really welcoming and helpful. I felt immediately comfortable and wouldn't hesitate to stay there again. It was wonderful getting to know them and the cats- which are adorable. The flat is in a brilliant location, and the room was perfect!

I had a great time!
Gus & Holly are very nice, the neighbourhood is awesome! Many bars in walking distance, lots of restaurants, supermarket nearby, safe...
The room is reeaally tiny - but the appartment has a living room - and a roof top with a great view, so there is enough space to relax :)

Gus & Holly were wonderful hosts, they are warm and easy going.
The apartment is in a great location with lots of nice cafes, bars, restaurants and shops. It's close to the subway, with Manhattan just a few stops away. They also have a rooftop with awesome views of the city. We'd definitely stay there again.

We had the most fantastic time in NYC largely due to our fab hosts, Gus and Holly, and the safe-haven they provided for us. Knowing we had a safe and cosy base in a great location (Williamsburg had so much going on: great restaurants, bars, galleries, shopping - there was a real buzz of culture around - It took us a week to actually get to Manhattan!) made all the difference to our getting the most out of NY.  Gus and Holly's accurate, friendly, local advice allowed us to be more travellors than tourists. We felt right at home here. The apartment was spacious and clean and even the cats grew used to us and came out to entertain as only cats can! Great people. Great place. Thankyoou

This was my first time using airbnb, and my hosts Gus and Holly made it an absolute delight. Despite a minor drama with my cell phone not working when I arrived in the US, I made to their apartment with no hassles. Gus and Holly make a huge effort to make guests feel at home, and are totally cool with having a chat, giving advice about places to go in the neighbourhood, but also fine with letting you just trek in and out as needed. The bed is amazingly comfy and the cats are adorable :) The list of places to eat, drink, get coffee and run errands were also incredibly helpful.

I highly recommend staying with Gus and Holly for anyone visiting NYC - I can't wait to visit again.

Our staying at Gus and Hollys place was great!
They are both wonderful hosts...! We highly recommend them...!
The location is ideal, easy access to both Brooklyn and Manhattan, having the subway lines L, G (and J etc...) just a stone's throw from the apartment.
Every day during the morning hours, the roof top was used by Els, reading in the sun!
Gus and Holly -thanks for two wonderful weeks and hopefully we meet again..., soon...!
Henrik and Els

Gus and Holly were lovely hosts, so friendly and helpful, and left some really thoughtful information in the room on great places to eat and drink locally. Very important.  The room was perfect for me as a single traveller, really great spot to be based, and really close to the subway. I would definitely recommend a stay here.

This was my first airbnb experience so of course I wasn't quite sure what to expect.I didn't have a long stay - and I didn't have time to see the famous rooftop that everyone is talking about in the other reviews - but I had a great trip and Gus, Holly and their cats were all great, but I didn't see much of them as I was out a lot.

They had a really useful list of places to go and eat out, which I made good use of and little extras like power adapters and Time Out guide in the room that helped make everything really straightforward and easy.

All in all a very good first experience and introduction to airbnb.
Gus and Holly were great.  Super nice people!  Location was very convenient - only 3 blocks from the L train.

We could tell Holly and Gus were AirBnB professionals because they were such great hosts. They gave us recommendations for the area (including a printed list of their favs), were very accommodating (they provided towels, umbrellas, maps, even a printer!) and were friendly when we saw them in the house. Their flat is perfectly located for Williamsburg fodder or transport to Manhattan and those rooftop views are just as good as all the other reviews say. Highly recommended!

Wonderful experience! It was my 1st time with AirB&B and I have to tell that was great. Gus and Holly are really nice persons, it's really easy to become friends in a little while. I trusted in every of their suggestions....and I discovered the beauty of Brooklyn (and more an amazing pizzeria close to the apartment! ...cazzo la pizza è buona sul serio! Incredibile!). The place is lovely and well located, near 2 different subway stations and in a very meaningful part of Williamsburg: I loved walking and discovering places, bars, clubs in the neighbourhood at night.
Very strategical place to discover NY both for Manhattan an Brooklyn.
Strongly suggested!!

This place was great. We loved the location as it's in the heart of Williamsburg and so close to Manhattan by subway. Gus and Holly were amazingly helpful and friendly. I'd go back just to see them! Would recommend their place to anyone, anytime. Book it.

First time with airbnb, and I can tell it was a hit. Gus and Holly were perfect hosts, very helpful, kind and relax. The location is also a great point, they live in this neighborhood since a long time so they can help you a lot with the billion good places around their flat. L and G trains are 3 steps away. From the apt to manhattan within a breathe.
Hope we will meet them again someday in Brooklyn !!
Gus and Holly were great hosts. Really nice people and their place was just as described. Very convenient, close to bars, food and subway etc! Would stay there again without hesitation!

Gus and Holly are excellent hosts, period. The position of their place is iterally 1-3 blocks from awesome eateries and night spots, not to mention the wicked coffee houses around there. From the get go I felt very welcome and continued with my trip aided by their very well thought out list of fantastic places to eat and drink at.

Definitely hit these guys up without any hesitation. This is a 5 star Airbnb destination.

Gus, Holly and their two cats made us feel very welcomed in their comfortable and cozy apartment. This lovely accommodation was an excellent home base for our unforgettable sightseeing trip to NYC. The two of them provided great suggestions on what to see and where to eat - their "list" is indeed awesome.

We could not have been more pleased with the location, friendly ambience, and cleanliness of Gus and Holly's home. Central to excellent bars and restaurants and the subway (both the L and JMZ are walkable). Cab fare from LGA was $22. Comfortable bed and pillows, closet with hangers, and secretary desk made us feel at home. Plenty of sunshine, windows to let the breeze in, and a view of Manhattan from the bedroom (and rooftop!). Being on the top floor (note a lot of stairs!) made for particularly quiet nights amid the hum of the city. Can't wait to come back. Excellent value. Friendly hosts. No complaints.

We had a great time staying with Gus an Holly, they were super welcoming and their place was perfect.  Its super close to lots of great places to eat and have drinks in the evening.  Getting into the city was a breeze and they offered lots of suggestions and material to help with touring around the city.

We had a great time staying with Gus & Holly (and their two adorable cats). They have a beautifully designed apartment that sits in a very good location in the heart if Williamsburg. They were extremely friendly and welcoming and even provided us with a long list of their favourite places to eat, drink and shop. We would highly recommend staying here. Oh, amazing rooftop view too!

We stayed with Gus and Holly over the easter weekend and really loved our stay! The room and the appartment were very charming, everything was clean and the vibe very good! The neighbourhood is really cool, lots of nice restaurants and bars. The appartment is super close to the metro station.

Gus and Holly are great hosts , very easy going, friendly and attentionate. The made us feel welcome and gave us many great suggestions for eating and visiting. The have a really cool list of all the good places to see in Williamsburg. We tried out a few of the places on the list and really enjoyed all of them : they really are great suggestions.

I would absolutely recommend staying with them if you are planning a trip to NYC.

What else can I add to the many reviews by others? I would only say: "Home away from home",Laurie is someone you can fully trust ( and she trusts you) a great host , a great house, a great neighborhood, a great great Prospect park, great public transports etc etc.

Don't hesitate - just book!
Holly & Gus are great hosts! We really loved the stay at their place. They gave excellent recommendations for bars,restaurants, activities... The location of the apartment is a perfect base to discover Williamsburg (what you definitely should do). We lost our heart in Brooklyn.
Perfect! Very nice people, the room is really nice!

Staying with Gus and Holly was the best AirBnB experience we could hope for, period.
They are SO nice, fun, passionate hosts, who love their neighborhood and are always happy to recommend great places to visit (their famous recommendations list is out of this world, totally fail-proof.. And we went to quite a few of the restaurants and coffee shops mentioned there).
The talented Holly even gave us both haircuts in the cool hair salon she works in, in SoHo - and we're very happy with the result (:
The apartment itself is very cool, the bedroom is nice and comfy, and sharing a bathroom was no problem at all. The view from the roof of the house is absolutely beautiful. It also comes with chubby, awesome cats, which is a huge plus in our book.
The location is great too, close to lots of restaurants, bars and coffee shops, and the L train is less than 5 minutes away from the apartment.
So basically - perfect! Gus and Holly really helped us have a great time in NYC, and we can't wait to come back and stay there again!

Perfect! Simply perfect!!!!
Clean, sunny, nice people, cute kitties!wonderful place guys!!!

It was just wounderful. Gus and Holly have been great hosts with lots of ideas and places they told us about we should not miss in NY.
The appartment is very nice, cosy and in a very cool area. Just minuts to walk to Bedford av, which is absolutly worth seeing it, and only 2 stations away from Manhattan. We would always come back! Thanks a lot to you both!

Perfect !
Great appartment, in the middle of Williamsburg.
Nice bedroom with everything we needed.
Gus and Holly were great, they gave us advices, and they were very friendly.
I higly recommand this place.
We can absolutely confirm all the good things mentioned in the comments before. Gus and Holly are SUPER nice and we had an amazing time staying at their place. So don't hesitate, just book!

I spent one month with Gus and Holly for my first AIrbnb experience. And I could not have dreamt of a better spot. Gus and Holly are amazing people and became my friends. They made me feel like home. They will always give you some good tips about WIlliamsburg's best places to eat/drink/partying... (you MUST check their list !) By the way, the location is just perfect, sooo close to Manhattan. The room is just as it looks on the pictures, very cozy, as the rest of the appartment. So if you want to spend a good time in NYC, just GO THERE ! I'll be back...

J'ai passé un mois chez Gus et Holly, et je ne pouvais pas rêver mieux pour ma première expérience avec AIrbnb. Je me suis vraiment sentie à la maison. Ce sont des gens incroyables, toujours disponibles pour donner de bons conseils sur les meilleures adresses de WIlliamsburg (il faut absolument jeter un coup d'oeil sur leur liste de bons plans). L'appartement est proche de Manhattan (10 min en métro...) et situé dans un de mes quartiers préférés de Brooklyn. La chambre est très douillette, vraiment conforme aux photos. Je recommanderais VRAIMENT cet endroit à tous mes amis pour passer un bout de temps à NYC. En tout cas, moi j'y reviendrai !
Gus and Holly were the perfect hosts, friendly and helpful! Their place is simply beautiful and their cats are adorable. It was a great location to stay at for my quick trip in and out of the city.

We spent 11 days in New York in July, and we're glad we chose to stay at Gus and Holly's! We were very happy with the flat, location and hosts. The flat is ideally located - it's a few blocks from the L train which took us to Manhattan in five or ten minutes. The neighborhood itself is safe and very lively (especially at night on weekends, but also on weekdays). Supermarkets, diners, bars and cafés are right across the street. Bedford Avenue is a fifteen-minute walk from the flat (the street is filled with laid-back bars, good restaurants and nice vintage shops and libraries).
As for the flat itself, although the room was small, it was very comfortable and had everything we needed - space to store our clothes and bags, adaptors, air conditioner... and we could see the Liberty Tower from the window. Moreover, Gus and Holly encouraged us to use the common areas (which were always clean) - we cooked in the kitchen and hung out in their lovely living room a lot, with Sid and Vicious purring next to us. Everything looked exactly like the pictures on the website. Great view of the Manhattan skyscrapers from the roof!
Gus and Holly were nice and extremely cool. They made us feel comfortable in their home, and gave us tips about what to do in Williamsburg. Moreover, they were of great help whenever we needed them! All in all, everything matched our expectations and we'd love to stay at the flat again when we come back to NYC!

We had a great time at Gus and Holly's place. Gus was really friendly and helped us with the luggage. The room was small but perfect for me and my friend. We also used often the kitchen and the living room, which both were very clean. Gus and Holly have also written a list with "best things to do in Williamsburg" (best restaurants and bars) and another one with a lot of other information, which were very useful! We enjoyed our stay in Brooklyn and can highly recommend it to everybody!

Laurie is a fabulous, knowledgable host.  She is right there for you to suggest wonderful opportunities to explore Brooklyn and beyond but recedes into her busy life to let you be on your own.  The house is quiet and the neighborhood is amazing.  Lots of places to eat, bistros and the like, and Laurie will steer you in the right direction.  There is wonderful opportunity to meet interesting people that are also staying at Laurie's - I do not think I could have had a better experience or a more affordable opportunity to get the best out of my stay in Brooklyn.  And, if you are a cat lover - Batman and Robin will make the most out of your affection and open door.

Highly recommend. Location was great. (Park Slope and Brooklyn are wonderful, subway was a few blocks away.) Clean house, comfortable beds, clean bathrooms. Sharing a bathroom with only one other bedroom meant very little/no waiting. Laurie was friendly and helpful. Good breakfast foods on-hand and she gave my husband a great Red Hook breakfast reco. Lots of local guidebooks and maps too, in case you like to digest stuff that way. Already thinking about when we can go back.
Gus and Holly are wonderful hosts!  The apartment was extremely convenient for my stay in Williamsburg Brooklyn.  I would definitely stay there again.

I spent 4 nights at Gus and Holly's place and had a great experience staying in their apartment. They were both really friendly, helpful..you couldn't ask for more! The bed is super-comfortable, and the room is perfect to go back to after a busy day in the city.

Hola somos Dana y Diego pasamos 17 días en el departamento de Gus & Holi y quedamos encantados! Por eso los recomendamos 100%
Ellos fueron muy amables nos hicieron sentir muy cómodos, como en casa.
El barrio es muy lindo y seguro, la cercanía al subway súper conveniente.
Sigan las recomendaciones de los chicos y van a conocer los mejores bares y restaurantes de Williamsburg.
Sin dudas volveríamos a elegirlos en un próximo viaje!

We spent a whole week there and the apartment is well located, close to the subway and quite fast to go to manhattan.The bedroom was totally fine even if it s a little bit small for a couple with big luggages! We could use the kitchen ( even had a space in the cupboard and fridge) and were invited to use the living room. Unfortunately, we didnt meet Gus as he was out of town and Holly was very busy but she gave us nice addresses to go and eat :) thank you for that! We felt very comfortable and we recommend it!

I stayed with Gus and Holly for 5 nights with my sister. They're both very lovely people and made us feel right at home. Their apartment is gorgeous, very well kept and in a great location. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend staying with them.

I loved my stay here! I felt like I was crashing at a friend's apartment. Everything was clean and comfy. My friend and I were gone most of the day so we didn't see Gus and Holly much, but they are the nicest people! The cats were very cuddly and sweet. Great area with alot going on...and close to the subway, which was extremely convenient. I definitely recommend staying here!
Great location! Really lovely cafés and nearby and super close to the metro. Gus and Holly were very accommodating.
Great location to visit NYC and to enjoy williamsburg neighbourhood! Gus was helpful and accommodating.

Had a fantastic time staying with Gus and Holly. They were really chilled out and welcoming, and their list of recommendations became our bible during our short time in NY.

Due to our busy schedule, we didn't spend a huge amount of time with them, but got the impression that they'd be happy to accommodate any of our needs, and that their invitation to enjoy the communal space was genuine.

The room is cozy and well-appointed, and the flat is lovely and characterful - an easy walk to loads of cool bars and restaurants. Plus the two gorgeous cats clearly share the temperament of their owners.

Gus and Holly were amazing hosts. You can really feel at home in their flat. This made the whole New York City experience even better. The can tell you the best places for eating, drinking and so on. We enjoyed our time alot!
Gus and his wife Holly were fantastic hosts. They were both incredibly friendly and easy going, and had great recommendations for restaurants, bars, sites, etc. We'd definitely stay with them again!

Our stay with Gus and Holly was delightful. A great first experience with Airbnb. As hosts, they provide you anything you may need and had great suggestions for local food, restaurants, bars and shopping. Their apartment is cozy and homey which is exactly what you need!. It's a great place to hang out, cook, drink, and unwind.  Gus & Holly are located right in the heart of Williamsburg ( just 2 blocks from the L train, so getting to Manhattan, centre of NY, was very easy). Also, we felt very safe walking home at night. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone! Thamk you Gus and Holly!! Kisses from Portugal (Italy) ;D

It was a great time to stay with Holly and Gus. They are so friendly and helpful. They recommended us many things, what we can do in New York and Brooklyn.
I would come back again.

I had a great stay at Gus'.  The room is bright and comfortable; the location is great; and while I never met Gus (he was out of town), he was still helpful and friendly over text and email, and his wife, Holly, was the same.  I'd absolutely stay here again!

We had a great time in Gus and Holly's place. The room is comfortable and their kitchen is very useful (and cute). The bathroom use was not a problem, as it was always available. The location is great, only 4 blocks from the L train and we felt very safe in the neighborhood, which is great, by the way. They gave as a list of good spots in the area which we highly recommend. We're eager to come back and have another brunch at Le Barricou (just 2 min-walk from the building).

Thanks to Gus and Holly, I had a wonderful stay in NYC. They are kind, laid-back, open minded and helpful. Together with their two cats, they really made me felt like home. The room is bright, clean, comfy and offers a great view. And the location of the apartment is very convenient too: Loads of great bars, cafes and restaurants are just some steps away, just as the L train, which brings you directly to Manhattan in less than 20 min (best part: due to it's transverse route, it crosses nearly ever other line). I totally recommend staying at their place - hopefully their room is available the next time I'm in town!

Les + : Jennifer n'était pas là, mais il y avait son coloc un peu zarbi mais très gentil. La personne auprès de laquelle nous avons récupéré les clés était très arrangeante. De plus, le quartier de East Village est vraiment hyper bien situé pour visiter Manhattan et toujours très animé (donc aucun problème de sécurité, et il y a plein d'endroits sympas où sortir la nuit).

Les - : Petit appart très sombre (aucune fenêtre), lit moyennement confortable.

En conclusion, prenez cette chambre si vous avez seulement besoin d'un endroit où dormir afin de visiter NY quelques jours.

Staying with Laurie was my first experience with AirBnB, and she was an absolutely wonderful host. Her house was lovely, very quiet, and perfectly located. I will definitely be staying with her again if I am ever in New York!

Our days with Laurie was excellent!

Her house is quite confortable, the room reserved for us was wide enough and spotlessly clean.
Laurie is an excellent person, friendly and a very good tourist guide. She gave us very good tips about Manhathan e Brooklyn. This is an excellent point to stay with her.

The location is excellent too, are just two blocks from Lines D, N, R, F and G subway, with easy access to any part of NY. All types of stores can also be found nearby.

Five stars for our new friend Laurie.

Laurie was an excellent host. She knew the neighborhood extremely well and was happy to offer advice on uncrowded cafes for me to work from, as well as restaurants, music halls, and other attractions. The room was comfortable and the house had lots of character--this was my first time using airbnb, and the whole experience felt a lot more authentic than the chain hotels I usually stay at. I'd definitely like to stay here again if I'm in the area.
Great visit. It was our second time. No problems at all. Laurie is helpful and the location can't be beat. Wonderful chocolate croissants!

A lovely querky house with lots of history. Laurie is a wonderful host and is so helpful with information on where to eat , where to go, how to get there and avoiding the queues.
Essential you like cats as Batman and Robin love people.
Once you have learnt the various foibles you can get your own breakfast (delicious) and come and go as you wish, which suited us perfectly and we had a wonderful time. Locally there are some excellent restaurants and wide choice, so no need to head back to Manhattan. An enjoyable place to stay.
Great location, nice clean rooms and excellent shower. Easy walk to subway for 20 min ride into Manhattan.

It was so great to stay in the apartment from Jennifer! Cozy Bedroom with comfy bed. The place was very clean ! I never met Jennifer but her flatmate Geoffrey. He was very helpful with me and a amazing host! We had a funny night with red wine in the kitchen.I felt at home instantly even though I was about 10, miles away from home!

The cleanliness of the place is disastrous. My wife and I just moved to New York from Croatia, where rental apartment industry is pretty developed because of tourism, so we were expecting a certain level of cleanliness.

The floor in the kitchen looks like it was never mopped, bottom of the bathtub is greasy and everything in the apartment has a layer of dust on it like it wasn't cleaned for a very long time. On top of that, the apartment is overcrowded with stuff, kitchen cupboards are filled with what looks like a pile of various old stuff and junk, and there is no sunlight whatsoever in the bedroom or kitchen. The whole place thus feels pretty suffocating.

The dining table in the kitchen is barley usable because of its loose wooden legs, so you basically don't have a proper place to eat a meal in the whole apartment.

The bathroom wasn't cleaned before we arrived, although the cleaning lady was supposed to do it, according to Jennifer. We complained and Jennifer reacted promptly and hired a cleaning lady again, so the bathroom was eventually "cleaned".

Finally, the pictures posted on Airbnb website are outdated, the room was redecorated in the meantime and is actually nicer than shown in the pictures.

Everything considered, a pretty horrible experience with a price tag of $1500 for a month long stay.

Great location in the middle of downtown manhatten, next to the subway bleeker street. Jennifer is very helpfull. The room is okay for two persons. The rest of jennifers appartment is clean and beautiful.

Jennifer fue una anfitriona sumamente atenta y cordial en todo momento. La habitación no era lo que esperábamos, pero para un par de días está muy bien. El barrio es cómodo y con muchos servicios cerca.

Jennifer was very accommodating in meeting my arrival schedule and waited for me even though I was almost two hours late driving into NYC. The room was relatively small but well equipped with a comfortable bed and other necessities. The apartment is very well-located in a vibrant part of the East Village, with restaurants, convenience stores, pharmacies, dry cleaners etc. all within proximity. The building is only 4 blocks away from a subway station. This is a walk-up building but very well maintained. Bathroom is clean and well-equipped. Jennifer was friendly, warm and approachable, and we even hang out at an event on one of the days. She isn't at the place most of the time so I had lots of privacy.

We didn't have the pleasure to meet Jennifer but she was very nice when we called her on the first day because we had some trouble finding the apartment. During the 9 nights we saw Geoffrey only 2 times but he was very nice and gave us great tips and adresses.
Concerning the apartment, the location is great and the room fits two people, but the cleanliness was a desaster and the door in the bathroom didn't close so we didn't have so much privacy which is not cool when you share your apartment.

Jennifer is a wonderful host. A genuine local-friendly and helpful. Her roommate Geoffrey is also great.
Their place is a perfect base to explore the East Village-it's quiet, clean and comfortable. Great stay-Thanks Jennifer!

Great room in a great part of NYC. I didn't see the host personally but her roommate is chill. The place is sanitary, quiet, and dark. There is also a lot of great food in East Village. Overall a great stay!

I had a really lovely time here. Location was fantastic and the guys are so easy going. Everything was clean and the apartment is adorable. Absolutely going to stay with them again if they'd have me. :) Just great. Thanks again Gus.

He!

Last week my girlfriend and me stayed at Guz and Hollys place. Both are very nice and Guz gave us some really good recommondations for food and drinks.
It was a friendly and welcome atmosphere!

The room:
the room was just perfect for us. The bed was big enough and comfortable, everything was clean and neat.
Guz prepared two sheets with wireless access and some really good food and drink recommondations.

Bathroom and kitchen:

Bathroom and toilet are very clean and tidy! The kitchen is very tidy and you can use whatever you what to have a meal, but we just processed the good recommondations ,)!

Neighborhood:

from the flat the connection to Manhattan by sub is really good and in the evening your just at the right place for having a drink or partying.

We had a great stay at guz and hollys place and if we would come back to new York we just would stay at their place!

Had a great time staying here! Clean, quiet, Holly was super sweet and the apartment was incredibly convenient for the trains into Manhattan. Also very safe neighborhood, and room was big enough for two! Would stay here again! Oh and the rooftop was awesome!

Gus, Holly and their furry companions were friendly, laid back, and immediately made me feel welcome. Their apartment is cozy and well appointed. And Williamsburg is a beguiling mix of ethnicities and sub-cultures with great eateries and easy access to Manhattan.

In short: if I was heading back to NYC any time soon, I'd look up Gus & Holly again without hesitation.

We stayed with Gus & Holly for 5 nights, the arrival and departure times were really flexible, and we were provided with every information we needed before and on our arrival, e.g. how to get there by subway, where to find cool bars and restaurants in the neighbourhood etc.
The apartment was clean and centrally located, just a few minutes to the subway and supermarkets.
Gus was really friendly and hospitable on our arrival (we didn't meet Holly).
The kitchen is fully equipped, what we found very useful.
The cats are quite well-behaved and didn't make much noise in the night; however, sometimes it smelled of cat food a little.
Unfortunately, the street is quite noisy on week-ends, therefore it might be useful to bring earplugs.

We stayed with Gus and Holly for an entire week and we had a good time there. The room itself is rather small, but since we were exploring NY all day long and only used the room to sleep, it didn't really bother us. Gus and Holly provided us with excellent restaurant recommendations and we LOVED the ones we tried - so thank you! If you're not a big fan of cats, it's probably not the best idea to stay there, since you do notice their presence. They have a cozy living room and a  very well equipped kitchen, which we didn't really use though since we preferred to spend our time out in the city. The view from the rooftop is amazing and the location of the flat is excellent as well. Staying there makes you feel like a local and that's what we liked about it!
Le logement correspondait à nos attentes, très fonctionnel et à proximité d'un métro pour aller facilement à Manathan. Le quartier est sympa et nous avons pu y diner quelques soirs.

Gus was super friendly, welcoming, and fun. The apartment was in a great location in Brooklyn. My boyfriend and I enjoyed several delicious meals on the roof, one being take out from Champs ( I highly recommend). We would definitely like to stay with Gus and Holly if we're back in New York again!

We had a great stay with Gus and Holly. Their apartment was very clean and centrally located, and they were more than helpful giving us directions to and from their place, and also providing some great suggestions for food and bars in the area. We are cat-lovers so having them around was a bonus too. Thanks for a great stay!

Il mio soggiorno presso Gus e Holly è stato solo per una notte. La foto è fedele alla camera che troverete. E' vicina ad una fermata della metropolitana. La zona di Williamsburg sta diventando sempre più cool, famosa per il vintage , il market che c'è sabato o domenica (non ricordo) e i locali. La camera era pulita come anche il bagno. La casa molto "cosy", ospitale e ben arredata e i due ospiti d'onore, i due gatti, sono stati degli Host con la acca maiuscola. Grazie Gus anche se per la breve ospitalità. C'è anche un parco vicino per chi ama fare jogging al mattino-
Gus and Holly are really nice, easy going people. Great communication in advance. If somebody is down for a small room downtown Wburg, this is recommended.

We spent a really nice stay at Gus and Holly's apartment. They really want us to feel at home. The 1st evening, Gus took time to have a tour of the apartment and to make us feel comfortable.
We slept very well, the bed is comfortable.
Gus likes to advice the guests about the nice places in the neighborhood and about the good things to do in NYC.
Williamsbourg is a great location to stay in NYC, there are awesome bars and restaurants and it's easy to access to Manhattan by subway.

We had a nice and comfortable stay with Holly and Gus in Williamsburg. This elegant house is close to the subway, the room is not big, but has a good bed and enough closet space. Holly was willing to give us first hand info on the city. A great little Airbnb-hotel in Brooklyn.

Unfortunately, my friend and I didn't have the pleasure of meeting Gus, but Holly was amazing and more than accommodating. When we arrived Holly provided us with a list of all of their favourite places in the area, which was very helpful. The apartment was clean and beautiful space, and very quiet at night. Holly didn't mind that we would come in and out of the apartment late at night. The cats were adorable (I may have made a best friend there). This was actually my first time using AirBnB and it was such a positive experience. Thanks Holly & Gus!!!!

We spent a fun week with Laurie and Peter and very much appreciated here. The house is situated in a quiet neighborhood with a large choice of restaurants of all nationalities who have been recommended by Laurie. The Ten (Japanese) has been our preference. Too bad we did not meet Laurie and Peter, maybe next time. Still, everything was all set to get a good breakfast and lots of information to a pleasant stay. We had the company of a charming English couple and also we will not forget the two cats who were very sociable. A big thank you to Kim and Dani who helped us provide the best for our stay is in good condition. Finally, a place we strongly recommend to all

Laurie is a gracious and very knowledgeable hostess. She knows Brooklyn very well, and she was incredibly helpful in guiding me to the  best places to eat, shop, etc. in the area. I stayed at her place while waiting for my husband to arrive from the West Coast; we just moved into the area, and Laurie made the initial transition much easier. She also has delicious croissants and cheeses available for her guests!

Our stay at Laurie's is probably the best experience one could ever imagine through Airbnb.  Laurie is an amazing host, a knowledgeable tour guide of New York, and a museum curator all in one.  Her home is in a great part of the city, yet on a side street where I never had a problem parking just a few feet from her front door.  Her house could be a Better Homes and Garden showpiece, and yes, it even has a large garden in her back yard.  There is artwork and books everywhere.  In fact, the photos on Airbnb don't even do justice to the beauty of the place.  The rooms are large, immaculate, and the beds are comfortable.  The espresso maker in the kitchen and fresh croissants and OJ every morning was a treat, and much better than even Starbucks can deliver!  The house management team, Batman and Robin (Laurie's two cats), were friendly and ever-present.  I couldn't think of a nicer place to stay.

It was great to stay in Laurie's well situated and welcoming home in South Slope.  Laurie was so welcoming to our family of four, and never failed to give us spot on advice for our queries on eating out, places to visit and things to do.
