Her home is comfortable and gracious and a joy to returw to air-conditioned rooms in the middle of a heat wave!
Laurie is great, lovely and welcoming. The place was really nice and with an easy access to the town. Will definetely recommend to my friends and be back! I really felt home there :-)

Gus and Hollys apartment is super cute - the highlights being a huge fully equipped kitchen and a rooftop with amazing views of the city. It's conveniently located to a couple of metro lines as well as Bedford ave which is a great street for wandering, people watching and shopping. Williamsburg is definitely a great area to be in, lots of cool bars and cafes about and so quick to manhattan. The room is fairly small but that's to be expected in NYC..! Gus and holly are absolutely lovely. They gave us lots of hot tips for groovy bars and restaurants in the area and they went above and beyond to ensure we had a very happy stay in their home. Thanks guys!! :)

Gus and Holly were perfect hosts! They were friendly and welcoming, helpful and quick to answer any of our queries! Their home is cute, clean and close to the subway. They also provided us with a list of recommended places to eat in Williamsburg which was really handy and everywhere they recommended was awesome! Would highly recommend

Holly and Gus were great hosts! They were super friendly, warm and welcoming and always checked in to make sure my stay was comfortable! When I arrived Gus carried my bag up the stairs (so helpful because there certainly were a few!), showed me around the place, including a shelf he had cleared and space in the fridge if I purchased my own food.

The room was clean and cosy - they had even listed out great local places to eat and drink, places to buy groceries and do my laundry if needed. They had also left guide books for me if i needed some extra tips on great NY things to do.

Also, great location being super close to the L and G lines so you were in Manhattan in 20mins door to door!

I do airbnb a lot, and this was one of my most positive experiences thus far. Gus and Holly were very welcoming, and easy to communicate with. I felt completely at home in the apartment. When the temperature plunged suddenly, they made sure I was comfortable, supplying a space heater as needed. Everything was as pictured and the location was perfect for me. I would not hesitate to recommended this cute room in Williamsburg to anyone. And by the way, Sid and Vicious are fantastic felines. Sid was a bit under the weather while I was there, but Vicious could not have been friendlier.

We arrived in the morning, during a snowstorm, carrying a bag as big as myself. Gus lifted it like it was full of feathers and we quickly climbed to the 3rd floor apartment. in the next 30 minutes we got the tour of the house by gus, the kitchen tour by holly, with all the drawers, and even managed to arrange for a short visit to the music studio he owns. Gus is a very tall, very friendly guy. Holly can make you laugh until your jaw hurts. We got the rules of the house - come when you like, go when you like, don't worry about anything, just enjoy new york.
They make a perfect pair, these two, we got that from the beggining. As we found out during the week there, we shared the same taste for art and politics. And music. And food. And fun. (they give you accurate lists of places they like in brooklyn, which we used extensively for eating and having fun). We were walking all day, some days we got to see them awake at home when we got back. So we talked about whatever, our jobs, their plans. It was very nice.
They helped us with everything: find routes, get places, transfer money, print bookings, get taxis, even prepare breakfast - thanks Holly.
The apartment was great, it looked like our apartment. It was also very clean, despite the two cats living there. It was generally cleaned twice during the week we spent there.
The location was great as well, williamsburg is the coolest place in ny. You can go everyhere easy from the apartment and get to Manhattan in 15 min.
Ah, we also got to meet the lead singer from Les Trois Accords, he had the second guestroom. Great guy, very polite, answered all our weird questions and made a great parralel on US and canadian policies and general politics.
We had a great time, me and my husband, part thanks to NY, part thanks to Gus and Holly.
Thanks guys!
PS: also great view from the roof, it was easy access and the best place to smoke.
The location was perfect with amazing views from the rooftop, both Gus and Holly were fantastic hosts and the space was great! Would definitely recommend it.

We stayed at Gus' and Holly's place for five days and had a great time! The apartment is located in a nice and safe neighborhood, close to cool restaurants, bars and shops; two different subway stations are just a couple of blocks away. Their place is very clean, the room's small but cozy and the view from the rooftop is amazing!
Holly and Gus were super friendly and communicative and recommended us a lot of things to do. We felt very welcome and would definitely recommend their place!

Great value for the location and room, just 1 min from grocery store and everything is a walking distance. The room is just right and exceeded my expectations. For the location it is a bargain, would Airbnb again. Jennifer is a great host and makes you feel comfortable and at home.
We didn't have the pleasure to meet Jennifer but her place was Very nice and a perfect location!
Отличное расположение, отзывчивая хозяйка , чистый подъезд! Желаю всем посетить Нью-Йорк! Комната Дженифер - отличный бюджетный вариант, рекомендую.
Jennifer was so nice and thoughtful, we couldn't wish for more.
Great place!

Jennifer's flat is at an excellent location in the middle of everything with a 24/7 corner shop, Fry Guys and 99c pizza across the street. It was really great value and we really enjoyed staying in such a vibrant area. Even though we didn't meet Jennifer in person, she was responsive and arranged our check in with her friend who was really nice and understanding when were late due to issues with transport from the airport.
The room had a comfortable bed but there was no daylight as the window points at another building's wall and for fresh air, you need to use the AC. The photos in the listing are misleading - the one that says "This is the room for rent" is actually her flatmate's place and the room we stayed at was redecorated and looks different (much better) than in the pictures.
We would definitely recommend staying at Jennifer's as no other place in New York can beat the amazing value.

Got in the room easily and she let us check in early. It was a great location close to bars, food, subways. Only thing we wished was that we were told that one of the nights someone had bought the other room so when we came home we weren't surprised and could have locked up our stuff before we left that morning. Otherwise it worked out great and I would stay there again.

The location is amazing because you can easily get anywhere in NY either by the subway that is a couple of minutes walk or in one of the bus lines that are super close! .. If you enjoy going for a walk and find many places either for breakfast or lunch and many bars is a perfect area and if you travel alone is perfect because it is a safe area and no matter how late it is there is always movement! But here is the point.. there is a lot of noise during the night, It doesn’t care to me because I have a heavy sleep. The room is super comfortable the bed, everything! Also warm so you will not be cold! Super recommended !!! Thanks Jennifer!
awesome! worth it!

Number one is this was the best value we could find.  Least money for being closest to what we wanted to see.  Was it a 5 star hotel?  No.  In fact, it was quite a bit lower standard then what we were used to.  But it was fun experiencing something different then what we were used to. I mean, the whole apartment would fit into just my living room!  But things were clean and Jennifer's friend was amicable, offering assistance if we wanted it but staying out of the way when we didn't.  In the end, I would stay there again.  Save money for doing things.
Great value, great location, and great communication. The radiator has a mind of its own, but just crack the window and you will be fine.

Near lots of great food, nightlife. Only stayed two day but seemed like a great neighborhood. Also ran out of toilet paper my last night and couldn’t find any in the bathroom. Room was smaller than expected but everything else was great other than that. Washer and dryer in apartment so I was able to go home with clean clothes

It was different from what I expected, but it was very cozy and reminded me of my old house. Unfortunately I came during Christmas so I was unable to get the full benefits/experience of living near the city. Jennifer was easy to reach and responded quickly to my messages. Would like to visit again someday :)
The price is good,the room is also good. The host is a good person.
It was absolutly amazing. Nice cozy room. Thumbs up 😊👍🏼
Jennifer is a really cool person who ensures that your stay is comfortable and great!
Lugar bien ubicado, todo correcto, Jennifer muy discerta.

Die Lage war praktisch, alles in der Nähe und die Subway ist auch nicht weit weg. Der Platz im Apartment war für zwei Leute grade so ausreichend. Leider hat uns die Küche nicht zum Kochen eingeladen, was uns Geld gespart hätte. Jennifer war aber sehr hilfsbereit und freundlich.

My husband and I stayed with Laurie and her beautiful cats for a week in September. We had a fantastic stay and Laurie couldn’t have been more helpful or generous. Brooklyn was a great place to stay and Laurie’s house was close to great restaurants and the subway for easy access to Manhattan. Laurie is a fabulous host and her home was like a home away from home. A wonderful retreat in a great city! Thanks Laurie, I would love to come back.

We really enjoyed our stay at Laurie Kellogg's house. The bedroom was clean and comfortable and the bathroom was clean too.We enjoyed great coffee,bagels and muffins and fresh fruit for breakfast.Laurie did everything to make us feel comfortable and gave us a lot of information about the restaurants and sightseeing in New York.She even gave us discount coupons for certain restaurants and activities(biking in Central Park).This is a great place to stay!

Staying with Laurie was the best part of our wonderful 6 day trip. The entire house was very clean. We loved our cozy room and our bed was really comfortable. A nice variety of croisants, bagels and cheeses and that awesome expresso machine (!) made for a yummy breakfast. Every evening we felt like we were coming home. Never felt like that staying in a hotel. And meeting Laurie was the best part of all...an interesting woman who is a concierge from heaven!
We'll be back.

Laurie was an excellent host.  The house and neighborhood were lovely. Laurie was always ready to help my girlfriend and I find our way around town. She showed us lots of great places to eat out and areas to tour which were very affordable. Be sure to try her awesome breakfast with organic orange juice and fresh croissants!  I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a great vacation in NYC.

HEAVEN!!!! If you"re reading this, then chances are you're in a pickle as to where to stay In New York, without having to blow your budget or take out a mortgage. You've possibly used airbnb before, and had average or bad or great experiences. You're asking yourself questions like.... Will the house and room be quiet, will it be close to subways, is it in a good area, will I have my privacy, will my host be able to help me find my way around, will my bed be comfortable, and if I wanna come home at 2 am wi after exploring the city, willll it be safe?. Well I just spent ten days of bliss at a house that was more like a home, a host that was more like a friend, in an area that couldn't be better situated. Look no further If you want a real home away from home at a great price in a great area!! Checklist. The R train is a few bllocks away, I used it to get everywhere and connect with every possible subway. You can walk in the area 24 hours with complete peace of mind. Laurie's house is on the corner of the hottest hippest liveliest street with tons of shops cafes restaurants a market and more, so u don't even have to go to Manhattan every day. You are so close to everything that you can explore every part of Brooklyn, and if u do have time and feel like a good brisk exciting walk while taking in the amazing sights oif Brooklyn,you will get you to the Brooklyn bridge, and over it i in 45.  miin. If you cycle, 2o min to Manhattan, and 10 min by subway.. So you're in the best area of New York, trust me!!! As far as the rrest of the checklist? Best bed ever, most beautiful home filled with life and history and art, quiet, tranquil, private, inhabited by the cutest cats ever, who on more than one occasion spent hours sleeping in with me one sunday after a rather late night. If I tell you I didn't hear a peep in the house I'm not lying, as the rooms are situated on the top of the beautiful house, and the apartment for rental is below and completely private and seperate from the rest of the house. The rooms have just been redecorated and spruced up for Christmas, and are truly the largest nicest rooms you could find in New York for the excellent price. I stayed on a little longer and Laurie was incredibly accomodating. She is an excpetional woman, mother and human being, intelligent talented resourceful and just sweeter than you could imagine. so don't look any further BOOK, before its all booked up!

We enjoyed staying at Laurie's and wished that we had more time chatting with her and scouring through her books. She's very flexible, friendly and always ready to share her knowledge of the area. The apartment is near to the subways as well as little cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and 24 hour pharmacy!

Both Batman and Robin (Laurie's pet cats) are simply adorable and very friendly too! Will miss them!
You cannot stay in a more wonderful environment! Loved it! Laurie is´a great and caring host!

El barrio es bastante pintoresco, estaciones de metro a 3 o 4 manzanas, varias tiendas y restaurantes por los alrededores. Aunque para nosotros fue difícil subir a un tercer piso con 4 maletas, la estancia fue agradable y Jennifer fue muy cordial con nosotros.
Fantastische locatie. Jennifer reageert snel en was heel soepel in logistiek.
Excelente ubicación. Piso pequeño pero con todo lo necesario

Jennifer was very nice and responded very fast to all my messages and requests. Great location in the middle of Manhattan, typical NYC building and charming area with a lot of bars and restaurants, but still a quiet place. This comes at the cost of the building being old and the flat (3rd floor, steep stairs) not being in the newest shape and tilted.

L'appartement est grand, très bien décoré et proche du métro, ce qui permet de rejoindre Manhattan rapidement. La chambre est jolie, un peu petite, mais offre une penderie. Le quartier propose de nombreux commerces variés.
Holly a été très sympathique et disponible pour nos questions.
Gus était malheureusement en déplacement pendant notre séjour mais est resté en contact avec nous par e-mail pour savoir si tout allait bien.
J'ai également passé de bons moments avec Alex, un autre voyageur qui séjournait dans une autre chambre de l'appartement.

Holly and Gus were great hosts. Very nice and helpful when we needed it. They had GREAT food suggestions too. We had no problem coming and going at any hour. The two four-legged hosts were very friendly as well. (Their two cats.)
The place was located very conveniently near the L train. It was a little on the smaller side, but it was plenty big for my sister and I to share. The bed was very comfortable. It's a very cute little place with a great view. Also the WiFi and AC worked well and were handy to have.
Would definitely recommend them.
Gus and Holly were wonderful. They are incredibly helpful and their apartment is in a great location. We had a great experience and would recommend to anyone visiting NYC

Abbiamo trascorso 8 giorni. L'accoglienza di Gas e Holly è stata buona. Gus parla bene Italiano il che non guasta, ci ha fornito un elenco di ristoranti e bar dove poter andare nei dintorni e ha risposto alle nostre domande sempre gentilmente. La camera è piccola così come i bagni ma credo sia a normale a N.Y. La casa è vicina alla fermata Lorimer e il quartiere è molto vitale sia di giorno che di sera.

Our stay in New York was amazing!
We spent six nights at Gus' & Holly's place and we really enjoyed our time there. They definitely made us feel home in their comfy apartment and we loved having interesting and fun conversations with them.
They also provided useful information where to go and what to see - They do know all the cool places, for sure ;-)
What I liked most, personally, was that Gus and I share a very specific field of interest which, among others, made me feel like we were very much in tune with each other.
Julia and I will miss Gus and Holly, and we hope to meet them again in the future.

Amazing hosts in a great neighbourhood!! My partner and I really enjoyed our stay at here. The apartment is located in an amazing part of Brooklyn amid many cafe's, bars and grocery stores. Very close to subway and a quick ride to Manhattan. The vibes in the apartment were very relaxed and easy-going. Gus was also really happy to help us brainstorm a brief itinerary as our stay in NYC was short. We felt very comfortable here and would definitely love to stay again in the future.

The room and apartment was exactly as depicted in the offer and on the photos. Gus was really helpful and nice, as well he provided recommendations for locations (breakfast, dinner, etc.) in the surrounding area. I could make use of the apartment including kitchen and living room, as well as the rooftop terrace was really nice! I always felt secure in the area and you find a lot of bars, cafes and grocery shops there. The apartment is quite close to the subway stations, so that you are in Manhatte in about 20minutes. Really great! If you like cats, I can only recommend staying with Gus!

We recommend Gus and Holly ;)
It was really a good trip for us and a beautiful meet .
The bedroom was comfortable .
Gus was in host to high quality, really nice and helpful and considering.
Holly was really nice with us .
And we can't never forget the cats so cool and nice too :)
Thank you for this journey we hope to read you soon. ;)
See you next year for a new traveling .:D

Gus and Holly provided us with detailed info for our arrival and nice recommendations for the stay. They were great hosts – we could ask for advice at any time and sharing the appartment was easy going. The room is nice and cosy as described and in a cool neighborhood with great infrastructure (easy to get to Manhattan via L-train). The rooftop terrace is great on evenings and for breakfast, a true New York experience.  Thank you 

We had an amazing stay at Gus and Holly's! We loved the apartment (the view from the rooftop is great) and the location. It's really easy to get to Manhattan by subway, and there are some nice restaurants in the area - Gus and Holly even had a list with their favourites/suggestions. If you're going to New York, this is the perfect place to stay! :-)

Gus was a friendly and fair host. Unfortunately we met only on the last day, but we always kept in touch and he promptly fixed an unpredictable fact that happened. From this I could judge his openness and pleasant character.
The room is quite small, but the bed is very comfortable and the common spaces enjoyable and functional. The location is great and convenient.
Gus gave us many tips to better enjoy Williamsburg; the near L subway allows a fast connection with Manhattan.

A cozy little room in williamsburg,
In a 5 mn walk you can reach the subway lines to manhattan.
Holly and Gus a very friendly and can give you tips.
they have a well equiped kitchen if you want to use it.

My stay was great, Holly & Gus were very polite and courteous. The room was clean & cozy as well as the rest of the apartment. Also they had an adorable cat to hang out with and a really cool rooftop to see the city views. Really cool area, close to subway station so I would highly recommend to anyone visiting!
Lovely place, great location and awesome hosts.

We loved our stay! Gus and Holly treated us like long lost friends and we were very sad to leave. The apartment is really nice and clean and we loved our bed, we slept like babies! They communicated everything really well and was always up for a chat and a beer (or martini ;) We would recommend them 150%, they are the true definition of the perfect Airbnb experience!

Room is near manhattan. Gus&Holly are very kind. I felt really comfortable like staying friend's house. They gave me lots of information about good restaurant. Nice bathroom, cute cat, lovely living room. They let me use refrigerator, plate and other things. I really recommend you to stay their home.

too many good things to say about Gus and Holly. great room in an amazing area. I could not have had a better location or better hosts. Gus and Holly really make you feel at home and are so flexible! I had a late flight out on my last day and they let me extend my checkout so that I could make the most of my trip. they also provided a list of all the best restaurants and bars in Williamsburg. excellent experience all around, highly recommend this place!

We spent one week in holly and gus's apartment in march 2016. Gus was away for work so we only met Holly. She was nice and explained us everything when we arrived. The place was very clean!! And, the most important for us, close to the metro. In 15 min we are in Manhattan!!
The room was nice, not so big but we didnt mind because we were out most of the time. Sometimes it was a bite noisy in the night.
We have a problem with our flight so we had to stay one additional night, Holly was very undestanding, she let us stay one more night and we didnt need to pay!
We recommend this appartment because it is cheaper than the hotels and really good located.

I have stayed with Laurie several times, and every one has been wonderful. Beautiful, clean, and warm! A glass of wine in the garden, dinner reservations made for you, and a fantastic breakfast!
I give Laurie's my highest recommendation.

Thanks to Laurie, she was a wonderful host. Her cats were lovely. We arrived very late at night and she was waiting for us! Lovely house. The room was very cosy and the beds were perfect. The bathroom we had to share with other guests was no problem. Towels, shampoo etc. all was there. Great shower. Breakfast was complete. We even might take a peace of fruit for the lunch. In the evening when coming back from sightseeing we were allowed to take a cup of tea or a glas of wine, so nice. Using her computer for the internet was also possible. Laurie gave us a lot of information about New York. The area where she lives is really safe. Very easy to walk about 5 minutes to the closest subway. With the subway it took about 20 minutes to be in the centre of Manhatten. We advice her appartement to anyone who goes to NY.
thanks Laurie.

I had a pleasant, easy stay.  All the food basics were provided, especially for breakfast.  Dinner was also provided some nights.  Bringing in my own food was also allowed.  I could go out and come in at odd hours without disturbing anyone.

We had a really nice time in Brooklyn. Laurie Kellogg is a magnificent host. She gives a lot of tips and useful advice about things to see & do, good restaurants, bars, subway schedules, ... We stayed in a room with double bed on the top floor: a quiet place to sleep. It's a house with a history... lots of books, pictures and drawings. A bit messy but really cosy. We felt at home immediately. Laurie can also provide breakfast if needed: organic orange juice, croissants & fruits. We enjoyed it a lot! Thanks Laurie for such a wonderful stay!

There are homes and there are homes. Some look like a House Beautiful photo spread, but do not have heart. Others are living breathing expressions of their owner's creativity and vitality.
I am not going to waste your time with a catalogue of the amenities which were all first-class all the way (special mention, however, to the superb coffee and croissants and the lush towels, and the comfortable beds and the generous showers and the warm inviting old wood floors that glowed under the lights ).
Rather, I prefer to share that this home is a true oasis in a busy city, one that nourishes the soul with real artists' art, with personable cats, with conversation, with books that reflect Laurie's expansive interests. This grand old house presents a gracious hospitality to all who visit.
Laurie is a wealth of information about the heartbeat of the city outside her door, and is responsive to your every request. All of the above at a reasonable rate, you can't go wrong.
Thanks Laurie,
Colin

We were delighted with our stay at Laurie's place. Her home is as warm and beautiful as the pix show. The area has a real feel of community about it and Laurie gave us invaluable advice on where to eat and find Jazz. We would heartily recommend this as a great place to stay, whether Brooklyn is your final destination or if, like us, NYC is where it is at!
Looking forward to returning,
Joan.

My stay at Laurie's home was delightful!  Park Slope is such a great neighborhood, and Laurie helped me to find good restaurants and things to do nearby.  She really loves Park Slope and New York, and makes sure that her guests have the info they need to have a rich and vivid experience while in town.  I arrived way too early from a red eye flight, and Laurie was very gracious to let me wait in her living room and get settled in as soon as the room was ready.  Staying in a home versus a hotel is just what I needed on my business trip, and the location is superb... close to transit, close to Prospect Park for much needed walks and quiet moments.  This will the be the first place I search for when I'm in town next and I'm really grateful I found it.

Had a GREAT time at Laurie´s and Peter´s place they are so nice! The house is big and very quite! They are always  willing to help.  Highly recommended :) Thank you Laurie and Peter, hope to visit you soon :)
Warm welcome, feel my like at home, beautiful to discover a part of real  Brooklyn by bike. Thank you so much, Laurie.

I had a lovely stay at Laurie's beautiful home in Brooklyn. It was my first time in New York and all the advice and information she shared was extremely helpful and valuable. Her house is conveniently situated near a subway station with great connections. This gave me easy access to everything I wanted to see - only 20 minutes to Manhattan. All in all, it was a pleasure staying with Laurie and her very handsome son, Peter.

Great stay with Laurie in lovely Park Slope. Transportation to Manhattan was easy and tons of great restaurants close by. Clean room and bathroom, cute cats and tons of great recommendations from Laurie.

We had a great stay in NYC. Unfortunately we could not meet Gus but he kept in touch by text message. Holly was very kind to us and Vicious is a cool cat! the room was cozy and warm. A cute place to rest from the cold. The apartment is ideally located, a few blocks from the subway. It is easy to go from there to anywhere in Manhattan or Brooklyn. We recommend Gus and Holly's room! We had a great stay there!

Gus and Holly made us feel really welcome and at home in their apartment. We particularly liked the list of food and drink joints they left in our room to help us explore the area- pie 'n' thighs being a favourite! The apartment itself is really cute and comfortable and you have a lot of freedom to come and go as you please. We had a really great stay with them!

Le logement correspond à la description faite par Gus. La literie est bonne. Le quartier est sympathique. Il y a à proximité restos typiques et boutiques variées. Les lignes de métros sont proches pour se déplacer dans tout NYC.

I have spent a wonderful week in Gus and Holly's home. The bedroom and the apartment match the pictures. Gus and Holly were very nice and discreet but always available to help us.
That was my first airbnb experience and I don't regret it at all.
Even if the street is noisy, I really recommend this place, close to Manhattan.

El apartamento está ubicado en una zona muy linda rodeada de bares y lugares para cenar y tomar algo. La cama es confortable, la ducha muy buena y ofrece una muy linda vista de Manhattan. Tiene un Rooftop muy lindo también. Gus fue muy amable y servicial. A tener en cuenta: - está ubicado en una zona bastante transitada por lo cual se escuchan bastante los ruidos de la calle, nosotros no tuvimos problemas para descansar porque llegábamos super cansados de caminar todo el día pero es bueno tener este hecho en cuenta.
Saludos!
Leo y Euge
We had a very great time with Gus and Holly. They are both very friendly and oblinging. The apartment is very cute and clean and the cats are so sweet.

gus è stato disponibile sin dal primo momento e qualche giorno prima del nostro arrivo, ha fornito tutte le indicazioni su come raggiungere la casa e potervi accedere in autonomia.
il palazzo è vecchiotto e senza ascensore, per cui se siete soli e con valigie pesanti vi consiglio di chiedere aiuto; l'appartamento si trova al terzo piano, le rampe di scale sono ripide e strette ma, salire sulla terrazza di casa, di sera, e ammirare lo skyline di new york ripaga tutta la fatica!
si trova a pochi "blocchi" (isolati) dalla metropolitana [linea L - grigia] che in 10 min porta a manhattan.
gus e holly sono stati molto gentili e ci hanno aiutato quando avevamo bisogno di informazioni.

Williamsburg is een veilige buurt met veel leuke restaurantjes en bars in de buurt. Gus en holly zijn heel vriendelijke mensen, ik voelde mij meteen welkom. Hun lieve kat is ook een pluspunt. Het appartement ziet er erg deftig uit, bovendien bezorgen ze jou nuttige spullen zoals een haardroger en universeel stopcontact.

Gus communicated well before arrival and him and Holly were great with welcoming me to the space and showing me around. They have both lived in the area a long time and had plenty of awesome local recommendations.  Neighbourhood was great with many bars, restaurants and supermarkets so close by. Had fun at both the Burnside bar and Mcondo Mexican bar, located just downstairs - great food and drinks. Close to three subway stations meant that Manhattan and other areas of Brooklyn were just a short ride away. The bed was comfortable and the AC efficient - I was vising during a spell of very hot weather so this was very welcome. Enjoyed relaxing on the rooftop with a beer watching the sunset.

Gus and Holly are very nice, they will be able to help you with any tip or doubt you have and also you can just talk to them about your NY experience, they will be happy to listen and have conversation. Vicious, the cat is just adorable, he is super cute and friendly.
The house is just like the photos and has a great location. It is walking distance from the subway station to Manhattan and also from some great restaurants there in Brooklyn.
Nice Host, good location. Close to good Coffee, restaurants, groceries, Close to Bikeshare and Subway. They have well thought out suggestions for things nearby. I really appreciated that.

Gus and Holly are very nice and give you good recommendations. We really liked the restaurants nearby like Rye and Diner.
Appartment is very good located and close to Subway. Would recommend to stay there!

Communication was awesome.  Gus and Holly were very available and helpful.  I had originally planned to have a friend share the stay with me but it didn't work out and the space was absolutely perfect for one person.  The neighborhood was fun and convenient.  It was a great space for this trip and I'm glad it worked out!

We had a great stay with Gus and Holly - Williamsburg is a perfect location, loads of bars and places to eat within walking distance and really easy to get to Manhattan from. They were great hosts and made us feel very comfortable in their lovely apartment. We will definitely stay with them again next time we come to New York!

Our stay at Gus and Holly's place was great! The room is comfortable, the location is awesome and Gus and Holly (and their friends and foster kitten, Davey) were friendly, fun and super helpful. The stairs up to their place were a bit of a killer for us and our four suitcases, but turned out to be totally worth it :)
A+ location with super choice of local or manhattan adventures. Gus and Holly were really accommodating and made our stay a breeze. Thanks, guys!

Staying at Gus and Holly's place was great.
We didn't get to meet Gus, but Holly was a great host. We really enjoyed our stay, our bed, watching TV, everything.
We had a great stay, Gus and Holly are very kind! The room is bigger than seems from the photo. There is enough room for your luggage and stuff.

Gus, his girlfriend and cat made us very welcome in their apartment. You can be as private or as part of their lives as you like - they even offered us access to their bar! The room is small but it was absolutely fine for us as we only used the room for storing and sleeping! The place is warm (be aware that it can get very hot at night), clean and equipped and our hosts were chilled but very happy to give us advice and say hello each day. They really made the trip top notch! (The kitty made us very happy too.) We found the location ideal as we came back to eat in Brooklyn most nights. Highly recommend!

My first air BnB stay was made a great one with Gus and hollys warmth and welcoming attitude. I felt at home instantly, the apartment was beautiful and in a convenient location (exactly like the pictures). Every question I had before and during the stay was answered instantly. Wouldn't stay anywhere else in Brooklyn.
We enjoyed the stay very much in a cool neighbourhood! Great hosts! Because the location is next to a lively road, its at night not quite.

This is in a great location, really close to the L train and the G train. The apartment is so cute and the room is cozy with a comfortable bed and window unit! Gus and Holly made everything super easy and check in and out was a breeze. Their cat is sweet and always came by to say hi and get some pets! I would 100% recommend this spot to anyone!

Excellent place and excellent location. couldn't ask for much more. the apartment was ideal for us. very comfortable and relaxed. private if needs be and also easy to be social with the hosts (and cat). 5/10 minutes walk to the G, L and J trains, which opens up the whole of New York. 15 minute ride to most of Manhattan. Williamsburg is the perfect place to chill after a day in the city, with countless bars and restaurants and really nice locals who are always willing to chat. The rooftop is also a great bonus, lovely place to sit and enjoy a beer whilst watching the city. Highly recommended.

Nuestra estadía en el departamento de HOlly y Gus fue excelente! Ellos son súper amables y atentos. El departamento está muy bien ubicado, el barrio es muy seguro y hay estaciones de metro al rededor. Lo más cómodo que tiene el apartamento es la habitación y está muy bien ambientando.
Es un barrio muy juvenil por lo que la vida nocturna es muy transitada, pero llegas a dormir tan candado de recorrer que no es molestia.
Lo súper recomendamos, saludos.
Aye y Sofi

A great place to stay, when visiting NYC. Gus and Holly are really cool, welcoming and make their guests feel at home. The place's description is very accurate. The location is very good - you have anything you may need withing a few minutes walk, including subway to Manhattan, restaurants, grocery shops and coffee shops (Listen to your hosts' recommendations!). The room is not big, but it is comfortable with a good storage space. The roof is very nice for a morning coffee or an evening drink. I was just a bit worried about having to share the bathroom with the hosts and other guests, but as promised, this wasn't an issue at all!  Thank you and hope to see you again soon.

Tolle Unterkunft mitten in Williamsburg. Gus und Holly sind sehr nette Gastgeber und die Wohnung ist toll eingerichtet. Viele Restaurants und Geschäfte in der Umgebung und mehrere U-Bahn Stationen sind zu Fuß erreichbar. Definitiv zu empfehlen!
Sin duda es una muy buena opción, Gus y Holly son muy amables, la ubicación es buena, cerca de la línea L, sin duda volvería

Gus and Holly's was my first experience trying out a shared AirBnb, and it was much better than I expected. I was traveling alone and felt very safe and comfortable in their apartment and in the neighborhood. They are incredibly warm and welcoming, make you feel right at home, and even though the apartment might be shared with multiple people, I still felt like I had the privacy that I needed. It was a great stay!
We really enjoyed our stay!
Gus and Holly have a lovely place in a great neighbourhood. Would definitely stay again!

Great location - tons of restaurants and bars nearby, and easy access to the metro. Jennifer is super nice and her apartment has a great vibe. It's on the third floor and there's no elevator, but that wasn't a problem for me. Would recommend 100%.

Jennifer helped me checking in and give me lots of information about the east village.
The room had a large bed which is spacious even for 2 people. Moreover, towels and shampoos are provided. The room is decorated with some stylish paints. Although it is not my taste, Jennifer does put effort on decorating the room.The apartment definitely isn’t the cleanest you can find, some hair is on the linens. But it is pretty fair considering about the low cleaning fee.
The location is surrounded with many restaurants. Overall I have a good experience during my stay.
Small room, mediocre building, not bad for what you pay, but it’s not an amazing spot. Not very private at all

Lo mejor del lugar es la ubicación. Está situado en el East Village, cerca de muchos bares para salir a la noche.
En cuanto a la habitación tiene una cama grande, muy cómoda donde entran dos personas, pero no hay mucho espacio para moverse y donde dejar las valijas.
La casa en general esta un poco desordenada, no lo recomendaría si quieren hacer uso de la cocina. Pero el baño esta limpio y Jennifer nos dio toallas.
A Jennifer no la vimos casi nada, solo el primer día y el día que nos fuimos, así que no llegamos a conocerla.
Algo importante, que no me acuerdo si lo lei en la descripción, es que hay que subir 3 pisos por escalera.

The only good thing about this place is the location and the relatively clean bathroom. The kitchen was a mess and our room dirty. Check in and check out went fine, but the host was unresponsive to texts and had to be called prior to arrival. I would not recommend this place, unless you don't mind sleeping in a bed with clearly unwashed sheets. There was hair all over the pillows so we covered them with sweaters and slept on top of the blanket. We checked out early but came back to retrieve our luggage and saw that the bed had been made in the same style for the next guests. We are almost certain that the sheets were not cleaned or changed after us. This is not ok!

It was our first Airbnb stay and Laurie was very welcoming! She was very thoughtful about us and made us feel home. I liked the lovely two cats!!
And has nice garden :)
Maybe the bed was too soft for me but other than that, everything was very comfortable! Thank you very much Laurie!!! We enjoyed our stay in New York!

Laurie´s place is all about care and details. I flet like home. I have really enjoyed mi time in Brooklyn. This house is awesome and very well located, near to Prospect Park and the aera is full of good restaurents and bars with live music and it is very easy to go to Manhattan by subway. I recommend Laurie´s house for your NYC vacation. Laurie was professional, very friendly and a wonderful host giving recommendations for my stay in Brooklyn. She also led me her bike for enjoying a beatiful day in Governors Island.

Looking forward to returning.

Luis

Laurie was informative as to places to eat in area as well as transportation needs.  Home has a very lived in feel.  Room was comfortable with the use of the air conditioner.  Sharing the bathroom was not a problem as I left early in morning most days.

We had a great stay at Laurie's place - it was perfect for all our needs. Park Slope is a great neighborhood, nice and quiet too, and Laurie's house is close to 3 very convenient subway lines. Laurie was very helpful in telling us where the best local places are for pizza, bagels etc. Not that we ever actually went out for bagels in the end - Laurie had the most amazing bagels, cream cheese and orange juice I have ever tasted!!

Laurie is a terrific person. Knowledgeable, helpful, good taste and extremely warm.

Gorgeous house doesn't go far enough as a description. Comfortable, clean, private and spacious. We had no idea that we could feel so at home in a foreign country. Brooklyn is amazing, the people are friendly and fun and helpful. The trains are all very close. Laurie's coffee maker is awesome.

It is my opinion that there is no better way to stay in NYC.

We had an unbelievable time. Simply immaculate!

laurie's 140+ glowing reviews can't be wrong! she's got a gorgeous house with a fantastic setup in a perfect location. she's proud to call brooklyn home and is passionate about sharing the things she finds special about her city and her borough. listen to her recommendations; she knows what she's talking about!

garden/backyard space is virtually unheard of in new york and laurie's got a truly beautiful back patio and garden. take advantage of relaxing out there with your morning coffee if weather permits!

park slope is an adorable neighborhood and a welcome respite from the over-stimulation of manhattan. being so close to so many great restaurants, markets, shops and the park should sell you on this place if nothing else has.

bottom line: if you're looking for an alternative to a standard vrbo-type place and want the opportunity to stay with someone who's as invested in you enjoying your trip as you are, laurie's what you're looking for!

Great location conveniently located within 4 blocks of the subway and two stops of transfers, coffee joints, restaurants and even a wonderful patisserie. Venture a little further by foot or train and find a plethora of boutiques, eats, bars and BAM (a Brooklyn gem!)

Laurie is warm and welcoming as is her lovely home. Coffee and breakfast snacks were a plus and the conversation was priceless. The shared bath was no problem and had a hair dryer, the house is quiet and the bed was comfortable. You'll have access to countless maps, area menus and suggestions for things to do and places to go. Help and smiles are available when you need but never intrusive. Will stay again next time I return. Thank you Laurie!

Laurie treated us like her family during our stay when we got hit by Hurricane Sandy. We felt very protected at her house that never lost power. Park Slope is a wonderful neighborhood to stay and stroll. Lots of great restaurants and shops on 5th and 7th Avenues which are all in walking distance from the house, but still it's very quiet.  We never got bored when we couldn't reach Manhattan. Great organic breakfast foods in the fridge, fancy espresso machine,  and beautiful art work everywhere in the house. Above all, Laurie is a very warm hearted hostess we can count on.

Laurie's home was the perfect place for my nine days in Brooklyn. I was visiting my daughter/husband/and baby who live just a few blocks away. It was nice to come "home" to a quiet/comfy room after a long, busy day. It was also wonderful to have breakfast and coffee every morning. Right after I arrived she texted me to find out what I liked for breakfast. Plus, she has a wonderful espresso machine. Laurie was a great host. We only crossed paths a few times, which was fine, but she keeps in touch to make sure your stay is going well. Thank you Laurie!

Nov./Dec. 2012

You would have to be crazy not to stay with Laurie! Five stars is not enough. My fiancée and I had a fantastic time in New York thanks to Laurie. We hadn't done any prior planning when we arrived and she helped us with our itinerary, gave us tips for restaurants and experiences and showed us the REAL soul of New York. When attending a recommended, very special intimate jazz performance in Harlem the person next to us commented it was amazing to see us there because most locals don't even know about it! That is exactly the kind of experience you will get staying with Laurie!
Her home is very clean and comfortable and we felt very welcome there. At the same time you were given plenty of space and freedom to do as you please. Breakfast is indulgently catered. Location is unbeatable and we had NO problems getting back home and felt safe even late at night. Laurie is a generous host and we would love to stay with her again!

The flat is very small but the room is nice and the beds comfortable. Jennifer gave us our space and we could come and go as we wished. The location is perfect, near several subway stations and there are lots of restaurants around. I definitely recommend that host! :)

This was the first time I had just rented the room instead of a whole flat and it was the best decision I could have made. My girlfriend and I arrived quite late but Gus had already sorted out all our instructions and reccomendations from the airport, prior communications was so good! Flat was easy to find and has great connections to the airport, would recommend a cab when first arriving just to get your bearings easier. The flat was spotless and the room really tidy and comfortable, we were given really nice towels etc too and really made to feel at home, Gus and Hollie are amazing hosts and were especially great reccomending local bars and restaurants etc. Also, you csn be as private or social as you want. The flat is close to great bars and and restaurants and around a 10 minute ride on the Subway to central Manhattan, so you get a bit of everything! Thanks for such a great stay!!!!
Great people great place
they were very kind. they directed us to lots of very interesting places we would never have seen on our own! highly recommended

Great place and great host !

Gus and Hollie were there every time we needed them and the appartement was so cool !

Hope to see you if you ever come to Paris.

Gus and Holly will welcome you with great kindness and will help you experience the best of Williamsburg. Very nice appartment, clean and in a safe area, great location, tons of restaurants and bars around... Best place to stay in Brooklyn. Thanks again Gus and see you soon !

My partner and I had a lovely stay at Holly and Gus's home. The apartment is really bright and clean with a well-equipped kitchen. We enjoyed making breakfast every morning and having it in the airy living room. It was two subway stops from Manhattan, but also located in a really lively, fun area. The room was small but had a large closet and chest of drawers for storage. Would highly recommend :)
It was a very nice stay at Gus and Holly's flat. Great surrounding and cool Places to Visit. Also the recommendations from Holly have been very helpful.

Wir haben das Appartement geliebt. Die Lage war nahezu perfekt. 2 Haltestellen und schon ist man in Midtown. Das Bett war unheimlich bequem und Holly und Gus die freundlichsten Gastgeber die man nur haben kann, die uns auch noch klasse Tipps geben konnten. Das Appartement ist so wie Beschrieben. Danke nochmal Holly & Gus

I had a wonderful, comfortable and educational stay at Laurie's bnb!
The spacious 4 story house is beautiful and has so much character that you just can't spend enough time looking at everything, especially all the art work! The Almond croissants in the morning were delectable and Laurie always has great advice to give about how to get to different places and where to go in Brooklyn to see the best french musician, at a secret little place that not many know about!
Thanks Laurie!
Laurie's house is beautiful--open, full of wonderful art and cozy. It is in a safe neighborhood, near the subway and Prospect Park. She was a thoughtful host--I recommend her to anyone.

Our stay at Laurie's place was just perfect! We especially enjoyed the daily breakfast, the presence of the cats and the lovely neighbourhood... For more than a week, we felt like real New Yorkers! There's no reason to stay in a hotel ;)

Laurie is more than a Hostess. she is a city guide, a friend and a mother! she took care of us with so much love and she help us move around town with incredible suggestions about places to visit (like the Brooklyn Museum, forget about the MET!) and great places to eat. Her son Peter is always willing to give you a hand and her two cats are so full of love and tenderness.

The house is great, just as you see it on the photographs, which was a great relief for us.

we had a great time and we felt at home all the time.
I had great stay at Laurie's. The apartment is very nice, clean and comfortable. It's walking distance to subway, you can easily get to Manhattan. Wonderful house with very welcoming host.
Laurie's home is wonderful. quiet and clean and comfortable. She is a wealth of knowledge and fun. She was very nice/understanding when I let out the cat- but it is not recommended.
Great and quiet neighbourhood, even though it is in the middle of the heart of Brooklyn, very clean and nice atmosphere, terrific breakfast and a great host. Thank you Laurie!!!

Laurie was an excellent host! It was the perfect location for us to be able to walk everywhere and really enjoy being in Brooklyn. She had great recommendations for places to eat and things to do. We'll definitely be back. Thanks!

For me Laurie and her house was perfect. Located between the film festival I was attending and the gym, I couldn't have asked for a better location. Plus I got the use of the kitchen so I saved money by cooking for one or two meals a day. There were markets close by and even 99 cent stores for the razors, tooth brush and gym lock I forgot to bring. Laurie lent me an umbrella when I needed it. She's very cool and mothering. I also love her adorable, friendly cats, Batman and Robin. The whole experience was very relaxed and comfortable with that homey and eclectic feeling. There's wonderful art all over the house from her family and friends and a two too narrow creaky staircases which led to my adorable room. I liked the bathroom as well which allowed me good lighting to prepare for my nights out. Laurie also helped me navigate the subways with instruction and maps and recommend her friendly and efficient car service. Nearby is the Brooklyn museum which had the most awesome John Paul Gaultier fashion show and of course there's Manhattan which is incredible for exploring only a subway ride away. I hope to stay there again!

Laurie's home is warm and welcoming and so is Laurie. We liked the relaxed atmosphere, and the delicious croissants and yoghurt / cereal for breakfast every day. The house is in an elegant tree lined street close to the subway, and the cafes, food stores and interesting shops on 5th and 7th avenues. We found good coffee just round the corner at Cafe Regular on 11th st. Loved  the margaritas at Rachel's taqueria, and the jazz duo at Oliviers ...both recommended by Laurie. The F train took us directly to Manhattan. It was ideal to start our time in NY in a more low key way in Park Slope. Thank you Laurie!
Gus And Holly are really cool! The place is awesome, great location and really cool flat. great to place to explore brooklyn.

I had an amazing stay. Holly took great care of me, was available to help me with everything I needed and gave me some great restaurant tips. The apparent is beautiful and very clean. Kitchen and bathroom were perfect and available the whole time. Check and communication were very easy. And the cats were lovely too :) thank you for everything !

I had a great time at Holly and Gus' place. Well located, good local tips and the weather was great (I don't think they had a hand in that!). An ideal location for exploring the city and Williamsburg is really hip and cool.
The host canceled this reservation 13 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
This was a wonderful location in Williamsburg!  Very close to multiple transit lines, lots of great cafés, restaurants and markets.  Clean apartment and great hospitality!
A really cool place in a great location, we had a really great time here. Loved the roof!!

We had a great time at Gus and Holly's. Check-in was super easy and they are lovely hosts who made us feel comfortable in their home. The location is perfect, close to multiple subway options and many great places for coffee/food etc. Can't recommend this place enough.
Bonito piso para conocer Nueva York. Muy cerca del metro. Los anfitriones son muy correctos y además hablan español. Sin duda volvería a repetir!!
Very nice and cozy Apartment with the sweetest cat! Located next to different metro stations, restaurants and Cafés. Thank you for everything!
Great access to transportation. I would recommend this stay.

Lindo y cómodo departamento muy bien conectado. Si bien el barrio en sí no es muy atractivo, tiene algunos restaurantes y bares entretenidos cerca.
Para la época que nosotros fuimos (noviembre, mucho frío) estuvo siempre excelente de temperatura.
Punto extra para el gato Grey <3
Appartement chaleureux et idéalement bien placé !
We had a great stay at Gus and Holly's place. We highly recommend this place!
Awesome week in this beautiful apartment in Williamsburg. Gus and Holly are two awesome hosts.
So many things to say I am a grateful and happy
Lovely little place, great hosts, super location.
We loved to stay here again - felt like home.  Highly recommended.
Gus is a wonderful host, his restaurant recommendations are really helpful for us. And the cats are cute!
Gus and Holly were lovely hosts, the place was really cosy and tidy. Bed is very comfortable and location is convenient. Would definitely stay again!

Nuestra estancia con Gus y Holly fue perfecta, nos dieron muy buenas recomendaciones sobre dónde desayunar, comer, cenar y tomar algo por la zona. La parada de metro L que te lleva a Manhattan está muy cerquita y tarda apenas 15min, y la zona donde está situado es increíble, sin duda repetiria mi estancia con ellos.

Exactement conforme aux attentes. Super emplacement, super rapport qualité/prix. Petite chambre mais bien décorée, lieu accueillant, super cuisine qui donne envie de se mettre aux fourneaux (nous avons dégusté tous nos petits déjeuners chez Gus et Holly).

Excellent Airbnb experience! Great location close to subway and amazing restaurants and shops. Easy subway ride into Manhattan or to explore other parts of Brooklyn. Guss and Holly were very helpful and responded to questions quickly. Two cute cats made the stay feel just like home :) would recommend this place to anyone.

Second time staying with Gus and Holly. As usual it was fantastic with a great balance of guest communication and personal space. I loved it so much I came back twice so you will definitely love it here.

I had a great time staying here! Check in and out was super easy and the bed and pillows were so comfy! Also, the cats are absolutely adorable. I never got to meet Gus (schedules just didn't match up) but Holly was really sweet and fun to chat with. Definitely recommend staying here!

We had a great stay in Williamsburg. Gus & Holly are perfect hosts and we felt like home the moment we walked in. The apartment is located only a few stations away from Manhattan, a variety of good restaurants and coffee shops is within easy walking distance.

Posizione ottima per conoscere Williamsburg, comodo accesso alla metro per collegarsi con Manhattan. Gus ed Holly sono stati molto gentili e ci hanno lasciato grande libertà in casa anche per gli orari di check-in e checkout. Ottimi i consigli per la cena!

I enjoyed my stay at Gus’s place a lot. The location is great, it is easy to get around with multiple train lines within 10 mins walking distance. Check out time was very flexible. Would definitely recommend this place for single travelers.
Very nice people and was a convenient and clean place to stay!

We had a perfect four day stay at Laurie's wonderful Park Slope home -- close to the F Train to Manhattan, great restaurants and cafes nearby, and the world's friendliest cats.  Even found the perfect parking space right across the street!  We'll definitely be back.
Very welcoming and friendly host!

A chic stay in a conveinent location in williamsburg. 10 minutes or less to get to metro, and lots of great places to eat nearby. Holly took the time to show us the place aswell as explain how the shower works. The front door to get into the building was a bit tricky to get into but with a bit of paitence and persistance we were able to get in. Air conditoner in the room was a blessing, it helped tune out the sounds of the busy city. Would recommend!

Really nice flat, very clean and in a really nice location in Brooklyn, you have a subway stop 1 minute away to go straight to Manhattan in less than 15 minutes. Molly and Gus answer very quickly if you need anything.

Really enjoyed the stay, i recommend it 100%.
Beautiful staying, lots of local tips. Moreover hospitality and help. Worth recommended.

We loved our stay at this airbnb. Holly‘s and Gus‘s Place is very nice and in a great location. Williamsburg has many great places to have lunch our go out in the evening and you can easily get to Manhattan. Would definitely recommend this place.

We had a great stay at Gus and Holly’s place. They were really nice hosts.
We loved the location of the apartment. It is perfect for exploring the city.
The apartment is in a great location. It was very clean; Holly and Gus provided good pointers for the neighbourhood, and communication was swift and helpful. Would absolutely stay again.

We had a great time and really enjoyed coming back to Gus and Holly's apartment after exploring the city. Communication was really easy. The room is small but clean and comfortable. Great location, close to three major subway lines. Some good restaurants close by.

Very welcoming home, the perfect comfortable and relaxing environment for the busy city. Great access to Manhattan if you need but plenty of local activities too which our hosts tipped off to us. Would love to stay again.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour chez Gus & Holly. La chambre est confortable et le logement très bien situé à Brooklyn. Gus et Holly sont discrets et agréables et leur chien est très mignon.

Convenient, comfortable, cosy - Gus and Holly were wonderfully respectful hosts who gave me a wide berth of personal space (important for introverted travellers!) and offered great tips and advice when asked. Short walking distance to the metro connecting to everywhere else in NYC. Look no further!

Awesome place, with a great location.  Close to bars/restaurants and such, but most importantly the metro.  Easy access to the city.  Gus and Holly were friendly and helpful. Great hosts, highly recommended.
Great stay in a great area. Close to everything and very safe neighbourhood.  Holly and Gus are very nice and relaxed guys.
Staying here was a pleasure. The space was clean, stylish, and in a great location. I highly recommend staying with Gus. Thanks!

Perfect little place to access manhatten. The L train is a few minutes walk, and the ride to 14th st is about 10-15 mins. Place was very clean, and the hosts were very friendly, and offered the use of a well outfitted kitchen, and use of the common living room.
Bathroom and shower were clean and pleasant to use.
Holly even invited me to attend a little get together they had one nite that i was there.
For value i dont think you can beat it.

Cool place in a nice thriving neighborhood. Welcoming and friendly hosts. Easy checkin.
Highly recommended.
The room is clean, has great views. The location is very good for the deal, and the hosts are amazing!

Everything is absolutely accurate in the description and I would recommend the place without reservation. Gus and Holly are indeed a very laid back couple that are both respectful of your privacy but also friendly and conversational. They made me feel at home and I'm sure they'll make you feel welcome too.

The room and apartment were clean, well decorated, and had a better than expected supply of kitchen equipment. Additionally, the apartment has tall ceilings, plenty of sunlight, and even a dedicated area to workout with an available and legit pull-up bar.

The apartment covers the entire top floor of a multi-story building in Williamsburg and as described there's easy access to the roof -- which offers a fantastic view of the surrounding Williamsburg. It was charming to hangout out and enjoy a meal with friends up there as the sun set in the distance...

If you want to go somewhere, there are multiple subway lines within easy walking distance.

For people who may be interested:
- The outside traffic can get a little loud at night but nothing overly excessive.
- Being the top floor of a 3 story walk-up, expect to climb some stairs on a fairly regular basis...But don't worry, you get used to it and then feel like a champ in no time. ;)

Beautifully decorated house. Has all the essentials you'd need such as coffee, cooking pans and pots, spices, umbrellas, etc. I worked out of this room for a week, and WiFi worked fine for video meetings and calls!  Holly is very quick to respond and helpful, and the other roomates are also easy to live with. Only thing is there is not an elevator, so if you have a lot of suitcases like I did, bringing them up and down can be quite a workout. Thanks for the great stay!

Awesome stay that's:
- Super close to the L train
- In an awesome neighborhood with lots of amenities
- Beautiful and well-thought out
- Hosted by really sweet people

Stay here if you're genuinely trying to feel "away from home."
The best kind of people. Kind hearted, caring, wonderful humans. An absolute delight

I stayed/worked from home at Holly’s for over 20 days and I’m really happy I chose her place. She was a phenomenal host, I felt very safe and comfortable. I especially loved the coffee/espresso setup and the big windows/natural light the loft gets. Holly is quick to respond and very friendly. The location is obviously very central and close to some great restaurants and the train. Highly recommend!

Clean room and thoughtful touches in this Brooklyn apartment, I worked from here for a week no issues, enjoyed the stay bed comfy. Close to subway, ended up visiting city few times, used kitchen few times very well stocked

Gus and Holly’s home is everything I could have asked for and more! They’re home is very welcoming and beautifully decorated! Also it’s in PRIME location for you to venture around Brooklyn or neighboring boroughs either by foot or public transportation. Lovely neighborhood, amazing vibe and sooo many options for entertainment be it restaurants, bars, museums, boutiques... etc. 20/10 I would stay at Gus and Holly’s home again!

I stayed here for about a month and grew so attached to this place. Pictures truly don't do this place justice– the flat is so cozy and warm and thoughtfully decorated. Holly, Gus, and Rus were all so kind and hospitable. The amenities were amazing– my favorites were the coffee set-up, work-out room, and shower– truly the perfect place to work from home ! The location was really super, a 2 minute walk  to the L and G lines and very proximate to great shops and restaurants. Such a wonderful house, great location, and fantastic people !
Holly, Gus, and Russ are absolute legends! My only regret is that my stay with them has concluded so it’ll have to happen again.

This was a fantastic Airbnb experience. The location is perfectly placed in Williamsburg next to everything you may need or want to do — as well as within easy walking distance to several different subway stops.

Inside of the flat feels very chill and comfortable — the room is cozy, the living room has extremely comfortable couches to sit and read on, the kitchen’s amazing coffee setup is unrivaled, and having a drink on the roof and watching the sunset feels great.

Holly and Russ were amazing hosts. Communication on how to get in and out and around was flawless, and they were also super nice and fun to talk to when we happened to be in the flat at the same time.

I would 100% stay here again and recommend it to others

Staying at this airbnb for the whole month of June was truly a wonderful experience from beginning to end. I loved every moment: from the perfectly equipped and decorated space to the unbelievable location. You will be staying at a private and comfortable airbnb at the heart of Williamsburg with so many restaurants, bars and amazing nightlife nearby. Of the many highlights of this place, my favorite has to be the rooftop. I was up there every day to eat my lunch, get a break from work, and to catch the most beautiful sunsets. You can even see the NYC skyline from the distance. Also, the access to public transportation was super convenient and gets you into Manhattan in under 15 mins. The host Holly really made my stay super pleasant, she was extremely communicative and available at all times. Truly this was the most perfect month-long airbnb experience I've ever had. Would have loved to stay all summer. Highly recommend this gem of an airbnb.

Everyone was amazing ! super nice individuals. Place was great, loved the natural sunlight, the plants, and everything else the place had to offer. Will definitely be looking to stay here again in my next visit to NYC!
I loved my stay here! Gus and Holly are extremely hospitable and their home was the perfect place for my month in Brooklyn. I absolutely loved my stay here and would highly recommend it to anyone!
Jennifer is great! Love the place! East Village is amazing
Jennifer’s place is super cool and in a great location for East Village !! Very clean, welcoming and comfortable !
Very good new york experience, the east village is the best place to visit Manhattan and you can have a nightlife safety, a lot of bars and good people.

Wir haben einen tollen Aufenthalt in New York verbracht. Wir wurden von Jennifer freundlich empfangen und alles verlief problemlos und wie besprochen. Die Wohnung ist wie auf den Abbildungen, so auch das Zimmer. Es war sehr heiss während unserem Aufenthalt, daher waren wir froh um die Klimaanlage. Die Betten sind ganz bequem und Jennifer hat uns frische Handtücher bereitgelegt. Wir hatten alles was wir benötigten! Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, unweit der Metrostation 2 Av oder Delancey street. West village ist sehr empfehlenswert, mit vielen Bars und Restaurants (gut und preiswert). Wir waren sehr zufrieden mit der Unterkunft bei Jennifer!

Jennifer's place is located in a great neighborhood with lots of public art and cafes and cute little shops to wander around in. Her actual accommodations were pretty unique too; the option for two beds in a private room with availability of a washer and dryer! We had been traveling for a few days before we arrived at Jennifer's, so we were able to pack less clothing knowing that we could do some washing at her place. Jennifer was incredibly hospitable and let us use the washer and dryer right away. She also has some great art in her place.

I enjoy talking to Jennifer about life in the East Village over the years, and the General Life of a New Yorker. She definitely gave us some space but was happy to talk with us if we had questions. We would definitely stay again, thank you so much!
I really enjoyed my stay at Jennifer place. It was cozy and close to everything I needed. She was so sweet and allowed me to leave my luggage and do some laundry while staying. I would stay again.

Jennifer’s place was great! The room is bright and comfy. The neighborhood is great. I have a very light sleep so I was scared of non being able to sleep but with ear plugs no problem. Very happy there was AC in the room! I met Jennifer quickly when arriving and she was super nice.

Accessible and nice location!!! Food available infront of the apt
good experience!

還不錯的房間，不是很大，但兩個女生剛好，浴室很乾淨，離地鐵站也不遠，附近還有小超市很方便，晚上聽說會很吵，我倒是沒什麼感覺，倒是暖氣開的很足：)

A great space in a great neighborhood, right near 5th ave shops and restaurants.  My stay with Laurie was lovely -- she even made sure I had breakfast every morning before I left her house.  A clean, quiet and sun filled room were perfect after long days spent in the city.  I really enjoyed looking at the beautiful artwork on the walls, too.  Laurie is extremely knowledgable about the city and even had a list of holiday windows she recommended seeing on my trip!  I recommend this place to fellow travelers.

Laurie was a gracious hostess who not only gave us helpful tips about how to enjoy the New York experience, but also provided fresh bagels and croissants every morning.  The bedroom was clean, the neighborhood environment was quiet and safe, and the bed was very comfortable.  We stayed on the top floor of her home and shared a bath with a lovely woman and her daughter visiting from the Netherlands.  Staying with Laurie was one of the highlights of our holiday trip to New York!

Croissants, cats and comfy bed. Laurie promises the best almond croissants you've ever tasted and she delivers. Batman and Robin, the cats, will nap with you if desired. My room, overlooking the garden, had one of those foam tops so I sank into it as if embraced. Great coffee on tap. Sun pouring in through the windows overlooking the garden. Some great suggestions from Laurie - things you wouldn't find on your own. Short walk to the subway. Quiet street near lots of cafes and shops.

Laurie is friendly, kind, and an great host. I was there for work and felt completely at ease going in and out as I pleased. It was great having an opportunity to communicate and chat with the other guests from Germany and the USA. Location is awesome. Room has everything you need.

The bagels with cream cheese were awesome.

Laurie and Chavi made us feel very welcome, and the room was perfectly situated for a trip to Brooklyn. We were out nearly all of the time so did not make much use of the breakfast, but it was great to know it was available, and the whole place was very homey - a real find in Brooklyn. In particular, given the extreme weather, the room was warm, the beds were clean and comfy and the cats very welcoming too. Would recommend this room to anyone who wants a home from home experience.

Laurie she's direct and natural.. she's a good hOst ! her house in Park slOpe ,Brooklyn is really good for mind ..colors and many drawings with sun ! and a nice garden with coffee tables ...and also two cute cats ! Batman and Robin to save us in case of disaster ! thank you Laurie for this nice week in yOur lOvely hOme  !

We hebben genoten van de warme gastvrijheid van Laurie! Ze maakte tijd voor ons en haar tips hebben zeker bijgedragen aan ons heerlijke verblijf in 'the Big Apple'. Het huis staat in een prima buurt, vlakbij winkels, restaurants en metro. Wij (twee vrouwen) voelden ons veilig in de buurt en gingen dus ook zonder problemen 's avonds nog op pad voor een restaurantbezoek. Vervoer vanuit JFK naar het huis van Laurie is een dingetje. Shuttlediensten rijden niet naar Brooklyn. Openbaar vervoer vonden wij vanwege het overstappen met koffers geen goed plan. Taxibedrijf Eastern wordt door Laurie aanbevolen. Echter, je kunt alleen vooraf reserveren als je een mobiel met USA-nummer hebt. Bleef voor ons de Yellow Cab over. De Yellow Cab die wij namen gaf $62 aan op de meter, veel meer dan het vaste tarief van $35 van Eastern. Oplossing: bel als je op JFK aankomt met een public phone gratis naar Eastern via 1-866-499-7177. Dan zou een taxi na ongeveer 20 minuten arriveren. Weer even bellen als het wat langer duurt. Wel goed aangeven waar je staat :-). Verder adviseer ik de minder mobiele gasten het appartement te huren in de souterrain. De andere twee kamers zijn namelijk op zolder en daarvoor moet je 2,5 flinke steile trappen op. Alles bij elkaar zijn we erg enthousiast over ons verblijf bij Laurie: we komen graag terug!

Great location in the East Village. Jennifer was great with communication and check in and the apartment was clean. The room was small, but fine for a short stay in NY where you’re out most of the time. We didn’t have any issues with noise which was a plus!

A pretty fair place to stay for the price in NYC. A fresh coat of paint would make all the difference.  Honestly it didn't bother me all that much, but I know it might for some.  The door handle should certainly be fixed though, no security from other guests.
Endroit bien situé dans Manhattan, une bonne épicerie pas loin mais pas vraiment ambiance village, métro assez proche.

The room in clean and located in a small but nice apartment full of music. There are many restaurants in the neighborhood, and the subway is very close.
Jennifer is very nice and helpful. We have enjoyed the place and the host and we went out one night and we had a best time.
Great place, perfect location in the lower east side! 👍🏻

Le logement de Jennifer est situé dans un quartier très vivant. il y a de nombreux restaurants, bars et magasins. Bref, si vous recherchez un logement aseptisé de type IKEA, passez votre chemin. Si vous recherchez un logement simplement pour dormir, c'est possible.

Ubytování bylo v pohodě, nebylo nijak luxusní, ale je naprosto dostačující pro lidi, kteří jedou poznat město, takže jim stačí místo pro odpočinek a hygienu. Die Lage des Apartments ist super (:

Great place for location and access to everything in Manhattan to use as a base.  However, if your looking for a place to relax while in NYC this isn't for you.  Jennifers place was quirky and small but while I was in NYC with my aunt, it could have done with a good clean before we arrived.
Jennifer is a great host, her place has a really good vibe and has a great location for exploring the East Village and Lower East Side.  We loved our stay there.
A great place in a great location close to 2nd Av station and Delancey/Essex station! Also walkable to SoHo!
Creo que el espacio es justo para dos personas y poco equipaje. El departamento está muy cerca de las zonas de interés común eso es muy bueno.

Jennifer war sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Handtücher und Bettwäsche waren sauber. Allerdings wirkte die Wohnung insgesamt etwas ungepflegt und dadurch schmuddelig. Trendy area, very walkable to everything we wanted to visit. Didn’t spend much time in the Airbnb so it’s a great place if you’re just looking for a comfortable, safe, and affordable place to lay your head. Mark was kind helpful and made us feel comfortable during our stay.

Great area and the hosts were extremely accommodating!

This is meant as constructive criticism & not mean-spirited: Jennifer, Mark, & Olive all seemed like nice people; although the listing mentions only 1 roommate, not 3-4 (there were 4 people one morning). I wouldn’t have booked this if I knew I’d be sharing a small apt. & 1 bathroom w/ 4 people. The bedroom was also very cluttered w/minimal space to put personal items. The heat in the bedroom didn’t work. This place is amazing, easy to walk every where to neighbourhood is nice no matter the hour you walk around. Adequate spot if you need a place to lay your head and freshen up. Space was good enough for 2 people and the location was a close walk to subways. I would consider staying here again if we visit NYC soon.

Jennifer’s place is an amazing location, I was in town for a week long training that was a few blocks away. There are so many things to do in the neighborhood. I had a lot of privacy during my stay. Thanks for a great stay!

Excellent location in a great part of Williamsburg, right next to stops on the L (into Manhattan) and G lines, and a short walk to the J/M train. Holly and Russ were excellent hosts, very helpful, and the apartment was a friendly and sunlit place to stay! Would recommend :)

Amazing location! It’s super close to Manhattan by subway and there are many station around. It feels very safe to walk around, even at night. Easy check in and check out. Room exactly as seen on pics. If you need anything just ask Gus or Holly.

La maison est magnifique et le roof top est vraiment un plus. Le quartier est vraiment sympa et il permet d’accéder très facilement à Manhattan. Holy est une hôtesse incroyable. La maison est vraiment accueillante et on y est comme à la maison. Hâte de revenir !
Great place to stay in a good location. Easy going people and a good set up to work remotely. Would definitely recommend.

Great room, great location in an awesome neighborhood, and of course, great people. Thanks for everything, Holly and Gus!

No problems. Hubert was friendly and everything worked fine. The location was great!

Hubert is such a nice host! The appartment is a really good place to stay, with a very good location (very close to subway, times square and central park) and the room is large enough for 2 girls and their NYC shopping!
We really recommend this place!
Enjoy your time in NYC at Hubert's place ;)

cozy and warm in the good location. jennifer is a great host

Her bathroom was beautiful and the shower was a pleasure.  The bedroom was tight for two but we expect that in NYC.  One traveler would have more room to spread out.  Heed Jennifer's warnings re street noise and wear your earplugs!  Thank you for allowing us to stay at your place, Jennifer.
Jennifer apartment is very well located. Although the space is a bit tiny, I had a very nice stay as I was by myself. Jennifer is a good host and was always available. Would recommend.

Jennifer was very very fast to reply and easy to communicate with.  She was very accommodating and made me feel like we knew each other in a really pleasant well.  I felt very good there and had great confidence in the space.  I’d be back there when I come to New York next.
Great location close to museums, restaurants and landmarks. Comfortable and clean.

Great location for money. Jennifer was very flexible and discreet - we've hardly seen her around. Nice and clean bathroom. One must admit though that the room is very small, hard to stay for 2 people, and not perfectly clean. But other than that I highly recommend.

Jennifer is very quick at responding to any questions and very welcomining. The apartment is very well located and it is ideal for solo travelers that plan to stay in the city for short period of time
Un appartement globalement correct pour dormir. La communication à été très bonne. l'hôte est très gentille et serviable. Pour le prix, ça vaut le coup. Merci beaucoup.

I had a great stay at Jennifer's apartment. The room was clean and neat. I had a lot of privacy. Also the bathroom was fine with a nice shower. I didn't use the kitchen, but it looked good.
