Jennifer is an amazing host. Very helpful, communicative and friendly. The flat itself is a very good size, cosy, comfy and amazing location. Worth every penny.

Jennifer is really great. She's the first person I reach out to when I know I'm coming back to New York to stay. Great location and Jennifer is really nice, communicative and very kind. I always will reach out to her first when coming to NYC.

Very little space as the ad states, but the location is perfect, the host is wonderful, the beds were cozy, walk to everything. For two adults it’s a little small, unless you are ok with a single bed plus a pullout bed. But it’s located great close to everything and the host is the most hearty and understanding person I ever met. She helped us to find a solution. Jenny is great <3
Great stay.lovely host and wonderful location. I recommend 👌🏾

We hebben een fijne tijd gehad in New York/Brooklyn. Het mooie huis van Laurie ligt in een rustige buurt met volop restaurantjes op loopafstand. De subway is binnen 10 minuten te bereiken. Tevens is er een mooi park in de buurt. De twee persoonskamer met gedeelde badkamer was prima. Groot genoeg voor twee personen. Laurie was erg behulpzaam en had vele goede tips over New York en Brooklyn. En de poezen waren gezellig aanwezig.

Laurie was awesome! Gave great directions, was communicative and honest about the place. The room was as described and the beds were comfy. The neighbourhood is beautiful and has a lot of cute restaurants, shops and dwellings.

The perfect experience: very clean (amazing shower- hot and powerful), very well situated, extremely generous host, very beautiful home. We feel already a bit nostalgic, loved the cats, the garden, the delicious teas and enormous toasts for breakfast. Also, not only will Laurie happily explain how to get around, but she will provide excellent addresses for food and good tips for cultural outtings. Full library of New York magazines, guides, as well as lots of flyers to guide you around this very nice area and generally NYC. She really does a lot to help you and it makes it so unique. So cool about the open flexible check-in check-out time: no arrival time plus we could leave our bags for the day of our departure and , and it helped a lot. Thank you for everything Laurie!

We had a great week at Lauries. The house was very homey and the bedroom very comfortable. Laurie also provides some breakfast in the mornings, to fuel up for a days sightseeing. The two cats will also be there to keep you company!

Brooklyn is a great place to visit and you could easily spend a week alone just seeing that district. Luckily Laurie was able to provide us with some great suggestions which were well worth listening to!

The house is close to great bars and restaurants on 5th ave and a number of subway lines only a few minutes walk away. We were lucky enough to catch the nyc marathon whilst we were there and enjoyed the rest of the city too!

Thanks Laurie for a great trip!

I booked this pretty place for four nights and ended up staying five.  I really enjoyed myself there and felt very comfortable.  Laurie was very accommodating while my plans kept changing--first there were two of us coming, then just one, then whoops, two for a while, just one for the rest, etc.  The house looks exactly as depicted--pretty, full of light, full of color, and full of interesting things collected with an artist's eye.  I really enjoyed the illustrations from famous children's book authors, including Laurie's own father.  The bed was very comfortable, the water pressure great, everything clean and nicely thought out.  Laurie is very interesting and I really enjoyed my conversations with her.  Oh and the house is just a few blocks to the subways that go into Manhattan quickly and easily.  There is also lots to explore in the pretty neighborhood (good food too, which Chavi and Laurie can point you toward). My partner and I recently spent 6 nights at Myung's. Our stay was fabulous - more than I could have hoped for! I completely agree with all the positive comments of the previous reviewers. Myung was very professional and responsive in all communications. She left us a wonderful welcome basket of breakfast items and an array of organic teas and coffees. The kitchen is well-equipped. Her apartment is spacious and comfortable with an amazing and delightful view of the Manhattan skyline from the bedroom and living room windows. It is across from a grade school in a safe and very quiet neighborhood. We were able to park our car on the street below during our entire stay. NOTE: buy 7 day unlimited Metro/bus pass for $27). The apartment was spotlessly clean and meticulously tidy. The bedroom is large with ample closet and storage space and a convenient desk. The queen bed is one of the most comfortable I have ever slept in! The curtains block out light and it is very quiet at night. We were provided with extra sheets and numerous sets of luxurious towels. Big TV and lots of stations in living room. CDs and DVDs with player in bedroom. WiFi worked well. The shower has great pressure, lots of hot water instantly. Hair dryer and iron available. Myung was completely respectful of our privacy. We only saw her on a couple of days when we were home and we were completely alone after 5 or 6pm. There is a lock for the bedroom door but we felt no need to use it. Even if you are thinking you would like to stay in Manhattan, as I originally did, do not hesitate to stay here! I hope to do so again.

And just around the corner on Manhattan Avenue there are lots of restaurants, groceries (even organic!) and many more shopping facilities.
The suite was very neat, anything provided you need (even very tasty coffee and tea!) and the bed is sooo comfy! There is also a possibility for making barbecue and enjoy your meal on the big terrace.
I've showed this apt to some of my NYC friends and they were blown away, saying this is the coolest hotel they've ever seen!
Dana and his crew are also really nice and cool! I could leave my luggage at the hotel after check out because I had a very late flight. And even the lobby was already closed on that sunday night, one of the staff members came over to let me in and get a cab to the airport. Thank you all and I hope to be back very, very soon!!! :)
Great location. Close to subway to Manhatten but situateed in a great location in Brooklyn

The entire box house hotel team was awesome, always willing to help and made the stay that much easier and better. The hotel is great and location is awesome. Next time I'm in the big apple I'm definitely staying there again.

Magnificent staff, even more beautiful in person. The amenities (shuttle service, concierge, zone lighting, coffee and fresh fruit) have made the box house our first choice for return visits. Slept four comfortably. Thank you to the personal touch by the staff. This is Brooklyn's best kept secret.

What a wonderful treasure the Box House Hotel is.  We had a wonderful three day stay and enjoyed every minute.  The staff went above and beyond to insure that we had a pleasant vacation.   The room was so light, bright and spacious.  We enjoyed dinner at the nearby Glasserie and coffee at several places on Manhattan Avenue. And of course the highlight was several fun rides in the Checker.  The only down side was the stairs to get to the room.  We were all OK with that, but for some people this could be a challenge. We will be surely  be returning to the Box House in the FUTURE!
The reservation was canceled 5 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Love the friendly staff and the very clean property. A home away from home!  Look forward to my next visit.

Had a great stay at the Box House. Stayed in the Duplex with Terrace which had lots of space. The kitchen is nice to have. Have seen lots of comments regarding noise in various stays around the city and can say that this room was very quiet. You may feel a slight rumble from the subway once in a while, but street noise was very limited. Close walking distance to mostly everything I’m Greenpoint. Close subway into Manhattan. Cafes and restaurants are close. Staff are all very friendly. Will stay here for future NY trips.
Fantastic stay. Will stay again.
Amazing stay!

Mycket trevligt boende på lagom avstånd från Manhattan. Lugnt och trevligt område med nära till restauranger och butiker när man inte orkar ta sig in till kaoset i stan. Fint bemötande och två härliga katter. Härlig trädgård för frukost med extra njutning.

Laurie var en jättebra värdinna och man kände sig varmt välkommen i huset. Rummet var fantastiskt vackert och bekvämt och vi hade allt vi behövde. Laurie hade bra tips och idéer om attraktioner, barer, restauranger och affärer som man kunde besöka både i Brooklyn och på manhattan som hon delade med oss. Jag och min sambo hade en underbar vistelse i Brooklyn. Huset är oerhört vackert och bra standard och beläget i ett vackert område nära till restauranger och barer! Vi rekommenderar varmt att stanna hos Laurie i Brooklyn.

Fantastic accommodation and not far from bubbling Brooklyn activity. Short walk across the bridge to the 7 line, bit of a walk to the G line, but good exercise.

Dana was always available for the odd question. If you don't mind how the area appears (and its improving) this is the place for you. Very comfortable and safe. When we come to new York again this is where we are staying.....nowhere else.

Un loft très agréable avec une vue magnifique. Le personnel d'accueil est efficace et courtois, une bonne adresse à 15 min du centre de manhattan.
Les moins: le bruit du frigo très bruyant surtout la nuit, l'équipement de la cuisine un peu léger, un ménage assez mal fait à notre arrivée (des miettes par terre), et du bruit mais un défaut inhérent à New York je pense.
Cependant il ne s'agit pas de défaut insurmontable et pour ceux que ca ne dérange pas de marcher 10 min le matin pour rejoindre la station de métro à 1 station de gran central, le séjour y sera agréable a un prix bien moindre que dans manhattan.
I have nothing but good things to say about The Box Hotel. Great place. Great neighborhood. Beautiful terrace with stunning view of Manhattan. I will definitely stay there again.

A delightful stay in a sun-drenched, spacious loft with terrace and Manhattan views. A home away from home. After having spent a week in a Manhattan hotel, moving to The Box House provided a peaceful break. The minor renovations being undertaken had little impact on my 9 day stay. I would have stayed longer if the room had been available. The purpose of my visit to NY was to spend time with my son who lives in Williamsburg. In this spacious apartment, we were able to spend time together to talk or share a meal in comfort. The 'zero tolerance to noise' policy was appreciated, as was the free local transportation.

After staying here for 9 nights I would recommend it to anyone, and will.

The staff were fantastic, the doormen Christian, Singh and Felix were particularly helpful as were all of the reception staff.

Great location, excellent facilities and I will definitely return to the Box House Hotel!

This a great place to stay!  The hotel is gorgeous and so so clean, the rooms spacious, the drinks at the bar supper yummy and everyone strives to make sure you have the perfect visit, from the front desk to the drivers who are cheerful and happily take you and pick you up from your excursions.  Special shout out to housekeeping, I inadvertently left a load of white shirts that I planned to take to my daughter's apartment for washing, which apparently got caught up in the sheets when the room was made.  These came back to me cleaned and pressed from housekeeping with a sweet apology, which was entirely my fault!  We will definitely be back and plan on making this our go to place every time we come out to Long Island City!  Book your hotel here, you will not be disappointed!
Definitely boutique
The Box House is a cute and clean hotel in fantastic Greenpoint. Great stay.
Convenient location, helpful friendly desk
Was there for a wedding had a great time

Spacious lovely room, clean kitchen/bathroom, easy access to subway station, various restaurants/shops around, and what is more, Myung is a wonderful host.  I really enjoyed talking with her although we didn't have so many chances to chat.  Her place made me feel like I'm living in NYC, absolutely great experience!

Me and my sister had the best time staying with Myung, she was the nicest host who was always thinking of us, buying us some food in the fridge for when we arrived as well as cookies during the stay! It was so nice to be able to come back from a day out in Manhattan to a nice quiet area where we were sure to get a goods night sleep. The next time we're in NY we'll be in touch to stay here again :)

Myung's apartment was the perfect place for our time in New York. The neighbourhood felt very safe when walking back late at night and it is a 2 minute walk to the subway station which takes you directly into Manhatten. It is only 5 or so stops to Times Square and trains are very frequent.
Myung was very accommodating with checking us in and out, and stocked the fridge for our arrival with basics which was very kind.
The bedroom is huge and comfortable, which was great as we were there for a week and meant we could unpack etc.
We would recommend Myung's place for people wanting somewhere to stay in New York. It is amazing value for money and has everything you would want.

Myung is a great host and her apartment is clean and lovely. The location is great, in safe and beautiful neighborhood, close to subway (2 blocks away). We have a wonderful stay and will def. go back next time. Thanks Myung :D

Myung is such a great and sweet host. Her place is clean and is exactly as pictured. Her apartment is in a great location! About 15 mins to Times Square. I would definitely stay at her place again.

Thanks Myung for being a wonderful host!!

My stay in Myung's room was ideal..She is very welcoming, making sure I had everything I would need, that I was comfortable, satisfied, and always there to answer any questions..She is very quiet and discreet which suited me perfectly. She works from home and sometimes I would not even noticed that she had left...
The room is large, fabulous mattress, well lit, facing west, the sunset and the Manhattan skyline in the distance...it is just like in the picture..The 2 large windows can be easily opened and closed and the shades be pulled down to keep the room cooler if needed..I was there in April when the central heating was on the whole time ,and therefore the room was very warm..The bedroom overlooks the public school playground which is also used by the community to play basketball or just bring the young ones who can use the playground equipment even evenings and weekends..
Myung provides you with your own minifridge in the kitchen and that makes life extremely easy..Your really feel at home.
All the rooms are kept extremely clean and it was no problem for me to keep them that way by participating in daily upkeep as I do at home either in the kitchen or the bathroom..
The apt building is superbly maintained by the superintendent, clean and quiet, very safe , located just 2 blocks from a clean laundromat, 3 blocks from the 7 train into Manhattan and 4 blocks from a larger supermarket..both Queens Blvd and Greenpoint Blvd are easily and safely accessible, a multitude of ethnic restaurants, cafe, convenience stores, fast food, banks, the local library etc..It is also right around the corner from the Saturday Farmer's Market on Skillman Ave with more choices to find places to eat or hangout...Excellent location indeed..More expensive than some others in the same area but you get a quality experience..For sure this was my favorite airbnb room so far... Convenient, Clean , Private, Comfortable and Quiet..Very homey..I highly recommend Myung's room to anyone and would most definitively book with her again..
Thanks for a lovely stay Myung..

Being a first time solo traveller, Myung's home was a great place for me to rest at the end of the night, as I had the place to myself, I had a mini fridge which was filled with a welcome package with jam,eggs,milk&bread which I was grateful for & the fridge was great to store my food however the freezer compartment didn't keep anything frozen properly so bear that in mind for the hot summer. The kitchen was equipped well enough to cook every night and there were a nice range of coffees & tea. The areas were overall clean, however during my stay a couple of mice found there way into the apartment which has yet to be resolved. Majority of the time I was there the wifi was down and as a person who works a lot online this was inconvenient for me, Myung gave me a small refund for the inconvenience and a new modem was put in a couple days before I left. The location was convenient, safe and close to the subway, grocery store and laundry mat. Overall I felt comfortable during my stay and would have happily stayed longer, initially I planned to stay longer May 12th-July16th however plans had changed and I gave 30days notice (airbnb change of reservation policy requirement) for change of dates so i could travel and explore other locations however the policy did not suit Myung so I had the option to leave 4days later or leave on the 12th July. I cut my trip short in NY and left early as staying until the 12th would have not allowed me to travel to other cities to explore, because we mutually agreed to the check out time i did not have to pay for the penalty however if you ever did want to change your reservation dates she will have the option to apply the penalty of 30days if you wanted to leave earlier(before the 30day policy) if you dont mutually agree on the date. Overall Myung was kind and i love the keyring she gave me as a parting gift. i would be happy to stay again.
The host canceled this reservation 50 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

A great stay at Myung’s place!! Super clean and everything is well organized, big bedroom with queen bed, closet, sofa bed, study desk, mirror, storage drawer, plants🌵🍃...and more! You’re all set when you first arrive!! Definitely recommended!
The bedroom is way more spacious than what’s shown in the photo. Myung is flexible, friendly, and responsive. Would choose her apartment again.

I couldn't have wished for better landlords. Very friendly and very quick to answer any queries I had. The apartment was in a decent area of town, very close to the subway links into Manhattan, and was a very nice furnished apartment with cable TV and internet for a price that was incredibly reasonable.

All in all, I couldn't have had a more comfortable stay in New York. Thank you guys very much. I will remember you for the next time I'm back in the US.

I recently booked an entire apartment from Renee and Sergei (August 22-27th) I was very pleased with the location in the heart of Brooklyn. You get a real flavour for the area as opposed to being in a hotel

Upon my arrival l found the apartment to be very clean with all the amenities as described in the listing. The apartment is only a few blocks from the Nostrand Subway Station. The building was very quiet which l appreciated after a long day site seeing etc....

I would book this apartment if travelling to New York again. Cant say enough on how easy going Renee and Sergei are to deal with.

Can't say enough wonderful things about this space. Luxuriously huge, absolutely spotless, incredibly comfortable. Renee was very available and ensured we had everything we needed. She's thought of every detail and hasn't cut a single corner, everything was very high-end.

The neighborhood is very vibrant and exciting and we felt very safe. Our temporary neighbors were all warm and friendly. It's a short trip into Manhattan by public transit or by bike.

Staying here really added something special to our trip to NYC and we will certainly stay here when visiting again.

What a FANTASTIC experience!  This was our first time trying Airbnb.....Renee and her husband were very kind, friendly and  accommodating host.  The apartment turned out to be much more than we expected, extremely clean, spacious, convenient, comfortable with all ammentities provided, WE ABSOLUTELY LOVED IT!  The neighborhood was exceptionally quiet and friendly with easy access to transportation and many attractions.  Our stay consisted of five (5) nights and left with WONDERFUL thoughts of wanting to return soon.  We would highly recommend staying at this location in Brooklyn!  Thanks Renee and Sergei!

The place is better than an executive suite in a 3-star hotel. It is spacious, homey, and very functional with Renee's thoughtful & tasteful deco. The kitchen and the washer/dryer are very handy. Renee has been very responsive to email, and kept plenty of supplies travelers need. The place is located in an genuine Brooklyn residential area; takes 10 minutes walk to the A/C subway; another 15 min. to Manhattan.

Great place!  We found it an impeccably clean, cozy, and spacious retreat for our family of four when the building we live in was undergoing repairs. Ellis & Sherry are attentive and gracious hosts, and the place has all the comforts of home - great books, fully stocked kitchen, and if you've got kids, they'll love the stash of toys.  Our three year old also loved the child's bed -- he keeps asking when we can go back to our "other house."

We just had a fantastic stay in this Park Slope brownstone. Ellis and Sherry welcomed us warmly, and we were made to feel at home right away. The home is just as pictured and described, but actually, better! It is very easy to feel you have been living there for years. The beds are super comfortable, the kitchen well stocked, and plenty of kitchen staples such as spices and the like available for use. The garden out back is a welcome treat in New York, and the entire home is very peaceful, especially at night. Yet steps away are many shops and eateries, coffee shops and two nearby subway lines. This place was also perfect for family needs, (we were traveling with teens, and each could have a space of their own to recharge at the end of a long day.) Thanks for a fantastic stay....we hope to be back.

Ellis was a great host and gave us a great tour of the place. The neighborhood near is rampant with fantastic places to dine and grab a tasty beverage. There is a perfectly cromulent market nearby as well.

Everything was clean and there was plenty of space for members of our party to have a little personal time throughout our journey. Would definitely stay again.

Thanks.

We had a wonderful one-week stay at this spacious home!  Pictures and description are very apt.  We traveled here as a group of 6, and found the apartment very comfortable and roomy (we had 3 small kids, my mother, and my husband and I).  Ellis and Sherry made us feel so at home, from the time they greeted us, to the time they bid us farewell.  If we had any questions or concerns, we could always call or email them, and they were so quick to respond.  They had some great tips for restaurants, transportations, how/when to go to certain points of interest, etc (and they were just fun to chat with, in general).  The home is only a couple blocks from two subway stations that took us to pretty much all our destinations, right around the corner from wonderful cafes and restaurants (try the bakery literally down the street on the corner, as well as the coffee roasters down the street toward the opposite corner).  Great shopping surrounds this place, too!  Prospect Park is a moderate walk from the doorstep.  The other great thing is that this place has it all, amenities-wise!  Having a washer/dry at our disposal was a godsend with three messy kids ;)  I also got to leave my hair dryer and iron at home.  Just ask before you come, they probably have it on hand, which makes traveling much lighter!  I should've asked about a pack'n'play, strollers, and noise machines fro sleeping, because they had that, too.  My only word of caution would be if you have children under the age of 3: there is a drop off from the kitchen to the basement stairs (aka there is no railing, and no way to put a gate up to block the entrance to those stairs).  We have a one-year old, so we did a makeshift block out of overturned chairs.  While not ideal, it worked in a pinch.  There were also exposed wires and rocks/shells at toddler eye-level (not actual hazards for older kids/adults, but a bit of problem for small hands and mouths).  Certainly didn't detract from hour great the apartment was, just kept us on our toes more.  The mattresses were so comfy, the place very clean, the books on the bookshelves and toy supply downstairs very abundant--you couldn't ask for much more!  There is even a small outdoor garden space that our kids loved exploring.  All in all, a wonderful and superior alternative to staying in a hotel with a larger group.  Would totally recommend this place, the gracious hosts, and the area.  Hopefully we will be back (my six-year-old is already asking to return).  Thanks for everything!

Ellis' Park Slope home was perfect, more than we could've hoped for. I stayed there for three nights with my family of 5 and we were all comfortable and had plenty of space. It's a cozy, homey place to stay. The backyard was nice for reading and drinking tea. The beds were comfortable with quality mattresses. Ellis himself was very friendly and accommodating and available if we needed anything. I had work in Manhattan and my parents went to a Broadway show. This was all very convenient via the nearby R-line, which got us around without any transfers. We'd definitely stay again and recommend it highly.

Ellis is a wonderful host; he is welcoming and kind and has a detailed manual about the house, the neighborhood, and any service you might need while visiting Park Slope. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable; Ellis keeps the home very clean (and we were so grateful!) The neighborhood is very safe and a nice mix of family homes, some great bars and cafes, and quaint shops. We felt safe walking back at night. We would love to stay here again.

Ellis and Sherry's home was perfect for our stay in Brooklyn. The house is very comfortable and well equipped. The beds were very comfortable and Sherry was very happy for us to move some of the beds around to accommodate the kids. We have 4 children aged from 2-6yrs. The basement was full of toys which was fantastic entertainment for the kids.
Park Slope is a great neighbourhood with everything at your fingertips. There is a fantastic playground just 4 or 5 blocks up 5th Avenue and, of course, Prospect Park only 3 blocks away too. The area was quiet in the evenings but full of life and buzzing during the day. The subway is just a few blocks away. Having 4 kids, this was a major plus for us. We didn't want to have to walk too far to public transport. Overall we highly recommend Ellis and Sherry's home and would definitely stay there should we return to NYC.

Ellis made us feel welcome, before we arrived and once we were there. He was easy to reach and communicate with, and offered to help with anything we needed. The apartment was perfect for our group of 5 adults and 1 infant (in fact we were delightfully surprised by finding lots of children's books and toys on site, and Ellis kindly offered other baby equipment if we wanted to use them). The house was well supplied and attractive; the living room and kitchen on the ground floor and the two bedrooms upstairs were light and airy. The third bedroom was in the basement and ok for the youngest pair of adults. The location of the house was fabulous - right in Park Slope, with tons of coffee shops, restaurants, markets and shops within easy walking distance. We were delighted with our stay and are happy to recommend it enthusiastically. We hope to return in the future. Thanks, Ellis!

wonderful apartment! more than we expected for the money. very spacious and nice furnished. everything was there for us, washing machine and dryer, brand new kitchen furniture, huge bedroom. if we ever return to NY, we will for sure stay there! it is better than a hotel room. we strongly recommend it!

We stayed at the Maslikhov's apartment September 21-27. Our stay at this apartment had its good and bad points. I'll start with the positive...This is a very good size apartment, large for NYC standards. There had been obvious attention to cosmetic touches and the apartment was very clean upon arrival. They had also provided laundry soap, dryer sheets and bleach for use with the washer/dryer combo.
Now to the negative...We happened to come shortly after a bad storm in Brooklyn. Thus when we arrived there was no power. It did come on later that evening. The next morning the power had to be cut off around 9am. It was on later that evening. Then the third morning the power was off when we got up and we were unable to get ready for the day in traditional fashion. So I had to go out in NYC without being able to do my hair. All you guys reading this will not understand that but you ladies know how frustrating that can be... I realize that this was out of the Maslikhov's control but would have like the option to find different accomadations since they had been dealing with this for over a week.
There is a window ac unit in the bedroom and the living room. The bedroom unit did not work for four out of seven nights of our stay. During our stay it was in the high 80's so that made it uncomfortable to sleep. As a side point, the bed is very noisy and my husband and I ended up sleeping one on the bed and one on the couch. That may not be an issue for you. When I did laundry on the second night the dryer was not putting out heat only air and the clothes would not dry. This was corrected by the last few days of our stay. It is important b/c you only have two towels for the apartment and if you are staying for a week you will want to wash them. You should also know that no matter how small of a load you wash the washer will make a loud knocking noise and the host will ask you not to let that happen.
This was my first experience renting an apartment for vacation. The price was good but in the future I will pay more and stay in a hotel.

What a beautiful place, luckily i was able to snap it up at a lower price. So it was even more worth it. My fiance and I stayed over from the 27th Sept to 4th Oct and we had such a wonderful stay @ Renee's. The pictures are what you can expect from the place. Renee greeted us upon arrival, showed us where everything was and explained how to get on wifi which we used every day! There's a grocery store nearby where my fiance and I did our weekly shopping from. The kitchen had all basic essentials. Plus point is there is a washer and dryer. AC located in living room as well as bed room which kept the house cool during hot days. Bathroom was up to scratch. Lovely window which looks into the sky. The room was spacious we had enough storage place for our luggage and a place to put our things. Both rooms have a fan so thats great to use when the AC gets too cold!!

Cons of the apartment; The stair case- each step you take squeaks as you walk up, i always walked up slowly hoping i dont disturb Renee as we go in and out the Apartment. 2nd) the TV. I cant remember the last time i watched TV from a CRT TV since flat screen was introduced - so it was quite strange. I would def recommend investing on a budget flat screen and have a DVD player. There were nights when we had come in early due to the rain and it wouldv been great to watch a movie rather then watching regular TV.

Apart from that our stay was perfect. If i came down to NY i would def stop by Renee's again if i could. its a 5 min walk to the Metro which takes you straight into NY in 15 minutes!

Overall, Renee was very welcoming, so was her husband. We had a few concerns and we were able to communicate these with Renee right away. Renee saw to our questions immediately. We enjoyed our stay and i would love to come back!

Oct 5th was my first time meeting Renee; but i felt like i already knew her (she is very good on following up with you via email once you shown interest in the apartment and will answer any questions you may have prior to your arrival).  She is warm, inviting and very accommodating.  (i called her because i needed a coke screw and she immediately went out and purchased one for me!) The apartment is bright, sunny and full of so much light its very clean and well kept; and you can tell that she put so much love into the decor. I only stayed for one night; but I highly recommend this beautiful safe haven to anyone.  The photos only give you half of the story; it is a lovely place to stay. And i plan to rent again from her in the near future.

This apartment is perfect! So big and so clean, and nicely decorated. The street it is on is quiet and very pretty. I only wish I could have stayed longer!

Thanks, Renee :)

Having this elegant apartment all to ourselves was really wonderful. It seemed cleaner and quieter than a lot of hotels I've been to. The queen size mattress is covered in plastic which makes for a sweaty night if the room isn't cold enough but otherwise pretty comfortable, with plenty of pillows. I was pleased with all the towels and wash cloths provided.

Our only snag was the early check-in. We arrived on the red-eye and had arranged to leave our luggage in the morning but when we arrived and stood outside the building no one would answer the phone. So we dragged our luggage all over Brooklyn that day until we could finally check in at 4pm. Renee told me later that we should have rung the bell even though it was 8:30am. We'll know better next time. :)

I had a great time in the BIG APPLE this past weekend and the appartment we stayed at was just what we needed. It is spotless clean and bright!  I was there with my 2 children and we were impress by the organization: all in place, instructions for key things (internet, recycling, etc). Rennee and Sergei were very kind and it is obvious the do put a lot of care to these properties. With respect to area:  I would recommed taking A subway line to Manhatthan as it is express (C is not and takes forever) and for a nice early morninig breakfast I would walk west on Jefferson to go down on Norstrand to stop by Delia's ... AmAzInG food!!!  If a place to eat is not your interest, then I'd recommend to get to Norstrand using Marcy south/north and fulton est/west.

Tasteful and spacious apartment, fully equiped, spotless clean, situated in a working class, black neighborhood. Ten minutes walk to an express train subway station.
Renee and husband made sure that we had everything.

Highly recommend this accommodation. Laurie was soo accommodating, lovely and helpful. Her home is beautiful full of character and great Neighborhood. Close to metro with optional routes to get home (Laurie went over the maps and option with me upon arrival). Prospect park, botanical garden, cafes and resturants close by. Really enjoyed our stay.

Laurie's place is the best that i had on airbnb. The room was cozy, clean and very comfortable. The house is big and you have your own privacy. Laurie is very welcome and willing to share her knowledge about whatever you need. the neighborhood is safe and got everything, with cool coffee and shops around. i really enjoy there and think this place is great for a long period

The apartment was brilliant for having two small kids.  Spacious and with loads of toys for them to play with and a little garden.  The location is perfect. In the heart of park slope, and Ellis was so helpful before we arrived and getting us set up (& even helping us retrieve a suitcase we left behind!).

Estuvimos 6 días en casa de Ellis con nuestros 3 hijos y fue una gran experiencia. El lugar es amplio, muy acogedor y completamente equipado, incluso con patio y parrilla lo que en NY es realmente un lujo. El barrio es encantador y de fácil acceso al metro. Muy recomendable para familias!

Sherri and Ellis welcomed us and allowed us to come by earlier than planned.  That was a big help.  They were available during our stay too.  The apartment is comfy and rooms big.  The bedrooms are air conditioned so sleeping in Brooklyn in August was fine.  I would suggest an AC unit on the first floor - living room and kitchen - as we really liked to relax on that floor.

The neighborhood is the nicest in Brooklyn. Close to lots of restaurants and stores. It's about a 10 minute walk to Prospect Park, 15 to the Brooklyn Museum and 5 to the subway station that takes you into Manhattan.

The space is two floors plus a couple beds in the finished basement. It's very comfortable. The beds were great (memory foam) and the bedrooms were dark and quiet. We slept great.

The hosts were in another living space in the building so it was easy to ask for eating and traveling recommendations, which they appropriately gave.

I would stay in this unit again as it provides convenient access to many NYC sites in a comfortable, safe and historic location.

Ellis' place was the perfect fit for our family (kids, parents, grandparent). There was so much space and we had everything we needed for our five day stay. The kids (4 and 2) loved the toys and books and backyard. The kitchen was well stocked and spacious, and the bedrooms were beautiful. The location is in the middle of park slope with lots of playgrounds, restaurants and shops. Easy access to the subway at Union and 4th to get into Manhattan. We had a great stay!

My family and I had a wonderful time while staying in Brooklynn at Ellis' place. Subway station was close by and amazing food around the neighborhood. My only complaint was that we found 2 cockroaches inside the bathroom sink upstairs. Other than that, no complaints.

This is a nice big place and was perfect for our extended family's stay in Brooklyn. Everything you need is only steps away and it's a super family-friendly neighbourhood. My parents loved all of the interesting books on the shelves, my kids loved all the toys and the private backyard, and my partner and I loved the generous master suite. Great trip.
Ellis's apartment is fantastic for a family stay. It's a great space in a convenient location. Thank you!

We stayed with some friends - all 30s professionals- for a weekend. We were attending a wedding at The Bellhouse in Gowanus. The house was spacious, surface cleaned, and the location cannot be beat. We didn't bring our children on the trip but this location and house would be very family friendly. There is a nice park/splash pad nearby and it is very close to Prospect park. There was a plethora of food/cocktail options closeby as well.
Just a lovely neighborhood. Very close to shops, restaurants, a beautiful park, a Catholic Church and so much more. Ellis was very responsive to all our inquiries.

Great duplex in highly desirable Park Slope. Super close to bars, restaurants, Prospect Park. Three stories and tons of open space so you never felt crowded like most NYC places. Host Ellis was great on check in and gave full tour as well. Thanks!

This is a lovely property in a great location. It is minutes from shops, cafes and restaurants and a 5 minutes walk to the subway for Manhattan. As a family of 4 adults it was perfect for us but it would also be ideal for families with children.

Laurie was extremely welcoming and friendly to us when we arrived. She actually sat down with us to explain the entire New York Subway. We felt so heart warmed by that gesture.
Breakfast was simple,and yet the quality of the food was astounding. We love the bagels and cream cheese! and we absolutely love the pears there!!
Thank you Laurie,for the lovely time there :)

Laurie made us feel very welcome.  Her home is well equipped to handle visitors and we could be very independent since instructions were sent prior to our visit.  The beds were comfortable and the bath was always accessible, although shared.

The location was perfect!  I enjoyed the stay immensely and would definitely recommend Laurie as a top-notch host that cares about her guests.  She clued us into great local things to do that never disappointed.  It definitely felt like a welcome home away from home.
很好的地理位置

The house is clean and well located, closed to the Amazing Prospect Park and bars of the Fifth Avenue. The room was warm (good, because it was on winter) and Laurie and Chad had been really helpfull. Laurie is not only an amazing host but also an incredible perron with great values and strong will. I will definitely go there again when I'll be in NY. Thanks Laurie.
Laurie's place was absolutely lovely and had so much character

Lovely home with two very sweet hearted cats. My boyfriend and me stayed at Laurie's home for one week and we felt us quite welcome and comfortable. A metro station is near by Laurie's home and the area (Brooklyn) is also quite pretty. Our room and the bathroom were clean and we slept there very well. Our week was wonderful, we had a great time!!!
Thank you Laurie :)

Laurie è una bravissima e gentilissima host, è stata disponibilissima mi ha spiegato come funzionava la metropolitana mi ha consigliato i posti da vedere sia in Brooklyn che a Manhattan, la colazione sempre buonissima, la casa molto bella, la mia camera molto spaziosa, il bagno carino, situata in una posizione a 2 minuti a piede dalla prima fermata della metro le altre poco distanti.
Grazie Laurie, sicuramente tornerò da lei nei miei prossimi viaggi a New York

Laurie hat uns persönlich empfangen und gleich mit Tipps und Ratschlägen versorgt. Es gibt auch ein Booklett, in dem Tipps für Lokale und Sehenswürdigkeiten in der näheren oder weiteren Umgebung aufgelistet sind. Es wäre hilfreich, wenn die Anhänge an die Mails verlässlich beim Empfänger ankämen. Das Frühstück ist wirklich vielfältig und reichlich. Außerdem kann man immer nehmen, was man möchte. Laurie war zwar nicht oft persönlich anzutreffen, aber immer erreichbar und kümmerte sich per Mail um uns. Als Ruhepol eignet sich die Gegend und das Haus ausgezeichnet.

Laurie's home was lovely and cozy - even better than the pictures. The location is super great - subway station right around the corner with direct connection to Manhattan. Laurie gave us everything we needed and great recommendations on what to do and where to eat. We will definitely come back and had a blast!

La casa está situada en un barrio en Brooklyn, muy cerca del metro, lo que hace fácil el traslado a Manhattan. La pieza que elegimos (dos camas angostas) está en el tercer piso, lo que es bueno tener en cuenta para personas con poca movilidad o maletas muy pesadas!, también este piso es el más caluroso. El resto de la casa es linda pero es mucho más ordenada en las fotos que en la realidad, realmente se siente como la casa de una artista! La pieza estaba ordenada y limpia y el baño también. El jardín es muy bonito y preferimos tomar desayuno ahí, que además era muy rico.
A pesar de que vimos poco a Laurie, ella trató de ayudarnos en lo que pudo, solucionar el tema del calor y darnos excelentes datos sobre el barrio y alrededores. Muchas gracias!

I had an awesome stay in New York - Laurie and her house contributed to making it great! When I arrived, Laurie welcomed me with recommendations what to do in the area, showed me around the house and provided valuable instructions for transportation. The room is spacious, and nicely furnished like the rest of the house.
I felt safe in the area and was happy that I chose Brooklyn to stay - really nice bars and affordable places to have lunch or dinner.
Also connections with the fast trains was convenient. In a nutshell: I would stay with Laurie again and highly recommend!

Zeer goede locatie voor een trip naar New York. Gelegen in een zeer rustige omgeving, 30min op de metro tot centrum Manhattan. Laurie helpt je op weg met tips over transport en events. We voelden ons er meteen thuis en werden uitgenodigd op haar feestje. Aanrader :)

Très belle maison typique de Brooklyn située dans un quartier très calme et à 5 minutes à pied du métro. Laurie est une personne très accueillante et toujours prête à nous renseigner. Nous reviendrons chez elle avec grand plaisir.

I got a lovely welcome pack from Laurie with loads of information about the area, and transport to and from the place. The room was air conditioned (absolutely necessary in New York summer time!) and perfectly comfortable. I didn't run into Laurie until my second morning in the place as our schedules didn't overlap, but I had everything I needed anyway, and once we did get a chance to chat she was warm and friendly and interesting.

Laurie is a wonderful host and her place is stunning. Every piece of art on her walls tells a story and there is so much character! Laurie had lots of great tips about the neighborhood and was a very gracious host. We very much enjoyed our stay. Thanks Laurie!

とてもフレンドリーなホストとスタッフで、
とても便利な場所にあります。
またNYCに行くときは、
是非お世話になりたいと思います。
ありがとうございました。

io e mia sorella siamo state a casa di Laurie dal 5 al 13 settembre, casa pulitissima e a pochi metri dalla stazione per il centro.
Unica pecca, al nostro arrivo purtroppo Laurie non c'era e ci hanno accolto due ospiti, ma che comunque hanno saputo essere gentili e disponibili.
Laurie è arrivata verso il termine della nostra vacanza e anche lei è stata davvero disponibile con noi, peccato non averla conosciuta meglio!
In ogni caso consigliamo vivamente casa di Laurie, che per quel poco che abbiamo avuto a che fare si è rivelata una persona davvero carina! Un abbraccio da Roma e grazie di tutto!!

Wonderful location in an interesting and relaxed neighbourhood. Ellis was a wonderful host, warm and accommodating. The accommodation and host really enhanced our stay in New York to attend our son's wedding.
The space is extra large; the washer dryer is great to have, Ellis is easy to work with. The location is amazing. We really enjoyed it,

Ellis is very friendly.
We had a warm welcome, our stay in his place went very well.
His place is great, lot of equipment and very well located.

Renee has a lovely and neat apartment. Clean, cozy, big, nicely furnished and really sunny. The street is also very nice and Bed-Stuy is an original neighbourhood.

Prior to our arrival to the apartment we e-mailed Renee several times, asking any kind of questions and she always answered us really fast and in a very helpful way.

Sergei was also very kind with us.

We loved our stay at Renee's and we would love to come back.

This apartment is terrific! It's a great bargain and adds to the experience of visiting New York. Staying in Renee's apartment in Brooklyn was one of the highlights of my recent trip. I didn't want to leave in the morning and I was happy to return at night. The apartment was very comfortable, very clean with large towels and perfect bedding. The building is old but they have done a good job of renovating and modernizing. BTW I did use the washer/dryer when I realized I hadn't brought enough socks and shirts. It did a good job. To try to summarize the apartment and amenities were as advertised. The neighborhood appears to be in transition and could seem intimidating, but I found everyone I encountered on the street to be helpful and friendly. Even though I have lived off and on in NYC for five years this trip gave me an opportunity to learn more about Brooklyn.
The hosts were very kind with us. The flat was very confortable, nice and just a few minutes to the center. We felt as we were at home. We recommend this apartment.

We had great two weeks in New York and Renees apartment in Brooklyn was perfect. Comfortable and big for two persons. We really enjoyed the equipment, not least the opportunity to wash.
The contact with Renee before the trip went very well and we got all the information we needed.
Finally a tip for future guests: Don't miss Dahlia's Café on Nostrand Avenue.
Renee's apartment was lovely and exceptionally clean with beautiful towels and linen- Sergie was extremely helpful- we really enjoyed our stay here and found it met all our needs.

We stayed here for 2 weeks and didn't had to worry for a single thing, every single thing was takencare of. We even requested for early checkin which was easily accommodated by Renee. The place is as shown in pictures. Travel to Times square is only 40 mins through subway, very well connected to places.

We would definitely come back to this place in case we again plan to visit NY.

Loved it... Loved it.... Loved it!.... We really enjoyed the placea very comfortable stay, felt like a home away from home. I most defiantly would recommend the stay. The aparment was clean and warm and gave you everything you needed. I must be honest and say that I was a bit sceptical being new at doing something like this, but we were very pleased. Beats the stay and the pay of a hotel. Very well worth it Thank you again Renee!

What a place!!
This apt was just lovely, indeed pictures were not enough to describe how nice, clean and confortable this place is. Great experience and hospitality from the
Maslikhov´s.

Our first time using Airbnb and it was a wonderful success. A beautifully appointed and nicely sized(read: LARGE) apartment in a transitioning neighborhood in Brooklyn- very diverse bunch. It is not a congested area, comfortable and quaint. Everyone we met was friendly. Our hosts were always available and allowed us to check out early. Sergei was friendly and welcoming upon our arrival.

The apartment is also very conveniently located- approx 15-20 minutes to Manhattan on the A Express(Can be up to 30 minutes depending on destination and transfers- plan accordingly, especially on Sundays when trains are NOTORIOUSLY SLOW).

We would ABSOLUTELY stay in Renee's apartment again. Wonderful location, great price, very accommodating hosts, really a great experience.

Tips:
-Stop by Ms. Dahlia's on Nostrand- a quaint little shop with amazing Chicken & Waffles and delicious cucumber lemonade(BRING CASH!).

- Stock up on groceries and save money. The gentleman at the corner shop was so polite and thanked us numerous times for coming in.

- We ordered delivery from The Spot & Nice Pizza. Both took more than an hour to deliver, probably closer to an hour and a half. The food was good, but order early if you're hungry.

- If you want to take a cab to Brooklyn, get inside the cab AND THEN tell them where you're going. If the driver claims he/she does not go to Brooklyn, tell them that both 311 and the NYC Taxi Commissioner say they do. (great tip from a friendly New Yorker).

Renee is organized and very helpful with the little things that always come up during a vacation. We had an extra guest one night and Renee thoughtfully provided a roll-away bed and extra linens. Sergeii was also there when we needed to figure out bow something worked. The apartment is roomy and fully furnished. It's a short walk to the A or C subway and they can take you almost anywhere. We enjoyed our two-week stay inspite of the blizzard!

We only stayed two nights. The place was fine. There was plenty of natural light coming in during the day which made it pleasant. It was very clean but perhaps a little old and funky for some. We did not mind it. However, it would have been nice if the bedroom door could shut properly. Parking was easy to find.  Renee was very helpful. All in all a positive experience.
Renee's place was fabulous very relaxing and comfortable. Renee was a great host and i look forward to booking a stay at her place again.

We really had nice time in NY because of her great hospitality and kindness.
The location is quite good, F train
goes to central directly, there are many nice restaurants,cafes and Prospect park nearby. If you have cat allergies, I don't recommend you to stay here. We stayed third floor, the cat came into our room every morning. Laurie is great host. Thank you so much once again! :)

Laurie provides an excellent booklet chocked full of information necessary to making the stay comfortable and easy.  This neighborhood couldn't have been any better, easy walking to the subway, neighborhood restaurants and shops.  A family neighborhood, felt perfectly safe, even late at night coming back from the subway.  When I go back to Brooklyn, I'm hoping I can make my home away from home at Laurie's beautiful home.

La signora Laurie è stata gentilissima, ricca di informazioni e molto precisa. Ad un giorno dalla partenza ho avuto un ricovero di un familiare e sono stato impossibilitato a partire. La signora Laurie è stata gentilissima e mi ha stornato il pagamento anticipato al netto delle tasse. Se tornerò a N.Y. andrò da lei. Mi sento di consigliarlo senza esserci andate, vista la correttezza e precisione

We just saw Renee the first day of our arrival but she seems to be a very kind woman. The appartement is large and clean. We were very enjoyed to find it by airbnb. The closest subway station was from 10 mn, if you like walk it's ok. So, it s a good adress.

The apartment was spacious, clean and well equipped to handle an extended stay in the city. The neighbourhood has all necessities, including a large grocery store, a coffee shop around the corner from the brownstone and lots of fast food restaurants, including Chinese, pizza and typical burger places.

Two subway stations (A and C lines) are within quick walking distance, with the "Nostram" station being a better option than Kingston-Throop (A is the express train that gets into Manhattan faster, and it stops at Nostram).

The hosts were friendly and very accommodating!

Renee and Sergei were excellent hosts.  The apartment was incredibly spacious and decorated very nicely.  It had everything i could want (including in unit laundry!) and would definitely stay there again.
Renee and Sergei were great host! The apartment matched the description and we had no issues.

Great apartment... quite, private, a nice space, very clean. Not the greatest neighborhood, but for the price this place is a steal! On street parking was easy to find closeby unless you were coming in late (after 11pm) and wanted to have the luxury of being within a block of the apartment.

About a mile away was a really good coffee shop called Outpost, I would recommend to hit it up for coffee, a snack, free internet, good atmosphere.

Renee was very accomodating and had great communication.
The stay was amazing. Renee and her husband were quick and prompt with inquiries! The place was great, close to all amenities and extremely clean. Would return again.
Enjoyed this stay a lot! Very nice, clean and BIG apartment. And really nice hosts! Will wish to stay here again once back to NY :)
Great apartment and very friendly, helpful hosts. We would definitely stay there again. Highly recommended.

Renee and Sergio were the perfect hosts during our stay
Nothing was too much trouble from instantly providing a brand new toaster to booking our taxi for our return to the airport and accepting the keys at 4am in the morning
The area provided us with a wonderful multicultural experience and we would recommend trying Brooklyn as a great place to stay in NY
The apartment was exactly as it was portrayed in the advertising material and was equipped with every convenience to make your stay effortless and enjoyable.

The place is great, very clean and has that vintage look that I really enjoy.  The host Sergei is very nice and helpful.  The place is a 8-10 minute walk from the Kingston/Throop subway station.  About a 25 minute subway ride to Manhattan and a 15 minute ride to the trendy Williamsburg area.  Great place overall.

The hosts were incredibly accommodating to our schedule. We arrived much later than originally anticipated and they were understanding and available. Likewise we needed some extra time to get out on the last day and they were again very understanding and accommodating. The apartment is absolutely beautiful with tall ceilings, wonderful & comfortable furniture, a handy little ipod dock, more than enough space (which is rare for NYC) and the whole place was pristine and clean. There is plenty of parking in the neighborhood. I intend to try and stay here again next time we are in town.

We have appreciated our appartment in Brooklyn , that was large and quiet, in a lively neighborhood .
We had a good reception by our hosts despite an arrival late in the night ( our flight had been delayed 4 hours )
It was a very pleasant stay !

We stayed in this appartment for a week while visiting New York. The appartment was really good, it's everything it says in the description, there is plenty of space, good bathroom and a neat small kitchen. The appartment was also exceptionally clean and warm. There is a decent supermarket nearby on Fulton Ave and the Norstand Subway station is close - its handy because that station is on the express line so all trains to Manhattan stop there, I dont think we ever waited longer than 1 minute for a train to arrive.
This area of Brooklyn is not like staying in Brooklyn heights (or on Manhattan) but it was definately a good travel experience.
If you're staying in New York for a week the unlimited 7 day travel pass at $29 is a definite bargain, and if you're planning on visiting most of the big name attractions then the New York City Pass at $79 is also great value - plus in some cases it lets you queue jump to get in quicker.

Ellis home is located in a perfect area to enjoy New York and of course Brooklyn. Very close to the subway (R) and surrounded by a lot of shops, bars, and restaurants. Ellis is a wonderful host with a lot of very good recommendations of all kinds (restaurants, museums,...) and with a lot of great books to read if you want to enjoy and relax at home. The house is justr great, a lot of space at disposal with all the necessary to make the stay enjoyable, even a garden for the BBQ. We definitively would repeat in case we are coming back to NYC. Thanks again Ellis. The whole family thanks you for the great moment we had in Park Slope.

This home has a wonderful location in Park Slope, Brooklyn.  The neighborhood feels comfortable and safe and there are so many great places to eat and shop within walking distance.  It's just a short walk to the subway (R Train) and that took us directly to most of the places we wanted to visit in Manhattan.  The master bedroom is divine - spacious, great queen bed, and very quiet.  The second bedroom is smaller,  has more street noise (more typical for NYC), but a very comfortable bed. Kitchen is well stocked with anything you might need.  Ellis was a great host and has tons of suggestions for places to visit and eat.  We loved the place.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour familial (2 parents + 4 adolescents) chez Ellis pour visiter NYC. Ellis est très sympathique, réactif dans ses réponses et nous a réservé un accueil très chaleureux.
Le quartier de park slope est parfait : très calme et silencieux la nuit, plein de magasins et restaurants à proximité et tout Manhattan à 30-60 minutes de métro.
La maison est spacieuse et bien équipée, située dans une jolie rue arborée, à 5 minutes à pied du métro.
Excellent choix pour visiter NY en famille !

The unit is fabulous for a "family" vacation in Brooklyn. Plenty of room, fully equipped kitchen and nice sitting area to "hang out" with friends and family. The neighborhood is amazing, with many wonderful restaurants and shops nearby. The subway is also 2 blocks away into Manhattan. Our host was very responsive and flexible as well!
Great space, amazing location, and Ellis is a very helpful and enthusiastic host.
Great location and family friendly place.
Great Home, Good location, limited parking but subway was perfect.  This would make a great home during the winter months but with it's limited AC - we would not stay here again in the summer.

This home is a perfect (save) place to visit New York. It's just a a few blocks away from the subway (R Train) that took us directly to Manhattan.
The bedrooms upstairs are comfortable. The bedroom in the basement is less comfortable due to limited AC. Ellis was very helpfull to make this bedroom more comfortable and he was very responsive to all our inquiries.
We had a lovely time. Fantastic location and large comfortable appartment.
This is a spacious, lovely home.  Well appointed, comfortable, and quiet.  Very private.

Ellis is an excellent host, funny and will give you lots of suggestions if you need some. He welcomed us and took the time to show us how to properly close the door of the house and answer any questions we had upon our arrival.

He is also very helpful and will accommodate your needs the best he can. For example we had to check out of his Airbnb during the day but our flight was very late at night, and Ellis was very kind enough to let us keep our luggages at his place until it was time for us to go to the airport so we didn't have to walk around the city with our bags. It was a very thoughtful gesture and we really appreciated that.

The location is great with easy access to the R line that brings you directly to the city. Park Slope is a very quiet neighbourhood with plenty of useful supermarkets and shops around which made our visit in NYC very pleasant.

Quick note: sleeping in a basement is not for everybody so make sure you're comfortable with that before booking.

Overall we had a great stay with no issues at all.
Ellis is a great host for a house in a perfect location.  Highly recommend the house!
The host canceled this reservation 40 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Ellis is a wonderful host. He is kind, generous, helpful and accomodating.
The house - all three levels - is very good value, superbly located and was perfect for our family. We would definitely stay here again.

Staying with Laurie was one of the best Airbnb experience we ever had! Not like other Airbnb host that you will never meet, the room that is perfectly organized which made you feel like a hotel room, Laurie is there for you, she talks to you, we shared our stories, opinions, laughed together, listened to the presidential debates together, it all makes us feel like visiting a family relative in NYC rather than staying thousands miles away from home knowing nothing and no one; the house is spacious, artistic, Laurie put all her stuff in the house(without segregation to the guests) without putting extra effort to make them look good or fancy but you can easily feel the artistic yet homy atmosphere, the moment you walk into the door you will feel like I'm home, again!Not mentioning the unlimited juice, yoghurt and cream cheese(with scallions! Perfect match with bagels, Yummy! Laurie will always think that you put too less cheesy on the bagel, do put as much as possible, American way! ;) ) available to you.
I think Laurie is the best representative of what the best Airbnb can bring about: share, trust, good taste and human!
Place is really nice, everything is new. Was well kept and easy check in / check out. If you have any issues, Dana seems very accessible.
I've been here with my girlfriend. Everything was so cool! And Dana gave us all directions and help we needed.

Me and my 19 year old daughter spent one week at Laurie`s place in Brooklyn. Laurie really made us feel comfortable and gave us good tipps for our stay in NY. The house is great and we had our privacy even though other poeple were around at some times.
The rooms were clean, shampoo and hairdryer were offered.
Around the corner, on the 5th Av, we got everything for our needs.
The neighbourhood was safe. In about a few minutes we got to the substation and in about 20 Minutes we got to Manhattan. We took the train until 11 `clock p.m. When coming back later on, we took a taxi, the prices were reasonable. Thank you Laurie for offering us a great breakfast (Bagels, yummie cream cheese, Orangejuice and Coffee) We didn`t take it for granted. We enjoyed our stay that much. At the end, the booklet is great and very helpful. Thank you so much.
Regards,
A and M

Laurie has a great place in South Slope, the bedroom was nice and big and had a window which was great. The house was beautiful and nice and clean. I would recommend this airbnb for folks not familiar with the area, as Lori has lots of tips and suggestions for tourists.
The only negative about my stay was in the middle of the night when a cat scratched at my door and woke me up with meowing- only a sore spot for me because I am not a cat person! Just happened the one time though, and I was able to fall right back asleep. Maybe this is something you sign up for when booking an airbnb with cats :)
Thanks for a nice stay, Laurie!
Great location! We spent 3 nights and had a great time.

Séjour parfait, appartement grand, bien équipé et très calme. Dans un quartier populaire de Brooklyn mais qui ne pose pas de problème. Grand supermarché et métro à proximité.
Propriètaire accueillant et serviable.
Bref à recommander.

I would recommend this apartment to anyone!

Lynne
Great and beautiful flat in Brooklyn! Very quiet, clean and pretty, this place is perfect for vacations and discovery in NYC. Sergei (unfortunately, we did'nt see Renée) is so kind.

Laurie was awesome...she actually drove me around to the best places to purchase wine,cupcakes,pies and all the fixings for my Thanksgiving dinner which she let me host at her Airbnb.
I will try to stay there again and again: )

Laurie is a great host. Even tough theres a lot of stress just before christmas she found time for me to give me really good recommendations  every day. She knows where to eat, where the best christmas windows is located and when the museums have special offers. If you want to try being a Brooklyner for a short time, this is where you should stay.

Inside - Just imagine you are in your grandma's house. The guest floor is family hotel-like, clean, well equipped and decorated, and detail-oriented. The main floor is cozy and warm, where, besides interacting with other interesting guests, you find the host welcome you and try to make you feel comfortable.

Outside - Park slope, is among the top neighborhoods in New York City: 5-10 minutes walk to the prospect park, 15-20 minutes walk to the barclays center/downtown brooklyn, two blocks away to the nearby subway stations and Manhattan is 20 minutes away by train.

Lauries Haus ist ein historisches Gebäude und etwa 140 Jahre alt. Wir lieben es, in diesen Häusern eine Zeit verbringen zu dürfen. Die Wohnlage ist für Unternehmungen in Brooklyn und Manhattan günstig. Auch gut von JFK zu erreichen. Die Lage ist ruhig. In der Umgebung sind gute Restaurants zu finden. Sehr schön ist ein Booklet, das Laurie vorab zur Information zusendet. Uns hat es insgesamt sehr gut gefallen.
Karola und Heinrich
Helmstedt, Deutschland

Staying at Laurie's lovely home in Brooklyn was what the Air B and B experience is all about, at least for me. Easy and clear instructions upon arrival and a feeling of being a welcome guest in a lovely home in Park Slope Brooklyn. Laurie is a busy person but always available if needed to provide guests with advice and assistance. My room was pleasant and quiet and the bed extremely comfortable. The bathroom always had hot water and was shared by guests in the second room on the floor but that was never an issue for me. Laurie always made sure there was plenty of bagels, croissants, cereal, and of course the delicious coffee. Subway is five minutes walk. There's plenty to see and do in Brooklyn and the area is a pleasure to simply wander around. I recommend a visit to the vast Brooklyn Green Wood cemetery if you feel like a ramble in a quiet and beautiful space only twenty minutes walk from Laurie's house.
As if all this wasn't enough there is Laurie's pretty garden at the back with tables and chairs for guests to enjoy sitting out. I couldn't have asked for more as it was the perfect spot for me to do tai chi each morning.
If I am fortunate enough to return to New York I wouldn't think of staying anywhere else but with Laurie in her warm and welcoming book filled home.
Maison très calme, beau jardin fleuri, hôtesse très chaleureuse mais malheureusement pas très présente en semaine.

We had such a great stay at Laurie's place. We booked kind of last minute but Laurie was very quick to answer.
She sent us a booklet With a lot of information about her place and the places to see around and in New York and restaurants suggestions, it was perfect!
The place is near the metro that took us directly to the places we wanted to visit in Manhattan or Brooklyn but there are also great places to see nearby (Prospect Park).
The room was perfect, quiet, we shared the bathroom with the people in the room next to ours which was not a problem at all. Everything was very clean.
We arrived late at the airport but had no trouble getting in the house and into our room.
I would definitely recommend!!
Laurie's home is beautiful and comfortable. A great place to stay while discovering NYC.

Laurie is an excellent host.  She provides information for various opportunities in the area from coffee shops and restaurants to museums and theatre.  This is a great location for a visit to Brooklyn, the lovely Park Slope part of Brooklyn, or it is only an easy subway ride to Manhattan.  Laurie's home is warm & welcoming!
Laurie很热情友好，典型的美国家庭！房子很漂亮，特别喜欢每个房间都有很多书，尤其儿童绘本！提供的早晨丰富多样，而且地铁交通很方便，走路5分钟到F，G，R，周边环境安静安全，到展望公园也不远！适合旅游出差和带孩子来旅游的客人！如果再来我还会选择Laurie家！谢谢Laurie提供的一切帮助！
Das Haus von Laurie liegt in einer ruhigen Strasse in einer sicheren Gegend von Brooklyn und ist ein idealer Ort NewYork zu erkunden.Der Garten ist auch toll .D hat biel

Laurie's place has character and charm, and the garden is a lovely place to enjoy coffee and breakfast. My friend and I stayed in the room with twin beds, which is on the top floor next to the shared bathroom. The space upstairs is, like most living spaces in this neighborhood, quite small.
While Laurie is formally welcoming, I felt as if I were clearly sharing her day-to-day living space. When booking here, be aware that the artsy open living space downstairs is not available in the evenings and, although open to access during the day, does not feel like a "hang out" space. We did not feel comfortable spending time in any space other than our private room and the garden.
Finally, our communication with Laurie was very confusing. I found the listing to be highly detailed yet unclear. I wanted to clarify it, but was unable to ask questions before booking, and was actually required to enter all my information in order to communicate at all and “apply” for the room. My application for the reservation was then automatically (and unexpectedly) “accepted,” paid for and subject to her cancellation rules! If you cannot clarify which room you will be booking in advance of payment, do not book here.
Warning: two days before our stay, Laurie informed us there was a mix up with double booking another guest. She offered for us to stay in a different listed room, as well as what used to be her son’s room, at first expecting us to pay a small amount for the inconvenience. When we stated we wanted to remain in the room we had booked, she heavily pressured us to wait until arrival and see what else she had to offer. She only backed off and worked it out with the other guest when we threatened to cancel our reservation.

Very clean, nice neighborhood, really close to a convenient subway line which worked out really well for us.  We had the third floor to ourselves with a clean bathroom stocked with any toiletries we might have forgotten.  Thanks Laurie! Also shoutout to Robin and Batman, they were the friendliest cats we've ever gotten to hang out with.  -Shannon and Sara
The apartment was lovely.  Everything was as stated on the website.  Theonly concern would be the distance from the subway.

GREAT PLACE, super clean (even for a near freak). Only gave 4 stars because of the neighborhood but if you will be gone all day anyways, not a big deal.

The pictures are exactly what it was.

We stayed at Renees for three nights and enjoyed it very much. The apartement is decorated tastefully, there is everything you need to make yourself comfortable and it is spaceous and clean. The metro is in walking distance (10 min.), which makes it easy to reach JFK airport, Manhattan etc. After a long day of sightseeing we enjoyed to stay in a rather quiet environment, and we found it interesting to see more of NYC than just Manhattan and get to know a little bit of Brooklyn.
The apartment was wonderful!  Clean, cute and spacious. Renne was super accommodating and extremely nice. I'm definitely checking with her the next time I vist NYC.

We loved our stay here! The apartment was large and airy and had everything we could have wished for for a week or even much longer. While Bed Stuy doesn't have the greatest reputation among New Yorkers, we loved it and found the locals friendly and the area very safe. A Metro pass for $29 for the week made getting around NY really easy, relatively fast...NY is a BIG place!!!... and cheap. Again, the subway and buses felt very safe. A nearby restaurant , Peaches, was excellent and there were also lots of local stores to buy milk etc as well as a big supermarket only a couple of blocks away. (NY blocks are much smaller than Australian blocks.) As others have said, the pictures of the apartment are accurate and the price very reasonable  for such a large place in NY.

Renee and Sergei were very kind and we did not have any problems what so ever with our stay. A quick walk to Nostrand station and you can get anywhere in NYC via the subway. I can really recommend their accommodation.

We had seven wonderful days in NYC and this apt in Brooklyn. It has been an ideal home. It was clean, it was big, like on the photos.
If you want to go to Manhattan it takes 20 min by metro and you can sleep at night cause it's not so noisy and stressful there. Bedford-Stuyvesant is a nice brownstone-place to be for a stay in this town and the given hints from Renee & Sergei (Cafe, Bar, Restaurant) have been very useful for us, beeing new in the hood.
If we come back to the new world, we will come back to Renee & Sergei again.

Staying at this neighbourghood and this flat complimented our NYC vacation. We got to experience a whole lot more of local way of living by staying here instead of hotel. Bed-Sty is also good place to stay if you want to explore more Brooklyn or go to Coney Island for example.

Flat is exactly like in the pictures, spacious and quiet. We really enjoyed our stay for almost two weeks here and highly recommend it to anyone who wants to get value for money and see more than Manhattan.

We stayed with Renee and Sergei in their 1 bedroom apartment in Bed Stuy for almost a month. Initially I was a bit daunted by the neighbourhood but Renee was very supportive and gave us some good pointers. As it turned out we came to really 'enjoy' living there and mixed and mingled with the locals. The apartment was a very good place to return to at the end of a long day and we were grateful for the excellent facilities, especially the spaciousness and the washer dryer. Renee and Sergei were available immediately if we needed anything. Being on the A subway line made living out there and commuting to Manhattan really easy and we had no problems, even coming home reasonably late at night.
We did find it a bit noisy at night sometimes as the 'street activities' were a bit loud. But we also had a movie being made in the next street over!! had locals that we could say hello to, met polite and friendly residents and shopped with the local businesses. All adventures!!
I only met Sergei once and Renee was extremely welcoming and helpful.
We would certainly consider staying here again should we be lucky enough to return to New York!

Renee and her husband were great hosts and we would highly recommend a stay at their apartment!
While the neighbourhood can seem a bit intimidating at first (especially for first time visitors to the USA like us!) we found that many of the people in the area are friendly and easy going. We never had any issues while we stayed there.
The apartment itself is in an old Brooklyn brownstone building just like you see in the movies! It was great to experience and even better to live as a New Yorker rather than as a tourist in Manhatten.
The trip to the main island doesn't take long and most things are conveniently located.
Renee was a great host and she was very helpful when we checked in.
Highly recommended!

Our stay at the 1 Bedroom apartment of Renee and Sergei was wonderful.
The apartment is fully consistent with the description and photos. Very bright, clean and comfortable.In the apartment is everything you need. Wi-Fi, all the necessary equipment in the kitchen. Very convenient was to have a washer and dryer - you can take a minimum of clothes and save space in your luggage for shopping in New York. In the bedroom was very nice linens and lots of towels.
Sergei has given us a lot of useful tips about New York.
Four days before our arrival to Renee we were leaving for Washington and it was very nice, that our hosts allowed us to leave our suitcase in their house before arriving.
The first day we were a little scared of the area where the house, but later we saw that there's not dangerous, and returned after walking in Manhattan at 10-11 pm.
On the way from the subway there are lots of places where you can eat - cafes, delis, fast food, shops and a supermarket. Deli are open 24 ours.
Excellent apartment for the money !
We recommend this accommodation!

My boyfriend and I recently stayed at Corey's Cool and Cozy East Village Pad for one whole week. Corey is an awesome host and his apartment was in the perfect part of New York City. The apartment was very neat and clean. The pictures show exactly what you get with no surprises. His place is located right in East Village (which is my favorite area of the city) and is in short walking distance to many fun bars, shops, groceries and lots of yummy places to eat. Corey was very warm and welcoming to his home and greeted us when we first arrived. I felt very comfortable with Corey from the first time we spoke. Whenever I contacted him with any questions he responded back almost immediately. He made our stay very relaxing and enjoyable. His knowledge about the city made things much easier for us especially when getting around. We would definitely stay at his place again. Thanks Corey, we couldn't have had a better trip and place to stay!
Room was exactly as described, and Corey was a great and accommodating host; the only problem was that Corey's cats really wanted to share the bed with me at night.

Well, what can i say? My friend and i have just been staying at Corey's place for the last 15 days and we have had the best time imaginable....
Corey met us at his place on our first night, and ever the gentleman, he took both my and my friends suitcases all the way up to the 5th floor (walk up). We immediately felt at ease with Corey, such a warm, funny guy with lots to tell us about New York and interesting things to do while we are here. We went straight up to the roof (night time), and he did a show and tell on the skyline (such a beautiful view!).
We kept in contact with Corey throughout most of our stay, he was there if we needed anything.
