His place is exactly how you see on the pictures, clean and very cool (quirky furniture and pictures on the walls), plus he is the owner of the worlds most comfortable bed. The apartment was just what we needed for our stay and is perfect for 1-2 people.
The area is lovely, lots of places to eat, go for coffee and drinks, plus there is a Deli just across the road who we became great friends with, such lovely guys!!
The f train subway line is about a 5-10 minute walk away, and is great for getting anywhere in the city.
All in all the east village is probably one of my favourite areas in Manhattan, and my friend and I would not hesitate to stay at Corey's place when we return to New York (hopefully sooner rather than later!)
New York rocks, and so does Corey!!

The hubby and I recently stayed at Corey's Cool and Cozy East Village Pad for three nights. Corey is a a great host: he quickly responded to our emails and phone calls; gave us great suggestions for things to do, both in the neighborhood and in greater Manhattan; and he was flexible about our check-in and check-out times. Corey made the whole process of staying in a stranger's house, in a strange city, more comfortable with his warm and laid-back personality. The apartment is how Corey describes it and the photos represent it very well. It is a cool, tidy, calming, and eclectic little pad with lots of light.

The neighborhood itself is safe and vibrant. There are lots bars, restaurants, delis, cute coffee places, and a 24 hour pharmacy nearby. Pretty much anything you could need or ask for is readily accessible with a short walk. The F train is about a 10-15 minute walk from Corey's place.

We only wish we had been able to stay for longer.

Corey was a great host! My friend and I really enjoyed our stay at his apartment. His apartment was very clean and welcoming, and it felt like we were real "New Yorkers" staying at his place. His apartment is in the heart of the East Village and is walkable to tons of fun restaurants, bars and shops, which he gave us great recommendations for!  Thanks Corey!

It's been nearly a week since I had the pleasure of staying at Corey's Cool and Cozy East Village Pad, and I'm still in a whirl from the fantastic experience. Corey's awesome pad injected this San Francisco girl with a huge does of Carrie Bradshaw coolness.

Corey is the man... you will not find a more wonderful and knowledgeable host! He's incredible friendly, very cultured, and had great suggestions of the places to see / things to do in the neighborhood. I had never vacationed in the East Village before, but his advice left me with a confidence only a local could have mustered.

While I had seen photos of Corey's place online, nothing prepared me for how wonderful his place really was. There is plenty of space to lounge, a really great little kitchen, decorated vintage Manhattan chic, and don't get me started on the views from tar beach... 360 degrees of Manhattan Magnificence!

Location, Location, LOCATION! You will not find a more hip apartment in the East Village. I kid you not - this place is in the center of it all. Walk 2-3 blocks in any direction, and you're hitting some of the best galleries, restaurants, nightlife, and nature the city has to offer. Hello Tompkins Square... where have you been all my life?!

My NYC Roman Holiday wouldn't have been possible without Corey's awesome pad to call home to. The next time 'I want to be a part of it' in NYC, I'm committed to renting Corey's place in the East Village again. It was a once in a lifetime experience I will never forget. Thanks Corey!
A brilliant apartment in a nice residential area, quick to get to Manhattan or hip Williamsburg. Thanks to Laurie and Maria!
非常好的体验

Laurie's house is a cosy, comfortable, and safe place in one of New York City's more laid back areas (Park Slope).

For the price Laurie's place is a no-brainer, I think you will be hard-pressed to get better value for your money. The house is situated in the Park Slope area and places of interest such a Prospect Park and the Barclay's Center are easily accessible via public transport and even on foot. The house itself is older but in excellent condition (although those stairs are a bit noisy at night) and it has a beautiful garden with terrace that's great to enjoy a sunny day in.

Laurie is quick and elaborate in responding to any requests or questions I had, on site before my stay and whilst staying with her. Any questions I asked about the area were met with detailed answers and tips for traveling and eating out cheaply. She also gave me overall money saving tips to enjoy as many things as I could in New York. I could tell she has been living in the area for a long time and is both very knowledgeable as well as enthusiastic about conveying that to her guests.

I had a great time staying at Laurie's place as she is an excellent host who really went the extra mile to make my stay as comfortable as possible. This was my first AirBnB experience and it has certainly left a good impression on me as a valid alternative to hotels. I heartily recommend Laurie's place to anyone wanting to visit New York City and/or Park Slope or surrounding areas.

Close to great restraunts, coffee, breakfast and brunch. Very close to subway.

Other than all the stairs and the clogged bathtub the apartment was great. Warm and cozy.
Great, quiet location close to subway. Breakfast is a treat. Room and facilities spacious and clean. A true home away from home!
great convenient recommend without hesitation and laurie is a great host

Lauries Haus ist ein Boheme Haus voller Bilder und Bücher, cosy und geräumig.  Laurie gibt tolle Tipps, organisiert Taxi zum Flughafen, hat booklet mit insider tipps, also da bleiben keine Fragen offen. Frühstück macht man sich selbst, die Küche ist ausführlich beschriftet und man findet sich gut zurecht. Die Lage in Brooklyn auf der 4. Strasse ist perfekt!!! Ganz toll war, dass Laurie für uns ohne Gebühr die Termine gewechselt hat weil uns Opodo mit englischsprachigem Mitarbeiter falsche Termine gebucht hat. Bucht nie bei englischsprachigem Opodo Mitarbeiter - das ist anderes Land und anderes Unternehmen und ihr habt keine Chance etwas zu reklamieren. Laurie hat uns da gerettet und die Termine angepasst. Das war total nett! Ich würde jederzeit wieder zu Laurie!
The Airbnb was in a great neighborhood with easy access to public transportation. Laurie provided excellent guidance regarding local amenities. The space was clean and well appointed.
Second time I have stayed at Laurie's.  it is a great placa very conveniently located and easy to arrive to and leave love the freedom to come and go.... and bedding is very comfortable!

You cannot find a better location for visiting Brooklyn and NYC!  Laurie's home is authentic Brooklyn, close to subways, awesome food, Prospect Park, friendly Brookklynites, all that is good about NYC! Yet - the neighborhood is quiet and mellow.    Laurie is welcoming, informative and very accomodating.  The delicious espresso, bagels and cream cheese in the morning -- just the icing on the cake!  Please note, as Laurie states in her post, the bedrooms are on the 3rd floor, so be prepared for the climb up the classic staircase.  It's a great way to assuage guilt after all the rich food you are going to enjoy!
Space was as described. No frills. I was really only there to sleep. It was very comfortable.

Really enjoyed our stay at Laurie's. The location is great! Close to the subway for easy access to the city, and there are lots of restaurants, shops and cafes in the neighborhood, if you don't want to travel far. The house is lovely. The stairs are steep, as it is an older building, but not too bad. Bed was comfy, sharing a bathroom upstairs was no problem. The garden is gorgeous! Excellent hospitality! Highly recommend!
Perfect location, very cute appartment. Loved it

We had a great time staying at Corey's. It is truly a cool East Village pad (literally...nice AC unit...and figuratively)  -- we'd like to add that it was also very clean and in a PERFECT location as well! Close to subway stops, our favorite Katz's deli, live music clubs, outdoor markets, the works. Corey was there right when we said we would check in, gave us a quick tour and even provided some fantastic recommendations for bars, brunch, dinner - pretty much everything. We couldn't have asked for better.  Thanks, Corey! We will likely be seeing you again!

Corey was a very welcoming, accommodating host. He gave me plenty of tips on East Village haunts, and answered any questions I had about getting around the city. His apartment is clean, full of character and a very comfortable place to retire at the end of the day.

Also, the five-floor climb is well worth it for the roof top access! Great spot to watch the sun rise on NYC.

Thanks for everything, Corey.

With my parents coming into town and a complete lack of affordable hotel rooms available in town, Corey's place completely saved my bacon!!

Corey's space is clean, beautifully decorated, and the perfect size for for a couple. It also has amazing light and access to the roof with some of the best views of Manhattan that I seen to date!

Corey himself is the perfect host, very helpful and laid back.

I would definitely recommend Corey's pad and will certainly be using it again!!

I'd recommend this place to my friends.
And I'd definitely try to stay there again.

The place was great. It was cool and comfortable.
The host (Corey) was great. He told us about the neighborhood, NYC highlights, transit, etc. He's really nice, too.

Corey made my first experience with Airbnb really easy, great directions, great advice. Thank you sir!! Not my first time in the East Village,but its a really fun neighborhood, apartment was perfect for me, roof top views of the city at night were amazing!

Staying at Corey's was a great pleasure. The apartment is perfect, as described and well located.
He made sure everything was ok for us even though he was out of the state.

Corey's apartment is the coolest place I've ever stayed in NYC. The rooftop view is incredible and his place is located within minutes of amazing East Village restaurants and nightlife. In addition to all of that, Corey was a great host who provided excellent communication, further adding to the overall positive experience of our stay.
I'd recommend this place to anyone and everyone!
Thanks Corey!

Corey and his pad are amazing. Perfectly situated and amply appointed, we were not disappointed in this selection. The bed with the most comfy pillows we've ever had was just awesome. We were grateful for Corey's availability and would definitely not hesitate to recommend his place.
The area was wonderful, corey was always helpful and we had a great stay. Thank you Corey!!!

This was my first AirBnB experience and I have to say it went seamless. Corey was an excellent host, the place was perfect & the bed was extremely comfortable (which was needed due to trekking the city all day via foot)

I highly recommend, it was a great neighborhood and close to so many amazing restaurants and things to do!!
Perfect place as a base in NYC for young/chill types looking for an authentic-feeling pad - would definitely stay again.

I don't even know where to begin... Corey's place is beyond awesome and totally exceeded my expectations.

Basically, everything everyone else has said is 100% true, and I actually think that the place is even better in real life than in the pictures.

The bed is *amazing*, the place is cozy and I felt like I was at home in my own apartment, location is perfect - I didn't get into a single cab, just walked everywhere and loved it.

Corey is super responsive and stayed in touch throughout the experience to make sure everything was working out.

I hope the feeling is mutual so I can stay here again next time I'm in NY :).

Renee was helpful and prompt responding to any questions that we had. The apArtment was exactly like the pictures. It was clean, roomy and had the washing machine which came in handy. The subway is only a short walk and takes about 20mins to get into times square. This was fine and convenient. We highly recommend this place. Brooklyn is a really friendly place to stay and ms dahlia's cafe is awesome! Thanks so much Renee for having us. We had a great time!
This is my favorite NY Airbnb apartment so far. I'll be back!

We loved staying in the place. It's just great. The rooms are really spacious and you'll find all you need - from Wi-Fi to washer and dryer. It's decorated tastefully and sofa + bed are very comfortable. People in the area are friendly and you'll find delis, grocery stores and cafes nearby. On your way to the subway, which is only a short walk, you can pick up some coffee and chat with the local. And you'll be in Manhattan really quick by A train.
Renee is the best host you can image. Communication was fast and she helped us out with everything we needed. We are very thankful, highly recommend the apartment and hope to stay there again some time.

I loved!! staying on Renee's apartment. she is super cool and helpful!!.
I really thank God to put me on this place to get to know NYC!!.
Thank you Renee for make this trip so special!!

kisses

Michelle and Juan

Our stay in Renee's apartment was great, she's a wonderful host and gave us good advises. The apartment is cozy, big, comfortable, beautiful and full equipped!! Even though the neighborhood and location could have been better, at the end of our stay it felt like home.  I will definitely recommend to stay there.

This was a great experience. Thank you, Renee. You are absolutely amazing and generous and kind and gracious.

Renee answered all of my questions in a very timely matter, was incredibly accurate about her listing. Everything was clean and provided for.

Thanks so much!

Excellent séjour chez Renee à Brooklyn! Nous avons passé 6 nuits dans ce petit appartement très agréable et propre, spacieux et parfait et avec toutes les facilités nécessaires! A 10min à pied du métro qui vous amène en 20min à Manhattan, dans une rue tranquille et agréable, cet appartement est un excellent port d'attache pour partir à la découverte du grand New York dans les meilleures conditions. Et comme Renee est parfaite, gentille et prévenante, nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour chez elle!

My Friend & I had a lovely stay at Renee's 1 bedroom Apartment. Just what we needed for a long weekend in New York. It was just as described & had all that was listed. Was clean, fresh & comfortable. Lots of light in the day time though the lovely big windows & Warm at night with the original window shutters. Apart from having to make your own breakfast, it was better than a hotel room & at so much of a better value. Living the life of a New Yorker & not a travelling sales man. Getting to be inside a Brown Stone house with character & not a boring room, that looks the same a million times over the World. Easy to get to by subway in & out of Manhattan & on the same line to & from JFK Airport. The Area was very clean and very friendly. We did not feel uncomfortable at all walking around, day or night. Renee to was lovely answered all we need to know & left us to enjoy our stay. We would both stay again & would deferentially be recommending Renee to any of our friends or family looking to stay in New York.
Many Thanks Heloise
The apartment was very well equipped and taken care of, and also with  close access to the Subway, a very cost-effective way for those looking to visit NYC without paying an arm and a leg.

Renee's apartment was great!  It was easy to find and she was always available.  The apartment was beautiful -- it has amazing antique details and was furnished beautifully and comfortably.  All the amentites were as described.  The area was good, only a few blocks from the subway.  I would definitely stay there again!  Thanks, Renee!

This was a great place to stay, very comfortable and clean with a lot of charm. The place has a nice touch to it and the host is extremely helpful.
I highly recommend it.

A lovely apartment in Bed-Stuy! If you don't mind staying a little ways from Manhattan, it's a perfect spot! It was very nice to have our own space and not have to worry about anything. The bedroom was very big, and the whole apartment was very clean and warm in 10 degree weather outside. There is a coffee shop and a small grocer right around the corner, as well as a subway and bus stop within 5 blocks I will definitely be staying here again!

The apartment is impeccably clean, and host Renee is very kind and totally lay-back. I have a whole floor by myself in a charming brown stone building. I don't even have this kind of luxury when I lived in NYC. I definitely recommend Renee's apartment.

A very nice apartment with easy access, decent parking.  Very clean - clearly Renee pays attention to maintaining a first-class place.  A bit rustic - as fits a classic Brooklyn brownstone, but tastefully so.  Our only complaint was that the bed was a bit saggy. My wife, who suffers from minor back problems, did wake up with a sore back.  I had no problem.

The apartment was clean and quiet.  It was convenient to everything we needed.  Renee was very helpful and prompt when answering any questions we had.  She was also extremely helpful adjusting our check-in and out times to accommodate our schedule. I highly recommend renting from Renee!
Very comfortable place, large and light. Everything you need for a affordable home base to see the city!

This was definitely the ideal stay, and Renee was the ideal host! The apartment was CLEAN & had all that we needed (including a washer/dryer), Nice size flat screen TV, comfy Queen size bed, High Ceilings, etc. Very cute Brownstone, the block is very nice & quiet. It's about a 5-7 minute Walk from the subway (A/C train to Nostrand).

Renee was very accommodating with local info, and additional needs! We will definitely be coming back here to stay.

My husband, 22-month-old, and I just stayed at this fabulous apartment. We were booked solid with plans and pretty much just used the apartment as a home base, but it was more than satisfactory. It will be our go-to place for any future excursions to NYC.

Many thanks Renee for staying at your flat. Very hospitality, comfortable, clear and been flat with 2 rooms. Kitchen, old house with history, modern interior. Nice to meet american-russian family)
Best regards, Elizaveta

great experience. renee was super helpful and even had the room ready early for us. the room was spacious and cozy, perfect to catch up form the hustle and the bustle of busy days. she even offered to print our boarding passes & called a car service for our ride to the airport. definitely went above and beyond all expectations.

Renee made us feel welcome, yet we were left with our own privacy the whole stay until we had questions, which she was happy to help us with. After the initial surprise once we got off at the station, we felt safe and everyone who greeted us was friendly; especially to my gf! This is actually one of the few areas in NYC that felt like a neighbourhood, which was cool. A nice older flat, very airy and warm.

This was a very nice old brownstone building and apartment. About a 5-8 minute walk to the nearest subway line into the city (there were actually two different stations roughly equidistant; one express, one local). The bedroom and bed was very and very comfortable, and it was a great value for the NYC area.
Perfect for our needs - will stay here another time
Nice and clean in a calm neighborhood. Kind host who lives in the apartment underneath so that felt good.

We found the apartment to be exactly as described in the listing, with everything we needed plus more, making for a very comfortable 2 week stay. Renee was a very welcoming and helpful host. Would certainly stay again and have no hesitation in recommending to friends.

Renee is very friendly and helpful. She always answer really quickly to any demand. The appartment was amazing, very sunny with a lot of character. Bigger than what it looks, particularly the bedroom, with everything you can ask for. The area is nice, 10 min to the subway (A & C) by foot. If I'm to return to NYC I definitely want to stay there again.

//
Renee a vraiment été très gentille et disponible. Elle a répondu rapidement à toutes nos questions et tout était toujours clair. Si je retourne à NYC, je resterai définitivement chez Renee à nouveau.

Great place, as described.  Renee was very nice and helpful.  Very clean apartment and I loved the neighborhood.  Easy access to shopping and transport.  Two train stations very near to the apartment.  Would definitely stay again.

Very clean  apartment with all amenities that you will require. It is very handy to the subway which gives access to all of the major attractions. Don't be put off by the area as it proved very safe and with lots of history. Highly recommend a a visit to the Peaches Hothouse just around the corner for fantastic southern chicken and dining atmosphere. Renee was the perfect host meeting us on arrrival and always available (living downstairs) to assist with any questions. Highly recommend a stay with Renee.

We had an abosolutely great time at Renee's place. The appartment is VERY clean and equipped with comfortable furniture (exactly like the pictures show it). Renee is perfectly reliable, communication about arrival and hand-over of keys worked out very well, too. I can only recommend you this place for a trip to New York.
Great area, cozy room, friendly host! Everything you need!

Laurie's home was absolutely amazing. The common area was the perfect place for me to go through emails and enjoy the complimentary bagel breakfast. Everything  was very clean and comfortable, I easily  could have moved in!! Can't wait to come back.
Staying at Laurie's home was delightful. The house and garden is beautiful and Laurie was an excellent host.
Great location in Brooklyn, easy access to subways and busses.

The house is very charming. Laurie gave us a lot of information about Manhattan and Brooklyn. The other guests were very nice. We liked sharing breakfast with them in the kitchen. We recommend this place!
Clean, comfortable, convenient, quiet with great coffee.  I enjoyed my stay.  I strongly recommend it.
it’s a very good choice for visitors who wants to experience NY for a few days. nice location.

Laurie is a lovely hostess. She knows the area and has great suggestions for things to do and places to go. Her home is walking distance from local stores, shops, restaurants, the local gym, and the subway. So, getting around from her place was awesome. She offered fresh fruit for morning snacks which we enjoyed. The bed was comfortable, our room and bathroom was clean. Our room was 2 flights up but we are in good shape and didn't mind the stairs. Her home is in a great location! Lovely hostess, lovely place to stay!
Nice cosy home in a wonderful residential area. Laurie has thought of everything and provided us with ample info and tips. We could help ourselves to fridge Nd had wonderful breakfasts...

Park Slope is a nice area of Brooklyn and Laurie’s place is a beautiful house. She has a working system with all that is needed: keys, bathroom, breakfast and recommendations for activities and sightseeing. Friendly, warm and welcoming atmosphere with easy communication. Close to the Metro and not far from JFK.
Laurie’s place is exactly as described.  Excellent neighborhood, classic house with some great coffee and nice  breakfast treats available.  Laurie was a great host!  I would stay here again.
Wonderful experience of traditional townhouse in Brooklyn.
Laurie's place is warm and charming, a lovely home. Laurie is not just the nicest person I met on my trip to New York, but one of the nicest people I've met. Period.

Laurie’s house is beautiful and she is a wonderful host who shares as much as she can, at all times: information about the city, events, restaurants and cafes; as well as her space (apart from the rented room, you can prepare food in her kitchen, eat her food and spend time in a living room);the bed is very, very comfortable and the bed sheets of a very good quality. What else? You’ll feel at home.

Laurie is a great host. She is very helpful with useful tips and recommendations of local places. We felt at home at her place. Our room was very clean and nice. It was possible to have breakfast in Laurie's dining room. The location is great - very close to a subway station. The neighborhood is great as well - lot's of places to relax at after all the sightseeing. Laurie also let us leave our big suitcases at her place when we were leaving for a trip to different cities. I highly recommend Laurie's place.
Thank you for having us. The place was very clean and comfortable. Laurie is very kind and give us great tips on where and what to do.

I spent almost three weeks at Laurie's and enjoyed it thoroughly. The house is in a beautiful safe area near transportation and shopping. It was lovely to be able to make breakfast with her delicious coffee, yogurts, breads, and so forth. The bed was very comfy, lots of closet space, and a big clean bathroom. I would stay here again easily. Laurie is also just wonderful.
Laurie has a lovely place. She was super helpful and the experience was great.

House in lovely neighbourhood, short walk to metro and easy to get into Manhattan. Laurie is very helpful and made us feel at home. After busy days sightseeing, it was good to know we had somewhere comfortable and relaxing to go back to.

Laurie's place is a fantastic place to stay for a visit to NYC. Laurie's warmth, quick responses and great tips made my visit so wonderful - including the much appreciated breakfasts every day! I'd strongly recommend this place.
Laurie was a great host and I loved her place, unfortunately I didn’t spent much time at home as I was always visiting the city but I had everything I needed in her house.

Laurie is an exceptionally gracious host.  She welcomed me, took time to make a connection and showed me around her lovely home.  She provides breakfast supplies which is unusual.  I loved that her house was filled with artwork made by children's book illustrators.  My room was very comfortable and I slept easily.  I love the neighborhood, Park Slope -- and Laurie's home--  are old NewYork at its best.
Great place with a gracious host.  Perfect location in heart of brownstone Brooklyn.

Laurie’s place is a gem, perfectly located in prime Park Slope, which is basically New York’s version of Islington. The house is a quirky, older home, warm and welcoming. Laurie is an extremely interesting person, friendly, knowledgeable and delighted to chat about everything from the locality to the state of the world. The upstairs rear bedroom I had was quiet and comfortable - I slept particularly well. It’s probably worth noting that the house could be tricky for anyone not steady on their feet as the stairs are narrow and steep. But don’t worry about taking bags up there - Laurie is more than happy to let guests keep heavy bags downstairs. Highly recommended, an easy subway trip to the varied neighbourhoods of Brooklyn and to Manhattan beyond.
Lauries home is super comfortable and in a great location . She is a fabulous host !
Corey was a great host. Perfect location + super comfortable bed. It all makes me want to move back to NYC.

Corey's place was a great base from which to explore New York city! Within walking distance to most of the best shopping, nightlife and restaurants, you won't need to get a cab anywhere! The place has great character and the bed was super comfy. The lack of an elevator wasn't a problem for us except for getting luggage up and down. We had a great stay and would recommend it to anybody.
Corey's place was perfect. Great location, great value. I'd stay here again in heartbeat.

We are an Italian young couple.

I would definitely recommend Corey's place as a great apartment for a social weekend visit - or longer - for a single or a couple. We stayed there in December 2011 and had a great time.

Wonderful experience.  Great place to stay at and Laurie is amazing. Close to a lot of things,  perfect location.  The place is very clean.

This was our second stay with Renee. We highly recommend anyone to stay at this warm, comfortable, clean,and safe apt. There is a great coffee place around the corner called Coffee Gounds. Everyone was very friendly.

Renee is just lovely. Very friendly and helpfull. The appartment is great too. We had a great time in this place.

Corey's crib is awesome and perfect for two people exploring the city. Corey was always available to help out with anything that we needed. I would definitely recommend his place to anyone looking for a place to crash in NY.

Laurie is so helpful, friendly, and communicative. She is passionate about her lovely neighborhood and her spot is unbelievably charming. The garden!!! Best airbnb hostess ever

Laurie is a true Brooklynite and was very helpful with suggestions about where to eat, what to do, and the way locals handle street parking. Her place is charming and is located in the best neighborhood of Brooklyn IMHO. It was a great launching pad for my various adventures around the city (it’s a short walk to the 4th Ave subway station). Laurie makes available a tasty spread of breakfast foods, coffee, tea, etc. to get get your day started. It was nice to come back to my clean room with cold AC during an intense June heat wave. I definitely recommend this place if you are visiting BK!

Great location on the south side of Park Slope close to the F, G, and R trains as well as countless restaurants, cafes, and bars, not to mention Prospect Park. Laurie’s place was perfect for my stay! A great location, comfortable room, and warm host!

Laurie provided a great deal of local information and we definitely followed her car service and dining recommendations.
Great location. Clean, quiet. Very nice home. Great value.
Laurie is a very kind person, very helpful. The area is really cool: I always prefer Brooklyn then Manhattan. Be careful she has two cats if you don’t like them.
Great host! Very accommodating and friendly. Highly recommended for a nice quite stay in the city.

Laurie was kind, knew her area! Offered recommendations we took and she was spot on.
Nice room with lovely cozy touches and a lot of local tips. Good value for money.

Amazing, kind and helpful!! Great location, amazing host!

Great place, very spacious, very clean and very beautiful..... I highly recommend it if you go to visit Brooklyn...

Great apartment in a very nice neighbourhood. It was my first time in Brooklyn and first airbnb experience and I'm certainly going to enjoy both again. Renée's apartment is a jem.
