Check out all his reviews!!
Fine experience at Corey's place.

Corey's pad was a great stay for us in the East Village. The place was very comfortable and felt quite big! Literally right in the middle of a great area with every type of restaurant/bar you could ever need, and 2nd street subway station is about a 10 minute walk. As per the other reviews, the apartment is on level five but we had no issues with it - most places in NY don't have lifts!

Staying at Corey's place was an absolute pleasure! The apartment was fantastic and in a great location!  Everything was simple and easy and Corey is a great host.  I am definitely coming back and when I do Ill definitely be looking to stay at Corey's again!  Ps Im stealing some of your decorating ideas, great taste!!

Corey's apartment was clean, comfortable and stylish. His thoughtful and artistic decor added to the pleasure of my stay. I also enjoyed the peek of the Empire State Building from his kitchen window and accessing the rooftop where an even more spectacular view of the city awaits.
The apartment is in a great location with many wonderful restaurants, coffee houses, and night spots nearby. The access to the subway is also convenient and check in and checkout was a breeze. I can highly recommend Corey's apartment in the East Village and I hope one day to return.

Corey place was great! Great location, and a really nice and cosy place. Corey gave us a lot of tips around the neighborhood and though we never met each other, he made it very easy for us to pick up the keys and return them again. We had a bit of problems with getting the key to work, because you had to twist it a special kind of way, but once we figured that out, there was no problems at all. It was tough climbing 5 flights of narrow stairs with our big suitcases, but we new that. Just keep it in mind if you rent this place. All in all we had a great time here :-)

Pick up and delivery of keys was easy. Got there a bit earlier than expected but Corey was more than accommodating and allow us to drop our bags so that we could start seeing the city. The place was clean and quite at night. The bed was very confortable, clean and big for two people. We didn't realized that just a few blocks away there were many places to eat, shop, etc. so that was a Plus Plus.

Although climbing the stairs to the apt. seem forever, it did not put a hamper on getting to the place and relax.

Thank you Corey for making our experience in NYC one to remember

If you love East Village, this is a great location to be in!  Corey's place is super cool, comfortable and clean. He made the check-in and check-out easy and efficient. And you can contact him at any time as he is very responsive. The only reason, I'm giving it 4 stars for this stay is due to the construction that was taking place next door, so it was getting loud on Sat and Mon morning while I was there and wished to sleep a bit longer. Again, if you're doing sight seeing and you're an early bird, this should not be an issue at all for you, as you'll be wandering around the city all day :)

Laurie is a wonderful host and great communicator, with a lovely Park Slope home full of books and art. I stayed whilst doing some apartment hunting in the area, and can attest to the fact that it’s one of the most fantastic neighbourhoods! Would definitely stay here again if need be :-).

For me it was one of the best experiences I have had on the platform, from the first day Laurie was willing to facilitate and deliver all possible information of new york, the house is very cozy and clean, and the whole experience in my stay was excellent, besides making my trip much more beneficial thanks to the information that the host provided me for the trip, I would gladly return to the same stay if I had the opportunity again.

Laurie’s is in a great location, easy access to buses and subway.
Brooklyn is my home town and I loved being back.
Great places to eat in walking distance, and Brooklyn has
The best Botanical Gardens. Laurie was a gracious hostess.
Thank You,
Sierra
Lots of steps but a wonderful location and knowledgeable host! My room was lovely and I’m so grateful for the week that I spent at Laurie’s place.
A beautiful house and a very warmly appointed and spacious room. Laurie is as good a host as she is an interesting person to talk with. Wish I stayed longer.
Me and my husband had a lovely time during out stay
Très belle maison historique dans un quartier très vivant. Proche des transports publics. Chambre confortable. Très bonne relation qualité-prix.
Laurie gave us a warm welcome and had wonderful recommendations that ensured our stay was as perfect as we could possibly wish for!

Great place. You felt just like a local living there. Laurie is a wealth of knowledge for things to do in the city. The place is very close to the subway, and there were tons of great restaurants a stone's throw away. Definitely would stay again.
Well equipped place to stay and close to subway.
Très bon séjour dans un lieu plein de charme et dans un quartier authentique bien desservi par les métros.

We very much enjoyed our week in NYC and found Laurie a most welcoming host with a fabulous brochure put together listing much helpful information about the area , where to eat etc.
We loved the Winner and the Runner up, just a couple of blocks away for breakfast and dinner respectively- Prospect Park, the Botanical Gardens, all local and very pleasant indeed.
Laurie helped us with the subway which became very manageable for us first time visitors.
A great place to Stay in a great area, highly recommended.

I had a very nice stay at Laurie’s place for a long weekend in nyc. Located in park slopes, it’s a good location walkable to subway lines, restaurants, cafes, and other great Brooklyn sites. The house the quiet and clean, with great communication from Laurie. The room is on the third floor with a shared bathroom, so please be prepared for stairs and a limited access to common space/kitchen.

Corey's apartment was perfect for our stay in NYC.  Comfortable, plenty of space, and very clean.  It is in such a fun neighborhood, with restaurants, bars, live music and people everywhere.  An easy walk to the subway.  Corey was very responsive and easy to reach when we needed him.  I would definitely stay here again, and highly recommend it to anyone else looking to stay in East Village.

We've stayed at Corey's apartment during our honeymoon in New York City. He was nice enough to have us stay at his place, as the Airbnb we had reserved couldn't be available (and we learned that at the last minute). Even if Corey didn't have the time to go to his apartment beforehand, we thought the place was clean and he had the cleaners downstairs wash the sheets. So we didn't see a difference. It is located in a very cool neighborhood and the subway is close by. There are nice restaurants nearby, and Corey made a few recommendations. The apartment itself is nicely decorated and we felt at home very quickly. The bed is also very comfortable! Also, we'd like to thank Corey for helping us with our very heavy luggage when we were looking for a cab to go to JFK airport. :)

The inconveniences we had are minor, but we felt we should mention them... We had a bit of a hard time with the building key at the beginning. Corey was very kind and called me back to explain it had a "sweet spot", but we felt maybe it should be added in the check-in email, just to avoid panic at the door! Also, the heating can't be controlled, so Corey told us to use the oven. Finally, there is some construction nearby, so this could be an inconvenience if you plan to sleep late and you are a light sleeper. I know Corey can't do anything about construction work, so it's another thing we feel goes in the "would be nice to know in advance" category.

But if you plan to visit NYC, there's so much to do that you'll want to wake up early to be sure to enjoy every part of it! Thanks for having us Corey!

very clean, perfect location. walked everywhere. the only downside was the construction next door, but we were out and about most of the day.  as mentioned in other reviews, corey is a very responsive and effective host. key pick up and return was very easy and corey was extremely accomodating & flexible with our check in and check out times.  thanks again!

My experience in Corey's apartment was spectacular. Corey makes sure that the apartment is extremely clean and has everything you need including linens and cookware. The neighborhood is what truly makes the experience. Within a 10 minute walk you are at some of the best restaurants and bars in the city. The area is full of young people and is very lively and fun, but the apartment stays quiet during the night so that you can get a solid sleep. Corey is very quick to respond to messages and requests, and is more than accommodating. I will stay here again, and I would recommend this place to anyone that needs an apartment to stay in. 5 stars. Thanks Corey.

It was just as described - cozy, clean and cool. Great little one bedroom in the heart of the east village. Check-in and out was simple and easy. There was phenomenal eats and pubs/bars surrounding the apartment and Corey was great to help throw out a few suggestions. The subway was a few blocks down and they can get you anywhere in the city. The apartment itself is on the older side, with big radiators that keep the apartment nice and warm (which was perfect for us since it was a little chilly that weekend). The apartment was really clean (from the sheets and towels to the kitchen), had great light and was overall very comfortable to hang out in after a long day of walking around. I would definitely recommend Corey's place if they are looking for a super energetic young neighborhood and a comfy place to come back to after a long day.

We had a greally great stay at Corey's.  The apartment was clean and comfortable.  We felt like real new yorkers for the weekend!  It's a great location with tons of good restaurants and bars a few steps away.  I highly recommend a stay here.  I can't wait to go back!

We had a great stay at Corey's place. The 5 flights of stairs are not for the faint of heart...just take your time and you will get there! It's a small place but it has a very open lay-out...very comfortable bed. The only negative, which is out of Corey's control, was the construction at the building next door. Overall, great experience and Corey left easy instructions for key pick-up/drop-off, everything was as promised. Make sure you check out Black Iron Burger on 5th St...awesome! Thanks Corey :-D

We had a really great time in New York over Christmas and New Years and Corey's Place was a great starting point. The walk to the train station in the cold weather was around 10 minutes at a quick pace, but in the rain we often ended up catching cabs.
I knew that there were going to be lots of stairs and thought I was prepared for that, but I was wrong. We had accumulated several extra bags over our 6 week trip and as Corey's place was our last stop we really struggled getting up to the apartment and then leaving. We're both fit young people in our early 20's, but found it a real struggle.
The apartment was a great place to come back to and relax after a long day of walking and there was heaps of supermarkets and cafes/restaurants nearby.
The only issue that we weren't prepared for was the noise the pipes made when the heating was on in the evening. It was a knocking sound that went on all through the night.
Corey's place was great for what we needed and we really enjoyed our stay, however now that I know how much shopping I'm capable of doing in New York, I think that I'll look for a first floor apartment next time.

Pros:
1. The apartment itself is very comfortable and includes all the required facilities for a pleasant stay. Also, the kitchen is equipped with everything you need.
2. Renee was very polite, considerate and helpful.
3. The apartment is very secure (Locked entrance gate + locked door).
4. If you are a TV addict, the apartment has got tons of channels in the cable TV in the living room (note: No TV in the bedroom).

Cons:
1. The place is a 10 minute walk from the nearest subway station and 30 minutes from the city (Up to 60 minutes at night).
It is a quiet residential area, that's a bit creepy at night.
If you wish to experience the hustle and bustle of the city, you may wish to consider another location.
2. a 125$ cleaning charge in advance is a bit harsh and makes the price go up significantly from the original offer (For a short stay).
3. We could not fill the hot tub (The drain's closing mechanism is not working).

Renee was a very welcoming host, who even stayed up to let us in when we arrived at 10pm. The apartment is lovely and there was loads of room for the pair of us. Shower has good pressure and there was always plenty of hot water. The A and C trains into Manhattan are a 10 min walk away and exploring Brooklyn (especially the flea market) was great too. The washer and dryer is also handy. No problems at all and we will be recommending Renee to our friends. Thank you!

We had a great stay at Renee's apartment. It is clean, light and spacious as well as being charming as it is in a renovated Brownstone with lots of original features. It is in a quiet residential area but it took us just under 10 minutes to walk to the Metro ( the A and C Lines) and then  another 15 minutes to reach Manhattan. The A Line also goes directly to the airtrain at JFK. The apartment is in a vibrant area with lots of shops and restaurants but after 8 weeks travelling we decided to cook for ourselves. This was easy in Renee's well equipped kitchen and with a very good supermarket about 5 minutes walk away. Just a few steps away there were several corner stores where you could get the basics such as milk and bread. All written communication  was  very easy with Renee and she was very amiable when she greeted us on arrival and  later on when she provided us with further advice and assistance during our week long stay. This was a great place to stay to finish our 9 week holiday. Highly recommended!
4.5 stars. Great place for the price. Lots of yummy local eats!

This is a very nice and clean apartment. Renee is a very attentive and helpful host. The subway to Manhattan is an easy 10 minute walk. But I found the area pretty rough and from the point of shopping and going out, it simply doesnt cater for any good grocery stores or cafes/restaurant. I did find this a drawback.

My son and I spent an awesome week in New York in October. The weather was great: sun was shining from a cloudless sky  – and New York offered us all kinds of wonderful experiences from rock concerts to ballet to walks in the beautiful Central Park. In the evenings it was great to come back to Renées beautiful house. The apartment was roomy, bright and quiet and everything was just as promised. Renée was veryhelpful and friendly and we will definitely come back again.

We had a great stay with Renee, the apartment is exactly as in the description, very well located 10 minutes walk from the metro station which drove us 20 minutes to Manhattan. Renee is very nice, helpful and available. We recomand this apartment for a couple or even a couple and 2 children because there 2 beds appoins very good and the room is really great. Renee thank you again and good luck. Sophie and Marc

Well Renée is like everybody here says. Just amazing! Getting up in the middle of the night to let us in. Fixing breakfast. Well she is as good as it gets, so we highly recommend her to everybody. The apartment was great, the neighborhood were really nice. Some said it seemed to be a bit spooky but it wasn't. Felt like your really got the true New York. People in the streets was friendly and a close supermarket hit the spot. If we come back to N.Y, Renée is our first choose.

Renee was responsive and as nice as can be. My only complaint about the apartment: doors. The first time I closed the apartment door from the outside, the door knob came off in my hand. Renee quickly apologized and tightened it, but it was a reminder that this is an old house and some of the doors are a bit wonky.

The bedroom door will only stay closed with a chain lock from the inside, and the bathroom door was almost impossible to get to stay closed, even with the lock engaged. This may not be a problem if you are alone, or with a partner where privacy is not necessary, but among two friends it required warnings of "I'm walking past the bathroom now".

Other than that, the apartment was bright, roomy, and just a few minutes walk from the subway and LIRR. The kitchen was stocked with dishes and silverware, and there was random reading material lying around. Renee has made helpful signs on the walls with the WiFi password, local shop recommendations, and instructions on various plumbing quirks. We had no problem besides the doors.

Renee was a wonderful host. Met me at the apartment buildings entrance right on time and had the apartment looking perfect. In regards to the apartment it was very cozy and comfortable. I would stay here again for sure. The kitchen has every utensil needed to cook and enjoy a wonderful meal. Plus having a drier and washer was quiet handy.

Thanks again Renee! Hope to come back and stay again.

We adored Laurie's place. We felt very at home and Laurie looked after us completely. The house is beautiful and cosy, the bed super comfy and the neighbourhood peaceful. Thank you for making us so welcome Laurie! xxx
Such a fantastic place to stay! Laurie really knows the area and it's close to everything. A gorgeous house and everything you need is easy to find. Comfortable bed too and spacious inviting room.

Loved this stay! Laurie had the most detailed guest guide I’ve ever seen, and the house is in a perfect location in Park Slope. Super close to the trains and lots of great food and fun stuff. I think I skimmed the listing so I didn’t realize the bathroom was shared — make note of this! It wasn’t a problem most of the time, but I did have one morning where I had to use the bathroom and had to wait a while for another guest. Everything is super clean, and the shower pressure is great — the water can get extremely hot (a plus!) so be mindful of that if you’re like me and just turn on the hot water and get in — I wouldn’t attempt that!

Laurie gave great advice about neighborhoods for apartments, and taking the trains. She has lots of neighborhood guides and maps, and little notes with instructions everywhere.

I’d highly recommend this stay if you’re looking for an affordable stay in a great part of Brooklyn. I miss it already!
Laurie, her home, and the neighborhood are all lovely. Extremely convenient for my mom and me to get around and my mom especially enjoyed the abundant artwork in the house.
If you are planning on running around the city all day then this is a great place to stay! It’s a great location and not overpriced.

I loved staying with Laurie in her fun, quirky, and very comfortable home. Her descriptions and communications were very complete and clear. (Do heed her notes on the stairs, you'll be getting your exercise!) Her handbook is fantastic -- i have never seen one like it! It was a true pleasure to meet Laurie in person, and given the great  location, i will stay with her again the next chance i get to visit BK! Solidarity forever!

Easy check- In process although getting up the stairs with a checked back was a little challenging. Really great location. The building, and surrounding buildings were beautiful to look at. A lot of great bars and resturants close by and location was close to subway which was nice. Laurie provided a booklet with all the best spots,  directions on how to get to and from the airport, etc.

Staying at Laurie’s was great! She was extremely flexible and allowed us to check in early from the airport! Laurie was very friendly and had great recommendations of things to do! Her place was walkable to a lot public transport access points! Great stay!

The loft is great and the room very comfortable. Maciek and Jason are pleasant hosts and they will give you all sorts of useful information on the city, plus the L-train station is just a few steps away!
Great apartment, great host and a great neighborhood. Just remember, be prepared for going up and down five flights of stairs.

Apartment was clean and tidy, and the location was great, in terms of being near a lot of cool vintage shops, cafes etc.
Quite a walk from the subway though, and a lot of stairs so only take this apartment if you're fit lol.
There was a construction site right next to the building, which at times didn't affect me, other times it did. In the last week of my stay I had to shower in a bikini to avoid embarrassing situations as builders were at eye level with me. Also, at times the construction was very loud. As I'm a student this place was very expensive for me yet the location was the factor that made this place worthwhile, and the acceptable level of cleanliness (this is important to me). What a cool neighbourhood! I wish i lived there.
Corey was a kind and helpful host which i appreciated. thanks
Corey was super awesome, especially considering my last minute request. The place was amazing and in such an great location. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great time in this apartment. Neighborhood is close to interesting restaurants so 5th floor aprt is a great help actually. Corey  responded very quickly to our emails and everything worked out perfectly. Great place to stay in NYC

We spent a great week in Coreys apartement. The apartement was clean and cozy and a perfect base for exploring NYC. Lots of nice restaurants in the neighbourhood. Corey was very helpful and always responded quickly to emails. We can definitely recommend the place!

Me and my sister stayed at Coreys place for four nights and we arrived and left his place smiling and happy. Communication with Corey was perfect, as well before the trip as also when we were there - he was always available to help us with questions and also provided cool ideas for things to do during our stay. Corey's appartment was awesome - it suited us perfect. The five floors up to his appartment proved to be a bit tricky with our luggage, but the view and the appartment made up for that asap. The bathroom was a bit dirty, but other than that we loved the apartment and the neighborhood it's in - we hardly even left it! Overall, I would highly recommend Corey's place and if I ever go back to NYC, I will definitely stay at his place again!

Corey has a great apartment. You will not be disappointed. The location is ideal, centrally located to all the top spots in NYC.
Corey's keeps the place in great condition with antique decoration abound.
I highly recommend this rental. Best decision of our trip.
We look forward to be repeat customers.
Corey was a great host and everything was completely smooth. Would come back for sure!

This was my first non-hotel experience and I loved every second of it.  Corey is like an old friend in the city -- always there to offer a suggestion on where to eat, and he makes the check in and check out process a breeze.  The location is perfect for experiencing the East Village, and is a quick cab ride from the Upper East Side or Mid Town. The apartment is quite, clean, accommodating and if you like putting, the hallway has a groovy putting green -- rather fabulous! I loved browsing his book collection and his funky slate table sets the tone for the decor.  And if that is not enough, I left with the best legs in NYC.  His 5th floor walk up is only a problem is you make it so, it never phased me.  I'll most certainly be back as a guest of Corey's.

We stayed 10 days in this appartement and it was great !
Clean, Well located, five minutes walk to the subway.
Corey was really helpfull, kind and reactivs to our requests!
The only thing is the 5th floor without elevator !
A great experience !!

Great apartment, would definitely stay again! Very good communications from Corey with flexible check-in and check-out times. The pad has all that you need and the 5th floor is great exercise! East Village is a very cool part of town and the pad is right the heart of it, great location.

We had a great stay at Corey's place! He made the whole experience really easy, and the apartment was clean and just as described. It felt very cozy and was a great home away from home to explore the city. Wonderful host and apartment. We would definitely stay here again!
Great apartment, great neighbourhood, great guy!

just returned from long weekend in the city at Corey's place. Corey and his apartment definitely lived up to their reputation. the whole experience was seamless. Corey was easy to contact before and during. we would definitely return. thanks Corey!

Awesome stay.  We couldn't have asked for better accommodations.  Both Maciek and Jason were helpful in letting us know about some of the lesser places you should see in NYC.  Will defiantly try to book them next time we come to NYC.

Great apartment, Maciek and Jason are both really nice and helpful.
They can recommend you galleries and let you know about what is going on in the NYC art world.

Our stay at the flat was great! Super clean and charming, warm and cozy.  The guys were very friendly great to chat with them after our long outings out and about town. The L train , which is just up the street takes you to Union Square in under 30 minutes. After our visit we hope to move to Williamsburg next summer. Would love to stay with the guys again!

Maciek and his flatmate Jason are two young artists who are very helpful and kind they immediately asked me what questions I had to ask them.

With their assistance I managed to find my way around New York finding Brooklyn an interesting and safe neighbourhood, the apartment being close to the Metro.

When I am next in New York I will book to stay with them again.
These guys were great, very friendly, great hosts, and very accommodating. I can call them friends now and if I ever go back to NY I will definitely stay here.
Maciek and Jason were the perfect hosts, I really enjoyed my stay and the loft is a really relaxing and comfortable place to hang out.  Thanks guys!

Perfect host, perfect accomodation!
I feel like home.
Great position, very close to L train, quiet and safe.
Maciek was a great host.  Really enjoyed staying in his fantastic pad - huge apartment right by the subway.  Recommend.
C'est bon!

I stayed at Corey's for the weekend, the location is excellent and the apartment is unique and inviting.

Corey was great - he was always available to answer my questions and provide suggestions. He even dropped off some extra household supplies to ensure my stay went smoothly. I would visit again!

We enjoyed two wonderful weeks in Coreys apartment. It was so nice to return to a cosy home after spending a long (warm) day walking around in NYC. Corey was quick to respond to every question we had during our stay. The neighborhood is cool and fuld of life during day- and nighttime, but the apartment stayed nice and quiet. A tip: We started every day with a walk on the rooftop with the amazing view, just to get in the New York mood.
We will definitely come back.

Thank you so much Corey.

Staying at Corey's place was a breeze, we had everything we needed and the place was spic n' span! Perfect location, restaurant recommendations, we couldn't have chosen a better spot to spend a weekend in the city! Thanks again.

I stayed for three weeks at Corey's place. I had a wonderful time. Apartment was perfect, clean and the neighborhood was very lively and nice. Corey was very helpful regarding questions, I would definitely like to come back some time!

My girlfriend and I had a great stay at Corey's place. Corey was very accommodating and recommended  some restaurants. No surprises here; the listing describes a cozy, clean, well decorated apartment, close to restaurants and bars, and that's what we got. Thanks Corey for letting us stay at your place!

Me and my husband spent a week at Corey's and We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is just like it's shown in the photos and a wonderfull experience to live like a new yorker for a few days. Besides all that, Corey was a very easy-going person and always helpfull with us. We definitly recommend it. Thank you, Corey!
We had a great time here, it's a great place to stay in a great location. Corey was very helpful!

Corey's place was amazing. It was right in the heart of East Village located next to many wonderful cafes shops and restaurants. I enjoyed the detail he placed in his apartment. He answered all my questions immediately if I called with any concerns. This location and apartment is a deal!

If you are looking for a cool and cozy place to stay: here you are!!! The apartment looks exactly like shown on the photos! You'll find everything you need and a host that replies quickly to all your questions. The view from the roof is amazing and the neighbourhood offers loads of restaurants and cute little shops. The next station is in walking distance as well as the next bus stop. It's not very touristy so you really get the NY feeling :)

We'll definitely recommend your appartment, Corey!!

I loved staying in Corey's cool apartment. The location is perfect - loads of bars/restaurants in the area, close to the foot of Williamsburg bridge, so Brooklyn is easy to get to (took me about 20 mins by bike). Hip Soho is just across Houston, and West Village/the High Line are 30 mins walk. The flat itself is also great, and organising keys etc was a breeze. I'd definitely stay here again.

Corey was awesome! He was very attentive and kind. The location is great and the place was very comfortable and clean. The only down side is that it's on the 5th floor but shall not discourage energetic New York visitors :)

My husband and I have just returned from 6nights at Corey's apartment - it was perfect. A good size apartment - clean,cozy and filled with interesting antiques. The view of NYC from the roof is also incredible. -day and night. Corey was a great host, immediately responding to any requests for recommendations as to where best to eat/drink. The walk to the subway is only 10 minutes from the apartment and means you get to soak up the east village culture which has lots of great bars,cafés and restaurants. Would definitely recommend this apartment.

If you've ever wanted to live in New York, Corey's apartment is the perfect place to pretend you do.  Amazing neighborhood, a million great places to eat and drink within stumbling distance, and everything you need in the apartment (super comfy bed, hair dryer, toiletries, cable TV) but this is New York, so you may have to run the shower for a solid 10 minutes for the quirky plumbing to bring forth the hot water.  Corey was super responsive and helpful, and the check-in, check-out process was nice and easy.  Apartment was very clean.

Corey's homey and artistic pad was a great way to spend a couple days in the East Village. Just like the pictures, and very clean. Location is awesome. Feel like a New Yorker for a couple days. Don't forget the five flights of stairs, but the exercise is good for you after a night out!

Corey was also super accommodating and responsive about everything -- check-in, check-out, local tips, and graciously helping me when I had to change dates. Recommended!

Perfect! Can't wait to come back! So comfortable, so impeccably styled. The books on Corey's shelf alone make you feel at home. Plus, the lower east side is the only place we want to be. Everything, everything, everything was easy and perfect. Walk to subway is farther than some, but more than worth it since you're in an awesome 'hood already. Plus, you know, walk a little, it's good for you. Corey was the most responsive and helpful Airbnb host we've had so far. He even offered to help park our car! This guy's incredible. Rent from him.
The reservation was canceled 4 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Corey's East Village pad did not disappoint. It was clean, comfortable and indeed cozy. It was a joy to return "home" after a day spent like locals sampling New York's finest.

We also found great eateries close by, from local fast food, to scrumptious Belgian waffles to "fancy" lobster rolls - all within walking distance !

Corey was very responsive to all requests and inquiries and I would definitely recommend him and his apartment !
Corey was awesome to work with and the apartment was great. We'd definitely stay again. Thanks for everything Corey!

Where to begin??!!  Corey was responsive, friendly and check-in was convenient and flexible.  The apartment was ideal.  Between the awesome location with tons of boutiques, restaurants and bars nearby, to the cozy and comfortable apartment, we couldn't have lucked out with a better spot for the weekend.  I instantly felt at home in his place and loved the decor and space in every way.  I had spent much time in the Alphabet City/East Village area, but it instantly became one of my favourite spots in NYC.  Without hesitation we would stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking to experience a more "authentic" NYC.

We had a great weekend in New York thanks to Cory and his wonderful apartment.  The apartment is charming, with plenty of space for the two of us, and every amenity would could need.  Located in the East Village, it was just a short walk to great food, shopping and the subway.  We'd happily stay here again.

Corey's place is a great spot to stay in the East Village. The location is very convenient and very close to local restaurants and bars and a little park. Corey is a very friendly, helpful and responsive host. The apartment is cute and clean, the internet was a bit slow but perhaps this is part of living in multimillion city. Overall we had an enjoyable Christmas at his place.

Just perfect. A cozy little apartment in the best and mist lively neighbourhood you can imagine. Its an old building and the pipes makkes a bit of noise when its very cold - as in very very cold - but beside that, its just about all you need for a very autentic stay in NY. And the best part is Corey, even though I didnt get to meet him. He was very attentative and delivered dozens of tips and advices. The perfect host!
A tip from me to you, would be to have dinner at the peruvian restaurant "cerveceria" a few bloks away. Fantastic food, vine and beer. Maybe the best "value for money" I've tried in my life.
I send all the best recommendations Corey way.
The apartment was as amazing as the pictures show! The hosts were very easy to contact and responsive. What a great find and amazing location.

What a lovely place! The apartment is adorable and makes you feel at home. Perfect location too, Xiren was a great host and very reactive! She gave very good recommendations of restaurants, bars... in the neighborhood. I will definitely come back.
Apartamento muy bonito en una zona muy buena. 2 lineas de metro cercanas. El único problema las escaleras pero sólo subíamos una vez al día. Xiren una gran anfitriona. Para repetir.

Great pad in a great area. Xiren was very helpful with advice on where to go. People aren't kidding, it is at the top of 5 flights of stairs but well worth it. I'd stay again if back in NYC. Thanks for a great stay Xiren!

WoW! Our stay was just perfect! The pad was exactly like on the pics. Quiet during the night, cozy and confy.
East village is a well situated borough to visit NYC.
Xiren is a great host! She ansewered to all of our questions very fast and with good advices. She really made us feel confortable. Can't wait to come back! Thanks Xiren! :-)

My husband and I just stayed at this apartment last weekend and had a great stay. We never met the hosts, just conveniently picked up and dropped off keys at the deli across the street so everything was very flexible. We weren't in the apartment much but it was cute and perfect for our needs, and quiet in the bedroom considering it was in a very central part of the East Village. A couple notes that others have likely said-- this apartment is on the 6th floor, so it's a bit of a workout if you are carrying lots of luggage! And there's some construction going on in the building during weekdays, but we could only hear it from the kitchen area closest to the entrance. Overall it was a very pleasant stay and the host was very accommodating!
Very cozy!!! Everything felt as if I were at home although I was just a visitor. Renee is great, this will probably be the only place I stay when I come back to New York

I've visited NY for short time with work related agenda and stayed at Renee's place. It was as described - quiet, bright and spacious! Strategic location - just in the centre of my roads - work, friends and the airport. I did enjoy my very first experience with airbnb.

Renée's place is wonderful!!!! My friend and I stayed 10 days here in this apartment and we really appreciated the whole experience. Renée was there when we arrived and showed us every detail and actually she left a lot of printed informations in the apartment. When we were there, I thought winter is already done but actually not that much(well, there do have people wearing shirts, but that's not my case…), but the heating system in the bedroom is very good. The neighborhood is calm and there is train A, C to connect with Manhattan for all the tourist things. And one of the great thing in this apartment is the washing machine and the dryer, pretty convenient when you don't wanna pack up too much clothes during the trip and leave more space for the shopping things:)

Anyway, it's a great choice and make us sad to leave, but for sure we'll choose it again with this price and this space!

This was the third time in the apartment - like coming home. This time we hired both apartments, the upper one for the grown up children. Thank you again Renée for your kindness taking care of ordering transfer from the airport. Furthermore you were  such a great help, when our daughter got ill and needed to see a doctor.

We enjoyed our first experience with airbnb! Renée is a very welcoming host. She is friendly, helpful and available if you need her. The apartment is lovely and very cozy. It's a 10 minutes walk to the metro-station and a grocery store. It took us about 20 minutes to reach Manhattan. (A and C line) On our last day Renée arranged a ride with her neighbor for us, who dropped us off at the JFK-airport. This made it so much easier than taking the metro! After a crazy day in the city, it's so nice to come home to this place!

We had a few lovely days in Renée's flat. She was an amazing host! Although, we saw her only briefly at the end of our stay, she had managed to prepare everything perfectly for our stay. Everything we needed was there - the bed was comfy, the furniture made us feel at home immediately, and everthing was super clean. The flat is located in a calm and green street and the next tram station is not even 10 minutes away. It is very easy to reach Manhattan with the A-line from here. But more importantly, the flat and its surroundings are wonderful for gathering enough energy to sustain the busy life of Manhattan. Also all the other lovely places in Brooklyn can be easily reached from Renée's flat (btw, one should take more time to discover Brooklyn).
We can't wait to come to Brooklyn and Renée's flat again!

Renée was kind and amiable. The apartment was clean, cozy, spacious and lovely. You can almost find everything you need (including toiletry, hair dryer, detergent, etc.) in the apartment. My family and I had a great time during our stay in Brooklyn. We were a bit concerned about the safety in the neighborhood, but after we moved in we found that the area was quite safe. We usually went back to the apartment at around 10-11 p.m. and the neighborhood was tranquil. By and large, it was a great experience.

Great space, was perfect for my mother and aunt who were staying in town. The kitchen had basic cooking utensils (pots, pans, mugs, etc) and a washing machine. Renee was very kind, welcoming, and helpful.
Will definitely have family/friends stay here in the future.

I spent a pleasant 2 weeks staying in Renée's apartment. Everything was clean, the furniture comfy and the place looks exactly as in the photographs.
Renée responded immediately when i had any questions and the check-in/check-out process was very smooth and painless.
This apartment would suit anyone looking to stay in a genuine brownstone in an authentic Brooklyn neighbourhood.

It was indeed real pleasure to stay and live in
Renee's apartment for the second time! She is a wonderful host - there is no doubt - very kind and flexible. Brooklyn and the neighborhood is changing on our eyes becoming a vibrant place.
Everything was perfect and exactly the same as advertised. Thank you so much Renee - we can't wait to visit you for the third time! Marta, Matylda and Andrzej.

Hi, 4 of us from Cape Town South Africa stayed at Renee's place from the 29/08 to the 04/09/14. We found the place to be exactly as it is described on Airbnd. It was clean and spacious and comfortably fitted all 4 of us! There were 1 or 2 things we required but this was seen to by Renee. The area was very interesting and the road the house is in is very pretty. There was a lot of noise over the weekend (labour day weekend), music and people staying upstairs coming and going throughout the night. Due to the wooden floor boards the noise travels. While we were woken up the first night we eventually got used to it after that. We were on holiday so just dealt with it. The subway was about 13 mins walk each day. We felt safe walking about at night (went to a Yankee game one evening and got back quite late). People were very friendly and Brooklyn is a very interesting suburb. It was our first trip to the USA and we enjoyed our time there. Renee is very friendly and helpful.

My friend Mariam and I really enjoyed our stay at Maciek & Jason's. We shared some very interesting conversations :), and they were friendly, welcoming and unobtrusive of our stay.
Train station (L Line) is unbelievably close, and I would recommend staying here if you are after a true New York experience!
Thanks guys!

This loft had so much character, as did its hosts, Maciek and Jason. They were extremely well-versed in the wonderful world of music, film, fine art, and literature. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to find an authentic, affordable New York location.

the room was very nice and the bed super confortble! The loft was a great place to stay in NY and Maciek and Jason are two lovely persons!
If we comeback to NY we definitely stay at his place!

Maciek is a really nice guy. I very much enjoyed staying at his place. We both laughed when we found out that staying at hotels is so boring, so if that sounds familiar to you, you should definitely check this out.
my room was really comfortable and the location was perfect for transiting to manhanttan and elsewhere. great collection of dvds and books

The apt was very close to the subway, only a minute walk away so perfect for late nights out and easy access to get back safely for single travellers. Plus having your own set of keys was useful. Direct line on the L train, only 10 mins away from vibrant Bedford Ave in Brooklyn.

Nice ergonomic foam pillows, friendly hosts and a good restaurant and bakery list compiled. It was very helpful to know tips for methods of transport via subway or bus routes from JFK and upon check-out.

This was our first Airbnb experience and everything worked out just fine. Renée was a welcoming host. She showed us the appartment when we arrived and was always available if we needed anything. We were able to store our luggage  in her own appartment during our day of departure which was really helpful. The appartment was clean and looked basically like on the pictures. It is located close to the A-train (express train) which gets you quickly into Manhattan. We did not use the kitchen, however supermarkets in the neighborhood are available. We had a great time in New York City and staying in Renée's appartment was a good choice for us. We would definitely recommend her place.

Good things:
Lovely apartment, lots of space, lots of light, great kitchen, original 1920's floors and doors- very nice preservation. Very clean!! Renee was very nice!

Not as good:
The bathroom door doesn't completly close. Not a big issue, theres a loundry basket we used to keep it closed. The neighborhood seems unpleasant at first but it was not a probleme, no one bothered us.

Thank you Renee :)

We had a great stay in Renee's apartment! Renee was very welcoming and happy to provide any tips. The apartment looked exactly as the pictures and was very comfortable. It was within walking distance to the subway station which could get us into Manhattan in 20 mins and was a 10 minute cab ride to Williamsburg. We were warned by friends about the neighbourhood, however we felt safe and comfortable the whole time. It felt like our own home for those few days. I would definitely stay again :)

L'accueil a été très chaleureux à notre arrivée; Renée s'est montrée discrète mais nous savions à tout moment que nous pouvions la joindre ou la voir; c'est très appréciable !
L'appartement est vraiment bien situé, proche du métro et toutes commodités.
Ce quartier de Bedford est vraiment sympa; c'est exactement ce que nous recherchions. Spacieux, lumineux et bien aménagé l'appartement répondait à toutes nos attentes. Nous avons vraiment passé un excellent séjour !

Renee was very welcoming and helpful.  The apartment is just as described and a good place to stay.  The neighbour hood is very interesting, with some good places to eat (great food at the Hot House) and Renee had good recommendations regarding local amenities

A lovely, clean, beautiful and well equipped apartment close to the subway station. Good value for the money.
Renee was very friendly and helpful - a pleasure to deal with. Will definitely book again next time when in New York.
バスルームのドアが壊れていたことと、そこまで治安が良いとは思わなかった。それ以外はとても良く、快適に過ごせた。

Renée was lovely, warm and welcoming. The apartment is clean, spacious, warm and homely. Bed-Stuy is great, met the nicest people in the neighbourhood, and it's close enough to all the usual hotspots while still feeling like a unique NY experience. Can't fault it at all.

Staying at the apartment was great. It is just as advertised, very clean with everything you need for a pleasant stay. While my mom and sister were there, the weather in New York was very cold, and the apartment was always warm and inviting. Renée is very kind and accommodating.
The neighborhood is also great. We ate at Peaches Hothouse around the corner and had an easy commute to Manhattan on the A.
We definitely recommend this apartment! We were lucky to find a place like this.

We have been ten days in this apartment and we can to say that it's very comfortable. It's got good calefaction, the kitchen has all the neccesary for cooking and It has washer and dryer. Renée is very friendly, she always helped in everything and plus the last day she called us a taxi for to go to the airport. About the transport, you have a subway around 5 minutes walking, the line A goes directly to Manhattan, you only must to know that it's not recommendable to come back very late home because the subway can to be dangerous. we were good in the neighborhood but the people says that it's better not walking for the street in the night because Brooklyn can to have not good areas. thank you so much.

Renée was very warm and welcoming, and also respectful of our privacy, as we prefer to keep to ourselves. We appreciated that she accommodated our early check-in, especially on Christmas eve.

The apartment was large, warm and fully equipped. We were looking for a comfortable, convenient place to stay as we explored New York City, and not only did we find that in Renée's apartment, we also found a place to feel at home for a week for a great price.

Thanks, Renée!
Todo estuvo perfecto. ..la casa es divina  como  en las fotos  calentita cómoda y acogedora. La ubicación es genial ya que la línea Ayudarme de su te llega al todas partes

Renee's flat has kind of magic power,we fell in love with it when arrived.This brownstone apartment is bright with high ceiling,warm and comfortable that we wish could stay whole day in the flat and do nothing.Renee's taste of decoration is good too.We really had a very pleasant stay.

We all love this neighborhood as well,the street we lived is calm but outside is vivid with the spirit of grass root.7 mins walk to subway,some nice cafe and cheap food supermarket nearby...we experienced a real local Brooklyn life style i think.

Renee is helpful not just when she was there,through MSG,her reply is always fast and negotiable.

We're all happy and feel lucky to meet Renee's place by chance from airbnb,it made our NY trip more colorful.Wish we could come back in the future and definitely will recommend to friends.

I had a very nice stay at Renée place's. It is my second time with her and not my Last for sure. The appartment was clean as usual. Very nice to stay and very safe. Renee is such a Lovely person and she does her best to make sure her guests stay in very good condition.
The appartment has everything we need and it is about 15 minutes to get Manahattan.
I 100% recommend this appartment .


J'ai passé un très bon séjour chez Renée. Ce fut ma deuxième fois chez elle et pas la dernière c est sur. L'appartement était propre comme d'habitude. Endroit idéal et sans danger.
Renée est une personne très charmante qui fait son maximum pour que ses clients soient satisfaits.
L'appartement à tout ce qu'il faut et est à seulement 15 minutes de manahattan.
Je recommande à 100% cet appartement.

El apartamento estaba bien. Era muy amplio y tenía todo lo necesario. Renée fue muy amable y simpática cuando la necesitamos.
El edificio está a unos 7/8 minutos de 2 paradas de metro. El barrio es tranquilo, nosotros no tuvimos ningún problema.
La relación calidad/precio (teniendo en cuenta lo que vimos en otros anuncios) realmente buena.

We had a great time staying in Xiren's apartment. The was place was lovely - homely, with great decor and a very comfy bed! It had everything we needed (incl speakers) and was in a really nice area of town with lots of good bars/cafés/restaurants (and about10/15 walk to the subway). Xiren was extremely helpful, replying quickly and being very accommodating on our check out time. Overall we'd definitely recommend this place if you're visiting NYC!

Our stay was seamless and very enjoyable. This apartment is in a great location, with plenty of bars, restaurants and a subway stop nearby. Xiren was very accommodating and helpful in the run-up to our stay, and there were no hiccups with access. We also got a run-down of the local highlights in an email, which was very much appreciated.

The apartment itself was cozy and warm. The living room is a great space and very nicely decorated, and there are tons of books and magazines to read and even video games to play if that's your thing. The bedroom was nice and quiet (we expected it to be louder, given the area), and the fan ensured it didn't get too hot.

Xiren was also very easy-going regarding check in and out times - we arrived early in the morning and left late in the evening on different days, which was no problem. Of course, the price was very competitive as well.

A couple of small gripes. The stairs to the apartment are a bit tough - five stories up - but you get used to it! The bathroom could have been cleaner as well; the shower curtain was a bit dirty, and the wall tiles and bathtub themselves look pretty old. But really, it wasn't that much of a big deal for us given the experience as a whole.

This is a great option in a fantastic neighbourhood!

We had a fantastic time! The neighborhood is great, lots of recommendations from Xiren worked out well. It's easy to get around via the subway. Do pack light; they aren't kidding about the stairs. The place is nice and clean with Buddhas keeping you company, lots of light and nice plants. A great place to crash while you're visiting the best city in the world.

Xiren's place is absolutely lovely. It's a magical little oasis in the Lower East Side.

It's a 5 floor walkup, but when you walk in the door it's perfect. It was kept perfectly clean and has some really funky style.

From the start of the booking process, until the moment we left, Xiren made me feel like I had made a great choice in choosing her apartment. She gave us updates on the weather, gave us a list of her preferred dining and drinking spots (of which there are PLENTY around the neighbourhood) and graciously allowed us to check-in much earlier than originally planned when I accidentally miscalculated the time we needed to  check-in. The apartment was exactly as described and in pictures. It had a lovely, personal warmth to it without it being cluttered, and was the perfect base for exploring NYC. It was like a quiet urban sanctuary, and gave us the opportunity to rest peacefully after a day of walking and exploring the city.  Thank you Xiren for allowing us to experience your beautiful home.

Xiren made my trip extremely easy and comfortable. The place is beautiful, very clean, and in a convenient location. She went out of her way to make sure everything was prepared for. Great place to say.
Fantastic place to stay! Extremely helpful hosts. Would absolutely stay again.

Xiren's Apartment was very beautiful and clean! This place was intellectual, creative, fun and cozy. Home away from home. The location was perfect (only a few blocks from the subway and in a neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars). Xiren was very polite and very responsive. She also went out of her way to provide tips on Brunch and Bars. Thank you very much Xiren!!!
Thanks Xiren, it's the perfect location to explore New York. The apartment was lovely, the east village had so much going on & all of NYC so easily accessible. Perfection! Recommend to everyone!
An extremely warm host, with an amazingly charming east village apartment. Loved every moment of our stay there. Highly recommend!

The apartment was all that we expected it to be. Xiren was super nice,
sending us emails to check if everything was ok and if anything was needed.
Communication before we arrived was straight forward and effortless as well as the check in and check out process. It was a surprise how quiet it was in the apartment during the night and such, even though the windows were open. The location is great in a lively surrounding, with plenty of bars and resturants and away from the tourist traps. We tried some places that Xiren recommended with great success. Highly recommended, we would definetly stay there again!

Xiren's apartment is a beautiful, cozy and creative place. It is located in walking distance not only to lots of restaurants and bars in East Village, but also to more touristy places and shopping districts.
Xiren was very polite, obliging and flexible.
Thank you very much!

We stayed a week at Xiren's place and had a great time. Here you'll find an inspiring place, with a suuuuper comfy bed, that has just the right space for your travel needs in NYC. You'll find 2 subway lines at walking distance and yes the stairs are no joke ;)
Xiren is a very helpful host. She will give you top tips for the spots to hit in the surrounding area. Don't miss those.
If I where you, I'd booking it right away.

Maciek is a really cool guy. When you're coming from europe and seeking for a very clean and comfortable place, this is definitely the right one to stay at. He's an expert of healthy food and can give you plenty of inside recommends about the local restaurants.
super! nice people, great location, thanx again.  Martin

Maciek has a lovely spacious apartment. He was very friendly and easy to talk to.
He gave us great information with regards ton where to go, how to get around and where to get great food. A little far from the action but when all public transports are running fine, it's easy to get to manhattan.

I really enjoyed my stay at Maciek's!  I didn't have much time in the place as I was out enjoying the city most of my time.  When I was there, it was quiet and relaxing.  The best convenience was the location to the L train... only a minutes walk away.  I think the space caters the best to the young at heart 18-40 age group.  I don't think my parents would be happy with it whereas I was ready to make the place mine and be a Brooklynite!
We had a wonderful time in New York City, and staying with Maciek was a real pleasure. He was very helpful and accommodating

The place is very spacious and clean. It locates 20ft from the Dekalb subway station. But be careful, because there are actually two Dekalb stations in Brookline... Pay attention to that one!~ Maciek and his flatmate are both very nice and gentle. And the decoration of the loft and books/dvd collection in the room show great test of the host.

Perfect transportation. It takes 1 minute from the house to subway station.
Very cozy bed and clean room. I really enjoyed for 4 days
Maciek was very accommodating and was very quick to respond to all my messages and inquiries. Five stars all the way.

Superb location; extremely close to the L train at DeKalb. Apartment was well kept and tastefully furnished. Maciek and his roommate were both very welcoming and provided excellent tips on what to do and where to eat.

Maciek is a rad guy! Recommend anyone taking a first trip to nyc  to stay here he's knowledgeable  and it's easy to get around town at the location really helpful dude and always has good tunes going!

Maciek's place in Brooklyn is amazing. During our trip, he gave us a lot of freedom to use everything in his apartment and also provided us with great recommendations in terms of where to eat and what to do in New York City. It was really easy to communicate with Maciek, and his apartment is located perfectly - right next to a subway station that takes you to Manhattan in just a few minutes. I can definitely recommend staying here and would love to come back some day. Thanks Maciek!

Maciek's place is fantastic. It's spacious, quiet with lots of natural light and everything you need to feel at home away from home. It's also conveniently located very close to the subway and only a 15-minute journey to Manhattan.

Maciek and his housemate, Claudine were equally fantastic - very warm and welcoming with great local knowledge. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in New York because of their hospitality.
Maciek was a very gracious host. I would highly recommend! Very safe and close to everything in Bushwick. A++

We recommend staying in this great apartment!Bed is comfy, the living room is amazing. Maciek is a good and useful host with a lot of tips and suggestions on what to eat and do in New York:) We wished we had time to explore more the location where the apartment is as there seem to be a really nice area with bars and restaurants and a lot of impressive graffiti.

I loved this place.  Firstly, Maciek was a great host and an interesting and kind human being.  The place itself is very warm and comfortable.  The plants, artwork, and decorations really made feel at home.  Very much an artists loft and a great place to stay.  The fact that the subway is less than a hundred yards away is beyond convenient.  You're in the city in no time.  The neighborhood is cool too and there are plenty of Deli's and shops and places to eat with a a few blocks walking distance. Maciek will let you know where to find what you're looking for, just ask him.  I thought the lack of Air Conditioning would be issue but it turned out to be a non-factor, as was the wiping of the shower.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone that would ask.
Everything was great — exactly as listed and consistent with my expectations. The room itself was clean, comfortable, and private. Maciek was very accommodating and helpful in getting situated.

The place was exactly what it was supposed to be. Bushwick is a fantastic district, full of art! The appartment's on L subway to Manhattan.
Maciek is a very nice person. He took me to great places. Moreover he used to travel a lot and is mostly interested on other cultures!
Yeah, great location, great space. Suited me perfectly.

Maciek and his roommate were very nice, and they were even accommodating enough to take in stride the dumb mistake I made when I occupied the wrong room. The place is right next to the train, and it's in a lively Latino area.
A great room in a convenient location. Host is great and has helpful recommendations.

Beautiful loft and space! Just down the street from the subway, which was very convenient. Maciek was very responsive to any texts or emails I sent him and he was friendly.  Only issue was the bathroom was a little difficult to get ready in, but other than that it was perfect! I'd definitely recommend staying here to any friend or family member.

Maciek was a great host.  Despite the fact that his work schedule kept him busy and away from the flat most of the time I was there he made sure everything was in order and was quick to respond to any questions I had.  The flat is well located right off the L subway line, so travel into Manhattan is a cinch.   I wish I could have stayed in New York longer and would gladly have spent those extra nights here.
Experience was great, everything was as described.  Very highly reccomended

This was my very first airbnb experience . I selected Maciek's place because Im sick of the typical ' hotel ' experience and visiting NY I felt the loft atmosphere w/ gorgeous window light would be just perfect for the weekend. My jaw dropped once i walked into Macieks loft that evening I came into town a tad bit late , just GORGEOUS ATMOSPHERE . Very spacious . Roomy and quiet neighbourhood !

He was also very awesome coordinating a place for me to pick up a key because I was late . I also want to note that he was very quick responding back to his messages which i feel is very important when hosting a place !

I feel very fortunate to have met him shortly before he had to take off to SF ; he had alot of fun places that he recommended to visit ( Totto Ramen, MoMa )

Wifi connection was top notch . Subway is literally 2 minute walk . The building itself is pretty rad . Its safe to say that when I return to NYC , ill definitely be reaching out to Maciek once more !

I ABSOLUTELY HIS PLACE !!

10 out of 10 ! Thank you Maciek !

Maciek's place is beautiful, spacious, very clean, large windows with plenty of sunlight. The location of his apartment is literally right around the corner from the subway station- very convenient. He was very responsive to emails and was very helpful when I asked him questions. I would no doubt come back to stay, he was a great host, never got to meet him but we thoroughly enjoyed our 2 nights at his place.

Ho veramente apprezzato questo loft a Brooklyn ricavato da un un ex spazio industriale. L'appartamento è molto confortevole e luminoso, la camera piccola ma comoda e pulita. Maciek era fuori per lavoro ma il suo compagno d'appartamento Devin è stato molto gentile e ospitale. L'appartamento è a meno di un minuto dalla fermata della linea L che porta a Manhattan in circa 40 min. Soggiornare a Brooklyn per me è la scelta migliore, qurtiere in forte ascesa, più a misura d'uomo di Manhattan e pieno di locali (soprattuto in zona Williamsburg) per la sera e di negozi d'arte/moda/design/mercatini di giorno. Se dovessi soggiornare nuovamente a New York, per me questa sarebbe sicuramente una delle prima opzioni (qualità prezzo ottima!)

We really enjoyed our stay at Maciek's apartment in Brooklyn. The place was clean, spacious and comfy with a creative vibe. Maciek was a excellence host who gave us really good tips on where to eat and drink, and even helped us get into the MoMA for much cheaper. The location was great, very up and coming area with craft beer bars and good restaurants close by. It's not too busy around that area too which is a nice relaxing break from the crowds of Manhattan. Would definitely recommend staying here. Thanks Maciek!

L’appartement est très bien situé au pied de la station de métro L qui nous amenait très rapidement dans Manhattan.
L’appartement est très similaire au photo, grand, lumineux et très bien décoré.
La chambre est conforme aux photos.
Quelques bémols, le matin les camions en bas de l’appartement sont extrêmement bruyants, impossible de faire la grasse matinée, nous étions réveillées à 7h…
La chambre aurait bien nécessité un bon coup d’aspirateur avant notre arrivée, il y avait pas mal de poussière.
Notre hôte était très discret voir un peu trop, nous aurions quand même bien apprécié qu’il nous donne quelques consignes pour l’appartement à savoir comment fonctionne la cuisinière, où se trouvent les couverts… Si bien que nous n’étions pas très à l’aise et nous n’avons jamais déjeuné ni pris un café à l’appartement.
Le rapport qualité prix reste tout de même très intéressant. C'est une bonne adresse.
Room and apartment were accurately described. The apartment is lovely and housemate James was very welcoming.

The apartment  was as described - we were actually surprised to see that it was so big! The apartment was clean and warm so we (3 adults and a child) felt very comfortable throughout the stay. Everything worked out very well with Renée, she responded to any questions super fast and was flexible about our  arriving / leaving schedules. Highly recommended!

Renée was the consummate hostess -- she welcomed me at the apartment, as I arrived, bedraggled and jetlagged, from the airport, and was unfailingly sunny and helpful throughout the stay. The place is marvelously cozy and comfortable, on a quiet and community-feeling block of BedStuy brownstones. Everything in the place worked fantastically well, and Renée responded to every request promptly and helpfully. I couldn't have asked for more!

This has been my third stay in this clean, bright and very cosy apartment, and it felt like coming home. To me, it is simply the best place to stay in New York City. Renée is a great host: very responsive, helpful and welcoming. I’m already planning to come back soon!
Fantastic! Great place, centrally located. Lots of light and comfortable, very clean and welcoming. Renée was a great host.

Renee was very helpful and even parked our vehicle for us early in the morning when it needed to be moved! She was extremely welcoming and even let us check in at 3 am! The neighborhood wasnt bad at all, parking is tough at night but during the day there are plenty of spots on the street..the subway is only a 10 min walk around the corner to get to Manhattan. Thanks!!

Appartement très clair, grand, propre, conforme au descriptif. Situé à 10 minutes de la station de métro qui vous amène à environ 20-30 minutes de Manhattan (tout dépend du bon fonctionnement du métro !). Quartier de Brooklyn très populaire mais sans soucis. Renée nous a accueilli très chaleureusement et à été à notre disposition dès que nous en avons eu besoin. Renée à également été très serviable avec nous !

Our stay was great. Renée was very helpful and clear with directions. The apartment was very comfortable, with a lot of sunlight and a small kitchen and free wifi. We really enjoyed our stay and recommend this place to anyone interested!
Renée was lovely to deal with and always quick to respond to anything we needed. Her flat was clean and just as depicted and described. Great experience.

Renee was very welcoming and a pleasure to work with.  We had a very nice stay in her apartment.  I would recommend staying in her place to anyone who is looking for an authentic Brooklyn brownstone experience.

I would totally stay here again, and if my friends or family wanted to stay in an apartment here, I would send them to this listing.

Unlike some listings I've stayed in, there are plenty of toiletries/coffee/milk etc. which guests are invited to use... being as it's stuff like that which really makes the experience different from a hotel, it's a very positive attribute. The location is classic Lower East Side, with a laundry below and endless gourmet delis and groceries on the doorstep. When I visited there were works going on inside the communal parts but they weren't particularly invasive and seem to be quite minor. All in all, this is a very slickly run operation indeed.

Xiren and Corey were the perfect "temporary landlords"!! Xiren responded to all pre travel inquires almost immediately and the very flexible check-in/-out times were much appreciated. Corey was on top of all communications during the stay going as far as to call and check on us mid-stay. The welcome e-mail was very comprehensive and a great primer for getting in touch with the local scene.

The flat is a perfect manifestation of the neighborhood it inhabits, hip, eclectic and comfortable as your favorite winter coat. It's located on the top floor of a fantastic old building, but as noted in the description it's a hike up the stairs, but who needs to run in and out when all the essentials are graciously provided. There's toiletries, coffee, milk, even umbrellas which come in handy when you have plans across town as when a cold rain starts and you've forgotten your own.

The neighborhood everything the LES has come to be known for; artistic and quirky restaurants, bars and shops. Don't miss the opportunity; send Xiren and Corey a request immediately, just not on any dates I'm looking to return.

Xiren was very responsive and informative. Her place is in an awesome location, convenient to many bars, restaurants and trains. We had a wonderful time and would love to stay again. I would highly recommend this place. Thanks Xiren!

Xiren & Corey were great hosts. They were super flexible and let us check in early with a red-eye flight. The apartment was clean and looked exactly as it appears in the photos. Xiren could not have been a more helpful host from beginning to end. She exceeded all our expectations, as did the apartment, which was incredible. Even better than in the pictures! Clean nice appartement in a great location (pictures are 100% accurate).

Renee's place was awesome - an amazing value in a neighborhood I really enjoy.  Renee was awesome too - she checked in and was a good communicator.  I hope to be back before long!

We really enjoyed staying in the apartment. It is private, large, full of light, and a great place to relax after a full day in the city. I'm happy to recommend it!

Renee is a great host. She is very responsive to all the questions you may have before and during the stay. The apartment itself is very clean and comfortable. I highly recommend this place who wants to visit NYC and stay close to the city. It's also 10 min walk from the subway station.

We had a great stay at Renee's place. It was perfect for our week long stay in NYC and had good transport links to help us get around. Renee was very helpful and accommodating and we would definitely recommend her place to friends!
Very charming and authentic place. We love staying in Bedford-Stuy. It's booming in a good way. Good value as well. If you like to be outside the commercial/touristic areas, this is for you.

Everything was perfect with the apartment and with Renée both before and during our stay in her house. It is good also for a family, as we are, with two children. Renee was great and answered right way.
The house is spacious and very nicely decorated, the area is vibrant, about 40 min. to Manhattan. thanks a lot Renee!

Renée was an exceptional host! She was very easy to communicate with and gave us tons of privacy. The location is convenient to public transit and several tasty places to eat. Can't say enough good things about this place. Great host, great location, and such a lovely space. Highly recommended. Will definitely be staying here again.

Renee's brownstone apartment was amazing. Very good lighting, pretty historic characteristics, very cosy huge bed with great pillows and sheets, and a cool mint green vintage sofa.

Thank you Renee!
My family had an excellent stay at Renee's home. The unit was very clean, bright and comfortable. I would recommend this place to anyone coming to NY.

really good spot and really good guy!!!

Goede locatie, dichtbij metro. Winkels/ restaurants op loopafstand. Ruime kamer met alle denkbare faciliteiten. Vriendelijke gastvrouw die klaar staat om al je vragen te beantwoorden. Zou deze plek zeker aanbevelen.

Je passé un excellent séjour chez Xiren qui s'est montrée très disponible et m'a donné plein d'indications utiles sur les lieux sympas près de son appartement. Ce dernier est parfaitement conforme à l'annonce. Il est très lumineux et est très calme, ce qui est un grand luxe à New York !

Xiren was very flexible with check-in and check-out and the apartment was very clean and comfortable and looks exactly like the photos. The bed was also super comfy! the place was as described and xiren was very communicative and helpful.

I had a great time at Xiren.. It's such a cozy appartment in a great neighborhood .!

Xiren is a very helpful host and the apartment was ideally situated for us. Picking up the keys was easy and communication was excellent. We would have no hesitation in staying there again.
