Xiren and Corey were wonderful hosts, very communicative, and accommodating to our needs. The flat is great, love the location and it has everything you need. I recommend this property.

Xiren's place is perfect for living like a local in NYC. Perfectly located near bars, restaurants and live music venues, which made our trip feel more than just a tourist vacation, to a real NYC cultural experience. The place was super cute, and Xiren kept in great contact, providing great tips and tricks.

Xiren was very accommodating and helpful naming great placing to visit. The neighborhood to great. There a lot of great places nearby which we tried and loved. Definitely recommend for your next trip to NYC.
Awesome place! Communication was always quick and clear, the apartment itself is amazing, and the host was flexible with check-in/checkout.
Great location, walking distance to a lot of nice restaurants and bars, and to the subway! The place had all we needed, we had a great time!

The positives about Xiren's place are many: great location, comfortable bed, lovely notes, two bottles of wine, some rum and vodka, two lovely bouquets of flowers.
The negatives could be fixed with just a little work and, as the reviews indicate, people didn't seem to notice them. I missed being able to read in bed as there was no light. The kitchen had no dish towels, kleenex, only two table knives and only six dishes. Only one burner was working on the stove. There were dusty unwatered plants. Light bulbs were burnt out. The toilet had to be jiggled to stop running. Tiles were missing in the shower, and the bathroom ceiling was peeling. The bathroom had no place but the toilet seat to set things down on. There were no washcloths. There were many shelves in the apartment, almost all covered in dusty bottles or baskets full of dusty stuff.

Excellent host in an excellent location. Xiren was very available and very responsive to any questions I had. She also had superb recommendations about how to best enjoy the East Village.  Would absolutely stay here again!

We had an amazing stay!! Xiren was an AMAZING host. Great recommendations. Great location. The apartment was cozy & lived up to our expectations. We will definitely be visiting again soon and hope to stay at Xiren's!

Xiren's apartment allows to live like an authentic new yorker. It's located in a very animated/dinamic zone, fully of highly recommended restaurants, bars, shops. The house is very welcoming and friendly so you can feel it as your own. It's true that the heating installation is old (little bit noisy), but it works properly and the house wasn't cold.
In summary, we highly recommend this apartment to really feel and enjoy NY life.
Regarding Xiren, she's been the perfect host: attentive to us, quickly in the answer and so friendly.
It's been a pleasure, many thanks for everything Xiren!

The apartment is located in a very nice neighborhood with lots of restaurants, bars and several of the subway lines nearby. I never felt unsafe in the neighborhood during my stay. The text and pictures in the ad correctly describes the apartment, there were no unpleasant surprises.

Xiren is a wonderful host, very responsive and easy to get hold of. She also gave good recommendations of places to visit in the neighborhood which was greatly appreciated.

I had a very nice stay and would gladly recommend Xirens place!
Really loved the place - homely, warm, great location - and Xiren was a superb host. Super helpful and accommodating. Thank you!
Xiren is a wonderful host! Her apartment is perfect for a short stay. Great neighborhood, quiet neighbor and overall chill vibe.

This was my second time staying at this apartment and I would come back again. The East Village is a fun, funky area to explore and the apartment is very charming and cozy as described and pictured. Check in and out is easy and host is great and easy to communicate. It's a great place to stay.

We spent 6 days at Xiren's cosy apartment as a base for an exploration of New York. It was exactly what we needed! The apartment is located in a great neighbourhood, we felt that we could have easily spent the 6 days just exploring the diversity of restaurants, bars and shops around us. Also, we never felt unsafe walking home. It's a little walk (some 10 mins) to the nearest subway station (F line) and from there we had easy access to all of Manhattan. Whereas the neighbourhood is rather busy (particularly on a Friday night), the apartment is surprisingly quiet, as it's on the 5th floor and the windows face the back of the building. We could hear steps from the neighbour sometimes and the radiators made a few noises at some point - but nothing to bothersome and otherwise the building was really calm.
The apartment was lovely, exactly as charming as represented in the photos. The bed was comfortable, the pillows too. The kitchen is a bit basic but it had all we needed to prepare light meals at home.
Xiren was an excellent host, responding promptly to any communication and giving us flexibility with the check-in hours. She also provided precious advice of good restaurants and other places in the neighbourhood.
In summary then, I strongly recommend this apartment, and would not hesitate to contact Xiren if I ever find myself in New York again.

Xiren's flat was absolutely perfect : beautifully decorated, great neighbourhood, and Xiren was extremely helpful (thanks for all the suggestions!). We'll definitely want to stay there next time we come to New York !

My boyfriend and I really loved staying in Xiren's pad. Xiren was great to communicate with and was always extremely friendly and helpful. Picking up/dropping off the keys were simple. Yes there are five flights of stairs but Xiren is perfectly honest about them and a little bit of exercise never hurt anyone! The apartment is quaint and characterful with all the basics you will require. Yes it has its quirks such as the small kitchen and bathroom but we didn't mind this at all, in fact it added to the 'feel' of the apartment. The apartment doesn't have TV but does have Xbox and a DVD player. But we didn't need use this once as we were too busy enjoying NYC! If we did need to catch up on anything we hooked up the iPad to the wifi and just streamed it on there. The apartment has a number of ceiling fans which really helped us as the weather was quite warm whilst we were there. We could hear some street noise in the apartment such as car horns etc. but it nothing that we didn't expect.

The area itself is full of life and cool bars. We particularly liked the Horseshoe Bar around the corner, Tompkins Bagels, Two Hoots pizza and there were two delis on the street below if we needed a late night snack! We would really recommend the Whole Foods supermarket about a 10/15 minute walk away from the flat. It was great for picking up groceries and we even saw Jennifer Lawrence shopping in there, so it can't be that bad can it! The apartment was within 10/15 minute walking distance to the subway, which we could hop on to get to our desired destination.

I would highly recommend this apartment to any single travellers or couples looking to visit New York. There was a really cool vibe in the Lower East Side area with plenty of areas to explore but you are also within reasonable distance of all the tourist attractions. The apartment was a real treat and some evenings we were perfectly happy just staying in and chilling with a drink, it really did feel like a home away from home. Thank-you Xiren!

Great apartment in a great area! It's true to the pictures, and Xiren's done a great job with layout to maximize the space. She's also a responsive host, with clear communication and great suggestions of things to see/do in the area. We'd stay here again!
Place was just as described in the listing.  Xiren was a great host, I would definitely recommend her as a host.

Sarah is an amazing and friendly host;) Her place is super cute and comfortable! Conveniently close to restaurants and bars.

Would definitely recommend Sarah's place! Great location and clean! It is exactly as advertised.
We enjoyed staying at Sarah's place. Would definitely stay here again!
L'appartement est très bien situé ! Idéal pour se sentir à New-York comme à la maison. Beaucoup de restaurants dans les alentours, l'appartement est au calme ce qui est vraiment un plus !

This is such a wonderful apartment. Sarah and Corey were very easy to deal with, there were lovely bunches of flowers everywhere when I arrived. The neighbourhood is perfect and you sure get fit carrying cases up five flights of stairs. I'll definitely be back.

Great apartment!
Cool location - Many bars and nice restaurants near by.

Small, but clean and convenient basement apartment. Comfy bed, friendly and attentive host. I had an excellent stay here, much nicer than the YMCA at less than half the price!

Nicky Hamlyn.

I spent 33 days at Edward's place and I thank him for making his home available.

The room was clean and adequate for what I needed, somewhere to sleep, write my notes and make my water colour sketches and other mini artworks (and the bathroom and kitchen were always available also) ---.

East Village is an excellent location to get the feel of New York with Edward's place in the Village being central to other areas of interest in New York for me.

Four Stars.

David T from Down Under.

Room and furnishings were as described. We had a great time staying with Edward. Location is convenient and everything we needed was provided. It was great to be able to have access to a kitchen/dining area.

Ed's place was a great hideaway in the East Village. Amazing location in the thick of it. My stay was a really quick one night stopover so I didn't get to meet Ed, but his apartment was nice and clean and hospitable. Highly recommended.

Edward is a very good host. He allowed us to check out late and helped us a lot during our stay there. His place is cool, everything is there. Even though it's quite hot down there you can always steal his portable fan ! :)

This apartment was really the bad side of our trip in NY, we advise you against it at all costs.

When we arrived, we saw the real lack of windows (in fact the apartment is in a kind of basement), and it was not really clean, overall the bathroom. But the room seemed to be clean (sheets and towels clean).

After a few days, we saw cockroaches in the bathroom, there were more and more until we left.

Edward was in holidays and wasn't there during our 10 days in NY, but was available by email, and was really nice... but that didn't solve anything, the apartment was dirty and we wanted to stay there the less time possible.

Edward and his place are exactly what you're looking for in NYC. Very comfortable apartment in a good location. Sarah was very kind with us and helps to enjoy a great trip in the big city. She give us very good suggestions and she was always available for anything. Thank you for everything Sarah.

Sarah's place was great, her apartment has so much personality. Central location in East Village with restaurants and bars close by. The apartment was as advertised. It was clean and well presented. The bed is very comfortable, the apartment a great size which fits a full kitchen, table to eat on and couch. I wouldn't look anywhere else for a place in New York, thanks Sarah.

A fantastic gem in East Village. Gorgeous apartment, exactly like the photos, and excellent communication with Sarah. Absolutely fantastic place in a great location. I stayed there for a month, and had nothing but great things to say. Perfect East Village apartment (as long as you are okay with the stairs). Homely and cute and stylish and in the absolute best location. Sarah was a FABULOUS host and so amenable and helpful
The touches in Sarah's place are well thought out and it's in a great location, nice and quiet but just a few mins from the subway. Check in was straightforward and thoroughly enjoyed it!
Lovely place in a great location!

The apartment is so great! Clean and comfortable, close to many good restaurants and cafes, near subway. Sarah is really a nice host. She gave us a lot of tips before and during our stay in NYC. Strongly recommend it!

Highly recommended.
Location is ideal for exploring the East Village, and a short walk from the West Village.

Sarah was a very responsive and helpful host.

Me personally prefer to meet with the host. We took the key from somehwhere and left also that place. But in general she is contacting via mail all the time and answering so fast. The coffee at the house was amazing. Everything you need was there. Even if you climb 5 floors thats really okey and the neighbourhood is amazing. For a Manhattan flat it is an okey price and really cool house. Only the smell of wetness kind of in the bathroom should be solved.  We really enjoyed our staying and the location fit us amazingly. Thank you.

There was great communication on Sarah's part and she left us relevant suggestions that highlighted the benefits of the community.  I wouldn't hesitate to go back and stay at this location again.  Enjoy!

The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures! It was full of the essentials and Sarah is very helpful for any event! It is located in a great zone and .. near Kats delicatessen where you can try an epic pastrami! The only negative aspect is the stairs! But it's ok for getting in shape ;) recommended!!

L’appartamento di Sarah è esattamente come descritto. C’è tutto ciò che serve e anche di più. Lei è sempre stata molto gentile, ha risposto a qualsiasi mia domanda in un attimo. Awesome little studio. Clean and quaint. Sarah was a great host and was always available to answer my questions and offer suggestions for the neighborhood. Perfect location in the east village. Would recommend to anyone!
Sarah’s place was as advertised, her place was neat and centrally located. Communication was seamless, check-in/out was flexible. Sarah was accommodating and thoughtful.
Great location and very large and comfortable apartment. Sarah was very easy to communicate with! Highly recommend this place!

Uns hat das Appartement gut gefallen. East Village ist ein toller Stadtteil: viele schöne Restaurants, Bars, Kneipen etc. und man ist schnell in Manhattan aber auch in Brooklyn. It's a great place, lot's of light, comfortable bed, quiet. It was our second time there and we really enjoyed it. I highly recommend this apartment.

This place is great for two people! The perfect amount of space and very cleanly decorated. My boyfriend and I loved the jukebox! The place was a ten minute walk to one train and a fifteen minute walk to another. There was a bar, shopping, and a deli down the street. The neighborhood is cute and friendly. I highly recommend staying here! Renee was super helpful.

As always, I very much enjoyed staying in Renée's apartment. It's a great place: clean and bright, in a beautiful brownstone building, and it has all the amenities you need to feel at home. Renee's place was comfortable for our 2.5-month stay. She was very responsive and lovely to chat about the neighborhood. Always very helpful with a NYC native host in such a great city.
Renee is very nice, and the place is very comfortable and convinent,anly 10mins away from A line
The place was pretty large and spacious. The bedroom gets great light, and we really enjoyed the neighborhood. The host was very responsive and helpful.

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. A good bed and nice bathroom. The apartment is in an older building, but the unit itself is very clean. Renee is a responsive host and easy to communicate with.
Renee was very welcoming to her large (for New York) apartment. Loved the neighborhood, not completely gentrified yet. Would definitely stay at her apartment again when coming to New York.

Staying at Renée’s was great. The place is very warm and comfortable, the main bedroom is huge and the bed so comfty.. the place is full equiped, and full of groceries. Renée was so nice and helpful at any time. 10/10 recommended. My next visit to brooklyn I’m pretty sure will stay at Renée’s.

Very charming and very “Brooklyn” feel! Bed was super comfortable and BIG! Lots of pillows were a plus! The bathroom is a bit small with limited storage, but manageable. Renee was very responsive when we had questions! FYI - the heater in the bedroom (which is not controlled by this unit) makes loud and random popping/banging noises. The pictures of the apartment represent accurately what you will experience at this place.   It's a beautiful old brownstone that Renee is renovating. The neighborhood has some great restaurants and it is conveniently located near a number of subway stops. Renee is very helpful and responsive.
Renee is delightful and wonderful.   Her place is light and super clean.   We enjoyed our stay and hope to come back.

Renee's apartment was so lovely! 10 minute walk to the subway, and nice amenities were included. Renee was extremely responsive and hospitable, I enjoyed my stay there.

I had a nice three week stay at Renée’s middle floor brownstone apartment. It was on a quiet block in Bed-Stuy, with an easy commute to and from my work in the West Village. Renée was quick to respond to any questions or concerns I had, and made it easy for me to feel at home in a new city.

Renee's apartment is a convenient location with just a few blocks from the subway and many stores and restaurants nearby. Renee herself is extremely accessible, and responds to questions promptly.  Would I stay there again? Absolutely.

The room is perfect for when you're staying for a couple of days and just need a place to sleep. The bathroom really reflects it being in a basement (pipe running through the room, a bit rusty and I saw some small bugs), but this was no problem for us. Oh and the towels we're nice and soft! :D

Ed is a great guy - the room is very modest but serviceable.  It also has a lock and key, so you can leave your stuff there.  Keep in mmind that these buildings are rather dated, so this is a basic living arrangement.  The area is really quite cool and has a funky vibe to it - lots of cool cafes and coffee shoppes, lots of young folks with a great chill attitude.
My partner and I have stayed with Edward twice now. He's a great host, his cat a serious bonus, the space is clean, and the neighborhood is alive! For the price, this accommodation can't be beat!

Close to the Express train to the city, a lot larger then I expected. close to a lot of great food and bars. cant ask for much more. The host was very good at communicating and giving good tips on where to go.
Very nice and clean , no big issues at all.

I had such a lovely stay! The space is BIG for New York and the value for money is really amazing.  I felt right at home there and it was a great place to come back to after a long day in the city. The neighborhood is great with plenty of bodegas, coffee shops, and restaurants around, but the apartment is still on a quiet block. Multiple subway lines are just a short walk away. I would absolutely stay here again.

The place is huge, especially by New York's standards. It's not far from public transportation and there are lots of stores close by. Renée was very quick to respond to all my enquiries (I booked this place 2 hours before check-in time after another host unexpectedly cancelled on me at the last minute). Overall, I had a great stay and I would definitely recommend this place to a friend.
Renee and her place were awesome! I love the neighborhood- walked to bagels and yoga both mornings- and  I am grateful for the last minute booking!

Renée was a fantastic host! She greeted us as soon as we arrived, even allowing for us to drop our luggage off a little early. She responded quickly to any questions we had and made sure our stay was a great one.

Her recommendations for dining were spot on and our commute in and out of the city was easy. We were able to park our car with no issue as well. The area felt very safe so late night commutes weren’t a concern.

I would highly recommend staying with Renée to anyone looking to experience a true city trip. The brownstones are beautiful and the old style is well preserved in her home. You cannot beat the space, convenience or price.

Renee was amazing and super helpful! Her place was a gem-perfect for visiting with our family 5. Lots of  old Brooklyn architectural character yet, modern feel.  We had everything we needed for our stay while we visited our NYC fam!

Exactly as advertised. Great location and most importantly excellent communication with the host. Not particularly fancy, which made me feel at home in the space.
Renee’s place is very light, spacious and clean. She is quick to respond.

Renée is an excellent hostess.
We had a delay in our checkin time and she was considerate about it.

In short, an extraordinary experience to stay with Renée.

I’ll put it this way, if you don’t stay with Renee you’re not doing it right. She was incredibly accommodating and allowed some lenience with bag checking in and out. Huge bed - robes, extra pillows, soft blankets. And a washer and dryer in the unit! Took us about 5-7 minutes to get to the subway and we quickly adapted to our morning routine ... a quick walk to Sincerely Tommy (our favorite neighborhood coffee shop) I could go on and on but I’ll leave it here.. I can’t wait for my next trip - NY is cool, this apt is cooler.
Renee is a great host, her place was great and comfy. I recommend it, subway to NYC is a 10 min walk which is great. Apartment had everything you need, would stay there again.

Apartment was great! Spacious and exactly as pictured. It truly does get great light during the day. Renée was kind enough to already include silk pillowcases on the bed without me having to request them.

The only things that I could've used in the apartment were facial tissues and washcloths to go with the towels provided, but it wasn't a big deal to not have these. Renée did offer to get me some washcloths by the next morning once I brought it to her attention, but I declined. I'd stay here again!
Edouard offre une chambre pas chère pour une ville telle que NY en plein East Village. La chambre est correcte et propre. Edouard a été disponible et toujours prêt à nous aider durant notre voyage.

Looking for a straight forward Brooklyn stay... come here. Up a flight of stairs, lays a cozy brownstone apartment with traditional wood molding that made me gush! Photos don’t do justice to the size of the bedroom. Thanks for a nice quick trip!

Renée was super communicative, friendly, and accommodating. Her place was bigger than I expected (our old BK apartments must have been half the size!). Her place had all the basics, was very clean, and had a king size bed, which is pretty rare in the city. We were incredibly comfortable and enjoyed our time. Renée was a wonderful host and I'd definitely recommend staying here, especially if you plan to spend most of your time in Brooklyn.
Renee's spot was a lovely jumping-off point for seeing NYC!  It's in a great neighborhood with lots of cool local spots.

L’appartement est très propre et bien décoré. L’emplacement est idéal pour visiter New York même sur un court séjour grâce à la proximité du métro. Renée est réactive et disponible. Je reviendrai et recommande sans hésiter !

Renee’s place looks exactly like the photos suggest. The bedroom is open and spacious but still feels personal and cozy. I was in love with the light and air that the windows let in. As for location, I’d never stayed in Brooklyn before so I wasn’t sure if the area would be safe but it definitely was. I felt completely comfortable walking from the subway and to local spots. Renee gave super simple instructions on checking in and was not invasive at all. Would definitely recommend!
wonderful location - great hostess - needs quite a bit of upkeep and since it is being sold it will need to wait for the next owner

Quiet,  safe, a home away from home.  First time in NYC and we had the luck to stay at Renée's. By the third night,  we already felt like we'd been living there for ages.  The place is cozy,  very well kept and spotless. Renée is the best of the best,  attentive and quick to answer all your questions and needs. I sure hope to visit again and have the pleasure to stay again at this wonderful place!
Clean spacious 1 bedroom close to all amenities. I was worried about finding parking but to my surprise I had no issues.

I had a great stay at Renée’s place while I was apartment hunting around Brooklyn for a few days. Lovely old brownstone architectural details throughout! All in all a great value for a legal Airbnb in New York with space to yourself (For anyone unfamiliar with NY Airbnb restrictions, many private listings on the site are not legal. Such a great stay in a centrally located part of  Brooklyn! Never too far from food, drinks, or a couple subway lines. The space was so open and clean and perfect to come home to after a long day of adventuring. Would definitely stay again!
We loved our stay at Renee’s place.  Her home is beautiful and exactly as described. The king bed is very comfortable!  Would recommend this listing to my friends for sure.
Renee was a great host and her place was perfect for a quick weekend in the city. Would definitely stay again!
Renee’s place was bigger and better than I expected.  Me and my family thoroughly enjoyed her place and her neighborhood.  I would definitely recommend and definitely come back for sure.

Renée is definitely a great example of a superhost. Responds quickly to texts and is available for anything you need. Her place is a gem and sparkling clean, the bed is super comfy and the kitchen fully equipped.
Renée’s home is beautiful, and she’s an amazing host. Because she lives in the building, she’s super responsive and available to help when needed. Would definitely stay here again!
This is a great spot in Brooklyn. Comfortable bed, lots of natural light, good kitchen. Communication with Renée was excellent. We would happily stay again.

It is quite an experience to live in an almost 120 years old authentic New York brownstone for a few days! Fantastic location and great host. Highly recommended. Definitely coming back!
Thank you Sarah for the great hospitality! We loved beeing in NY. The flat was very clean and Sarah gave us much information. We can highly recommend the apartment!

East Village is where it’s at. Manitoba’s bar is on this street! There is a deli on every corner. Uber pool is the best mode of transport and it’s cheap. We got a subway pass for 7 days for about $32 at 2nd Ave station and was well worth it. The neighborhood around Sarah’s apartment is brilliant. We stayed 10 days and it really gives you a true feeling of living in New York. The stairs are exhilarating and by the end of our stay we didn’t need a breather 3/4 of the way to the 5th floor. Laundry at the base of the stairs and for $10 we washed and dried 2 loads. Sarah couldn’t have done enough for us. The apartment has everything you need and air conditioning which we needed in the heatwave. Thanks again for everything.

Sarah’s place is just right for an inexpensive, comfortable stay in Manhattan. The neighbourhood is friendly with lots of good eats and drinks really close by. New York is so explosive with opportunities that one week’s nowhere near long enough but Sarah’s place was great to come home to and relax, despite the heat. She’s right to point out the stair climb because it is a workout especially in summer but in reality that’s life in New York and nothing to complain about. We’re both in our 60s and frankly quite enjoyed the workout!!
Thanks Sarah

Really great experience. Everything was simple and convenient, and allowed us to make the most of our stay there. Stairs were great exercise, but normal for Nyc. Great tips about the local area and brilliant communication. Sweet, cosy apartment with good air conditioning (necessary for July) - can’t recommend highly enough. Stay here!

Sarah has created a beautiful and cozy hideaway that invites you to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. Thoughtful design touches wait to surprise you as you settle in and explore the space, making it a fun and surprising place to stay. I had to really force myself to leave during the day instead of just staying in and reading. The apartment is a fifth story walkup and the common areas do not benefit from air conditioning. I found the apartment to be quiet, hearing only the occasional siren and no other street noise. Sarah is quick and extremely helpful when it comes to communication. Checkin/checkout instructions were clear and easy and she sent not one, but two exceedingly helpful messages about the apartment, the ares, and the surrounding amenities. If you're lucky enough to be able to snag this place, do so!

Overall, we had a good stay at Sarah's place. We did not have the chance to meet, but the check in and check out options went without problems, and the communication with her was very good, she is responsive and always providing the detailed, required information .

The flat is located in a rich area full of pubs and restaurants, but a bit far away from a subway. We had to walk in average 15/18 mins from the flat to a convenient subway stop. For New York, it might be normal but for us, after a full day of walking around, and sightseeing it felt quite exhausting.

The flat itself is as advertised, the only downside of it was that it was very warm inside. The AC did not work for us, the two ceiling ventilators made it a it better.
We really enjoyed Sarah's place and the Style of the Apartment. A big thank you for the easy check-in/check-out and the cool recommendations!

L'appartement est très original et est situé au 5è étage d' un immeuble sans ascenseur. Cela demande un peu d'exercice physique, mais c'est très bien car on marche beaucoup à NY!  Sarah est rapidement disponible pour répondre aux questions qu'on lui pose. Les check-in et check-out ne posent aucun problème. Christine

Our first trip to NYC as a married couple and this place did everything we wanted and more. The location was great so many good places to eat around and near all sights. Sarah also had great tips for places around that we used and worked out great!!
Sarah's place is a fantastic way to get to know New York! Everything was in order and we had some great tips for the neighborhood. I highly recommend it.

Appartement idéal pour un couple, correctement équipé, dans un quartier proposant nombre de commerces, restaurants et bars.
