Perfect green and cosy oasis in the East Village. Nicely decorated and equipped with everything you need for a city trip. The apartment isn’t vert spacious but perfect for a couple. Sarah is very attentive and responsive. Checking in and out couldn’t be easier. The apartment and building are very clean. The neighbourhood is the best. Don’t plan everything in advance and enjoy discovering new bars and restaurants by wondering around. Subway is a couple of minutes walking. My advice is to rent the Citi bikes, a docking station is just around the corner. We would go back immediately.
Nous avons passé un super séjour à NYC. L’appartement de Sarah est très bien située. Très bonne communication avec Sarah qui est très réactive et nous a donné plein de bonnes adresses et conseils.
Appartement très bien situé et calme dans un quartier vivant. Literie très confortable. Hôte très réactive et disponible.

Sarah’s Airbnb is probably my favourite I’ve ever stayed in from anywhere around the world. It is a stylish space in an amazing area and it’s very big for a Manhattan apartment. The decor is beautiful and Sarah was the perfect host who couldn’t do enough for us. If you want a real Manhattan experience in an impeccable and quiet haven above the bustling city I would highly recommend booking this Airbnb, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
The place is very great and Edward is a very great guy as well. It is a very friendly, nice environment. I was definitely lucky to have stayed here.

Edward was an amazing host who is knowledgeable and friendly - the room is perfect if you need a place to crash and is close to so many great bars, cafes and restaurants.  I would stay there again anytime!

Edward's apartment is perfectly located in the East Village, close to just about everything I wanted to do and everywhere I wanted to go. The apartment itself is a small basement unit that gets very little light. But that wasn't an issue since I was barely there during my three nights stay. It was the ideal place for me to drop my stuff off, go out, come back to for sleeping and showering.

I met Edward for a brief time. He was really nice and courteous, much like his cat Joshua, who was very friendly and playful.

All in all, a good and comfortable experience.

Great location and price, Edwards' a champ and I highly recommend it as an alternative to hostels or more expensive options. I had a bit of work to do and it was quiet and peaceful there as well.

Cheers Edward!

Edward was extremely accommodating, left his keys at the restaurant downstairs so I wouldn't have to drag my luggage around until he was off work.  His cat is adorable by the way.  Would definitely recommend staying there!

Ed is a great host and a very open-minded person. I stayed six nights there - the room is small but the price is awesome when you consider that you are in the middle of crazy hopping East Village!
Klaus - Denmar

I had a great time in NY staying with Edward. Edward, his girlfriend and Dennis (the guy living next to me) are nice and helping people. They know the neighborhood and all the good places to go and they're happy to share. So if you're a tourist like me, ask them where to go and what to see.

Definitely a place for 'backpackers'. A bargain for NYC! Excellent location, near to the coolest places of the East Village and easy to get in and out by Subway & Bus.

Edward is a very nice person, respectful, easy-going and ready to answer your questions. The room is fine, very comfortable bed and we even found there a very interesting guide for New York that we used a lot.

The only DOWNSIDE of the place are the bath and kitchen amenities that you share, which are not always in the best conditions. Since it's a basement and there's lots of humidity, you may find bugs or moisture in both. So be warned if you can't stand bugs or small insects (roaches)... you could be surprised when going to pee at night. If you are OK with this GO ahead and book!
The bed was good and Edward is a very nice host.

Price/quality is good. We recomment this place.
We have had a very nice and pleasant week at Edward's place. He and his girlfriend are very nice people. The room was small and dark, but then again, we were not in NY to stay in the room all the time. We enjoyed the wifi and the tv in the room.
The only remakrs are that the apartment is very dark and could be a little cleaner.
The neighborhood is very nice with lots of nice bars, restaurants and deli's. It is about 10 minutes walk from the subway to the apartment.
Edward, thanks for a nice week!

Ed's place is great for the cost. It's a sweet location and I never had any trouble getting back to it. It's smaller, but I'd have to describe it more "cozy" than I would "cramped." Everything was in good order and there were even magazines and cool guide books to seeing the city. I dug it.

As for the host himself, Ed was great. He wasn't intrusive nor was he elusive. Very kind and helpful with suggestions of things to do. Down to Earth friendly guy. I'm glad it worked out so well. This was my first time ever using Airbnb and I had no idea what to expect. I can only hope that all my future trips work out like this one!

Edward was a wonderful host !
The room is great, private and all. Ask anything to Edward, he knows a lot of stuff about the city, what to do, you can find guides in the room, etc etc. So great !
The bathroom is a little bit small, but overall it's still a great !
The appartment is in a basement, you have to go through a backyard/garbage hall to get in, but once you're there it's OK. Located in a vibrant neighborhood of the city, very nice to wander in !
The basement location can feel cramped or such to some people, but really, if you come to visit NyC, you don't want to stay in your room all the time ;-)
Overall, a bargain for the location, a real great value, and Joshua (the cat) is so cuute and friendly !
Highly recommended for a good quality/price ratio !

Great room and apartment, and Edward is a very thoughtful, helpful and friendly host.  Location is pretty good, too (near pleasant restaurants, several minutes walk from a subway stop).  The only problem is outside of the apartment:  the courtyard and hallways you have to walk through to get to Edward's place are full of loose garbage.

Great place to stay if you love food and east village. Everything is in walking distance and even the typical tourist attractions can be reached easily with bus and subway.
Sarah's apartment is very unique and we felt like home immediately.
Good price for location, host very helpful and gave lots of hints and tips. Place a lot bigger than expected too and in a relatively quiet area too!
Good value for New York and this neighborhood.

The place is in great shape for NYC standards. The place was clean and was really comfortable to stay in. Proximity to restaurants we're great. Only negative is how far you are from the subway. It's not even that big of a deal if you don't mind walking. Overall, a wonderful place to stay and Sarah was an exceptional host.

The location of Sarah's place was great. Unfortunately the toilet in the flat broke and this was not seen to promptly. The first evening there was no response for a solution, the second day she wanted her neighbour who is not a tradesperson to come into the place with his own key, next she wanted us to leave the apartment unlocked when we left and she would try and get someone to fix it and finally her partner and the 'Super' came in and fixed it. We suggested compensation given we didn't have a working toilet for a few days but Sarah did not respond to any criticisms, choosing only the parts of communication she wished. Felt anxious for the first half of our trip.
Otherwise the apartment was what you would imagine living in NYC would be, very compact, strange noises from the heating, many stairs and very well decorated.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié cet appartement très agréable, joliment décoré et bien situé. On s’y sentais comme à la maison. Le chauffage est parfois bruyant mais ce n’est pas gênant. Sarah et Corey sont des hôtes attentionnés et réactifs.

Gorgeous little apartment full of character in fantastic neighbourhood from where you can walk all over Lower Manhattan or over the bridge to Brooklyn. The 2nd Street F train was convenient for our Broadway trips. Sarah was a super-helpful and responsive host.
Great location and nice flat. Would highly recommend!

Awesome place - very roomy for city standards. On the fifth floor and no elevator so just have that expectation - I honestly loved it because I got a workout in every day (haha). Sarah is so hospitable though and gives great recommendations for restaurants around the area. Just a great location and experience all around- highly recommend!

This place was great! Perfect location for bar hopping and food, plus close enough to public transit that you can get anywhere in the city really quickly. The 5 flights of stairs are NO JOKE - we came mentally prepared, but if you have a lot of luggage you might have a difficult time. The apartment itself is well equipped, quiet, and very comfortable for two people. We would definitely want to stay here again!

Muy buena situación. El barrio es encantador. Sarah es maja pero lo único malo es la limpieza del apartamento que tuvimos que limpiar la nevera con restos de comida de otros inquilinos y había bastante polvo aunque Sarah nos dijo que lo había hecho pero... Y otra sugerencia es que estaría bien que dejaran un cajón libre para meter ropa interior. Tuvimos que dejarlo en la  Maleta. Por lo demás el edificio es cómodo y con encanto, el portal y las escaleras nuevas y no se hace tan pesado subir si estás acostumbrado a ello. Nueva York es fascinante.

What a great stay.
Good communication from Sarah. Good recommendations.
The place was clean, comfortable, and a great location. 10 min walk from the subway. Lots of great food and bars close by.
We would recommend it highly.
Thank you Sarah
The apartment is in a great location, so many bars and restaurants nearby. The apartment is a lovely place to come back to after a day exploring New York. Thanks for all the tips and recommendations!

My sister and I spent a week in Sarah's appartment. It was perfect for our needs. The eclectic decor was charming. A great selection of books both local  travel guides and novels. The 5 flights of stairs at the end of a days walking was a bit challengeing however this meant we had great views. Communication was always easy. We would readily stay there again.

The apartment is very nice and perfectly situated (but be prepared for the daily training of going up to the 5th floor👍). Sarah gave us great tips for the area, and picking up and dropping off the keys went all very smooth.

The location of this apartment alone makes it worth booking.
Along with great location Sarah is a great host, super communicative and helpful.
There are so many lovely personal touches in this place and it is super clean.
We had a wonderful stay here.
The stairs may put you off, don't let it as they help with all the calories you will consume as you're surrounded by amazing food choices in short walking distance.
This place is a gem!
Our best air bnb stay yet!
Fabulous place - would definitely stay there again. Sarah is also a great host.
Wonderful location, very nice hosts

We thoroughly enjoyed staying at Sarah's, the apartment is beautiful, spacious and clean and had everything we needed. The location is great and we found many things just on the block. Sarah was very helpful and responsive and sent many recommendations for places to eat in the area. Would recommend and stay there again.

Sarah was a very clear communicator, check in was easy and the location was very convenient for where I had to travel during my stay. the decor was cute And the apartment was very quiet.

Overall, it feels like you are crashing at someone's place who was there that morning, as their personal items are everywhere in the home including food still in the fridge and no space in the bathroom cabinetry or dresser (there was space in the closet which I prefer anyway); as long as you are fine with that, it is okay. I would have personally preferred having some cleared off shelving to put my stuff without needing to move things around. Tile work missing in the shower and on the bathroom floor.

Sarah’s place is such a wonderful location and neighborhood. Check in & check out were super easy and we especially loved the Tempur-pedic mattress and pillows!  Great suggestions on where to eat close by that were really yummy. The noodle shop and the sushi place being our favorites. Thanks so much Sarah! Barb

Lovely little apartment on the 5th floor of a classic building in the East Village. Sarah was very helpful throughout our stay, we would happily stay again (when they finish the construction in the apartment below)

Sarah’s flat is small but comfortable, nice hot shower (small bathroom).  Sarah provided a good hair dryer, an iron and table top ironing board. And the bed was good.The location is very good. Lots of good restaurants, close to subway and you could walk to Broadway in about 30 mins. The only negative for us were the stairs being 72 and 69 the flat is on the 5th floor and 81 stairs is a lot to climb,  if it had not been for my nephew helping with bags we may have been in trouble. This flat would be good for younger people, collecting of keys was easy,  there were 2 small corner supermarkets close by and you could buy everything.

Sarah was a great host and answered any question really fast. The appartment is really nice, clean and is located in an amazing area of New York with really nice pubs and restaurants.

The vacation was absolutly gorgeous. Thank you Sarah :)

El apartamento es tal y como se ve en las fotos, precioso, acogedor y con todo lo necesario. La situación es estupenda, en una zona muy animada. A los anfitriones no les llegamos a conocer, pero nos echaron una mano en todo lo que les pedimos. Las escaleras son terribles, eso sí, con maletas y sin ellas. Si vuelvo a NY y está disponible, elegiría este sitio otra vez. Gracias, Sarah.

The apartment was very much what we expected, in a great location for bars/restaurants and getting around the city; the bed was especially comfortable and the apartment very cosy. Sarah provided us with lots of good tips and information for our stay in NYC and was fast at responding to any questions we had.
The apartment is however in need of some cosmetic attention. The bathroom door would not close properly and the bathroom itself appeared ‘scruffy’ - the tiles around the bath/shower needed a good clean and quite a few were cracked/broken. The paintwork in many places was peeling, and there was no blind (for privacy) on the window immediately outside the bathroom. A bit of a shame given its size & location, but we could not recommend the apartment; we would not stay there again due to the apparent lack of cleanliness.
Nice little appartement in East Village. Good location. Not easy to access with a big suitcase as there are 5 stairs to climb. But overall good stay.

Sarah is a special host. Sweet, caring, full of advice.
Our stay in NY was great and for this, I need to be thankful to Sarah for her management of reservation and home.
The house was nice and very clean, 10/15 minutes walk to metro and full of nice places all around.

I recommend the house!

we loved living in the east village. the apartment is beautiful and the work out with the
suitcases up to the fith floor no issue. the apartment matched perfectly with our way of looking at things. there are fantastic options for food and drinks and shopping close by....
sarah was a perfect host and relplied immediately to my mails. we would love to come back being back in the city .....

Perfect place for a New York vacation. The flat is adorable, well laid out and has lots of natural light. The bed was especially comfortable! The neighbourhood is one of my favourites in New York and Sarah’s place is steps from great coffee shops, cafes, restaurants and bars. Would definitely stay here for any NYC trip, and will be recommending to friends.

I stayed in Sarah's house for 5 nights and absolutely loved it! It has the perfect new york atmosphere! It was cozy and fun and right in the center of the east village which is such a lively great neighborhood! Sarah always answered my messages in a quick and precise way and was very nice. It's definitely going to be my go to place in new york from now on!!
Great place!

Lovely apartment, extremely well placed for exploring new York. She's not joking about the steps up to the apartment which were a challenge after all the walking round the city, but otherwise a very honest and authentic new York experience. Loved it and would stay again!
Nous avons passé un bon moment chez Sarah. Tout était conforme à la description et Sarah nous a donné des bons plans sur place.
This is Airbnb experience was the best . The host is very accommodating. This place was better then I expected. Definitely coming back soon.

Renée was SUPER helpful and always prompt with responding. Her place was larger than expected and conveniently located near corner stores, restaurants and public transit. Fantastic experience overall - highly recommend

L'appartement est propre, très spacieux et fonctionnel.
Facile d'accès, à 15 min à pied du métro, puis 20 min en métro pour Manhattan, il est idéalement situé.
Pratique pour profiter de la folie de Manhattan et du calme de Brooklyn.
Je recommande

Renée thank you so much! This place is conveniently located with stylish comfort. Host is very responsive and accommodating. As a first timer to NY, we were able to find amenities easily, place was bigger or roomier than expected, safe and comfortable. We'll def stay again!

We had a great time at Renée’s place,  made even better by all of her tips and local recommendations - the details for the listing are well worth reading! The place itself is gorgeous, check in and check out were smooth, and the location sets you up well for a day/night out in either Manhattan or Brooklyn.

This place was perfect! Close to major subways, restaurants,  coffee shops, and anything you can think of. Renée was quick to respond to our inquiries  and always was nice in all transactions.  I would DEFINITELY stay here again.

Renee’s place is a gem. It’s spacious, simple, welcoming, practical, and spotless. Her communication was quick and clear, and her apartment had enough amenities (coffee maker, huge TV, wonderful bed, among others) while maintaining enough free space to spread our and be comfortable (I had a lot of work to do while I was there). She was also lovely to chat with. The neighborhood is also a great Brooklyn experience. I would stay again in a heartbeat!

We appreciate Renée’s hospitality, clear instructions, and prompt responses. The rental fee is very good for the area it is conveniently located in. It is also clean and secured. Also conveniently located close to corner stores and restaurants/shops.
Renee was great, the place very lovely and beautiful, quiet street with nice things all around. Great trees front and back--a huge catalpa!
Renee’s place was very charming and in a good neighborhood. Renee was very quick to respond and address any questions or requests we had.

First time using AirBNB and Renee was very quick to answer any questions I had . The space itself is located in a beautiful brownstone neighborhood . About a 10 min walk to the A train that takes you to Manhattan, markets and food places are nearby!
The apt made me feel at home! Very large space , I loved the bed! Washer and dryer were a plus ! Definitely would book again.
Renée’s Brooklyn apartment is beautiful, clean, and within walking distance of great bars and coffee shops. We really enjoyed our weekend here. Hope to come back again.

A lovely space. Super clean and livable.

Only thing I'd keep in mind is that one of the subway lines to the location essentially stops running, so I'd keep in mind which of the subway lines runs throughout the night. And, I'd recommend checking the locations of the stations and using one over the other based on the relative safety of the area!

Overall though we could not have had a nicer stay ! A super clean and comfortable stay !
This place is as it appears in the photos. Huge bedroom, nice sized living room. Great location, and you can do laundry. Easy check in and Renée was responsive.

Renee's place is located in Brooklyn and if you catch the subway it is a short ride to Manhattan depending on where you want to go. Everything was clean and the flat offers enough space for four people. Kitchen equipment could have been a little bit more. If you're budget is limited and you don't want to live to far from some of the hotspots I would highly recommend this place!

This was the perfect landing spot for a weekend exploring NYC! It was really spacious (especially for city living), so it was nice to be able to spread out when we were back at the bnb for some down time. The bed was really comfy. We took advantage of the kitchen to make some meals at home. Overall, perfect spot, great price.

Renée and her apartment was wonderful, and her availability and timely communication made my experience all the better! The space is wonderful-- I had a hard time understanding how I had such luck in finding myself there. It's in a great and convenient part of Brooklyn, and the space itself has been thoughtfully refurbished without sacrificing the building's original structure or character. The apartment was spacious and incredibly clean, complete with lots of light and ample plants.
Renée, thank you again!

We enjoyed our stay by Edward's. First experience with airbnb and definitely not the last!
Edward is a friendly and helpful host. The appartment is in a basement, the room quite small but very clean and comfortable! The location is perfect to enjoy NYC especially by night. The price is amazing for travellers with low budget!

Edward's place is in a fabulous part of the city! The price was a steal for a place in Manhattan. The sheets were clean and the atmosphere quiet and chill. Edward is very easy to get in contact with, super friendly and a great host. He offers up everything - towels, NYC books, kitchen, fridge, tea, house keys - that you need to make your trip comfortable.
Although the room is clean, the guest bedroom's window is ground-level on a garbage-filled alley, so if the window/fan is left open, the smell in the room will reflect what is going on outside - one evening we could smell vomit (however, the next day no problems). To avoid this, keep the window closed if it's not hot.

I had a really great time at Edward's place, him and Kara were amazing and we got along pretty well. They are amazing people and I felt so comfortable in the house because even if it isn't big it felt cozy and cool for me.
I would definitely keep in touch with both of them and I really hope to see them in the near future.

Edward a été accueillant disponible lorsque nous en avions besoin.
L'appartement est bien situé à East Village, le point négatif est qu'il se situe en demi-sous-sol et qu'il est donc sombre.
Good and cheap location to visit Manahattan.

Hey! Was really great meeting the guys, very nice to stay over, the area is great. Definitely a place to stay!!

Thanks Edward!!

Edward is an awesome guy, I only met him briefly as he was going to Cali but he was always generous helpful and welcoming on every occasion we met. His room mate Denis is lovely aswell, always happy to stop and have a chat. The room and apartment are exactly like they are in the photos on the website. Perfect for me, in a great location, close to a lot of little deli shops and a laundrette. The East Village comedy club is just around the corner and the view from the room alone is enough to take this apartment. I stayed here for a month and loved every min of it. No complaints at all.

We had a good time with Edward and his flatmates who were really friendly, laid-back and helpful. The room is pretty basic and doesn't get much natural light but it's comfortable, clean and fairly quiet - perfect if you just need a bed and an internet connection. The location is fantastic and overall it's a really good value place to stay

Preis und Leistung sind angemessen
allerdings sollte man mit seiner Partnerin nicht unbedingt dort übernachten da es doch sehr einfach ist.Wer ansprüche hat sollte woanders buchen. Der Gastgeber war nett und man kann in 30 minuten den Timesquare erreichen .
Es war sauber allerdings gab es im Bad kleine Mitbewohner (Ka....)

I always love staying in the Lower East Side. It's close to some of my favorite eateries.  Ed's place is simple and no frills but you get a private room with a queen bed in a great location.  What more can you ask for? I would definitely stay there again.

Great room! The location is awesome, walking distance to everything great downtown, on a quiet street. Edward and Kara are extremely nice and helpful, and their cats are so sweet! Tidy place, small kitchen area to share, can get a bit hot at times with the water pipes but crank up the fan and you'll be fine. I definitely recommend it and would stay there again. Thanks!

Great place and awesome hosts! Perfect location, close to everything in the EV and very accessible. The room was clean and comfortable and all the basic necessities were covered. Fun loving cats with great personalities too, very entertaining. We really enjoyed our stay and will definitely be back.

Myself and my gf stayed over the first week of december.

Good points:

The shower worked with hot water and the bed was comfortable, Edward and his room mate were really friendly and helpful.
Location is great with many resturants and bars nearby that do happy hours, half the price of midtown. Tube is 10 mins walk away which wasn't too bad.

Negatives:

Room temperature was up and down, some nights it was cold, other nights very hot.
For two people (who did quite alot of shopping) we struggled for space in the room however I would see it as perfect for a lone traveller or for people with not alot of stuff.

If you don't like cats then I would not recommend staying there, you cannot avoid the litter tray and the friendly inqusitive cats!

Edouard et Kara ont été formidable tous les deux. Extrêmement arrangeant puisqu'ils nous ont hébergés chez eux dans leur nouvel appartement pour une nuit.

L'appartement est idéalement situé (East Village) et permet l'accès à pied aux incontournable de Manhattan.

Seul bémol (que de l'eau chaude dans la baignoire :)

It was a small room in the basement, not that much daylight but very peaceful and quiet. The temperature was either very hot or chilly. Still very   affordable and Edward was always nice and helpful when we needed help.

Edward has been very nice, reliable and helpful with recommendations on where to eat and what to do in NYC. The room is clean and very functional. There was enough space for my luggage, a very comfortable bed and everything I needed, even a TV. The bathroom has a good shower with constant hot water. The best thing about the apartment is its location. It's located in the east village, a nice and vibrant neighborhood, close to sweet shops, plenty of restaurants, NYU, subway stations... I can totally recommend staying there if you look for an inexpensive place to sleep and relax in Manhattan.

One of the most helpful and considerate people on this site. Koray helped me with everything, and was willing to go above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable. If you are going to stay in New York City, make this your first choice.
Apartment was beautiful, immaculate.  Koray was very accomodating for both key pickup as well as my check-out time.  Would book again in a second for return trips back to NYC.

Koray's apartment is absolutely gorgeous. My friend and I had a fantastic trip to NYC and coming back to this apartment at the end of the day was an absolute pleasure. Koray was helpful and incredibly patient when we encountered some unexpected delays in arriving. We couldn't have asked for more.

Koray's apartment is a winner - beautifully presented, spacious, excellent location.  It actually looks as great as it does in the photos, and was perfect for our needs.  I definitely recommend this apartment.
Koray is a gentleman and the loft is a really beautiful space. He was always available for any help. We couldn't find a better place... we enjoyed the East Village and NYC.

We loved our stay in Korays apartment. It is very clean, well furnished, spacious and a little sanctuary in the East Village. The area is close to most things and the subway, so it is easy to get around and is safe. Koray was great to deal with and we really enjoyed the experience. Thanks Koray!

Having stayed at Koray`s was the best thing.  It made our marathon weekend.  Coming back each time from the cold to a worm and beautifully decorated apartment, that has every things you needed.  We are glad we got to meet Koray, amazing gentleman and most accommodating host ever.  Thanks a lot again and again.

Koray is a 1st class host with a fantastic perfectly located apartment.

We highly recomend staying here, it truly is home away from home.

Thanks Koray we'll be back !

Thorne & Carolina
Great place.  Easy to get to. Sarah was super easy to work with.

Sarah’s is a great little spot in the East Village. Well situated in a vibrant neighborhood where you can spend your whole visit, but also an easy walk to subways and buses to explore the rest of the city. The flat is exactly as advertised, cozy and fun, a comfortable bed, wifi, kitchen you can cook in. Sarah responded quickly and thoroughly to my questions, and was an attentive host who gave local tips worth knowing. I would happily stay again.

We were incredibly happy with Sarah's place. She was an excellent host; very easy to communicate with and gave us plenty of great, local recommendations. Check in and out was super easy as well and she even let us check out late which was incredibly helpful for us. The bed is one of the comfiest beds I have slept in when on holiday which was massively appreciated after all the walking we did. We also got much fitter over the 4 days from climbing the 5 flights of stairs which was a handy bonus!
Enjoyed my time at Sarah’s apartment. Very cute decor and an amazing location in the heart of Alphabet City. The brand new A/C unit kept the whole place quite cool in July.
This place is amazing, great energy, host is very nice and very helpful! I enjoyed my stay very much!
Great stay, highly recommended!

Sarah’s place was perfect for a few nights in east village - clean, comfortable space with unique touches, it was in a great neighborhood with tons of restaurant options nearby. Would definitely stay here again.
I Had a great stay at Sarah’s! Cozy and stylish place, she was very communicative and accommodating. Couldn’t imagine a better stay 🙂
Great stuff!
Cute tiny apartment in a very bustling area! Sarah gave excellent local suggestions and made in check-in/check-out very simple.
Great location, host was super helpful, easy check in, and so close to Tompkins Square Park! Definitely recommend!

Sara's place was the perfect place to stay in NYC. I fell in love with the location, all the amazing people and restaurants and parks, ect. She was very helpful and the space had everything I needed for my two months in NYC. Thank you Sara!

Great little place in the heart of the East Village close to restaurants, shops and all the action.
The stairs are no joke but once your up there it feels like your in your own tower above the city.
Perfect for a single or couple to spend some time exploring NYC.
The kitchen is NYC sized (small) but worked for our needs and there are so many great restaurants & bars nearby to try.

Great place to stay in the heart of the lively East Village!
Probably more equipped for short touristy trips than long extended stays

Sarah's space is ideal for one person, it can be right for two people. It IS in a very prime location, but that also means that street noise is abundant. Your thighs will get a workout from the five flight of stairs, this type of apartment/building is very typical in NYC. Sarah is a pretty responsive and flexible host.

Note: the bedroom does not have a door in the door frame.

Sarah's apartment is a gem - a real taste of La Bohéme New York-style. Clean and comfortable, everything you need, and perfect location in the best part of the city. If it's available for your stay take it.
Sarah’s place is in an amazing location, and is a great building - the apartment is well furnished and Sarah was super helpful as I enjoyed my stay.

Artistic, cozy 5th floor apartment a couple blocks south of Tompkins Square Park. The apartment is bohemian and eclectic. I felt very much at home. You have access to all of the amazing restaurants, bars, and cafés of both the East Village and the Lower East Side.

Quiet building! Highly recommended, and Sarah is a breeze to deal with.

Note that there are four flights of stairs (good exercise!) and the closest subway is a 10–15 min walk.
Amazing place and stay!

The listing is conveniently located near the major A and C line (Nostrand Av metro station, approx. 7 mins by walking), and the Manhattan can be easily accessible, either the down town (Staten Island Ferry / Statue of Liberty, Nostrand Av - Jay St Metro Tech - Whitehall St South Ferry), mid town (911 Memorial, Wall Street, Nostrand - Fulton St), or up town (United Nations / Rockefeller Center / Time Square / Museum of Art, Nostrand Av - Jay St Metro Tech - B'way-Lafayette St - Grand Central / 86 St).

And it located at the top level of a street town house with free street parking available most of the time (well, except 9-10:30am every Tue and Friday for garbage collection, according to my memory. And though not many slots were available during our stay, but we could always find one to park our car). And it is value for money, cozy and very spacious in NY standard.

Furthermore, Mr and Mrs Ruthven are very attentive, welcoming and helpful. We were even attended by them personally although we checked in on the Christmas Day, and asked whether things went well during our stay. And they also helped to book a SUV for our check out for airport, as the normal cab is not fit for us.

Thanks for the hosting, and we had a good time here and will definitely recommend others to check out this nice listing.

Checked with the host why there were only a few reviews for them, though the listing is pretty nice. They explained that airbnb is not the main platform for them. And we are glad to give them a thumb up and you will not go wrong to choose them.

My friends and I had a great experience staying here. The hosts were very responsive and accommodating. They actually live in the same building on a different floor, so they are pretty accessible. They were very warm and welcoming and also helped us out by suggesting some local treats/restaurants! The apartment was spacious, comfortable and very clean. The location allows you to explore Brooklyn while also being easily accessible to Manhattan. I definitely recommend this apartment!

A wonderful apartment in an absolutely charming brownstone in Brooklyn.  The apartment was very clean and well appointed.  All necessities are provided and in excellent condition.  The hosts made us feel very welcome.  They shared information about the neighborhood, answered all our questions about getting around and even offered to walk us around the area.  A completely wonderful place to stay.

Definitely the genuine NYC experience here!
This is the perfect place for those looking for convenient, inexpensive & no-fuss accommodation. Edward was a gracious host, quick to respond to any queries I had & only too happy to play guide & share information to a traveller.
Would try to book again when I return, such a unique vibe!

What an odd little place. It's exactly as described - a very small place buried in the basement at the back of a larger apartment building. Apparently there are lots of apartments in NYC just like this, so you'll really get a feel of what it's like to be a typical New Yorker that doesn't work on Wall St. It's a great place to crash, but don't expect to get too comfortable (who wants to stay inside when you're in NYC, anyway?). The bed was a bit on the firm side, and my girlfriend ended up buying a small mat to take the edge off and it was fine. One thing to be aware of: sometimes the heat in the building is turned on, and since the main line radiator pipes pass through the apartment, it can get really hot in there really fast. We walked in from 50 degrees and raining to a dry 90 degrees inside the apartment! Once we got the fan and the window unit rolling, it became comfortable enough, so it wasn't any big deal. Overall the place is super functional, not fancy, and perfectly located close to just about everything.

Edward was a gracious host, and gave us a few tips of where to go and where to catch some good food in the neighborhood.

I'd recommend this place to anyone who is looking to spend most of their time exploring the city, isn't too concerned with creature comforts, and doesn't want to spend a lot of money. Thanks, Edward!

Edward was such a great host! The place is exactly as it looked, and Edward was really accommodating about letting me check in and out when it was convenient to my friend and me. I would definitely stay here again -- you can't beat the price or the location.
The host canceled my reservation 37 days before arrival.

I simply cannot recommend this apartment highly enough. We stayed here for 6 nights and it was an absolute pleasure. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable and clean.  Koray is a perfect host and we found him to be accommodating and considerate both prior to the  stay and during our visit. The apartment is located in a great part of the city and Koray recommended some lovely local restaurants and bars. It is also conveniently located for exploring other neighbourhoods.  This was our first airbnb experience and it exceeded our expectations.

Koray was a real gentleman. He was so helpful with all our needs. The apartment was lovely, in a real trendy part of town. If you want to experience New york like a new yorker, don't hesitate to give this place a go! Many thanks again,
Shona and Yossi.
The host canceled my reservation 38 days before arrival.
The host canceled my reservation 35 days before arrival.
The host canceled my reservation 17 days before arrival.
The host canceled my reservation 14 days before arrival.

Let us start by saying Koray is an excellent host. He was great in communicating before and during our stay.
Due to renovations at his apartment he arranged for us to stay at his business partners place which is a fantastic apartment in Chelsea just north of the west village. Koray was very helpful on our arrival providing great travel tips. A bit of a confusion meant we needed to change apartments and stayed back at korays apartment in the lower east side. The apartment is going to be a rockstar apartment when it's finished with a fantastic view and super stylish.
The lower east side is a bit grungy and cool but a very short walk to soho and Greenwich and easy to get around on the subway. So we definitely recommend korays apartment. Brace yourself for 5 floors of stairs but it's worth it at the top.

Koray very kindly waited for us when our flight was late in arriving, despite the late hour, which we really appreciated. The apartment is in a great location, very close to transport, little italy, china town, and so much more. We very much enjoyed our stay there, and have to say it is a gorgeous apartment (despite the 5 floor walk up). It's great to have your coffee in the morning over looking the park. The only issue we experienced was that there was no wifi during our stay, which Koray did his best to fix for us, but to no avail. Great host in a great city!

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment.  Koray was a great host.  The apartment had recently been renovated, is a great size, in a convenient location and has all of the necessities for a comfortable stay.

Koray was a brilliant host, very accomodating and easy to get in touch with if we ever needed anything!

Place was beautiful, spacious and clean & tidy. My girlfriend and i stayed here for a week and did not want to leave!!! Location of the apartment was perfect, only a short walk from chinatown, little italy, soho etc. not to mention - there were a bunch of lovely little cafe eateries just down the road from Koray's.

Would recommend this place to anyone - as long as they could put up with the 5 flights of stairs. It worked out well though, and ended up being our only form of exercise the whole time we were in the US.

Thank you Koray, for providing us with an amazing NY experience in your gorgeous apartment.
:)

the Apt was great, very modern designed pad. Stainless steel kitchen, timber floors, 2 toilets, lots of windows for natural light. Soho Prince street, Chinatown centre and Rivington street in LES are all a block away. Deli downstairs and subway stn Grand st on a main line is simply across the street. Staying in a pad with an edge and that was clean and newly refurbished was great to kick back in after busy days.

My second stay at Koray's apartment - I stayed at his old place last year, and his new place is even cooler than the last. Koray is a great host - communicative and helpful and he was quick to update me about the adverse weather conditions New York was facing the day before we were due to arrive. The apartment is close to the subway, and well located for bars and restaurants. We had a brilliant time in New York - the only downside to the apartment were the killer stairs up to the apartment - but on the plus side, it helped me to work off the massive New York food portion sizes :) Would definitely recommend and I hope to stay here again on any future trips to NYC.

Koray's apartment is TO DIE FOR! Okay, so the 80 stairs to get up and down with your luggage are a bit tough, but once you're there it's totally worth it. It's like a tiny corner of paradise, awesome design and features, really practical, wonderful place to relax. Can't recommend it enough. Total refit since the photos on Airbnb and somehow it's even groovier than it was. Great location close to so many cool places and a real home away from home. Koray was very responsive and helpful, even when I got there extremely late on my first morning. Highly recommend.

Semaine très agréable.
Nous n'avons croisé Edward qu'une fois (très sympathique) mais il était très disponible par mail, par téléphone.
Bon emplacement de l'appart et bon rapport qualité/prix.

Hosts Kara and Edward were super lovely and happy to help. The room is rather small..well, for someone like me who had 2 big suitcases, a carry on and a big bag. For someone who wanted a room and a fairly big bed with a bit of room, no problem. It wasn't really a problem for me either. I'm pretty easy when it comes to things like this. It was just a bed for me to sleep in really. Big clean bed. Comfy. No natural light in room though. I didn't spend much time in there as i was too busy seeing NYC. Bathroom was small but do-able. I'm only little. I'd say the place was quite clean. I caught Edward cleaning out the rooms once people had left to change the sheets, etc and clean the kitchen and bathroom and vaccum, so i was pleased. There were however a few cockroaches which have seen roaming around in the room and bathroom. No biggie though. The room has some hangers for your clothes if you need them. I didn't use them. There is a tv and a dvd player which i didn't use either. There is a small bedside table with a few drawers if you need it and there's a mirror too. It's not a hotel room so don't expect too much but is perfect for the simple traveller like myself who really just wanted a bed in a nice location. It's safe and it's near the corner of 5th St and Avenue A. There is a supermarket a block away and i always walked to 14th street to catch the L train to get to places. I thought the area was close to everything i needed. Kara was helpful when i arrived and waited until i got there as i got a little lost. Met some lovely people who lived in the room next to me too. This is my first time using airbnb so i didn't know what to expect, but i'll surely be using it again!

Only minusing points for the small room and cockroaches :) Though, i'm sure the small room part was already stated so that's my fault.

Thanks Ed and Kara!

We had a great stay here. The room is quaint but exactly what you need, and super peaceful for something in Manhattan! The area has a great vibe, with cafes, bars and restaurants all at close reach. The burger bar next door was quite possibly the best burger bar I went to whilst in NYC.

Edward is super friendly, helpful and accommodating; and has some great stories to share of all the people that have stayed there.

Definitely recommend this for people looking for cheap and convenient.
Very accommodating on short notice. Fast responses. Great place thank you
The only good thing about this place is the location.

My boyfriend and I stayed with Edward for two nights recently and we were both happy with the experience. The room was cool enough to sleep on two hot days in July, aided by the fact that it is a basement apartment and Edward’s fan set up. The towels and sheets were clean and seemed to have been purchased relatively recently and the common space was tidy. Edward was very nice, stopping to talk with us for a few minutes when we first go to the city and when we were on our way out. If he were in my city I would certainly meet up with him again.
The only downside I can think of is that the tiny bathroom was not quite as clean as I could have preferred, but it was fine and had everything we needed. The room wasn’t big, but the bed was firm and comfortably slept the two of us. It was also nice that the door to the room locked, so we felt safe leaving our suitcases there while we were out. The location was the high point for sure, as we were easily able to walk through the majority of lower manhattan, catch the subway, and on our last day we got a cab to the airport in no time.
I hope this is helpful to anyone considering staying with Edward. Have a good time!

I stayed here with my girlfriend for four nights. Edward was terrific and the room and apartment were exactly as described. Edward is more than accommodating with any of your needs and is a wonderful host. The apartment's location in the East Village is great. NYU, Washington Square Park and great East Village stores, restaurants and boutiques were all within walking distance. The Delancy St and 2nd Av subway stations are both close by. From there, you can reach almost anywhere in NYC in 30 minutes or less. While the apartment is not luxurious, you are close to just about anything you'd want to do in NYC. Also, Edward gave us great info on where to eat, how to get places and what things to do in the city. Highly recommend staying here for anyone planning to visit New York. The experience was great.

Nous avons été accueillis par un ami d'Edward car celui-ci était parti faire du camping. Là, mauvaise surprise : le logement, que nous avions compris comme étant un rez-de-chaussée, était en fait une cave dans une cour pleine d'ordures, de poubelles, et de meubles usagés.
"L'appartement" ne comportait aucune fenêtre, aucune aération, était vraiment d'une propreté douteuse, le frigo ne marchait pas...Le premier soir en faisant la cuisine, nous avons eu la désagréable surprise de rencontrer un cafard, puis deux, puis trois...Pareil dans la cour où ils pullullaient. Le deuxième soir, nous nous sommes aperçus qu'il y avait des puces dans la literie, donc nous sommes partis. Alors que nous avions payé pour cinq nuits.
Nous n'avons jamais rencontré Edward, qui nous a quand même envoyé un mail pour savoir s'il y avait un problème...
J'oublie : les rencontres avec les clochards du coin qui se lavent au jet dans la cour ou qui fouillent dans les poubelles quand vous sortez le matin.
Même si elle est éminemment bien placée dans NY (quoique l'East Village prenne des allures de cour des miracles en journée, avec des rassemblements de marginaux), peu chère, et pas loin des transports et d'une supérette, une adresse absolument à éviter donc, sauf si l'on est un routard très très très endurci.

Edward was a great host! friendly and very relaxed. Our expierence there was great! the department is located in a really convenient place. Even though it doesn't seem too luxurious at first sight, it is very confortable and it has everything you need.
Edward really made the most of this small basement apartment. He was very accommodating, and The place made for a nice stay.

First of all, I put 3 stars to our stay, but I could have put 2 or 4 stars. Edward is a really kind person, he really takes care of his guests. But the apartment is not so good ! The appartment is really dark, there are few cockroaches, the bathroom is quite old and not so perfectly clean! BUT, the apartment has a great location and for this price you can't find any hotel in NYC. For students, it's a quite good location !

My brother and I stayed in NYC for one week and we were really happy with the apartment. It's located right in the middl of East Village which is a very good place for people who love bars, pubs and restaurants. Also, it's just a 5 min walk away from the subway station, so you can go anywhere in no time.
Edward was very helpful with giving us directions, especially when I first called him at the airport. We met up twice, so he told us some more things about where to go and what to do.
Altogether, I really recommend this apartment.

Ruthven es un gran anfitrión. Nos recibió él mismo en su casa y nos proporcionó todo lo que necesitábamos para hacernos nuestras primeras horas más fáciles.
El barrio es agradable, tranquilo y nos permitió vivir NYC de una manera más cercana y personal.
El departamento es muy espacioso, se encuentra en muy buenas condiciones y está completamente equipado.
Pasamos un gran momento! Muchas gracias!

Great place for the price ! Check in / out was very flexible and we got 2 sets of keys so it's easier to go back and forth to the city. City was a short metro ride from Ruthven's place. Neighbourhood was pretty quiet  and looked pretty safe. Be careful walking in the dark further than a metro stop you will run into few streets where you don't want to be. Overall great experience, would use Ruthven's place again in the future.

What an awesome experience my family had with Ruthven and Olympia!  Both greeted us upon arrival and immediately made us feel at home.  The apartment was exactly as advertised.  It was well appointed, very clean and quiet, plus the location was fantastic.  The subway station and the cutest eateries were all within a 5-minute walk.  But best of all was the personal service of our hosts.  After a long cross country flight, walking into the apartment and seeing fresh flowers, bottled water and orange juice was epic.  Never before have I received such a warm welcome.  Thank you Ruthven & Olympia for a very special visit.

From the beautiful fresh flowers to the chilled water and juice in the fridge, everything was ready for us upon arrival. The space is exactly as it looks in the photos and very welcoming.

The beds are super comfortable. The location was great. We walked home from the Nostrand subway on several occasions late at night without problem.

There are some great restaurants in the area. There is one at the corner of Jefferson and Nostrand (I think it is called Alice's) which was delicious. Bedford Hall, a five minute walk away, was a great place to grab a drink and a bite.

The hosts were great, although we only met Olympia. Communication was easy and hosts were accommodating of us arriving at different times.

Randomly, if you are tall, you might care that the shower head is higher than average so likely will not have to squat to shower properly.

If the apartment is available on my next trip, I would definitely stay again.

Olympia and Ruthven nous ont très bien accueilli chez eux. Avec grand sourire et gentillesse! Ils nous ont fait visiter leur quartier et indiqué où se trouvaient les épiceries et supermarchés proches.
We had a really lovely stay at the apartment. The apartment was really good and the hosts were friendly and they made us feel very welcome. I would definitely go back again! Thanks!

We completely enjoyed our stay! We flew in on a trans-atlantic flight and were very tired. So tired, that we didn't want to even pick up snacks/drinks on the way to this home. We found fresh flowers on the table and ice cold water and orange juice waiting in the fridge. Just what we needed.
The hosts had made arrangements for us to easily get into the apartment and then came up to meet us the next morning.
This home is in an easy to access area of Brooklyn. We made our way via the JFK AirTran and then the A-train to this place. It was so convenient.
The area has several cute boutique type places to eat; with gluten free options, which was a plus for our family.

The apartment/home was very clean and bright. It had all we needed for our stay. We would love to go back and stay longer the next time!

Malgré notre retard à l'arrivée, nous avons été super bien accueillis et notre hôte a même pris le temps de nous accompagner jusqu'à un restaurant où elle nous a présentés au propriétaire.
l'appart était très propre et tout a fait conforme aux photos. Nous avons apprécié la clim car nous avions eu chaud toute la journée sur Manhattan. Lits super confortables.
Brooklyn peut paraître un peu éloigné de Manhattan (une petite demi heure du domicile au cœur de Manhattan en métro), mais c'est finalement beaucoup moins aseptisé, on a eu l’impression d'être bien plus avec des new-yorkais (ils y vivent) que dans toute l'ile de Manhattan envahie parles touristes.
Ruthven nous a aidé à trouver une place pour notre voiture dans les rues adjacentes. Il a été vérifier chaque jour qu'il n'y avait pas de soucis.
A conseiller sans aucun soucis.

Nos sentimos muy cómodos, a pocas cuadras del metro y comunicados. La zona es muy concurrida y segura, hay bares y mercados cerca que solucionan todo lo que se necesita. Así mismo Ruthven y Olympia son excelentes anfitriones, nos han ayudado con todo lo que necesitamos. Altamente recomendable!

We enjoyed our stay here. Ruthven and Olympia were very friendly and helpful. The apartment was spacious and clean. It's also an easy walk to the subway, so getting to Manhattan and the airport is simple. Would definitely stay here again.

C'est avec regret que nous avons quitter l'appartement de Ruthven et Olympia dans lequel nous avons passé une très belle semaine. Il est encore plus sympa que sur les photos. Agréable, frais (AC partout), parfait pour 4, joli, bien décoré, bien isolé de l'extérieur, représentant tout le charme des brownstones de Brooklyn, c'est un lieu à découvrir où l'on retrouve une certaine tranquillité après l'effervescence de Manhattan. Idéalement situé sur la ligne A (express) /C , on relie rapidement Fulton Street, Canal Street ou encore Times square.
La station de métro est à 300 m juste à coté de 2 superettes et autres magasins. Restos variés (latins, carraibes...) tout près de l'appartement et du métro.
Le voisinage est très sympa et comme toujours à Brooklyn, sans nous connaitre les voisins et autres personnes croisés dans la rue ont toujours un "bonjour" ou "bienvenue à brooklyn".
Ruthven a eu la gentillesse de nous faire faire une visite rapide du quartier en nous faisant bénéficier de ses conseils.
Je remercie Ruthven et Olympia pour leur accueil chaleureux, leur présence, leur disponibilité et leur aide jusqu'au dernier moment (tout particulièrement en ce qui me concerne).....
Jefferson ave va rester notre adresse à Brooklyn!

Vi fik den sødeste velkomst af Ruthven og Olympia da vi ankom sen eftermiddag og de havde sat vand, mælk og juice til os i køleskabet. Lejligheden levede fuldt ud op til vores forventninger, masser af plads til vores familie på fem voksne og dejlig ren. Da vi spurgte til supermarked i området, sagde Olympia, at hun meget gerne ville vise os rundt i nabolaget, hvis vi havde lyst. Det var alletiders, og vi fik da endda handlet lidt ind til aftensmad på vejen.
Lejligheden ligger meget tæt på subway, hvor man tager linie A ind til Manhattan på mindre end 30 min. Og skal man til JFK lufthavn er det også det helt rigtige sted at bo. Dejligt område, livligt, men alligevel meget stille og roligt når man sammenligner med midtown/uptown. Det var skønt at komme hjem til lejligheden efter en lang dag på farten.
Hvis vi nogensinde vender tilbage, ville vi bo her igen.

We enjoyed every minute of our stay in this beautiful apartment. Ruthven and Olympia were wonderful hosts, and have thought of everything needed to make a stay convenient and comfortable. The location was perfect for our stay - with the metro just a few minutes away by foot - making it easy to explore both Brooklyn and Manhattan.  We would certainly stay again!

We had a great week at Ruthven's apartment. The place is fantastic; the neighborhood is friendly and handy for the subway (Nostrand Avenue). Lots of places to eat - we particularly enjoyed breakfasting at the local Dominican cafe.

Ruthven and Olympia were extremely friendly, welcoming and accommodating. We would definitely stay here again when we return to New York.

We stayed with Edward for 2 weeks and we had a great experience. The room and apartment provides you with all the basic things you need in NYC. The apartment is located in the basement of a very popular part of town where there are always things to do and is close to the tourist shopping and sightseeing areas. Edward gave us tips about where to go and provided us with a subway map and tourist guide. Edward was a great host, we could reach him anytime if we had questions or needed some info about something. Overall, a great experience

We stayed at Ruthven’s apartment last weekend, during the heat wave. Ruthven graciously accommodated a late arrival, and had the A/C already turned on, so that the apartment would be comfortable upon our arrival. There was even a vase of fresh flowers on the table, and some water in the refrigerator. Ruthven helped us find late dining options for the first night, and was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay.
We found free street parking directly in front of the apartment right away, and saw that there often were free spots available on the street throughout the weekend (that was a welcome and unexpected savings right there!). The apartment was immaculate. We found that the rooms seemed more spacious than the impression we got from the pictures. 6 of us (3 adults/3 young kids) stayed for the weekend without ever feeling like we were on top of each-other.The furniture was of good quality and very comfortable. The HDTV, Cable and WIFI all worked well. The neighborhood is safe and both quiet (i.e. no traffic or raucous street noises) and vibrant (i.e. people are active at all times). There are many dining options close-by, and access to public transportation was very easy. We found that based on all of the above, the price per night was truly reasonable.
Overall, this was an excellent experience, we would highly recommend Ruthven’s apartment.

Accueil souriant et chaleureux, la communication avant et pendant notre séjour a été excellente. Ils ont été plein d'attention à notre égard. L'appartement était assez grand pour une famille de 5 personnes, tout était réuni pour un premier séjour à New York.
Encore un grand merci !

Adèle

Our hosts were gracious and kind.  The accommodations were exactly as described and shown in the pictures.  The house was conveniently located near a subway as well as an all night market. Our hosts were always available and helpful with any requests or questions that we had. My travelling companion, my mother, and I would stay again without question.

Ruthven and his wife were both so welcoming and accomodating! I rented with them for my mother-in-law's birthday and when we checked in there was a bouquet of flowers and a birthday card! The 2br is beautiful, and the neighborhood has so much to offer and is right near the A/C train!

Ruthven and Olympia were wonderful hosts and very friendly. They were always available and helpful with any doubt. The apartment had all the facilities and amenities for my family. Moreover, the place was very clean and organized. The neighborhood is very safety. Of course, I recommend the apartment to all the people. If I return to New York, I would definitely stay here again.

We had a great time at Ruthven's beautiful apartment during the labor Day weekend. There was a block party on the day we arrived and Ruthven was extremely kind to invite us to that party. The house is clean and perfect for 3-4 guests. Wish we could stay a little longer.

We had a wonderful stay in Brooklyn! The apartment was very clean, spacious, quiet, and only 3-4 blocks from the subway station. Ruthven and Olympia were flexible on check in time and allowed us to arrive earlier than published check in time. We got lost on the way to the apartment (MY address error with uber; Note: Jefferson St. and Jefferson Ave. are different!) and Ruthven was very patient and gracious as we found our way. He checked on us multiple times to make sure we found the apartment and was there waiting to help get us settled into the apartment. While we were in New York City, a bombing took place and Ruthven reached out to us to make sure we were safe and ok for the night. I very much appreciated the concern and care they had for us as new visitors in the city.  I highly recommend staying here as it is on a quiet street, close to public transportation, and great hosts! We will be back!

Located on a quiet street of brownstones in Brooklyn, this home was comfortable and roomy.  The hosts were there when we needed them, but didn't bother us when we didn't need them! They did extra things that we appreciated, like provided coffee, flowers, and orange juice. The three flights of stairs are a challenge with luggage, but worth the trouble.  Thank you, Ruthven and Olympia, for a pleasant stay.

Olympia and Ruthven are the most amazing hosts you could wish for. Their apartment is cozy and has loving touches all over the place (such as fresh flowers upon arrival). The location of the apartment is perfect. It is around 10 minutes walk to the next subway line which will get you everywhere, you’ll be downtown in just 30 minutes! The area the apartment is in is great, too. A lot of small shops and restaurants are around that have a Brooklyn touch and are just amazing to discover.
Olympia and Ruthven also help out with recommendations regarding dinner etc. (Go and try Angela’s right down the street for some Caribbean food!) and just try to make the stay as convenient and nice as possible. This place is highly recommended to everyone and if we ever make our way back up to NY, we will definitely stay again at Olympia’s and Ruthven’s.
The host canceled this reservation 40 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

My family and I truly enjoyed our stay at Ruthven's place. Him and his wife greeted us at the front door and showed us around the apartment. We arrived on Christmas Day and Ruthven had a bottle of wine in the house and fresh flowers, truly nice details.  He also gave my dad, boyfriend and brother a tour of the neighborhood and showed them where everything we needed to know was (subway, grocery stores, etc.). The place was clean, spacious and comfortable, we had everything we needed. Ruthven and his wife were great hosts. All in all, we loved our stay in Bed-Stuy and loved being in NYC. It was always nice to come home form touring around Manhattan to this nice quiet neighborhood in Brooklyn (the brown stones on the street are super cool).

Edward was very friendly, helping carry our heavy bags down to the room & providing maps/ nyc guides. The east village is an awesome location, surrounded by quirky little restaurants & bars & fairly close to the subway. Our stay was affected by hurricane sandy & he was very quick with communication due to travel changes that occurred. The room was small but comfortable, bed linen & towels provided were nice.

Edward and his girlfriend did everything to make our stay very welcome and enjoyable.
The apartment is very simple and we only used it to sleep and if you want it for that reason it's okay. It is not a place to spent much time, because it's dark and not too cosy. At night (in winter) it is very warm and there is not much daylight. The privacy is not high because we shared the kitchen and bathroom with another (by the way: a very friendly man) resident (which was not mentioned).
The place is clean en kept tidy good enough. The neighbourhood is friendly and nice, and there are some good cafes (the croissant cafe is excellent!) and coffeeshops and stores.
We recommend the place for those who want a very affordable place to sleep and shower and who do not want topquality or luxury.

Our experience is that we had a good host who gave us value for money and above all: who was friendly and generous.

Thanks Edward for the experience!

Edward was very cool about letting me and my friend check in earlier in the morning, having just jumped off an overnight redeye flight from LA.  Very easy going, gave me a quick rundown of things to enjoy the apartment and our stay.  We were not home often so I didn't really see Edward after but he made it clear that we can call him if we needed anything.  Great location!  And as his description said, he did have roommates and they were cool and friendly!  I'd definitely come back here again.
Very good experience in the flat of Edward ! it was very nice to met him ! It's a very nice "hote" !

Edward was a great host: good communication even before booking and throughout stay. And he is a very nice guy!
The room was exactly as pictured. It is very basic but had everything I needed. I was going to be out enjoying the city and wanted a clean, safe place to shower, sleep, and charge my phone. I wasn't planning on hanging out in the apartment, so location and price were much more important to me than having a deluxe spa accommodation. The location is great: lots of good food within walking distance (even on the same block), supermarket 1 block away, post office nearby, deli on the corner. Easy access to the subway. The apartment does not get a lot of natural light and the tub is old so the undercoat shows through the porcelain even when it is scrubbed. For such a fabulous location at such a reasonable price that was fine with me. - like all older buildings in NY, the heating turns on / off based on outside temp, so sometimes it is too cold or too hot
- because access is via the interior courtyard, you have to walk past rubbish dumps to get in (on rubbish days)

THANK YOU, Koray! Best, Birgit
Very spacious and clean apartment — we had a great stay. Communication with Koray also very easy.
Great and specIal Place and nice Communication. Thank u !
Fantastic loft!  Beautifully-designed, bright and open space, well-stocked, and super clean.  Koray was very responsive.  Would absolutely return.

We can recommend Koray's apartment on the Lower East side. It is really beautiful, spacious, modern and fully equipped. Koray lives with his family in the apartment himself, so that you can enjoy the advantages of a fully equipped apartment in addition to the comfort. The apartment is designed according to a modern industrial style and the kitchen is simply stunning and contains everything you need; Olive oil, good pepper, tea...etc. The apartment also has exceptionally comfortable beds, which is great for rest. It is also centrally located in Manhattan. At least two subway stations are very close to the apartment, so you can get anywhere quickly (15 minutes Central Park, 10 minutes 9/11, etc.). You can walk to Little Italy in 5 minutes or in chic Soho or in Broadway shopping street in 10 minutes, where you have endless possibilities for dining or shopping. Koray is above average attentive. Having spent two weeks in NYC, we had many questions for him. He is always very polite, quick and precise in the answers. We see this as an exceptionally valuable service. The only special thing is the Lower Eastside area. You can feel that there is a lot of up-and-coming potential and that the area is developing; but the area is rough. You see many homeless and begging people and the cleanliness of the streets is not yet of the highest standard everywhere. On the other hand, this also gives room for many original small coffee shops, artistic shops and wonderful culinary shops where you can eat fantastically and internationally. ... We were able to spend two wonderful weeks in NYC and were very happy for Koray's apartment so that we could retreat to a nice place in the evening after exciting days.

Lovely apartment, tastfully furnished, perfectly equipped, with a fantastic view. It is located in bustling neighbourhoud with lots of restaurants and coffeeshops.
The only drawback could be that soundproofing is limited and it can be quite noisy especially at night due to the lively atmosphere around.

Loved staying here! Bright and cheery top floor with unobstructed views. Perfect for our family of 4, plenty of room and bedrooms are on opposite ends with separate bathrooms for plenty of privacy for all. Easy to get anywhere with the subway around the corner. I’d love to stay here again! Thank you Koray!

Koray’s apartment is beautiful in every way. The view can take your breath away. It is a walk up but worth every step up. This is his own home and is kept incredibly well.

Ruthven's place is a gem.  My family and I were so pleasantly surprised at how homey and comfortable we were in the space and we were able to enjoy a great thanksgiving holiday together. nice place, clean, safe and we had all  owner’s support

Comfortable and convenient 2 bedroom apartment  in Brooklyn near the subway. Really felt like we were locals, buying our groceries and getting on the train. Lovely place to come home to each night after seeing the sights of NYC.

Ruthven and Olivia have been great hosts for me and my family. We loved our month long stay! We would have extended if it wasn’t booked up. Nice neighborhood and easy access to transportation and other facilities.

Cheap, easy-going and in a great location. It was snowing outside and the room was still really warm. Great for anyone who only needs a place to sleep, wash and store their belongings.

Slightly confused on when I arrived how to get into the building, and who to contact. Other than that, absolutely wonderful experience and location. Probably one of the quietest blocks in NYC, right next to one of the best ramen restaurants

Had an AMAZING time in New York City thanks to the hospitality of Edward and Dennis, the Super.  The bed is literally like sleeping in a hug.  The best bed to sleep in  after hitting up the city. We enjoyed our stay - the apartment is centrally located in the cool east village, room was warm& comfy provided a good night sleep. Edward is really friendly and a great conversationalist! He was flexible with our check in/ out time and always helpful. Thank u !

Edward is an awesome host, easy talk to, and knows the great places ( e.g. : Cafe, supermarket, how to go to subway stations ) in the area. The location is very good it isn't crowed area filled with tourists, so you can stay the usual life in NYC. I highly recommend staying there. Thank you for wonderful so many experiences there! His Apt is nice atmosphere, clean room, bed is super comfortable. Thanks, Edward!!!

A very basic room which has just what you need - the main attraction is great location. A good option if you want to save on New York accommodation. Friendly and helpful host. Clean, quiet to sleep. Very good wifi.

An affordable room, convenient location, mostly a place to sleep at night, take a bath in the morning and prepare your breakfast (but what else do you need if you are visiting NY?) Edward is a nice and easy host who always is ready to solve any of your requiriments.

What you see is what you get, small room in basement with no view but you stay here for the location and nothing else. Shared bathroom and kitchen were clean enough and Edward was a very nice and friendly host. Maybe the wall between the two rooms was a bit too thin. Julian and Karen are great! The apartment is super clean well kept which made for an enjoyable stay.

Highly recommended!

My flight got delayed and I arrived really late. Me and my girlfriend ended up having to check in much later than planned but Julian had no issues with that. The apartment was nice and cozy. Everything was clean. Julian even gave us a little gift and brought us down a bottle of wine shortly after we had arrived. He also offered to bring me to and from the airport, really nice. Truly an accommodating host. It was close to the subway line too so getting into Manhattan was relatively quick. I would gladly stay here again any time.

House on Henry is clean, spacious and feels safe. Shower and bathroom in general is upgraded and beautiful. Shower and tub are spacious and clean. All appliances work well; though I didn;t try the clothes washer, I was pleased to see one there. The bed was clean and comfortable.

Annette and Carlo seem kind and I think want the best for their guests, but I think it fair to note that almost all of the reviews below refer to their apt in Park Slope. House on Henry is not quite as nice and has some shortcomings and safety issues.

Location is really not in Carroll Gardens, more like on the "edge" of Carroll Gardens, at the very end of Henry Street, butted up against the Brooklyn Queens Expressway (BQE) and pretty noisy at night. It's not on a nice quiet tree-lined street like the other parts of Carroll Gardens.

There were no lights in the hallway, and the wooden banister on the steep flight of stairs was loose. Coupled with the neighbor kid's jogging stroller left in front of the stairs at night, these things made ascending the stairs and unlocking the door a real adventure.

There were overhead lights in the place, and there were three lamps in the apt, but only one of them had a light bulb. The AC unit in the bedroom wasn't operating properly. There were no extra sheets or blankets of any kind to use on the day bed in the living room. There were no instructions on how to use the TV remote, and I couldn't get it to change the channels. When I called Carlo or Annette, they always promised to come over and bring the bulbs and a blanket, but they never did.

This is the most rent I have ever paid on a place in 6 visits to NY over the last 8 years, so I have to say, I think for the cost, it wasn't as luxurious as I expected. It's the risk one takes when choosing a place based on a few small photos. Next time I will ask my son to come check the place out in person first.

I do appreciate the cleanliness of the spot, and the friendly attitude of the hosts. Just attend to a few of these details mentioned, and perhaps give a warning of how close to the Expressway the place is, and House on Henry will be much improved.

I have tried to be factual in this review.

thanks.

The house on Henry St has some pluses: new kitchen, spacious bathroom with good water pressure, washer-dryer combo, overall clean and fairly comfortable. Negatives were minor but still negatives: bannister for the narrow wooden staircase leading to the apt was very loose, the stairway lights were on timers (not light sensors)so it was very dim as the days were getting short in early October, there were no instructions to operate the TV or any other information regarding the neighborhood (i.e. directions to the subway, restaurant recommendations, that are not mandatory but certainly helpful to first time vistors to Brooklyn). The location of the apt was 5 blocks from the Carroll St. station, but otherwise removed from the desirable areas of Carroll Gardens.

(Note: try the Tues-Wed Prix Fixe dinner at "Chestnut" restaurant on Smith. Great food, superior value!)
We loved staying at the House on Henry.  We had everything we needed to make the house feel like a home away from home.    Next visit to New York, I plan to stay there.
The apt was nicely furnished and comfortable. We felt it was overpriced as we have stayed in similar apts for less and had not had to pay a cleaning fee.

While communicating with Annette while in Brooklyn or after wasn't the best, I absolutely loved my time at her place. I can not stop raving about it to my friends.

I believe staying in such a lovely, clean home helped cement Carroll Gardens as a place I'd like to move.(I was neighborhood scouting on this trip)

Though the street noise wasn't ideal, you really can't beat the ease of walking to the subway or the charming neighborhood this apartment is located in.

I highly recommend Annette's places. They are spotless and beautifully decorated.

We were very pleased with our stay.  The place was very clean,  and charming.  There were 4 of us staying here, and we were mostly gone during the days, and only their at nights to rest our heads.  The building was very quiet, and we slept well.  The House is in a super great neighborhood, and Annette was very hospitable with all the accommodations.  I would definitely recommend this place to someone, and stay there again!

Lovely place overall. Two beds, nice bathroom with tub. Host left soap and shampoo, very nice touch and much appreciated! Plenty of storage.

End of Henry street means that you are close to the freeway, so there is a fair bit of traffic noise especially on weekday mornings. Much quieter on weekends. Great location otherwise - close to tons of restaurants in Carroll Gardens and you can also walk across to Red Hook. Great place, we would use it again and recommend to friends!

House on Henry was wonderful! Annette was flexible with my late arrival time due to Amtrak delays, and I had no problems. The AC kept the suite a perfect temperature despite it being 100+ outside, and the location was a 5-10 minute walk to the Subway. I had no problem with road noise and although it's not in the thick of things, you're just a few blocks from the main drag of Carroll Gardens shops and restaurants. It was also very easy to catch a cab just 1 block away on Clinton Street. If I need a place to stay in Brooklyn, I will definitely look up House on Henry again!

First let me say that I think the apartment would be fine for younger travelers who don't care where they stay.
