The block itself is unattractive given that the surrounding area is actually quite pretty, but very residential.

Now onto the experience of my parents... When walking into the building there's a pungent smell of cat urine, enough said.

The apartment although what seemed clean on the surface is old, the furniture is uncomfortable due to scratchy fabrics, has old mattresses and has dirty ice cube trays.

The air conditioners have passed their prime and don't cool the space off sufficiently. There's absolutely no flowing air. This creates a major problem in the summer.

There's religious paraphernalia, which should be left out along with a strange head of something.

Lastly, Annette the host was pleasant enough, but is charging far too much for an apartment that needs some work and is difficult location.

Great location, excellent neighbourhood, close to the sights and lots of dining places around. Nice room with AC, definitely recommend this place

Also four o'clock is a very late check in time and no effort was made to allow us to leave bags earlier.

We had an excellent stay in House on Henry. The apartment offers great value for money. The apartment sleeps 5, 2 x queen size beds and 1 couch in the living room. Noise level is low despite the freeway in close vicinity. The place was clean and cozy, good kitchen and bath. The nearest subway station is Carroll St, about 5-10 min walk. A cab to midtown Manhattan will set you back 20-25 bucks.

We enjoyed our stay at the 2nd Floor Suite. Annette greeted us upon arrival and quickly responded to our request for an additional fan (the bedroom has a ceiling fan) and extra set of keys. The apartment was tastefully appointed as described. The unusually warm weather, though, made the living space feel stuffy, especially at night when the loud traffic noise discouraged us from keeping the windows open.

The apartment was very comfortable & near major highways. We enjoyed staying there very much. Our hostess, Annette, was very friendly & helpful when we checked in. We would definitely stay there again when we visit New York again. This was our first experience with AIRBNB & are about to use this service again for our next trip.It was so much more comfortable then staying in a hotel room.

The best and excellent solution to the accomodation problem of the whole family during our stay in Brooklyn, NY, in connection with the wedding of our daugther Maria-Laura. it is worth mentionning the courtesy and professionalism of the host Annette Bruno.
Very comfortable and accommodating. Annette makes it easy to stay here and it's a great location.

I was a bit weary to rent this space based on some of the negative complaints, like noise and stuffiness, but I'm SO glad I went ahead and booked, as the place is absolutely adorable, impeccably clean, and incredibly comfortable.

The mid-century meets French vintage is charming, the apartment itself has great bones and tons of character, the kitchen and bathroom are renovated and modern, and the bed is super comfortable.

There are two air conditioners, so I'm not sure what anyone meant by 'stuffy.' It is New York city so there is some car noise, but it's really not at all bad.

Overall, I thought the price for such a cute place in an awesome neighborhood was well worth it. Plus, the host let us check in early and check out late, which was amazing considering we got in at 6am and really wanted to nap before heading out.

Will definitely stay there again and couldn't recommend it more!

With pleasure have spent time in apartments. A good location, 20 mines to Manhattan. Friendly and careful owners. Have provided a transfer from the airport and back. In apartments there is all necessary. Nearby a market and metro station.

Julian was a great host, and the apartment was exactly as pictured.  We had a great time staying in the apartment.  Just an FYI for light sleepers bring some ear plugs, or you'll wake up to the water pipe.

We had an excellent time staying here! It is two blocks away from the J train and 20 minutes ride into Manhattan. Julian picked us up from the airport after arriving really late at night. The bedroom is really spacious and is so quiet and dark at night you could hear a pin drop.

I think it took like 15-20 minutes to get to canal street in Manhattan.  What made the experience even better was that Julian and Karen are great hosts. We probably called Karen a million times and she was really very patient and helpful with all our questions. My parents had a great time, and overall it was great value for money. If there is anything at all that I saw negatively, it was that the place was in Brooklyn, and it seemed a little creepy to walk around at night.
Very nice apartment, 20 minutes by metro to Manhattan, good grocery stores nearby. Julian and Caren were very helpful.
Lovely apartment, lovely people. Would definitely stay there again and recommend them to friends. Made my stay very simple. 5 stars *****

Great, cute little place. A bit humid for the summer without A/C, but since it is on the basement floor, the temperature was pretty cool, and never uncomfortable. We didn't take the fan Julian offered us, but looking back, it might've been nice to have the extra air circulation. The commute to midtown was about 40 mins, but we didn't mind since we weren't on a strict schedule. And, having free wifi was a definite plus for our trip-planning. Overall, it was a nice and comfortable place to come back to at night and rest up for our adventures the next day. Julian and his wife were very friendly, warm, helpful people, and we definitely enjoyed our stay in new york! We would stay here again!
A very nice, clean, and cozy apt. We enjoyed our stay very much. Julian was very friendly, responsive, and helpful. :)

My boyfriend and I stayed at Julian's Brooklyn Cove apartment for 4 nights while visiting friends and family in Manhattan.  We had a great stay!  The apartment was clean, comfortable and just two blocks from the train that took us directly into Manhattan.  Julian was extremely friendly and helpful.  We would definitely recommend his place to anyone!

Julian and his wife are just Amazing!!! We arrived a little bit sooner than planed, it wasn't a problem!! We arrived hungry, they took us to a really good and "Brooklyn style" restaurant! Thank you again for this wonderfull welcome! See you soon!!!!

Julian is a very nice host. He picked us up from the airport and the apartment was very nice and clean. He was kind and we really enjoyed staying at his place. Would definitely recommend it :)

I enjoyed 4 quiet and blissful evenings at Brooklyn Cove. I had a last minute job opp. that brought me to NY, and Brooklyn Cove was my first pick b/c I liked the value for what was being presented.

Although the commute to Manhattan was long, it was a great value to know I would be going back home after a long day in a crowded and loud city to a quiet retreat of a place.
The ammenities were clean and tastefully presented. Julian communicated with me throughout my stay and made sure everything was ok.

Everything was just as advertised, except better!
The property was clean, tidy and very comfortable.
Julian and his wife were very kind, welcoming and helpful.
It was a delight to have them as hosts and I hope to go back to stay with them again soon.
Thank you!

I filmed with my 16mm movie camera. I think it will be awesome ! This city is just ... amazing !!! So listen to me : if you want to visit NYC not like a tourist, Go to Brooklyn Cove. Julian will hook you up ;-)
Julian is a really nice host! The house was well comunicated and comfortable, except when it rains! We spent a really good time and enjoyed NY very much.

Area was for me very Convenient to transportation and travel to and from the airport.

A nice and inexpensive way to enjoy New York. The appartment is close to the subway, which comes in handy. Try to check out Brooklyn Heights and Williamsburg!
The appartment is fairly clean, but as it is a basement appartment it is something to get used to.

The very 1st and foremost thing I like about staying at this apartment is the host Julian and his wife. Julian is very responsive, anytime I called he always picked up the phone and answered all the questions I have, which is very important to me (and I believe for other as well) who is a traveller and not familiar with the city.
Considering it is a New York City, Julian's apartment is very spacious. There is a lovely garden, and there is a enough ventilation for airflow in the apartment. If you travel by MTA Subway, there is an easy walking distance to the nearest station, and you will be in Manhattan in less than half an hour.
Julian also gave me a reliable taxi company to bring me to JFK airport that Sunday morning, with no traffic and it takes only 15 minutes.
For the location and pricing, I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

We stayed at Julian's for over a week. It was incredibly good value for New York.
He was very accommodating and helpful, always easy to contact.
Bushwick is a vibrant place and there is a subway station at the end of the road, about 2 minutes walk, which takes you to Williamsburg or Manhattan.

Our stay at Julians apartment was exact what we expected and how it is described at airbnb. Julian and his wife were very kind and helpful. They were always available whenever we had questions. We enjoyed our stay very much and can recoommend this apartment in Brooklyn to100%.  ps: Sweet dog ;-) THX!

Stayed here in late Oct. 2011 for 4 days. It's really close to the subway station, about 2 blocks away.   The location doesn't have any interesting eateries to walk to so it's best to catch a cab somewhere or the subway.  The location might seem scary to some, but was pretty safe.  We would get back almost every night passed midnight and would walk back from the subway to the apartment and it was always safe.  It's really loud upstairs and if you're a light sleeper, it can be quite annoying so you might want to take some earplugs. The room itself is small, but perfect for 2 and if you're not planning on staying indoors then it's not even an issue. Julian was kind and friendly and the room was clean.  Everything that you might need is there, except for TV so take a laptop if you need it. The free wi-fi was a PLUS for netflix movies at 3am when I couldn't sleep from the noise upstairs.

Hosts Julian and Karen were super friendly and helpful. Very easy to contact and did all they could to ensure we had a great time in new York. Accomidation was as advertised, and presented good value for money. Good location just two blocks from the j train, which is a twenty minute commute to manhatten. If you are a light sleeper pack ear plugs as there is a little noise from the apartment upstairs, and the pipes in the walls.
Julian and Karen were great!  Nice apartment and convenient location.  I'd gladly stay here again!
We very much enjoyed our stay in Julian's apartment.  We appreciated how clean it was and how close it was to the train.  Being able to park our car in front was a treat.

This appartment is really recommendable, no doubts. Just like it is described.
Julian is a great host.
Thanks again!

Hi,
We recommend the accommodation of Julian in Brooklyn because of the price, the own kitchen, the space and proximity to the subway. Julian is a perfect host. The neighborhood is quiet and very close to Manhattan ... but I recommend that because you can enjoy life in Brooklyn and its neighborhoods.

Thank you Julian...and see you at Barcelona

The place is great, and it is just as it looks in the pictures. The bed is very comfortable, the whole apartment was neatly clean, and the towels and linens were impecable. It is very well located, since it is just 2 blocks away from the subway station. The wi-fi conection is fine too. Julian is a very nice host. Highly recomended place.

It was easy to communicate with Julian who answered always quickly our requests.

The place could have been cleaner but it was really convenient.Close to the subway station (5 mn)and it took 25 mn to go to Manhattan.
We had a parking place which is nice in New-York, grocery store, pharmacy, coffee are near by...Spacious place for NY with kitchen.

Let me start off and say that Julian is the man.

Despite our last minute reservation, Julian was able to quickly accommodate us during our stay in Brooklyn. Also, since we were extremely rushed upon arrival, he was also able to work around our schedule for key pick-up. He was also just a text / phone call away in case we needed anything, and was kind enough to check up on us via text after our first night.

Over all, our experience was awesome! We enjoyed a complimentary bottle of wine after a long day of filming in the city, and the bed itself was a super comfortable, providing us with a fantastic night sleep and the energy to be on set early in the morning. Also, the bathroom was stocked, complete with shampoo, hair dryer, soap, first aid kit, etc. which was nice because we had no time to pick up the necessities. Finally, each room had it's own heater/temp control, which is pretty cool in itself.

As for the surrounding neighborhood, it is as authentic as Brooklyn gets. With a fantastic little breakfast diner and some awesome hole-in-the-wall Spanish spots, you won't be spending very much for good food. Julian's BnB was right down the street from the Metro, which was super convenient for us as well.

If you are going to NY and want a quiet, authentic Brooklyn experience, this is definitely your spot. I will be recommending this spot to anyone visiting the area.

The apt was wonderful! It was about a 4 minute walk to the J-Train. I went by myself and felt very safe. I would definitely stay again. The only kinda downfall is that there's no TV so bring your laptop. :)
Nice people. The place is really close to the subway.

I stayed in the flat for 10 days. working during daytime and exploring New York in the Evening. The flat was very nice with lots of space. No problems with the internet. There is a space outside where you can sit in good weather. Julian was nice and good to talk to. Only 4 min. to the Metro and 25 mins on The J Train direct to Manhatten. Also easy to get back from Manhaten late at night with the J Train. No need to take Taxi.
Nice area with lots of shops to get food and do shopping. I can recommend this place.
Kind Regards
Bent
Great place. Very comfortable and private. Easily accessible by metro. Free and easy private parking was a plus.

The place is located very close to Halsey Subway station, which is great to reach Manhattan through J line in about 30 minutes.

It was clean and quiet, we could not hear the street nor the subway, which is really great when you just need to sleep !

There is a grocery store very close to the subway station (Key Food).

Our hosts were very friendly and made us to feel at home, they helped us to reach the place by phone and arranged a taxi to go back to the airport.

They live just upstairs, which is convenient if you have any question (or just need an Iron).

Karen and Julian were great hosts. the place was nice.
thanks to them we enjoyed our stay in NY

It was great staying at this apartment! Julian was very nice and helpful. It was easy to reach him and whenever questions came up, he answered them immediately. The apartment is comfortable and has all appliances you need. It is also very close to the J-Train, which made it very easy for us to get to Manhatten and eveywhere else. I can totally recommend staying here!

The apartment was clean and the garden patio was kick ass. The place is really close to the J train and getting around was super easy. The neighborhood felt safe-  I was traveling with a teenage girl and both of us felt comfortable, even at night. Julian was very friendly but we didn't see much of him. I would definitely stay here again. It was the ultimate authentic Brooklyn experience!

Very easy to get to manhattan, Simple apartment but that was all we needed. Julien was easily reachable if we needed anything and everything we needed was close by. The neighborhood was alright but not ideal, but we mostly felt safe and there was about 4 doors to get into our apartment.

My parents and I had a lovely 10-night stay at Julian and Karen's apartment. The rooms were spacious and nicely decorated. The location is extremely convenient, with only 3 blocks to the J train stop! There's also a supermarket, seafood market, Rite Aid, Popeye, liquor store and other convenience stores steps away from the apartment. We came back home after 11pm almost every day and felt safe walking in the neighborhood. Julian and Karen were very friendly and responsive at requests. I would recommend this place to other NYC explorers looking for value places to stay!
The host canceled my reservation after arrival.

A neat and cozy apartment within 5 minutes of the nearest subway with supermarket and pharmacy within the same distance.
Clean with all the essentials and although there is no air conditioning it wasnt hot even though it was 38° outside.
Very nice hosts.

Julian and Karen were gracious hosts.  The apartment was spacious and stylishly furnished with a great kitchen, wonderful bed, and very nice bathroom, beautiful tile and large shower.  The place was outstandingly clean.  The climate control consisted of two fans and a dehumidifier, which allowed us to be comfortable in 90-degree weather.  The subway was literally two blocks away, and there was a supermarket a block and a half away.

Julian and Karen were great. The location was good via car or train. We had private parking which is a must!!! Fit our family perfect. Clean apt and attentive hosts. We'll be using their space again!!!
Thanks

Everything you need for a stay in Brooklyn. Very close to the J Train and local super markets as well. Jullian the owner is very helpful and accomadating! This was a really great place to stay, I know that I did not want to leave. Definitely will book with Karen & Jullian again.

The appartment is very comfortable and clean. It's very close to the subway ( the J line leading to canal street) and there are a lot of shops and restaurants around. Julian was very welcoming and helpful.
It's à good place if you want to discover New York .

We really enjoyed our stay in Brooklyn and Julian's apartment was great for us. Spacious and comfortable, clean and well furnished; we were happy to have this apartment to come back to after long days of exploring New York.
Very helpful and attentive hosts, really short distance to the nearby subway station and great value overall.

We lived there for almost three weeks. and loved every minute of it. I can really recommend this apartment. It's spacious and the two of us had separate bedrooms, a livingroom with a flatscreen, cable and fast WIFI, a fully equipped kitchen with a dining table. And the bathroom has a tub! The apartment has aircondition which was great, cos' it was hot and humid outside most of the time..
The neighbourhood is cool! I can recommend Fresh Gourmet on Court Street and there´s so many cool restaurants and bars in this area of Brooklyn.
Oh, and the apartment is placed nearby Caroll Gardens station and the F train will take you Times Square in about 25 minutes.
Anette greeted us upon arrivall eventhough we were delayed more than an hour. She has been helpful and kind. She helped us getting car service to the airport at a great price. She is very serviceminded.
Henry St. is a very local, neighborhood type location.  Stairs could be a problem for some, but it was clean and nicely decorated.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in the Henry suite.
We loved staying here! Annette was an extremely gracious host.  We would reccomend it to anyone!

This was a lovely apartment, perfectly appointed and very accessible within Carroll Gardens. The apartment is quiet, clean and very nicely decorated. Annette was a flawless communicator and I truly thank her for the stay.

Annette's House on Henry was a fine place for us to stay for our five hectic days in New York. Fiona and I booked HonH as it was in the same street as my son and daughter-in-law, Sam and Katie, and also because we had never spent any time in Brooklyn. Besides, Fiona's son, Michael Dunbar, was making his début at BAM in Lucy Guerin's dance work, Untrained.
Enough family history. Annette's full-length second-floor studio apartment was perfect for us. Within its long, narrow layout were all the creature comforts that made our (relatively) brief time in the apartment a time of efficiency and solace. The small but workable kitchen, the clean and serviceable bathroom, the fine bedroom and surprising lack of noise for a place just by one of Brooklyn's busiest expressways, made House on Henry an excellent place to stay. Oh, there's also a magnificent amount of cupboard space. We'd happily do it all again. Thank you, Annette, for being so helpful and nice.

This was one my best Airbnb experiences, hands down. Annette was a fantastic host and her apartment was perfect. It felt like staying in a five star hotel.

I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a clean, well designed and comfortable apartment in a central Brooklyn location.

The second floor apartment was very good.  The accommodation was very clean and spacious for our needs: a good sized bedroom with an extra bedroom smaller bedroom, a good kitchen, living room, and even a dinner area.  Annette was very accommodating and helpful.  The apartment is close to the F train for travel and many restaurants and amenities.
Very welcoming.  Annette was there to greet us and help with our luggage.  So convenient for visiting our relatives round the corner. Will definitely use again and recommend to others.

Great room, close to everything.  Most reasonable price I saw listed, and in the center of alphabet city.  It was quiet and pleasant.  I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a place in Manhattan.
It's a small space but all we really needed for a cheap yet comfortable stay in Manhattan! Clean and priced for a smaller budget we were happy to stay with such a kind and considerate host.

We stayed here for 7 days and I would describe the place as a dingy basement apartment that is decent for the price you are paying. Unfortunately, the cleanliness of the shower was unsatisfactory. We regularly stay in cheap motels while traveling. We frequently go camping and shower in public gyms/public restrooms, however we have never seen a bathroom like this. The picture's of the bathroom on airbnb looked much cleaner.

The shower tub and walls contained yellow and orange stains throughout as well as mold. The shower curtain had stains, mildew and was slimy. The shower head was not working properly. The shower drain was clogged. We also found a couple of cockroaches in the bathroom and our bedroom, but that may be expected in a New York City basement.

Aside from the bathtub, the rest of the apartment was okay and the bed was comfortable. The location was pretty close to public transportation and food. Edward is also very nice and accommodated our crazy check-in/check-out times. He does not live in the apartment, but we didn't have problems reaching him. We would stay here again if the bathroom can be fixed/cleaned.

Basic room in basement apartment in a great location. Room is quiet and bed is comfy. Good base for exploring NYC - close to metro, cafés, bars and shops.
Great communication with Edward leading up to our arrival and throughout our stay.

The place is pretty bare-bones but the location is great and the bedroom is more than adequate. Edward is friendly and hospitable, and very easy to get ahold of. The bathroom left some cleanliness to be desired but it was also very old, so it could just be one of those bathrooms that always looks kind of gross even when it's just been cleaned. Overall, a decent place if you're willing to "slum it" a little in exchange for a great and budget-friendly location.

El apartamento está muy bien situado...y dentro de ella tienes de todo. Cierto es q es un sótano y el patio de acceso no está en buenas condiciones. Pero calidad/precio, es recomendable. Edward es muy amable! :)

The place is very close to great food places and subways not too far to walk from! My brother and I felt that the simplicity of the room to just sleep in and safely store our belongings was great! The bathroom could use a little fixing up but other than that, our stay was great and Edward is a very friendly host! We tried the burger place and ramen place right next to the appartment and they both were amazing! So awesome that it's right there!

This apartment was small, but comfortable. NYC is an expensive place to stay and Edward has done a great job of providing comfortable accommodation for those on a budget. Location was fantastic, near plenty of shops and restaurants with a great calm hipster vibe. The apartment itself is small and dark (being a basement apartment), but this is no issue if you are a busy traveller looking to spend your days out and about exploring. Downsides: the apartment was cold at night, quite old and a little dingy. The wifi was not working during our week long stay, despite Edward's efforts to fix this. Edward however was a great host; always contactable and is doing his best to improve the place. He was always friendly and helpful if we had any questions.

Had to book on very short notice (same day booking) but Edward answered right away and he organised everything very fast. He is a great host, you find everything you need in the apartment. Thanks again!
The room was exactly what we expected it to be: basic and clean, and the location is perfect for exploring NYC. Edward is a great guy, and he was a very helpful host before and during our stay.

Edward is a great guy and he is an inspiring actor. Which is awesome to meet. His place is cheap and Edward supplies everything! From the room to bath towels. There are also extra shower stuff supplied, but this was my first time using AirBNB, I ended up using my own stuff. Great place. There are plenty of places to eat and drink! You are 10 minute walk away from LES. You are smack in the middle of Alphabet City, and few minutes away from St. Mark's Place. I will highly consider this place for a budget and enjoy the night life.

I'm very glad I stayed at this place,  had an amazing time here. very good price and the lower East village is a great neighbourhood to stay in, it's close to everything and safe.   The bedroom is big enough for 2 people and the bed is very comfortable and big.  Edward is friendly, helpful and quick to return messages if you need to contact him.  I highly recommend staying at this place.

Eric was great communicating with me, and made me feel welcome from the beginning. It is a small and cozy room, and is great for the price - and the central location. This is a great place for someone who spends most of their time out of the apartment!

Très bon accueil, hotesse charmante. Appartement très propre et joliment décoré. On entend la circulation mais c'est pas trop bruyant. Le quartier est très sympa avec tout ce qu'il faut. Métro pas loin pour aller dans Manhattan.

Annette was very kind, she welcomed us and helped us out, even offered to help with printing out our tickets, which was invaluable. I'd definitely recommend staying with her- the neighbourhood is lovely for walks, nearby there are shops and the underground is a close walk away. I also recommend The Farmacy Soda Fountain, best place ever, just up the street, on Henry str.
Annette was a very gracious host.  She was open and willing to make sure that we were comfortable.  The apartment had plenty of space.

Annette's apartment could not have been more perfect. We were coming to Brooklyn to visit our friends who just recently became engaged. Initially, we were planning on staying at the Comfort Inn two miles away until we came accross this gem. Not only did we save money, Annette's apartment was 20x bigger, nicer and made us feel more at home than the Comfort Inn could ever have. The kicker is that her place turned out to be right around the corner from where our friends lived. All in all a PERFECT experience! Cannot reccomend or thank Annette enough!

I was very happy to Stay at the House on Henry - it was clean, warm and cozy. I don't have any negatives for Annette. I considered my stay a relaxing jaunt with no stress. The area is very lovely and a pleasure to walk to cafes or restaurants with reachable distance.

Norma

Annette is very helpful and responds very soon if anything goes wrong during your stay or if you have any questions. The reasons I give Annette's place 5 stars is because the House on Henry is great, spacious. We stayed 3 people and one more guest joined us for one night and all was great. The house is nice and it's location is really great close by subway station to Manhattan (15' ride) and a nice neighbourhood. You will get occasional greetings from the neighbors. I would recommend House on Henry to all my friends coming to NYC.

Annette's Wohnung ist super groß für 2 Personen ( hatte schon mal eine Miniwohnung in Manhattan ) und die Gegend ist eine sehr angenehme ruhige Nachbarschaft. Die Wohnung liegt nahe dem Highway, ist aber mit Ohrstöpsel in der Nacht kein Problem. Es ist alles vorhanden, gute Küchenausstattung, genügend Handtücher und natürlich auch sauber. Brooklyn hat uns sehr gut gefallen zum Wohnen, würden wieder bei Annette buchen, sie ist auch eine sehr liebenswerte, hilfreiche Person.

Nous avons été très bien accueilli par Julian et Karen qui attendent leur 1er bébé.L'appartement est vraiment top,..... spacieux impeccable et cosy! Exactement comme la description. Le manque de lumière ,causé par sa situation en demi sous sol ,ne nous a pas gêné, car nous revenions tard le soir. Le métro est indispensable pour toutes les visites.
Julian& Karen are so kind hosts. We met just Julian in person, and he gave us all the information we needed. The apartment is clean, comfortable and useful for visit NYC.

Appartement conforme à l'annonce, rien à redire, le métro tout comme la supérette sont à 5 min à pied. Quartier agréable. De plus, Julian et Karen sont dès hôtes très gentils et à l'écoute en cas de besoin ! A noter pour les francophones que Karen parle français !!!

N'hésitez plus, vous pouvez y aller en toute confiance !
Julian & Karen are very kind and cheerful, well met. The apartment is exactly like in the picture. very nice and cozy. Thank you for a memorable week in New York!

Ce grand F2 est comme sur les photos. Très propre, grande salle d'eau. Karen & Julian sont fort sympathiques. Chaque fois que j'avais une question ils y ont répondu aussitôt. Le quartier est typique, et aucun problème d'insécurité. Très positif.

This 2 room apartment is secure, clean and quite roomy although being in the basement needed the air conditioning on to make it less claustrophopic for Aussies not used to basement living.  Very friendly host who is willing to answer any questions.  Subway station very close and Metro into Manhattan easy to use.  Large supermarket across from subway.

Julian was very friendly and easy to communicate with, and the apartment was clean, spacious and exactly as described in the listing. We enjoyed the proximity to the J train, which can get you to many fun spots to visit around Manhattan (45 minutes) and Brooklyn (such as Williamsburg, Prospect Park, Carroll Gardens, less than 30 min). My only notes to future guests might be that if you're planning to be out late at night, definitely program the number of a car service (Julian has recommendations on the fridge) into your phone as some taxis may not venture into Bushwick, and the trains may require quite a wait. Also, there is a little bit of noise from the upstairs when folks walk around and the plumbing, so if you're sensitive to noise you might want to bring earplugs, but we didn't have any issue with this during late/early hours, just a little shuffling during the early evening.
Overall, good stay!

The Brooklyn Cove was a clean and pleasant apartment in Bushwick, Brooklyn. It is only 3 blocks from the J train. We went to NY for a getaway weekend a few days after Sandy, and still had a fantastic time!
Julian and Karen were pleasant and available but not invasive.
I highly recommend this Airbnb for the recreational or business traveler on a budget!

Great experience. Steps from the J line and near a grocery. Comfortable beds, lots of hot water, nice bathroom and nice kitchen.  Perfect for what we needed -- an inexpensive and convenient place to stay!
Very clean place and close to J station. Julian is very friendly and easy-going.

Spent 3 nights here (Dec 2012). Clean and well-kept accommodation. Julian was a very responsive and helpful host. The biggest positives were the proximity to the J/Z line, the availability of reserved, off-street parking, and continuous hot water. It rained heavily during our stay, and Julian even had umbrellas for our use, which we found very helpful. The fact that they provided Coffee/creamer, cups and plates gave it a homelike feeling. All-in-all, a place I would recommend for a short stay with good metro connectivity to NYC's attractions.

Edward was a great host. He was responsive to questions and very helpful in resolving any issues that came up. A friend and I visited for a week from Texas and stayed in one of the three bedrooms. The other two rooms were rented out to 4 others. There is a shared bathroom that is small. The cleanliness was satisfactory but there may have been a cockroach infestation as we saw more roaches than we cared to count in the kitchen area and bathroom.

My friends and I had a great time staying at Brooklyn Cove. Julian was extremely helpful and welcoming, he even gave us a bottle of wine to welcome us (which we cracked up straight away - much to Julian's amusement). New York was freezing cold (it snowed) during the time we were there, but the apartment had great heating so we hardly knew it. The location is really convenient - just a few hundred metres from the supermarket and the J train. A great place to stay.

Expérience très positive. Julian est un hôte accueillant, très sympathique et arrangeant (nous avons pu laisser nos bagages le dernier jour, pour profiter de notre journée en attendant notre vol du soir). L'appartement est bien situé, tout proche du métro, propre et en tous points conforme à la description donnée. Une bonne adresse à New York, donc !

My sister and I were lucky enough to secure Julian and Karens gorgeous basement apartment at extremely short notice on a recent trip to NY. The apartment is just as described, has everything you could require for a short stay and was seconds from the Subway. Julian met us promptly on arrival and was friendly and welcoming. The place was spotless and the linen smelt like grapes! I would definitely  recommend Brooklyn cove to visitors of New York and hope to stay again.
Séjour très agréable avec des hôtes accueillants! Bonne expérience :-)

Great space- very clean and spacious. Appartment was very convenient to subway and a quick 20-30 minute ride took us right into Manhattan. Julian made us welcome and we thoroughly enjoyed our first trip to NYC. Thank You
Julian and Karen were perfect hosts and provided us with everything we needed. The apartment was very clean and nice and we had a pleasant stay.

Karen and Julian were excellent hosts! The apartment was lovely and perfect for our two week trip. It was spacious and clean and we felt like we lived there! The subway is so close and only takes 20 mins to Manhattan, plus there are plenty of shops in the area too :) We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with them and they will be our first port of call if and when we come back. Thank you for making our holiday even better!

Karen and Julian's place was perfect for the 4 of us who stayed there. It was very close to the subway and didn't take long to get to the trendy parts of Brooklyn. There was a deli with very yummy and very, very cheap breakfast sandwiches nearby. It was perfectly clean when we arrived and Julian was friendly and accommodating. The cheap parking in front was a huge plus for us.
Très bon accueil de julian.5 mn du métro et d'un petit supermarché .Appartement  sombre car en sous sol.Accés à une petite terrasse.Suffisant pour passer une semaine à new York.

Un bon rapport qualité prix. Tout a été déjà dit mais il est vrai que Karen et Julian sont des personnes très attachantes .Ils ont toujours été disponibles tout en restant discrets.L''appartement se situe près de toutes les commodités (supermarchés,boutiques diverses, poste, et surtout métro!) .
Un buon arredamento accanto la fermata di metro "J" a 15 mn di Manhattan e anche accanto di supermerchati , ufficio postale, e oltri negozzi. Un buon ambiante con proprietari molto disponibili.

We had a wonderful time at Julian and Karen's place. It was well taken care of, clean, cool (which was a blessing given that temperatures were above 35C when we were there) and suited our needs very well while we were in the New York area. Julian was quite helpful and made sure we knew he was around if we needed him.

While it takes around 30-45 minutes to get back to their place from Manhattan, it is so cute it makes the trip worthwhile.

If you're looking for a clean, homey and reasonably priced place to stay this is the place for you! And the shower is glorious after a long day of walking in Manhattan!

Great apartment, minutes from subway, very accommodating hosts.
Will definitely recommend it!

Our hosts were gracious and welcoming but disorganized. Missing keys and failing to tell us that at 9 am the next day, they would be sending contractors through our room to work on the backyard. After some discussion, it was agreed to comp us a nights stay for the inconvenience of rearranged plans.
The rooms were VERY hot and damp despite the dehumidifier (which we had to empty as it leaked everywhere) and fans blowing 24/7. On the last night, we came home to ants in the bathroom and front room which Julian promptly took care of even though it was late at night.
Despite our experience, I give Brooklyn Cove three stars as Julian and Karen were prompt with resolving concerns. I'm sure the basement is very cozy when weather permits!

Julian, our host, was extremely welcoming and accomodating during our stay.  Overall, the apartment was clean and comfortable.  My only complaints would be that the surrounding neighborhood was sketchy and felt unsafe at times, especially during late night walks back from the Halsey J Train subway stop.  In addition, the apartment was very hot and humid with no air conditioning, although leaving the fans running for 24/7 made the situation bearable. Overall, decent stay for the price and gracious hosts.

Our hosts Julian and Karen were very nice and welcoming even with us arriving late past our check in time. The surrounding neighborhood isn't the best, and can be a little scary at night walking back from the subway. But everything you need is within walking distance; a laundromat around the corner and a supermarket and the J train just down the block. They have private parking in the front which made it VERY convenient. The apartment was well stocked with everything that we might need, but the floors seemed a little dirty and it looked like the place hasn't been dusted in a while. There was no AC, but there were 4 fans going constantly at all times which made it a little bearable but still pretty hot. And the wifi connection was horrible, which made it a little inconvenient. Overall, it was a good place to stay for the price and pretty close by to most of the boroughs.

The apartment is perfect, clean and very convenient. No A/C but they did everything to cool down the apartment during the summer and we thank them a lot for that.
They beds are comfortable, the kitchen well equipped and the bathroom is clean.

We didn't have the chance to meet Karen but we had nice discussions with Julian. They answered very quickly to our questions and were very available with us.
Parking is just in front of the apartment (10$ / day) and the neighborhood is quite safe.

We will contact you back for a next stay in NYC.

Thank you

Nous avons passé un bon séjour dans l'appartement qui est très propre et bien situé. Le parking est très pratique. Nous avons été très bien accueilli et une bouteille de vin nous attendais même au frigo !

It was a pleasure staying at Annette's. The flat was spotless when we arrived and Annette showed us around and gave us recommendations on where to go out for food and drinks.
The flat is very well located to explore Brooklyn and Manhattan but being next to a flyover makes it a bit noisy.
I would recommend House on Henry for anyone who want a clean, affordable and well located place to explore NY.

Annette's apartment is amazing. Really comfortable and in a great location, close to Brooklyn Bridge Park. She was a great host and helped us out when our transport to New York arrived later than planned.

Great location and a very clean, nicely appointed space. Was a little on the small side for two couples, but would be perfect for a family.

The owner Annette was also great - very responsive and helpful.

Definitely recommend overall.

We were glad we had chosen to stay at the House on Henry rather than a hotel and thoroughly enjoyed our 5 nights there. The apartment is sympathetically renovated and everything works well.

We did not find it at all noisy and did not need the thoughtfully provided ear plugs! The apartment is well located for public transport and for many restuarants and shops. We loved the whole area.

Thank you for having us.
Being in Brooklyn for my daughters giving birth of her lovely baby girl, miss Bruno's sweet house on Henry street worked nicely in my plans.   Mhb

We rented both apartments for 8 days for 6 people and had a really good time. We felt sad to leave and would return anytime we needed a place to stay in Brooklyn for more than two people. The apartment is sufficiently appointed with kitchen/tableware for three.
Annette was very nice and friendly. We were careful not to wear shoes as not to disturb her at night, as she lives right underneath.
One can hear the nearby Brooklyn Queens Expressway from the bedrooms, but we all could sleep fine.
The little bedroom is only accessible through the master bedroom. This was the only somewhat uncomfortable feature for us.
A great place. I highly recommend it. Spotlessly clean and well-furnished. Our host was extremely thoughtful and responsive with arrangements and logistics. We definitely would return.

This (Jan 26-Feb 5, 2014) is the second time I have stayed at House on Henry. There will be a third and a fourth and, maybe, a fifth. Annette is the ideal host and her second-floor apartment is a comfortable and - yes - homely place. The only shame about being in New York is that one is always out, so there is not much time to spend at home, let alone use the kitchen or entertain guests for dinner.
It was bitter winter this time. Snow fell, my daughter and I slipped and slid along Henry Street, but it was always a comfort to know that House in Henry was at the beginning or the end of our days.
Great Place, Enjoyed the stay:)

Annette's apartment is very clean and lovingly furnished.  The bed is very comfortable and the bathroom very spacious.  Unfortunately, however, it is on block that is very close to the Brooklyn-Queens Expressway and therefore it is very loud at most times of the day and night.
This is a lovely apartment and Annette is a very welcoming host, we arrived late on Saturday night and it wasn't a problem. Would recommend.
Great stay at Annette's apt! Spacious living room , dining area and a nicely furnished kitchen.
The reservation was canceled 15 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Another great stay at House on Henry. Clean to a high standard, cozy, fully equipped kitchen (though I still can't figure out how the broiler (grill, in English) works).
Other guests have complained about the proximity to the expressway - this hasn't been a problem for my partner and I either of the times we've stayed here. I think you would only really notice the noise if you live on a mountain where it's always deathly quiet. Otherwise, if you live in a regular town or city, I don't think you'll have a problem. And you can always wear earplugs. We stayed in the 3rd floor suite last year, and the 2nd floor suite this year. If you are wondering which to pick, they are kind of the same. The 2nd floor has more space in the second bedroom, so this is probably the best choice if you have kids, but there is more kitchen counter space in the 3rd floor suite. I preferred some of the furniture in the 3rd floor suite, but this is just my taste.
The walk to the subway takes 10 minutes, and it's through beautiful Carroll Gardens, it is always a pleasant walk. It is a safe area, and I personally prefer it to Park Slope.
This year a couple of light bulbs didn't work when we arrived, but we emailed Annette in the morning, and it was resolved that day while we were out enjoying NY. I recommend these two suites, and would happily stay there again. The benefits are the space and hotel-standard cleanliness, at half the price you'd pay in town for a closet! I've given it 4 stars but I really mean 4 and 3/4, there just wasn't an option to do this!

Great room and great price! The location was perfect for us and near lots of cool restaurants and bars. East Village was the perfect spot for our New Years celebrations. Edward was very helpful and answered all of our questions. The room was clean and cosy and the bed was very comfortable.

I can't say enough positive things about Annette's place! The pictures in her posting don't do it justice....
Not only is it beautifully decorated but it feel like home.... The apartment itself is in a great location close to the subway and local markets which is a huge plus in my book. Annette goes that extra mile to make you feel comfortable as her guest which is why I would strongly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

House on Henry is in a lovely part of Brooklyn, very close to some great restaurants, shops and bars. The house itself is just as described and beautifully maintained. Annette was also kind enough to allow us to check in a little earlier than planned and was on hand to meet us in person upon arrival, for which we were very grateful. We will definitely be heading back for another stay soon!

Annette's space is beautiful, functional and relaxing. The neighborhood is not only safe but inviting for walks. Annette was great to work with. We have already recommended her place to others we know who are planning a trip to New York.

Dear Annette,
Thanks again for sharing your cute apt on Henry. It was exactly like the photos showed it. We knew the neighborhood, and liked it as it was close to everything we wanted. It was very clean, and that was appreciated. We hope to come out again soon and stay at your place. We also loved your coffee shop. Can't wait to come back!! yours. carol Peterson
Annette was communicative prior to our arrival and the department was as described/shown. The location was very convenient for us since we were visiting family nearby. Would stay here again.
It was our 2nd time staying there and we were looking forward to coming back.  Great location for us and can easily walk to whatever we need and want.   Thanks again, Annette!

Staying at Annette's apartment was great ! The apartment was really nice, clean and well-located. The metro-stop and several places to eat or have a drink are not far away from there. Check-in and check-out were easy, as it was communication with Annette at any time ! I would absolutely recommend Annette's apartment for a great stay in NY !

Annette's flat in Brooklyn was perfect for our long weekend. It was clean and cheerful. We were able to walk to the subway, restaurants and stores. Annette is friendly and attentive. We will be coming to NYC a couple times a year and hope to stay in this apartment again.

The apartment was exactly as pictured in the ad. It was immaculate and in a very good neighborhood. She moved in a new mattress while we were there which was a big improvement over the prior one. The kitchen is stocked with all the necessary items to cook your own meals. Lots of good restaurants a few blocks from the apt.

One item of note is that the wooden floors in the living room and bedroom are not level and slant towards one side. Feels weird until you get used to it.

Would stay there again. Also, don't miss visiting her coffee shop as it serves excellent coffee.
Annette made us feel very comfortable, the web-site description of the suite was right on! and the location fit our needs.

Annette's second floor unit worked out great. It was clean and plenty large enough.  The bed was comfortable, and although we were a little nervous about noise from the nearby expressway, it wasn't an issue at all.  The only issue we had was getting into the unit: the lock is a little temperamental, and it would take a few minutes to get the key in just the right spot.

We appreciated the discount for our long stay (43 days, visiting family nearby). However, as our 8th Airbnb stay (plus 4 from other sites) the contrast with the others could not have been more pronounced, and for the first time we’d hesitate to make a positive recommendation. Had it not been for the ‘Strong’ cancellation policy we would have moved out. The three main reasons (which you couldn’t know from the listing) are:
1. Dirty. Cracked walls around bath/shower with accumulated grime and mould; mould-encrusted shower curtain. Dirty windows with unremoved anti-hurricane tape. Apartment lacing what’s needed to keep it clean – dustpan but no broom, mop but no bucket, no vacuum cleaner.
2. Unpleasant atmosphere. It was fine to be asked in advance to agree explicitly to Annette’s rules about no shoes, quiet hours etc, but another thing to be greeted with imperative instructions about these rules attached to the outside of the apartment door (plus another on the exit door from the building), as though we were children and would not have understood or remembered what we’d already signed up to. We had two adult friends to stay and even though we’d spent little time in the apartment and crept around quietly, we were again given instructions in writing about how they should behave, and again (with elaboration) when our two grandchildren came twice for sleepovers.
3. The least usable kitchen by far of any apartment we’ve stayed in – almost no bench space, no light over the work space, lacking basics (not even a chopping board). But given the house rules, you could hardly have had people to eat, which rather spoilt our whole purpose of having an apartment rather than a hotel.

Ontvangst door Annette verliep prima! Annette is erg vriendelijk. De kamer is ruim en voorzien van de noodzakelijke apparatuur, inclusief 2 airco's (niet overbodig in begin september!). Wij verbleven op de 2e etage, samen met onze 2 jarige zoon. Dit ging prima.

De algemene staat van het pand en het appartement was matig. Met name de badkamer en de beglazing van de woning kunnen een opknapbeurt gebruiken. Ook de hygiëne in de woning had ik beter verwacht, gezien de schoonmaakkosten.

De ligging van de woning in Brooklyn vonden wij goed. Ondanks, dat het 20 min lopen is naar de metro, hebben wij dit niet gezien als een probleem. De wijk is erg gezellig, vooral 's avonds.
De woning ligt aan het einde van Henry Street, dichtbij de doorgaande weg. Overdag is het er druk, maar in de avond/ nacht valt dit erg mee.
Parkeren in de wijk is over het algemeen gratis. Er is altijd wel ergens plek, maar niet altijd dichtbij de woning.

Samenvattend vonden wij de woning een prima basis om van daaruit New York te bezoeken.

Another fabulous stay at Karen and Julian unit. The apartment is exactly as the picture to show it. It is clean, centrally located and equipped with everything you need for your stay. The hosts are more than helpful and go out of their way to make sure your stay is excellent. Looking forward to our next time trip there.

Appartement confortable, propre et bien équipé (2 pc, 1 gd lit + 1 gd clic-clac, sde avec gde douche, cuisine avec cuisinière gaz 4 feux + gd four, gd réfrigérateur+congélateur, vaisselle, draps et serviettes de toilettes, accès cour privée avec 2 fauteuils ext.) pour une famille de 4 personnes ou deux couples. Hôtes très accueillants. 3mn métro (ligne J), 20mn max centre Manhattan. Quartier calme et tranquille + commerces près métro. A recommander pour budgets serrés qui ne peuvent résider dans Manhattan.

We (Group of 4 adults) stayed at Julian's place for 4 nights. It was a very convenient stay. The location of his apartment is the biggest plus. Halsey St. is a 2 min walk and the J train that runs 24x7 that connects you to any part of the city. The room is exactly as it is in the pictures and was decently clean. Julian was very prompt in his responses over email or text. He even helped us in arranging a taxi for our return to LGA. The apartment is in the basement with only one window and a patio entrance in the living room. The bedroom has no fresh air inlet. That's probably the only thing to note if one has reservations about ventilation. The neighborhood is very safe. On two of those days we returned past midnight and it was absolutely fine. A grocery store even closer than the station is a good help too. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a place just to sleep at night and is majorly going to be out all day. There is not much or in fact anything to do if you plan to stay at home.
I absolutely agree with Saurabh, the only thing to note is the light in the apartment, but it is a problem only if you travel to New York to stay in an apartment...

The apartment was great and comfortable. I stayed there with a friend for 9 nights and we enjoyed it a lot. The apartment is very close to the subway (J). I would defiantly go back there on my next visit to NY.

We had a great stay at Julian and Karen's place. The apartment itself was very nice and had everything we needed. Julian and Karen were very friendly and helpful, they live close by in case you need anything. Everything is conveniently located within walking distance, subway, grocery store, pharmacy, coffee shop etc.
New York is a great city and we can not wait to go be back in Brooklyn!

We were just arriving from France to visit our son living in Brooklyn for a while and it was great to be so close and also so close to Manhattan. We appreciated the sympathetic welcome and the disponibility of Julian for our requests.
The apartment is very close to the J line joining Manhattan and other areas very shortly.
What a shame about the snow. We couldn't appreciate the garden.
Neighbors are really nice;
A good time in New York City!
Julian & Karen are very nice, we spent a great moment at the flat, which was clean and confortable. Thank you for everything !

un tres bon séjour dans cet appartement ou tout est propre et fonctionnel. Julian et Karen sont très gentils même si nous n'avons pas eu trop l'occasion de les voir. L'appartement est près du métro (il ne s'arrête pas toujours à cet arrêt cependant mais il est possible d'aller 2 arrêt plus loin et le prendre dans l'autre sens pour descendre devant l'appartement)
Nous avons loué une voiture pour une journée et aucun problème pour la garer. Le quartier est assez calme et il y a un magasin juste à coté.
Seul point noir le dernier jour nous avions demandé à laisser nos bagages pour la journée (avant de réserver) et au dernier moment on m'a dit que c'était impossible... Donc une journée avec les bagages, pas très pratique.
Mais Julian s'est excusé ensuite car il avait oublié et nous a rendu un peu d'argent pour le dérangement ce qui prouve qu'ils sont de bonne foi et de confiance.
Je reviendrais sans problème dans cet appartement si je dois loger a Brooklyn.

Julian & Karen have been very helpful, pleasant and accomodating. We were arriving very late at night after having some flight cancelation, but they didn't seem to mind at all. They also let us to have a late afternoon checkout on our last day, which allowed to enjoy our last day. The flat was great value for the money too.

L'appartement est fonctionnel avec sa cuisine équipée qui nous a permis de rentrer manger tout les soirs, sa chambre séparée et sa salle de bain agréable. Nous n'avons pas eu de sentiment d'insécurité dans ce quartier de Brooklyn même lorsque nous sommes rentrés de nuit. Il y a tout ce qu'il faut à proximité (supermarchés, restaurants, magasins, ...) et surtout le métro (ligne J) qui passe tout prêt de l'appartement , ce qui rend l'accès à Manhattan assez rapide.
Julian est un hôte accueillant. Nous nous sommes tout de suite senti à l'aise.

Julian was a great host. He was very accommodating as we needed an early check-in and early check-out. I think the place we got was actually different from the one pictured, but still good as it was very roomy. His place is very close to the subway and easy access to Manhattan. There is a nearby laundromat, small grocery market, and many small restaurants. This would be a great place to stay if you would prefer to stay out of the hustle and bustle of the city. Thanks!

Great location as advertised. It was very close to a big grocery store and the J line train that runs to Manhattan and the Jamaica Airtrain stop. I stayed for four nights with my parents and we all loved this place! Julian and Karen were very nice and kind as well :)

Julian was super nice and the apartment is as described and as you see in the pictures. Also very clean and the wifi was working properly. The location was great, right next the J train. I would definetly recommend it!

Julian and Karen are great hosts, their place was perfect for our stay in Brooklyn. It's located about two blocks from the J train which is very convenient we will be staying there again. We felt safe and secure. Thank you for letting us reside in your place.

L'accueil a été agréable et patient (nous sommes arrivé plus tard que l'heure prévu et Julian guettait notre arrivée).
Julian et Karen sont discrets, souriants et disponibles si besoin.
L'appartement, situé en sous sol, est agréable malgré la petite fenetre. La terrasse sur l'arrière permet d'aller fumer en toute tranquillité si on le souhaite.
Il s'agit donc selon nous d'un bon rapport qualité prix.
La station de métro est proche et mène à Manhattan Sud en environ 20mn. Les métros sont nombreux et fonctionnent 24h/24.
L'arrivée par l'aéroport JFK est pratique par Airtrain + métro.
Everything went great, the basement is cozy and the bed is comfortable. The neighborhood has a lot of life, specially in the night.

Un séjour très agréable à New York chez Julian & Karen, il s'agit d'un petit appartement sympathique, et accueillant avec le nécessaire pour cuisiner ( casseroles, verres, assiettes.. ) les deux lits sont aussi très bien : lit 2 place + clic clac 2 places également. On regrettera simplement le manque de luminosité de l'appartement mais qui est vite comblé lorsque l'on sort dans le jardin privée. En somme c'est un appartement très bien on se sent vraiment en autonomie et le fais que Julian habite au dessus permet de nous rassurer en cas de problèmes, en ce qui concerne l'hôte Julian à su être présent aux bons moment et à su nous indiquer les bonnes adresse du quartier. De plus le quartier ( Bushwick ) est relativement calme et très sur. Enfin, nous avons passé un agréable séjour à Brooklyn chez Julian  & Karen.
Julian was very nice, we got us the key right away. The apt was clean and nice, the neighbor is a little dirty.  Really close to the J train.

Julian was a great host! He was always available for all our questions. The apartment was just enough for 4 people, and it was easy to find. It is also a 1 minute walk to the nearest metro just as Julian wrote and about a 20 minute ride to Manhattan. Would recommend this booking!

Julian was wonderful and very flexible when our schedules for check in were conflicting.

The apartment is clean and well furnished, and we felt safe here.

Some reviews say there is not much light, which is true, but for us it didn't matter- in fact, it made it easier to sleep without all of the noise and light from outside.

Would definitely stay here again!

peu de contact avec le proprietaire
le logement est un peu moins lumineux que sur la photo , le lit est de mauvaise qualité , mais pour le reste c'est conforme au descriptif

We loved the House on Henry.  Great location. Would definitely like to come back.  I was lucky to chance a brief meeting with Annette to pick up keys.  She was lovely.  Hope to see and get to know her more on future trips.

If you're looking for place to stay that feels homey and quintessentially Brooklyn it's hard to beat House on Henry. It's a cozy spot on a street that straddles Carroll Gardens and Red Hook. The house is within a ten minute walk of the best both neighborhoods have to offer.

The rules may seem strict - and Annette will follow up with you to make sure you understand them - but it's all basically common courtesy and keeping the peace with neighbors in an old building. Just be cool and you'll have a great time.
Annette was a gracious host. Warm and welcoming. Her place was perfect for our stay in Brooklyn.

The description of the apartment was very accurate.  It was great for my family of 4.  2 Bedrooms and a pull out sofa bed for my son.  The apartment was very nicely decorated and a wonderful place to come home to after a busy day in the city.  It was in a great location 10 minutes to the subway and a short ride into the city.  We loved the neighborhood which had many great restaurants and coffee shops in the area.  We didn't have the chance to meet Annette but she left instructions of how to access the apartment and it was not problem.  We loved our stay and would  definitlely try to stay again when we get to Brooklyn.  Thank you Annette!

Annette was a great hostess! She gave me a tour when I arrived and was readily available upon check out. The apartment is charming and very convenient to the Carroll Gardens/Cobble Hill/Brooklyn Heights neighborhoods.  Overall a very favorable experience!
Lovely little appartment just across an overpass from Red Hook. Neibourghood is very pretty and calm. If you doubt any detail of the reservations, just contact her about it.
Beautiful home, charming and safe neighborhood, flexible host! Recommended place to stay if you are in Carroll Gardens.

Our keys were waiting on arrival, and the location was easy to find. The apartment is charming and well decorated, and the kitchen well stocked with utensils etc. Great restaurants in walking distance. We would return.
The listing was very accurate. We had a wonderful time at Annette's. Getting in was easy and the stay worked out well.

Lovely apartment beautifully decorated in the fantastic Carroll Gardens area. It is in a most convenient location, great access to the City, and great eateries and playgrounds for our little one all around. Annette was very welcoming and the whole experience highly enjoyable.

We had a wonderful stay! Annette is very helpful and responsive. The home was clean, comfortable, and stylish. I stayed here with my partner and his mom. We were very comfortable with three people. The neighborhood is fun to explore and many options within walking distance.

The location was perfect..just a block or two away from shops and restaurants. The accommodations were beautiful and stylishly decorated. The check in and out process was very easy and Annette was very friendly, helpful and accommodating. We couldn't have asked for more.

We would definitely stay there again and recommend it to our friends and family.

Gorgeous carroll gardens apartment in one of Brooklyn's most desirable neighborhoods! My fiancé and I stayed here while I was in town for a book launch at BookCourt and it couldn't have been a more ideal spot. The little side bedroom was perfect for my sister who was joining us from London for the night. Comfy bed, cute vintage furnishing. Provided the perfect restful escape during a busy book tour! Annette even extended the invitation to check out a bit later the next day. Thank  you, Annette!

Edward' place is in a great location not far from the metro to reach "uptown" and "downtown" in a very short time. The apartment, however, is not very quiet, lots of noise from neighbors. But, it is functional and clean, the room is simple but practical. Overall, I'm quite satisfied with the value for money. Bedding is very good, and Edward provides towels, shampoo and shower gel, big plus! Thank U !

Todo muy bien! Edward es genial, y se ocupa mucho del departamento! Todo muy limpio siempre, algunas cucas, pero se estaba solucionando. El barrio esta muy bien! Lo recomiendo! Everithing was great! Edward is an amazing host!

Edward was on POINT!  He was very well prepared and gave me a lot of notice on what to do before my trip. He was kind, very personable, and the place was better than what I imagined!  Even though there was one shared bathroom, I honestly had no problem with it at all!  (me and my long showers)  I never notice when the other tenants were using it, and all of our schedules for some reason offset one another because I honestly never even saw the other tenants!  This place is perfect for someone who wants to enjoy the city and rest in the middle of the day because being a tourist can be exhausting.  This place is super close to the subway stop, and it's next to a lot of great VEGAN restaurants as well!  I love the Lower East Side, and I'm definitely going to try to book this place again if it's available the next time I'm in town.  Thank you so much again, Edward!
The house is so clean and location is great. You can go everywhere by subway. Edward is a cool guy, he helped me to explore the city and neighborhood also.
Clean and great room. Edward is an awesome host. Will definitely look up this place again when next time around. Recommended.

Edward is an EXCELLENT host with fabulous communication skills and prompt replies. He is also willing to work with you to accommodate different arrival times, etc. Most impressive were the many thoughtful touches, such as having a computer and printer available, or providing recommendations for eateries, etc. The space is much larger than it appears in the photos and the bed is fabulously comfortable. Plenty of room to hang your clothing with provided hangars. Hair dryers, shampoo, dishes, too many little comforts were easily accessible. Everything is quite clean, including the bathroom. I would stay here again in an INSTANT and highly recommend it to anyone who wants a centrally located, friendly clean, reasonably priced accommodation to enjoy the fabulous city and feel safe. I always felt safe here.

Hosting more than 300 people means quality: email with all the informations, flexible check in and check out and last but not least Edward helped us to bring our luggages. The house is essential and it has everything. It is located in a great neighborhood with a lot of restaurants, pubs and near the subway. I recommend this place.

Boendet hos Edward var bra. Vi hade tillgång till ett sovrum och ett gemensamt kök och badrum som vi delade med ett annat airbnb-rum och Edwards kompis Dennis som bodde där permanent. Lägenheterna ligger i en källare. Ett bra badrum med fräsch toalett och dusch/badkar. Generellt sett var det bra städat och relativt fräscht överallt. Något sämre möjligheter till att laga mat och ha någonstans att äta, då vardagsrummet är väldigt litet och utan matbord.

Läget är perfekt. Nära till allt, både kommunikationer, restauranger och bra områden.
Jag kan verkligen rekommendera boendet hos Edward. Både Edward och Dennis (som bodde där) var enkla att få tag på och tillmötesgående. Vi kommer att bo där igen nästa gång vi kommer till New York.

Never met the host but entry directions were perfect. Apartment was clean and tidy and bed was very comfortable. Air conditioning worked well. Kitchen is tiny but fine for breakfast. Loved the location.

Annette's place was totally perfect for our quick stay in Brooklyn! We had a big group of family traveling together and we were able to book each of the two available floors to ensure everyone was more than comfortable staying there. Finding a way to make a big group stay together in NYC is a big challenge, and having found her adorable and well appointed apartments was just a dream. Annette was lovely and I enjoyed getting to meet her while we stayed. Many convenience stores and a 5-block walk to the subway were also big perks. Thank you Annette!

We had a wonderful stay at House on Henry - this is a beautiful apartment, and Annette was extremely nice, accommodating, and easy to communicate with.  I would definitely recommend this apartment to others.

Annette was a gracious host and made us feel welcome upon our arrival!
Though not able to accommodate an early check-in and late checkout request, she was kind enough to store our luggage at the house so we wouldn't have to lug it around while walking the quaint streets surrounding her B&B. The photos of the 2 bedroom suite posted on the airbnb app are accurate :-) The suite was clean and welcoming ! We/I will be back!

My experience at Annette's Henry Street apartment was wonderful. We arrived to a very clean and nicely decorated apartment that looked just like the photos. The location made it easy to walk to great restaurants and cafes. We really enjoyed brunch at Buttermilk Channel. It was also a quick walk to the subway. Annette was always responsive to my questions and made it easy to check in and out. I would definitely stay at her apartment again!

Annette was incredibly responsive before and during our 5 night stay. She communicated arrival instructions clearly, which made it a breeze to settle in. If we needed something, a quick text was all it took. The space itself is lovely, clean and simple. I'd recommend this for a group of friends travelling together, mostly because the smaller bed connects to the main bedroom (you have to walk through the bedroom to get to it). This worked well for us, but maybe not so well for two couples or a group who would prefer their privacy. Earplugs are provided, it can get a bit loud on weekday mornings. Overall, I would definitely stay at Annette's again :)
Clean apt.  Plenty of space. Short walk to Court and Smith St where the commercial activity is centered.  Far superior to the chain hotels in area. We will be back.
Location is good. Kinda noise at night because of the expressway nearby. No shampoos, body wash, hand soap.

Great value for a home of its size! Annette was easy to communicate with for a seamless arrival/entry process. The home is impeccably kept and clean with nice linens and furnishings. It's amply heated in super cold weather. Only downsides are a slightly sloped floor, limited hot water for showering, and traffic noise from the nearby highway (the upside of which is that it's right near the entrance to the Brooklyn-Battery tunnel for easy access to Manhattan). Still I recommend this place!

A lovely spot, especially for those driving. Parked right in front. Convenient to family and friends. Bodega not too far away, where the woman gave me a deal on water to make tea. I was on the second floor, which was well appointed, plenty of glasses and chairs, nice big bed and a cosy private bedroom. Did hear the people upstairs, and always have to remember to walk lightly in these traditional brown stones. I look forward to trying out the other two apartments in the building in the future.
Quiet, roomy and comfortable.

Annette's place is furnished with care and detail, we felt at home immediately. The apt is located in Carroll Gardens, a great neighbourhood with lots of restaurants and nice shops within a short walking distance. The apartment can get noisy due to the highway nearby, but this didn't bother us that much. Annette was very easy to communicate with, friendly and a great host. We stayed at the apartment for eight days, with our two children (age 9 and 12) and had a wonderful time.
Annette's home is a beautiful and comfortable place. She is a wonderful host. Highly recommend.

We were visiting some family nearby and the location was perfectly situated. Annette's place is an easy walk to many very good restaurants, coffee shops and places to get together.  Close by is the subway to easily get around Brooklyn or go into Manhattan. I've stayed in Manhattan many times, but now prefer Brooklyn because of the great atmosphere and so much to do there, especially great restaurants. A great place to visit and we will return!

Great Experience and first time visitors!

We had the opportunity to meet both Kara and Julian. They are a lovely couple and made us feel right at home. It was great to know they live upstairs in the same building and are a call away.

The details of the listing are accurate and we enjoyed our stay. This location is a short walk to a local grocery, laundry center and the stops for MTA(train/bus).

Our family is in walking distance from this apartment and will be planning to stay here again!

Thank you Julian and Kara!

Clean, roomy with excellent bathroom. Close to train station, food, laundry mat, booze and supermarket.

Noisy floors above made it difficult to sleep. Basement air is a little bad but bearable.

Nice host, contactable and patient!

Un appart conforme a la description, propre, grand, équipé. Rien a redire
Situe a deux minutes du métro. A trente minutes Max de Manhattan Sud.
Tout ce qu'il faut a côté, épiceries, fast food, corners Shop, laverie.
Je recommande vivement.
Un hôte réactif et a l'écoute
Quartier très calme.


A Nice place to stay, next to the j and z train.
A lot of shops and restaurant inn the neighbourhood, which is very calm.
Julian is a Nice host, answering all your demands.

If i have to Come back in New York i'll stay there again with a great pleasure.

I récommend this place.
my friends and i arrived really late. so we checked in much later than planned, Julian had no issues with that. The apartment was nice and clean.

mMy friend and I stayed at Karen & Julian's this past weekend (Nov 14th-17th). They were kind enough, and able to accommodate an earlier check-in. This was so helpful because we wouldn't need to carry around our heavy bags through NY. Upon arriving, Julian and his adorable daughter were there to greet us. The place was very clean and exactly as advertised. There were issues with any of the available amenities. The outside area was also cute. Unfortunately, it was too cold outside for us to enjoy it. The neighborhood was quiet at night. My friend and I, two female travelers, often traveled via train very late (very close to sunrise) back to the place without incident. And if you don't need "fancy" restaurants, there is a large variety of restaurants within walking distance from Karen and Julian's. There is also a Rite-aid, and plenty of grocery stores in the area. When we needed to venture into other boroughs, the train is only 3 blocks away. All in all, it is the perfect spot if you want to explore NY.

Julian & Karen Cover muy buenos anfitriones, nos hicieron sentir como en casa, muy amables y serviciales.
El apartamento igual a las fotos de la descripción, muy amplio y cómodo, a dos cuadras de la parada del MTA y un supermercado con todo lo necesario.
El barrio muy tranquilo y pintoresco.
Muy recomendable para quien quiera conocer New York.

L'accoglienza è stata buona, precisa e puntuale. L'appartamento è come si presenta dalle foto, è un seminterrato con uscita privata sul cortile. Il letto è abbastanza comodo.
Pulizia buona ma non ottima.
Per chi è in vacanza e pensa di passare tutta la giornata fuori casa, la soluzione è perfetta in quanto posta a due isolati dalla fermata della metro che collega direttamente Brooklin al downtown di Manahattan.

My friend and I stayed here for 4 nights. The apartment was nice and clean and as they described it. There was a grocery store in the area and the subway station was also very close. It was very easy to take the subway (J-line) to Manhattan.
Julian and Karen were both very nice and helpful. We could always come to their apartment if we needed help.
The only negative thing is the wifi connection. It works and is good enough if you just want to check your mails or google something but if you want to do more it could be difficult. But besides that, everything was very good!
I would book it again!

We stayed at Julian and Karen's for a week this February and everything was as described!
The appartement is as shown on the pictures (a bit darker but comfy!). It's very close to the subway and you can get to Manhattan easily.
Julian was here when we arrived and left and was very nice.
I recommand this apt!

Julian was there when we arrived to give us the keys. He was very welcoming and helpful. The listing description was accurate and the apartment was perfect to live in. It was very spacious for NYC. The heaters worked perfectly - kept the house warm and comfortable. The place was convenient to nearby stores and the train which was a major plus. Would definitely rent from again.

Nous avons passé 2 semaines à 4 dans cette appartement, situé dans un quartier calme de Brooklyn à 5 minutes du métro et d'un petit supermarché (très pratique donc). Notre séjour c'est très bien passé, l'appartement est propre et fonctionnel, et est équipé d'un accès wifi. Nos hôtes ont étés disponibles pour nous dès que nous avions besoin (à savoir que Karen parle Français ce qui peut aider la communication franco-anglaise, et qu'ils vivent dans le même
immeuble que l'appartement loué donc ils ne sont pas loin). Bref séjour au top, merci encore à Julian et Karen :-).

Julian haben wir direkt vor dem Haus getroffen. Alles hat super geklappt. Das Apartment war schön, allerdings doch bisschen dunkel. Für die 5 Tage wo wir da waren hat es aber locker gereicht,da wir tagsüber immer unterwegs waren. Zwischenzeitig hat Julian immer gefragt ob alles okay bei uns ist und ob wir noch was brauchen. Als der Toaster defekt war,hatten wir auch direkt am nächsten Tag einen neuen.
The house was nice, clean, and convent. Being so close to the J train really helped for easy travel!

The apartment is small but comfortable and clean.
Perfect solution for visit NY if you use it just to sleep

Appartement bien situé à 5mn à pied du métro, facile pour aller découvrir New York et plus principalement Manhattan. Liaison rapide également avec JFK airport.
Conforme à la description, l'ensemble est tout à fait correct pour y passer une semaine dans un quartier calme de Brooklyn.
Nous avons rapidement rencontré Julian durant notre séjour, accueil sympa et son aide nous a été très précieuse pour réserver un taxi.
Globalement satisfait ...

Je suis très contente de notre choix. L'appartement était propre et les lits étaient quand même confortable. Après une grosse journée de marche, même le divant lit était confortable. L'appartement est très bien équipé. Nous avons eu un peu peur quand nous sommes arrivés le soir car la clé n'y était pas mais heureusement Julian est arrivé très rapidement. Nous entendions l'eau dans les tuyaux et les gens qui marchaient en haut mais ce n'etait pas vraiment dérangeant.
