Le métro est à 4-5 minutes de marche. Le quartier est très sûr et il y a plusieurs petits commerces et resto. Très pratique!!! Julian à été très disponible comme hôte. C'est toujours très apprécié. Il a été très gentil aussi lors de la réservation. J'y retournerais sans aucune hésitation. Merci Julian et Karen.

When we arrived, we met Karen. She showed us the place and answered all our questions. She was so nice and made sure if we needed anything to just let her know. The place was safe and comfortable. It had everything what you need and even more. Thank you for letting us stay.
Julian was warm and welcoming.  The apartment was clean,comfortable  and well equipped and perfect for our trip to NYC.  It was a very short walk to the J train and an easy commute to Manhattan.

PROS:
- Apt is 3 blocks away from the J train to Manhattan, and halfway between JFK and the city (it takes about 30 mins to each end)
- It is a quiet neighborhood
- There's free WiFi. Although, bandwidth is not mindblowing, it's ok to check on emails and stuff
- Although being in the basement, the apt gets good sunshine through the garden's door. Oh, and the garden is a nice add on

CONS:
- NEIGHBORS!! Apparently other Airbnb guests were staying in the apt above us. They'd start walking around the house with high heels and boots and non-stop flushing the toilet at 1 AM and would not stop until 6. The walls seemed paper thin because we could hear everything. The last day, the couple seem to had been gone and we could finally get some sleep. Julian & Karen tried contacting the guests upon our complaint
- The place would be small for 4 adults. I would recommend it for 3 people or 2 adults + 2 kids
- The neighborhood seemed unsafe. Nothing happened to us, so this could be just a misperception

Overall, I recommend this place to travellers staying in NYC for up to a couple of weeks. It's good value for the money taking into account NYC prices.
Thank you guys for receiving us!

Everything was as advertised.  Julian was there when we arrived and left and we had no issues with the lock boxes. They offer off street parking but you might as well be on the street so I wish I had just parked on the street and avoided the cost.

Appartement idéalement situé pour une visite complète de New York. Le metro à moins de 5 minutes, une superette a 2 minutes que demander de plus? L'appartement était comfortable, propre et bien equipé avec une place de parking pour seulememt 10$ par jour. Nos hôtes étaient trés disponibles et rassurants. Malgré une premiere impression différente le quartier est trés sûr, même le soir tard. Une semaine inoubliable avec nos 2 enfants. Je recommande.
Edward is a great host. He communicated clearly and promptly with me. For the price and convenience I have no complaints.
Edward was a very nice host. I met some accidents and talked with Edward. He gave me valuable advice and we figured my problem perfectly.
The place was comfortable and clean, and the location was amazing, would definitely stay here again

Edward is the most professional airbnb host I've ever met. Not only is his place super clean, he is also very hospitable - he was more than willing to accommodate my requests and gave me some tips on NYC. The location of his place is very central in the east village in a safe and quiet area. I would definitely stay at Edward's again when in New York.
Nice room in a fantastic location. Edward is very nice and accommodating too. Enjoyed the stay!
Edward and his rommates Dennis are nice guy.  They are very friendly to talk to.  We even drink together during our conversation.  I strongly recommend other guests to stay with them in the future.

I had a great time at Edward's place. The room was clean and cozy and the bed was so comfortable! The location was perfect for what I needed. I didn't meet Edward nor his roommates, but they were easily reachable if I had any concerns. There was a slight snafu with getting the keys: Edward was away on a business trip and his roommate Isai was at work so they left the keys for me at a local coffee shop. However, the wrong name had been given to the people at the shop so when I told them my name, they said there were no keys for me. However, once I managed to get in contact with Isai and got the situation sorted, it was smooth sailing from there. Overall, I had a great experience and if I'm in NYC in the future, will definitely consider staying here again.

The room was quite humid, even with the a/c on and there were a lot of cockroaches mainly in the kitchen but also in the bathroom and room.
We didn't meet Edward, but he checked in on us by messages and had Dennis, who lived in another room in the basement, to help us.
The neighborhood was great and close to everything, but a bit dirty.
We lived there for two weeks and it was ok, but we will not stay there again mainly because of the cockroaches.

Julian and Karen were lovely hosts, the apartment was exactly as described! It was a nice neighborhood, the train J was very close, there was a great supermarket just a corner away. The only concern was that the apartment is in the basement and we could hear noises from upstairs but it was acceptable. All together we had an amazing time and would stay here again!

Pros: Karen and Julian were very quick to respond when I messaged them. Getting into the apartment were quick and easy. Location to the subway and private driveway for my car were great. Its basement location made the apartment relatively cool in the hot New York summer.
Cons: Cleanliness-- The mattress cover under the sheets had an old blood stain on it (which we didn't realize until we stripped the bedding at the end of our stay). The tile floors felt grimy against my bare feet (and left our soles black). The mattress should be replaced. as it was old, soft and lumpy. Also, the WIFI was painfully slow!!

Great stay. Annette is very responsive and helpful and the unit is clean and comfortable.  Good for business stay. Definitely close to a large expressway but I was so tired from work and travel that the noise didn't bother me much.

Annette's place has everything I needed for a great weekend in Brooklyn. She was quick to communicate and answer questions I had. The check-in process was seamless. The apartment is close to a highway, as one can see on a map, so I had trouble sleeping the first night. However, the host (or another traveler) had left a jar of foam ear plugs for others to use, so I was able to sleep after finding those. The apartment itself is very comfortable and convenient to transportation. The neighborhood is beautiful, with lots of places to eat and walk around. I never felt unsafe (as one can in a city) walking around at night. I would definitely stay here again!
Petit appart sympa a Brooklyn
House on Henry was amazing. 2 strong A/Cs in July ... and a comfortable floor through unit. Great hood and close to F train. Annette was also great. Very communicative for check in / out, etc.
Annette's place is convenient and very clean. It's also nicely decorated. Annette is very responsible about the check in. We have stayed many times with her and will return.
Great location and comfortable space. Would certainly use again. Thanks!
Le logement est spacieux, confortable, et l'hôte est à l'écoute, ses instructions sont claires et son tarif raisonnable. Parfait !
We weren't impressed. There needed a bit of cleaning and it was in a basement with no opportunity to open a window, but there was air-conditioning.

The location is great; close to many restaurants, pubs, entertainment venues,etc... in east village.

The host is very communicative; I haven't met Edward but he was always helpful in his replies to my messages. I was delayed to arrive to New York and check-in was flexible. I've also had a last minute visit from a friend and Edward agreed to let my friend stay with me for one night.

One negative aspect. The flat is in the basement as mentioned in the ad so it is not very pleasant having to walk next to the building waste disposal containers to go in the flat. But the main unpleasant aspect were the cockroaches in the room, kitchen and bathroom. I suggest for the sake of future visitors to make an extra effort to apply additional spray treatment in the flat for pest control.

Edward is a nice guy, very "professional" with useful guide tips. It's a 3-room flat, 2 for rent, shared kitcken and bathroom. Good for bagpackers if just taking a sleep at night after an exausting trip day in NYC. Superior location in Manhattan, easy access to metro, restaurant and grocery.

Nice host - good location - reasonably clean accommodations.
The room is in a basement suite in the back of the building, and while the place itself is reasonable, the entrance way is a bit stark.
Still a reasonably good place to stay.

The room looks exactly like the pictures. The bed is super comfortable and also there's a full length mirror, which I appreciated much so. The bathroom is small, but I did not mind. The location is everything! There are many cafes, bars, and restaurants around the area but what won me over was the people. Everyone I have encountered in the neighborhood was really kind. Edward is very friendly and nice. If I'm ever in New York again, I would stay at Edward's place again.

Edward is great. He was super helpful and quick at responding, only tries to accommodate. The apartment is clean and well located although a bit of a hike to the subway but manageable. All in all a good experience and would recommend to anyone :)
Edward is the perfect host, always available and kind. The room is small but has everything needed.
Super cute apartment in a very convenient location!  We'd stay there again!
Great spot, comfortable bed. I would stay again!

Brooklyn is the best and Annette's place is great. The location is perfect for anyone who wants to spend time in Carroll Gardens/Cobble Hill/Park Slope/Downtown Brooklyn, and the apartment was a nice place to relax betwen wanderings (and the bed was INCREDIBLY comfortable!). I got to meet Annette briefly, and she was super helpful on the phone when we first arrived and had some trouble with the key lockbox out on the stoop. I'd definitely stay here again anytime.
Great location & place!

Annette's apartment is clean and comfortable. Walking distance to stores , great restaurants and transportation. Noise from the parkway was not an issue for us at all, and we had great nights sleep on a comfy bed. Annette is a very nice and respectful host.
Awesome flat! Awesome location! Highly recommended
Great place, good location. Would happily go back again. Thanks for a wonderful stay!
Comfortable 2nd floor apt. with fully equipped kitchen , good windows and AC. Traffic on Henry St. morning rush hour; ear plugs provided.  Host available and helpful.
Street and highway noise is a major problem. Run the air conditioner to drown it out at night

Annette's place was perfect for our visit to Brooklyn. It was very clean and charming, and Annette was easy to communicate with throughout our entire visit. We enjoyed walking around Carroll Gardens and Red Hook. We also were able to pretty easily walk to Park Slope. The subway stop was convenient. We would stay w/Annette again for future visits.

Annette's place was very nice for us!  Not too many stairs to climb; a sparkling, clean, uncluttered atmosphere with enough space for sleeping, reading, cooking, without one of us bothering the other.  We very  much appreciated the quietness inside and out, and friendly, respectful relationships among lodgers and hostess.  It's a cozy apartment with everything provided as advertised and more (closets and hangers, iron, etc.).  Thank you!      Nancy and Jonathan
My parents stayed here for the second time when visiting us recently. The location is excellent, and Annette was a great host.
Really Nice Apartment
Spacious layout, plenty of natural light, good heat in the winter, Nice!
Great place, easily walkable from subway, had everything I needed.

L'appartement est très confortable, parfait pour 4 personnes. Il se situe dans un quartier calme, tout près d'une station de métro.
On peut faire les courses facilement. Le seul inconvénient est que l'on entend les voisins du dessus marcher sur le parquet ! Quel dommage.
Julian et Karen sont très accueillants.

Karen and Julian have been good host though I didn't meet them.
The apartment was clean and has good location, just 5min walk to the subway, and 20min ride from the first manhattan station.
Check in and check out was very easy.
One towel was missing but they anwsered and provided us with everything we needed very fast
Thank you Karen and Julian !

Quelle déception!! Les photos sont bluffantes! Je suis restée 12 nuits avec mes 3 enfants et je le regrette. Arrivées à 23h avec mes filles, nous n'avons pu contacter mon fils arrivé plus tôt pour qu'il nous ouvre car le wifi ne marchait pas. Obligées de sonner, Julian nous a insultées même si on s'est excusées. Aucune explication préalable non plus sur l'utlisation de la key box...
Le quartier est sale (des rats dans la cour) et peu rassurant, il y a eu des coups de feu dans notre rue dans la nuit du 3 au 4 septembre avec 5 policiers blessés et le lendemain le quartier était bouclé avec les médias sur place.
L'appartement est en sous-sol, sans ouverture (pas de fenêtre), il n'y a qu'une porte que nous ne pouvions laisser ouverte pour les raisons que j'ai déjà citées. Sans climatisation, ni aération non plus, c'était étouffant quand il a fait jusqu'à 36°! Nous avons fait le ménage car le sol était noir alors que dans le prix est prévu une prestation ménage au départ, pour 4, il n' y avait que 3 chaises! Nous n'avons plu vu nos hôtes de tout notre séjour. Ah j'oubliais, si malgré tout vous souhaitez réserver à cause du prix attractif, le wifi ne marche pas donc prévoyez avant vos sorties et réservations. Pas de possibilité non plus de laisser les bagages le dernier jour quand on a un avion tard à JFK.
2 points positifs quand-même : la proximité du métro et des services (laverie, épicerie...)

I live in Ridgewood, near this apartment, but my family was coming from Spain so I wanted to put them up in a place near by for convenience of meeting up purposes. The room we rented was in the basement with access to a small terrace in the back. Very nice, clean, and quiet. It's a simple space with the main necessities that you would need if you're looking for a room to just crash in, shower, and relax after exploring the city. The only cons I would say is there was no television (for my 16 & 17 year old siblings), and there was no A/C. The hosts were very available via text with any questions I had, and according to my parents very helpful even with a language barrier. I would highly recommend Julian & Karen's airbnb to anyone traveling to new york. Easy access to the J train which takes you right into the city, and the local bodegas and stores make getting last minute groceries easy.

El apartamento tiene una cocina completa, con todos los electrodomésticos necesarios. Tanto la cama como el sofá-cama son cómodos.

La parada de metro está a 5 minutos andando y, aunque el barrio no parece muy seguro, no hemos tenido ningún problema. El tiempo medio del trayecto hasta Manhattan es de 45 minutos. Hay un supermercado en el camino hacia la parada de metro.

En cambio, el apartamento está en el sótano del edificio y, aunque tiene una escalera que da hacia el "garden", la ventilación no es la mejor. El "garden" es en realidad un espacio bastante descuidado.

Lo peor de nuestra estancia han sido los ruidos que había tanto a últimas horas del día como a horas bastante tempranas de la mañana. Estos ruidos procedían de alguna planta superior y durante esas horas parecía que no dejaban de arrastrar muebles.

El propietario, aunque no lo hemos visto ni a la llegada ni a la salida, se preocupó por nosotros y nos permitió hacer el check out a las 2pm.

En general, el apartamento está bien para un grupo de amigos que busca una buena relación calidad-precio y no les importa tardar 45 minutos en llegar a Manhattan.

The apartment was clean and it worked good with getting the keys in the lockbox. We met with Julian and he made us feel welcome. The J train is very close by and it will take you to downtown Manhattan, and other exchange hubs for other trains. It did take a while some days due to many trains in queue, so for us getting to Uptown Manhattan it took more than 1 hour. It was, as mentioned earlier, a bit noisy from upstairs, but it was acceptable. The neighborhood may look a bit unsafe at night, but nothing happened to us. We also used UBER when getting in very late.
We recommend this place for staying in NYC. It is good value for the money taking into account NYC prices for hotels etc.
Thank you from us!
Helena & Patrik
October 2015

Julian était sur place (il habite au dernier étage) et nous a rapidement mais bien accueilli. Il n'est pas toujours chez lui alors que la wifi est un vrai problème : elle ne fonctionne pas toujours et est très lente.
L'appartement est en sous-sol. Il n'a qu'une seule petite fenêtre et le voile qui la recouvre aurait besoin qu'on puisse l'attacher dans la journée. Le réfrigérateur est plutôt bruyant et les voisins de l'étage supérieur marche parfois à des heures incongrues, ce qui peut être agaçant.
Pour le reste l'appartement est correctement équipé. Il manquait cependant une chaise.
Le quartier n'est pas très entretenu mais nous avons apprécié la proximité des commerces, et notamment d'un supermarché. Chez les commerçants, nous avons fait la connaissance de plusieurs africains francophones (pratique pour demander des informations précises alors l'accent américain était un peu difficile à comprendre pour nous). La station de métro est vraiment très proche du logement. Il faut cependant se méfier des métros qui ne s'arrêtent pas toujours à la station aux heures d'affluence.

Julian hatte uns bereits lange vor der Ankunft zuvorkommend und sehr freundlich kontaktiert und sichergestellt, dass wir den Schlüssel übernehmen konnten (lockbox). Er war jederzeit ansprechbar und hat sich wirklich vorbildlich um uns gekümmert - ein sehr sympathischer Gastgeber!
Die Beschreibung der Wohnung war zutreffend. Die Wohnung selbst ist im Keller gelegen, recht geräumig und gut ausgestattet. Uns haben lediglich ein Fenster im Schlafzimmer, ein Fernseher und ein leistungsfähiges WLAN gefehlt (WLAN war zwar vorhanden, aber viel zu schwach). Auch die Küche war gut ausgestattet. Die Wohnung war ok gereinigt. Im Haus sind insgesamt drei Ferienwohnungen; wichtig zu wissen ist, dass die Wände leider wirklich sehr hellhörig sind. Abhängig von den Gästen in den anderen Wohnungen kann es also auch lauter werden.
Wirklich toll fanden wir die Lage der Wohnung, nur 5min Fußweg von der Subway "Halsey St" entfernt. Die Nachbarschaft war ordentlich und für die Lage ruhig und sauber.

L'appartement est conforme à la description. Il est proche des commerces, d'une laverie et du métro (compter 45 min jusque Manhattan centre). Les voisins du dessus sont souvent bruyants et notamment la nuit. Karen s'est montrée disponible lorsque nous avions des questions. En résumé un appartement fonctionnel qui permet de passer la nuit à un prix correct.

Listing was accurately described. It was absolutely fine for our needs... most days were spent in the city. Very close to subway station. Key was easy to acquire. Met Julian the second night.. very friendly and helpful.. wifi was very slow so he helped with that. Would definitely stay there again.

The place was nice. There are tissue, Shampoo and cooking tools. This is located basement. The most good thing was it is located near subway station. It was so nice and it takes only 30mins to Manhattan. But the wall was so thin , so I can hear upstair's sound.
Btw, the host was good and I recommend this place.

A casa é exatamente como mostrada nas fotos, limpa e perto do metrô, supermercado e tem uma boa vizinhança. Se precisar de algo ou tiver alguma dúvida pergunte ao Julian que ele irá ajudar assim que puder. A casa tem todos os utensílios de cozinha que você possa precisar. O supermercado tem TUDO o que você precisa e por um bom preço. O metrô J te leva até manhattan, e você precisa pegar mais um se quiser ir aos pontos principais da cidade, o que não demora nada e é bem fácil. Pra quem interessar, do JFK até o apt de taxi deu $42 com gorjeta, e ainda peguei trânsito. Se você e seus amigos estiverem em 3 pessoas vale muito a pena! Foi uma viagem perfeita e a estadia ajudou muito pra que ela fosse desse jeito. Obrigado Julian, nos vemos em breve

Realmente la casa cumple con todo que dice en el anuncio, esta limpia y ordenada, y cuenta con toallas y sabanas. Eramos tres y estabamos super comodas! Julian estuvo predispuesto a ayudarnos cuando lo necesitaramos.
El departamento esta a dos cuadras del subte J, lo que nos permitio movernos con facilidad. El barrio nos parecio seguro, llegamos de noche varias veces y siempre estuvo todo bien.

I just want to say that my girlfriend and I had a fantastic stay at Julian's apartment.
Firstly, Julian: We got to meet Julian and he was a thoroughly nice man and he was extremely helpful. He did not impose himself on us, but we always knew he was available.
The apartment: Exactly as described, really clean, spacious, great location and at a great price.
The place: Brooklyn is a fantastic place with so much exciting things happening around every corner. The positioning of the apartment was great also, we were never a 30 minute subway trip from anywhere.

Place was really close to the J-line, groceries and some good food (Bravo and Crown). Communication was Excellent! I had one more addition to my party and Julian was extremely helpful bringing down extra supplies. Would strongly recommend.

Julian hôte très amical. l'appartement est situé proche du metro J
l'intérieur est simple sombre confort minimum est présent. salle de bain un peu sale. quartier tranquille avec tous les commerces a proximités.

Pour l'arrivée aucune difficulté la récupération des clés a été simple.
Grosse déception en entrant dans le logement, malheuresement le sol n'a jamais été lavé, la poussiere a même formée des moutons dans tous les coins de la maison. Nous n'avons pas osé défaire le lit nous avons acheté des draps et des taies d'oreillé pour éviter d'être en contact direct avec la litterie.
le frigo très sale à l'exterieur et à l'interieur! avec une odeur suspecte ! le meuble dans lequel se trouve la vaisselle n'a jamais rencontré de depoussiérant ! des especes de rideaux devenus gris , des toiles d'araignés dans le placard à linge et dans les coins des murs. les murs étaient également très sale !
Lorsque nous étions dans l'appartement IMPOSSIBLE de fermer la porte donc nous dormions la porte ouverte !! avec 2 enfants de 10 et 7 ans mes nuits n'étaient pas tout à fait reposantes!
C'est dommage, les 40€ de ménage inclus dans le prix n'ont pas eu l'usage prévu et ce depuis très longtemps!
Je constate que le prix, que j'ai payé est passé tout de meme de 75€/jour pour arriver à 59€ /jour, je pense qu'il mérite d'etre encore réduit.
la wifi est quasi inexistante!
seuls points positifs:
L'appart proche de la station de métro et proche d'un petit supermarché .

le séjour a été formidable dommage qu'il est été terni par l'etat calamiteux du logement.

Overall, great experience! The apartment was in a basement, but it was in the excellent location, just 5 minutes walk to the subway station, so it wasn't scary to come back home late night. The hosts were super nice and friendly, and made sure we were happy with the stay. The apartment had everything we needed for the short stay, we liked it! The only thing we would change is the fact that every morning around 8am it was disturbing to hear steps, and the sound of water from the floor above, probably it was due to poor noise isolation. But if you have good sleep, then no worries!

C'est notre deuxième visite à l'appartement de Julian et nous regrettons pas notre choix. C'était propre, il n'avait pas d'odeur désagréable et c'était confortable encore une fois.

L'appartement est bien situé avec des petits commerces vraiment pratique pour déjeuner rapidement le matin. Une pharmacie 24h tout pres de la station de métro. Le métro est d'ailleurs situé très proche de l'appartement.

Le seul point négatif est le bruit de l'appartement du haut. L'appartement n'est pas insonorisé et les voisins semblent vivrent la nuit alors c'est parfois difficile. Malgré ce bruit, je reviendrais à cette place sans aucune hésitation. Pour le prix et les économies que nous faisons en louant cette appartement, c'est vraiment l'idéal. Après tout....ce n'est que pour dormir quelques heures......

Merci encore une fois Julian pour ta disponibilité et ton écoute. C'est très apprécié.

Julian was a great host!
